*Felix Nützel,Mischa Dombrowski,Luca Hagen,Bernhard Kainz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 冻结预训练自编码器的编解码器，仅在其潜空间之间插入一个离线对齐语义教师、训练时固定的可逆双Lipschitz适配器，实现免微调、参数高效的潜空间语义适配，并在两个医学影像数据集上验证其优于无约束适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练潜空间在压缩率、重建质量与下游生成器所需坐标可学习性之间存在权衡，导致跨域/跨任务适配困难：继续训练成本高，且缺乏新的对齐目标时往往无法改善下游生成。作者希望在不破坏原自编码器兼容性的前提下改善潜空间的语义组织。

Conclusion: 经过谨慎约束的事后（post-hoc）潜空间适配，是替代在生成训练中联合修改表征的一种参数高效、免调参方案。

Abstract: Pretrained latent spaces trade compression, reconstruction, and the learnability of the coordinates a downstream generator has to work in, which complicates adapting these spaces to different domains or tasks: continued training is expensive, and without a new alignment objective it often fails to improve downstream generation. We instead leave the encoder and decoder fixed and change only the coordinates between them, using an invertible bi-Lipschitz adapter aligned offline to a semantic teacher and frozen during class-conditional flow matching. Invertibility preserves compatibility with the pretrained autoencoder, while the bi-Lipschitz constraint limits how far alignment can distort its latent geometry. In contrast, unconstrained adaptation can become highly anisotropic and sensitive despite remaining invertible, highlighting the importance of controlling geometric distortion. Our results suggest that carefully constrained post-hoc adaptation offers a parameter-efficient and tuning-free alternative to jointly modifying the representation during generative training.

</details>


### [45] [When Should a Low-Light Pipeline Generate? Auditable Risk Control for Selective Generative Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21335)
*Qiyi Xie,Wei Chen Ng,Suyang Xi,Xicheng Wang,Ziyao Li,Bohong Xu,Wenyi Liu,Jian Ding Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VetoNet：将低光增强建模为"选择性生成式增强"的区域路由决策问题，基于冻结的复原+生成专家对，用无分布假设的危害预算证书（LPIPS风险）认证是否允许区域覆盖，证据不足时保守否决切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式低光增强纹理逼真但可能虚构结构，复原网络保结构却易欠增强，且两者优势在空间上非均匀。因此需要一个"在哪里覆盖冻结基专家有益、何时应拒绝切换"的可审计决策机制。

Method: 提出VetoNet区域路由框架：(1) 度量冻结的复原-生成专家对的互补强度与路由方向；(2) 仅用部署可得信号预测区域覆盖的效用；(3) 通过无分布假设的harm-budget证书，仅在LPIPS感知风险预算允许时准入覆盖，否则否决（certified veto）。

Result: 在多个专家对与域上：专家互补性可预测时获得统计显著的认证增益；专家相对强度变化时路由方向相应反转；路由证据弱或受跨域偏移影响时保守否决切换。

Conclusion: 选择性、可认证的区域路由比"全图切换"更稳健，VetoNet能依证据强弱与可靠性自适应调整路由行为，兼顾感知增益与风险可控。

Abstract: Generative low-light enhancers recover plausible texture but may hallucinate structure; restoration networks preserve structure but can leave regions under-enhanced, and neither advantage is spatially uniform. Therefore, we formulate selective generative enhancement as a decision problem: determine where overriding a frozen base expert is beneficial and refuse to switch when the evidence is insufficient. We propose VetoNet, an auditable regional routing framework centered on a certified veto. It first measures the complementary strengths and routing direction of a frozen restoration generative pair, then predicts the utility of regional overrides from deployment-available signals alone and admits an override only when a distribution-free harm-budget certificate says the perceptual (LPIPS) risk budget allows it. Experiments across multiple expert pairs and domains show that VetoNet adapts its routing behavior to the strength and reliability of the available evidence. When expert complementarity is sufficiently predictable, it achieves statistically significant certified gains; when the relative strengths of the experts change, it correspondingly reverses the routing direction; and when routing evidence is weak or affected by cross-domain shift, it conservatively vetoes switching.

</details>


### [46] [L2GSSL: Label-Efficient Local-to-Global Self-Supervised Learning for Volumetric Healthcare Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21356)
*Po-Cheng Cheng,Hung-Hsuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: L2GSSL：面向CT体数据的局部到全局自监督预训练框架，将预训练分解为层内（slice内）与层间（slice间）表示空间，用stop-gradient隔离局部空间，支持低显存三阶段训练；在LIDC-IDRI肺结节恶性分类上仅用10%/25%标签即达0.9229/0.9377 AUROC，跨数据集与跨解剖域迁移均有提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗机构积累大量高维CT体数据，但仅有极少数能被专家标注，标注稀缺成为医学影像模型训练的主要瓶颈。现有体级（volume-level）自监督方法难以在有限显存下充分利用未标注体数据，也未显式区分层内局部特征与层间全局上下文。作者希望设计一种能高效利用未标注CT体、并最大化自监督在低标注条件下的收益的预训练框架。

Method: 提出L2GSSL局部到全局自监督学习框架。将预训练分解为层内（intra-slice）与层间（inter-slice）两个表示空间：切片编码器学习视图不变的局部特征，全局编码器聚合切片token以建模体上下文；用stop-gradient将局部空间与全局目标隔离，避免局部被全局目标污染。采用逐切片执行与三阶段训练调度，在受限GPU显存下完成训练。在LIDC-IDRI上做肺结节恶性分类，并迁移到外部LNDb队列；结合切片级病灶掩码做归因分析。

Result: LIDC-IDRI肺结节恶性分类：仅10%标签达0.9229 AUROC，25%标签达0.9377，分别超过volume-level VICReg 0.0229和0.0294；使用全部标签时最强监督基线仅比L2GSSL高0.0044 AUROC。未在外部LNDb队列上适配时，用25% LIDC-IDRI微调的模型仍达0.8138 AUROC与0.7589 AUPRC，较最强被评估自监督基线提升0.1130/0.0954。实验覆盖不同数据来源、胸腹部解剖、下游任务与两种backbone，并通过病灶切片掩码表明预测依赖含病灶内容。

Conclusion: L2GSSL通过层内-层间解耦的局部到全局自监督预训练，在标注稀缺条件下显著优于体级自监督方法，且标签越少收益越明显；具备跨队列与跨解剖域的泛化性，并受病灶内容驱动，说明该框架是医学CT标注稀缺场景的有效方案。

Abstract: Healthcare institutions routinely accumulate high-dimensional computed tomography (CT) volumes, but only a fraction can be annotated by experts. We present L2GSSL, a local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that leverages unlabeled volumes by decomposing pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces. A slice encoder learns view-invariant local features, and a global encoder aggregates the resulting tokens to model volumetric context. The stop-gradient isolates the local space from the global objective, while slice-wise execution and a three-phase schedule support training under constrained GPU memory. On LIDC-IDRI lung nodule malignancy classification, L2GSSL reaches $0.9229$ AUROC with only $10\%$ of the labels and $0.9377$ with $25\%$, exceeding the volume-level VICReg by $0.0229$ and $0.0294$, respectively. With all labels, the strongest supervised baseline exceeds L2GSSL by only $0.0044$ AUROC, consistent with self-supervised pretraining providing its greatest value when annotations are limited. Without adaptation to the external LNDb cohort, a model fine-tuned on $25\%$ of LIDC-IDRI obtains $0.8138$ AUROC and $0.7589$ AUPRC, improving over the strongest evaluated self-supervised baseline by $0.1130$ and $0.0954$. Experiments across data sources, thoracic and abdominal anatomy, downstream tasks, and two backbones examine healthcare-data variety, while lesion-slice masking shows that the predictions depend on lesion-bearing content.

</details>

*Rejoy Chakraborty,Prasun Roy,Saumik Bhattacharya,Umapada Pal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoDeFont：脚本无关的一次性字体生成框架，通过多级风格-内容分解与渐进式风格-内容调和提升单参考字形风格迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单参考字形的风格信息有限，难以准确捕捉字体风格，复杂书写系统（如孟加拉文）中问题更严重。现有OFG方法缺少显式的风格-内容解耦与多层级信息利用。

Method: 1）跨多个空间层级独立聚合并互补的风格与结构信息，得到因子特异性表示；2）用对比学习目标显式分离风格与内容嵌入；3）重建时通过多级风格条件将解耦表示按解码分辨率渐进注入，兼顾风格迁移与字形结构保持。框架与脚本无关。

Conclusion: 多级风格-内容分解结合渐进式调和可有效提升单样本字体生成在多种书写系统上的泛化与保真度，验证了脚本无关OFG框架的可行性。

Abstract: One-shot Font Generation (OFG) aims to synthesize a target glyph by transferring the stylistic characteristics of a single reference glyph while preserving the structure of the target character. However, accurately capturing font style from a single reference image remains challenging due to the limited stylistic information available in a single glyph, and this challenge is further amplified for complex scripts. We propose CoDeFont, a script-agnostic OFG framework that addresses this challenge through multi-level style-content factorization and progressive style-content reconciliation. CoDeFont independently aggregates complementary style and structural information across multiple spatial levels to obtain factor-specific representations, while a contrastive objective explicitly encourages separation between style and content embeddings. During reconstruction, the disentangled representations are progressively injected through multi-level style conditioning, enabling stylistic information to be incorporated at different decoding resolutions while preserving the underlying glyph structure. We evaluate CoDeFont on structurally distinct Bengali and Latin scripts across seen and unseen font styles. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses demonstrate consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed framework for OFG across diverse writing systems.

</details>


### [48] [SATOR: Backpropagation-Free 3D Test-Time Adaptation via Sample-Adaptive Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21367)
*Inseok Kong,Geunyoung Jung,Jiyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SATOR：一种无需源数据、无需反向传播的3D点云测试时自适应框架，通过Otsu自适应划分token并做keep-ratio校准路由，在三个3D腐蚀基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免反向传播的token-purge方法依赖预设的剪枝数量候选，需要每样本多次前向传播，推理开销大。作者希望消除候选搜索，直接从单样本导出划分阈值与路由决策。

Method: SATOR从互补的注意力图与几何关系图计算token异常分数；用基于Otsu的可分性导出样本自适应的保留/剪枝划分，无需评估候选规模；再以keep-ratio校准的路由，仅当被剪枝预测的熵（经保留比例惩罚后）低于原始预测时才采用剪枝预测。属source-free、backpropagation-free的3D TTA。

Result: 在ModelNet40-C、ScanObjectNN-C、ShapeNet-C三个3D腐蚀基准上取得SOTA精度，同时免去候选规模搜索带来的多次前向开销。

Conclusion: SATOR通过样本自适应token路由，在不增加搜索成本的前提下提升了3D点云分布偏移下的测试时自适应性能，为高效3D TTA提供了新范式。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates the performance degradation of source-pretrained models on unlabeled test data under distribution shifts. Recent backpropagation-free token-purging methods address 3D point cloud distribution shifts by filtering unreliable tokens. However, their reliance on predefined purge-size candidates requires multiple forward passes per sample and increases inference cost. We propose SATOR (Sample-Adaptive TOken Routing), a source-free and backpropagation-free 3D TTA framework that eliminates this search by deriving both the partitioning threshold and routing decision directly from each sample. SATOR computes token abnormality scores from complementary attention and geometric relation graphs. It then derives a sample-specific partition into retained and pruned tokens via Otsu-based separability, without evaluating candidate sizes. Keep-ratio-calibrated routing then selects the pruned prediction only when its entropy, penalized by the keep ratio, is lower than that of the original prediction. Experiments on ModelNet40-C, ScanObjectNN-C, and ShapeNet-C demonstrate that SATOR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three 3D corruption benchmarks.

</details>


### [49] [Perception or Reasoning? Diagnosing and Tackling Reinforcement Learning Bottlenecks in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21380)
*Zeyuan Yang,Zhuohao Chen,Jiaben Chen,Yao Zhang,Maohao Shen,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PARA归因框架衡量模型-基准对上的感知与推理剩余空间，发现RL收益随感知空间增大而减小；据此提出GRAD组相对注意力蒸馏目标，直接引导弱rollout的视觉注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉任务上RL增益不稳定，因为同一基准对不同模型可能分别受限于感知或推理，缺乏对可恢复误差来源的归因手段，也就无法针对性地改进RL目标。

Method: PARA通过对比"给定更准确视觉信息"与"换用更强推理器"两种条件下可恢复的当前错误数量，量化每个模型-基准对的感知与推理headroom；随后分析现有RL目标（奖励级、token级信号）对视觉注意力的间接影响，提出GRAD：组相对注意力蒸馏，用组内最佳rollout的视觉注意力分布直接监督较弱rollout。

Result: 在4个VLM、17个多模态基准上，PARA与基准预期特性大致一致，并揭示显著的模型特异性差异；RL增益随感知headroom上升而下降、随推理headroom占比上升而增大；GRAD在两个模型规模、七个基准上持续提升性能，并与现有RL方法互补。

Conclusion: RL主要利用推理空间而非感知空间，指向视觉感知是当前RL的瓶颈；通过注意力蒸馏可直接注入感知改进信号，与RL形成互补。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has brought strong gains to language model reasoning, but its improvements on visual tasks remain less consistent. One difficulty is that visual task failures can arise from different sources: the same benchmark may be limited by perception for one model and by reasoning for another. We introduce Perception and Reasoning Attribution (PARA), which measures the remaining perceptual and reasoning headroom of each model--benchmark pair by comparing how many current errors are recovered with more accurate visual information versus a stronger reasoner. Across 4 vision-language models and 17 multimodal benchmarks, PARA broadly agrees with the expected characteristics of existing benchmarks while revealing substantial model-specific variation. More importantly, it shows that RL gains become smaller as perceptual headroom increases, but larger when reasoning explains more of the recoverable errors, suggesting that current RL exploits reasoning headroom more effectively than perceptual headroom. Motivated by this gap, we analyze how existing RL objectives affect visual perception and find that reward- and token-level signals influence visual attention only indirectly. We therefore propose GRAD, a group-relative attention distillation objective that uses the best rollout in each group to directly guide the visual attention of weaker rollouts. GRAD consistently improves performance across two model scales and seven benchmarks, and further complements existing RL methods.

</details>


### [50] [CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21409)
*Masaki Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CLAD（Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor），用匹配直线提供的全局几何上下文来增强关键点描述子，并结合 HOME 检测强弱线结构，在重复纹理场景提升匹配可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统局部描述子（SIFT、ORB）仅依赖局部图像块，在重复纹理或弱纹理场景中不同位置的特征块外观相似，导致匹配不可靠。作者希望引入全局几何结构信息来补充局部描述子。

Method: CLAD 将每个关键点表示为一个向量，向量元素编码该关键点到已匹配直线的邻近程度，从而刻画关键点与场景中直线的空间关系；使用 HOME（霍夫空间一维极值匹配）检测清晰与弱线结构，建立足量的线—关键点关联以构成上述上下文。

Result: 在 TUM RGB-D SLAM 数据集与室外视频序列上的评测表明，CLAD 给出的几何一致匹配可补充传统局部描述子的匹配结果；在局部描述子难以区分相似图像块的重复场景中，CLAD 借助全局结构提高了匹配可靠性，且计算开销小、易于实现。

Conclusion: CLAD 表明利用直线对应的全局几何上下文可有效提升弱纹理/重复纹理场景下的关键点匹配性能，作为局部描述子的互补手段，轻量实用。

Abstract: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.

</details>


### [51] [Where, How, and When: Query-Guided Grounding for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21422)
*Yogesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 博士论文，围绕"查询引导的视频 grounding"提出三类任务与模型：对象级（QDETRv 单样本、TOViT 少样本视频目标检测）、关系级（少样本指代关系，T-partite 随机场+元学习关系网络）、时刻级（MATR 视频到视频时刻检索，双阶段 DTW 对齐）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频理解需要跨粒度推理：从识别物体，到理解交互，再到定位动作发生的时刻。现有方法多面向图像或单一粒度，且新对象/新关系/新时刻的少样本泛化能力不足，因此需要一个统一的"查询—定位"视角来分别处理空间、关系与时间三类 grounding。

Method: 1) QDETRv：在 DETR 上做查询引导扩展，融合查询-上下文、记忆模块保持时序一致性、合成轨迹无监督预训练，实现视频中未见对象的一次性定位；2) TOViT：基于语言对齐的开放集视觉编码器，跨帧传播高置信度对象特征，用于少样本视频目标检测；3) 少样本指代关系：给定 (subject, predicate, object) 查询与若干共享谓词的支撑视频，用元学习关系网络（查询条件化平移嵌入、全局语义聚合、局部定位聚合、置信传播式消息传递）优化 T-partite 随机场定位实体；4) MATR：双阶段 DTW 进行融合前/后对齐、可学习查询做边界预测、时序增强自监督预训练，并扩展到文本到视频时刻检索。

Result: 在对象级、关系级、时刻级三类查询引导 grounding 任务上均取得有效性能；MATR 在视频到视频时刻检索上具备竞争力，并扩展到文本到视频时刻检索时性能与当前最优相当或更好。

Conclusion: 该论文以"查询引导"为主线，将视频定位统一为对象、关系、时刻三个粒度，分别提供单/少样本检测、结构化关系定位与 DTW 对齐的检索方案，共同推进了跨空间、关系、时间的视频理解。

Abstract: Understanding video content requires reasoning at multiple levels of granularity, from identifying objects to interpreting their interactions and localizing when specific actions occur. This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks that answer where key objects are (object-level grounding), how they interact (relationship-level grounding), and when specific moments occur (moment-level grounding). For object-level grounding, we present QDETRv, a query-guided extension of the Detection Transformer for one-shot localization of unseen objects in videos, which combines query-context fusion, a memory module for temporal consistency, and unsupervised pretraining on synthetic object trajectories. We further propose the Temporal Object-Aware Vision Transformer (TOViT) for few-shot video object detection, which builds on a language-aligned open-set vision encoder and propagates high-confidence object features across frames. For relationship-level grounding, we introduce few-shot referring relationships in videos: given a (subject, predicate, object) query and a few support videos sharing the predicate, the entities are localized by optimizing a T-partite random field using a meta-learned relation network with query-conditioned translational embeddings, Global Semantic Aggregation, Local Localization Aggregation, and belief-propagation-based message passing. For moment-level grounding, we propose the Moment Alignment Transformer (MATR) for video-to-video moment retrieval, which uses dual-stage Dynamic Time Warping for pre- and post-fusion alignment, learnable queries for boundary prediction, and self-supervised pretraining with temporal augmentations; MATR also extends to text-to-video moment retrieval with performance comparable to, or better than, the state of the art. These contributions advance query-guided video understanding across spatial, relational, and temporal grounding.

</details>


### [52] [ManiFusion: Unlocking the High-Throughput Generation via Superposition in Manifold Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21433)
*Minkyu Kim,Baekseung Kim,Junhoo Lee,Jangho Kim,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ManiFusion是一个骨干无关的扩散模型多样本生成框架，通过在去噪前融合多个样本、去噪后拆分，实现吞吐量导向的加速，并提出轨迹融合调度（TFS）动态调整融合因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成质量高但迭代去噪导致计算昂贵。现有加速方法主要降低单样本延迟，这一维度收益趋于饱和，因此作者转向正交的吞吐量方向：在单次去噪评估中并行处理多样本。

Method: 提出ManiFusion，在去噪骨干前将多个样本融合到共享的"融合空间"表示，去噪后再拆分（unfusion）；从几何视角论证多样本如何共享融合表示并保留各自生成轨迹所需信息；使用Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling（TFS）在采样过程中动态调整融合因子以匹配不同去噪阶段。

Result: 框架在扩散模型家族中通用，涵盖像素与潜空间的U-Net和Transformer骨干；可与现有加速方法组合，达到先前方法无法触及的吞吐量区间，且质量退化极小。

Conclusion: ManiFusion以吞吐量为中心、骨干无关地加速扩散生成，与现有延迟优化方法正交且可叠加，为多样本并行去噪提供了通用方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.

</details>


### [53] [RLDF: A Region-Level Deepfake Dataset and Benchmark for Partial-Face Manipulation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21438)
*Shukesh Reddy,Abhijit Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出RLDF，首个区域级深度伪造（局部面部子区域篡改）评测数据集，含超200万张局部换脸图像，并揭示现有检测器在区域级篡改下泛化下降10.5% AUC/10%准确率，同时提出掩码引导交叉注意力基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型均基于"全脸替换"或"全脸合成"的篡改图像训练，一个开放问题是：当篡改仅限于局部面部子区域时，现成检测器能否有效检测？作者旨在填补区域级深度伪造评测的空白。

Method: 提出区域感知部分换脸合成模型，用8种换脸方法生成超200万张局部换脸图像；定义7个面部区域（4个离散区域：眼、鼻、嘴、眉；4个复合区域：眼+鼻；眼+鼻+嘴；眼+鼻+嘴+眉；全脸）；设计3种评测协议，在5个标准跨数据集评测、DF40及自建RLDF上对12种SOTA检测器进行基准测试；并提出掩码引导的交叉注意力（mask-guided cross-attention）模型作为区域级检测基线。

Result: 现有检测器在部分面部区域上无法一致泛化，区域级评测下整体下降10.5% AUC和10%准确率；所提出的掩码引导交叉注意力基线可有效检测区域级篡改。数据集、代码与检查点已开源。

Conclusion: RLDF填补了区域级深度伪造评测的空白，系统性审计了现有检测器的失效位置与原因，并提供可有效检测区域级篡改的基线方法，推动更细粒度的深度伪造检测研究。

Abstract: Existing deepfake detection models are built upon manipu- lated images that are tampered with either exclusively fully swapped or fully synthesised faces, which leads us to an open question: Can off-the-shelf deepfake models detect manipulation effectively while tampering is confined to a local facial sub-region? To fill this gap, we introduce RLDF (Region-Level Deepfake), the first dataset for region-level deepfake evaluation. Employing the proposed region-aware partial swap synthesis model, we generate over 2M par- tial face-swap images by using eight face-swapping meth- ods. Altogether, we considered seven face regions, among which there are four discrete regions (eye, nose, mouth and eyebrow) and four composite facial regions (eye and nose; eye, nose and mouth; eye, nose, mouth and eye- brow; and full face). In addition, we define three evalu- ation protocols and benchmark 12 state-of-the-art detectors across the five popular standard cross-dataset evaluations, DF40, and the proposed RLDF, providing a comprehen- sive audit of where and why existing detectors underper- formed. Our evaluation reveals that existing detectors fail to generalize consistently across partial facial regions, re- sulting in an overall drop of 10.5% AUC and 10% accu- racy under region-level evaluation. Further, we propose a mask-guided cross-attention model as a baseline approach that can effectively detect region-level manipulation. The proposed dataset, code, and checkpoints are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [54] [PET Quantification-Preserving Registration for Longitudinal Whole-Body PSMA PET/CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21451)
*Fryderyk Kögl,Anna Reithmeir,Daniel M. Lang,Emily Chan,Rickmer Braren,Julia A. Schnabel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将LapIRN粗到细微分同胚配准架构适配于纵向全身PSMA PET/CT配准（Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg挑战），引入MTV/TLG生物标志物保持损失与骨骼刚性正则，达到81.0% DSC、6.17 mm HD95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向全身PSMA PET/CT配准需在多模态形变配准中保持代谢肿瘤生物标志物（MTV、TLG）的定量一致性，同时兼顾骨骼结构的刚性约束，而通用配准方法未显式建模此类临床量化指标。

Result: 官方评估协议下DSC 81.0%、HD95 6.17 mm，MTV误差3.3%、TLG误差3.3%；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作表明将领域量化指标（MTV/TLG）与解剖刚性先验嵌入微分同胚配准框架，可在多模态全身PET/CT纵向配准中兼顾几何精度与生物标志物一致性，属医学影像配准的挑战赛方案。

Abstract: We adapt the diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN architecture for longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge. The method combines affine pre-registration, multi-modal deformable registration, and test-time instance optimization. We further introduce PET biomarker preservation losses for metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG), including Jacobian-based constraints, and a per-structure rigidity regularization for skeletal structures. The submitted configuration achieved 81.0% DSC and 6.17 mm HD95, with MTV and TLG errors of 3.3% and 3.3%, respectively, on our evaluation protocol. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [55] [Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21459)
*Wenkai Li,Wenyi Hong,Zhuoyi Yang,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP) 协议，验证图像生成训练能否向纯文本问答迁移新知识，并发现视觉监督到语言存在直接但不均衡的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型在图像生成训练中接触到大量文本未记录的信息，作者想探究生成式视觉监督是否能成为语言知识的新来源，以及这种跨模态知识迁移的可及性与局限。

Method: 设计 KTP 控制协议：通过图像生成训练注入新知识，再用纯文本问答测试可及性；覆盖 7 类知识与 3 个 UMM；随后引入 Textual Alignment 与 Interleaved Image-Text Alignment 两种对齐方式，连接生成与问答。

Result: 观察到直接但不均衡的迁移；对部分实体的引导可提升其他实体的知识可及性且无需 QA 监督，交错对齐带来额外增益；图像中正确复现的知识往往在文本中更易获取，但两种访问方式之间仍存在显著差距。

Conclusion: 视觉生成可作为超出文本监督的知识来源，需要结合训练数据设计与模型架构的联合研究，使该知识更广泛可及。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? We introduce Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), a controlled protocol that supplies new knowledge through image-generation training and tests its accessibility through text-only question answering. Across seven knowledge categories and three UMMs, we observe direct but uneven transfer from visual supervision to language. Motivated by these observations, we successively introduce Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image--Text Alignment, which connect generation and answering through shared knowledge and interleaved responses, respectively. Guidance on selected entities can improve knowledge access on other entities without QA supervision, with additional gains from interleaved alignment. Further analysis shows that knowledge correctly reproduced in images is often more accessible through text, although substantial gaps remain between the two forms of access. These findings support visual generation as a source of knowledge beyond textual supervision, and motivate joint investigation of training data design and model architecture to make this knowledge more broadly accessible.

</details>


### [56] [Cross-Prompt Inference Mitigates Rare-Class Suppression in Imbalanced VLM Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21470)
*Emanuel Ben Baruch,Sivan Biham,Alon Shoshan,Yochai Zvik,Avi Ben-Cohen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 发现视觉语言模型在类不平衡微调后存在"匹配提示惩罚"：推理时改用与微调不同的描述性提示（cross-prompt inference）可恢复稀有类召回率，机制在于降低了模型对微调计算的依赖、回归预训练组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在类不平衡数据上微调后，稀有类召回率可能低于其自身零样本水平。作者想探究这种稀有类知识是否真的被"遗忘"，还是仅仅被微调抑制、仍可通过推理策略重新访问。

Method: 在六个数据集、多种 VLM 上对比"匹配提示"（复用微调时的描述性提示）与"跨提示"（cross-prompt，使用不同的描述性提示）的推理效果；检验效应是否依赖描述性内容变化；利用 Tuning Contribution (TuCo) 将模型计算分解为预训练部分与微调部分，分析跨提示推理对二者依赖的影响。

Result: 跨提示推理一致地恢复稀有类召回率，但伴随频繁类召回率的权衡变化；该效应源于训练-评估提示交互而非单纯提示质量，非描述性提示改动无法复现；效应在不平衡与视觉混淆严重、稀有类被强抑制时最强，无抑制时则微弱或不存在；TuCo 分析显示跨提示推理减少对微调计算的依赖并向预训练组件偏移，削弱微调贡献也会显著削弱该优势。

Conclusion: 被不平衡微调抑制的稀有类知识并未真正丢失，仍可在不同推理提示下被访问。这提示了训练-推理提示一致性假设的局限，并为缓解类不平衡下的性能退化提供了无需重训的推理期方法。

Abstract: When a vision-language model is finetuned on class-imbalanced data, rare-class recall can fall well below the model's own zero-shot performance. In this regime, we uncover a surprising matched-prompt penalty whereby the standard choice of reusing the descriptive finetuning prompt at inference can yield lower rare-class recall than using a different descriptive prompt. We call this inference-time strategy cross-prompt inference. We evaluate diverse VLMs across six datasets and find that cross-prompt inference consistently recovers rare-class recall, with varying trade-offs in frequent-class recall. The effect reflects a train-eval prompt interaction rather than prompt quality alone, and does not arise with non-descriptive prompt changes. It is strongest when imbalance and visual confusability produce substantial rare-class suppression, and is weak or absent when such suppression does not occur. Using Tuning Contribution (TuCo), which decomposes a model's computation into pretrained and finetuning parts, we find that cross-prompt inference reduces reliance on finetuning-induced computation and shifts the model toward its pretrained component. Reducing that finetuning contribution also substantially reduces the cross-prompt advantage. These results show that rare-class knowledge suppressed by imbalanced finetuning can remain accessible under a different inference prompt.

</details>


### [57] [GRASE: Geometry-native Real-to-sim Agentic Scene Modeling from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21498)
*Zhaorui Lin,Haohan Liu,Zhen Chen,Xiangru Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRASE：以视频观测为持续参照的智能体式真实到仿真转换框架，通过反馈闭环迭代修正中间估计，生成跨视图一致、可用于仿真的3D场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有真实到仿真（real-to-sim）方法多采用单次、松耦合流水线：各阶段仅从前一阶段获得有限反馈，误差逐级累积且缺乏可靠校正，导致最终场景几何与布局不一致。作者希望用闭环反馈打破固定中间假设的局限。

Method: GRASE将捕获的多视图视频作为贯穿建模过程的"常驻参照"。首先由深度与多视图线索拟合建筑外壳及其开口；随后由智能体在共享坐标系中放置生成资产并校验其空间关系；最后对每个资产的几何与位姿进行迭代细化，以提升与各观测视图的一致性。各步骤通过反馈耦合，可定位结构性偏差并仅修正应负责的组件，同时保持跨视图一致。

Result: 实验表明GRASE显著优于现有最先进方法，包括直接使用GPT6-Astra进行的真实到仿真转换。

Conclusion: 以观测为常驻参照的智能体闭环修正范式，能有效抑制流水线误差传播，产出忠于输入、跨视图一致且适配仿真的3D场景，为真实到仿真提供更强的可编辑场景重建路径。

Abstract: Real-to-sim conversion aims to turn a captured video of a real environment into an editable 3D scene while preserving the geometry and layout of what was observed. Existing methods often follow a one-pass, loosely coupled paradigm: each stage receives only limited feedback from previous stages, allowing errors to propagate without reliable correction and leaving the final scene inconsistent. We present GRASE, an agentic framework that closes this loop by treating the captured multi-view video observations as a standing reference throughout scene modeling. Instead of committing to intermediate estimates, GRASE revises its current hypothesis whenever rendered evidence disagrees with the capture, overcoming the fixed intermediate assumptions of conventional pipelines. Specifically, GRASE first fits the architectural shell and its openings from depth and multi-view cues. An agent then places generated assets in a shared coordinate frame while checking their spatial relationships. Finally, each asset's geometry and placement are refined iteratively to improve agreement across the observed views. By coupling these steps through feedback, GRASE localizes structural discrepancies and revises only the responsible components, while preserving cross-view consistency. The resulting 3D scenes are faithful to the input, consistent across views, and suitable for simulations. In our experiments, GRASE substantially outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, including a direct real-to-sim conversion using GPT6-Astra.

</details>


### [58] [FilterFusion: Prior-Guided Adaptive Filter Fusion for Efficient Video Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21505)
*Wenlong Yang,Weihang Yuan,Canran Jin,Jiahao Li,Henrik Turbell,Lifeng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FilterFusion，一种先验引导的多帧去噪框架，将时序感知学习特征与可解释滤波器组分支结合，通过低分辨率控制器预测低成本引导信号并自适应混合去噪响应，实现实时视频去噪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实视频去噪需同时处理传感器噪声、压缩伪影与运动不一致，且须满足严格时延预算。纯深度模型精度高但计算昂贵，传统滤波器高效鲁棒但自适应性不足，因此需要兼顾质量、效率与速度的方案。

Method: FilterFusion 在原始分辨率上自适应混合一组紧凑的滤波器响应（高斯模糊、中值、加权求和等），由低分辨率控制器预测引导信号；控制器显式注入时序方差与空间方差线索以增强自适应性。全模型仅 109K 参数，网络部分仅 0.18 GFLOPs，合成路径可用简单规则的编译 C 实现。

Result: 在 CRVD 真实传感器噪声数据集上达到 34.72 dB PSNR / 0.9330 SSIM；1080p 下单 CPU 线程 17.9ms/帧（55.9 FPS），超过实时且比需 2 秒以上的轻量 CNN 基线快 122–252 倍。

Conclusion: 低分辨率控制加显式滤波器合成的设计在质量、效率与速度间取得良好折中，为通信系统中的实时视频去噪提供了可部署的实用路径。

Abstract: Real-world video denoising for communication systems must handle mixed degradations such as sensor noise, compression artifacts, and motion-induced inconsistency while remaining deployable under tight latency budgets. Purely deep models often achieve high accuracy but come with significant computational cost, whereas classical filters are robust and efficient but insufficiently adaptive. We present FilterFusion, a prior-guided multi-frame denoising framework that combines temporally-aware learned features with an interpretable bank of denoising branches. The model predicts a low-cost guidance signal and uses it to adaptively mix a compact set of denoising responses at the original resolution. The lightweight design uses only 109K parameters and explicitly injects temporal variance and spatial variance cues into the low-resolution controller. On CRVD (real sensor noise), it reaches 34.72 dB PSNR and 0.9330 SSIM with only 0.18 GFLOPs (network-only). Because the filter-bank operations are simple and regular (Gaussian blur, median, weighted sum), a straightforward compiled C implementation of the synthesis path achieves 17.9ms per frame (55.9 FPS) on a single CPU thread at 1080p---exceeding real-time and 122--252 times faster than lightweight CNN baselines that require over 2 seconds per frame. The results demonstrate a strong quality-efficiency-speed trade-off and a practical route to real-time denoising through low-resolution control and explicit filter-based synthesis.

</details>


### [59] [Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance for TI2I Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21550)
*Andreas Floros,Elena Koritska,Teofilo de Campos,Christoph Vogel,Chu-Tak Li,Anuj Sharma,Alexandros Neophytou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究了文本+图像到图像(TI2I)的流匹配可控图像编辑方法,发现CFG机制在流建模的噪声阶段对编辑隐含有害,并对此提出一种仅在早期流步骤中应用的简单修正方法,在像素空间和潜空间TI2I流上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG是生成建模中保证高质量输出的关键组件,但作者认为其在TI2I建模中的作用被严重忽视。作者做出一个反直觉的观察:CFG机制在流建模的噪声阶段实际上会损害编辑效果,阻碍指令遵循与可控性,因此需要重新审视CFG在TI2I中的角色。

Method: 针对CFG在TI2I流匹配早期(噪声)阶段带来的负面影响,提出一种简单的修正:仅在早期流步骤中对该机制进行校正,从而在不增加额外计算成本的前提下获得更丰富的"对齐-保真度"权衡,并在像素空间与潜空间的TI2I流模型上进行了验证。

Result: 在像素空间和潜空间两类TI2I流匹配模型上均展示了该方法的有效性,表明早期流步骤的修正能够改善指令遵循与编辑可控性,且不带来额外开销。

Conclusion: CFG在TI2I流匹配中并非一贯有益,尤其在噪声阶段会损害编辑可控性;通过在早期流步骤施加简单修正即可改善对齐与保真度的权衡,为可控图像编辑提供了低成本且通用的改进方案。

Abstract: We study Text-and-Image-to-Image (TI2I) flow matching methods for controllable image editing. In a broader generative modeling context, Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is established as a key component responsible for high quality outputs. However, we argue that its role in TI2I modeling is poorly understood. Specifically, we make the surprising observation that the CFG mechanism is implicitly harmful for editing in the noisy phase of flow modeling, hindering instruction following and controllability. We propose a simple correction in the early flow steps, enabling a richer alignment-preservation tradeoff at no extra cost. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on both pixel-space and latent TI2I flows.

</details>


### [60] [Decoupled Safety Control: A Safety-Control Algorithm for Training-Free Safety Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21569)
*Huilin Zhou,Ruoxi Cheng,Yuhang Wang,Yuming Liu,Minghao Sun,Ruolong Ma,Lan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DSC（Decoupled Safety Control），一种即插即用的免训练安全引导算法，将安全控制重构为显式的状态依赖控制过程，使干预由当前生成状态决定而非直接继承自单一不安全条件，从而在抑制不安全内容的同时保持良性生成质量与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练安全引导方法多依赖"耦合式安全控制链"：同一个不安全条件同时承担"应避免什么"、"当前不安全信号"、"构造干预"和"干预何时失效"四个角色。当危险与良性语义在生成状态中纠缠时，这种耦合会失效，导致残留不安全内容，或过度牺牲良性生成质量与提示词保真度。

Method: DSC 将免训练安全引导形式化为显式的状态依赖控制过程（state-dependent control process），把实际执行的干预与单一不安全条件解耦，由当前生成状态来动态决定干预内容与作用时机，作为插件接入已有 latent-space 与 text-space 安全防护模块。

Result: 在标准安全基准上，DSC 提升了代表性 latent-space 与 text-space 安全防护方法的表现，实现更强的不安全内容抑制，同时保持良性生成质量与高效推理。

Conclusion: 解耦安全控制链、以状态驱动干预的设计，可为免训练安全引导提供更可靠的推理期防护，兼顾安全性与生成质量。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong performance in text-to-image generation, but they can still produce unsafe content. Training-free safety guidance offers a practical inference-time alternative that intervenes during sampling without modifying model weights. However, many existing safeguards still rely on a coupled safety-control chain. In this chain, the same unsafe condition simultaneously specifies what should be avoided, indicates the current unsafe signal, constructs the intervention, and determines when that intervention remains active. This coupling can work when unsafe factors are explicit, but becomes less reliable once harmful and benign semantics are entangled in the current generation state, often leaving residual unsafe content or unnecessarily degrading benign-generation quality or prompt fidelity. We address this problem with Decoupled Safety Control (DSC), a plug-in safety-control algorithm for training-free safety guidance. DSC reformulates training-free safety guidance as an explicit state-dependent control process, so the executed intervention is determined from the current generation state rather than inherited directly from a single unsafe condition. Experiments on standard safety benchmarks show that DSC improves representative latent- and text-space safeguards, achieving stronger unsafe-content suppression while preserving benign-generation quality and maintaining efficient inference.

</details>


### [61] [MYOPIA: Understanding the Limits of Tree-Based Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21573)
*Islam Mesabah,Sary Elmansoury,Gerrit Großmann,Peter Neigel,Sebastian J. Vollmer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出MYOPIA基准，用LLM生成并人工精炼的决策树替代VLM单次预测，在4个数据集、3个模型共12组设置中系统揭示决策树遍历一致劣于零样本提示，并诊断出属性回忆与图像接地脱节、早期错误不可逆等失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策树可通过根到叶的问答序列使VLM分类可解释，但这种贪心、不回退的遍历带来多大精度代价尚不清楚，缺乏系统评测框架。

Method: 构建MYOPIA基准：针对GTSRB、MNIST、CIFAR-10、MSCOCO构造4棵由LLM生成、人工精炼的决策树，配套匹配提示、诊断协议与评测工具；在GPT-4o、Qwen-VL Max、LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision上开展配对bootstrap分析与节点级审计（分割熵、深度、分支因子、节点内接地差异）。

Result: 12组数据集-模型组合中决策树遍历全部低于零样本提示，配对bootstrap一致支持零样本；标签-图像接地精度差距分别为GPT-4o 9.5、Qwen-VL Max 13.8、LLaMA 12.6个百分点；错误局部决策不可逆地排除正确类别，答案抽取带来额外模型相关损失；分割熵与节点精度下降弱但稳定相关。

Conclusion: MYOPIA提供了诊断层次化视觉分类的框架，说明当前决策树式VLM推理存在系统性缺陷，未来应设计优先考虑感知可回答性与早期错误恢复的树结构。

Abstract: Decision trees can make vision-language model (VLM) classification interpretable by replacing a single prediction with a sequence of root-to-leaf questions. However, the accuracy cost of this greedy, non-backtracking procedure remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MYOPIA}, a benchmark comprising four LLM-generated, human-refined decision trees for GTSRB, MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MSCOCO, together with matched prompts, diagnostic protocols, and an evaluation harness. Across GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision, tree traversal underperforms zero-shot prompting in all 12 dataset--model pairs; paired bootstrap analyses consistently favor zero-shot. Our diagnostics characterize interacting failure modes associated with this gap. Models often recall tree-encoded class attributes more accurately than they ground the same attributes in images: the mean label--image accuracy gaps are 9.5, 13.8, and 12.6 points for GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA, respectively. Incorrect local decisions then irreversibly exclude the correct class, while answer extraction introduces additional model-dependent loss. A node-level audit of the four trees finds that split entropy is weakly but consistently associated with lower node accuracy, whereas depth, branching factor, and within-node grounding differences are less stable. \textbf{MYOPIA} therefore provides a framework for diagnosing hierarchical visual classification and motivates testing tree designs that prioritize perceptual answerability and recovery from early errors. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [62] [Hear, Localize, and Reason: Spatially Aware Scene Understanding for Audio-Visual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21588)
*Kim Sung-Bin,Lee Jung-Mok,Jinwoo Jung,Oh Hyun-Bin,Hyeonggon Ryu,David Harwath,Tae-Hyun Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HLR-AVSceneQA 基准（hear-localize-reason 层级）与 HLR-LLM：在视听大模型中并行加入双耳空间音频分支，并以含思维链监督的课程学习训练，实现空间音源定位与关系推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AV-LLM 多把音频当作单声道语义内容，缺乏对"声音来自何处"及"声源与视觉场景关系"的推理能力；已有空间视听工作多只针对单一能力（空间对应或方向/距离推理），缺少统一评测与系统建模方案。

Method: 构建 HLR-AVSceneQA 基准，按"听到什么—定位声源（自我中心/异我中心视角）—关系推理"三层级评测。模型 HLR-LLM 在强视听基座模型上，保留单声道语义音频通路并额外增加双耳空间音频分支；训练采用课程式策略，末阶段引入思维链监督以支持多步空间推理。

Result: 实验中现有 AV-LLM 在空间定位与关系推理上表现受限；HLR-LLM 显著提升空间视听场景理解，且不损害语义视听感知性能。

Conclusion: 空间音频分支结合层级化基准与课程式 CoT 监督，可作为提升 AV-LLM 空间理解的有效范式，同时揭示当前模型在空间 grounding 上的普遍短板。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) have made strong progress in multimodal understanding, yet most treat audio as monaural semantic content, limiting their ability to reason about where sounds originate and how they relate to the visual scene. Recent spatial audio-visual studies address parts of this problem, but often focus on specific abilities, such as spatial correspondence or direction and distance reasoning. In this work, we introduce HLR-AVSceneQA, a comprehensive benchmark with a hear-localize-reason hierarchy that evaluates whether models can recognize what is heard, localize sound sources in egocentric and allocentric views, and use these localized sources to reason about how they relate to the visual scene. We further introduce HLR-LLM, which augments a strong audio-visual foundation model with a binaural spatial audio branch alongside its monaural semantic audio pathway. We train HLR-LLM with a curriculum that incorporates final-stage chain-of-thought supervision for multi-step spatial reasoning. Experiments show that existing AV-LLMs remain limited in spatial grounding and relational reasoning, while HLR-LLM substantially improves spatial audio-visual scene understanding without compromising semantic audio-visual perception.

</details>


### [63] [A Decision-Aware Evaluation Protocol for Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21616)
*Saket Maganti,Shreyank N Gowda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出一种"决策感知"的医学分割不确定性评估协议，将不确定性估计与延迟复核策略解耦，在固定复核预算下评估二者的组合效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学分割不确定性评估多依赖校准误差或像素级错误检测指标，这些指标无法反映不确定性是否真正改善了下游的复核决策（哪些像素/区域/图像应直接接受、哪些应交由人工复核）。

Method: 提出决策感知评估协议：分离不确定性估计器与延迟策略，在固定复核预算下评估组合表现；报告固定预算误差下降、风险-覆盖率行为、区域级复核代理指标、结构性失效模式、概率派生基线以及对复核假设的敏感性。在视网膜血管、皮肤病变、息肉分割任务上，跨多种骨干网络与不确定性估计器实例化该协议，并进行架构与Dropout位置检查。

Result: 在匹配推理预算与标准多层MC Dropout下，TTA在匹配的MC-TTA对比中提供更强的错误检测信号；但估计器排名并非普适：概率派生分数仍具竞争力，深度集成可超越TTA，学习式延迟主要在基础估计器较弱时有效，且排名随复核单元、不确定性目标、校正假设与成本模型而变化。结构与第二观察者分析显示边界和细结构失效部分源于标注歧义。

Conclusion: 应将不确定性作为"估计器-策略-复核"配置整体来评估，而非独立的分数图。

Abstract: Medical segmentation uncertainty is often evaluated with calibration error or pixel-level error-detection scores, but these metrics do not show whether uncertainty improves downstream review decisions. We propose a decision-aware evaluation protocol that separates uncertainty estimation from deferral policy and evaluates their combination under fixed review budgets: which pixels, regions, or images should be accepted, and which should be reviewed. The protocol reports fixed-budget error reduction, risk-coverage behaviour, region-level review proxies, structural failure modes, probability-derived baselines, and sensitivity to review assumptions. We instantiate it across retinal vessel, skin lesion, and polyp segmentation with multiple backbones and uncertainty estimators. Under matched inference budgets and canonical multi-layer MC Dropout, test-time augmentation (TTA) gives a stronger error-detection signal across matched MC--TTA comparisons, including architecture and dropout-placement checks. However, estimator rankings are not universal. For example, probability-derived scores remain competitive, deep ensembles can outperform TTA, learned deferral helps mainly when the base estimator is weak, and rankings can change with review unit, uncertainty target, correction assumptions, and cost model. Structural and second-observer analyses further show that boundary and thin-structure failures are partly tied to annotation ambiguity. These findings support evaluating uncertainty as an estimator-policy-review configuration, not as a standalone score map. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [64] [Anchor3DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Compact Anchor-Based Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21634)
*Sheng Ye,Jiangke Lin,Fudong Wang,Yi Yuan,Zhen-Hui Dong,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无位姿前馈3DGS框架Anchor3DGS，用信息熵引导的稀疏3D anchor替代逐像素高斯预测，在保持SOTA新视角合成质量的同时将高斯数量减少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法普遍采用pixel-aligned范式，即每个输入像素预测一个高斯，导致高斯数量与输入分辨率、视角数强耦合；在无纹理区域产生大量冗余基元，而在几何复杂区域覆盖不足。

Method: 以信息熵为指导在场景中布置一组3D anchor，在高视觉复杂度区域加密、同时保持全局空间覆盖；每个anchor对多视角图像特征做遮挡感知聚合（occlusion-aware aggregation），并在anchor之间进行信息交互，随后解码为一组局部高斯；另设轻量特征增强模块对高斯splatting输出的粗糙RGB进行细化，提升渲染保真度。整个框架为pose-free前馈式。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法达到SOTA的新视角合成质量，且所需高斯基元数量比对比方法少约一个数量级。

Conclusion: 将前馈3DGS从像素对齐表示解耦为紧凑anchor表示，可在显著压缩高斯预算的同时维持甚至提升渲染质量，说明基于熵的稀疏场景表示是前馈3D重建的有效方向。

Abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have enabled effective multi-view 3D reconstruction by predicting Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass. However, existing approaches predominantly adopt a pixel-aligned paradigm that predicts one Gaussian per input pixel, coupling the Gaussian count to the input resolution and number of views. This also leads to redundant primitives in textureless regions and insufficient coverage in geometrically complex areas. We present Anchor3DGS, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that replaces pixel-aligned prediction with a compact anchor-based representation. Guided by information entropy, our method places a set of 3D anchors in the scene, concentrating them in regions of higher visual complexity while maintaining broad spatial coverage. Each anchor performs occlusion-aware aggregation of multi-view image features, exchanges information with other anchors, and is decoded into a set of local Gaussians. A lightweight feature enhancement module further refines the coarse RGB output from Gaussian splatting and improves rendering fidelity. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our Anchor3DGS achieves state-of-the-art novel view synthesis quality while only using an order of magnitude fewer Gaussian primitives.

</details>


### [65] [Spurious Attention Heads in Vision Transformers: Mechanistic Identification of Annotation-Driven Bias in Medical Chest X-Ray Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21638)
*Joshua Muhumuza,Cornelius Kalenzi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用机制可解释性方法在ViT-Base/16中定位到一个虚假关联注意力头L8H10，它专门"阅读"胸片角落标注文本而非肺实质病变，且单头/多头消融均无法在输出层面暴露该电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像中的ViT会利用虚假相关（shortcut），但其内部机制不明、难以修正。作者希望用机制可解释性定位具体电路，并检验这种电路是否被行为层面评估所掩盖。

Method: 对ViT-Base 16做注意力头级机制分析，识别出L8H10为"标注阅读头"；用inpainting做因果验证（排除亮度/边缘密度）；跨NIH ChestX-ray14、DeiT-Base、ViT-Large 16复现；对比全量微调及单头/多头消融对输出指标的影响。

Result: 200张COVID-19胸片中62%图像的L8H10关注角落文本；移除标注后肺部注意力提升1.52倍（p<0.0001）；复现率NIH 79%、DeiT-Base 88%、ViT-Large 80%；全量微调未抑制该行为（98.4%虚假图像仍虚假，比例略升）；单头消融p=0.340、三头多头消融p=0.532。

Conclusion: ViT家族存在一致的"标注阅读头"虚假关联特性，且该因果验证过的电路对输出级评估完全不可见；机制审计能发现行为测试无法发现的问题。

Abstract: Vision Transformers deployed in medical imaging exploit spurious correlations, yet the internal mechanisms remain unidentified and impossible to fix. We apply mechanistic interpretability to locate one such mechanism in ViT-Base 16: a single attention head (L8H10) that functions as a dedicated annotation-reader on chest X-rays, attending to corner text rather than lung pathology in 62% of 200 COVID-19 images. Causal validation via inpainting confirms annotation content rather than luminance or edge density drives the behaviour, increasing lung attention 1.52 times upon removal in affected images ($p{<}0.0001$). The finding replicates across NIH ChestX-ray14 (79%), DeiT-Base (88%), and ViT-Large 16 (80%), establishing spurious annotation-attending heads as a consistent property of ViT-family architectures across two datasets and three architectures. Full fine-tuning does not suppress the behaviour and may entrench it: 98.4% of spurious images remain spurious and the spurious rate rises marginally, as the shortcut is reinforced rather than removed. Critically, single-head ablation produces $p{=}0.340$ and multi-head ablation of all three identified carriers produces $p{=}0.532$, meaning a causally verified annotation-reading circuit is completely invisible to output-level evaluation. Mechanistic auditing finds what behavioural testing cannot.

</details>


### [66] [DIAL: Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law for Reliable Weather Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21639)
*Yucheng Wang,Haonan Guo,Tianhao Zhao,Di Wang,Yu Wu,Zengmao Wang,Bo Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIAL 在推理阶段冻结天气预报模型，学习按变量与尺度预测扩散噪声的增减，并用噪声扰动对后续精度的影响做引导，实现尺度分辨的集合可靠性校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合天气预报在全局平均上看似可靠，但不同变量、空间尺度、预报时效和天气状态下的离散度存在过大/过小误差；训练期固定随机性、后处理只能在输出端校准、推理引导又常逐成员打分而非评价集合整体，且末端的可靠性反馈难以穿越大量混沌预报步稳定回传。

Method: DIAL（Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law）控制冻结模型的固有随机性：从历史预报中学习预测各变量与尺度需要的离散度增减；在预报推进中估计可能的噪声变化对后续预报精度与可靠性的影响；二者结合，在每一步对噪声做小幅度更新，形成推理闭环，无需重训天气模型也不必对整个预报做完整反向传播。

Result: 在 FourCastNet 3（FCN3）上，用训练时未见的较晚 ERA5 年份评估：DIAL 的尺度分辨可靠性优于学习式后处理与基于奖励的控制基线；相比未修改的 Native FCN3，主要多尺度 CRPS 提升 8.27%。

Conclusion: 在推理阶段对预训练随机动力模型施加动态、有信息的噪声调控，可在不重训、不做全局反传的前提下改善集合预报的尺度分辨可靠性，是随机性控制与可靠性反馈闭环相结合的有效方案。

Abstract: Ensemble weather forecasts can look reliable in global averages while hiding too little spread in some cases and too much in others. These errors vary across variables, spatial scales, lead times, and weather states. Adapting randomness during forecasting can correct these errors, but training fixes stochastic behavior beforehand and output calibration acts afterward. Inference guidance also acts during forecasting, but typically scores ensemble members separately rather than the ensemble as a whole. Reliability feedback arrives at the end, and tracing it backward through many chaotic forecast steps is expensive and unstable. We therefore introduce Dynamic and Informed Adjustment of the Native Stochastic Law (DIAL), which controls a frozen model's native stochasticity. DIAL learns from past forecasts to predict whether each variable and scale needs more or less spread. As a forecast develops, it estimates how possible noise changes will affect later forecast accuracy and reliability. It combines these predictions to make small noise updates at each step. This loop avoids retraining the weather model and full backpropagation through the forecast. We evaluate DIAL on FourCastNet 3 (FCN3) using later ERA5 years unseen during training. DIAL provides better scale-resolved reliability than learned postprocessing and reward-based control baselines. Relative to the unmodified Native FCN3 reference, DIAL achieves an 8.27% improvement in the primary multiscale continuous ranked probability score (CRPS).

</details>


### [67] [SCMerge: Spatial-Consistency-Aware Token Pair Merging for Efficient Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21642)
*Junfeng Ren,Yi Gong,Yuan Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCMerge 是一种免训练的词元合并方法，同时利用特征相似度与空间一致性来成对合并 ViT 编码器中的词元，以在语义分割中取得精度与效率的更好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 在语义分割上表现优异，但注意力二次复杂度限制实际应用；现有词元合并方法仅依赖特征相似度识别相似词元，忽略空间一致性，易在语义分割中引入分割错误。

Method: 提出 SCMerge：免训练的词元合并方法，联合考虑特征相似度与空间一致性来配对相似词元；配对后的词元在编码器内合并，解码后再将所得词元序列重建回原始 patch 网格；方法可灵活插入现有基于 ViT 的语义分割流程。

Result: 在 ADE20K、Pascal Context、Cityscapes 基准数据集上，SCMerge 相较基线方法一致地取得更好的分割精度与效率权衡。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模特征相似度与空间一致性，SCMerge 在不需训练的情况下有效提升 ViT 语义分割的精度-效率权衡，具有即插即用性。

Abstract: Vision Transformer architectures have showcased impressive performance on semantic segmentation, yet their quadratic attention complexity hinders practical applications. Recent works have focused on merging tokens to reduce sequence length and thus improve transformer efficiency. However, existing token merging methods primarily rely on feature similarity to identify similar tokens, overlooking spatial consistency, which may introduce segmentation errors in semantic segmentation. In this work, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that jointly considers feature similarity and spatial consistency in pairing similar tokens. The pairwise tokens are then merged within the encoder, and the resulting token sequences are reconstructed onto the original patch grid after decoding. The proposed method is flexible and can be plugged into existing vision Transformer-based semantic segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes show that SCMerge consistently achieves a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and efficiency than baseline methods.

</details>


### [68] [Digital Typhoon Dataset V3: Benchmarking for Multi-spectral Extension and Analyzing Systematic Bias in Intensity Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21654)
*Asanobu Kitamoto,Victor Le Louarn,Noelia Falczuk,Ngoc Anh Tong,Anja Veleva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Digital Typhoon Dataset V3：近50年最长台风卫星影像数据集，新增多光谱数据，评估数据划分与南北半球基准，发现多通道未优于单通道，ResNet-18+全分辨率+Channel 1最佳，并揭示强度回归存在对强台风低估的系统性偏差，失衡加权不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有台风卫星影像数据集时间跨度有限，且缺乏多光谱通道与长期时空机器学习的划分/基准规范；需要长时序数据来检验模型在长期、多通道、跨半球条件下的表现，并揭示强度回归的偏差问题。

Method: 发布 Dataset V3，在原有近50年长时序台风卫星影像基础上新增多光谱数据以支持多通道模型；研究数据划分策略；在南北半球（WP、AU）上进行基准实验，比较多种模型架构、图像类型与光谱通道（含单/多通道输入），并采用逆密度加权等失衡感知策略（BalancedMSE 思路）缓解强度回归偏差。

Result: 在当前设置下，多通道输入对气压回归并未明显优于单通道；单通道最佳组合为 ResNet-18 + 全分辨率图像 + Channel 1；气压回归在 WP 上 RMSE 更低，风速回归在 AU 上 RMSE 更低；强度回归存在对强台风的系统性低估，逆密度等失衡加权策略不足以消除该偏差。

Conclusion: 基准性能高度依赖数据集与任务特性，需分别解释；多通道与失衡加权并非普适增益，强度回归偏差需新的建模思路；数据集已公开。

Abstract: This paper presents the Digital Typhoon Dataset V3, a new version of the longest typhoon satellite image dataset spanning nearly 50 years, designed to benchmark machine learning models on long-term spatio-temporal data. The latest addition to Dataset V3 is multispectral satellite data, enabling multi-channel models. We investigate data-splitting strategies and present benchmarking results for the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Experimental results show that, under the current dataset construction and experimental setting, multi-channel inputs do not clearly outperform single-channel inputs for pressure regression. Among the evaluated model architectures, image types, and spectral channels, ResNet-18, full-resolution images, and Channel 1 generally provide the best single-channel performance for pressure regression. Performance also differs between the WP and AU datasets by regression target, with lower RMSE on WP for pressure regression and on AU for wind regression. These results highlight the importance of considering dataset-specific and task-specific characteristics when interpreting benchmark performance. Additionally, we analyzed systematic bias in intensity regression, which leads to underestimation of intensity for strong typhoons. We tested imbalance-aware weighting strategies, including inverse-density weighting inspired by BalancedMSE, and showed that these approaches are not sufficient to remove the bias. The dataset is publicly available at this http URL and this https URL .

</details>


### [69] [FusionAudit: Pathway-Conditioned Robustness Auditing for Native Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21667)
*Jiaming Zhang,Zherui Li,Siqi Guo,Junhao Dong,Kun Wang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PaRMA 审计框架，从"像素扰动"与"渲染文本插入"两条通路刻画视觉语言模型的攻击风险，并据此设计 MANTIS 与 Nat-Evid 两种攻击，揭示原生多模态模型的架构性盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 正从冻结编码器流水线转向原生多模态架构，视觉通道既是感知输入又承载渲染文本，与用户提示形成竞争；现有单攻击、以像素为中心的评价把不同攻击面坍缩为单一标量，且忽略了架构演进带来的脆弱性变化。

Method: PaRMA 以证据为基础的审计框架，定义"通路条件化风险"，覆盖像素扰动与渲染文本插入两类图像级干预；用通路特定诊断而非任意枚举攻击，暴露架构特定盲点，并实例化 FusionAudit，包含边距感知像素扰动 MANTIS 与宿主一致的语义插入 Nat-Evid；在 18 个开源权重 VLM 上按"原生性分类法"评估。

Result: 发现"看却不受骗"特征：原生 VLM 高度关注排印式叠加文本但视觉上拒绝之；识别出深度融合模型中编码器级与答案级攻击之间的目标错配；表明传统单攻击排名（如 PGD）对原生模型不稳定，诊断驱动攻击显著提高估计的残余风险。

Conclusion: PaRMA 提供了可证伪、证据驱动的审计方法，能揭示标准基准遗漏的漏洞，说明需按架构通路而非单一标量评估 VLM 的视觉风险。

Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) transition from frozen-encoder pipelines to native multimodal architectures, the visual channel increasingly serves as both a perceptual input and a carrier of rendered text that competes with user prompts. Current single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations fail to capture this complexity: they collapse distinct visual attack surfaces into a single scalar and ignore how architectural shifts alter vulnerability. We introduce PaRMA, an evidence-based auditing framework that defines pathway-conditioned risk over two primary image-level interventions: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Instead of arbitrary attack enumeration, PaRMA uses pathway-specific diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots. Notably, we uncover a see-but-not-deceived signature where native VLMs attend heavily to typographic overlays but visually reject them, and we identify an objective mismatch between encoder-level and answer-level attacks in deep-fusion models. To exploit these findings, we instantiate FusionAudit, introducing two diagnostic-motivated attacks: MANTIS (margin-aware pixel perturbation) and Nat-Evid (host-congruent semantic insertion). Evaluating 18 open-weight VLMs across a novel nativeness taxonomy, we demonstrate that legacy single-attack rankings (e.g., PGD) are unstable for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual risk, showing that PaRMA provides a falsifiable, evidence-driven auditing methodology for uncovering vulnerabilities missed by standard benchmarks.

</details>


### [70] [Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21668)
*Chanwoo Kim,Tackgeun You,Hwasup Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Edit4D：分解式文本到4D场景生成框架，将背景与动态角色分离建模并支持对象级编辑与相机控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本驱动动态场景生成方法将背景与动态角色耦合在整体视频中，导致对象级编辑困难、相机控制不灵活，且难以同时保持空间几何与时间动态。

Method: 分阶段流水线：先将用户指令分解为背景、动态角色、场景-角色合成三类阶段化提示；用文生图与相机条件生成先验合成多视角场景图像并重建背景3DGS；再生成角色图像，用图像条件视频先验驱动动画，重建4D网格并绑定高斯primitive得到角色表示；最后通过文本引导分割与接触感知优化合成两部分，并进行全局场景精修以提升和谐度与渲染一致性。

Result: 摘要中未给出定量结果，声称可实现可控相机运动、灵活的对象级编辑以及可编辑4D场景的实际构建。

Conclusion: 通过阶段化组件解耦背景与动态角色，Edit4D为可编辑4D场景生成提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: this https URL

</details>

*Connor Daly,Salvatore Russo,Jinendra Ekanayake,Daniel S. Elson,Ferdinando Rodriguez y Baena*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无标记RGB-D术中脊柱追踪是替代侵入性骨锚定基准点的潜在方案，但现有临床数据集缺乏独立的皮下真值，无法验证这类方法。

Method: 构建标定变换链：以术中透视中可见的多模态基准阵列将RGB-D坐标系与C臂坐标系对齐；用多视角2D-3D CT-透视配准恢复椎骨位姿，再映射到RGB-D坐标系作为独立参考。全流程不增加辐射、器械或手术流程改动。

Result: 离体羊椎骨对照光学追踪验证端到端精度2.06±0.29 mm、3.35±0.93°；在3例手术序列、11节椎骨、1500帧临床数据上评测两种无标记配准策略，为首次临床环境下对照独立皮下参考的评测。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了可复用的基础设施，用于在真实手术数据上基准测试新兴无标记追踪方法。

Abstract: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CE-MRI需注射造影剂，存在健康风险并提高扫描成本，因此希望从非增强序列合成CE-MRI以降低风险与费用；同时现有方法多用通道拼接融合多序列信息，融合方式较简单、未显式建模序列间差异。

Method: 提出Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD)模块，用动态加权策略自适应选择并聚合两类特征：各源序列的个体特征，以及序列之间显式差异特征；并对比了对抗式学习与回归式变体两种训练范式。

Result: 在UCSF-PDGM和UPenn-GBM数据集上，定量与定性评估均优于基线（图像保真度与感知质量）；成功重建肿瘤区域，基于合成CE-MRI的分割性能与真实CE-MRI相当；消融显示对抗学习提升感知质量，而回归变体结构保真度更高。

Conclusion: 显式建模序列间差异并动态加权融合，是提升跨序列医学图像合成的有效策略；风险与成本降低的同时可支撑下游肿瘤分割，感知与结构保真度之间存在对抗学习与回归之间的权衡。

Abstract: Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is crucial for accurately diagnosing and segmenting brain tumors. However, the acquisition of CE-MRI requires injecting contrast agents, which poses potential health risks and increases scan costs. Here, we propose a CE-MRI synthesis method from non-contrast sequences, reducing both risk and cost. Unlike existing methods that rely on channel-wise concatenation to fuse multi-sequence information for synthesis, we introduce a Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module. The proposed module uses a dynamic weighting strategy to adaptively select and aggregate informative features from both individual source sequences and explicit differences among them. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms baselines in terms of image fidelity and perceptual quality on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets. Our method successfully reconstructs tumor regions and achieves segmentation performance comparable to that obtained with real CE-MRI. Our ablation studies show that although adversarial learning improves perceptual quality, a regression-based variant of our method achieves higher structural fidelity.

</details>

*Zhanhan Tu,Nikhil Reddy,Helen J. Kuht,Ha-Jun Yoon,Gail D. E. Maconachie,Ravi Purohit,Prateek Pani,Line Kessel,Jinu Han,Jing Jin,Shui-Hua Wang,Karthik Bharadwaj,Viral Sheth,Michael Hisaund,Rebecca J. McLean,George Garratt,Chetan Kantibhai Patel,Kanmin Xue,Callum Hunt,Zisen Zhou,Ian De Silva,Seema Teli,Sonal Shah,Vanessa Rodwell,Aarti Patel,Irene Gottlob,Yu-Dong Zhang,Zedong Zheng,Girish Varma,Mervyn G. Thomas*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童视觉障碍与视网膜发育停滞相关，但OCT分级在不同设备与中心之间难以标准化，缺乏标注的目标设备数据阻碍了跨设备自动判读。

Method: 回顾性多中心研究，使用五中心四国及UK Biobank的OCT扫描，覆盖4种设备（台式与手持）。以ResNet50为骨干构建域对抗神经网络（DANN），源设备有标签图像+目标设备无标签图像训练，评估6组源-目标配对，并与7名临床医师评分者对比；另留Heidelberg Spectralis数据集做外部验证。

Result: 验证集准确率87.75%–96.06%，敏感度88.68%–98.38%，特异度78.00%–98.02%。最佳模型（TM OCT1→HH OCT1）准确率96.06%，AUC 0.994（95%CI 0.981–0.999）。多个模型在未见过的Heidelberg设备上仍保持判别能力。

Conclusion: 无监督域适应可在无目标设备标注数据的情况下实现跨设备OCT分类，有望支持更一致的视网膜发育评估与既有影像数据的大规模分析。

Abstract: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. We evaluated six source to target pairings and compared model performance with seven clinician graders. A separate Heidelberg Spectralis dataset was reserved for external evaluation. Across validation sets, accuracy ranged from 87.75% to 96.06%, sensitivity from 88.68% to 98.38%, and specificity from 78.00% to 98.02%. The best performing model, adapted from TM OCT1 to HH OCT1, achieved 96.06% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.994, with a 95% confidence interval from 0.981 to 0.999. Several models also maintained discrimination on the unseen Heidelberg device. Unsupervised domain adaptation enabled OCT classification across devices without labelled target device data. The approach may support more consistent assessment of retinal development and large scale analysis of existing imaging datasets.

</details>


### [74] [The Dormant Spiking Neuron: A State-Driven Mechanism for Efficient Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21748)
*Ruichen Ma,Yicai Chen,Pujun Zhou,Yue Zuo,Chongyang Li,Shuang Liu,Shaogang Hu,Guanchao Qiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Dormant Spiking Neuron (DSN)模型，通过状态驱动的动态门控让深度抑制的脉冲神经元进入休眠态，在实例级别剪枝冗余计算，能量降低40%–70%并在ImageNet上超过静态剪枝方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）的高能效主要来自突触前输入驱动的稀疏性，但被长期忽视的是突触后神经元的持续阈下动态开销：在ImageNet训练的ResNet-18中高达44%的神经元处于深度抑制状态，几乎不可能发放却仍持续消耗计算。

Method: 引入DSN模型：构造状态驱动的动态门，当膜电位低于预设负阈值时神经元进入休眠态，在实例级别动态剪枝冗余计算；休眠机制直接嵌入神经元动力学，通过BPTT与替代梯度端到端训练，使网络主动学到鲁棒的休眠策略并自适应保留关键信息流。

Result: 在静态与神经形态数据集上一致降低计算能耗40%至70%以上；在ImageNet上，在相近的报道代价下降下优于SOTA静态剪枝技术，同时将对应基线SNN精度提升1.34%。

Conclusion: DSN建立了一种可训练、状态驱动的稀疏范式，与常规输入驱动方法正交，可获得协同的效率增益，为神经形态计算的高能效推进提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a compelling pathway toward energy-efficient artificial intelligence, fundamentally anchored in presynaptic input-driven sparsity. However, a substantial yet chronically overlooked source of computational overhead persists: the continuous subthreshold dynamics of postsynaptic neurons. Quantitative analysis reveals that up to 44% of neurons in an ImageNet-trained ResNet-18 model reside in a deeply inhibited state, imposing a persistent computational burden despite having a negligible probability of firing. To address this inefficiency, the Dormant Spiking Neuron (DSN) model is introduced. By incorporating a state-driven dynamic gate, the DSN allows a neuron to enter a dormant state when its membrane potential falls below a predefined negative threshold, dynamically pruning redundant computations at the instance level. Crucially, this dormancy mechanism is directly integrated into the neuronal dynamics and trained end-to-end via backpropagation through time using surrogate gradients, enabling the network to actively learn a robust dormancy policy that adaptively preserves critical information flow. Extensive experiments across static and neuromorphic datasets demonstrate that the DSN framework consistently reduces computational energy by 40% to over 70%. Notably, on the large-scale ImageNet dataset, the DSN outperforms state-of-the-art static pruning techniques at comparable reported cost reductions and simultaneously improves the corresponding baseline SNN accuracy by 1.34%. By establishing a trainable, state-driven sparsity paradigm orthogonal to conventional input-driven methods, the DSN unlocks synergistic efficiency gains, presenting an effective approach for advancing neuromorphic computing.

</details>


### [75] [Beyond Source Prompts: Towards Visually Grounded AI-Generated Video Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21758)
*Kehao Zhou,Yixuan Li,Yuxuan Jiang,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VGCap 提出以"视觉接地字幕"(全局修订字幕+分段字幕)作为文本参考的 AI 生成视频质量评估框架,在 LGVQ/FETV 上三维度均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AIGV 质量评估依赖源提示词作为文本参考,但源提示与实际生成内容常不一致,导致文本-视频对齐评价失真。作者希望通过视觉证据重新生成更贴合内容的字幕来缓解这一语义鸿沟。

Method: 提出 VGCap 框架:1) 全局字幕——基于多帧视觉证据对源提示做最小修订,得到与生成内容一致的全局描述;2) 与提示无关的分段字幕——描述局部时序内容。两类字幕互为补充,为空间质量、时序质量和文本-视频对齐三个维度提供文本证据。

Result: 在 LGVQ 和 FETV 数据集上,三个质量维度均超越代表性基线;消融实验验证了视觉接地字幕对每个维度均有效,并显示分段级特征对时序质量预测尤其有益。

Conclusion: 视觉接地字幕可有效替代源提示作为质量评估参考,分段级字幕对时序质量建模具有独特价值;代码将开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence have accelerated video generation technologies. However, AI-generated videos (AIGVs) remain susceptible to various distortions, highlighting the need for dedicated video quality assessment methods. Content semantics play an important role in AIGV quality assessment, with source prompts typically used as textual references. However, these prompts may not accurately reflect the generated video content, resulting in a discrepancy between the intended textual description and the generated result. To address this limitation, this paper proposes VGCap, an AIGV quality assessment framework guided by visually grounded captions that align better with generated content. Specifically, we introduce two forms of captions: a global caption obtained by minimally revising the source prompt based on multi-frame visual evidence, and prompt-independent segment captions that describe localized temporal content. Together, these captions provide complementary textual evidence for assessing spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. Experimental results on the LGVQ and FETV datasets show that VGCap outperforms representative baselines across all three dimensions. Further ablation studies on caption sources and temporal components confirm the effectiveness of visually grounded captions for each quality dimension, while highlighting the benefits of segment-level features for temporal quality prediction. The source of VGCap will be available at this https URL .

</details>

*Olivia Salamon,Virginia N. L. Franqueira,Shujun Li*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 部分 MLLM 检测准确率较高，GPT-5.2 在成对实验中针对特定生成器达到 97.9% 的峰值，整体成对平均准确率为 82.5%，其判据为图像内部的结构或物理不一致性。自检测实验中，SynthID 隐式水印的存在使 Gemini 检测准确率相对干净对照组下降约 10%，推测原因是 SynthID 嵌入抑制了模型所依赖的部分可见伪影；不同模型代际间性能差异显著。

Conclusion: MLLM 能够在不依赖水印的条件下识别结构性伪影并完成合成图像检测，但检测性能随模型代际波动明显；SynthID 嵌入可能压制检测所依赖的结构伪影，说明水印既可能作为线索也可能成为干扰项，取证可靠性仍受生成器类型与水印机制影响。

Abstract: As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up. This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media. Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded this http URL MLLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6, are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images. Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5. The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini. Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images. However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group. One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for this http URL results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations. The findings from comparison C5 also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.

### [77] [FuseAdapt: Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Semantic Segmentation with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21779)
*Xin Zhang,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FuseAdapt 在冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）的适配空间内做多模态语义分割融合：各模态学习轻量低秩适配分支，将 FFN 低秩残差激活跨模态路由，Q/V 适配保持模态私有；并引入预测式模态建模（PMM）训练目标增强跨模态冗余。在三大多模态分割基准上，全模态最高 +3.01 mIoU，缺失模态最高 +12.56 mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态语义分割依赖传感器互补性，但测试时模态退化或缺失会使融合失效；现有方法依赖专用融合模块或多分支跨模态编码器，参数开销大且模态缺失时性能骤降。作者希望验证 VFM 先验是否能作为多模态分割的有效共享骨干，从而以参数高效方式获得鲁棒融合。

Method: 提出 FuseAdapt：冻结 VFM 主干，为每个模态分配轻量适配分支，执行"适配空间融合"——Q/V 低秩适配保持各模态私有，仅将 FFN 低秩残差激活在模态间路由，实现显式跨模态交互，主干参数保持固定。另提出预测式模态建模（PMM）：训练时遮蔽目标模态，由可见模态预测其嵌入，并以全模态输入下的教师目标监督，属表示层直接目标；PMM 仅用于训练，无推理额外开销。

Result: 在 MCubeS、DELIVER、MUSES 三个多模态分割基准上，FuseAdapt 以很小的可训练参数量同时提升模态完整与模态缺失场景的分割性能，相比此前 SOTA 在全模态下最高 +3.01 mIoU，在模态缺失下最高 +12.56 mIoU。

Conclusion: 研究表明冻结 VFM 可作为多模态分割的有效共享骨干，在适配空间内进行跨模态融合比附加独立融合网络更参数高效、更鲁棒；PMM 以零推理开销的表示级监督缓解模态缺失问题。

Abstract: Multi-modal semantic segmentation benefits from complementary sensors, but this benefit is fragile when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time. Many existing methods rely on dedicated fusion modules or multi-branch cross-modal encoders, and the fusion often becomes unreliable when modalities are absent, leading to substantial performance drops. We propose \textbf{FuseAdapt}, a parameter-efficient framework that performs fusion within the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM), exploring whether VFM priors can serve as an effective shared backbone for multi-modal segmentation. Instead of attaching a standalone fusion network, FuseAdapt assigns each modality a lightweight adaptation branch and performs \emph{adaptation-space fusion} by keeping Q/V low-rank adaptation private to each modality and routing only FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside the frozen backbone. The pretrained VFM remains fixed while modality-specific corrections and explicit cross-modal interaction are learned through the adaptation paths. To handle missing modalities, we further introduce \textbf{Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM)}, a direct representation-level objective for cross-modal redundancy. During training, PMM masks a target modality and predicts its embedding from the visible ones, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input. PMM is used only during training and adds no inference-time overhead. Across three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks (MCubeS, DELIVER, MUSES), FuseAdapt consistently improves both modality-complete and modality-incomplete segmentation with a small trainable budget, yielding up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [78] [DINO-FIL: Multi-Layer Transformer Fusion for Generative Inpainting Forgery Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21780)
*Simon Freitter,David Fischinger,Silvia Poletti,Marcel Hasenbalg,Martin Boyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DINO-FIL：基于DINOv3 ViT-H+/16多层特征与轻量融合解码器的生成图像伪造像素级定位框架，跨数据集泛化能力强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式图像编辑引入的细微、空间局部伪影往往被单层特征方法忽略，需要跨深度的多层表示来同时捕捉语义结构与纹理不一致性。

Method: 采用预训练DINOv3 ViT-H+/16编码器提取中间Transformer多层特征，聚合不同深度的表示，配合轻量级融合解码器实现像素级伪造定位。

Result: 在跨数据集设置下训练于B-Free，测试于Beyond the Brush、CocoGlide、TGIF和SAGI-D，平均及五个数据集中四个上超越现有基线，并在真实图像上保持高真负率。

Conclusion: 多层特征聚合有效提升对局部细微伪造伪影的敏感度与跨数据集泛化能力，DINOv3特征在图像取证定位中具有迁移价值。

Abstract: We propose DINO-FIL, a transformer-based framework for pixel-level localization of generative image forgeries. The method leverages multi-layer representations from a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder combined with a lightweight fusion decoder to capture both semantic structure and fine-grained texture inconsistencies introduced by image editing. By aggregating intermediate transformer features across depths, the model improves sensitivity to subtle, spatially localized artifacts that are often missed by standard single-layer approaches. We evaluate DINO-FIL in a cross-dataset setting, training on B-Free and testing on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, and SAGI-D. The model achieves strong generalization, outperforming existing baselines on average and on four of five evaluated datasets, while maintaining a high true negative rate on pristine images.

</details>


### [79] [Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21783)
*Yijiang Li,Bingyang Wang,Nuno Vasconcelos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ACT3D让VLM保留单帧原生视觉编码，把3D场景仅当作可交互环境，通过"推理—移动—重定向"的多步rollout答题；先用轨迹监督微调，再用仅以最终答案正确性为奖励的强化学习，在无任何视角/动作监督下自发学出问题条件下的探索策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D视觉语言方法多依赖多视角图像、视频或显式3D表示，偏离VLM原生单图编码方式，且无法主动获取被遮挡或缺失的视觉证据。作者希望模型像人一样一次只看一张图，在3D环境中主动探索，以解决初始视角信息不足的空间推理问题。

Method: 把3D表示当作环境：每次rollout从第一人称初始视角+视觉问题出发，模型迭代地推理、导航、调整朝向，最后给出答案；动作（如左移）产生新渲染观测。训练分两阶段：先做轨迹监督微调，再做RL，奖励主要由最终答案正确性驱动，对访问哪些视角、采取哪些动作不给任何直接监督，探索策略完全由交互对性能的提升程度学得。基础模型为Qwen。

Result: 在六个3D基准上平均准确率53.2%，比基座Qwen提升22.0%，超过Gemini 3.6 Flash；优于现有开源3D方法，且输入帧数少50–70%。泛化到未见域平均提升5.9%（相对监督初始化）。分析显示存在自适应、问题条件化的探索：从初始视角即可回答的问题增益0.6%，需大量探索的问题增益16.3%；模型会搜索被遮挡目标、避免无谓探索、并为空间比较获取互补视角。

Conclusion: 基于结果的RL能让VLM不仅对已有视觉证据做推理，还能学会何时、如何主动获取证据，实现自适应主动3D探索，且不牺牲原生单帧视觉编码与跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

</details>


### [80] [NICE Toolbox: Nonverbal Interpersonal Communication Exploration Toolbox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21786)
*Aleksandr Evgrashin,Carolin Schmitt,Timo Lübbing,Ashutosh Jha,Buket Naz Zeren,Sophie K. Bauer,Johannes Kopf-Beck,Anton K. G. Marx,Anamaria Semm,Gökce Ergün,Senya Polikovsky*

Main category: cs.CV
