TL;DR: BigCell 首次实现在原生 gigapixel 分辨率下生成连贯的全切片组织病理图像，用流匹配 Transformer 训练 + 滑动窗口推理生成高达 32768×32768 的图像，并提出自适应调度加速与 8k 文本到图像合成，合成数据可将切片级少样本分类提升最多 18%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组织病理生成模型停留在 patch 尺度（≤1024×1024），只能覆盖 WSI 的一小部分；而临床诊断文本报告和切片级标签等大规模监督信号都位于全切片层面，二者尺度不匹配，缺乏原生 gigapixel 级生成能力。

Method: 在 12 万余张多器官公开 WSI 上以 2048×2048 分辨率训练流匹配（flow-matching）Transformer；以病理基础模型嵌入为条件，推理时采用滑动窗口流水线拼接出超大图像；引入自适应调度策略优先生成重要区域以加速；另训练独立模型从病理文本报告生成稠密条件网格，实现 8k 文本到图像合成。

Result: 可生成最高 32768×32768 像素的连贯全切片图像，在 tile 级与 slide 级保真度指标上均优于既有 tile 生成器；自适应调度带来 3 倍以上加速且质量损失极小；用合成样本增强后，切片级少样本分类较纯真实数据基线提升最多 18%。

Conclusion: BigCell 将组织病理生成从 patch 尺度推进到原生 gigapixel 全切片尺度，缩小了生成粒度与切片级监督之间的差距，并通过加速调度与文本条件合成使超大图生成实用化，合成增强可有效提升下游少样本诊断任务。

Abstract: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024$\times$1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048$\times$2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768$\times$32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to $18 \%$ over baselines trained on real data.

</details>


### [149] [Thinking with Images without Coordinates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14265)
*Cao, Meng,Zhao, Haoze,Wang, Yi,Reid, Ian,Liang, Xiaodan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TiCO提出"无需坐标的以图思考"范式，将视觉推理重构为潜空间语义证据发现，用探针token估计相似度分布并对空间连通分量做重要性采样，生成token级证据区域替代像素坐标定位，在高分辨率与通用视觉推理基准上超越坐标方法并提升推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"thinking with images"多模态推理方法严重依赖显式坐标定位，存在两个根本缺陷：一是语义鸿沟，稀疏坐标回归难以刻画高维潜结构；二是分辨率鸿沟，patch级token与像素级坐标存在粒度错配。

Method: TiCO将视觉推理改写为潜空间中的语义证据发现过程，证据以token级区域形式注入而非像素坐标。具体使用专用probe token估计相似度分布，并在空间连通分量上进行重要性采样，生成多样且语义主导的证据rollout。

Result: 在多个高分辨率与通用视觉推理基准上，TiCO一致优于当前最优的基于坐标的方法，且推理效率显著提升。

Conclusion: 论文表明去除像素坐标依赖、以潜空间语义证据采样替代坐标回归，是提升多模态视觉推理忠实性与效率的有效路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in multi-modal large language models have shifted toward the "thinking with images" paradigm to improve reasoning faithfulness, yet existing methods rely heavily on explicit coordinate- based grounding. We identify two fundamental limitations in this approach, i.e., a semantic gap where sparse regressions miss high-dimensional latent structures, and a resolution gap due to the granularity mismatch between patch-level tokens and pixel-level coordinates. To address these, we propose TiCO (Thinking with images without COordinates). It reformulates visual reasoning as a semantic evidence discovery process within the latent space, and evidence is injected as token-level regions without pixel coordinates. Specifically, TiCO utilizes a dedicated probe token to estimate similarity distributions and performs importance sampling over spatially connected components to generate diverse, semantically dominant evidence rollouts. Extensive experiments across multiple high-resolution and general visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our TiCO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art coordinate-based methods with significantly improved inference efficiency.

</details>


### [150] [RoboFake: Are Deepfake Detectors Ready for Humanoid Face Robots?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14269)
*Chen, Hao,Xu, Junnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"RoboFake"概念——用真实人脸外观的唇同步机器人替代数字换脸，在镜头前制造无像素编辑的伪造人脸，并测试6个FaceForensics++训练的检测器对物理机器人、合成视频及渲染机器人脸的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有deepfake检测器被默认为能识别"伪造"，但机器人脸具备真实材质与实时运动，却缺乏人类面部外观。作者想检验检测器的判别依据究竟是"识别伪造"还是"非人类外观"。

Method: 使用物理唇同步人脸机器人、同一机器人的合成视频、以及渲染机器人脸三类素材；固定FaceForensics++阈值，并以经过相同处理的真人脸作对照；引入匹配人类对照与掩码实验分离面部与背景/处理因素；再做JPEG压缩鲁棒性测试。

Result: 在标定5%真人脸虚警的阈值下，3个检测器几乎标记每一帧物理机器人，另2个标记不到7%；掩码与对照实验证明响应来自面部而非处理或背景；检测结果不跟随合成属性——全脸可见时6个检测器中3个给物理机器人的伪造分高于其合成视频；轻度JPEG压缩即可将多数机器人帧压至阈值以下。

Conclusion: 当前检测器标记机器人是因为其面部"不像人"，而非识别出伪造；对真实感、交互式RoboFake提出三个可检验假设，并公开评测协议与代码。

Abstract: Humanoid face robots can now move their lips in sync with speech and show detailed facial expressions. Give such a robot the face of a real person and drive it with generated speech, and you get a face forgery that happens in front of the camera: the camera records a real object, and no pixel is edited. We call this a RoboFake. In this paper we ask what current deepfake detectors do when they see a robot face. We test six public detectors trained on FaceForensics++ on video of a physical lip-syncing face robot, on a synthesized video of the same robot, and on rendered robot faces. All thresholds are fixed on FaceForensics++, and every result is compared with real human faces that went through the same processing as the robot videos. At a threshold that flags 5% of real faces, three detectors flag almost every physical robot frame, while two flag fewer than 7%. A matched human control and masking show that the response comes from the face, not from the processing or the background. However, it does not track synthesis: with only the face visible, three of the six detectors give the physical robot a higher fake score than its synthesized video. The response is also fragile, and light JPEG compression is enough to push most robot frames below the threshold for some detectors. Our results suggest that current detectors flag today's robots because their faces do not look human, not because they recognize a forgery. We release our evaluation protocol and code, and state three testable hypotheses about realistic, interactive RoboFakes.

</details>


### [151] [TGSR: Text-Grounded Diffusion for Faithful Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14281)
*Hu, Zhiming,Zhang, Ran,Ye, Angela,Goyal, Raghav,Ali, Faraz,Aumentado-Armstrong, Tristan Ty,Rangrej, Samrudhdhi B.,Derpanis, Konstantinos G.,Mohomed, Iqbal,Levinshtein, Alex*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将文本图像超分辨率重构为选择性生成问题，提出测试时框架TGSR，通过检测器渐进识别并抑制可能幻觉的文本区域，在多个骨干网络上提升文本保真度（识别精度最高+17.68）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型图像超分虽提升感知质量，但对文本内容常产生幻觉（不存在或扭曲的文字），改变场景语义、损害可靠性；已有方法无差别地增强文本生成，未从根本上解决幻觉。作者认为核心在于缺乏选择性控制。

Method: 将文本超分重构为选择性生成：仅在预期可靠生成时解析文本，其余场景内容正常超分。提出TGSR——一种测试时框架，在生成过程中渐进地识别并抑制可能被幻觉化的文本区域；为此在从多种扩散式超分输出构建的大规模数据集上训练专用检测器。

Result: TGSR在多个骨干网络上一致提升文本保真度，识别精度最高提升17.68个百分点，且不降低感知质量。

Conclusion: 选择性控制是生成式超分中解决文本幻觉的有效思路，TGSR作为即插即用的测试时方案具有跨骨干泛化性。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image super-resolution (SR) by leveraging strong generative priors to enhance perceptual quality. However, for textual content, these priors often produce text hallucinations: non-existent or distorted text, which alter scene semantics and compromise model reliability. While recent methods focus on enhancing text generation, they do so indiscriminately, leaving hallucinations fundamentally unresolved. We argue the core problem is a lack of selective control. Therefore, we reformulate text SR as a selective generation problem: text is resolved only when reliable generation is expected, while other scene content is fully super-resolved. We introduce TGSR (Text-Grounded Super-Resolution), a test-time framework that progressively identifies and suppresses likely hallucinated text regions during generation. To enable this, we train dedicated detectors on a large-scale dataset curated from diverse diffusion-based SR outputs. TGSR consistently improves text fidelity across multiple backbones, increasing recognition precision by up to 17.68 points without degrading perceptual quality, underscoring the value of selective control in generative SR.

</details>


### [152] [GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14293)
*Hong, Yeobin,Go, Hyojun,Lee, Dohun,Lee, Jeongjae,Hong, Sunghwan,Tombari, Federico,An, Zhaochong,Ye, Jong Chul,Schindler, Konrad,Narnhofer, Dominik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoFix统一框架，用单一几何奖励（跨视角深度一致性，并针对相机重叠度校准）同时提升4D生成视频的几何一致性与视觉质量，WorldScore 3D一致性+39%，VBench质量+4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型作为4D生成先验时几何一致性差；现有后训练几何奖励会损害纹理细节，需搭配外观奖励并小心平衡。作者希望用单一几何奖励同时改善几何与外观。

Method: GeoFix基于静态区域的跨视角深度一致性设计奖励，不直接约束外观、也不惩罚合理的物体运动；关键在于发现深度一致性与相机FOV重叠度正相关（真实视频与4D数据集均如此），会误把更小相机位移当成更好几何，因此对奖励做重叠度趋势校准。框架可用于训练与推理期奖励对齐。

Result: WorldScore 3D一致性提升39%，VBench质量分提升4%。

Conclusion: 通过重叠度校准的单一几何奖励，可在不引入外观奖励的情况下同时提升4D生成的几何一致性与视觉质量，适用于训练与推理两种奖励对齐场景。

Abstract: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

</details>


### [153] [MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14315)
*Li, Yuguang,Deng, Yichuan,Liu, Zixuan,Boyadzhiev, Ivaylo,Wu, Xiuyuan,Zou, Xinyu,Shapiro, Linda,Colburn, Alex*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MOIS局部墙体实例分割表示与MvFFN前馈网络，从稀疏无位姿宽基线全景图联合预测相机位姿、稠密几何与墙体语义，经布局链式聚合生成共享全局坐标的多房间户型图，并构建ZInD-CrossView数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏、无位姿、宽基线RGB全景下的相机位姿与多房间户型重建仍属难题：位姿、几何、语义与全局布局强耦合，将完整户型当作单一全局输出难以学习。作者的关键洞察是让模型预测严格保持局部性，由重叠局部预测的确定性聚合自然涌现全局结构。

Method: 1) MOIS（多视图有序墙体实例分割）：每个全景图的每一列仅预测其观测到的墙体及顺时针方向相邻的两面墙，全局墙体划分、房间布局与共享坐标由重叠局部预测的确定性聚合产生；2) MvFFN：在MOIS基础上联合预测粗相机位姿、稠密全局几何与逐墙语义输出；3) 下游Layout Chaining（LC）后处理流水线，将预测组装为具有共享全局坐标、一致墙体身份与连通房间结构的多房间户型图。

Result: 稠密MOIS预测在跨视图墙体身份识别与房间内局部连通性上比组合式模块化基线更准确；组装后的布局在墙体级与交角（junction）级精度上显著优于既有方法。同时发布ZInD-CrossView数据集，在ZInD基础上增加全局唯一墙体实例与跨视图分割标注。

Conclusion: 以"严格局部预测+确定性聚合"替代单一全局户型输出，可有效解耦位姿、几何、语义与布局结构，实现稀疏无位姿全景下的多房间前馈户型重建；配套数据集为该任务提供统一评测基准。

Abstract: Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.

</details>


### [154] [EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14324)
*Diko, Anxhelo,Lin, Jieyu,Ambrogio, Stefano,Li, Ziyun,Assran, Mahmoud,Moutakanni, Théo,De Salvo, Barbara,Liu, Chiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Elastic V-JEPA（EV-JEPA），一种训练一次即可在边缘-云连续体上任意部署的宽度弹性、可分区基础模型，核心是 Transition-Aware Triplet Training（T3）三路径训练策略，并扩展到弹性 token 压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型（如 V-JEPA）是固定容量的刚性网络，绑定单一设备，无法支持可重构算力预算与跨设备协同。现有方法只解决单一维度：slimmable/NAS 提供宽度弹性但假设单设备推理；split-computing 支持跨设备协同但仅限固定分区与静态容量。作者希望用单一模型同时覆盖异构设备上的单机与协同执行。

Method: 核心为 Transition-Aware Triplet Training（T3）：每步采样一个窄宽度和一个宽宽度，训练三条路径——窄宽度单独、宽宽度单独，以及前段窄、后段宽的混合路径。混合路径的切换点即设备间交接点，使同一组权重同时学会单设备与跨设备执行，并支持 many-to-one、any-to-any、variable-split 配置。此外将弹性原则扩展至 token 压缩，暴露设备端计算、延迟与精度之间的可控权衡。

Result: 在多项基准上，EV-JEPA 与独立训练基线差距在 1 个精度点以内，较此前弹性训练方法最高提升 11 个精度点；窄到宽的跨设备混合执行恢复到最高容量单机模型 1.1 个精度点以内，支持多种分区配置；弹性 token 压缩可提供计算-延迟-精度可控权衡。

Conclusion: 单一弹性模型可同时实现宽度可重构与原生可分区，统一单设备与跨设备执行，为边缘-云连续体上的基础模型部署提供实用方案，并将弹性从骨干扩展到 token 压缩。

Abstract: Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path that runs the early layers narrow and the rest wide. The hybrid switch point is where one device hands off to another, so the same weights learn both single-device and cross-device execution. Across various benchmarks, EV-JEPA falls within 1 accuracy point of independently trained baselines while improving over previous elastic training approaches by up to 11 accuracy points. Narrow-to-wide cross-device hybrid execution recovers to within 1.1 points of the highest-capacity standalone model and supports many-to-one, any-to-any, and variable-split configurations. Finally, we show that the elastic principle extends beyond the backbone to an elastic token compression mechanism that exposes controllable trade-offs among on-device computation, latency, and accuracy.

</details>


### [155] [Manifold Navigation Learning Using Recurrent Networks: Efficient Training Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14325)
*Dayton, Sarah Harkins,Rengaswami, Sathya,Maroulas, Vasileios,Boothe, David L.,Schizas, Ioannis D.*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将流形导航形式化为速度驱动的位置跟踪任务，提出基于坐标图卡的欧氏学习框架，用GRU预测速度序列对应的流形轨迹，并由自定义损失函数提升长时程精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧氏导航中的位置跟踪已有充分研究，但一般流形上的导航（运动受空间内在几何约束支配）关注较少。直接在流形上施加约束进行学习较为困难，需要一种既保持几何一致性又能在欧氏表示中高效学习的建模方式。

Method: 将流形导航建模为速度驱动的跟踪任务；采用坐标图卡（coordinate chart）表示，模型完全在欧氏空间中学习；预测轨迹通过浸入（immersion）函数映射回流形后再计算误差，从而在不显式施加流形约束的情况下评估几何一致性。在比较多种循环架构后选用GRU做序列位置预测，并设计针对性自定义损失函数，与标准MSE损失及朴素向量相加基线对比。实验对象包括解析/数值定义的流形以及由LiDAR点云重建的曲面。

Result: 循环模型能够从速度序列学习近似流形约束动力学，并稳定优于欧氏基线；某些自定义损失函数相比传统逐点损失显著改善长时程预测精度。

Conclusion: 坐标图卡+浸入映射的学习框架为一般流形导航提供了可行的几何一致建模途径，序列模型与损失函数设计是提升长时程跟踪精度的关键。

Abstract: Position tracking is a well-studied problem in Euclidean navigation, yet comparatively little attention has been given to navigation on general manifolds, where motion is governed by the underlying geometry of the space. In this work, we formalize the problem of manifold navigation as a velocity-driven tracking task and propose a coordinate-chart-based learning framework in which learning models operate entirely in a Euclidean representation. Predicted trajectories are mapped to the manifold via an immersion function prior to error computation, allowing geometric consistency to be evaluated without explicitly enforcing manifold constraints during learning. Within this framework, we focus on Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) for sequential position prediction on curved manifolds after comparisons with alternative recurrent architectures. We evaluate our GRU models, trained with pertinent custom loss functions, against both a standard MSE loss function and a naive vector-addition baseline. We evaluate our approach on both analytically (and numerically) defined manifolds, as well as a surface reconstructed from a LiDAR point cloud. Our results show that recurrent models can learn to approximate manifold-constrained dynamics from velocity sequences and consistently outperform Euclidean baselines. Our results demonstrate that certain custom loss functions significantly improve long-horizon prediction accuracy compared to conventional point-wise loss functions.

</details>


### [156] [Real-Time Traffic Density Estimation: A Hybrid Computer Vision and Predictive Machine Learning Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14326)
*Boadu, Prince Kwabena Appiah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文构建了一个用于交通密度预测的两阶段流水线：先用车检+跟踪与道路掩膜空间过滤提取逐帧交通特征，再用LSTM/GRU/TCN从10帧输入预测未来5步；在5,716帧数据集上评测了6个家族共10种检测器，并用29,243个窗口评估时序预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从摄像头视频估计交通密度需要将视觉感知与短时预测相结合，作者希望系统性地量化检测器的速度—精度权衡，并评估不同时序模型（LSTM/GRU/TCN）在检测器派生遥测上的短窗口预测能力。

Method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 空间逻辑层，用预计算道路掩膜按重叠度过滤检测框并提取逐帧交通特征；(2) 时序估计器，使用LSTM、GRU和TCN，以10帧窗口为输入预测未来5步。检测器评测覆盖6个家族10个变体，单张NVIDIA GPU，5,716帧标注数据；时序评估使用29,243个留出窗口。

Result: YOLOv5l取得最高mAP@50:95 0.524，速度56 FPS；YOLOv8n达258 FPS、mAP@50:95 0.487（均为不含跟踪与空间过滤的纯检测推理）。时序预测聚合R²：GRU 0.858、LSTM 0.856、TCN 0.840。评估流缺少道路掩膜，无法验证空间过滤模块。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了检测器的速度—精度权衡，并揭示了短窗口交通遥测预测的局限：所报指标反映的是检测器派生遥测的预测（且由方向方差主导），并不等同于绝对交通密度精度；受限于缺失的道路掩膜，空间过滤环节未获验证。

Abstract: Traffic density estimation from camera feeds requires connecting visual perception with short-horizon forecasting. We present a two-stage pipeline that combines vehicle detection and tracking with a spatial logic layer, followed by a temporal estimator. The spatial layer filters bounding boxes by their overlap with a precomputed road mask and extracts per-frame traffic features. LSTM, GRU, and Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) estimators use these features to predict five future steps from a ten-frame input window. We benchmark ten detector variants from six families on a dataset of 5,716 annotated frames using a single NVIDIA GPU. YOLOv5l achieves the highest mAP@50:95 of 0.524 at 56 frames per second, while YOLOv8n reaches 258 frames per second at 0.487 mAP@50:95; these rates measure detector inference without tracking or spatial filtering. Temporal evaluation on 29,243 held-out windows yields aggregate R-squared values of 0.858 for GRU, 0.856 for LSTM, and 0.840 for TCN. These metrics measure forecasts of detector-derived telemetry and are dominated by direction variance, rather than establishing absolute traffic-density accuracy. No road mask was available for the evaluation stream, limiting validation of the spatial filtering component. A live run on a third camera stream examines forecasting behavior within the complete pipeline. The results characterize detector speed-accuracy trade-offs and the limitations of short-window traffic telemetry forecasting.

</details>


### [157] [TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14332)
*Matthew, George,Zhang, Guoqiang,Niwa, Kenta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TraceSampler 是一种后训练方法，将少步采样的端点误差建模为样本特异预测问题，用采样轨迹的紧凑表示配合浅层 MLP 预测残差系数并进行两阶段修正，在 10 步下显著降低轨迹 MSE 与 FID，且几乎不增加推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间生成模型（如扩散、流匹配）要精确采样需大量模型评估；少步采样虽降低成本，但粗粒度更新会引入端点误差并逐步累积，损害生成质量。作者希望在不修改预训练模型的前提下修正这些误差。

Method: TraceSampler 不直接优化少步更新，而是把端点误差当作样本特异预测任务：用同区间的高步数参考积分作为监督目标，并用兼顾共享残差结构、轨迹导出方向与低秩余项的紧凑表示，使高维误差可预测；浅层逐步 MLP 头预测样本相关系数，驱动两阶段学习型残差修正——第一阶段预测完整端点残差，中间 backbone 评估提供新轨迹信息以预测剩余残差，且该评估被下一步复用。

Result: 在 Rectified Flow + CIFAR-10、SiT-XL/2 + ImageNet-256、SD3.5 Medium 文生图上评估。10 步时轨迹 MSE 相对同步骤 Euler 在 CIFAR-10 降低 90.5%、ImageNet-256 降低 85.6%，FID 分别为 2.692 与 2.189，接近 120 步 Heun 参考的 2.601 与 2.056，而 backbone 评估少 24 倍。SD3.5 Medium 上 10 步 ImageReward 从 0.752 升至 0.906，轨迹 MSE 下降 70.7%；收益不改变 Euler 的评估预算，额外推理 FLOPs < 0.4%，墙钟开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 粗步采样误差可从采样轨迹中预测并被高效修正，TraceSampler 以极低额外成本显著缩小少步与多步参考之间的质量差距，为连续时间生成模型的高效采样提供了实用的后训练方案。

Abstract: Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual, while an intermediate backbone evaluation provides new trace information to predict the remaining residual; this evaluation is reused by the following step. TraceSampler is evaluated with Rectified Flow on CIFAR-10, SiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, and SD3.5 Medium for text-to-image generation. At 10 steps, it reduces trajectory MSE relative to matched-step Euler by 90.5% on CIFAR-10 and 85.6% on ImageNet-256, while achieving FID scores of 2.692 and 2.189, close to 120-step Heun references of 2.601 and 2.056 with 24$\times$ fewer backbone evaluations. On SD3.5 Medium, TraceSampler improves image quality and prompt following; at 10 steps, ImageReward rises from 0.752 to 0.906 while trajectory MSE falls by 70.7%. These gains preserve Euler's backbone-evaluation budget, add less than 0.4% inference FLOPs, and incur negligible wall-clock overhead, showing that coarse-step sampling error can be made predictable from the sampling trace and efficiently corrected.

</details>


### [158] [Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14351)
*Park, Jeongeun,Kim, Taekyung,Han, Dongyoon,Yun, Sangdoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 WATCH 跨视频预训练方法：以任务配对的人类演示为输入，条件于一演示的视频与动作，联合预测另一演示的未来帧与动作，从而学习跨场景、跨具身可迁移的世界-动作表征，并提升下游机器人策略的上下文成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准"视频内下一帧预测"预训练让世界-动作模型依赖上下文与未来之间共享的外观信息（如背景、纹理），而非学习可跨场景与跨具身迁移的任务交互规律，导致迁移能力受限。作者希望以可扩展的方式（仅用人类-人类配对演示，无需人-机器人配对数据）获得可迁移的世界-动作先验。

Method: WATCH 采用跨视频预训练范式：从多样环境中采集任务配对的人类演示，条件于其中一个演示的视频与动作，模型联合预测另一个演示在其当前观测下的动作与未来帧。通过"以一演示预测另一演示"的交叉条件设计，迫使模型忽略实例级外观、聚焦任务相关交互；预训练不需要匹配的人-机器人演示对，仅需可扩展的人类配对数据，之后再进行机器人后训练。

Result: 机器人后训练前的分析显示：跨具身运动对齐改善，在未见机器人上的动作与视频预测更好，表征更接近由机器人配对学习所得。接入机器人后训练后，WATCH 将 MimicDroid 的上下文成功率从 Cosmos Policy 的 40.9% 提升至 68.3%，从 Cosmos3 的 59.8% 提升至 77.7%，在未见难度层级上增益最大；在跨机器人具身的无上下文后训练下增益依然保持，并优于视频内预训练与联合训练基线。

Conclusion: 跨视频预测是一种可扩展地学习可迁移世界-动作表征的途径；仅用人类-人类配对演示即可获得跨场景、跨具身的任务交互先验，并显著提升机器人策略在未见环境中的泛化表现。

Abstract: World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training. However, standard within-video next-frame prediction allows them to rely on appearance shared between the context and future, rather than learning interactions that transfer across scenes and embodiments. We introduce WATCH, a cross-video pre-training that learns from task-paired human demonstrations collected across diverse environments. Conditioned on the video and actions of one demonstration, the model jointly predicts another demonstration's actions and future frames from its current observation. Predicting one demonstration from another encourages the model to learn task-relevant interactions that transfer across scenes and demonstrators. Our pre-training shows that these capabilities can be learned from readily scalable human-human pairs alone, without requiring matched human-robot demonstrations. Analyses before robot post-training show improved motion alignment across embodiments and better action and video prediction on unseen robots, with representations closer to those learned from robot pairs. After robot post-training, WATCH improves MimicDroid in-context success from 40.9% to 68.3% with Cosmos Policy and from 59.8% to 77.7% with Cosmos3, with the largest gains on the unseen levels. Gains persist under context-free post-training across robot embodiments. WATCH outperforms within-video pre-training and co-training baselines, supporting cross-video prediction as a scalable approach to learning transferable world-action representations.

</details>


### [159] [RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14397)
*Perrault, Andrew,Takiar, Anmol,Winecki, Dominik,Nandi, Arnab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文用Blender构建11个真实户外作业环境（含屋顶光伏、车辆维修）的合成物理工作基准，评估26个视觉语言模型在"文档化理解"与"可接受性（是否可作为工作凭证）"两项任务上的表现，发现模型能处理帧内文字但弱于读数、小部件与空间关系判断，且可接受性判断仅相当于单个非作者人类评分者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体通过相机/智能眼镜辅助物理工作者的关键能力是理解作业状态并生成文档，但真实物理工作数据私有、变异大，缺乏原则化的评测；现有结构化场景（厨房、仓库）无法代表屋顶光伏、车辆维修这类高变异、无约束的现场任务。

Method: 在Blender中建模11个真实物理工作环境，并变化图像可接受性与文档化条件；定义两项任务：可接受性（该视角是否可作为工作证明）与文档化（智能体能否从该视角理解任务相关环境状态）。对26个视觉语言模型进行评测，并与人类评分者（含作者与非作者）进行对比校准。

Result: 顶尖模型在"答案为帧内文字"时基本解决文档化，但在读取测量值、识别小部件和空间关系（如卷尺是否倾斜）方面较弱。可接受性判断因人类评分者间分歧大而难以界定；相对与人类多数意见一致率约等于单个评分者的评分器，最佳模型无法与单个非作者评分者区分，成本位于人类通过一次的水平。在可追溯错误的三类环境中，多数误拒源于对场景的误读而非对要求的误解。在三个有真实图像对照的文档化问题上，渲染帧上的模型排序可迁移到真实图像。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了高变异真实物理工作场景的合成评测框架，揭示VLM在空间/测量推理和小部件识别上的短板及可接受性判断的人力对齐困境；渲染帧结论可迁移到真实图像，为后续现场辅助智能体的能力评估与改进提供基础。

Abstract: Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. The acceptability task asks whether a particular view would be suitable proof-of-work and documentation asks whether an agent can understand the task-relevant state of the environment from that view. Across 26 vision-language models, we find that top models largely solve documentation when the answer is text in frame, but are weak at reading measurements and at judging small parts and spatial relations, such as whether a tape measure leans. Acceptability is harder to pin down because human raters disagree with each other. Measured against a scorer that agrees with the raters' majority about as often as a single rater does, the best models cannot be distinguished from a single non-author rater, at a cost within the range of a human pass. In the three environments where we can trace acceptability errors, most wrong rejections come from misreading the scene rather than the requirement. On the three documentation questions for which we have real images, model rankings on rendered frames transfer to real images.

</details>


### [160] [VisualCoding: Learning Executable Skills for Reliable Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14403)
*Jiaqi, Liu,Ruinan, Jin,Xiaoxiao, Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisualCoding将「执行引导的可复用视觉程序获取」与「按作用域直接复用程序答案」结合，在69个任务族上验证，平均准确率较最强基线提升4.45（Gemini-3.1-Pro）和14.78（复用冻结Pro产物于Flash-Lite）个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉推理智能体虽可从经验中学习可复用技能，但复用阶段仍须由模型自行实现或调用过程并生成最终答案，该环节的错误与幻觉会削弱已获取经验在单次运行中的收益。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：执行引导的程序获取（Execution-Guided Program Acquisition）将视觉原语与附加代码组合成族级求解器，并在带标注训练实例上迭代测试与修正；作用域感知直接执行（Scope-Aware Direct Execution）运行已保留的求解器，对其判定在作用域内的输入直接返回有效答案，而非重新调用或改写程序。

Result: 在4个模型、4个基准、69个任务族上评测。Gemini-3.1-Pro平均准确率超最强基线4.45个百分点；用Flash-Lite复用冻结的Pro产物时提升14.78个百分点。消融实验支持执行引导获取的有效性，并显示直接执行优于对同一程序的文本式或可调用式复用。

Conclusion: 以执行反馈获取可复用视觉程序、并对适用输入直接采纳其答案，可显著提升智能体单次运行的视觉推理可靠性，且所得程序产物具备跨模型复用价值。

Abstract: Learning reusable skills can improve visual reasoning agents, yet applying a skill still requires the agent to implement or invoke a procedure and produce the final answer. Errors and hallucinations at these steps can prevent acquired experience from translating into reliable single-run performance. We propose VisualCoding, which combines execution-guided acquisition of reusable visual programs with direct adoption of their answers on applicable inputs. Execution-Guided Program Acquisition composes visual primitives and additional code into family-level solvers, then iteratively tests and revises them on labeled training instances. Scope-Aware Direct Execution runs a retained solver and returns its valid in-scope answer. We evaluate VisualCoding on four models across four benchmarks spanning 69 task families. VisualCoding exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in mean accuracy by 4.45 percentage points with Gemini-3.1-Pro and by 14.78 points when reusing the frozen Pro-acquired artifacts with Flash-Lite. Ablations support execution-guided acquisition and show that direct execution outperforms textual or callable reuse of the same programs. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaq-liu/VisualCoding.

</details>


### [161] [SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14439)
*Li, Chaoyue,Han, Shoudong,Wu, Haoyang,Yang, Boxue,Chen, Sijia,Chen, Yufan,Zhang, Ruping*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"场景演化理解"(SEU)任务，构建SceneForesee基准（144.57K时序对、1.05M实体对应、272.49K事件），并提出EvoSee时空推理框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配学习未来几何与事件语义，在SceneForesee和Dyn-Bench上均显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LMM需要理解场景发展过程中实体如何运动与交互，这要求跨时间跟踪同一实体并将其观测运动与后续变化关联。现有工作缺乏对"实体连续性+场景演化推理"这一能力的显式建模与评测基准，因此作者将预测和解释场景变化形式化为SEU任务。

Method: 提出EvoSee框架：基于共享候选状态与联合分配（joint assignment）学习未来几何与Event语义；为每个实体从观测中选取一个continuation，并利用被选中的变化进行实体精炼、保持与场景表示；同时带有Visual Evidence与场景描述输出。配套构建SceneForesee基准，含成对的观测/未来场景并共享实体身份。

Result: 在SceneForesee上，Combined Point-F1较Qwen3.5-9B提升10.45分，Event Global F1提升17.24分；在4D推理基准Dyn-Bench上，问答准确率与grounding J&F分别较各自基线提升4.8与3.58分。

Conclusion: 结果表明场景演化既可作为一种预测目标，也可作为一种动态表示，将预测的实体变化引入时空推理，为LMM的视频/4D理解提供了新任务设定与方法。

Abstract: Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

</details>


### [162] [FreeCHROMA: Generative Chroma Keying from Unaligned Background References](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14445)
*Wu, Jiayi,Wang, Tianfu,Zhao, Rui,Schiffers, Florian,Chen, Zhimin,Fermuller, Cornelia,Yang, Yezhou,Metzler, Christopher,Aloimonos, Yiannis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FreeCHROMA 用参数高效微调预训练视频扩散模型，从 1–3 张未对齐背景参考图实现端到端生成式抠像合成，无需预对齐、独立重光照或首帧环境表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 chroma keying 需协调拍摄的背景板与专门的和化(harmonization)流程；近期生成式方法多要求预对齐背景、仅做背景条件的前景重光照，或用编辑后的首帧表示环境，从而限制背景选择、场景构图与相机运动，并增加准备/编辑成本。

Method: 在预训练视频扩散模型上做参数高效适配（parameter-efficient adaptation），以 1–3 张未对齐背景参考为条件，将前景生成式合成进参考环境；同一生成过程中完成前景-背景和谐化，省略独立重光照阶段；可选文本指令消歧复杂空间关系与相机行为。训练数据由真实单目视频经基座模型做前景-背景分离与增强，构造伪配对数据，原视频作为监督目标，配自动处理与质量校验实现可扩展构建。

Result: 在参考保真度、前景保持、场景融合、和谐化与整体视频质量上一致优于近期合成与条件视频生成基线，相机运动条件下增益尤为明显；探索性实验显示其在机器人领域的潜力。

Conclusion: FreeCHROMA 放松了现有工具的约束，实现从未对齐输入到端到端的生成式抠像合成，并可扩展到机器人等下游场景。

Abstract: In film production, chroma keying composites an approved foreground performance into a new environment, but conventional workflows require coordinated background plates and dedicated harmonization. Recent generative methods often require pre-aligned backgrounds, focus on background-conditioned foreground relighting, or represent the environment only through an edited first frame. These restrictions limit background selection, scene composition, and camera motion while adding preparation or editing effort. We present FreeCHROMA, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion model in a parameter-efficient manner for generative video compositing from one to three unaligned background references. The model integrates the foreground into the referenced environment, preserving foreground identity, motion, and fine visual details while generating a spatiotemporally coherent background. Foreground-background harmonization occurs within the same generation process, without a separate relighting stage. Optional text instructions help disambiguate complex spatial relationships and camera behavior. To train the model, we construct pseudo-paired data from readily available real monocular videos through foreground-background separation and augmentation with existing foundation models. The original videos serve as training targets, while automated processing and quality verification enable scalable data construction. Across reference fidelity, foreground preservation, scene integration, harmonization, and overall video quality, FreeCHROMA consistently outperforms recent compositing and conditional video-generation baselines, with particularly clear gains under camera motion. FreeCHROMA relaxes the constraints of existing tools to enable end-to-end generative chroma keying from unaligned inputs, with exploratory experiments demonstrating its potential in robotics.

</details>


### [163] [DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14499)
*Li, Fan,Xiang, Jian,Xue, LinLin,Gao, Yuwei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DSR-Net，通过动态骨骼关系建模、层级关系感知融合与轻量残差骨骼重校准模块，实现自适应关节依赖学习的3D人体姿态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计方法多依赖GCN的固定骨骼拓扑或注意力隐式建模关节关系，难以适应多样化的运动模式，缺乏对运动相关骨骼结构与关节间依赖的显式动态建模能力。

Method: DSR-Net包含三个核心组件：1) 动态骨骼关系（DSR）模块，学习超越预定义骨骼连接的关节自适应依赖关系；2) 基于学习到的关系构建层级关系感知融合策略，促进结构与时序表征的有效交互；3) 轻量残差骨骼重校准模块（RSRM），以极小计算开销增强结构感知特征的稳定性。

Result: 在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上分别取得37.9 mm和14.9 mm的MPJPE，持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了动态骨骼关系建模对鲁棒3D人体姿态估计的有效性，表明自适应关节依赖学习是提升运动泛化能力的关键方向。

Abstract: 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

</details>


### [164] [Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14512)
*Athreya, Shreeram,Melehy, Andrew,Prentice, Carter,Robinson, Michael,Arnold, Corey,Wu, James,Speier, William*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究在光学套管针穿刺入腹过程中，将每一帧划分为28个极坐标网格扇区并标注9类组织，采用梯度提升发射分类器结合颜色、邻域扇区与位置特征，再叠加学习式时间平滑、空间正则、解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型与后验融合，在71段录像、1,516关键帧上做按录像分组五折交叉验证。完整流程使准确率、宏F1与宏AUROC分别提升至0.646、0.507、0.882，标签跳变由66.2降至19.5次/扇区·分钟，深度编码起始误差中位数由15.58s降至2.45s，但腹膜前脂肪与肠管识别仍受限，过早起始比例残存44%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学套管针入腹时视野内常同时出现多层腹壁组织，单帧外观信息不足以稳定区分组织类别与"腹膜或更深层"的起始时刻；作者希望验证引入空间上下文与时序建模能否提升回顾性组织识别精度与入腹起始定位的稳定性。

Method: 回顾性分析71段录像（1,516个标注关键帧、29,151个临床医生标注扇区）。每帧切为28个极坐标网格扇区，归入9类组织。发射分类器为梯度提升，输入颜色、相邻扇区及位置特征。完整流程在其上叠加：学习式时间平滑、空间正则、解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型、后验概率融合。采用按录像分组的五折交叉验证并作交叉拟合以避免同录像泄漏；指标以临床医生标注为目标，消融评估分类、概率质量、空间一致性与腹膜或更深层起始时序。

Result: 完整流程：准确率0.646、宏F1 0.507、宏AUROC 0.882；仅用发射分类器时为0.600、0.440、0.861。宏F1在五折中均提升0.066。标签跳变由66.2降至19.5次/扇区·分钟；起始时刻误差中位数由15.58s降至2.45s。组织深度编码跨度≥3的帧比例由53%降至26%（临床医生标注为22%）。腹膜前脂肪与肠管性能仍有限；完整模型仍保留44%的过早起始比例。

Conclusion: 融合外观、空间上下文与时序约束可改善回顾性组织识别与起始定位；但存在组织类别特定瓶颈、残余时序误差，且依赖未来观测（非因果），在临床使用前需外部验证与因果模型的前瞻性评估。

Abstract: Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.

</details>


### [165] [TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14513)
*Kwon, Hyeokjoon,Cai, Jiting,Li, Ruogu,Bhandari, Kritan,Hemkumar, Geethika,Maheshwari, Parv,Qiu, Yuheng,Zhang, Yuchen,Scherer, Sebastian,Wang, Wenshan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TartanMatch：单一共享网络实现 RGB、事件、热成像、深度、投影LiDAR 共25个有序模态对之间的稠密对应，借助轻量模态适配与真实+合成数据混合，在零样本真实基准上大幅降低EPE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人平台搭载多模态传感器，但现有稠密对应方法多局限于RGB-RGB或少数模态对；为每个模态对单独训练模型随传感器数量增长而不可扩展，且浪费模态对之间的正迁移潜力。

Method: TartanMatch：以RGB预训练的对应模型为基础，通过轻量级模态适配模块和真实/合成数据混合策略，在单一共享网络中统一适配全部25个有序模态对；联合训练所有模态对。

Result: 零样本真实世界基准上，跨模态匹配EPE较最强基线降低61.9%，同模态匹配降低49.6%；联合训练相比逐对训练提升平均匹配精度，尤其在困难的跨模态对上。

Conclusion: 单一统一模型即可实现广泛多模态覆盖并达到SOTA匹配精度，验证了跨模态正迁移的有效性，为机器人多传感器稠密对应提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

</details>


### [166] [Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14514)
*Xiao, Yang,Deng, Kaiyuan,Li, Gen,Ling, Zinan,Fan, Zhiwen,Ma, Xiaolong,Hui, Bo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出域流形遗忘（DMU），利用扩散中间特征的EMA特征代理表示被保留目标对象方向，实现对象-风格组合场景下的选择性遗忘，缓解多请求遗忘中的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型存在生成非法内容与版权侵权的风险，需要机器遗忘来移除有害概念或受版权保护的风格。但已有方法多局限于对象级或风格级移除，无法处理"对象+风格"组合遗忘；同时多个遗忘请求叠加会导致灾难性遗忘。

Method: DMU从扩散模型中间层特征中提取EMA更新的特征代理，用以表征需保留的目标对象方向；该代理作为对象的轻量估计表示，使模型能够选择性地遗忘特定对象中的域相关成分，同时保留其他语义表示，从而提升多组合遗忘场景下的鲁棒性。

Result: 大量实验表明DMU显著缓解灾难性遗忘，在批量遗忘与顺序遗忘两类设定下均优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: DMU通过流形上的轻量特征代理实现了对象-风格组合的细粒度遗忘，为扩散模型多请求遗忘提供了一种有效且鲁棒的方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

</details>


### [167] [We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14517)
*Meng, Benyuan,Huang, Longtao,Liu, Yang,Lin, Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文重新解释扩散模型（DiT）深度维度上"倒U形"中间激活性能曲线的成因，提出预测目标（ε/u/x0）而非信号粒度才是曲线中心，并用该解释预测REPA的最优插入位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散骨干前向过程中产生的中间激活，其下游基准性能随深度呈倒U形，社区普遍将其归因于"信号由粗到细"，但缺乏DiT证据；且研究多为静态分析，未考察不同训练设置下曲线如何变化。作者希望给出更准确的机制解释并使相关应用（如REPA）可被预测。

Method: 通过在不同训练设置（不同预测目标ε、u、x0等）下对各深度中间激活施加统一下游评测协议，绘制深度性能曲线，对比分析以检验"信号粒度"假说，并围绕预测目标构建新的机制解释。

Result: 语义上有意义的信号只是预测目标的中间副产物，预测目标才是骨干的真正目标；预测目标的选择（属于训练设置的一部分）可系统性地预测曲线形状，进而可用于预测REPA等应用的最优层位放置。

Conclusion: 倒U形深度曲线的成因应重新归因于预测目标而非信号粒度；更新后的解释使该现象的多种下游应用更可解释、更可预测，例如依据训练设置的预测目标确定REPA的近似最优插入位置。

Abstract: During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $\epsilon$, $u$, $x_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.

</details>


### [168] [InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14544)
*Wang, Songkai,Bai, Xiaokai,Yang, Lei,Shen, Hui-liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfraWorld 将路侧 4D 占据预测建模为选择性状态演化：用稠密 BEV 状态承载全局场景，用持久化运动查询承载局部动态，通过 DQI、LST 与 MAQI 实现运动区域定向更新，在 InfraOcc 与 Occ3D-nus 上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧场景具有"全局结构化、局部演化"的双重特性：需要完整场景级上下文，又需精确建模稀疏局部运动。现有预测范式难以同时满足这两点，往往在全局上下文保持与局部动态刻画之间受制。

Method: 提出 InfraWorld 世界模型，将路侧占据预测形式化为选择性状态演化。维护稠密 BEV 状态（全局）与持久化运动查询（局部动态）两类互补状态；用 Dynamic Query Initiation（DQI）在历史运动支持区域初始化查询；rollout 时用 Long–Short Temporal Fusion（LST）融合短时相邻帧连续性与长时运动趋势更新稠密状态；再用 Motion-Aware Query Injection（MAQI）细化查询并将置信度加权信息注入对应 BEV token，实现定向动态更新而不扰动全局上下文。

Result: 在 InfraOcc 与 Occ3D-nus 数据集上取得路侧 4D 占据预测的 SOTA；在自车中心（ego-centric）设定下仍保持有效性。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 通过区分全局稠密状态与局部运动查询并按运动感知方式注入更新，可将预测容量集中于演化中的交通区域，兼顾场景一致性与局部动态精度，方法具备跨设定（路侧与自车）的适应性。

Abstract: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.

</details>


### [169] [Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14553)
*Xia, Chenxi,Xu, Yixuan,Liu, Shan,Wang, Jiapeng,Li, Maohua,Tang, Hanlin,Liu, Kan,Lan, Tao,Lu, Weiyi,Liu, Xinggao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF) 框架，通过对抗扰动自生成历史并结合分布匹配梯度联合训练，提升少步自回归视频生成模型的局部历史鲁棒性，缓解长时域误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成在长时域生成中仍存在误差累积。作者指出其关键局限在于模型对自生成历史中的误差高度敏感，微小偏差会被后续生成放大，并将该未被充分探索的问题命名为“局部历史鲁棒性缺口”。

Method: AGF 利用未来块预测的分布匹配梯度来筛选自生成历史的对抗扰动，然后在原始历史与扰动历史上联合训练生成器，以增强后续生成的鲁棒性；训练仅需 5 秒 rollout。

Result: 在 60 秒视频生成上取得最高 VBench Total 分数，在四分钟视频生成上取得最佳视觉质量。

Conclusion: 面向自回归视频模型历史敏感性问题，AGF 以低成本短 rollout 训练实现了长时域生成鲁棒性提升，可视为对 Self Forcing 类方法的鲁棒性扩展。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation models generate videos sequentially, with each new block conditioned on previously generated blocks. By training on the model's own rollouts, Self Forcing and its follow-up methods substantially mitigate exposure bias caused by the mismatch between training- and inference-time history distributions. However, these models still suffer from error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We identify a key underlying limitation: the model remains highly sensitive to errors in its generated history, allowing small deviations to be amplified through subsequent generations. We refer to this underexplored problem as the local history robustness gap. To address this gap, we introduce Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF), a framework designed to improve the robustness of few-step autoregressive video models to perturbations and accumulated errors in their own generated histories. AGF uses distribution matching gradients from future block predictions to select adversarial perturbations of self-generated histories. It then jointly trains the generator on the original and perturbed histories to improve the robustness of future generation. Extensive experiments show that AGF achieves the highest VBench Total score on 60-second video generation and the best visual quality on four-minute video generation. Notably, AGF achieves such long-horizon robustness while requiring only 5-second rollouts for training.

</details>


### [170] [FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14568)
*Liu, Muyu,Liu, Mingming,Gu, Hong,Zhang, Yuyao,Lu, Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FrameFold：一种免训练的自回归视频生成KV缓存合并方法，通过比较合并前后"近期历史查询"检索到的内容来指导代表构造与合并选择，在匹配缓存预算下提升长视频一致性与画质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成中保留全部历史KV会随视频变长而增加显存与每步注意力开销；固定缓存预算虽可控制成本，但如何在有限预算下保留支撑一致、高质量生成的历史内容仍是难题。现有基于选择或合并的缓存控制方法，都面临"保留什么"与"如何减少有用内容损失"的共同挑战。作者分析发现：不同空间查询依赖不同历史内容，且当前注意力覆盖率高并不必然带来更好的长视频质量。

Method: FrameFold为免训练方法：利用相邻历史条目间的时间冗余，将其KV状态合并为共享代表，同时保留完整空间网格（不做空间下采样）；以同一组近期历史查询在合并前后检索到的内容做比较，作为响应失真度量；通过匹配条件注意力响应，闭式求解值合并系数，再选择剩余响应失真最小的合并方案。

Result: 在匹配KV缓存预算下，Self Forcing与Causal Forcing在30秒、60秒，以及LongLive在120秒的实验中，一致性与视觉质量均提升；Self Forcing连续8分钟长程生成的质量退化小于基线。

Conclusion: 以查询响应一致性为目标、利用时间冗余的闭式KV合并，可在有限缓存预算下有效缓解长视频生成的画质退化，且无需训练、适配多种自回归视频生成框架。

Abstract: In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

</details>


### [171] [Attribute-Centric Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Gait Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14589)
*Hou, Saihui,Wang, Chenye,Lang, Wenpeng,Guo, Qiannan,Lan, Zhengxiang,Fan, Chao,Yu, Shiqi,Huang, Yongzhen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RA-GAR大规模步态属性识别多模态基准（1001人、242,729序列、15种属性）与Gait-VL视觉-语言对齐框架，通过属性特定查询聚合多帧RGB证据与LLM扩展的文本类原型匹配，并验证属性预训练视觉编码器可迁移至身份步态识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有步态属性识别基准缺乏细粒度标注，且基于分类器的方法用学习到的输出权重表示候选类，而非将视觉证据与文本类表示直接匹配，限制了对步态属性的可解释细粒度理解。

Method: 构建RA-GAR基准；提出Gait-VL：视觉侧用属性特定的可学习查询跨空间位置与帧聚合RGB特征，得到逐属性视觉embedding；语言侧用LLM扩展多样描述并结合相关身体区域上下文，构建文本类原型；通过视觉证据与类原型匹配完成属性识别。属性预训练不涉及身份分类或度量学习目标。

Result: 在RA-GAR上取得SOTA属性识别性能；属性预训练视觉编码器替换通用上游大视觉模型后，在多个身份步态识别流水线与基准上取得一致性提升，表明属性中心表示的有效性与可迁移性。

Conclusion: 属性中心的视觉-语言对齐可实现细粒度步态理解，并作为通用上游预训练任务为身份识别提供有效、可迁移的视觉表示，验证了该学习范式的泛化价值。

Abstract: Walking sequences reveal human-interpretable attributes related to body structure, posture, and motion. Gait attribute recognition provides a concrete route to fine-grained gait understanding by predicting these attributes. However, existing benchmarks provide limited fine-grained annotations, while classifier-based gait attribute recognition methods typically represent candidate classes through learned output weights rather than directly matching visual evidence with textual class representations. To address the annotation gap, we present RA-GAR, a large-scale, richly annotated multimodal benchmark for gait attribute recognition, containing 1,001 subjects, 242,729 walking sequences, and annotations for 15 static and motion gait attributes. We further propose Gait-VL, an attribute-centric vision-language alignment framework that recognizes gait attributes by matching attribute-specific multi-frame visual evidence with textual class prototypes. On the visual side, attribute-specific learnable queries aggregate RGB features across spatial locations and frames into per-attribute visual embeddings. On the language side, diverse descriptions expanded by a large language model are combined with context about relevant body regions to construct textual class prototypes. Beyond attribute recognition, we evaluate the transferability of the attribute-pretrained visual encoder by using it to replace generic upstream large vision models in identityoriented gait recognition pipelines; attribute pre-training uses no identity classification or metric-learning objectives. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art attribute recognition performance on RA-GAR and consistent improvements in downstream identity recognition across multiple pipelines and benchmarks, supporting the effectiveness and transferability of attribute-centric gait representation learning.

</details>


### [172] [Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14598)
*Jiang, Yuxin,Cao, Yunkang,Shen, Weiming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双向自适应Transformer（BAT）框架，通过双向特征对齐与参数高效适配缓解RGB与点云多模态异常检测中的跨模态干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-点云多模态异常检测依赖冻结编码器上的静态融合范式，仅完成空间对齐而缺乏潜在语义对应，导致跨模态干扰、异常判别性下降。

Method: BAT包含双向特征对齐（BFA）模块，用互预测机制在2D纹理与3D几何结构间建立双向交互，增强点云描述子纹理粒度与RGB特征空间上下文；并引入参数高效的图像/点云适配器微调预训练模型，减少冻结编码器的信息损失。

Result: 在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies数据集上达到SOTA，显著优于现有MAD方法。

Conclusion: 双向语义对齐加轻量适配可有效提升多模态异常检测的判别能力。

Abstract: The effective integration of features derived from RGB images and 3D point clouds presents a substantial challenge in the field of multimodal anomaly detection (MAD). Existing MAD methods typically rely on static fusion paradigms built upon frozen pre-trained encoders. While these frameworks facilitate spatial alignment, they lack the mechanism to establish latent semantic correspondence, thereby inducing cross-modal interference that degrades anomaly discriminability. To mitigate these limitations, this study proposes a Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers (BAT) framework, which constructs comprehensive and semantically aligned multimodal representations by leveraging complementary attributes across modalities. The BAT framework introduces a Bidirectional Feature Alignment (BFA) module, which employs a mutual predictive mechanism to bridge the gap between 2D textural patterns and 3D geometric structures. This bidirectional interaction explicitly enhances the textural granularity of point cloud descriptors while augmenting the spatial contextual awareness of RGB features. To ensure that the latent representations possess sufficient informational density for alignment, BAT incorporates a parameter-efficient adaptation architecture. By utilizing lightweight image and point cloud adapters, the framework facilitates specialized fine-tuning of pre-trained models, mitigating the information loss inherent in frozen encoders. Extensive experiments conducted on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies confirm that BAT achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance, significantly outperforming existing MAD methods.

</details>


### [173] [EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14609)
*Wang, ZiAn,Liu, Ruiqi,Zhang, Zhengbo,Han, Yi,Shen, Jialiang,Chen, Ruoxin,Cui, Manni,Zhu, Ximo,Jiang, Jin,Liu, Mingzhe,Wang, Linhao,Wang, Wenhao,Wu, Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"图像事实性评估"任务（给定图像与通用验证指令，输出支持/驳斥判定及证据支撑的解释），构建专家审核基准 EviLens（10,174 张图、12 类事实错误）并提出多模态 ReAct 智能体 EviScene，通过 SFT + 特权 on-policy 自蒸馏训练，9B 模型达 79.05% 平衡准确率与 52.26% SESR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测只判断图像是否由模型生成，无法回答"图像所描绘的情形是否与事实相符"。在无显式文本声明的前提下，系统必须自主提出并迭代细化事实性问题，并将外部证据与图中具体情境对齐，这一能力此前缺乏任务定义、评测基准与方法。

Method: 定义 Image Factuality Assessment 任务并构建 EviLens 基准（受控构造 + 网络收集，10,174 张支持/驳斥图像，覆盖 12 类事实错误，同时评测判定准确率与证据充分性）；提出 EviScene 多模态 ReAct 智能体，交替进行视觉检查、外部检索与证据分析，用新发现细化问题并回看图像细节；以专家审核的教师轨迹做监督微调，再对策略自身调查中被验证的决策进行特权 on-policy 自蒸馏，得到紧凑策略模型。

Result: 在 1,527 张测试集上，训练后的 Qwen3.5-9B 智能体取得 79.05% 平衡准确率与 52.26% 严格证据充分率（SESR），较同骨干基线智能体分别提升 6.71 与 9.37 个百分点，SESR 在被评测智能体中最高。代码、模型与数据将开源。

Conclusion: 该工作将"图像是否真实"的问题从生成检测推进到事实核查层面，提供任务定义、可审核基准与可训练的多模态调查式智能体；其"检索—验证—自蒸馏"的迭代证据对齐范式对需要外部事实核验的智能体系统具有迁移价值，但对具身智能/机器人方向属外围相关，优先级有限。

Abstract: Determining whether an image is AI-generated does not establish whether the situation it depicts is factually supported. We formulate Image Factuality Assessment: given an image and a generic verification instruction, a system returns a supported or refuted verdict with an evidence-grounded explanation. Without a supplied textual claim, the system must progressively refine factual questions during investigation and align external evidence with the specific situation depicted. We introduce EviLens, an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 supported and refuted images from controlled construction and web collection, covering twelve factual error types and evaluating both verdict accuracy and evidence sufficiency. We develop EviScene, a multimodal ReAct agent that interleaves visual inspection, external retrieval, and evidence analysis, using new findings to refine its questions and revisit relevant image details. We train a compact policy with supervised fine-tuning on reviewed teacher trajectories, followed by privileged on-policy self-distillation applied to verified decisions from the policy's own investigations. On the 1,527-image test set, the trained Qwen3.5-9B agent achieves 79.05% balanced accuracy and a Strict Evidence Sufficiency Rate (SESR) of 52.26%, improving over the same-backbone base agent by 6.71 and 9.37 percentage points, respectively. Its SESR is the highest among the evaluated agents.Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/wangzian828/EVISCENE and https://huggingface.co/ZiAnwang/EviScene.

</details>


### [174] [EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14624)
*Maani, Fadillah Adamsyah,Saeed, Numan,Ma, Jiaqi,Nguyen, Dat Tien,Wehbe, Youssef,Watson-Parris, Duncan,Khan, Salman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EarthAlign 大规模气象-语言对齐数据集与 MeteoLIP 双编码器框架（含 MetTok 时空条件化 tokenizer），在检索、天气分类、物理变量估计三任务上优于 CLIP/SigLIP 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地球系统多模态工作多为任务专用（预测、生成、问答），缺乏气象数据与语言的通用对齐；根本瓶颈在于缺少以气象条件为基础、风格多样的语言监督数据。

Method: 1) EarthAlign：2000–2024 全球覆盖，融合 10 个专家整理的自然事件/灾害数据源与气候学推导的常态天气样本，每样本含时空信息与 4 种接地字幕风格，对齐 63 变量 ERA5 数据；2) MeteoLIP：双编码器气象-语言表示对齐，其中 MetTok 以地理位置与时间条件化 query 将变量级 patch embedding 聚合为紧凑气象 token 序列；3) 三项下游评测：跨模态检索、天气状态分类、物理变量估计，并做气象输入、时空条件、多风格监督的消融分析。

Result: MeteoLIP 在三项下游任务上均优于对应 CLIP 与 SigLIP 基线；消融显示气象输入、时间/地理空间条件化以及多风格监督对气象-语言对齐均有显著贡献。代码、数据与权重已开源。

Conclusion: EarthAlign 与 MeteoLIP 为地球系统数据提供了可学习、可评测的语言对齐表示基础，可作为气象多模态通用对齐的底座。

Abstract: Interpreting Earth system conditions is central to understanding environmental risks and informing decisions across weather- and climate-sensitive sectors. Existing multimodal weather systems primarily target task-specific prediction, generation, or question answering, while general-purpose alignment between Earth system data and language remains underexplored due to the limited availability of diverse language supervision grounded in meteorological conditions. To fill this gap, we introduce EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset with broad geographic coverage spanning 2000-2024 that combines 10 expert-curated natural event and disaster data sources with climatology-derived normal-weather samples. Each sample includes temporal and geospatial information and four grounded caption styles aligned with 63-variable ERA5 meteorological data. Building on EarthAlign, we introduce MeteoLIP, a dual-encoder framework for learning aligned meteorology-language representations. MeteoLIP incorporates MetTok, which uses a geolocation- and time-conditioned query to aggregate variable-specific patch embeddings into a compact sequence of meteorology tokens. To comprehensively assess Earth system multimodal representations, we introduce three downstream tasks: cross-modal retrieval, weather-condition classification, and physical variable estimation. Our experiments show that MeteoLIP improves upon the corresponding CLIP and SigLIP baselines across these tasks. Further analyses highlight the importance of meteorological input, temporal and geospatial conditioning, and multi-style supervision for meteorology-language alignment. Thus, EarthAlign and MeteoLIP provide a foundation for learning and evaluating language-aligned representations of Earth system data. Our code, dataset, and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EarthAlign.

</details>


### [175] [DuSRFlow: Dual-Lens Super-Resolution via Parallax-Aware Flow Estimation and Complementary Reference Warping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14630)
*Zhang, Fangpu,Yue, Huanjing,Cui, Zifan,Tu, Shaoxiong,Yang, Qirui,Yang, Jingyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双镜头超分框架 DuSRFlow，从对应学习与参考聚合两方面提升参考图利用率，并构建真实基准 DuSR-RealV2，取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双镜头超分（DuSR）需利用长焦参考图增强广角低分图，但大视差、遮挡、跨相机差异下参考利用困难；现成单目光流模型假设光度一致与平滑运动，在双镜头场景中被破坏，导致对齐不可靠、重建退化。

Method: 1) DuFlowNet：专用双镜头光流估计器实现鲁棒跨视角对齐；2) 真实-合成数据融合策略：将合成前景物体合成到真实双镜头图像对上，无需光流真值即可生成可控大视差样本并保留真实跨相机成像特性；3) 互补参考变形策略：依据局部参考可靠性协调基于 patch 的变形与无核引导可变形变形，在融合前得到更可靠的参考表示；4) 构建 DuSR-RealV2 真实基准。

Result: 在多个 DuSR 基准上，重建质量、感知质量与跨数据集泛化均达到 SOTA。

Conclusion: 针对双镜头场景光流假设失效问题，通过专用光流估计、可控大视差数据合成与可靠性感知的参考聚合，显著提升参考图利用效率；DuSR-RealV2 为复杂深度、大视差与遮挡场景提供具挑战性的评测基准。

Abstract: Dual-lens super-resolution (DuSR) aims to enhance a wide-angle low-resolution (LR) image by exploiting a telephoto reference (Ref) image. A central challenge in DuSR is reliable reference utilization under large parallax, occlusion, and cross-camera imaging discrepancies. Existing methods often employ off-the-shelf monocular optical flow models to provide geometric priors. However, their assumptions of photometric consistency and smooth motion are violated in dual-lens scenarios, leading to unreliable alignment and degraded reference-based reconstruction. To address these issues, we propose DuSRFlow, a dual-lens super-resolution framework that improves reference utilization from both correspondence learning and reference aggregation. First, we introduce DuFlowNet, a dedicated dual-lens flow estimator for robust cross-view alignment. To train DuFlowNet without ground-truth flow annotations, we develop a real--synthetic data fusion strategy that composites synthetic foreground objects onto real dual-lens image pairs, generating controllable large-parallax samples while preserving realistic cross-camera imaging characteristics. Second, we observe that reference reliability is highly spatially uneven in DuSR, where unreliable local reference responses may suppress the utilization of reliable cues. We therefore propose a Complementary Reference Warping strategy that coordinates patch-based warping and kernel-free-guided deformable warping according to local reference reliability, producing a more reliable reference representation before LR--Ref fusion. In addition, we construct DuSR-RealV2, a challenging real-world benchmark with complex depth variations, large parallax, and occlusion. Extensive experiments on multiple DuSR benchmarks demonstrate that DuSRFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction quality, perceptual quality, and cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [176] [Automatic assembly modeling through attention-based assembly feature mate prediction and assembly feature pattern recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14633)
*Dai, Ziheng,Pan, Wanbin,Tang, Zhihong,Gao, Shuming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于装配特征配合（assembly feature mate）预测的数据驱动装配建模框架：自动标注管线构建大规模数据集，注意力网络预测配合关系并以工程兼容性融合（ECF）注入显式工程约束，再用装配特征模式（AFPs）引导匹配，后处理搜索生成并求解装配约束。六装配集约束准确率74.79%，16装配扩展集64.09%，给定真值面标签时分别提升至81.78%与80.93%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配建模仍是经验依赖、劳动密集的交互操作。现有数据驱动方法或预测无法直接生成可编辑B-Rep装配约束的位姿，或需预设零件对/装配面，候选空间难以收敛，且缺乏装配特征级别的标注数据。

Method: 1) 以装配特征对局部配合界面的几何实体分组，从而无需预设装配面即可收缩约束候选空间；2) 通过自动标注管线构建大规模装配特征数据集；3) 训练注意力网络预测装配特征配合，引入Engineering Compatibility Fusion将显式工程兼容性融入学习到的匹配分数；4) 用装配特征模式（AFP）引导匹配；5) 后处理搜索选择特征配合与AFP配合候选，生成并求解约束完成装配建模。

Result: 在六装配对比集上装配约束准确率74.79%，含该集的16装配扩展测试集上64.09%；额外输入真值面标签时分别提升至81.78%和80.93%。

Conclusion: 以装配特征为单位的配合预测可有效压缩候选空间并免去装配面预设，实现从无装配B-Rep零件到完整装配约束的自动建模；结合工程兼容性与特征模式引导进一步提升了自动化装配建模精度。

Abstract: Assembly modeling plays an important role in constructing product models, yet it is still mainly performed via interactive operations that are experience-dependent and labor-intensive. Data-driven strategies hold promise for automating this process; however, existing approaches either predict poses that cannot directly generate editable B-Rep assembly constraints or require prescribed part pairs or predefined assembly faces. To reduce the large candidate space of constraint prediction without predefined assembly faces, we propose a data-driven framework based on assembly feature mate prediction. The framework performs automatic assembly modeling from unassembled B-Rep parts, using assembly features to group the geometric entities of local mating interfaces and restrict candidate formation. Given the lack of suitable assembly feature annotations in existing datasets, we construct a large-scale dataset through an automatic annotation pipeline. Using the annotated dataset, we train an attention-based network to predict assembly feature mates, with Engineering Compatibility Fusion (ECF) incorporating explicit engineering compatibility into learned matching scores. To improve the accuracy of automatic assembly modeling, we use assembly feature patterns (AFPs) to guide the matching process. Finally, a post-processing search selects assembly feature mate and AFP mate candidates, whose associated constraints are generated and solved to complete assembly modeling. Experimental results show that the framework achieves assembly constraint accuracies of 74.79% on the six-assembly comparison set and 64.09% on the extended test set of 16 assemblies, which includes the comparison set. With ground-truth face labels supplied as additional input, the corresponding accuracies increase to 81.78% and 80.93%, respectively.

</details>


### [177] [Can Synthetic UAV Benchmarks Be Trusted? Real-Synthetic Validation for UAV Model Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14647)
*Zhi, Yuyi,Du, Min,Shi, Bill,Yuan, Guodong,Liang, Junheng,Liao, Peifan,Guan, Xin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究合成UAV图像评估能否替代真实数据做模型选择：在道路碎片基准上排序结论得以保持，但在业务语料检测压力测试中排序被翻转，且真实-合成存在类别、密度与尺度错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成UAV影像可缓解任务专属真实数据稀缺的问题，但视觉逼真度或语义标签对齐本身不足以证明其用于模型选择的有效性，需明确合成评估在何种条件下可信。

Method: 在固定评估协议下设计两个互补案例：(1) 需求特定的道路碎片基准，比较4个语言条件感知系统的F1排序，并做bootstrap与规模匹配重采样；(2) 在独立构建的业务语料上用4个VisDrone兼容检测器、8个经验支持类别做闭集压力测试；另对5个UAV业务场景做类别构成、目标密度与目标尺度的匹配审计。

Result: 道路碎片案例中合成数据绝对F1更低，但点估计排序与最优模型保持一致，bootstrap未发现支持的成对反转；压力测试中合成数据改变点估计最优检测器，并反转6组成对偏好中的3组；审计发现明显的真实-合成失配，尤其小目标系统性欠表示。

Conclusion: 合成UAV基准的可信度是有条件的：语义覆盖不充分，有效性需针对具体任务、运行工况与模型集合进行实证验证。

Abstract: Synthetic UAV imagery can expand pre-deployment test evidence when task-specific Real data are scarce, but visual plausibility or semantic label alignment alone does not establish validity for model selection. We study when Synthetic evaluation preserves the model-selection conclusions obtained from Real UAV data through two complementary cases under fixed evaluation protocols. In a requirement-specific road-debris benchmark, four language-conditioned perception systems obtain lower absolute F1 on Synthetic data, yet the point-estimate ordering and top-ranked model are preserved; bootstrap analysis yields no supported pairwise reversal, and size-matched resampling preserves the top-model decision. In contrast, a closed-set stress test on a separately materialized business corpus, using four VisDrone-compatible detectors over eight empirically supported classes, changes the point-estimate top-ranked detector and reverses three of six pairwise point-estimate preference directions. A complementary audit of five UAV business scenarios further reveals substantial Real-Synthetic mismatch in class composition, object density, and target scale, including systematic under-representation of small targets. These results show that Synthetic UAV benchmark trust is conditional: semantic coverage is insufficient, and validity must be established empirically for the task, operating regime, and model panel of interest.

</details>


### [178] [TAG: Calibrating SAM3 for Universal Image Segmentation without Dense Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14651)
*Zhu, Hao,Sun, Heyu,Jin, Shuo,Xiao, Jiayu,Dai, Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TAG 提出一个无稠密标注的框架，通过文本锚点重定位（Anchor Residual Pathway + Soft Boundary Ranking + Confidence-Weighted Distillation）修复 SAM3 的概念识别瓶颈，仅 3.1M 可训练参数即释放其分割潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM3 将可提示分割从空间线索扩展到概念层面，但这一潜力在下游任务中难以转化为可靠性能。作者实证发现瓶颈并非掩码质量，而是概念识别：SAM3 能精确分割其识别出的目标，却难以稳健判断哪些概念存在。

Method: 提出 Text Anchor re-Grounding (TAG)。核心是 Anchor Residual Pathway，由图像条件化的低秩适配器构成，在目标分布上重新锚定文本并调制后续文本条件交互；仅用图像级类别标签，联合优化二元交叉熵与 Soft Boundary Ranking 目标以校准存在置信度并区分易混淆负类；进一步设计 Confidence-Weighted Distillation，将多模态大模型的语义上下文与 SAM3 的细粒度空间先验耦合。

Result: 大量实验表明 TAG 仅用 3.1M 可训练参数即释放 SAM3 的分割潜力，在多种场景下取得显著性能提升，部分指标甚至超过领先的掩码监督方法。

Conclusion: 概念识别是概念级分割的基础模型可靠性瓶颈；通过轻量文本锚点重定位与置信度加权蒸馏，可在无稠密标注条件下有效校准，为通用分割基础模型的下游适配提供简洁有效范式。

Abstract: The recent Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) extends powerful promptable segmentation from spatial cues to concepts, raising the prospect of a single foundation model for universal image segmentation. However, this promise often fails to translate into reliable performance on downstream segmentation tasks. In this work, we empirically identify concept recognition, rather than mask quality, as the primary bottleneck: SAM3 accurately delineates the objects it recognizes yet struggles to robustly determine which concepts are present. Driven by this, we present \textit{\underline{T}ext \underline{A}nchor re-\underline{G}rounding (\TAG{})}, a simple yet effective framework that rectifies the concept recognition of SAM3 on the target domain without dense annotations. Specifically, \TAG{} introduces an \textit{Anchor Residual Pathway} comprising image-conditioned, low-rank adapters to re-ground text anchors in the target distribution and modulate subsequent text-conditioned interactions. Guided solely by image-level category labels, \TAG{} jointly optimizes binary cross-entropy with \textit{Soft Boundary Ranking} objectives to calibrate presence confidence and distinguish present concepts from confusable negatives. Building upon this, we devise \textit{Confidence-Weighted Distillation} to couple rich semantic context of a multimodal large language model with fine-grained spatial priors of SAM3, thereby achieving effective calibration in the absence of manual annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \TAG{} unlocks SAM3's segmentation potential with only 3.1M trainable parameters, achieving impressive performance across diverse scenarios, and notably, even surpassing leading mask-supervised methods on several metrics. \href{https://github.com/MiSsU-HH/TAG_SAM3}{Our code will be publicly available at GitHub \faGithub}.

</details>


### [179] [Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14654)
*Shen, Yifan,Xia, Yewei,Luo, Gongxu,Zhu, Peiyuan,Sun, Boyang,Chen, Zhenhao,Liu, Guangyi,Chen, Guangyi,Zhang, Kun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Prospective Forcing：在滚动窗口式自回归视频生成器上附加轻量、按未来时间偏移区分的预测头，将监督扩展到多个未来 chunk，使共享历史表示保留长程信息，并用预测结果跳过骨干执行以加速采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成通过分块 rollout 合成长视频，但训练目标通常只预测紧邻的下一 chunk，预测视野过短，导致长时间 rollout 中画质与一致性退化。

Method: 基于滚动窗口生成器，附加共享同一条件信息、针对不同未来时间偏移的轻量多预测头，独立预测不同偏移处的 chunk，从而把监督信号延伸至下一 chunk 之外；推理时用被接受的未来 chunk 预测跳过完整窗口的骨干前向；为预测头配备可学习嵌入以生成下一 chunk 的多个候选，并用学习到的验证器选择候选，或全部拒绝时回退到标准自回归生成。

Result: 摘要未给出定量指标与实验设置，仅声称该多偏移监督有助于时间一致生成，并可通过接受预测跳过骨干执行来加速采样。

Conclusion: 通过多偏移未来预测监督增强历史表示的长期预测能力，并结合候选生成与验证器实现加速采样，为长视频自回归生成提供了一种折中质量与效率的框架。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

</details>


### [180] [TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14657)
*Chen, Zhuo,Zou, Bin,Wei, Fanyue,Duan, Lixin,Yao, Angela,Li, Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TGuide通过轻量级Anchor-Transport-Correct(ATC)预测器，利用历史采样轨迹（当前chunk前一步特征+前一chunk同时刻特征）加速自回归视频扩散，在仅剩4步去噪时仍保持质量，去噪加速最高1.89×，并支持长视频外推。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散在极少去噪步数（如4步）时，相邻时间步特征变化剧烈，使现有特征缓存与轻量预测器失效（直接复用与预测误差都大）。作者观察到跨视频chunk在相同去噪时间步上的特征强相关，可作为互补guidance来弥补步内特征剧变的问题。

Method: 提出TGuide框架与Anchor-Transport-Correct(ATC)预测器：融合两个互补参考——当前chunk前一去噪步特征（保空间结构）与前一chunk同去噪步特征（提供目标去噪阶段信息），经空间检索与自适应校正整合以预测velocity；为缓解去噪步与chunk双重误差累积，在自身自回归rollout上训练预测器；另设可选的置信度感知调度器调节质量-效率权衡。

Result: 在Self Forcing、Causal Forcing、HY-WorldPlay上，TGuide在保持生成质量的同时相对原4步生成器实现最高1.89×去噪加速；在Self Forcing上从81帧训练视频泛化到333帧（约4倍训练长度）生成，且VBench分数超过原模型。

Conclusion: 跨chunk同时刻特征相关性可作为特征缓存的互补信号，结合检索-校正式轻量预测器与自回归rollout训练，可在极低去噪步数下显著加速自回归视频扩散并保持甚至提升质量，且具备长序列外推能力。

Abstract: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance.
