Starting from FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, slide-specific post-training adds 1.6 points overall, with the largest generation gains in content faithfulness; the remaining gap to proprietary models is smallest in content faithfulness and largest in aesthetic quality. Built on InfoVis, our document-to-slide workflow achieves the second-highest Aesthetics score on the external SlidesGen-Bench. We will release the model, code, data, and benchmark.

</details>


### [346] [ViewStruct: View-Grounded Articulation and Connectivity Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16793)
*Bian, Wenjing,Huang, Ranran,Geiger, Andreas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViewStruct 提出一种从单张RGB图像（配对齐部件分割与深度）联合预测物体/场景的刚体分组、连接关系与关节参数的前馈框架，无需观测运动或逐实例优化，可迁移到未见类别与真实交互视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与陌生物体交互需要理解其部件如何连接与运动。现有方法通常依赖类别特定的规范朝向、需要观测到的关节运动或逐实例优化，难以泛化到新类别与新场景。

Method: 输入RGB图像+对齐部件分割+深度（可选图像/视频补充）。采用视图锚定（view-grounded）表示，将预测链接到观测区域，并把关节几何表达在重力对齐的视图相对坐标系中，避免类别规范朝向。微调预训练视觉-语言模型，秒级前馈预测刚体分组、附着关系与关节参数。

Result: 在评测基线上结构预测指标提升；可迁移至未见类别、新资产来源及真实人-物交互视频（尽管仅在合成数据上做任务训练）。仿真操作实验表明预测关节可用于生成机器人运动轨迹。

Conclusion: 视图锚定+重力对齐视图相对坐标系+前馈VLM适配，为无运动观测下的通用部件连接与铰接建模提供了可泛化方案，并为机器人操作提供关节先验。

Abstract: Interacting with unfamiliar objects requires understanding how their parts connect and move. We introduce ViewStruct, a framework for jointly predicting connectivity and articulation in objects and scenes. Given an RGB image with aligned part segmentation and depth, optionally supplemented by images or video, ViewStruct predicts rigid-body groupings, attachments, and joint parameters. Its view-grounded representation links predictions to observed regions and expresses joint geometry in a gravity-aligned, view-relative frame, without requiring category-specific canonical orientations. A pretrained vision--language model is adapted to predict structure in seconds, without requiring observed articulation motion or per-instance optimisation. Experiments demonstrate improved structural prediction over evaluated baselines and transfer to unseen categories, asset sources, and real-world human-interaction videos, despite task-specific training exclusively on synthetic data. Simulated manipulation experiments further demonstrate the utility of predicted joints for generating robot motion trajectories.

</details>


### [347] [X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16811)
*Wang, Yi,Yuan, Zhenlong,Guo, Yuchan,Huang, Maolei,Song, Zijian,Zhang, Dapeng,Tan, Rongbin,Wang, Jiyuan,Wang, Zhiyuan,Lin, Fangfang,Song, Shuhan,Cao, Huawei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 X-Ragent 后训练框架：解耦"辅助证据搜寻"与"有效性门控的定量测量获取"，结合 Rad-CoT 数据与 GRPO 准确率门控奖励，提升胸片推理的证据基础性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片判读需将视觉所见与任务相关证据整合，而非单纯依赖直接视觉识别。现有工具增强医疗智能体虽能借助外部模块提供证据，但缺乏显式机制来学习"何时需要辅助证据"，也无法阻止不适用的定量证据进入诊断推理，可能导致过程看似合理但结论错误。

Method: 构建 Rad-CoT 语料（7.7K 样本，含因果排序的工具增强轨迹与报告式诊断推理），用智能体式 SFT 初始化 Qwen3-VL-8B；随后以 GRPO 优化策略，采用准确率门控奖励：仅对诊断正确的轨迹施加测量一致性与辅助工具成本的过程级奖励项。

Result: 在三个胸片基准上取得最优结果，其中在完全留出的 ChestAgentBench 上提升 8.6 分；通过选择性寻求证据并仅接纳有效测量，实现更忠实、证据充分的推理。

Conclusion: X-Ragent 表明"解耦证据寻求与有效性门控测量获取"加"正确性门控的过程奖励"能有效提升工具增强医疗智能体的证据基础推理能力，避免过程合理掩盖诊断错误。

Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. To address this, we propose X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented reinforcement learning that decouples learned auxiliary-evidence seeking from validity-gated quantitative measurement acquisition for evidence-grounded CXR reasoning. We construct Rad-CoT, a 7.7K-sample corpus combining causally ordered tool-augmented trajectories with report-style diagnostic reasoning, and use it to initialize Qwen3-VL-8B via agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We then optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an accuracy-gated reward that applies process-level terms for measurement consistency and auxiliary-tool cost only to correct trajectories, preventing plausible process behavior from compensating for an incorrect diagnosis. Across three CXR benchmarks, X-Ragent achieves the strongest results, including an 8.6-point improvement on the fully held-out ChestAgentBench. By seeking evidence selectively and admitting only valid measurements, X-Ragent supports more faithful and evidence-grounded CXR reasoning.

</details>


### [348] [Carve VFM: Carving Specialists out of Generalists, Automatic Task-Specific Compression of Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16813)
*Mecharbat, Lotfi Abdelkrim,Elsayed, Abdelrahman,Almakky, Ibrahim,Takáč, Martin,Yaqub, Mohammad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Carve VFM 将结构化剪枝中的子网选择与性能恢复联合求解：跨层按任务敏感度分配容量，层内用"可恢复性感知"适应度指导搜索，并用迭代闭式低秩修正重建被删除行为，在单卡数分钟内从 DINOv3/MetaCLIP-2 中"雕琢"出稠密紧凑编码器，8 个骨干-预算配置中 7 个取得评估方法最高平均精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）迁移性好但推理开销大。微调不缩小模型，蒸馏需昂贵教师引导训练；结构化剪枝更直接，但激进压缩时现有方法失效，原因是把"子网选择"与"性能恢复"当作两个独立环节：跨层容量应随任务敏感度而非均匀分布，层内某个权重是否可删不仅取决于其重要性，还取决于删除后的贡献能否由剩余参数补回。二者必须联合决策。

Method: 提出 Carve VFM，输入为 VFM、校准集与参数预算，包含三部分：(i) 搜索跨层的任务特定容量分配（每层保留比例）；(ii) 以"自适应、恢复感知"的适应度准则引导该搜索，将层内可恢复性纳入选择评价；(iii) 对删除造成的行为损失，用迭代闭式低秩修正（closed-form low-rank correction）合并回存活权重，无需反向传播重训骨干。整体为稠密编码器输出，单 GPU 分钟级完成。

Result: 在 12 个基准、DINOv3 与 MetaCLIP-2 共 4 个模型上评估：8 个骨干-预算配置中有 7 个取得所评估稠密结构化剪枝方法中的最高平均精度。进一步微调后达 88.1%，超过最强对比边缘模型 85.8%。剪枝模型在降低计算量与内存的同时，GPU 吞吐比未压缩模型高 1.3–2.0 倍。

Conclusion: 结构化剪枝中"选择"与"恢复"必须联合优化；VFM 内部已隐含所需的小模型，CARVE 通过容量分配搜索＋恢复感知适应度＋闭式低秩修正即可高效"雕出"，无需骨干重训，在精度-效率权衡上优于现有稠密剪枝方法。

Abstract: Vision foundation models (VFMs) provide transferable visual representations, but their inference cost limits deployment in many settings. Fine-tuning specializes a VFM without shrinking it; distillation shrinks it, but through expensive teacher-guided training. Structured pruning offers a more direct route by extracting a compact subnetwork from the VFM. However, as compression gets aggressive, existing methods fail because they treat subnetwork selection and recovery as separate axes. Across layers, capacity must follow task sensitivity rather than spread uniformly. Within a layer, a removal cannot be judged by importance alone; its impact also depends on how well the lost contribution can be recovered from what remains. Selection and recovery must therefore be decided jointly. We introduce Carve VFM, which resolves this interdependence. Given a VFM, a calibration set, and a parameter budget, it (i) searches for task-specific capacity allocations across layers; (ii) guides the search via an adaptive recovery-aware fitness criterion; and (iii) reconstructs removed behavior through iterative closed-form low-rank corrections merged into the surviving weights. The result is a dense encoder produced in minutes on a single GPU without backbone retraining. Across twelve benchmarks and four models from DINOv3 and MetaCLIP-2, Carve VFM achieves the highest reported mean accuracy in seven of eight backbone-budget configurations among the evaluated dense structured-pruning methods. Further fine-tuning surpasses the strongest evaluated edge model (88.1% vs. 85.8%), and carved models cut compute and memory while delivering 1.3-2.0x higher GPU throughput than the uncompressed one. These results show that the compact model you need is inside the VFM; it only has to be carved out.

</details>


### [349] [Growing to See: Efficient Pretraining of Self-Supervised Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16817)
*Mamaghan, Amir Mohammad Karimi,Kapl, Ferdinand,Dittadi, Andrea,Johansson, Karl Henrik,Maile, Kaitlin,von Oswald, Johannes,Bauer, Stefan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了自监督视觉Transformer（MAE与DINOv3）中的渐进式深度增长策略，发现逐层插入可在减少13.9–24.8%训练FLOPs的同时提升下游性能（ImageNet线性探针最高+3.36pp），并重塑内部注意力计算模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型领域重新关注渐进式深度增长以提升训练效率与推理能力，但其对自监督视觉Transformer的表征质量与内部计算模式的影响尚不明确。

Method: 在两个主流自监督范式（掩码自编码器MAE与自蒸馏DINOv3）中系统开展渐进式深度增长实验，逐层插入网络层并分析其对下游性能、中间层表征与内部计算（注意力模式）的影响。

Result: 在全局与密集任务上，增长策略提升下游性能并减少13.9–24.8%训练FLOPs，ImageNet线性探针精度最高提升3.36个百分点；中间层下游性能同样改善，且MAE中出现全局-局部注意力交替，DINOv3中局部到全局注意力进展提前。

Conclusion: 渐进式深度增长是一种高效且有效的自监督视觉预训练策略，能在更少计算下提升全局与密集视觉任务性能，并加深对增长如何塑造视觉计算的理解。

Abstract: Progressive depth growth builds large networks by starting with shallow models and inserting layers during training. Recent advances in large language models have renewed interest in this longstanding approach, demonstrating benefits for training efficiency and reasoning alongside changes in internal computations. However, how growing affects representation quality and computational patterns in self-supervised vision transformers remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate progressive depth growth in two popular self-supervised families, namely masked autoencoders (MAE) and DINOv3, and analyze how growing affects downstream performance, intermediate representations, and internal computations. Across global and dense tasks, we show that growing improves downstream performance while reducing training FLOPs by 13.9--24.8%, with ImageNet linear-probe accuracy gains of up to 3.36 percentage points. Growing also improves downstream performance at intermediate layers and reshapes internal computational patterns, introducing recurring alternations between global and localized attention in MAE and earlier local-to-global attention progression in self-distilled DINOv3. Together, these findings establish progressive depth growth as an effective and efficient pretraining strategy for improving downstream performance across global and dense visual tasks with less computation, and advance our understanding of how growing shapes visual computation.

</details>


### [350] [A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Pose-Invariant Face Recognition and Facial Landmark Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16849)
*Ashkeyev, Ali,Abdiakhmetova, Zukhra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多任务深度学习框架，在统一架构中联合进行姿态不变人脸识别与五点面部关键点定位，并基于CPLFW构建多任务数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大姿态变化导致人脸外观改变、判别性特征可见性下降，使现有识别系统性能退化；作者希望通过联合学习身份语义与面部空间结构来增强跨姿态鲁棒性。

Method: 将CPLFW数据集改造为多任务数据集（身份标签+五点关键点标注）。共享输入下并行两个任务分支：ResNet50用于身份识别，EfficientNetV2B0+空间注意力用于关键点定位；以加权多任务损失联合优化。

Result: 在改造后的CPLFW多任务数据集上验证：识别准确率81.58%，关键点定位MSE为96.38。

Conclusion: 在单一优化框架中结合身份分类与关键点回归，可有效学习跨姿态鲁棒的 face representation；展示了多任务学习与注意力特征细化在无约束人脸分析中的潜力。

Abstract: Face recognition systems often experience performance degradation under large pose variations due to changes in facial appearance and visibility of discriminative features. This study presents a multi-task deep learning framework that jointly addresses pose-invariant face recognition and facial landmark localization within a unified architecture. To enable simultaneous optimization of identity recognition and facial structure learning, the original Cross-Pose Labeled Faces in the Wild (CPLFW) dataset was adapted into a multi-task learning dataset by associating facial images with identity labels and five-point landmark annotations. The proposed framework consists of two task-specific branches operating on a common facial input: a ResNet50-based branch for identity recognition and an EfficientNetV2B0-based branch with spatial attention for facial landmark localization. The two objectives are jointly optimized using a weighted multi-task loss, allowing the model to learn complementary semantic and spatial facial representations. The proposed framework was evaluated on the prepared CPLFW-based multi-task dataset. Unlike the original CPLFW benchmark, which focuses primarily on identity recognition, the proposed dataset adaptation incorporates five-point facial landmark annotations to enable joint recognition and localization learning. Experimental results demonstrate that the model achieves a validation recognition accuracy of 81.58% and a facial landmark localization mean squared error of 96.38. The results indicate that combining identity classification and landmark regression within a single optimization framework provides an effective approach for learning robust facial representations under cross-pose conditions The proposed method demonstrates the potential of multi-task learning and attention-based feature refinement for unconstrained facial analysis.

</details>


### [351] [Towards Cost-Efficient Video Dataset Construction with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16857)
*Shabot, Mohammed,Adams, Jonathan,Stock, Jan Van den,Vennekens, Joost*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用LLM基于元数据预筛视频以替代"先下载后判断"的数据集构建流程，并通过人类多数投票与交错评分者一致性验证其作为虚拟标注者的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频分类数据集构建的瓶颈在于候选视频必须先下载才能做相关性判断，造成存储、时间与标注成本高昂，因此希望在下载前引入前置过滤。

Method: 利用LLM基于视频元数据进行预筛选；以四名独立标注者的严格多数投票为基准，用Gwet's AC1分析标注一致性；与两种关键词启发式基线对比；通过Leave-One-Rater-Out与Add-One-Rater-In机制评估LLM作为虚拟标注者的表现，并给出成本对比。

Result: LLM预过滤在作为虚拟标注者时优于关键词启发式基线，标注一致性与成本收益均通过量化分析得到验证（具体指标数值未见摘要）。

Conclusion: LLM元数据预筛可在下载前有效过滤无关视频，降低数据集构建的存储、时间与标注成本，是视频数据策管中可复用的前置环节。

Abstract: Research on video classification models has witnessed significant growth recently, accompanied by a significant increase in the demand for datasets to train such models. Existing video dataset curation approaches share a common bottleneck: candidate videos must be downloaded before any relevance judgment is made, which results in storage, time and annotation costs. In this work, we present a filtering step, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to pre-screen videos based on their metadata, before actually downloading these videos, thereby saving on these costs. We evaluate the LLMs against a strict human majority vote derived from four independent annotators and validate the reliability of the annotations through inter-annotator agreement analysis (Gwet's AC1). We compare the LLM pre-filter against two no-LLM baselines, namely two keyword heuristics. Via a Leave-One-Rater-Out (LOO) mechanism and an Add-One-Rater-In (AORI), we evaluate the performance of the LLMs as virtual annotators. Finally, we report cost comparisons relative to existing approaches. To ensure reproducability, we made our implementation available on github.

</details>


### [352] [Vision Models Capture Complementary Representations in Children That Converge in Adults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16860)
*Bersch, Domenic,Schaumlöffel, Timothy,Proietti, Michela,Franaszek-Traczewska, Antonia,Zwad, Hannah Elisabeth,Xie, Siying,Baldauf, Marlena,Sylvester, Teresa,Schätz, Christina Maria,Turtleton, Bert,Köster, Moritz,Höhl, Stefanie,Cichy, Radoslaw,Roig, Gemma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用时间分辨表征相似性分析（EEG）比较8岁、12岁儿童与成人的脑表征与CLIP（图文对齐）及纯视觉模型的匹配度，发现CLIP在儿童期即已对齐，纯视觉模型的对齐随发育增强，二者互补，且对齐主要反映语义结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图文对齐模型（如CLIP）与纯视觉模型在发育过程中与大脑视觉表征的关系尚不明确，需要厘清二者在不同年龄阶段对脑表征的贡献，以理解视觉表征的发展轨迹，并为可随时间学习与适应的AI系统提供约束。

Method: 对8岁、12岁儿童及成人的EEG数据应用时间分辨表征相似性分析（time-resolved RSA），比较脑表征与CLIP及架构匹配的纯视觉模型之间的对齐程度；并通过残差分析分离二者的独立贡献，同时考察语义结构（类别、生命性）与低层图像属性的贡献。

Result: CLIP在儿童期即表现出显著的模型—脑对齐；纯视觉模型的对齐在发育后期更强。残差分析显示二者具互补结构，CLIP在8岁起即保留超越架构匹配纯视觉模型的对齐。模型—脑对齐很大程度反映语义结构，类别与生命性的EEG表征随成熟增强，而与低层图像属性的对齐在各年龄段均较弱。

Conclusion: 图文对齐模型与纯视觉模型捕捉了发展中的视觉表征的互补方面，可作为面向随时间学习与适应的AI系统的有用约束。

Abstract: How the relationship between image-text aligned and vision-only models changes across development remains unknown. We applied time-resolved representational similarity analysis to EEG data from 8-year-olds, 12-year-olds, and adults. CLIP showed significant model-brain alignment already in children, whereas vision-only models aligned more strongly later in development. Residual analyses revealed complementary structure, with CLIP retaining alignment beyond an architecture-matched vision-only model from age 8. Much of the model-brain alignment reflected semantic structure, with EEG representations of category and animacy strengthening toward adulthood, while alignment with low-level image properties remained weak across age. Together, these findings suggest that image-text aligned and vision-only models capture complementary aspects of developing visual representations and may provide useful constraints for AI systems that aim to learn and adapt over time.

</details>


### [353] [From Volpiano to Pixels: 30,000 Lines of OMR Ground Truth for Medieval Chant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16862)
*Klugseder, Robert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于Cantus Database的Volpiano转录构建中世纪圣咏OMR数据集体（30,567图像-目标对，1,952,143 tokens），采用六类检测器与两个小U-Net辅助定位谱线与谱号，CRNN从零训练在3,086测试行上取得9.6%符号错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中世纪圣咏的光学音乐识别（OMR）缺乏跨记谱体系的手稿图像-符号对齐训练数据，既有模型泛化性差，需构建规模化标注语料并提供可训练的基线。

Method: 从Cantus Database已有Volpiano转录反向生成图像-目标对，覆盖10个来源、11种导出、339个诗节片段。流程先定位谱系统、推断谱号并将已知音高映射到谱表位置；用六类检测器处理不同版面与记谱法；启发式失效处用两个小U-Net从人工标注学习谱线与谱号字母；最后以符号级CRNN从零训练作为基线。

Result: 构建30,567图像-目标对、1,952,143 tokens的数据集。抽样评审每行0–4个音高或谱号错误，但误差定义不一致，缺乏统一审计。CRNN从零训练在3,086测试行上符号错误率9.6%；早期以15–16世纪奥地利来源为主的模型为45.3%；三次留一手稿交叉测试中，被排除手稿错误率21.5–31.0%；模型辅助对齐另恢复2,686行。

Conclusion: 该工作为跨记谱体系中世纪圣咏OMR提供了大规模自动构建的标注语料与可复现基线，但语料质量缺乏统一审计，跨手稿泛化仍是主要瓶颈。

Abstract: Optical music recognition (OMR) for medieval chant lacks training data linking manuscript images to musical symbols across notational families. Using existing Volpiano transcriptions from the Cantus Database, we created 30,567 image-target pairs from ten sources in eleven exports, including 339 verse fragments. Their target sequences contain 1,952,143 tokens. The pipeline locates staff systems, infers clefs and maps known pitches to staff positions. Six detector families handle the different layouts and notations. Where heuristics failed, two small U-Nets learned staff lines and clef letters from manual annotations. Reviews of sampled export lines found zero to four pitch or clef errors, but used different error definitions and do not provide a uniform audit of the corpus. A CRNN trained from scratch achieved a symbol error rate of 9.6 % on 3,086 test lines. The earlier model, trained mainly on Austrian sources of the 15th and 16th centuries, scored 45.3 %. In three separate training runs, each excluding one manuscript, error rates on the excluded manuscript were 21.5-31.0 %. Model-assisted alignment recovered a further 2,686 lines.

</details>


### [354] [EviStress: Evidence Stress Learning for Generalizable Face Forgery Detection with Textual Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16879)
*Jing, Jiuyao,Yi, Xuanyu,Zheng, Yu,Peng, Chunlei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EviStress 两阶段框架：先用证据定向的 patch 扰动(ETPP)与判别性变化保持(DVP)训练更鲁棒的人脸伪造检测器，再通过内在证据指令微调(IEIT)将适配后的 CLIP 编码器接入 LLaVA，实现真实性预测与文本解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web 上人脸伪造来源管线不断演化并经过多种传播处理，检测器需在未见伪造方式和视觉退化下保持可靠。作者观察到标准 LoRA 适配的 CLIP 检测器在 patch 级决策依赖上高度不均衡，少数 patch 承担了过多类相关证据，导致鲁棒性脆弱。

Method: 两阶段：1) Evidence-Targeted Patch Perturbation (ETPP) 从全局、关系、语义线索估计 patch 依赖度，按正相关概率施加扰动，对高依赖证据做压力测试；Discriminative Variation Preservation (DVP) 约束干净与扰动表示间的残差以保留真伪判别信息。2) Intrinsic Evidence Instruction Tuning (IEIT) 将适配的 CLIP 编码器作为 LLaVA 视觉塔，进行参数高效多模态指令微调，直接从伪造敏感表示输出真伪判断与文本解释，无需外部检测器。

Result: 实验显示跨数据集、跨伪造方法泛化以及 corruption 鲁棒性均有提升，多模态模型可同时给出真实性预测与人类可读的解释。

Conclusion: 通过显式压力测试高依赖视觉证据并保持判别信息，可将鲁棒伪造检测与可解释多模态生成统一到单一框架中。

Abstract: The rapid spread of face forgeries on the Web challenges the credibility of visual content. In practical Web environments, manipulated media originate from evolving generation pipelines and undergo diverse processing during dissemination, making reliable authenticity assessment under unseen manipulations and visual changes a critical challenge. We observe that a standard LoRA-adapted CLIP detector exhibits uneven patch-level decision dependence, concen trating a disproportionate share of class-specific relevance on a small fraction of visual patches. To improve robustness to variations in such highly dependent evidence, we propose EviStress, a two-stage framework for generalizable face forgery detection with textual explanations. In the first stage, Evidence-Targeted Patch Perturbation (ETPP) estimates patch dependence from global, relational, and semantic cues and assigns positively correlated perturbation probabilities, explicitly stress-testing highly dependent visual evidence during training. We further introduce Discriminative Variation Preservation (DVP), which constrains the residual between clean and perturbed representations to retain authenticity discriminative information. In the second stage, Intrinsic Evidence Instruction Tuning (IEIT) transfers the adapted CLIP encoder into LLaVA as its vision tower and performs parameter-efficient multimodal instruction tuning, enabling authenticity prediction and textual explanation directly from the learned forgery-sensitive representation without an external detector. Experiments demonstrate improved cross-dataset and cross-method generalization and corruption robustness, with the multimodal model providing authenticity predictions and human-readable explanations.

</details>


### [355] [Barycentric Guidance: Turning Foundation Image Editors into Continuous Affective Controllers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16892)
*Mannering, Harvey,Huang, Zhiwu,Prügel-Bennett, Adam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Barycentric Guidance——一种免训练框架，将预训练基础图像编辑器转为 VA 空间上的连续情感控制器，无需微调、额外数据或改模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VA 图像编辑器多为训练式、领域特定，受限于训练见过的 VA 区域，跨数据集/领域鲁棒性差；而基础图像编辑器因文本编码器情感表征非线性，提示插值校准差，无法作为连续情感控制器。

Method: Barycentric Guidance：免训练。将任意目标 VA 点映射为基于单纯形的引导权重（重心坐标），在多条情感提示间做重心加权引导，从而在预训练基础编辑器上实现连续、覆盖广、精准的 VA 控制，无需微调/额外数据/模型改动。

Result: 在三个面部数据集上，相比最强基线：VA 目标精度提升 25–29%，VA 平面覆盖扩展 28–50%，表情多样性提升 29–49%；并可泛化到动物、艺术作品、复杂场景。代码开源。

Conclusion: 免除训练与领域约束的连续情感编辑可行且有效，借助基础模型的通用性实现跨域泛化。

Abstract: Emotions are expressed on a continuum and are naturally described in the valence-arousal (VA) space. Existing VA-based image editors are typically training-based and domain-specific, limiting them to VA regions seen during training and making them brittle across datasets and domains. Meanwhile, despite producing high-quality edits, state-of-the-art foundation image editors are not continuous affective controllers: non-linear emotion representations in text encoders makes prompt interpolation poorly calibrated, so accurate and continuous VA control remains unreliable. To fill this gap, we introduce Barycentric Guidance, a training-free framework that turns pretrained foundation image editors into continuous affective controllers over VA, requiring no finetuning, extra data, or model changes. Our method maps any target VA point to simplex-based guidance weights, enabling VA controllability in three aspects: (i) accurate targeting of VA states, (ii) broad coverage across the VA plane, and (iii) continuous control. Across three face datasets, we improve VA target accuracy by 25-29%, expand VA-plane coverage by 28-50%, and increase expression diversity by 29-49%, over the strongest baseline. Unlike prior domain-specific methods, our training-free approach exploits the foundation model's inherent versatility, enabling generalization beyond human faces to animals, artworks, and complex scenes within a single framework. Code is available at https://github.com/harveymannering/BarycentricGuidance.

</details>


### [356] [Mining Cross-Modal Perception Gaps in Autonomous Driving: When Camera and LiDAR Disagree](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16906)
*Cao, Hongsen,Jaber, Mona,Yuan, Shanxin,Sayed, Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文审计多模态3D检测中"模态可信度"的隐含结构：用标注驱动的0.4M目标数据库与距离分层的Shapley归因(SSFA)揭示三条融合设计假设不成立，并将挖掘出的结构压缩为Modality Reliability Map，以轻量注意力层注入四个预训练融合检测器，仅调参<4%、2-3 GPU小时即可提升最高1.3 mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机-LiDAR融合检测通常假定两模态"大体互补"，但每个位置究竟信任哪个模态由学到的权重决定，这些权重既无刻画也不可审计，缺乏部署前可检验的安全依据。作者希望把"可靠性"从黑盒权重中抽离出来，变成可量化、可视化、可注入的先验量。

Method: 1) 对nuScenes、KITTI、Waymo中每个GT目标标注"被哪些模态检出"，构建约0.4M目标数据库；2) 提出SSFA(空间分层特征归因)，将Shapley归因按距离区间分层，避免全局平均掩盖结构；3) 归纳模态偏好边界、距离-密度交互、方向非平稳性等规律；4) 编译成Modality Reliability Map，通过轻量注意力层注入四个预训练融合检测器，做参数高效微调。

Result: 模态偏好边界随目标类别而非仅随距离移动：交通锥仅被相机检出的概率约为卡车的6倍(16.8% vs 2.9%)，且与距离无关；仅相机检出在10-30 m达到峰值，落在通常让给LiDAR的区间；距离-密度交互项单独就超过视角方向的全部主效应；模态主导性方向非平稳，车后目标显著更偏LiDAR。注入可靠性图后，四个检测器在<4%参数、2-3 GPU小时内最高提升1.3 mAP。

Conclusion: 作者将模态可靠性从不可审计的融合权重中解耦，转化为可先验检查、可注入的结构化量，并验证了其跨数据集泛化性与高效的性能增益，主张这是多模态感知安全措施应依赖的基础。

Abstract: Multi-modal fusion for 3D object detection assumes that cameras and LiDAR are broadly complementary. In practice, how much each modality is trusted at a given location is decided by learned weights that are neither characterized nor auditable. We label every ground-truth object by which modalities detected it, then mine the resulting 0.4M-object database across nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Because the patterns shift with distance from the ego vehicle, we read the mined model through Spatially Stratified Feature Attribution (SSFA), which conditions Shapley attribution on distance zones and exposes structure that global attribution averages away. Three assumptions built into the current fusion design do not hold. The modality-preference boundary tracks the object itself: a traffic cone is nearly six times as likely as a truck to be seen by the camera alone (16.8% vs. 2.9%), regardless of range. Camera-only detections peak at 10-30 m, inside the band usually ceded to LiDAR, and fall away on either side. The drivers of failure are not additive either: the distance - density interaction alone outweighs the entire main effect of viewing direction. We further find that modality dominance is directionally non-stationary, with objects behind the vehicle being markedly more LiDAR-dominant than those in front. We compile the mined structure into a Modality Reliability Map and inject it into four pretrained fusion detectors through a lightweight attention layer. This improves performance by up to 1.3 mean Average Precision (mAP) while fine-tuning under 4% of their parameters in 2-3 GPU-hours. Our work lifts reliability out of the weights and treats it as a quantity that can be examined before deployment. That is what a safety measure for multi-modal perception must rest on.

</details>


### [357] [ConDenseDrive: Knowledge-Dense, Token-Sparse Visual Encoder for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16908)
*Li, Shengzhen,Li, Yongkang,Gao, Hao,Wu, Chenxi,Sun, Yajing,Hou, Lu,Liu, Wenyu,Wang, Xinggang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ConDenseDrive：知识密集 + token 稀疏的视觉编码器，用于端到端自动驾驶，通过三阶段（多基础模型蒸馏、时空寄存器 token、寄存器引导 token 压缩）实现 2.0× 加速并提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶需在严格延迟约束下具备丰富时空表征。现有系统视觉编码器多由通用图像预训练初始化，并对每路相机、每帧的所有 patch token 做稠密处理，导致表征质量与推理效率均受限。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 知识密集化——从三个视觉基础模型蒸馏视觉、语义、几何互补知识；(2) 将蒸馏编码器适配到多帧端到端驾驶，并把时空上下文整合进 register token 用于规划；(3) token 稀疏化——寄存器引导的 token 压缩，减少冗余 patch 计算。

Result: NAVSIM v1 达 94.5 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 达 90.8 EPDMS，HUGSIM 零样本评估达 37.4 HD-Score；token 压缩带来 2.0× 推理加速且规划性能提升。

Conclusion: 视觉编码器设计是通往可靠且高效端到端自动驾驶的有效路径，兼顾表征质量与推理效率。

Abstract: End-to-end driving requires rich spatiotemporal representations to support scene understanding and trajectory planning under strict latency constraints. However, most systems initialize their visual encoders from generic image pretraining and densely process all patch tokens for each camera view and input frame, limiting both representation quality and inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we present ConDenseDrive, a knowledge-dense and token-sparse visual encoder for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our three-stage framework first makes the encoder knowledge-dense by distilling complementary visual, semantic, and geometric knowledge from three vision foundation models. It then adapts the distilled encoder to multi-frame end-to-end driving and integrates spatiotemporal context into register tokens for planning. Finally, it makes the encoder token-sparse by applying register-guided token compression, reducing redundant patch computation and yielding a 2.0$\times$ speedup while improving planning performance. ConDenseDrive achieves 94.5 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and reaches 37.4 HD-Score in zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM. Extensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate that visual encoder design provides an effective route to reliable and efficient end-to-end driving.

</details>


### [358] [FOCUS: A Subspecialty Foundation Model for Intraoperative Central Nervous System Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16914)
*Liu, Xing,Guo, Yifan,Lv, Hongtai,Lou, Lei,Tan, Yuyi,Du, Jiang,Zhang, Xijia,Zhang, Ming,Pang, Chao,Li, Minglei,Liu, Wei,Zhu, Xiaobo,Zhang, Song,Yu, Rong,Shu, Hanlin,Xu, Wenzhuo,Jiang, Tao,Lu, Cheng,Tian, Jie,Chang, Qing,Liu, Zhenyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FOCUS，一个面向中枢神经系统术中冰冻切片的亚专科病理基础模型，实现高精度诊断与生物标志物预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNS术中冰冻诊断受伪影、诊断复杂性和时间限制制约，通用病理基础模型对冰冻组织暴露不足。

Method: 在27,930张富含CNS组织的冰冻切片上预训练亚专科基础模型FOCUS，构建WHO对齐的诊断层级，并单独评估淋巴瘤检测任务。

Result: 11项内部诊断任务与12项生物标志物预测任务平均AUC分别为0.969与0.877，时间与外部队列保持领先；六位神经病理学家评估中，辅助使初级读者淋巴瘤灵敏度由81.6%升至94.7%。

Conclusion: FOCUS可提升诊断准确性与细粒度、辅助淋巴瘤切除决策并提供暂定分子信息，具备术中CNS病理的临床可执行支持潜力。

Abstract: Intraoperative frozen-section diagnosis of central nervous system (CNS) lesions guides surgical decisions but is challenged by artefacts, diagnostic complexity and time constraints. Most pathology foundation models have limited exposure to CNS frozen tissue. Here we present FOCUS, a subspecialty foundation model pretrained on 27,930 frozen-sections enriched for CNS tissue. FOCUS led 11 internal diagnostic and 12 biomarker-prediction tasks, with mean AUCs of 0.969 and 0.877, respectively, retaining leading performance in temporal and external cohorts. To provide more comprehensive diagnostic information, we further organized ten diagnostic tasks into a WHO-aligned diagnostic hierarchy and separately evaluated FOCUS for lymphoma detection, a critical task for intraoperative surgical decision-making. In reader assessments by six neuropathologists, FOCUS assistance enabled junior readers to approach or exceed unassisted senior readers in hierarchical diagnosis and raised junior readers' lymphoma sensitivity from 81.6% to 94.7%. FOCUS could improve diagnostic accuracy and granularity, inform lymphoma-related resection decisions and provide provisional molecular information. Such capabilities highlight the potential of FOCUS to provide robust, clinically actionable support for intraoperative CNS pathology.

</details>


### [359] [UniMetric: Universal Metric Scale Recovery for Visual Geometry Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16945)
*Yang, Lei,Zhang, Yuner,Liu, Ziyang,Song, Ziying,WU, Kai,Gao, Yiyang,Su, Jiangtao,Li, Yiming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniMetric：免训练的通用度量尺度恢复框架，用 VLM 的物体尺寸先验联合约束几何基础模型重建的共享尺度，并发布 MetricBench 评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型推动通用具身推理与规划，用互联网视频做具身预训练需要可靠的物理尺度标注；但现有视觉几何基础模型只能恢复场景结构与相机运动，缺乏可靠度量尺度，且不应依赖额外传感器或任务特定监督。

Method: 三阶段免训练流程：1) Metric Prior Acquisition 用 VLM 提取熟悉物体的高度区间；2) Semantic-Geometric Alignment 沿估计的支撑面法向测量每帧重建物体高度，将先验转成尺度区间；3) Global Scale Recovery 用凸目标函数融合各区间，重叠时求共同可行尺度，不重叠时给唯一折中解，序列级尺度统一施加于重建点与相机平移。

Result: 真实 VLM 先验的受控实验显示，精确相对物体高度下融合多观测可提升尺度精度；在 MetricBench（12 个具身/驾驶/路侧子集，传感器真值）上，跨 9 个几何基础模型，平均深度 Abs Rel、重建 Chamfer 距离与轨迹误差分别降低 54.2%、83.8%、65.6%，且套件级三项任务上每个模型均有提升。代码与数据开源。

Conclusion: 利用熟悉物体尺寸先验可在无传感器、无任务监督下为几何基础模型恢复序列级度量尺度，并具备跨模型与跨场景的普适性；MetricBench 为无真值尺度对齐条件下的度量精度评测提供了基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, exemplified by GPT-6 Astra, raise the prospect of general-purpose embodied reasoning and planning. Using Internet videos for embodied pretraining calls for reliable physical-scale annotations. Yet visual geometry foundation models often recover scene structure and camera motion without reliable metric scale. We show that uncertain size priors of familiar objects can jointly constrain a reconstruction's shared scale. Building on this insight, we present UniMetric, a universal and training-free metric scale recovery framework for geometry foundation models, without additional sensors or task-specific metric supervision. Specifically, Metric Prior Acquisition elicits object height intervals from a vision-language model. Semantic-Geometric Alignment measures reconstructed object heights along the estimated support-surface normal in each frame and converts the priors into scale intervals. Global Scale Recovery reconciles these intervals through a convex objective, yielding a jointly feasible scale when they overlap and a unique compromise otherwise. The estimated sequence-level scale is applied uniformly to reconstructed points and camera translations. Controlled experiments with real VLM priors show that combining observations improves scale accuracy with exact relative object heights. To evaluate metric accuracy on GFM reconstructions without ground-truth scale alignment, we introduce MetricBench, covering twelve embodied, driving, and roadside subsets with sensor-derived ground truth. Across nine geometry foundation models, UniMetric reduces mean depth Abs Rel, reconstruction Chamfer distance, and trajectory error by 54.2%, 83.8%, and 65.6%, respectively, improving every model on all three tasks at the suite level. We release the UniMetric code and MetricBench data.

</details>


### [360] [DDVR-Net: Degradation-Aware Decoupling and Visibility-Guided Restoration for Historical Document Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16956)
*Sha, Jiu,Weng, Yu,Zhu, Mengxiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DDVR-Net，一个退化感知解耦+可见性引导修复的历史文档识别框架，通过特征级解耦字形结构与物理损坏、预测局部可见性并选择性激活上下文解码器，同时构建藏文/蒙文/维文低资源多语言基准（187000对），在三种语言和多种阅读顺序上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实历史文档常因墨迹侵蚀、结构破损导致字符"混合可见度"，传统OCR在证据受限时失败，而上下文语言模型又可能对视觉上清晰的字符过度纠正。需要同时解决"退化字符修复"与"清晰字符保真"的矛盾。

Method: DDVR-Net在特征层将内在字形结构与物理损坏解耦，预测局部可见性以估计字符可靠性；通过可见性引导门控选择性激活上下文解码器，仅在退化区域进行修复，保留清晰视觉识别结果。此外构建覆盖藏、蒙、维三种文字的低资源多语言基准，含187000文档对，结合大规模合成数据与渐进式训练及真实标注以缩小sim-to-real差距。

Result: 大量实验表明DDVR-Net在三种语言及多种阅读顺序下持续优于现有方法，并提供了有效的框架与基准（代码与基准已开源）。

Conclusion: 该工作为低资源历史文档识别提供了退化感知解耦与可见性引导修复的统一框架，以及多语言基准，有助于文化遗产保存与低资源语言数字化。

Abstract: Historical document analysis is crucial for cultural heritage preservation and low-resource language digitization. However, real historical documents often suffer from severe degradation, such as ink erosion and structural damage, causing mixed-visibility character sequences. Conventional OCR systems struggle in such evidence-limited scenarios, while contextual language models may over-correct visually clear characters. To address these challenges, we propose DDVR-Net, a degradation-aware decoupling and visibility-guided restoration framework for historical document recognition. DDVR-Net decouples intrinsic glyph structures from physical corruption at the feature level and predicts local visibility to estimate character reliability. A contextual decoder is selectively activated through a visibility-guided gate, restoring degraded characters while preserving clear visual recognition. Furthermore, we construct a low-resource multilingual benchmark covering Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur scripts with 187000 document pairs, combining large-scale synthetic data and progressive training with real-world annotations to reduce the synthetic-to-real gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DDVR-Net consistently outperforms existing methods across three languages and diverse reading orders, providing an effective framework and benchmark for low-resource historical document recognition. Code and Benchmark: https://github.com/Shajiu/DDVR-Net

</details>


### [361] [Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16967)
*Yang, Zhenhua,Liang, Jiafeng,Zhou, Xingyu,Jiang, Yi,Cao, Xiayu,Chen, Zui,Wang, Luqi,Sun, Haiyang,Xiang, Yufei,Li, Chang,Mu, Rongchuan,Chi, Bowen,Tong, Zihe,Li, Mingyu,Ma, Huijie,Yang, Yiqiao,Ren, Baoqi,Ma, Zhiming,Zhu, Zhihao,Ji, Jiahao,Wang, Zhuoyao,Wang, Qianyu,Liu, Xiangyu,Zixiang, Wang,Zhang, Shunliang,Liu, Ming,Feng, Xiaocheng,Tang, Duyu,Qin, Bing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Proactive Physical AI 问题设定与 ProAgent 系统，用 StreamingJev 主动时机模型判断何时干预，并配合响应模型执行动作，实现从视频自动生成主动时机的监督数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Physical AI 多围绕显式给定任务（目标或指令）展开，但真实场景中重要任务常在用户明确表述之前就从不断变化的世界状态中涌现，缺少"持续观察—判断是否/何时需要干预—及时发起行动"的能力。

Method: 端到端系统 ProAgent，含两部分：(1) Jev 风格的主动时机模型 StreamingJev，判断是否需要以及何时干预；(2) Response Model，生成面向人的回应或调用设备能力进行物理执行。同时构建自动化数据流水线，将视频转换为主动时机的监督信号以支撑大规模学习。

Result: 在显式目标与常驻角色两类设定下均取得较强的主动性能，干预时机更准确且误触发少于源骨干基线；真机实验表明系统能识别涌现需求并转化为恰当的物理动作。

Conclusion: 主动式物理 AI 是可扩展且有前景的互补方向，时机建模加响应生成的两段式架构配合视频自动标注可支撑学习，并在真实机器人上初步验证。

Abstract: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

</details>


### [362] [The Value of Being Wrong: Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16977)
*Zhao, Shu,Yu, Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SMILE：离线记录目标 VLM 自身错误构建模型特定难负样本池，测试时以当前预测为方向信号在语义嵌入空间中检索最可能重演的历史错误作为反事实示例，统一支持闭集分类与开放式 VQA，四基准四模型平均提升 +3.09 分且延迟降低 5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉上下文学习（visual ICL）的效果高度依赖示例选择；现有反事实选择方法需属性抽取、caption 工程与组合图像匹配的多阶段流水线，成本高、工程复杂且任务耦合。作者观察到模型自身的预测错误天然就是编码其失败模式的反事实示例，据此寻求一种更简单、任务无关的替代方案。

Method: SMILE（Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors）：离线阶段记录目标 VLM 自身的预测错误，构建模型特定的难负样本池；测试阶段将模型对当前查询的预测作为方向信号，在语义嵌入空间中检索与该预测方向一致、最可能再次复现的历史错误，作为预测条件化的上下文示例。该机制无需属性抽取或图像组合，统一适用于闭集分类与开放式视觉问答。

Result: 在 4 个基准、4 个 VLM 上，SMILE 相比 SOTA 基线平均任务得分提升 +3.09 分，同时延迟降低 5 倍（约 5x lower latency），且不依赖任务特定设计。

Conclusion: 以模型自身错误作为自挖掘反事实示例，可在不引入多阶段流水线的前提下提升视觉 ICL 的选择质量与效率，说明"失败模式即示例"是简洁而有效的归纳偏置；局限在于需对目标模型做离线错误采集，且泛化到新模型需重跑该过程。

Abstract: Visual in-context learning (ICL) enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt at test time via demonstration examples, but its effectiveness depends critically on the examples selected. Recent counterfactual selection methods improve ICL by constructing demonstrations that expose how individual attribute changes affect the answer. However, they require multi-stage pipelines involving attribute extraction, caption engineering, and composed image matching. We propose a simpler alternative grounded in a key observation: a model's own prediction errors are natural counterfactual demonstrations that directly encode its failure modes. Our method, SMILE (Self-Mined Visual In-Context Learning from Errors), builds a model-specific pool of hard negatives offline by recording the target VLM's own mistakes. At test time, the prediction serves as a direction signal that surfaces, in the semantic embedding space, the past mistakes most likely to recur for the current query. This prediction-conditioned identification provides a unified mechanism for both closed-set classification and open-ended visual question answering without task-specific design. Across four benchmarks and four VLMs, SMILE delivers an average task-score gain of +3.09 points over the SOTA baseline at 5x lower latency. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/SMILE/

</details>


### [363] [AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16985)
*Ye, Yuqi,Jiang, Caigao,Wang, Zhuonan,Pei, Congyuan,Qu, Chao,Peng, Changhao,Lin, Junhong,Yu, Qize,Song, Zetian,Fu, Guangzhao,Wu, Chongruo,Huang, Shiyu,Zhou, Shuchang,Yang, Honggou,Gao, Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AUGUstus 将扩散式动作生成与自回归 CoT 理解统一在单个 VLA 模型中，并将动作生成置于 CoT 之前，实现低延迟自动驾驶规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶 VLA 存在两难：回归/流式方法为低延迟直接出动作，退化为视觉-动作模型、浪费 VLM 理解能力；自回归方法虽充分利用 CoT 但串行解码延迟高，难以部署。目标是在保留 CoT 辅助动作生成的同时实现低延迟。

Method: 提出 AUGUstus，统一扩散动作生成与自回归 CoT 理解，理解仅服务于生成；通过联合 CoT 监督在共享表征中保留 VLM 空间理解；AUGUstus-mode 将动作生成排在 CoT 之前，训练时 CoT 监督可靠动作，推理时仅需动作输出；并用统一的 AUGUstus-GRPO 算法联合优化动作与 CoT。

Result: NAVSIMv1 达 94.6 PDMS、NAVSIMv2 达 90.7 EPDMS，在无 scorer 模块条件下 SOTA；nuScenes 平均 L2 误差 0.27 m、平均碰撞率 0.05%，优于对比方法；内部 1,000 km 数据集评估并在实车初步部署，达 12 Hz。

Conclusion: 统一生成与理解、调整动作/CoT 顺序，可兼顾 VLM 理解带来的安全性与低延迟部署，AUGUstus 在公开与内部数据及实车上验证了实用性与 SOTA 规划性能。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging world knowledge and understanding to excel in long-tail scenarios. However, current VLAs have two limitations: 1) Degeneration into vision-action (VA) models. For low latency, regression/flow-based methods directly generate actions but underuse VLM understanding, causing unsafe, unexplainable actions. 2) Autoregressive high latency. Autoregressive methods sequentially generate chain-of-thought (CoT) and action tokens, fully leveraging VLM understanding, but high latency hinders deployment. To enable low-latency deployment while using CoT to assist action generation, we propose AUGUstus, an Autonomous-driving VLA model with Unified Generation and Understanding. We unify diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive CoT understanding in one model, where understanding only serves generation. Joint CoT supervision preserves VLM spatial understanding in shared representation for safer, more accurate trajectories. AUGUstus-mode orders action generation before CoT, so CoT supervises reliable actions during training while inference needs only action output, enabling low latency. AUGUstus-GRPO, a unified GRPO algorithm, jointly optimizes action and CoT, improving action performance. Experiments show AUGUstus achieves 94.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1 and 90.7 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2, SOTA planning without scorer module. On nuScenes, it achieves average L2 error 0.27 m and average collision rate 0.05%, best among compared methods. To validate AUGUstus practicality, we train on in-house data with 512 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for ~2 days, evaluate on an internal 1,000 km dataset, and preliminarily deploy on a real vehicle, achieving 12 Hz operation. Project page: https://augustus-ad.github.io

</details>


### [364] [Self-Supervised Learning of Semantically Consistent Visual Features via a Simple 3D Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16988)
*Day, Sebastian,Mac Aodha, Oisin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种自监督方法，在数据集全局层面通过对比学习与分布匹配，学习拓扑复杂类别的视觉特征，使语义对应特征复现真实图像的全局与局部统计量，无需标注关键点或相机位姿，也无需拓扑假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINOv2、Stable Diffusion 等视觉模型的特征在语义对应上表现优异，但存在对称或重复部件类别左右不可区分等固有缺陷。已有改进依赖监督数据（关键点对、相机位姿）或强拓扑假设（如将目标建模为球体），成本高且泛化受限。作者希望以廉价的简单先验实现拓扑复杂类别的对应特征学习。

Method: 放弃逐实例的分析-合成（analysis by synthesis）流程，改为在全局数据集层面进行对比学习与分布匹配，以学习类别的粗粒度形状与外观；再结合额外的几何损失，使学习到的特征在全局与局部统计上与真实图像提取的特征对齐。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的物体类别上给出定量结果，验证了方法在语义对应任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: 无需监督标注与限制性拓扑假设，仅凭简单先验与数据集级分布匹配即可获得适用于拓扑复杂类别的语义对应特征。

Abstract: Visual features extracted from vision models like DINOv2 or Stable Diffusion enable high quality semantic correspondence between images. However, such features exhibit documented limitations that hinder accurate correspondence estimation such as the inability to disambiguate the left from right for categories exhibiting symmetries or repeated parts. Previous attempts to improve these features rely on using supervised data such as annotated keypoint pairs or camera pose information, or make restrictive topological assumptions, such as modelling the object of interest as a 3D sphere. We introduce a new self-supervised approach that allows us to learn features for topologically complex object categories using a simple prior. Instead of relying on an expensive instance-level analysis by synthesis pipeline, our approach makes use of contrastive learning and distribution matching at the global dataset-level to learn the coarse shape and appearance of a category. Combined with additional geometric losses, this enables us to replicate the global and local statistics of visual features which match those that are extracted from real images. Quantitative results are presented across several challenging object categories, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [365] [MaskSense: Confronting the Visual Exploration Trap in Masked Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17009)
*Shao, Yawen,Xiao, Jie,Zhu, Kai,Liu, Yu,Luo, Hongchen,Fu, Xueyang,Cao, Yang,Zhai, Wei,Zha, Zheng-Jun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对掩码生成模型(MGM)应用RL时的"视觉探索陷阱"，提出MaskSense框架，在采样与优化两个阶段分别引入语义锚定路由采样与全局熵转折锚定策略，显著提升文生图对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL在生成模型对齐上潜力巨大，但将GRPO直接迁移到掩码生成模型时存在结构性冲突：MGM基于置信度的解码本质是"利用型"（exploitative），与GRPO所需的"探索型"多样性相矛盾，导致rollout多样性塌缩、优势估计失效。

Method: 1) 揭示并定义"视觉探索陷阱"（visual exploration trap）：置信度采样用对低不确定性背景区域的贪婪解析，换取了多样主体实现的探索，造成生成探索空间过早崩塌。2) 提出MaskSense：采样阶段用语义锚定路由采样(semantic anchored routing sampling)，借助语义先验保留高熵主体token探索，并通过探索-利用路由放大组内奖励方差；优化阶段设计全局熵转折锚定策略，定位最关键解码步并集中梯度更新。

Result: 在多个文生图基准上大幅超越基座模型：GenEval准确率从54%提升到86%，HPS从28.89提升到36.39，达到SOTA。

Conclusion: MaskSense通过同时解决采样与优化阶段的探索-利用冲突，为掩码生成模型的RL对齐提供了有效范式；但实验限于文生图基准，未涉及具身/物理交互等任务。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong potential for aligning generative models with human intent, but adapting RL to masked generative models (MGMs) remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches that directly adapt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to MGMs leave a foundational conflict unaddressed: MGMs' exploitative decoding nature is inherently at odds with the exploratory diversity that GRPO presupposes. In this work, we reveal a structural decoding bias termed the visual exploration trap: confidence-based sampling trades the exploration of diverse subject realizations for the greedy resolution of low-uncertainty background regions, causing premature collapse of the generative exploration space and starving GRPO of the rollout diversity it depends on. To this end, we propose MaskSense, a novel RL framework for MGMs that confronts the visual exploration trap at both the sampling and optimization stages. Specifically, we introduce a semantic anchored routing sampling mechanism that leverages semantic priors to preserve high-entropy subject token exploration while amplifying intra-group reward variance through exploratory-exploitative routing to yield more discriminative advantage estimates. Furthermore, we design a global entropy transition anchoring strategy to identify the most consequential decoding steps and concentrate gradient updates on them. Extensive experiments on multiple text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that MaskSense substantially improves upon the base model, with GenEval accuracy improving from 54% to 86% and HPS from 28.89 to 36.39, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [366] [DIME: Scaling Facial Representation Learning via Differential Masked Autoencoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17015)
*Yu, Hao,Chen, Haoyu,Wei, Hui,Jiang, Yan,Sebe, Nicu,Zhao, Guoying*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIME：差分掩码自编码器，通过同身份图像对的"重建差值方向对齐"监督，使细微面部变化成为主导训练信号，在20M人脸图像上预训练后AU检测等细粒度任务显著优于MAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规视觉预训练 pretext 任务在细粒度人脸分析上收益递减，作者归因于"规模瓶颈"：这类任务建模整图外观，被身份、姿态、光照主导，身份内部的细微面部差异对训练信号贡献极小。

Method: DIME 对同身份图像对的两张图分别做掩码重建，用显式差分方向监督（EDDS）让"两重建图之差"的方向对齐真实图像之差的方向，同时用 source isolation 保证每个重建只依赖各自输入；差值中共享外观被抵消，且 EDDS 忽略幅度，使细微变化与大姿态/光照变化同等权重。仅需身份标签构对，无需稠密标注。在2千万高分辨率人脸图上预训练。

Result: 数据从6M扩到20M时AU检测持续提升，BP4D F1提升5.9点，而MAE仅提升0.5点；在AU检测、AU强度估计、跨域反欺骗、关键点定位、头部姿态估计、人脸解析与人脸生成上均优于专门的人脸方法，并涌现部件级语义。

Conclusion: 通过在一比对而非单图上施加差分方向监督，可破解细粒度面部表征的规模瓶颈，获得可随数据规模持续受益的稠密人脸表征。

Abstract: Scaling up data and model capacity has driven substantial progress in visual representation learning. However, conventional pretext tasks exhibit diminishing returns on fine-grained facial analysis. We attribute this to a scaling bottleneck: these tasks model each image's appearance and are dominated by identity, pose, and illumination, so subtle within-identity facial differences contribute little to the training signal. We introduce DIME, a differential masked autoencoder for large-scale facial representation learning. DIME builds on a simple observation: two images of the same person share identity-specific appearance, so their difference exposes facial changes. DIME reconstructs both masked images in an identity-matched pair and, through an Explicit Differential Direction Supervision (EDDS) objective, aligns the direction of their reconstructed difference with the true difference, while source isolation makes each reconstruction depend only on its own image. Shared appearance cancels in this difference, and because EDDS ignores magnitude, subtle facial changes count as much as large pose or illumination changes. DIME uses identity labels only to form pretraining pairs, requires no dense annotations, and learns dense facial representations with emergent part-level semantics. We pretrain DIME on 20 million high-resolution facial images consolidated from existing face datasets. DIME's AU detection performance continues to improve as pretraining data scales from 6M to 20M images, with its BP4D F1 increasing by 5.9 points, while MAE gains only 0.5 points on the same subsets. DIME also outperforms specialized facial methods on AU detection, AU intensity estimation, cross-domain anti-spoofing, landmark localization, head pose estimation, face parsing, and face generation.

</details>


### [367] [PerturbBridge: Direct Phenotypic Supervision for Cellular Perturbation Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17066)
*Yang, Yucheng,Sun, Xiaoxiao,Sun, Huangqingbo,Sui, Elaine,Lundberg, Emma,Yeung-Levy, Serena*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PerturbBridge——一种随机 data-to-data bridge 生成模型，在训练时直接对预测扰动图像施加可微的生物学响应损失监督，使生成模型显式优化扰动特异性表型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟细胞模型应能刻画特定扰动诱导的表型，但基于图像的模型通常只以匹配真实图像分布为训练与评估目标，未显式优先考虑扰动特异的生物学响应；近期方法通过强化学习后训练或推理时引导注入生物信号，因此核心问题是：生物学响应信息应进入生成流程的哪一环节？

Method: 采用随机 data-to-data bridge 框架，联合优化 bridge 回归损失与可微生物学响应损失；生物梯度经冻结的图像编码器回传，从而在训练阶段直接监督预测扰动图像的扰动特异表型。同时引入基于下游分类与检索的扰动-响应评估协议。

Result: 在三个显微成像基准（扰动谱分析与亚细胞成像）上，生物保真度、图像质量与采样效率均优于 CellFlux：BBBC021 上 MoA 分类在形态学特征与学习视觉特征下分别提升 5.66 与 7.5 个百分点；JUMP 与 AllenCell 上检索 Hit@10 与 Hit@1 分别提升 1.77 与 7.15 个百分点；BBBC021 与 JUMP 上以少 80% 的模型评估次数取得更低 FID。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在训练阶段直接监督扰动响应可提升表型保真度，同时实现高效的细胞图像生成；该工作为"生物信号应置于生成流程何处"提供了明确的训练期监督方案。

Abstract: Virtual cell models should capture phenotypes induced by specific perturbations. However, image-based models are typically trained and evaluated to match real-image distributions, which alone does not explicitly prioritize perturbation-specific biological responses. Recent approaches add biological signals through reinforcement-learning post-training or inference-time steering, raising a central question: where should biological response information enter the generative pipeline? We introduce PerturbBridge, a stochastic data-to-data bridge model that directly supervises perturbation-specific phenotypes in predicted perturbed images during training. PerturbBridge jointly optimizes bridge regression and differentiable biological response losses, with biological gradients passing through a frozen image encoder. We further introduce perturbation-response evaluations based on downstream classification and retrieval. Across three microscopy benchmarks for perturbation profiling and subcellular imaging, PerturbBridge surpasses CellFlux in biological fidelity, image quality, and sampling efficiency. On BBBC021, mechanism-of-action classification improves by 5.66 and 7.5 percentage points with morphological and learned visual features, respectively. On JUMP and AllenCell, retrieval Hit@10 and Hit@1 improve by 1.77 and 7.15 percentage points, respectively. On BBBC021 and JUMP, PerturbBridge achieves lower FID with 80% fewer model evaluations than CellFlux. Overall, these results show that directly supervising perturbation responses during training improves phenotypic fidelity while enabling efficient cellular image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/PerturbBridge.

</details>


### [368] [A unified three-branch deep learning framework for automated detection and counting of wildlife in aerial imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17067)
*Xu, Zeyu,Wang, Tiejun,Skidmore, Andrew,Claase, Megan,Wells, Harry,Duporge, Isla,Crego, Ramiro D.,Lamprey, Richard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三分支深度学习框架（WildSeg/WildMatch/WildDet），用于航拍野生动物调查：条带分割、跨图重叠匹配与动物检测计数，在南苏丹四种羚羊斜摄影像上验证，检测计数误差较YOLO11明显下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍野生动物调查需三件事：可靠的动物检测、一致的观测条带划分、以及相邻影像重复覆盖的校正。现有方法各自独立、依赖地理定位元数据、且计算开销大，难以规模化处理大量航拍影像。

Method: 统一三支框架：WildSeg以杆状标记分割加几何细化提取计数条带；WildMatch用师生蒸馏学习稠密图像对应关系，在不依赖地理元数据的情况下识别重叠调查区域；WildDet结合双尺度检测与特征融合、密度监督和空图门控实现动物检测与计数。在四种羚羊的斜航拍影像上评测。

Result: WildSeg实现可靠杆提取；WildMatch以更轻更快的模型接近教师精度；两模块在缩放图像上保持高精度；WildDet在四个物种上均提升检测性能，检测计数的MAE、RMSE与平均偏差相对YOLO11分别降低21.0%、4.6%、27.8%。

Conclusion: 将空间调查约束与动物检测相连接，可为大规模航拍影像库提供实用且计算高效的野生动物监测与种群调查方案。

Abstract: Automating aerial wildlife surveys requires reliable animal detection, consistent delineation of observation strips, and correction for repeated coverage between successive images. We present a unified three-branch deep learning framework that integrates these tasks through WildSeg, WildMatch and WildDet. WildSeg combines rod segmentation with geometric refinement to delineate counting strips from aircraft-mounted markers. WildMatch uses teacher-student distillation to learn dense image correspondences and identify overlapping survey areas without relying on geolocation metadata. WildDet combines dual-scale detection with feature fusion, density supervision and empty-image gating to support animal detection and counting. We evaluated the framework using oblique aerial imagery of four antelope species from the Great Nile Migration Landscape in South Sudan. WildSeg achieved reliable rod extraction, while WildMatch approached teacher-level accuracy with a substantially lighter and faster model. Both modules maintained high accuracy on resized images, improving processing efficiency. WildDet improved detection performance across all four species and reduced detection-based count MAE, RMSE and mean bias by 21.0%, 4.6% and 27.8%, respectively, relative to YOLO11. By connecting spatial survey constraints with animal detection, the framework provides a practical and computationally efficient approach to processing large aerial image collections for wildlife monitoring and population surveys.

</details>


### [369] [Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17079)
*Saha, Aneerban,Kumar, Vijay,D., Sameer Madhav,Srivastava, Priyam,Bansal, Dhruv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在OK-VQA上对比LLM引导的两种集成深度：浅层决策级晚融合显著优于深层注意力注入，集成深度需匹配数据规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识型VQA需引入外部常识与事实知识，已有工作多用LLM作知识源，但"引导应多深地注入视觉-语言架构"这一设计问题缺乏系统研究，作者意在厘清集成深度与数据条件的匹配关系。

Method: 用Llama 3.3 70B生成结构化推理引导、视觉焦点概念、干扰元素与外部知识；在冻结ViT + FLAN-T5统一框架、OK-VQA基准上，对比决策级晚融合与注意力矩阵注入两种策略；并构建基于LLM的问句改写增强流水线，将训练数据扩充逾十倍，考察数据稀缺微调场景。

Result: 反直觉地，浅层晚融合最优：39.4% exact match，较无引导基线提升10.0；深层注意力修改仅31.8%。数据稀缺微调条件下，浅层融合优势明显。

Conclusion: 更深集成未必更优，集成深度必须与数据规模（regime）相匹配；LLM引导的有效性受微调数据量制约。

Abstract: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge. While recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as knowledge sources, the question of how deeply such guidance should be integrated into a vision language architecture remains underexplored. In this work, we generate structured reasoning guidance, visual focus concepts, distractor elements and external knowledge using Llama~3.3~70B and systematically compare two integration strategies within a unified frozen ViT + FLAN-T5 framework on the OK-VQA benchmark: decision level late fusion and attention-matrix injection. Contrary to the prevailing assumption that deeper integration is superior, we find that shallow late fusion achieves the strongest results (39.4% exact match, +10.0 over the no guidance baseline), outperforming deep attention modification (31.8%) under data scarce fine-tuning. We further contribute an LLM based augmentation pipeline that expands training data more than tenfold via question paraphrasing. Our findings indicate that integration depth must be matched to the data regime.

</details>


### [370] [Scaling Unified Multimodal Models to Long-Horizon Interleaved Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17080)
*Peng, Ziqiao,Cui, Yutao,Lin, Wang,Li, Zhong-Yu,Gu, Qingwen,Song, Tianhui,Jia, Chengyou,Zhang, Guozhen,Qiu, Xuerui,Wang, Qixun,Yang, Miles,Zhong, Zhao,Tian, Yonglong,Liu, Hongyan,He, Jun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视觉记忆框架，将原生多模态模型的交错图文自回归生成扩展到超长轨迹，并发布LongMIG-Bench评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽支持交错文本-图像生成，但仅在短轨迹或简化视觉内容上验证。长轨迹生成中，生成图像持续累积于上下文：无关或瑕疵的视觉状态干扰后续合成，而早期建立的字符与场景需在长间隔后仍能恢复。

Method: 1) 原生基于交错多模态数据训练的大规模UMM，具备图像合成、文本渲染、复杂构图与多模态规划能力；2) 视觉记忆框架：维护持久视觉参考、选择性检索与场景相关的历史状态同时保留完整语义历史；3) 少步self-rollout使模型适应不完美的自生成历史；4) 提出LongMIG-Bench，评测长时程text-to-multi-image与image-to-multi-image生成。

Result: 模型实现高保真长时程交错生成，字符与场景一致性显著，证明视觉记忆可将原生交错生成扩展到更长轨迹。

Conclusion: 视觉记忆机制是缓解长上下文视觉状态干扰、维持长时程一致性的有效路径，为长时程多模态生成与规划提供可行范式与评测工具。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) provide an interface for interleaved text-image generation, where generated visual states can directly inform subsequent reasoning and synthesis. However, existing systems are still primarily demonstrated on short trajectories or simplified visual content. We develop a large UMM natively trained on interleaved multimodal data, with strong capabilities in image synthesis, text rendering, complex composition, and multimodal planning, and study how to extend these native capabilities to substantially longer autoregressive trajectories. The main challenge is that generated images continuously accumulate in context: irrelevant or imperfect visual states interfere with future synthesis, while previously established characters and scenes must still be recovered after long intervals. We introduce a visual-memory framework that maintains persistent visual references, selectively retrieves scene-relevant historical states while preserving the complete semantic history, and uses few-step self-rollout to adapt the model to imperfect generated histories. We further introduce LongMIG-Bench for evaluating long-horizon text-to-multi-image and image-to-multi-image generation. Our model achieves high-fidelity long-horizon interleaved generation with strong character and scene consistency, demonstrating how visual memory can scale native interleaved generation to substantially longer trajectories.

</details>


### [371] [Contrastive learning for video reuse detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17098)
*Cann, Tristan J. B.,Biswas, Arjun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Siamese网络与对比学习微调的框架，将视频数据压缩为关键帧集合（<10%体量），并据此高效识别视频素材的复用来源，在库存素材库测试中平均准确率>0.95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨来源素材复用涉及版权风险，且社交媒体"混剪"与专用素材库兴起，使得视频内容复用识别有广泛需求；同时大规模视频数据集分析需要高效的降维与检索手段。

Method: 构建Siamese网络框架，采用对比学习进行微调，对给定视频的关键帧提取特征并与素材库比对，从而定位可能的原始素材来源；框架兼顾关键帧约简与检索两方面。

Result: 关键帧集合通常小于完整数据集的10%；在来自库存素材库的视频上，组成素材识别的平均准确率超过0.95。

Conclusion: 对比学习驱动的Siamese检索可用于大规模视频数据的复用检测与素材溯源，兼具压缩与高精度识别能力。

Abstract: The incorporation of footage from other sources has long been a concern from a copyright perspective, as such usage can harm the interests of rights holders. Recent trends in the ``remixing'' of social media content and the development of bespoke stock libraries for specialist causes mean that methods to identify content reuse will have a range of applications. In this paper, we develop a framework based on a Siamese network fine tuned using contrastive learning to identify potential sources for key frames in a given video. This framework makes two contributions to analysis of large video datasets. Firstly, we demonstrate its utility at reducing complex video data to a set of key visuals typically less than 10\% of the size of the full set. Secondly, we show that these reduced sets allow for efficient and effective identification of component footage. We test this method over a set of videos compiled from a stock footage library and demonstrate its effectiveness for constituent video identification with average accuracy greater than 0.95.

</details>


### [372] [EgoProbe: Benchmarking Long-Range and Exact Memory in Streaming Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17128)
*Pang, Haokai,Fu, Yuqian,Wang, Yifei,Shen, Yujiao,Qian, Tianwen,Elhoseiny, Mohamed,Fu, Hongbo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 EgoProbe，一个评估流式第一视角视频记忆能力的基准，从"记忆距离"（长程保持）和"记忆精度"（干扰下的事件特定细节回忆）两个维度评测模型，包含 EgoProbe-Base（无相关干扰事件）与 EgoProbe-Echo（含相似干扰事件与事件接地干扰项、粗到细多轮探测）两个子集，并通过事件接地数据引擎与人工校验构建数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴 AI 助手需要流式处理持续到达的第一视角观察，而查询可能指向遥远的过去经验。现有工作多关注"能否跨长时距回忆"，但真实场景中反复出现的物体、动作与地点还要求模型精确区分"哪个细节属于哪个事件"。因此需要一个同时衡量长程保持与干扰下精确回忆的评测基准。

Method: 基于长时段第一视角视频，构建事件接地的数据引擎：延长回忆间隔、识别相关事件、构造事件接地的干扰项，并经人工验证。基准含两个子集：EgoProbe-Base 评测无中间相关事件的长程回忆；EgoProbe-Echo 引入相似中间事件与事件接地干扰项，采用粗到细多轮探测（第一轮测粗粒度事件回忆，第二轮测能否检索指定事件的目标细节）。对多种模型进行广泛评测。

Result: 评测显示各类模型在长程回忆上存在显著局限；在有相关经验干扰时恢复目标事件细节更具挑战。即便模型正确回答粗粒度问题，也常无法回忆指定事件的具体细节，暴露了这一此前未被充分探索的失败模式。

Conclusion: EgoProbe 同时刻画"记忆多远"与"记忆多准"两个维度，揭示了流式第一视角视频理解中长程且精确记忆的未探索失败模式，为推进该方向提供了可复用的测试平台。

Abstract: Egocentric video provides a continuous first-person record of everyday activities, making it a natural foundation for wearable AI assistants. Unlike offline video understanding, streaming systems must process observations as they arrive, while queries may refer to experiences from the distant past. Recent work has begun to explore whether information can be recalled across long temporal gaps. Yet remembering how far is only part of the challenge: recurring objects, actions, and locations also require models to remember exactly which detail belongs to which event. We introduce EgoProbe, a benchmark that evaluates streaming egocentric memory along these two complementary dimensions: long-range retention, i.e., how far, and event-specific recall under interference, i.e., how exact. Built on long-form egocentric videos, EgoProbe uses an event-grounded data engine to extend recall intervals, identify related events, and construct event-grounded distractors, followed by human verification. It contains two subsets: EgoProbe-Base, which evaluates long-range recall without intervening related events, and EgoProbe-Echo, which challenges models with similar intervening events and event-grounded distractors. EgoProbe-Echo adopts coarse-to-fine multi-turn probing: the first turn evaluates coarse-grained event recall, while the second tests whether the model can retrieve the target-specific detail associated with the designated event. Extensive evaluation across diverse models reveals substantial limitations in long-range recall, with further challenges in recovering target-event details among related experiences. Even when models correctly answer coarse-grained questions, they often fail to recall the specific details of the designated event. EgoProbe exposes this underexplored failure mode and provides a testbed for advancing long-range and exact memory in streaming egocentric video understanding.

</details>


### [373] [MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17141)
*Zuo, Zengyuan,Zhang, Yongchang,Zhao, Guangyu,Zhang, Tianze,Wu, Biao,Fang, Meng,Zhong, Yiwu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS 是一个免训练、即插即用的世界行动模型（WAM）多级推理加速框架，通过选择性跳过注意力计算、按运动粒度自适应加速扩散去噪、以及在线校验的跨查询推测复用，在 LIBERO/LIBERO-PRO/RoboCasa 上分别实现最高 4.00×/3.94×/2.10× 端到端加速，成功率接近原策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM 联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作，但视觉编码开销大、扩散式迭代生成推理延迟高，难以用于高频闭环控制。现有免训练加速方法只优化单一阶段，激进复用下加速有限或控制退化。作者需要系统刻画 WAM 推理开销，并在保证动作预测与控制敏感性的前提下安全地去除冗余。

Method: 先系统剖析 WAM 推理开销，发现 Transformer 计算、扩散去噪与连续策略查询三类冗余。提出 MARS 多级加速框架：(1) 选择性移除低影响注意力计算；(2) 依据运动粒度自适应加速扩散推断；(3) 在连续查询间推测性复用预测的未来视觉表征，并做在线验证以控制近似误差。整体免训练、即插即用。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、RoboCasa 上分别取得最高 4.00×、3.94×、2.10× 端到端加速，任务成功率接近原始策略；并跨不同模型骨干、仿真与真机实验均验证有效，显著改善 WAM 推理的效率—性能权衡。代码开源。

Conclusion: 针对 WAM 高频闭环控制的延迟瓶颈，MARS 通过多级、互补的冗余去除机制，在基本不损失控制性能的前提下大幅降低推理延迟，且具备跨骨干与真机泛化能力，为 WAM 部署提供了通用加速方案。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative for embodied intelligence by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions. However, their heavy visual encoding and iterative generative inference incur substantial latency, limiting their applicability to high-frequency closed-loop control. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically optimize a single stage, yielding limited speedups or degraded control under aggressive reuse. In this work, we systematically profile the inference overhead of WAMs and observe abundant redundancy across Transformer computation, diffusion denoising, and consecutive policy queries. However, the safe removal of such redundancy depends strongly on its impact on action prediction and control sensitivity. Based on these observations, we introduce \textbf{MARS}, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for multi-level WAM acceleration. MARS selectively removes low-impact attention computation, adaptively accelerates diffusion inference according to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive queries with online verification. Together, these complementary mechanisms provide remarkable acceleration while limiting approximation error. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa show that MARS achieves up to $4.00\times$, $3.94\times$, and $2.10\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, while maintaining task success rate close to the original policy. Moreover, MARS generalizes across different model backbones and across simulation and real-robot experiments, substantially improving the efficiency--performance trade-off of WAM inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS.

</details>


### [374] [Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17201)
*Huang, Kaiyi,Yu, Wangbo,Huang, Yukun,Yu, Jiwen,Liu, Kunhao,Yang, Donglin,Hu, Wenbo,Shan, Ying,Liu, Xihui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Multics：面向多玩家交互世界模型的层次化通信视频生成框架，通过玩家-组-全局三级拓扑与预算约束动态分组，在4/6玩家设定达SOTA，并可零重训泛化至8/10玩家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多玩家交互世界模型存在两类缺陷：全连接通信（Solaris）随玩家数呈二次注意力开销；中心化全局表示（γ-World）中无关事件相互干扰。需在可扩展性与一致性间取得平衡。

Method: 引入组令牌作为中间层表示插入自注意力，组令牌聚合局部相关玩家信息并连接全局令牌实现跨组通信；层次拓扑限制无关局部事件直接混合。组令牌参数跨组槽共享，通信模块与玩家数解耦。另提出基于近期相机轨迹的预算约束动态分组，自适应聚合相关玩家并限制冗余通信。

Result: 4/6玩家设定取得SOTA，跨玩家一致性、玩家动作与相机可控性、抗干扰性提升；可由4玩家训练零重训泛化至6/8/10玩家推理，且自注意力计算量低于全连接通信。

Conclusion: 层次化通信与动态分组是扩展多玩家世界模型的有效范式，参数共享设计带来玩家数维度的泛化能力与计算效率优势。

Abstract: Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $\gamma$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

</details>


### [375] [AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17227)
*Rajabi, Javad,Roohi, Koorosh,Lindell, David B.,Taati, Babak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的注意力机制 AReA，令 DiT 的注意力感受野随去噪过程由粗到细演化，从而在高分辨率图像生成中同时降低计算开销并缓解结构畸变与细节退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT 在超出训练分辨率生成时，token 数随分辨率快速增长：全注意力带来二次复杂度开销，且每一步都让模型接触到超出训练范围的更多 token 与相对距离，导致分布外（OOD）问题，进而产生结构性畸变和细节劣化。作者认为"均匀的全注意力"是这两个问题的共同根源，并观察到去噪过程中注意力有效感受野自然地从早期的全局（构建结构）收窄到晚期的局部（精修细节）。

Method: AReA 是一种无需训练、无额外参数的注意力机制，其感受野"由粗到细"随去噪进度演化：早期步骤在降采样后的 key/value 上执行跨尺度粗粒度注意力以捕获全局上下文；后期步骤则在逐步收缩的窗口内执行局部注意力。设计遵循去噪进程的整体到局部规律。

Result: 在多个目标分辨率和不同模型上，AReA 无需额外参数或训练即一致优于现有免训练基线，同时在速度与效率上更优。

Conclusion: AReA 通过对全注意力进行符合去噪进程的粗到细改造，同时解决了高分辨率 DiT 生成的计算瓶颈与 OOD 畸变问题，是一种高效、通用、免训练的即插即用方案。

Abstract: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.

</details>


### [376] [Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17233)
*Shao, Daniel,Bang, Dongmin,Weishaupt, Luca L.,Wagner, Sophia J.,Reitsam, Nic G.,Lu, Ming Y.,Le, Long P.,Chen, Richard J.,Mahmood, Faisal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LIMIT预训练框架：冻结病理视觉编码器、仅微调文本编码器，用病理报告嵌入作为交叉注意力查询在patch特征包上生成报告条件化切片表征，以InfoNCE优化；据此构建CONCH-Z，在22项任务上取得零样本SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理视觉-语言预训练依赖社交媒体、教学视频、论文等策展图像-字幕数据，规模稀疏且难以扩展，因临床实践中病理医生不常规撰写描述性字幕；而切片级病理报告可在常规诊断流程中大规模产出，故希望以弱监督方式利用这类报告替代策展字幕。

Method: 关键难点在于报告描述宏观诊断结论而patch视觉特征刻画微观形态。LIMIT采用锁定图像的多实例预训练：冻结预训练视觉编码器，仅微调文本编码器；报告嵌入作为交叉注意力查询作用于patch特征包，产生报告条件化的切片表征，并通过InfoNCE对比损失优化。用该框架将CONCH v1.5的文本编码器对齐到33.5万份临床报告，得到CONCH-Z。

Result: 在覆盖patch级分类、肿瘤检测与切片级亚型分型的22项任务上，CONCH-Z在零样本性能上超越基于策展字幕数据训练的VL编码器，同时缩小了与参数量和算力显著更大的切片级基础模型之间的差距。代码与模型已开源。

Conclusion: 以临床切片报告作为可扩展弱监督信号、配合冻结视觉端、仅适配文本端的跨注意力多实例对齐策略，可有效构建病理切片级视觉-语言模型，为无需策展字幕的规模化病理VL预训练提供可行路径。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.

</details>


### [377] [When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17242)
*Cheng, Chong,Zhang, Ran,Li, Xinyuan,Zhao, Alan,Wang, Hao,Wang, Xi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CameraVLM，通过将相机运动状态表示与语言对齐（camera tokens + flow tokens + 两阶段训练），使视觉语言模型具备相机运动理解能力，仅9B参数即在三个基准上大幅超越20+基线，并匹敌GPT-6 Astra与人类观察者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM虽能解视觉谜题、处理长视频，但在判断相机左移还是右移这类基础空间问题上表现接近随机（抛硬币水平）。单独加入相机运动数据或几何表示均无法弥补该差距。作者认为相机运动理解需同时满足两个条件：表示需将屏外相机运动与屏上光流动态耦合；且必须由语言模型解释，而非作为独立位姿/深度估计器训练。

Method: 提出CameraVLM，将运动状态表示与状态-语言对齐相结合：camera tokens捕捉屏外相机运动，flow tokens捕捉屏上主体与背景运动；采用两阶段训练策略，保持语言在训练回路中，使两类表示与相机运动语义联合学习。

Result: 仅9B参数，在三个基准、超过20个基线上大幅超越所有开源及相机运动专用模型；在48人参与的用户研究中匹敌或超越GPT-6 Astra及人类观察者。

Conclusion: 相机运动理解需"屏外运动-屏上光流耦合表示"与"语言模型在环解释"两个条件同时满足，该思路使小规模模型在相机运动理解上达到甚至超越大模型与人类水平。

Abstract: Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/

</details>


### [378] [HybridDualPathNet: Cross-Fusion Attention of EfficientNetV2 and Swin Transformer for Brain MRI Classification of Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17251)
*Nirjala, Jarpula,Patel, Rahul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HybridDualPathNet，融合 EfficientNetV2-S 局部特征与 Swin-Tiny 全局上下文并通过交叉融合注意力（CFA）分类 AD、PD 与健康对照；在图像级划分下准确率 98.25%，但在按患者分离的跨数据集评估中仅 73.37%（Kaggle 91.2% vs ADNI 59.2%），并给出温度缩放与保形预测的不确定性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD、PD 与 HC 的结构 MRI 特征重叠，且模型指标对数据划分方式高度敏感；单数据集高分常被误读为泛化能力，因此需要强调患者级分离与跨数据集评估。

Method: HybridDualPathNet：EfficientNetV2-S 提取局部特征、Swin-Tiny 建模全局上下文，经 Cross-Fusion Attention（CFA）模块融合。设两组实验：(1) Kaggle APD-3-Class 图像级划分；(2) 合并 Kaggle 与 ADNI 共 17,859 张切片，按来源划分并对 ADNI 受试者做患者级隔离。评估含来源分层准确率、温度缩放校准、split-conformal 覆盖与 Grad-CAM++/Integrated Gradients/遮挡显著性分析。

Result: 图像级划分准确率 98.25%；跨数据集设置标准准确率 73.37%，macro AUC 0.880；来源分层为 Kaggle 91.2%、ADNI 59.2%，显示显著域间差距。温度缩放将 ECE 由 0.130 降至 0.015，split-conformal 覆盖率达 89.5%；显著性图集中于脑组织区域。

Conclusion: MRI 分类系统评估应采用患者级分离、跨数据集验证与不确定性估计；单数据集上的优异表现不等于跨影像队列的可靠泛化，存在明显域间差距。

Abstract: Separating Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Parkinson's Disease (PD), and Healthy Controls (HC) using structural MRI remains challenging because disease signatures overlap and model performance can be strongly affected by data partitioning. We present HybridDualPathNet, a hybrid architecture combining EfficientNetV2-S for local features and Swin-Tiny for global context through a Cross-Fusion Attention (CFA) module. We evaluate the model in two experiments. First, on the Kaggle APD-3-Class dataset using an image-level split, the model achieves 98.25% accuracy. Second, on a combined Kaggle and Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset containing 17,859 slices, we use a per-source split with patient-wise separation for ADNI subjects. In this setting, the model achieves 73.37% standard accuracy and a macro AUC of 0.880. Source-stratified evaluation reveals a substantial domain gap, with 91.2% accuracy on Kaggle test images and 59.2% on ADNI test images. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error from 0.130 to 0.015, while split-conformal prediction achieves 89.5% coverage. Saliency analyses using Grad-CAM++, Integrated Gradients, and occlusion indicate that model activations concentrate on brain tissue. These results highlight the importance of patient-level separation, cross-dataset evaluation, and uncertainty estimation when assessing MRI classification systems. The findings also show that strong performance on a single dataset does not necessarily translate to reliable generalization across imaging cohorts.

</details>


### [379] [SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17323)
*Parlayıcı, Tunahan,Aptoula, Erchan,Saygın, Yücel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SSM-Attack：用选择性状态空间模型（Mamba类）一次性预测人脸扰动预算的空间分配图，再经短程投影细化生成对抗扰动，实现黑盒人脸隐私保护；在CelebA-HQ/LADN/FFHQ上黑盒攻击成功率87.10/86.90/81.15，且分配网络仅5.73M参数，同预算下图像质量显著优于均匀分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线分享的人脸照片易被未授权人脸识别系统匹配，需要隐私保护。现有基于生成器的保护方法依赖大型预训练主干、多阶段推理或可见语义编辑，成本高、不够隐蔽。

Method: 基于选择性状态空间模型构建黑盒人脸隐私框架。不直接合成扰动，而是由状态空间模型以线性时间单次前向预测扰动预算的空间分配（标记承载身份证据的人脸位置），再由一个短程投影细化步骤在该逐像素预算内确定具体扰动值。分配网络5.73M参数（含冻结网络共16.13M）。
