Method: 计算沿SFC相邻点之间的距离，设计损失函数，对在原始3D空间中彼此远离的点对，抑制其特征相似性（即弱化这种虚假邻近的特征一致性）；将所提损失集成到高性能3D点云分割模型中训练，并在三个数据集（室内与室外）上评估。

Result: 在室内和室外点云数据集上，所提方法均优于传统方法。

Conclusion: 通过损失函数层面的简单修改即可有效降低SFC邻近与欧氏邻近之间的偏差，提升基于SFC的点云分割性能，方法通用、可插入现有模型。

Abstract: As a lightweight and highly accurate method for nearest-neighbor search in 3D point clouds, approaches based on space-filling curves (SFC) have been proposed. However, due to the inherent properties of SFC, a gap arises between proximity relationships along the SFC and those in the original Euclidean space. In this study, we propose a loss function that reduces the influence of this gap. Specifically, we compute the distances between adjacent points along the SFC and train the model to optimize feature similarity between pairs of points that are distant from each other in the original 3D space. We incorporate the proposed method into a high-performing 3D point cloud segmentation model and evaluate its effectiveness on three datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional methods on both indoor and outdoor point cloud datasets.

</details>


### [547] [RDCompGS: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting with Image Codecs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19538)
*Ren, Huiping,Wan, Shuai,Bai, Luqian,Chen, Zhang,Yang, Fuzheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RDCompGS 提出面向 3D Gaussian Splatting 的率失真（R-D）联合优化压缩方法：将可微的编码码率估计引入优化目标，并用码率约束调整模型调节不同压缩条件下的 R-D 权衡，在 H.265/HEVC 与 JPEG XL 上分别取得 37.84% 和 49.31% 的 BD-Rate 下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 渲染质量高、可实时新视角合成，但存储与传输开销大。将高斯属性映射到 2D 表征可用成熟图像编解码器高效压缩，然而现有方法在优化时对不同高斯表征一视同仁，忽略了它们编码码率的巨大差异，导致压缩后的率失真性能受限。

Method: 提出 RDCompGS：在优化中以渲染失真加可微码率估计构成整体 R-D 目标，使高斯表征针对后续编码进行端到端率失真优化；并设计码率约束调整模型，在不同压缩条件下自适应调节率失真权衡。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，配合 H.265/HEVC 平均 BD-Rate 降低 37.84%，配合 JPEG XL 降低 49.31%；估计码率与实际比特率在不同压缩条件下高度相关。

Conclusion: RDCompGS 表明将可微码率估计纳入 3DGS 优化可显著提升压缩后的率失真表现，且估计码率能可靠替代实际码率用于率失真权衡调控。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis but requires significant storage and transmission resources. Mapping Gaussian attributes to 2D representations enables efficient compression using mature image codecs. However, Gaussian representations that achieve comparable rendering quality are generally treated similarly during optimization, despite substantial differences in coding rate, leading to limited rate-distortion (R-D) performance after compression. To address this limitation, we propose RDCompGS, a 3DGS compression method that enables overall R-D optimization of Gaussian representations with respect to subsequent coding. A differentiable estimate of the coding rate is incorporated into the R-D optimization with rendering distortion. The rate constraint adjustment model further regulates the R-D trade-off across different compression conditions. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that RDCompGS achieves average Bj{\o}ntegaard Delta Rate reductions of 37.84% and 49.31% with H.265/HEVC and JPEG XL, respectively. The estimated rate also shows a strong correlation with the actual bit-rate under different compression conditions.

</details>


### [548] [Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19540)
*Li, Dikai,Wang, Weijia,Wang, Yuan-Gen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 面向工业板卡跨场景缺陷检测（域泛化），提出四模块协同方案：跨场景鲁棒训练、小缺陷感知学习、分数校准与阈值选择、面向指标的检查点选择，在 IDA 2026 Track 1 测试集取得 0.564 分数线与 0.696 筛选分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业板卡自动缺陷检测需在光照、表面污染、产线条件变化下保持高可靠，同时减少对洁净板卡的误报，因此被建模为域泛化问题。IDA 2026 Track 1 的设定要求模型在未见场景中完成缺陷的检测、定位与分类。

Method: 四个互补模块：(1) 跨场景鲁棒训练：跨场景鲁棒归一化 + DSU 风格统计扰动 + 渐进式随机卷积；(2) 小缺陷感知学习：NWD 损失 + 无参数空间注意力；(3) 分数校准与推理阈值选择：采用 VFL 学习目标；(4) 面向指标的检查点选择：面向 Track 1 代理指标的自定义 SWAD 变体。

Result: 单张 RTX 4090 上，测试集 Track 1 得分 0.564，screening score 0.696。代码已开源（GitHub: GZHU-DVL/Dikai）。

Conclusion: 多模块组合（鲁棒归一化+统计扰动、小目标损失与注意力、校准阈值、指标对齐的权重集成）可有效缓解跨场景域漂移与误报问题，但文中未给出与基线的消融细节及各模块贡献的量化证据。

Abstract: Automated defect detection of industrial boards must remain highly reliable under cross-scenario variations in lighting, surface contaminants, and production line conditions. This makes cross-scenario defect detection a domain generalization problem, wherein models are required to detect, localize, and classify defects across unseen scenarios while minimizing false alarms on clean boards. For the IDA 2026 Track 1 challenge, we propose a cross-scenario defect detection method that includes four complementary modules: cross-scenario robust training, small-defect-aware learning, score calibration and inference threshold selection, and metric-aligned checkpoint selection. These four modules respectively introduce cross-scenario robust normalization and DSU-style statistic perturbation with progressive random convolution, NWD and parameter-free spatial attention, the VFL learning objective, and a custom SWAD variant driven by the Track 1-oriented proxy. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves a Track 1 score of 0.564 with a screening score of 0.696 on the test dataset on a single RTX 4090 GPU. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/Dikai.

</details>


### [549] [TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19551)
*Chen, Yiyang,Wang, Guo-Hua,Liu, Yaoli,Chen, Qing-Guo,Xu, Zhao,Luo, Weihua,Ma, Xiujun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出目标条件下的文字渲染验证任务，用字符的IDS序列替代单字token训练TEXTVERIFIER，并构建首个生成中文逐字符基准TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH，F1达0.844，且可作为Flow-GRPO的逐字符奖励降低渲染错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生图模型生成的中文文本常出现局部缺陷（多笔/少笔、部件畸变），而OCR与视觉语言模型面向识别训练，对这些结构性偏差天然不变，导致此类错误难以被检出。

Method: 将文本渲染验证形式化为目标条件判别问题：给定目标字符与图像裁剪，判断渲染是否正确。TEXTVERIFIER向文本塔输入表意文字描述序列（IDS）而非单字符符号，训练于12.7M裁剪-IDS对，并加入从文本区域inpainting模型训练轨迹中采样的无标注"同字不同质"困难对；同时构建逐字符基准TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH（7,358字符，标注位置、身份与正确性）。

Result: TEXTVERIFIER取得F1 0.844，显著优于OCR置信度（0.526）、通用VLM（0.329）与TextPecker（0.590）；作为Flow-GRPO后训练的逐字符奖励可进一步减少渲染错误。

Conclusion: 通过IDS结构化解耦与困难对训练，可实现细粒度字符级渲染验证，其分数兼具检测与纠错能力，可作为生成模型的细粒度奖励信号。

Abstract: Text-to-image models increasingly generate readable Chinese text that still contains local rendering defects, such as a character with an extra or missing stroke or a malformed component. Such errors are invisible to OCR and vision-language models, which are trained for recognition and are therefore invariant to the very structural deviations that define a rendering error. We formalize text rendering verification as a target-conditioned problem: given a target character and an image crop, decide whether the crop is a correct rendering of that character. Our verifier TEXTVERIFIER feeds the text tower a character's Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) rather than a single-character symbol, and is trained on 12.7M crop-IDS pairs plus label-free "same-character, different-quality" hard pairs sampled from the training trajectory of a text-region inpainting model. To evaluate this ability we build TEXTRENDERBENCH-ZH, the first per-character benchmark for generated Chinese text, annotating position, identity, and correctness for 7,358 characters. TEXTVERIFIER reaches an F1 of 0.844, far above OCR confidence (0.526), a general VLM (0.329), and TextPecker (0.590). Used as a per-character reward for Flow-GRPO post-training, it further reduces rendering errors, showing that its score can both detect and correct errors.

</details>


### [550] [Learning Visual Speech Representations via Cross-Modal Distillation and Joint Face-Lip Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19559)
*Zhang, Jing-Xuan,Wan, Genshun,Gao, Jianqing,Pan, Jia,Zhang, Yumei,Zhang, Lichen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FLARE框架，通过Whisper跨模态蒸馏与"唇部ROI+全脸"双流联合建模学习鲁棒视觉语音表征，在LRS2/LRS3/WildVSR上WER分别为11.7%/13.2%/34.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语音线索本身存在歧义，且对头部姿态和视频分辨率敏感，导致唇读性能受限；同时现有方法多只用唇部ROI或只依赖单一模态监督，视觉信息利用不充分、鲁棒性不足。

Method: 以Whisper声学表征作为教师信号，经随机投影量化器转为离散蒸馏目标；采用掩码预测目标预训练；双流架构分别处理唇部ROI（细粒度发音动作）与全脸（整体面部动态）；预训练时引入辅助音频做跨模态对齐，并使用模态dropout促进纯视觉表征；下游接轻量Transformer解码器或LLM解码器。

Result: 在LRS2、LRS3以及域外WildVSR基准上取得强唇读性能，WER分别为11.7%、13.2%、34.3%；渐进式消融验证各主要模块贡献；分析表明联合脸-唇建模在低分辨率与大头部姿态变化下更鲁棒，且视觉表征音素判别性更强。代码与预训练模型已开源。

Conclusion: 跨模态蒸馏与脸-唇联合建模能有效提升视觉语音表征的鲁棒性与判别力，尤其改善分辨率退化和大姿态场景下的唇读表现。

Abstract: Lipreading remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of visual speech cues and their sensitivity to head pose and video resolution. In this work, we propose FLARE, a framework for robust visual speech representation learning via cross-modal distillation and joint face-lip modeling. FLARE leverages semantically rich Whisper representations as the acoustic teacher signal, converting them into discrete distillation targets through a random-projection quantizer and pretraining the model with a masked prediction objective. To capture complementary visual information, FLARE employs a dual-stream architecture that jointly processes lip region-of-interest (ROI) and full-face inputs, where the lip stream captures finegrained articulatory motion and the face stream encodes broader facial dynamics. During pretraining, auxiliary audio input is incorporated to facilitate cross-modal alignment, and modality dropout is applied to encourage robust visual-only representations. For downstream lipreading, FLARE serves as a visual encoder coupled with either a lightweight Transformer decoder or an LLM-based decoder. Evaluated on LRS2, LRS3, and the out-of-domain WildVSR benchmark, FLARE achieves strong lipreading performance, with word error rates of 11.7%, 13.2%, and 34.3%, respectively. A progressive design study confirms the contribution of each major component. Further analyses demonstrate that joint face-lip modeling improves robustness under degraded video resolution and large head pose variation, while yielding more phoneme-discriminative visual representations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/jxzhanggg/FLARE.

</details>


### [551] [SaTPO: Text-to-Image Safety Alignment via Transition Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19563)
*Fang, Ziyi,Li, Jingzhi,Jia, Xiaojun,Wei, Xingxing,Ren, Wenqi,Zhang, Haijun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SaTPO 将安全对齐从"完整图像偏好"改为"去噪逐步偏好"，用同一父状态+噪声下的不安全提示与其安全改写构成紧耦合偏好对，配合多尺度漂移约束与良性回放，在 SD1.5/SDXL 上同时改善安全性与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐基于完整图像的粗粒度偏好信号：它把多维生成因素压缩为单一标量，优化时会牵动超出安全所需的生成行为，损伤有用生成能力。作者希望在去噪轨迹层面做细粒度、增量式的安全适配，避免因轨迹历史分叉导致的语义漂移。

Method: 提出 Safety Transition Preference Optimization（SaTPO）：在去噪过程中执行逐步对齐。核心洞察是不安全提示与其安全改写在同一父状态与同一噪声实现条件下，天然构成紧耦合偏好对；以相同父状态为锚点优化，消除历史轨迹差异，使安全适配仅表现为增量对齐并保留任务相关语义。另加多尺度漂移约束与良性回放限制行为偏移、维持常规生成；并构建经视觉校验的对比数据集 CoProPV。

Result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 与 SDXL 上验证安全—质量权衡改善。相对 AlignGuard，在 Inappropriate Image Prompts 上 PerspectiveVision 不安全检出率分别由 12.70% 降至 6.00%、15.04% 降至 9.30%；FID 分别由 32.28 改善至 25.95、36.50 改善至 27.51。

Conclusion: 将安全对齐下沉到去噪步骤级偏好优化，可在不牺牲生成保真度的前提下显著降低不安全内容生成率，说明"更细粒度的偏好信号"是缓解安全—质量权衡的有效方向。

Abstract: Safety alignment of text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress harmful content without compromising useful generation capabilities. However, preferences over completed images compress multidimensional generation factors into a coarse signal, potentially driving changes beyond those required for safety. To address this, we propose Safety Transition Preference Optimization (SaTPO), which enforces step-wise alignment during denoising. SaTPO leverages the insight that an unsafe prompt and its safe rewrite naturally form a tightly coupled preference pair when conditioned on a shared parent state and noise realization. By anchoring optimization on identical parent states, SaTPO eliminates historical trajectory divergence, confining safety adaptation to an incremental alignment while preserving task-relevant semantics. Multi-scale drift constraints and benign replay further limit behavioral deviation and preserve ordinary generation. We additionally construct CoProPV, a refined dataset ensuring visually verified contrasts. Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and SDXL demonstrate improved safety-quality trade-offs. Compared with AlignGuard, PerspectiveVision unsafe-detection rates on Inappropriate Image Prompts decrease from 12.70% to 6.00% and from 15.04% to 9.30%, respectively, while FID improves from 32.28 to 25.95 and from 36.50 to 27.51. Warning: this paper includes potentially offensive content.

</details>


### [552] [Frame Evidence:A Benchmark for Reference Frames and Visual Evidence in Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19564)
*Luo, Chunxi,Ding, Qishuai,Peng, Xingchen,Ye, Hengwei,Zhang, Ke,Lian, Wenxin,Lu, Tianyi,Yu, Chunlong,Lin, Zhenya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Frame Evidence 基准，用 320 个匹配三元组和 960 道中文选择题检验空间问答在参考系与图像证据变化下答案是否持续正确，发现现有模型联合正确率远低于单项准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间答案依赖语言指定的参考系及支撑它的视觉证据，仅看单题准确率无法判断参考系或证据变化时答案是否稳定正确。

Method: 构建 Frame Evidence 基准：320 个匹配三元组、960 道中文多选题，来自实拍与渲染场景；一族固定图像比较三种有依据的参考系，另一族将标注为证据不足的删图与保答增图配对；提出联合指标，要求三种参考系及配对证据变体全部答对。

Result: 在 288 道留出题的 20 种配置中，GPT 三样本单项准确率达 50.00%，但最佳三帧组准确率仅 5/48（10.42%，GPT 两样本）；少样本提示与任务适配提升单项准确率，却未稳定提升联合正确率；输入控制显示图像在何处支撑匹配成功，重复运行揭示相似分数下的答案不稳定。

Conclusion: 仅凭单项准确率会高估空间推理能力，参考系与证据不变性需作为独立评价维度。

Abstract: A spatial answer depends on the reference frame specified in language and its supporting visual evidence. Item accuracy alone obscures whether correctness persists when either changes. We introduce Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions from captured and rendered scenes. One family compares three grounded reference frames over fixed images. The other pairs image deletion annotated as insufficient with answer-preserving addition. Joint metrics require correct answers across all three frames and paired evidence variants. Across 20 configurations on 288 held-out questions, GPT three-shot reaches 50.00\% item accuracy, but the best three-frame group accuracy is 5/48 (10.42\%), reached by GPT two-shot. Few-shot prompting and task-specific adaptation improve item accuracy without consistently improving joint correctness. Input controls show where images support matched success, while repeated executions reveal answer instability beneath similar scores.

</details>


### [553] [LED-BENCH: A Benchmark for Large-format Engineering Drawing Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19571)
*Li, Ke,Wang, Tianyi,You, Enning,Wan, Chaoqun,Huang, Zhen,Liang, Shuxian,Hua, Xian-Sheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LED-BENCH：面向大幅面工程图纸（机械、建筑、交通）细粒度理解与复杂推理的多学科基准，评测11个MLLM，最强GPT-5.6 Sol平均仅52.65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实工程图纸大幅面、信息密集，回答工程问题需细粒度理解与跨区域/跨视图的证据整合推理；现有基准多局限于局部区域、单一视图或受限视觉条件，缺乏对真实大幅面工程图纸理解能力的系统评测。

Method: 构建LED-BENCH多学科基准，覆盖机械、建筑、交通三个领域的大幅面工程图纸，任务设计强调细粒度理解与对分散对象、关系、证据的复杂推理；对11个代表性MLLM（8个闭源、3个开源）进行系统评测，并按领域、证据整合需求分层分析表现。

Result: GPT-5.6 Sol取得52.65%平均准确率，为最佳；模型表现随工程领域不同而波动；所有被评测模型在需要更广证据整合的问题上表现更差。

Conclusion: 大幅面工程图纸上的细粒度理解、证据整合与复杂推理仍是当前多模态模型的持续性挑战，LED-BENCH为后续研究提供了评测基础。

Abstract: Real-world engineering drawings are often large-format and information-dense. Answering practical engineering questions therefore requires both fine-grained understanding of engineering information and complex reasoning over objects, relations, and evidence distributed across different regions or views. Existing benchmarks cover a range of engineering-drawing understanding tasks involving local regions, individual views, specific elements, or more constrained visual settings. However, systematic evaluation of understanding over realistic, large-format engineering drawings remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce LED-BENCH, a multidisciplinary benchmark designed to evaluate fine-grained understanding and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings, spanning the mechanical, architectural, and transportation domains. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative multimodal large language models, including 8 proprietary models and 3 open-source models, reveals substantial remaining difficulty: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves 52.65% average accuracy, performance varies across engineering domains, and all evaluated models perform worse on questions requiring broader evidence integration. These results highlight fine-grained understanding, evidence integration, and complex reasoning over large-format engineering drawings as persistent challenges for current multimodal models.

</details>


### [554] [CORE: Contrast-and-Reflect for Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization in Anomaly Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19610)
*Rao, Haoxiang,Zhao, Fang,Wang, Zhao,Li, Weijia,Si, Chenyang,Shan, Caifeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CORE：基于大型多模态模型的免训练提示优化框架，统一零样本与单样本工业异常合成，通过异常上下文接地与自监督对比-反思机制生成真实缺陷，提升下游异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测受限于异常样本稀缺，高保真异常合成对下游性能至关重要；但现有方法依赖稀缺的真实异常参考或辅助数据，且缺乏复杂推理与迭代优化能力，难以在开放集场景生成真实缺陷。

Method: 提出CORE，成本高效、免训练的提示优化框架，基于LMM统一零样本/单样本异常合成。第一步：异常上下文接地模块，将稀疏用户上下文转化为缺陷感知生成上下文；第二步：实例化为结构化异常提示，解耦正常区域保持与异常特定变化，实现可控且忠实的缺陷生成；第三步：通过自监督对比-反思机制自主迭代精炼提示。模型无关、即插即用。

Result: 在MVTec-AD与VisA上，CORE合成出真实且多样的异常，带来下游AD性能的显著提升；模型无关的即插即用范式可无缝集成多种LMM，适应未见开放集场景。

Conclusion: 免训练LMM提示优化可有效替代依赖真实异常样本的合成范式，为开放集工业异常合成与检测提供通用、低成本且可迁移的解决方案。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection (AD) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of anomalous samples, making high-fidelity anomaly synthesis crucial for improving downstream performance. However, existing methods either rely on scarce real anomaly references or auxiliary data, while lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities for generating realistic defects in open-set scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose CORE, a cost-efficient and training-free prompt optimization framework based on Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which unifies zero-shot and one-shot anomaly synthesis. CORE first introduces an Anomaly Context Grounding module to transform sparse user context into defect-aware generation context, which is subsequently instantiated as structured anomaly prompts that disentangle normal-region preservation from anomaly-specific variation, enabling controllable and faithful defect generation. Furthermore, CORE autonomously refines prompts through a self-supervised contrast-and-reflect mechanism. This design empowers general-purpose LMMs to synthesize realistic anomalies under both zero-shot and one-shot settings without task-specific training. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD and VisA demonstrate that CORE synthesizes realistic and diverse anomalies, yielding superior improvements in downstream AD performance. Furthermore, its model-agnostic and plug-and-play paradigm enables effortless integration with diverse LMMs, facilitating adaptation to unseen open-set scenarios.

</details>


### [555] [What Breaks in Multi-Image Schema Application? Factorial Oracle Interventions Reveal an Instance-Information Bottleneck](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19611)
*Xu, Yiliu,Li, Xinjin,Ma, Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过2×2 Oracle因子实验，将多图VLM推理流水线的主要可恢复缺陷定位于上游有序实例恢复，而非下游模式使用与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多图上下文视觉语言模型的聚合准确率无法揭示多图推理流水线在哪个环节失败，需要受控的解耦分析手段来定位瓶颈。

Method: 设计受控的schema应用任务：在16张图像序列中定位两个目标字符、识别视觉属性、查阅条目专用视觉码本并组合两个有序无义码名。引入项内2×2因子Oracle设计：Oracle-A给出经验证的文本schema，Oracle-B给出经验证的有序目标外观表示，两者均保留原始图像与最终问题。共72个新条目、1188条模型响应；另设去除码名生成的有序外观检索诊断。

Result: Oracle-B将严格精确准确率提升54.6个百分点（95% CI：46.3–63.0），比Oracle-A高60.6个百分点（Holm校正p≤.0002）；辅助检索诊断在去除码名生成后仅达49.1%有序外观准确率；同时提供两种Oracle时所有模型均达100%准确率。

Conclusion: 多图推理的主导可恢复缺陷位于上游有序实例恢复，而非下游schema使用与组合；提升应按阶段诊断而非仅看聚合准确率。

Abstract: Modern vision-language models can accept multi-image contexts, but aggregate accuracy rarely reveals where a multi-image reasoning pipeline fails. We study a controlled schema-application task in which a model must locate two target characters in a 16-image sequence, identify their visual attributes, consult an item-specific visual codebook, and compose two ordered nonce code names. We introduce a within-item 2-by-2 factorial Oracle design: Oracle-A supplies a verified textual schema, Oracle-B supplies a verified ordered target-appearance representation, and both interventions retain the original images and final question. Across 72 new items and 1,188 analyzed model responses, Oracle-B increased strict exact accuracy by 54.6 percentage points (95% confidence interval: 46.3 to 63.0) and outperformed Oracle-A by 60.6 points (Holm-adjusted p-value no greater than .0002). An auxiliary retrieval diagnostic reached only 49.1% ordered-appearance accuracy even after removing code-name generation. Providing both Oracle sources yielded 100% accuracy across all models. These results localize the dominant recoverable deficit to upstream ordered instance recovery rather than primarily to downstream schema use and composition.

</details>


### [556] [MagicGarment: Benchmarking Single-Image Standalone 3D Garment Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19623)
*Chen, Jia,Zhao, Ruyang,Bai, Jun,Huang, Chao,Zhong, Saishang,Hu, Xinrong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MagicGarment 单图独立服装 3D 重建基准（1518 个资产、17 类组合服装、多模态对齐标注与统一评测协议），并给出融入服装先验的参考基线（GSR 语义细化 + FTR-LoRA 时序/路由/专家负载适配）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集与评测协议难以系统评估单张图像下的独立服装重建：薄壳几何、开放边界、多层结构等特性使该任务缺乏针对性基准与适配方法。

Method: 构建 MagicGarment 基准，含 1518 件专业制作资产、17 种组合服装类型、对齐的多模态标注与统一评测协议；参考基线在预训练 image-to-3D 主干上做两层适配：Grounded Semantic Refinement（GSR）提供面向服装的视觉条件，Flow-Time-Route LoRA（FTR-LoRA）利用流时间步、token 路由与专家负载信息微调冻结的 3D 生成主干。

Result: 实验验证了 MagicGarment 的基准有效性与服装感知适配方法的性能增益（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: 该工作为单图独立服装 3D 重建提供了系统化基准与可参考的服装感知适配方案，后续可扩展至更复杂层级与可动服装场景。

Abstract: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. Existing datasets and evaluation protocols provide limited support for systematic evaluation in this setting. We introduce MagicGarment, a benchmark for single-image standalone 3D garment reconstruction with 1,518 professionally constructed assets across 17 composite garment types, aligned multimodal annotations, and a unified evaluation protocol. We further establish a garment-aware reference baseline by adapting a pretrained image-to-3D backbone at two levels: Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) provides garment-focused visual conditioning, while Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) adapts the frozen 3D generative backbone using flow-timestep, token-routing, and expert-load information. Experiments demonstrate MagicGarment's benchmark utility and the effectiveness of garment-aware adaptation. Project page: https://1019538157.github.io/MagicGarment/.

</details>


### [557] [Adaptive Observation Control for Active Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19624)
*Li, Dikai,Wang, Weijia,Wang, Yuan-Gen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将固定步数的 AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S 主动视觉识别器扩展为可控观察接口：每步预测视场尺度，结合尺度门控中央凹化与残差高分辨细节 token 分支，并用标签监督的停止头实现输入自适应早停，从而在同一权重下实现阈值控制的精度-算力权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉识别模型在固定视场与固定计算预算下处理图像，而图像往往需要不同尺度与不同数量的空间证据。现有 AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S 主动视觉流水线虽能选择信息量大的注视点，但视场大小与观察步数仍固定，无法按输入自适应调整计算量，也无法在不重新训练的情况下调节精度-算力折中。

Method: 在固定步数识别器上增加可控观察接口：（1）每次注视预测一个尺度，用以设定该步视场；（2）对被选裁剪区域用可选的尺度门控中央凹化与残差高分辨细节 token 分支进行精化；（3）用标签监督的停止头实现输入相关的早停。同一 checkpoint 支持阈值控制的自适应推理。

Result: 在细粒度基准、完整 ImageNet-1K 及 ImageNet-A/R 派生分类划分上，该接口与固定步数基线保持竞争力，同时暴露可控观察预算。在序列式 ImageNet-1K 上，学习到的停止规则优于同一 checkpoint 的固定步数截断：平均使用 4 步中的 2.45 步即达 81.9% top-1，且以更低代价超过三步截断。各基准上，结合尺度控制与细节 token 融合的变体在测试的各类非早停组件叠加变体中精度最高。

Conclusion: 固定视场与固定步数的主动视觉识别可通过可学习的尺度预测与停止头实现输入自适应的计算分配，单次训练即支持多阈值精度-算力折中，且不损失相对固定步数基线的竞争力；尺度控制与细节 token 融合是两个有效的增益组件。

Abstract: Visual recognition models usually process a fixed view under a fixed computation budget, although images often benefit from different scales and amounts of spatial evidence. Active vision can adapt by observing a coarse scene and then selecting informative fixations, but the public AdaptiveNN-DeiT-S pipeline still fixes both field of view and observation count. We extend this fixed-step recognizer with a controllable observation interface that adapts both the field of view and the number of fixations to the input. Specifically, the model predicts a per-fixation scale that sets its field of view, refines each selected crop with optional scale-gated foveation and a residual high-resolution detail-token branch, and uses label-grounded stop heads for input-dependent early termination. Experiments across fine-grained benchmarks, full ImageNet-1K, and ImageNet-A/R-derived classification splits show that the interface remains competitive with fixed-step references while exposing a controllable observation budget. The same checkpoint enables threshold-controlled accuracy-compute trade-offs without per-threshold retraining. On sequential ImageNet-1K, the learned stop rule outperforms fixed-step truncation of the same checkpoint, sustaining 81.9% top-1 using 2.45 of the four focus steps and exceeding three-step truncation at lower cost. On each benchmark, a variant combining scale control and detail-token fusion achieves the highest accuracy among the tested component-added non-exit variants. Our code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/LI-Dikai.

</details>


### [558] [Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19628)
*Zhang, Zeyang,Gao, Linxiang,Gu, Meiqi,Chen, Xingyan,Luo, Minrui,Lyu, Kaifeng,He, Tianxing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 从电路复杂度视角证明：vanilla flow matching 的多步采样轨迹可被常数轮并行模型评估模拟，故增加采样步数不提升常数深度骨干的表达力；自条件（self-conditioning）可突破该瓶颈，使常数深度模型达到空间有界图灵机的表达力，并在视觉推理任务上验证了更高精度与更深推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "通过图像生成做视觉推理"这一范式直觉上认为迭代采样器（如 flow matching）的每一采样步对应一步推理，因此步数越多推理越深。作者要检验这一直觉是否成立，并寻找让额外采样步真正转化为更深推理的机制。

Method: 理论侧：在电路复杂度框架下，对满足温和正则性条件的模型输出，构造模拟证明 vanilla flow-matching 采样轨迹可由常数轮并行模型评估复现，从而在标准 transformer 复杂度模型下与常数深度骨干等价；进一步证明加入 self-conditioning 后，常数深度骨干可达空间有界图灵机的表达力。实验侧：在多种视觉推理任务上做受控对比（vanilla vs. self-conditioning），并变化采样步数观察精度与推理深度。

Result: 理论：vanilla flow matching 的额外采样步不增加常数深度骨干的表达力上限；self-conditioning 消除该瓶颈并给出空间有界图灵机级表达力上界。实验：带 self-conditioning 的 flow matching 在多个视觉推理任务上精度更高、推理深度更深，且性能随采样步数增加而提升。

Conclusion: 提出视觉推理的设计原则：在采样步之间携带更多信息（如自条件），使额外采样步转化为更深推理；这为未来视觉推理与生成式推理模型设计提供了复杂度理论依据。

Abstract: Recent work has explored visual reasoning through image generation, where models solve visual-reasoning problems by directly generating solution images. Intuitively, iterative samplers such as flow matching are well suited to this task, since each sampling step may resemble one reasoning step. However, in this work, from a circuit complexity perspective, we show that this intuition is misleading. We prove that as long as the model outputs satisfy certain mild regularity conditions, the trajectory of the vanilla flow-matching sampler can be simulated by a constant number of sequential rounds of parallel model evaluations. Consequently, additional sampling steps cannot increase the expressive power of a constant-depth backbone model under the standard complexity-theoretic model of transformers. We then reveal that self-conditioning, which conditions the model on the previous step's estimate of the final image, plays a previously unrecognized role in removing this bottleneck. Controlled experiments on diverse visual-reasoning tasks show that flow matching with self-conditioning achieves higher accuracy and greater reasoning depth than vanilla flow matching, and its performance improves with more sampling steps. Theoretically, we prove that with self-conditioning, a constant-depth backbone can achieve expressive power equivalent to that of space-bounded Turing machines. Our study suggests a design principle for future visual reasoning research: carry more information between sampling steps, so that additional steps translate into deeper reasoning.

</details>


### [559] [Mapping Arctic Polynyas from Sea Ice Concentration Data Using Hierarchical Partitioning and Differentiated Region Growing: Sensitivity to Threshold and Product Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19647)
*Zhang, Tianyu,Ren, Haiyi,Zhang, Zhilun,Hong, Yang,Mi, Chunlei,Cheng, Xiao,Hui, Fengming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于层次划分、连通域分析与差异化区域生长的北极海冰密集度制图框架，用于提取沿岸冰间湖与开阔水域；2002/03–2024/25年9–5月冰季平均总体精度96.74%、kappa 0.93，但绝对范围强烈依赖阈值与产品配置，长期监测需固定并明确记录SIC产品、阈值与分类规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 北极沿岸冰间湖在复杂海岸几何与空间异质冰情下难以准确从海冰密集度数据中界定，且不同阈值/产品的定义差异使结果可比性差，因此需要一个可复现的制图框架并量化配置敏感性。

Method: 构建日尺度海冰密集度制图框架：层次划分 + 连通域分析 + 差异化区域生长，分别处理冰间湖与开阔水域区域；用63景目视评估验证精度，并开展SIC阈值（75%/80%/85%/90%）敏感性实验，以及6.25/12.5/25 km产品间MAPE对比。

Result: 平均总体精度96.74%、kappa 0.93；相对75%阈值，季节范围积分在80%/85%/90%阈值下分别相差13.48%/32.47%/65.04%，但年际结构仍可辨识；阈值敏感性区域与季节差异显著（中央北冰洋最强、圣劳伦斯湾最弱、1月起曲线分离加大）；80%阈值下产品对比MAPE为68.19%（6.25 vs 25 km）与11.47%（12.5 vs 25 km）。

Conclusion: 绝对冰间湖范围高度依赖SIC产品、阈值与分类规则配置，而主要时间变化特征较稳健；可复现的长期冰间湖监测须固定并显式记录产品-阈值-分类规则组合，绝对范围差异大时宽泛时间模式仍具信息量。

Abstract: Accurately delineating Arctic coastal polynyas from sea ice concentration data remains challenging because of complex coastal geometry and spatially heterogeneous ice conditions. We develop a daily sea ice concentration (SIC) mapping framework based on hierarchical partitioning, connected-component analysis, and differentiated region growing for polynya and open-water regions. Applied to September-May ice seasons from 2002/03 to 2024/25, the framework achieves a mean overall accuracy of 96.74% and a mean kappa coefficient of 0.93 in the 63-scene visual assessment. Sensitivity experiments reveal a consistent pattern: the absolute magnitude of SIC-defined polynya extent is strongly configuration-dependent, whereas major temporal features are comparatively more stable. Relative to a 75% upper SIC threshold, seasonal extent integrals differ by 13.48%, 32.47%, and 65.04% at thresholds of 80%, 85%, and 90%, respectively, while the broad interannual structure remains recognizable. The response is also strongly regional and seasonal, with the largest threshold sensitivity in the Central Arctic Ocean, very weak sensitivity in the Gulf of St. Lawrence, and greater pan-Arctic curve separation from January onward. At an 80% threshold, product-comparison MAPE is 68.19% between the 6.25 and 25 km products and 11.47% between the 12.5 and 25 km products under their respective comparison periods and reference definitions. Regional product disagreement is likewise heterogeneous. Together, these results show that reproducible long-term polynya monitoring requires a fixed and explicitly documented combination of SIC product, threshold, and spatial classification rules, while broad temporal patterns can remain informative even when absolute extent differs substantially.

</details>


### [560] [SPECTRA-VLA: Base-Fine Hyperspectral Token Transfer at Frozen Vision-Language-Action Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19651)
*Hsu, Chih-Chung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPECTRA-VLA通过“自token连续残差+归一化伪彩色参考”在不重训冻结视觉编码器与动作解码器的情况下，将高光谱能力原生注入预训练VLA，类别均衡准确率由0.812升至0.883。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB难以区分光谱相似物体，而高光谱可提供判别信息；但把高光谱接入冻结的VLA时，解码器需要一种与预训练接口兼容的状态表示，直接在外部替换/池化会破坏接收token的语义完整性。

Method: 在原生宽度上做光谱升级：为每个目标token学习连续残差，以自身归一化伪彩色参考进行增强；通过投影、范数控制与验证集校准的注入强度调节残差幅度；对比“自token相加”与“池化替换”两种注入方式，并用类别匹配光谱互换检验token组成的作用。

Result: 86次留出采集上类别均衡准确率0.812→0.883；相同残差与尺度下，自token相加在冻结解码器logits上复用外部类别探针为0.701 vs 池化替换0.590，且图像不重叠识别性能相当；5组分组测试在连续与后验码状态下恢复类内光谱形状R²=0.802/0.337；类别匹配光谱互换显示自token组成使目标特定恢复增量约翻倍。

Conclusion: 光谱增强与接收token保持需在预训练接口处协同，自token注入优于池化替换，可在冻结编码器-解码器条件下有效复用外部判别信息。

Abstract: Hyperspectral imaging distinguishes RGB-similar objects, but a pretrained vision-language-action model needs a state its frozen decoder can use. SPECTRA-VLA provides a native-width spectral upgrade without retraining the visual encoder or action decoder. A learned continuous residual enriches each target token through its own normalized false-color reference; projection, norm control and validation-calibrated injection regulate the change. Across 86 held-out acquisitions, category balanced accuracy rises from 0.812 to 0.883. With identical residuals and scale, own-token addition improves reuse of an external category-derived probe on frozen decoder logits: 0.701 versus 0.590 with pooled replacement, at similar image-disjoint recognition. Five grouped tests covering the same 86 acquisitions recover within-category spectral shape with $R^2=0.802/0.337$ from continuous and posterior-code states. Category-matched spectral swaps further show that own-token composition approximately doubles the target-specific recovery increment after frozen decoding. Spectral enrichment and receiving-token preservation thus work together at the pretrained interface.

</details>


### [561] [Remember, Revisit, Revise: Scaffold Memory for Long-Horizon 3D Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19674)
*Sarker, Soumick,Zhang, Mengmi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SMORE 为冻结的几何基础模型配备可修订的外部记忆，通过“位置-观测”关联存储并校验历史信息，缓解长序列位姿与重建误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时序几何重建存在两难：前馈模型按固定长度窗口独立处理并拼接，误差跨窗口累积；流式模型虽保留历史信息，却无法在后续观测揭示错误时回改早期估计。作者希望赋予预训练几何模型可迭代纠错的长程推理能力。

Method: 受海马体联想记忆启发，提出 SMORE：在冻结的几何基础模型外挂可修订记忆。将观察者的“所在位置”与“所观察内容”关联，使过去观测可被存储、检索，并用新证据验证；检测到不一致时触发修订。框架不重训骨干，作为通用接口接入多种几何模型。

Result: 在 8 个几何模型、5 个数据集上评估，覆盖位姿估计、多视图深度、点云重建、SLAM 与新视角合成。一致改善长序列位姿；多视图深度误差最多降低 58%；点云 Chamfer 距离最多降低 43%；长时序 SLAM 平均轨迹误差低至 2.9 cm。保留修正后的位姿与观测还提升大规模场景重建的保真度与空间一致性。

Conclusion: 可修订外部记忆可作为灵活接口，把预训练几何模型从固定上下文预测扩展到长视觉序列上的迭代式纠错推理，为长时序几何基础模型提供通用增强范式。

Abstract: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.

</details>


### [562] [MicroSDF: Microfacet-Driven Hybrid Neural SDFs for Mixed-Reflectance Surface Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19681)
*Ye, Lejia,Xu, Yuhua,Guo, Yulan,Xu, Lian,Zhang, Xiaohu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MicroSDF：基于微表面理论的神经隐式框架，用微表面引导几何+双分支颜色+检测引导混合，统一重建反射与非反射表面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中反射与非反射表面共存，二者建模需求不同；现有方法分开处理，泛化性与物理合理性受限。

Method: 三项创新：(i) 微表面引导几何模型，从SDF提取宏观与微表面多尺度法线，并用微表面法线一致性损失正则；(ii) 增强双分支颜色模型，镜面分支用微表面法线建模高频反射，基分支用反射方向（非观察方向）建模漫反射与低频镜面；(iii) 检测引导颜色混合策略，基于反射先验自适应融合；配合多阶段优化。

Result: 在DTU、Shiny Blender、Ref-NeRF、DeepVoxels数据集上取得SOTA，反射与非反射表面均实现高保真重建。

Conclusion: 为物理可解释的神经重建开辟新方向，兼顾几何与反射率建模，提升泛化性与物理合理性。

Abstract: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.

</details>


### [563] [SceneAE: Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Queryable 3D-Anchored Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19708)
*Sun, Shuofeng,Zheng, Wenzhao,Zhang, Yunpeng,Wu, Yi,Zhao, Linqing,Yan, Haibin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SceneAE，将场景表示为非结构化的 3D 锚定隐空间（显式 3D 位置 + 隐式内容特征），同时支持重建与生成，并解耦相机与外观。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型已用 3D 记忆整合历史观测，作者追问：若 3D 表示能有效记忆场景，能否直接作为重建与生成的隐空间，从而摆脱逐相机轨迹重新生成视频的范式。

Method: 将场景编码为稀疏的 3D 锚定潜点云，每个潜点由显式 3D 位置与隐式内容特征组成，并在空间上绑定局部区域。重建时从持久 3D 表示投影解码为任意目标相机的 RGB-D 观测；生成时先由几何-内容分离生成相机可控的 3D 几何，再以几何为条件合成内容。

Result: 摘要报告该方法在生成质量、计算开销与相机可控性上均取得更优表现，但未给出量化指标与数据集细节。

Conclusion: 以 3D 锚定潜空间统一重建与生成，可减少相机-外观纠缠、提升相机可控性，并为持久 3D 场景表示提供新范式。

Abstract: Recent video world models have increasingly adopted 3D memory mechanisms to integrate historical observations into a lightweight and persistent scene representation. This naturally raises a complementary question: if 3D representations can serve as an effective mechanism for memorizing observed scenes, can they also be directly used as the latent space for reconstructing and generating scenes? Motivated by this idea, we represent a scene as a compact and unstructured 3D-anchored latent space (\textbf{SceneAE}). Each latent combines an explicit 3D position with an implicit content feature and is spatially grounded to describe its local scene region, forming a sparse latent point cloud. Unlike conventional video-VAE latents that describe how a scene appears from particular viewpoints, our representation directly describes the scene itself, making it naturally applicable to both reconstruction and generation. For reconstruction, once the scene has been generated, our persistent 3D representation can be projected and decoded into RGB-D observations by different target cameras, without the need to regenerate a video for each new camera trajectory. For generation, we leverage the geometry-content separation to first generate camera-controlled 3D geometry and then synthesize content conditioned on it, reducing camera-appearance entanglement and improving camera controllability. Experiments show that this 3D latent achieves superior generation quality, computational cost, and camera controllability.

</details>


### [564] [No Way To Steal My Face: Proactive Defense Against Identity-Preserving Personalized Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19717)
*Xiong, Lizhi,Li, Jun,Li, Ziqiang,Jiang, Weiwei,Fu, Zhangjie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IDGuardian：首个通用、模型无关的个性化图像生成身份保护框架，通过对抗扰动同时破坏身份提取与身份注入两阶段，兼顾训练式与免训练式个性化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型个性化（数字头像、虚拟试衣）依赖敏感人脸参考图，存在隐私风险；现有防御主要针对训练式个性化，无法泛化到免训练方法，因二者身份集成范式根本不同。

Method: 将个性化流程抽象为身份提取与身份注入两阶段；注入定制对抗扰动，一方面退化外部编码器提取的身份特征，另一方面构建"对抗概念桥"使生成轨迹偏离目标身份。

Result: 在多条个性化流水线与模型架构上有效保护身份，且对后处理、自适应攻击和跨数据集泛化保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: 提出首个可泛化、模型无关的身份保护框架，弥合训练式与免训练个性化防御的空白，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-fidelity, identity-preserving image generation for personalized applications such as digital avatars and virtual try-on systems. However, their reliance on sensitive facial reference images raises growing privacy concerns. Existing defense mechanisms are primarily designed for training-based personalization and struggle to generalize to emerging training-free approaches, due to fundamental differences in their identity integration paradigms. To bridge this gap, we propose IDGuardian-the first generalizable and model-agnostic identity protection framework capable of defending against both training-based and training-free personalization methods. IDGuardian abstracts the personalization process into two critical stages: identity extraction and identity injection. It then introduces crafted adversarial perturbations to simultaneously disrupt both stages. Specifically, it degrades the identity features extracted by external encoders and establishes an adversarial conceptual bridge that misdirects the generative trajectory away from the target identity. Extensive experiments show that IDGuardian effectively protects identity across various personalization pipelines and model architectures, while remaining robust to post-processing, adaptive attacks, and cross-dataset generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/IDGuardian.git.

</details>


### [565] [Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19726)
*XGEN Team,Cai, Guohao,Che, Haoxuan,Fan, Frank,Huang, Chenran,Huang, Junjia,Jiang, Jiayi,Li, Yanheng,Liu, Leon,Liu, Shaoteng,Liu, Xi,Nie, Feng,Rao, Zhefan,Wang, An,Wang, Hanwen,Yan, Pengxiang,Yu, Jieming,Zha, Qian,Zheng, Wentao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"生成式世界模拟"框架,耦合持久共享世界状态(DAO可计算世界引擎)与连续第一人称视听生成(JING自我中心交互体验模型),形成"状态演化—体验生成"闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式世界/世界模型通常在每次观测时重新生成场景,难以保留历史行为的后果,缺乏跨观察者持久、可演进的世界状态;需要将"世界状态"与"体验生成"分离并闭环耦合。

Method: DAO维护角色、物体、空间及其关系的状态,按交互规则与世界时间推进并保留既往动作后果;由演化状态推导出观察者特定条件,与角色/物体/场景引用、观测历史、当前动作共同输入JING,生成该观察者的视听体验;用户通过视角控制与文本指令探索、操作物体和与角色交流。

Result: 摘要为框架性描述,未给出定量实验结果、评测基准或真实部署证据;仅说明动作会同时改变共享状态与后续体验,并支持持续交互。

Conclusion: 通过将世界状态演化与体验生成置于持续交互循环中,为构建"保留历史、随行动演化、超越单个观察者而持续存在"的交互式世界提供了一种思路,属于世界模型/生成式模拟的方向性工作。

Abstract: We present a Generative World Simulation framework that couples persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation. The framework integrates DAO, a computable world engine, and JING, an Egocentric Interactive Experience Model, to support sustained interaction for humans and agents. DAO maintains the states of characters, objects, and spaces and their relationships, advancing the world according to interaction rules and world time while preserving the consequences of past actions. From this evolving state, DAO derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which combines these conditions with character, object, and scene references, observation history, and current actions to generate each observer's audiovisual experience. Users can explore environments, manipulate objects, and communicate with characters through viewpoint control and text instructions, with their actions shaping both the shared state and subsequent experiences. By connecting world-state evolution with experience generation in a continuous interaction loop, the framework offers an approach to building interactive worlds that retain their history, evolve through action, and persist beyond any individual observer.

</details>


### [566] [Mitigating Video Hallucinations via Attention-Guided Representation Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19728)
*Cai, Zhixin,Yuan, Ruoqi,Yang, Xinchen,Chen, Zhuofan,Bai, Jun,Yin, Chuantao,Rong, Wenge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架ARP-CD，在表示空间用注意力引导扰动构造对比负样本，以缓解Video LLM幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Video LLM常生成视频不支持的内容；现有对比解码依赖预定义扰动或问题重构掩码，对答案生成中模型的视觉依赖控制有限。

Method: 利用答案预测位置对视觉token的注意力质量，引导对LLM输入视觉隐状态做有界梯度更新，降低视觉注意力生成负样本输入；生成过程中将负分支预测与原分支对比，实现对比解码。

Result: 在4个Video LLM与4个基准上，多数模型-基准组合优于代表性免训练基线，减少幻觉并提升通用视频理解；分析表明注意力引导扰动方向提升负样本质量，生成的负样本可有效校正原始预测。

Conclusion: 注意力引导的表示扰动为Video LLM对比解码提供更可控的负样本构造，免训练即可缓解幻觉。

Abstract: Video large language models (Video LLMs) often generate responses unsupported by the input video. Contrastive decoding (CD) can mitigate these hallucinations, but its effectiveness depends on how the negative branch weakens visual evidence. Existing methods rely on predefined perturbations or masking guided by question reconstruction, offering limited control over the model's visual reliance during answer generation. We introduce Attention-guided Representation Perturbation for Contrastive Decoding (ARP-CD), a training-free framework for constructing contrastive negatives directly in representation space. ARP-CD uses the attention mass assigned to visual tokens at the answer-prediction position to guide bounded gradient updates of the language model's input visual hidden states. These updates reduce visual attention and produce a negative input, whose predictions are contrasted with those of the original branch throughout generation. Experiments across four Video LLMs and four benchmarks show that ARP-CD outperforms representative training-free baselines in most model--benchmark settings, reducing hallucinations while improving general video understanding. Further analyses show that attention-guided perturbation directions improve negative quality and that the resulting negatives provide effective contrastive references for correcting the original predictions.

</details>


### [567] [A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19729)
*Chien, Hao-Jen,Chao, Wei-Lun,Liu, Yu-Lun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出K-Pop压力测试（快速大范围相机运动的广播舞蹈视频），诊断出单目世界空间人体恢复中漂移源于相机与人体各自尺度的不匹配，给出无需重训练的闭式尺度校正，实现稳定的共享世界坐标重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目世界空间人体恢复基准几乎不含快速相机运动。在广播舞蹈这类快速、大范围相机运动叠加密集多人编舞的场景中，主流方法逐帧网格看似合理，但世界空间轨迹会严重偏离表演者真实舞台位置，限制了编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成与虚拟重拍等下游应用。

Method: 首先构建K-Pop压力测试数据（广播舞蹈视频）进行系统性诊断：验证相机估计与人体估计各自自洽，漂移出现在二者以不一致尺度融合之时——相机位移被误转为随位移增长的人体漂移。随后推导闭式校正，估计该尺度不一致量，并对所有表演者施加统一尺度，从而在消除漂移的同时保持其相对位置于同一共享世界坐标系；方法无需重训练，可即插即用于现有后端。

Result: 诊断表明相机与人体估计分别自洽、错在跨尺度融合；闭式尺度校正可有效去除随相机位移增长的漂移。结合物理约束后，方法在快速相机运动舞蹈视频上产出稳定的世界空间重建，并支持编舞建模、场景编辑、数据生成与虚拟重拍等应用；兼容现有后端且无需重训练。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了快速相机运动下世界空间人体恢复的尺度不一致失效模式，并提供简单、通用、免训练的闭式修正，为野外人体的世界坐标重建与视频到3D/4D动态场景重建提供了实用且可复用的洞察。

Abstract: Monocular world-space human recovery methods excel on current benchmarks, but these rarely include fast camera motion. We introduce the K-Pop stress test, broadcast dance videos that combine fast, large camera motion with dense multi-person choreography. Leading methods produce plausible per-frame meshes on these videos, yet their world-space trajectories drift far from the performers' stage positions. Through a systematic diagnosis, we show that the camera and human estimates each remain self-consistent, and that the drift appears when they are combined at mismatched scales. Each is recovered at its own scale, so a mismatch between the two can turn camera motion into human drift that grows with camera displacement and becomes severe in broadcast dance videos. We derive a closed-form correction that estimates this mismatch and applies one scale to all performers, removing the drift while keeping their relative positions in one shared world frame. It requires no retraining and works with existing backends. Combined with physical constraints, the correction yields stable world-space reconstruction for choreography modeling, scene editing, data generation, and virtual reshooting. Project page: https://chien90190.github.io/worldhmr-fastcam-website/

</details>


### [568] [Object Pose from 2-D to 3-D Point and Line Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19734)
*Phong, Thai Quynh,Horaud, Radu,Yassine, Adnan,Tao, Pham Dinh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用对偶四元数表示旋转和平移，构造二次误差函数，并用信赖域法最小化，实现相机与三维物体间的位姿估计，在噪声与误匹配下鲁棒性优于牛顿法、Faugeras-Toscani线性法与Levenberg-Marquardt法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从点/线对应关系估计相机与三维物体间的旋转和平移是摄影测量、手眼标定和视觉伺服的基础问题。已有方法（牛顿法、Faugeras-Toscani线性标定法、Levenberg-Marquardt）在噪声与误匹配下鲁棒性不足，且旋转与平移的耦合导致误差函数非线性强、优化困难。

Method: 采用对偶四元数（dual number quaternion）统一表示旋转与平移，使误差函数具有二次形式；在二次模型上设计信赖域（trust-region）优化方法，并详细给出其计算细节（步长求解、子问题近似、收敛判据）。

Result: 与牛顿法、Faugeras-Toscani线性标定法及Levenberg-Marquardt非线性优化相比，所提出的信赖域方法表现更优；实验表明该方法对图像噪声和匹配错误具有较强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 对偶四元数加信赖域优化可有效、鲁棒地求解点/线对应的相机-物体位姿估计问题，是该经典问题的一种实用改进方案。

Abstract: In this paper we present a method for optimally estimating the rotation and translation between a camera and a 3-D object from point and/or line correspondences. First we devise an error function and second we show how to minimize this error function. The quadratic nature of this function is made possible by representing rotation and translation with a dual number quaternion. We provide a detailed account of the computational aspects of a trust-region optimization method. This method compares favourably with Newton's method which has extensively been used to solve the problem at hand, with Faugeras-Toscani linear method [6] for calibrating a camera, and with the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear optimization method. Finally we present some experimental results which demonstrate the robustness of our method with respect to image noise and matching errors.

</details>


### [569] [HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19742)
*Bhalla, Annie,Rotondi, Dennis,Giubilato, Riccardo,Arras, Kai O.,Stuerzl, Wolfgang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 HyperLoop，首个将高光谱成像（HSI）引入 3DGS-SLAM 回环检测模块的框架，用光谱描述子（BoSW、PCAK-VLAD）补足 RGB 在视觉重复环境下的退化问题，并在 DLR 月球-火星模拟场地数据上评估，发现 600–860 nm 红-近红外波段对岩石地形区分力有限，最佳融合与纯 SIFT-VLAD 相差仅 1.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行星漫游车自主导航面临视觉高度重复、无纹理地形的挑战；基于 3DGS 的 SLAM 虽能稠密建图，但依赖 RGB 外观描述子，在感知混叠下会失效——这是地外环境中物理上不同位置外观相同的常见失败模式。因此需要引入材质级、对光照变化鲁棒的模态来增强回环检测。

Method: 将 HSI 集成进 3DGS-SLAM 的回环检测模块：提出两类光谱描述子——BoSW（用 TF-IDF 加权直方图编码光谱材质分布）和 PCAK-VLAD（对 PCA 压缩后的光谱签名提取一阶残差统计）；与 SIFT-VLAD、NetVLAD 两种 RGB 描述子在 Strict-AND 与 Weighted 两种融合策略下组合；在 DLR 的 MMOTS 月球-火星户外测试场自建数据集上评估，含同步 RGB-D 与高光谱序列、四段行星类比行进路线（共 65.5 m）。

Result: 核心发现是传感器 600–860 nm 红-近红外波段对岩石地形的可区分性有限：最佳 HSI 融合（SIFT-VLAD + BoSW，Strict-AND）达到 5.04 cm ATE RMSE，与单用 SIFT-VLAD（4.95 cm）仅差 1.8%；相对 NetVLAD（8.81 cm）的增益实际来自 SIFT-VLAD 而非 HSI 融合。

Conclusion: 当前红-近红外高光谱波段难以在岩石地形上提供有效的回环判别增益，未来行星 SLAM 任务应改用能捕获诊断性矿物吸收特征的短波红外（SWIR）传感器。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.

</details>


### [570] [Discriminative Score Function: Turning Pretrained Models into Functional Generative Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19743)
*Lee, Junhoo,Kim, Hyeonjin,Han, Sangbum,Kwak, Nojun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场（DSF），无需训练即可实现无条件生成、条件引导、编辑、修复与解释，并可用于零样本量化校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判别模型仅以分类、检测、表征学习等任务目标训练，但其实际效用依赖对同域未见样本的泛化，暗示模型内部隐式保留了数据流形的痕迹；作者希望在不依赖任务特定监督的条件下，将这一痕迹显式暴露为生成信号。

Method: 提出 Discriminative Score Function（DSF）：从预训练判别模型的损失梯度几何中抽取图像空间生成场，给出免训练（training-free）的更新规则，将图像推向模型一致的视觉区域，无需重训练或任务特定目标；在 ResNet 分类器、DETR 检测器、DINOv2 ViT 编码器等多类模型上应用。

Result: DSF 可从噪声生成无条件图像，并支持条件引导、编辑、修复和解释；DSF 生成样本在缺少真实图像或标签时可作为有效的零样本量化校准数据，特征几何保持优于无数据校准基线。

Conclusion: 判别式训练会留下可用于合成与校准的生成性功能信号，判别模型不仅是判别器，也可作为免训练的生成与校准信号源。

Abstract: Discriminative models are trained with task-specific objectives such as classification, detection, or representation learning, yet their practical utility depends on generalizing beyond the training task to unseen samples from the same domain. This suggests that a discriminative model may retain an implicit trace of the data manifold beyond its task labels. We ask whether this trace can be exposed as a generative signal without task-specific guidance. We introduce the Discriminative Score Function (DSF), which extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of a pretrained discriminative model. DSF provides a training-free update rule that moves images toward model-consistent visual regions without retraining or task-specific targets. We apply DSF to diverse pretrained discriminative models, including ResNet classifiers, DETR detectors, and DINOv2 ViT encoders. DSF generates unconditional images from noise and supports conditional guidance, editing, inpainting, and explanation through the same field. DSF-generated samples also provide effective zero-shot quantization calibration when real images or labels are unavailable, preserving feature geometry better than data-free calibration baselines. These results show that discriminative training leaves a generative functional signal for synthesis and calibration. Project page: https://junhoo.me/dsf.

</details>


### [571] [Physics-Shaped, Not Physical: Auditing Physics-Guided Underwater Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19763)
*Fauzan, Mochamad Rizal,Surya, Irgi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过四个受控实验审计了代表性物理引导水下图像恢复网络（PhysGuide-Net），发现其物理模块在零样本泛化上并无增益，预测的透射图也不具备物理量性质，因此收益来自"物理形状的归纳偏置"而非真正物理约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理引导网络普遍基于图像形成模型预测透射与后向散射并反演成像过程，但很少有工作检验"物理"本身是否真正发挥作用。作者希望审计这一设计范式，判断性能提升究竟源于物理建模还是仅源于网络结构的归纳偏置。

Method: 对PhysGuide-Net进行四项受控实验：(1) 在UIEB上做五随机种子消融，并在完整LSUI（4279对）与AUIED3K（3000对）上零样本评测；(2) 数据效率研究，加入容量匹配但去除形成模型的对照；(3) 在Sea-thru上验证预测映射与实测距离的一致性；(4) 分析透射图与距离的相关性及Beer-Lambert拟合优度，并检验模块效果随退化程度变化的符号。

Result: 使用全部800张训练图时，物理模块无零样本增益（PSNR平均差异不超过0.16 dB，95%置信区间均含零），但FLOPs增加3.4倍；仅用80张图时增益较明显（UIEB +0.65 dB，AUIED3K +1.48 dB，AUIED3K种子间标准差由1.3降至0.5 dB），但校正后个体并不显著，且容量匹配对照无法复现（低0.8–1.0 dB）。预测透射图与距离的相关性不强于"另一张图的距离图"（合并差+0.02，暗通道先验为−0.06），Beer-Lambert拟合仅解释其方差的0.4%；模块效果在数据集间随退化程度变号。此外还发现单次运行消融可导致符号反转，并记录使损失消融失效的实现缺陷。

Conclusion: 物理引导模块的收益本质上是"物理形状的归纳偏置"带来的，而非真实物理约束在起作用；论文强调需要多随机种子评测并警惕实现缺陷，对物理引导图像恢复类工作的方法论提出质疑。

Abstract: Physics-guided networks for underwater image restoration predict transmission and backscatter and invert the image-formation model, yet rarely test whether this physics does any work. We audit one representative design, PhysGuide-Net, with four controlled experiments: five-seed ablations on UIEB with zero-shot evaluation on the complete LSUI (4279 pairs) and AUIED3K (3000 pairs) sets; a data-efficiency study with a capacity-matched control that removes the formation model; and a validation of the predicted maps against measured range on Sea-thru. With all 800 training images the physics module gives no zero-shot gain (mean PSNR differences of at most 0.16 dB; all 95% intervals include zero) at 3.4x the FLOPs. With 80 images it helps more (+0.65 dB on UIEB, +1.48 dB on AUIED3K; seed-to-seed s.d. on AUIED3K from 1.3 to 0.5 dB), although not individually significant after correction, and the control does not reproduce this (0.8-1.0 dB lower). Yet the predicted transmission does not behave like a physical quantity: its correlation with range is no stronger than for the range map of a different image (pooled difference +0.02, versus -0.06 for the dark-channel prior), and a Beer-Lambert fit explains 0.4% of its variance. The effect of the module also changes sign with degradation severity between datasets. The benefit thus comes from a physics-shaped inductive bias, not from physics. We further show that single-run ablations can reverse sign and document implementation defects that invalidate loss ablations.

</details>


### [572] [Q-MAGIC: Quad-only Mesh Autoregressive Generation via Singularity-Aware Circular Relative Offset Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19777)
*Zhao, Yuming,Li, Zezeng,Wang, Weimin,Wu, Xiang,Lei, Na*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Q-MAGIC：面向纯四边形网格生成的自回归模型，提出奇点感知序列化与环形相对偏移token化，压缩序列长度并提升几何保真度与网格质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型已在三角网格生成中将不可微的连通性预测转化为序列token预测，但四边形网格拓扑约束更严格：需将四边形面序列化为合法token序列，并在反序列化时无歧义重建连通性，现有方法难以满足。

Method: 1）设计适配四边形网格的序列化方案：下一个面至少需要两个新顶点，受严格布线约束、灵活性低于三角形；2）奇点感知序列化：优先从奇异点出发布线，获得更连贯的遍历并缩短序列；3）环形相对偏移token化：主要用局部相对偏移编码几何；4）基于该表示，用自回归Transformer通过下一token预测学习四边形网格分布。

Result: 大量实验表明，Q-MAGIC相比现有最先进方法能生成更紧凑的序列，并持续提升几何保真度与网格质量。

Conclusion: 面向四边形网格的序列化与token化设计可有效支撑自回归生成，兼顾序列紧凑性与网格质量，为纯四边形网格生成提供可行路径。

Abstract: Autoregressive models have proven effective for triangular mesh generation by transforming it into predicting the next face, converting the non-differentiable connectivity prediction into a sequence of token predictions. However, generating quad-only meshes remains challenging because quad faces impose stricter topological constraints than triangles. The model must not only serialize quad faces into a valid token sequence, but also support unambiguous connectivity reconstruction during de-serialization. To address this, we propose Q-MAGIC, a novel autoregressive model for quad mesh generation. We first introduce a tailored serialization scheme for quad meshes, which requires at least two new vertices for the next face and is less flexible than triangles due to strict wiring constraints. To meet these requirements and reduce serialization length, we propose a singularity-aware serialization that prioritizes wiring from singular points, leading to more coherent traversals. Additionally, we propose a circular relative offset tokenization that encodes geometry mainly via local relative offsets. Built upon this representation, an autoregressive Transformer learns the underlying distribution of quad meshes via next-token prediction, enabling effective quad mesh generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-MAGIC produces more compact sequences while consistently improving geometric fidelity and mesh quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [573] [FPV-CRASH: A Dataset for Offline Crash Moment Localization in Drone First-Person-View Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19785)
*Zhang, Jifan,Wang, Tingyu,Liu, Qian,Zheng, Zhedong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FPV-CRASH 数据集与固定协议基准，用于无人机 FPV 视频中的坠落时刻（撞击瞬间）时序定位；含 1052 段片段、单帧参考标注与自动生成字幕，并提供热力图式参考模型，在非源分离的片段级协议下将 MAE 从 1.12s 降至 0.56s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有坠落视频数据集多面向监控或行车记录仪，标注方案与任务定义并非为无人机机载 FPV 视频中"主要物理撞击瞬间"的时序定位而设计，缺少可复现的评测协议与参考基线，导致回顾性坠机分析缺乏统一基准。

Method: 构建 FPV-CRASH：1052 段无人机 FPV 片段（526 坠机 / 526 正常），坠机片段给出单帧坠落时刻标注，每段配 4 条由采样帧与已知标签自动生成的英文描述；正常片段无时间戳目标，仅作训练期背景监督。字幕支持辅助性文本-视频检索任务，而定位推理仅用视频。提出基于热力图的参考模型，从稀疏采样帧回归连续坠落时刻。

Result: 在固定、非源分离的片段级协议下，参考模型 MAE 由最强固定时间先验基线的 1.12s 降至 0.56s（相对降低 50%），MedAE 0.33s；0.5s 内定位比例由 37.14% 提升至 65.71%。发布内容含标注、可获取的源视频标识与 URL、切片元数据、固定划分列表与预处理代码。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了无人机 FPV 视频坠落时刻定位的数据集与评测空白，提供了可重建的公开基准与有效参考模型；但采用非源分离的片段级划分，且未验证跨源泛化，实际部署价值有限。

Abstract: Crash Moment Localization aims to localize the major physical impact that interrupts controlled flight in an onboard first-person-view (FPV) video recorded by a drone, thereby providing a temporal reference for retrospective crash analysis in aerial robotics. However, existing crash-video datasets predominantly target surveillance or dash-camera footage, and their annotation schemes and task formulations are not designed for temporal localization of the major physical impact in UAV onboard FPV videos. To address this gap, we present FPV-CRASH, a dataset and fixed-protocol reference evaluation for offline Crash Moment Localization in drone FPV videos. FPV-CRASH contains 1,052 drone FPV clips (526 Crash and 526 Normal); each Crash clip has a single-frame reference annotation for the Crash Moment, and every clip is paired with four English captions automatically generated from sampled frames and the known Crash/Normal label. Normal clips carry no timestamp target and provide training-time background supervision. The captions support an auxiliary Text-to-Video Retrieval task, whereas localization inference remains video-only. We further provide a heatmap-based reference model that estimates a continuous Crash Moment timestamp from sparsely sampled frames. Under the fixed, non-source-disjoint clip-level protocol, the reference model reduces MAE from 1.12 s for the strongest fixed timing-prior baseline to 0.56 s (a 50% relative reduction) and achieves a median absolute error (MedAE) of 0.33 s; the fraction of clips localized within 0.5 s rises from 37.14% to 65.71%. The release includes annotations, available source video identifiers and URLs, clipping metadata, fixed split lists, and preprocessing code so that the reportable portion can be reconstructed without redistributing source footage. At submission time, all source-compilation URLs remained accessible.

</details>


### [574] [LiFi: LiDAR Generation from Multi-View Images via Geometric and Semantic Collaborative Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19786)
*Zhou, Sizhuo,Jia, Xiaosong,Zhang, Fanrui,Li, Qifeng,Li, Junjie,Wang, Zirui,Feng, Yukang,Hong, Yu,Zhang, Shaofeng,Liao, Wenlong,He, Tao,Zhang, Juyong,Yan, Junchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiFi 是一个从多视角相机图像生成 LiDAR 点云的专用框架，通过几何与语义双分支引导潜扩散过程，并提出双分支平衡的无分类器引导策略，生成结果在保真度上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角图像生成 LiDAR 在可控数据合成、跨模态仿真与感知任务中有价值，但现有方法并非专为此任务设计，生成质量有限，且多只利用单目图像的语义线索，缺乏几何与语义的协同建模。

Method: LiFi 将潜扩散过程由两条互补分支引导：几何分支通过反向采样算法与不确定性感知几何编码器（结合 DepthAnything3）从图像构建场景特征；语义分支通过跨视角交互模块提供高层语义表示。此外提出双分支平衡的无分类器引导（CFG）策略，在增强条件生成能力的同时保持两分支的独立学习与协同可控性。

Result: 大量实验表明，LiFi 在生成高保真 LiDAR 场景方面优于当前最先进方法；代码将开源于 https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi。

Conclusion: LiFi 作为面向多视角图像到 LiDAR 场景的专用扩散框架，通过几何-语义双分支引导与平衡 CFG 实现了视觉与几何对齐的高质量生成，为该方向的专用化建模提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Generating LiDAR point clouds from multi-view camera images is a valuable task with applications in controllable data synthesis, cross-modal simulation and various perception tasks. However, most existing methods are not specifically designed for this task, and the quality of their generated LiDAR remains limited. Moreover, these methods typically focus only on semantic cues in images or generate LiDAR from a monocular camera image. In this work, we introduce LiFi (LiDAR From images), a dedicated framework for generating visually and geometrically aligned LiDAR scenes from multi-view camera images. LiFi guides the latent diffusion process through two complementary branches: geometry and semantics. The geometry branch constructs scene features from images through a reverse sampling algorithm and an uncertainty-aware geometric encoder combined with DepthAnything3, whereas the semantic branch provides high-level semantic representations via a cross-view interaction module. We further introduce a dual-branch balanced classifier-free guidance (CFG) strategy, which enhances the model's conditional generation capability while preserving the independent learning and collaborative controllability of the two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiFi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating high-fidelity LiDAR scenes. The code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LiFi.

</details>


### [575] [StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19795)
*Venturoli, Lorenzo,Savov, Nedko,Wang, Xi,Pollefeys, Marc,Van Gool, Luc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StateCraft：将持久可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦，用语言模型+视频扩散模型演化世界，在生成式交互界面上实现长程一致性与可编辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型需在长交互中保持一致性，必须跟踪历史动作及其对环境的影响。但模型每次只能生成世界的部分观测，仅记忆过去观测不足——经过一系列动作后，旧观测已不再反映当前世界状态。因此需要一种能持续更新、与视觉观测解耦的世界状态表示。

Method: 核心范式：解耦持久、可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态。抽象状态追踪随世界演化而变化的实体，并用于条件化表示当前视角的视觉状态。提出StateCraft架构，将语言模型与视频扩散模型配对以演化动态世界。同时构建数据采集流水线，无需人工或智能体监督即可规模化生成信息丰富、密集标注的轨迹，并提出衡量生成质量、记忆与可控性的基准。另做概念验证3D实验，动作改变未观测房间的光照。

Result: 在生成式交互界面基准上超越SOTA基线；长轨迹下保持高自一致性与强生成质量；抽象状态显式可编辑，生成能跟随数据中从未观测过的状态编辑；3D概念验证表明该范式可推广到空间环境。

Conclusion: 解耦抽象状态与视觉状态的范式有效提升了视频世界模型的长程一致性、记忆与可控性，并具备向3D空间环境迁移的潜力。

Abstract: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. We evaluate our approach on generative interfaces, which pose a substantial challenge because a single action may change parts of the state that are not currently visible. To support training and evaluation, we develop a data collection pipeline that produces informative, densely annotated trajectories at scale without human or agent supervision, together with a benchmark measuring generation quality, memory, and controllability. On this benchmark, our approach improves surpasses the state-of-the-art baselines. We demonstrate that StateCraft maintains high self-consistency and strong generation quality over long trajectories. Because the abstract state is explicit, it can be edited directly, and generation follows edits to states never observed in the data. Finally, a proof-of-concept 3D experiment, in which actions change the illumination of an unobserved room, shows that the paradigm can also be applied to spatial environments. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/StateCraft/.

</details>


### [576] [Improving Category-Aware Active Domain Adaptation via Uncertainty-Guided Region Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19803)
*Huynh, My Tra Nguyen,Ta, Viet Cuong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于区域（流形覆盖）的主动域适应样本选择策略，解决逐点选择易过拟合与敏感冗余的问题，并结合不确定性评分改善目标域决策边界，在多个域适应基准上超越现有主动域适应方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动域适应旨在于降低源域与目标域标注成本并提升无监督域适应性能，但以平均精度为优化目标会导致困难类别性能下降。逐点选择策略虽可缓解该问题，却存在敏感性与冗余性，易使采集函数过拟合。

Method: 提出基于区域的选择策略，通过最大化正流形覆盖来保证适应模型性能提升，避免逐点采样的过拟合；同时引入不确定性评分到选择机制中，以学习更优的目标域决策边界。

Result: 在多个域适应基准的综合实验中，所提方法优于首个类别感知主动域适应基线及现有主动域适应方法，并公开代码。

Conclusion: 区域级主动选择结合不确定性度量能更稳健地提升域适应效果，尤其有利于困难类别，是主动域适应中更具鲁棒性的样本采集范式。

Abstract: Active domain adaptation researches focus on alleviating the annotation cost, which comprises source data and target data labelling, as well as enhancing the performance of unsupervised domain adaptation. However, optimizing the adaptation model based on the average accuracy can lead to the drop in performance of some difficult categories. To overcome this issue, a point-wise selection strategy built upon the influence function can be used to improve domain adaptation performance. In our work, we first address the sensitive and redundant aspects of point-wise selection, which can lead to overfitting of the acquisition function. We thus introduce a region-based approach that ensures the improvement of the adaptation model by maximizing a positive manifold coverage. An uncertainty score is further introduced to the selection mechanism to learn a better decision boundary for the target domain. In comprehensive experiments, our proposed method surpasses the first category-aware active domain adaptation baseline as well as existing active domain adaptation methods across multiple domain adaptation benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://github.com/nhtm2702/WHO IS NEXT.

</details>


### [577] [PhyMetric: Diagnosing Physical Plausibility in Text-to-Video Generation via Scene-Level QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19823)
*Meng, Siwei,Cai, Xuerou,Hu, Rui,Liu, Ping*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhyMetric：将T2V物理合理性评估重构为场景级可验证的二元问答基准，含1,115场景、50物理类别、8,920个答案均衡问题，并配结构化物理先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V物理评测依赖整体合理性打分或宽泛质量维度，无法定位到底测哪种物理行为、模型为何失败。作者希望把物理合理性评估变成可解释、可归因的场景级检验。

Method: 构建PhyMetric基准：1,115个场景覆盖六域50个物理类别，每场景配8个针对性yes/no问题（共8,920个，答案均衡）与结构化物理先验（支配定律、期望时序、可观测signature、常见失败模式）。评测时VLM裁判基于先验、从问题感知采样帧作答，正确率按场景→维度→物理类别→模型层级聚合。在4个开源T2V模型、3个VLM裁判上验证。

Result: 把每个针对性问题换成单一通用合理性询问后，裁判准确率跌至随机水平，说明场景专属二元QA是协议关键；结构化物理先验提供互补信号、提升分数与人类判断的对齐度，且效应随VLM裁判能力不同而变化。

Conclusion: PhyMetric将物理合理性评估由不透明的整体打分转为可解释的场景级诊断；但属于基准/评测类工作，未提出新的生成或世界模型方法。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce visually realistic videos that nevertheless violate the physical consequences implied by the prompt and scene. Existing benchmarks largely rely on holistic plausibility scores or broad quality dimensions, leaving it unclear which physical behavior is being tested and why a model fails. We introduce PhyMetric, a scene-level diagnostic benchmark that recasts physical plausibility evaluation as verifiable, scene-grounded question answering. PhyMetric contains 1{,}115 scenes spanning 50 physical categories across six domains, paired with 8{,}920 answer-balanced binary questions over 12 evaluation dimensions. Each scene is associated with eight targeted yes/no questions and a structured physical prior specifying the governing law, expected temporal sequence, observable signatures, and common failure modes. At evaluation time, a vision-language model (VLM) judge answers each question from question-aware sampled frames conditioned on the prior, and correctness is hierarchically aggregated into scene, dimension, physical category, and model scores. Experiments on four open-source T2V models and three VLM judges show that scene-specific binary QA is a critical component of the protocol: when each targeted question is replaced by a single generic plausibility query, evaluator accuracy drops to the chance level. Structured physical priors offer a complementary signal that improves human alignment of the resulting scores, with effects that vary across VLM judges of different capacity. These findings establish PhyMetric as a benchmark that turns physical plausibility evaluation from opaque holistic scoring into interpretable, scene-level inspection. Our project page is available at: https://mengsiwei.github.io/PhyMetric/.

</details>


### [578] [VisibilitySplat: Ray-Traced Occlusion for Relighting with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19847)
*Kluge, Sven,Staadt, Oliver*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在3DGS逆渲染中引入稀疏可见性oracle（BVH加速点光线追踪），用于材质-光照分解与重光照，保留光栅化管线以维持效率与生态兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS逆渲染中，标准光栅化管线缺乏显式可见性/遮挡建模，导致重光照与材质-光照解耦困难；需在保持3DGS训练效率与交互可视化优势的前提下补足可见性信息。

Method: 在标准rasterized 3DGS管线中附加稀疏可见性oracle：用BVH加速的点基光线追踪估计高斯基元沿采样光照方向的透射率加权遮挡；在逆渲染目标中稀疏查询，主循环仍为3DGS；着色采用PBR框架，含microfacet BRDF与低分辨率HDR环境贴图。

Result: 在TensoIR合成数据集上与NeRF、张量表示、3DGS类基线对比，NVS、反照率重建与重光照取得有竞争力的表现并优于若干早期基线；消融显示显式可见性建模对重光照与材质-光照解耦贡献显著，而纯PBR监督在NVS中更利于外观拟合。

Conclusion: 稀疏、点基可见性查询可有效补充光栅化splatting以完成逆渲染，同时保留3DGS生态的实用优势。

Abstract: We address inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by introducing explicit visibility modeling for relighting as well as material and light decomposition. Our approach augments the standard rasterized 3DGS pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle that estimates transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions. This oracle is implemented using a point-based ray tracer accelerated by a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) and queried sparsely within the inverse-rendering objectives, while the original 3DGS loop is retained for training efficiency, interactive visualization, and tooling compatibility. Shading follows a physically based rendering (PBR) formulation with a principled microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) and low-resolution high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps. We evaluate our method on the TensoIR synthetic dataset against baselines based on neural radiance fields (NeRFs), tensor representations, and 3DGS. The results show competitive performance and improvements over several earlier baselines for novel-view synthesis (NVS), albedo reconstruction, and relighting. Ablations indicate that explicit visibility modeling is an important contributor to relighting and material-illumination disentanglement, while pure PBR supervision can favor appearance fitting in NVS. Overall, the findings suggest that sparse, point-based visibility queries effectively complement rasterized splatting for inverse rendering while preserving the practical advantages of the 3DGS ecosystem.

</details>


### [579] [DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19849)
*Sun, Boyuan,Miao, Deshui,Gao, Wenzhao,Jia, Shaoyong,Jiao, Shaohui,Liu, Chi,Shu, Yan,Li, Derek,Dai, Bryan,Qian, Shengsheng,Hou, Qibin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeltaStreamer：面向流式视频理解的智能体框架，以"变化感知记忆 + 查询驱动规划 + 定向回放取证"三阶段机制，在查询到来前显式记录视觉变化，查询到来时规划并回放历史帧恢复被压缩丢失的视觉证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解需在未知未来查询的前提下保留证据。现有方法压缩历史时模糊事件转换、遗漏细节，且无法恢复已丢弃的视觉证据。

Method: 受"观察—记忆—调查"启发：1) 查询前持续观察流，将视觉变化显式写入结构化记忆，保留事件如何演变而非仅当前状态；2) 查询到来后由查询驱动规划器识别所需证据，指导记忆检索与定向回放；3) 通过重访历史帧恢复观察阶段被省略的视觉细节，使回答基于超出留存描述的原始证据。

Result: 在 OVO-Bench 与 StreamingBench 上均优于代表性流式视频理解方法，总体得分分别为 66.07% 与 59.53%。

Conclusion: 将连续观察与面向每个问题的主动调查相连接，显著提升流式视频理解性能，为记忆压缩与证据恢复的权衡提供了可行范式。

Abstract: We propose DeltaStreamer, a novel agentic framework for streaming video understanding inspired by how humans observe, remember, and investigate. Streaming video understanding requires a system to retain evidence before knowing which details future queries will need. Existing approaches often obscure event transitions and omit relevant details when compressing video history, and cannot recover missing visual evidence. DeltaStreamer addresses these limitations by combining change-aware memory with query-driven planning and targeted evidence gathering with replay. Before a query arrives, it continuously observes the stream and explicitly records visual changes in structured memory, preserving how events unfold rather than only what is present. When a query arrives, a query-driven planner identifies the required evidence and guides memory retrieval and targeted replay. By revisiting historical frames, the agent can recover visual details omitted during observation and ground its answer in evidence beyond the retained descriptions. This connects continuous observation with active investigation tailored to each question. Experiments on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench demonstrate improvements over representative streaming video understanding methods, with overall scores of 66.07% and 59.53%, respectively. Project page: https://bbbbchan.github.io/DeltaStreamer/

</details>


### [580] [OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19857)
*Liu, Minghao,Tang, Tutian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniPoser 提出统一框架，用跨模态掩码机制与掩码条件编码器，从任意异构稀疏传感器子集经条件流匹配单步推理恢复全身 SMPL 运动，达 700+ FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏可穿戴传感器恢复 3D 人体运动面临噪声、遮挡与不稳定问题；现有方法受限于固定传感器配置，且基于扩散模型的方案计算开销大，难以实时部署。

Method: 跨模态掩码机制 + Masked Conditioning Encoder，使单一架构兼容多种异质输入（3D 关键点、稀疏 IMU 旋转、头显 6-DoF 位姿及其任意子集）；解耦双流生成主干通过 Conditional Flow Matching 生成完整运动，推理仅需一次 ODE 积分步。

Result: 在三种设置、七个基准（含野外 Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D）上，性能与 SOTA 相当，推理速度超过 700 FPS。

Conclusion: 掩码式统一条件建模配合单步流匹配生成，可同时兼顾灵活传感器配置、跨数据集泛化与实时性，为可穿戴运动捕捉提供实用通用解法。

Abstract: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.

</details>


### [581] [CoDy: Codec Dynamics as Complementary Priors for Unsupervised Temporal Action Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19880)
*Yan, Tianyu,Yang, Qingyi,Yang, Qin,Guo, Xufei,Tang, Yuan,Wang, Rui,Hao, Yixue,Hu, Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoDy：利用视频编解码器中的GOP量化模式、运动矢量与残差动态作为无标注先验，通过置信度感知共识聚类生成伪标签并构建类无关边界先验，在THUMOS14与ActivityNet v1.3上取得SOTA的无监督时序动作定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督时序动作定位（UTAL）需在无标注下同时完成动作分类与时序边界定位，而现有方法仅依赖RGB与光流两种视觉表征推导监督信号，导致类别分配噪声大、边界不准。作者发现编解码器动态（GOP量化模式、运动矢量与残差变化）未被利用，可提供互补的判别性与边界线索。

Method: 以视频编解码信号为第三视角：(1) 构建codec-enhanced视图，与RGB、光流通过置信度感知共识聚类融合，生成可靠软伪标签用于类别监督；(2) 将编解码动态转化为类无关边界先验，监督视觉边界学习，并引导候选段初始化与迭代细化；(3) codec分支仅在训练阶段使用，推理不增加编解码侧计算。

Result: 在THUMOS14和ActivityNet v1.3上一致优于现有UTAL方法，达到SOTA定位性能，验证了编解码信号作为无标注先验在"发生何种动作"与"何时发生"联合推断中的有效性。

Conclusion: 视频编解码中的压缩动态是可高效获取、无需额外推理开销的互补先验，为无监督时序动作定位提供了新的监督来源；该思路可推广至其他视频理解任务的多视角表征融合。
