Abstract: Unsupervised temporal action localization (UTAL) aims to identify action categories and localize their temporal boundaries without annotation supervision. Existing methods typically derive supervision for both tasks solely from RGB and optical-flow representations, often resulting in noisy category assignments and inaccurate temporal boundaries. In this work, we reveal an overlooked property of video codecs: group-of-pictures quantization patterns preserve category-discriminative dynamics, while motion-vector and residual variations exhibit pronounced responses around action transitions. Based on this insight, we propose CoDy, a codec dynamics-guided framework that exploits the codec as complementary information to the visual view for UTAL. CoDy integrates a codec-enhanced view with RGB and flow through confidence-aware consensus clustering, producing reliable soft pseudo-labels. It further converts codec dynamics into a class-agnostic boundary prior, which supervises visual boundary learning and guides proposal initialization and iterative refinement. The codec branches are only used during the training stage and introduce no extra codec-side computation at inference. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate that CoDy consistently outperforms existing UTAL methods and achieves state-of-the-art localization performance. These results establish codec signals as effective annotation-free priors for jointly inferring which actions occur and when they occur.

</details>


### [582] [BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19882)
*Guan, Shanyan,Li, Shiyu,Li, Xin,Chen, Zhizhou,Xu, Yunzhe,Liu, Yuehao,Shen, Ruixue,Zhang, Shiju,Jin, Min,Liu, Qiang,Liu, Junbo,Shi, Penggang,Sun, Sheng,Wang, Xiao,Zhang, Yong,Qi, Zhongang,Li, Wei,Ma, Chao,Tai, Ying,Ge, Yanhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BluePixel 将原生 4K 指令图像编辑视为系统问题：开源一套完整训练配方（渐进式 VAE 适配 + 持续学习 + RL 微调美学-保真权衡 + SATP 蒸馏至 4 步），并配套 BluePixel Agent 将模糊指令分解为专家/通用操作、用同一奖励模型验证与有限次重试，单卡 8.7s 完成 4K 编辑，在 VINS-4KEval++ 上非编辑区一致性仅次于 GPT Image 2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生 4K 指令图像编辑的训练方法未公开，从零预训练超出多数团队能力。任务本身也难：单一端到端编辑器无法做精确参数化调整、无法匹敌专用专家、也难以理解用户实际写下的模糊指令。因此作者主张 4K 编辑是系统级问题而非单模型问题。

Method: 1) 渐进式 VAE 适配，把 1K 预训练编辑器升级为原生 4K，使 4K 训练成本与 1K 相当；2) 持续学习吸收长尾垂类编辑技能；3) 用强化学习精修美学与保真度权衡；4) 源锚定目标投影蒸馏（SATP）将 50 步去噪压缩到 4 步；5) BluePixel Agent 作为 harness，将用户指令分解为专家操作与通用操作，用训练时同一奖励模型验证每个结果，并在有界次数内重试。

Result: 单块昆仑芯 P800 XPU 上 8.7 秒完成一次 4K 编辑，同时保持任务成功率与背景一致性；在 VINS-4KEval++（3,305 个原生 4K 案例）上七个模型排名第二，非编辑区域一致性仅落后 GPT Image 2。

Conclusion: 4K 指令编辑的可行路径是"原生 4K 模型 + 智能体 harness"的系统耦合，而非单一模型扩容；公开完整训练配方、把推理成本降至单卡 8.7s，并以奖励模型驱动的验证-重试闭环换取可控性，是该工作的主要贡献形态。

Abstract: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.

</details>


### [583] [Multimodal Medical Image Parsing with Task-Specific Low-Rank Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19901)
*Sabir, Taha,Molina, Alberto Montero,Ly, Thinh Quang,Dmitrenko, Veronika,Yaqub, Mohammad,Saleem, Tausifa Jan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 面向 FLARE 2026 Task 3 的医疗视觉-语言模型任务自适应方案：共享冻结 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B 主干 + 按输入问题选择的 LoRA 适配器，覆盖六大任务族、七种影像模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一视觉-语言模型直接适配医疗图像解析时，不同任务（分类、多标签分类、计数、检测、回归、报告生成）对训练配置的需求各异，需要任务特异化的适配策略而非统一微调。

Method: 共享冻结 4-bit 主干 + 依据输入问题动态选择的 LoRA 适配器；针对各任务自定义 LoRA rank 与 prompt，对稀有分类目标进行重平衡，并在回归训练中补充皮肤科分类样本；以 FLARE 2026 Task 3 为评测场景（六任务族、七模态）。

Result: 内部固定 holdout：分类数据集宏平均平衡精度 0.7791、多标签微 F1 0.6286、计数 MAE 11.73、检测 F1 0.8914、回归 MAE 9.78、报告生成 CRIMSON 0.8204；组织方 1,703 例隐藏验证集：分类 0.8496、多标签 F1 0.5338、回归 MAE 14.5950。容器 30.1 GB，含模型加载平均 3.1 秒/例，重复运行输出一致。

Conclusion: 任务特异化的适配器配置与图像预算在共享医疗视觉-语言模型内带来跨任务但幅度不一的收益，验证了统一主干+任务特化适配的可行性与可复现性。

Abstract: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.

</details>


### [584] [Quantifying Annotation Agreement in Object Detection with Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19912)
*Prokhorov, Kirill,Kalinin, Alexandr A.*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于最优传输（OT）的目标检测标注一致性度量，用分级代价替代二值化IoU匹配，能刻画标注间一致性的渐变并区分阈值化指标给出相同分数的标注对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型验证依赖被视为真值的标注测试集，但标注本身存在噪声与歧义：目标存在性、框位置、类别标签都可能分歧。标准一致性指标（如基于IoU阈值的方法）先二值化框重叠再汇总，丢失了分歧的程度与结构信息。

Method: 将标注集合间的一致性建模为最优传输问题：对匹配与未匹配的标注框施加分级（graded）代价函数，而非用硬阈值把框重叠二值化，从而在传输代价中同时编码位置偏移、类别差异与漏检/多余框。

Result: 理论分析加真实与合成扰动标注实验显示：OT度量能捕捉一致性的渐变变化，并区分出阈值化指标评分为同一值的标注对；在小目标或歧义目标较多的场景中优势更明显。

Conclusion: OT为目检标注一致性提供了更丰富的度量，可在标签噪声或冲突时支撑更可靠的模型验证；作者建议将其用于小目标与歧义目标密集领域。

Abstract: Reliable validation of machine learning models is a crucial step in designing robust and trustworthy systems. Yet validation relies on annotated test sets treated as ground truth, even though annotations can be noisy or ambiguous. In object detection, sources may disagree on object presence, box location, or class label. Standard agreement metrics usually binarize box overlap before computing a summary score, obscuring the degree and structure of disagreement between annotation sets. Here, we study an Optimal Transport (OT)-based metric for measuring agreement between object detection annotations. Instead of binarizing bounding box overlap, this metric assigns graded costs to matched and unmatched labeled boxes. Through theoretical analysis and experiments on real and synthetically perturbed annotations, we show that OT captures graded changes in agreement and distinguishes annotation pairs that thresholded metrics score identically. Our results suggest that OT provides a richer measure of annotation agreement in object detection, especially for domains with many small or ambiguous objects. Such agreement estimates can support more reliable validation when labels are noisy or conflicting.

</details>


### [585] [SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19931)
*Čížek, Tomáš,Straka, Matej,Volkov, Illia,Kripner, Matěj,Macić, Ervin,Matas, Jiri,Janouskova, Klara,Schmid, Martin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAM3RL 将视频分割跟踪器的记忆库管理建模为序贯决策问题，用轻量 RL 控制器学习哪些帧写入记忆，在 12 个跟踪/VOS 基准中的 10 个上达到 SOTA，且无运行开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 2/3 跟踪器依赖简单 FIFO 记忆库维持时序一致性；近期手工设计的记忆更新规则（针对干扰物、遮挡、运动等单一失败模式）在更强的 SAM 3 骨架上增益仅部分可迁移，缺乏通用性。

Method: 提出数据驱动的记忆控制范式：将记忆库写入策略视为序贯决策任务，为 SAM 3 跟踪器附加一个轻量记忆控制器，用强化学习训练其决定哪些帧进入记忆库，以最大化跟踪性能；同方法迁移到 SAM 2 得到 SAM2RL。

Result: SAM3RL 在 12 个跟踪与视频目标分割基准中的 10 个上刷新 SOTA，优于所有手工规则且无运行时开销；SAM2RL 在 12 个基准中的 9 个上优于手工规则。

Conclusion: 学习式记忆控制比手工启发式更通用、可跨模型代际迁移，是提升视觉跟踪与视频分割性能的有效方向。

Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.

</details>


### [586] [Instruction Mining From Images: Constructing a Synthetic Dataset for Multimodal Learning ILSP DCVLR Competition Submission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19932)
*Kasoura, Eleni E.,Damianos, Dimitrios,Paraskevopoulos, Georgios,Katsouros, Vassilios*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作提出一套紧凑可复现的流程，用Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct以Magpie风格从Cauldron数据集合成图像条件指令-回复对，并经清洗、打标、基于DeBERTa-v3奖励模型打分过滤，最终得到数学、空间、社交推理等多样化的DCVLR指令数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为DCVLR任务构建高质量、多样化且可复现的图像条件指令-回复数据，缓解此类多模态指令数据依赖人工标注、成本高且难以扩展的问题。

Method: 基于Cauldron数据集合，采用Magpie风格指令与回复合成：以输入图像为条件、系统提示控制生成，随后进行清洗、打标，并用DeBERTa-v3奖励模型对指令打分，保留正分样本以提升质量。

Result: 奖励分数中位数约1.53、均值约1.75，表明多数生成指令质量良好；所得数据集在数学、空间与社交推理领域具备多样化的指令。

Conclusion: 该可复现流程能够低成本地合成并筛选出高质量图像指令数据，为DCVLR训练提供了具备领域多样性的数据基础。

Abstract: This work presents a compact and reproducible pipeline for synthesizing and curating image-based instruction-response pairs for DCVLR. We draw from the Cauldron collection and use Magpie-style instruction and response synthesis with Qwen2.5-VL-7B Instruct to create concise, image-conditioned instruction pairs. The pipeline consists of instruction synthesis, conditioned on input images and controlled via a system prompt, sanitization, tagging, and filtering of the instructions based on the score obtained by a reward model (DeBERTa-v3). We retain samples with positive scores to maximize the quality of the generated instructions. We observe that score distributions have a median and mean reward score of ~ 1.53 and ~ 1.75 respectively, indicating that most generated instructions are of good quality. The resulting dataset contains diverse instructions in the math, spatial, and social reasoning domains.

</details>


### [587] [Why 3D Reconstruction Breaks Down on Under-Ice AUV Video, and How to Predict It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19993)
*Kogălniceanu, Ana-Ştefania,Orbán, Klára,Nedungadi, Ashwin,Lüdtke, Stefan,Benţa, Kuderna-Iulian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在冰下AUV（Icefin，Kamb Ice Stream）同一段视频上系统评测四类三维重建方法——经典特征匹配SfM、可微光度splatting、体深度融合、无位姿前馈基础模型——发现四者均失败且失败模式各异，但可统一归因于同一采集条件：相机基线-场景深度比过小，并提出可在数分钟内检测此类失效的检测系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冰下AUV视频三维重建结果长期不准确，但无法判断问题根源是重建方法缺陷还是采集系统固有不足；需要在同一数据上横向对比代表性的不同范式方法，以厘清失败归因并避免无效算力消耗。

Method: 在同一段南极冰下AUV视频上复现并评测四种代表性重建范式：经典特征匹配SfM、可微光度splatting、体深度融合、无位姿前馈基础模型；分析各自失败模式，并将其与采集条件（小相机基线-场景深度比）关联；进而设计快速失效检测系统。

Result: 四种方法全部失败且失败模式各不相同：近乎完全无法配准、几乎不产生结构；光度指标健康但几何破碎；持续存在的覆盖伪影；跨分块尺度不稳定。实验表明这些失败均与同一采集条件一致，即小基线-场景深度比；所提检测系统可在数分钟内（而非数小时算力浪费）标记该类失效。

Conclusion: 冰下AUV重建失败主要源于采集系统本身的退化几何条件（小基线-场景深度比），而非单一方法缺陷；该条件下多种主流重建范式均不可靠，快速失效检测比盲目增加算力更有实际价值。

Abstract: Reconstruction of 3D structures using under-ice AUV video footage has been inaccurate, although it is not certain whether this is due to shortcomings in the methods or an inherent deficiency of the capture system. We test four different models for reconstruction on the same Antarctic under-ice AUV video (Icefin, Kamb Ice Stream): classical feature matching SfM, differentiable photometric splatting, volumetric depth fusion, and a pose-free feed-forward foundation model. All four fail, each in a distinct way: near-total registration yielding almost no structure, geometrically broken output despite healthy photometric metrics, a persistent coverage artifact, and unstable cross-chunk scale. We show that all four are consistent with the same capture regime, a small camera-baseline-to-scene-depth ratio. Following our analysis, we propose a detection system that flags this type of failure in minutes, rather than hours of wasted compute.

</details>


### [588] [GeoCloak: An Agentic Framework for Semantics-Preserving Geolocation Privacy via Peripheral Clue Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20055)
*Wu, Yixin,Li, Mingjie,Shen, Yun,Backes, Michael,Zhang, Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoCloak，一个agentic语义保持的地理定位隐私保护框架，利用"视觉-地理定位不对称性"，通过语义编辑抑制周边性线索（如路牌）并配合对抗扰动，将LVLM城市级定位准确率从41.2%降至9.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型使单张无元数据照片即可被黑盒定位，隐私风险严重；而现有防护几乎全靠对抗扰动，带来可见伪影与图像效用退化。

Method: 识别视觉-地理定位不对称性（决定性线索视觉上边缘却主导定位）。GeoCloak作为线索感知规划器：分析图像定位相关线索→派发定向语义编辑直接压制周边线索→自动配置对抗扰动抑制残存特征，全程由效用感知的迭代反馈驱动。

Result: 在覆盖108国576城的4个数据集上，对5个LVLM与3种推断方法评测：城市级准确率由41.2%降至9.9%，约为最佳基线的一半，同时定性定量上效用保持显著更优。

Conclusion: 语义保持的地理定位隐私保护可行，让用户对分享图像中无意嵌入的位置信息拥有更强控制力。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large vision language models (LVLMs) has made geolocation inference from images highly accurate and accessible. This poses serious privacy risks: a passive adversary with black-box LVLM access can infer a user's location from a single photo with no metadata. Existing protection methods rely almost exclusively on adversarial perturbation, which introduces perceptible visual artifacts and utility degradation. We identify the visual-geolocation asymmetry: geolocation-decisive clues, such as street signs, tend to be visually peripheral but dominate location inference. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose GeoCloak, an agentic framework for semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection. It acts as a clue-aware planner that analyzes each image to identify geolocation-relevant clues, dispatches targeted semantic edits to directly suppress peripheral clues, and autonomously configures adversarial perturbation to further suppress residual geolocation features, all under iterative utility-aware feedback. We evaluate GeoCloak on four diverse datasets spanning 108 countries and 576 cities against five LVLMs and three inference methods. GeoCloak reduces overall city-level accuracy from 41.2% to 9.9%, approximately half of the best-performing baseline, while achieving substantially superior utility preservation both qualitatively and quantitatively. We hope this work takes a meaningful step toward practical, semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection, giving users greater control over the location information inadvertently embedded in their shared images.

</details>


### [589] [GDBA-Net: A Gated Dual-Branch Adaptation of SAM2 for Robust Cross-Domain Nuclei Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20073)
*Poudel, Biplab,Magarire, Betserai Albert,Shah, Anish Kumar,Xie, Jiacheng,Xu, Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GDBA-Net：在冻结 SAM2 编码器上插入门控双分支适配器（GDBA），融合语义表示与频率域结构先验，仅 4.3M 可训练参数，在六个细胞核分割基准上取得同数据集 SOTA 与更优跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算病理学中细胞核分割受形态多变、边界微弱、核拥挤及染色/制备/采集差异导致的显著域偏移影响，现有深度学习与基础模型在分布匹配时表现良好，但跨异构病理域泛化能力有限，且全量微调代价高。

Method: 参数高效框架：冻结 SAM2 编码器，引入 Gated Dual-Branch Adapter，将预训练语义表征与显式频率域结构先验作为互补分支，各自经 Grid MLP 独立变换，再以样本自适应通道门控动态融合，选择性强化与核边界刻画相关的结构线索。

Result: 仅 4.3M 可训练参数，在六个多样细胞核分割基准上达到同数据集 SOTA，并在完全监督、跨数据集与五样本（five-shot）适配协议下均取得更优泛化，超过 CNN、Transformer 与基础模型类方法；消融显示增益来自语义-频率互补与自适应门控的协同设计，而非模型容量提升。

Conclusion: 将可迁移语义表示与显式结构先验结合，为细胞核分割中的域差异问题提供鲁棒、低标注成本的参数高效方案，但适用范围限于医学病理图像分割。

Abstract: Accurate nuclei segmentation underpins quantitative computational pathology, yet remains challenging due to morphological variability, weak boundaries, nuclear crowding, and pronounced domain shifts arising from differences in tissue preparation, staining, and acquisition. While deep learning and recent foundation models have improved segmentation performance under matched distributions with the original training data, their generalization across heterogeneous histopathology domains remains limited. We introduce GDBA-Net, a parameter-efficient nuclei segmentation framework built around the proposed Gated Dual-Branch Adapter (GDBA). GDBA-Net adapts a frozen SAM2 encoder by integrating pretrained semantic representations with explicit frequency-derived structural priors. The complementary representations are independently transformed through Grid MLP branches and dynamically integrated using sample-adaptive channel-wise gating, selectively emphasizing structural cues relevant to nuclear delineation. Despite using only 4.3 million trainable parameters, GDBA-Net achieves state-of-the-art in-dataset performance and consistently superior cross-dataset generalization across six diverse nuclei segmentation benchmarks under fully supervised, cross-dataset, and five-shot adaptation protocols, outperforming competing CNN-, transformer-, and foundation model based methods. Comprehensive ablations confirm that these gains arise from the coordinated design of semantic-frequency complementarity and adaptive gating rather than increased model capacity. By uniting transferable semantic representations with explicit structural priors, GDBA-Net provides a robust, annotation-efficient solution to domain variability in nuclei segmentation. https://github.com/biplabpoudel25/GDBA_Net

</details>


### [590] [Feasibility of a Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Ventriculoperitoneal Shunt Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20074)
*Chongsrid, Kritsanavis,Yindeedej, Vich,Konmun, Supaporn,Yang, Xulei,Yeo, Si Yong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建基于术前CT的数字化孪生模型，围绕Keen点搜索满足安全约束、脑室内长度最长的垂直穿刺轨迹，输出为耳部标尺测量与两个深度值；11例徒手执行中10例达到Hayhurst 1级置管。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 导管梗阻是分流失败最常见原因，而Keen点徒手置管仅约1/10能将管端置于脑室内脑脊液中，亟需一种不改变现有操作流程、仅优化入点和深度的个体化规划方法。

Method: 由术前CT以确定性几何重建颅骨、头皮、耳廓与脑室；在Keen点周围遍历所有入点，在安全约束下搜索脑室内长度最长的垂直轨迹；将规划结果表达为两点耳部标尺测量值和两个进针深度值。前瞻性IDEAL Stage 2a连续11例成人徒手执行。

Result: 11例中10例达到Hayhurst 1级置管，历史对照为213例中22例（p=9×10⁻⁹）；入点与角度偏差中位数分别为2.5 mm和5.9°；脑室内导管长度比Keen点平均多1.4 cm；无术中并发症。

Conclusion: 在不改变徒手技术本身的前提下，仅通过个体化选择入点与深度即可显著提升置管精度；是否能降低翻修率留待下一阶段验证。

Abstract: Catheter obstruction is the commonest cause of shunt failure; freehand insertion at Keen's point leaves the tip free in cerebrospinal fluid in only one case in ten. We built a digital twin that reconstructs skull, scalp, ear and ventricles from preoperative CT by deterministic geometry, searches every entry around Keen's point for the perpendicular trajectory with the longest intraventricular length under safety constraints, and returns the plan as two ruler measurements from the ear and two depths. Executed freehand in 11 consecutive adults (IDEAL Stage 2a), it achieved Hayhurst Grade 1 placement in 10 of 11 against 22 of 213 historically (p = 9 x 10^-9), median entry and angular deviations 2.5 mm and 5.9 degrees, 1.4 cm more intraventricular catheter than Keen's point, and no intraoperative complication. The technique was unchanged; the gain came from choosing entry and depth per patient. Whether it lowers revision is the next stage's hypothesis.

</details>


### [591] [VisualWorldBench: A Fine-Grained Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Visual World Knowledge in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20083)
*Chen, Chen,Liang, Zheming,Wang, Jiaqi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VisualWorldBench：基于 21,291 个叶节点类别的层级分类体系，构建含 32,541 个评测实例的多任务基准，覆盖闭集识别、对比选择、精确定位与开放世界命名四类任务，并配套 50K+ 类别的训练资源 VisualWorldBench-50K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）的视觉世界知识是知识密集型 VQA 与细粒度视觉推理的核心能力，但现有基准存在两点不足：一是类别覆盖狭窄，仅涉及少数领域和少量类别，远不及真实世界开放实体规模；二是任务构建不够严谨，模型可凭粗粒度线索、模糊联想或排除法答对，难以真实衡量细粒度实体知识。

Method: 构建基于层级分类体系（8 个视觉领域、21,291 个叶节点类）的多任务基准 VisualWorldBench，共 32,541 个评测实例，真值标签覆盖 15,479 个类别；设计四类互补任务：闭集识别、对比选择、精确定位、开放世界命名，分别对应不同知识检索方向与答案开放度；多数问题由分类学上邻近的类别构造，强制模型做细粒度区分。另构建覆盖 50K+ 类别的训练资源 VisualWorldBench-50K。

Result: 最强闭源模型在 VisualWorldBench 上平均准确率仅 80.4%，暴露出传统基准掩盖的能力缺口；在 VisualWorldBench-50K 上微调可带来超过 21 个百分点的提升，并一致迁移至公开的细粒度识别与视觉知识基准。

Conclusion: 该工作通过分类学驱动的多任务设计揭示了 MLLM 在开放世界细粒度视觉知识上的真实短板，同时证明大规模细粒度训练数据可显著提升并泛化该能力。

Abstract: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.

</details>


### [592] [When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20089)
*Lin, Xinrui,Li, Fan,Wang, Shumin,Kong, Dehong,Zhang, Yanyong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对视频生成模型 RL 中的成对偏好反馈，构建偏好图并发现循环偏好普遍存在，提出图感知的 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk (RAPW) 优势聚合方法，在不增加评估查询的情况下优于 Pairwise-GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对比较比逐点标量评分更可靠，已成为视频生成 RL 的常用监督信号；但现有方法（如 Pairwise-GRPO）用平均胜率聚合奖励，丢弃了比较图结构，且循环偏好普遍存在，导致部分 rollout 的优势估计不可靠。

Method: 为每个 GRPO 组的 rollout 构建偏好图（节点=rollout，边=成对偏好），审计 6,976 个 on-policy 比较图；提出 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk，在胜率给出的全局偏好信号基础上，通过可靠性引导的图上游走引入循环偏好图中的关系证据，进行图感知优势聚合，且不额外增加评估器查询。

Result: 在匹配评估器、比较协议、组大小、提示调度和查询预算的条件下，RAPW 在受控对比、迁移设置和盲测人类评估中均优于 Pairwise-GRPO，且不需要额外的评估查询。

Conclusion: 循环偏好是视频生成 RL 中成对监督的普遍现象，显式利用偏好图结构与可靠性信息可带来更稳健的优势估计和更好的生成质量。

Abstract: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

</details>


### [593] [RTAformer: Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer for Video Scene Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20091)
*Heo, Jaeyeon,Lim, Geuntaek,Choi, Yukyung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RTAformer：一阶段视频场景图生成框架，分别建模实体持续性与关系变化，通过注入相邻帧关系查询的校准差异引导谓词更新，并借助跨帧实例对齐减少表征漂移，缓解"关系语义惯性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VidSGG方法跨帧聚合时空上下文，但过度强调一致性会掩盖关系的突变，导致关系已变化后模型仍保留旧预测，即"关系语义惯性"失效模式。

Method: 提出Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer（RTAformer），一阶段框架：解耦建模实体持续性与关系变化；将相邻帧关系查询之间的校准差值注入以引导谓词更新；训练时进行跨帧实例对齐以抑制跨帧表征漂移。

Result: 在Action Genome上召回率与平均召回率均优于现有方法；消融实验验证各组件贡献；在匹配骨干下，关系转变帧上的提升大于非转变帧。

Conclusion: 显式区分实体持续性与关系转变、并注入校准的帧间差异，可有效缓解关系语义惯性，为动态场景图建模提供可行方向。

Abstract: Video scene graph generation (VidSGG) aims to capture objects and their evolving relationships in videos. This requires accounting for both the persistence of object identities and abrupt changes in relationships. Existing methods aggregate information across frames to exploit temporal context, but an emphasis on consistency can obscure these changes. As a result, a model may retain its previous prediction even after the underlying relation has changed. We refer to this failure mode as relational semantic inertia. To address this issue, we propose Relation-Transition-Aware Transformer (RTAformer), a one-stage framework that separately models entity persistence and relation changes. It injects calibrated differences between adjacent-frame relation queries to guide predicate updates, while cross-frame instance alignment during training helps reduce cross-frame representational drift. Experiments on Action Genome show improvements in recall and mean recall over existing methods, with ablation studies supporting the contributions of the proposed components and comparisons using matched backbones showing larger gains on relation-transition frames than on non-transition frames.

</details>


### [594] [RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20111)
*Fu, Siming,Fu, Zheming,Mu, Lianrui,Huang, Haoyang,Gu, Chaojie,He, Ruizhe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将预训练视频扩散模型蒸馏为少步自回归生成器时，用"表示强制"（Representation Forcing）在表示空间中监督因果初始化，替代中间教师轨迹回归，4步设置下优于因果ODE初始化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有做法（学生初始化+DMD）依赖中间AR教师提供因果兼容的ODE初始化目标，但因果兼容不等于短采样步数下高质量：作者分析发现直接隐回归偏向后验均值预测，导致模糊；因果ODE初始化虽缓解模糊，但细节仍不足。

Method: 提出Representation Forcing：以冻结视频扩散Transformer的归一化特征为监督空间，用teacher forcing比较干净预测与训练目标，学习少步因果初始化；复用双向模型为AR教师训练生成的合成视频，替代教师训练与因果ODE蒸馏，无需生成额外因果ODE轨迹；后续非对称DMD流程保持不变。

Result: 4步采样时，RepForcing在DMD前比基于中间教师的初始化更好保持生成质量；DMD后，4步chunk-wise模型相对报告的因果ODE基线，VBench Total由84.04提升至84.66（+0.62），VisionReward由6.326提升至10.074（+59.25%）。

Conclusion: 表示空间监督比轨迹回归更适合少步因果初始化，可在不增加ODE轨迹生成开销的前提下提升蒸馏后少步视频生成质量，为少步AR视频生成提供了一种高效初始化范式。

Abstract: Distilling pretrained video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) generators typically combines student initialization with distribution matching distillation (DMD). An intermediate AR teacher can provide causally compatible targets for ODE initialization. However, causally compatible targets alone do not ensure high-quality generation under a short sampling schedule. We analyze the posterior-mean predictions favored by direct latent regression and empirically find that causal ODE initialization alleviates blur but still leaves fine detail unresolved. To address this limitation, we propose Representation Forcing, which learns few-step causal initialization through representation-space supervision rather than intermediate-teacher trajectory regression. The student is trained with teacher forcing by comparing clean predictions and training targets through normalized features of a frozen video diffusion transformer. This phase reuses the synthetic videos generated by a bidirectional model for AR teacher training and replaces both teacher training and causal ODE distillation, without generating additional causal ODE trajectories. The subsequent asymmetric DMD procedure remains unchanged. Empirical results show that, at four sampling steps, RepForcing better preserves generation quality than intermediate-teacher-based initialization before DMD. After DMD, our four-step chunk-wise model improves VBench Total from 84.04 to 84.66 (+0.62 points) and VisionReward from 6.326 to 10.074 (+59.25%) over the reported causal-ODE-based baseline.

</details>


### [595] [DreamHMR: From Video Generation to Human Motion Modeling via Structural Focusing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20124)
*Xu, Zhengjie,Gong, Ruihao,Liu, Xianglong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DreamHMR：将视频生成预训练先验适配到全身+手部网格重建，采用全局-局部策略，在3DPW/EMDB-1/RICH上全面超越现有方法，遮挡场景下body/hand MPJPE降低7.0%/10.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频中同时重建身体运动与精细手部关节在真实遮挡场景下仍很困难；视频生成预训练蕴含丰富时空先验，但其表征面向视觉合成，与显式人体几何存在鸿沟。

Method: DreamHMR采用全局到局部策略：①Global Body Representation Transfer，训练视频骨干预测完整人体渲染，将原生预测任务转化为学习表面对应关系与姿态几何；②Local Joint Feature Enhancement，将上下文估计与可靠局部证据融合以恢复身体和手部细节，并抑制遮挡物与背景干扰。

Result: 在5个数据集、4种视频骨干上验证跨骨干族泛化；统一评测协议下最佳模型在3DPW、EMDB-1、RICH所有报告指标上均优于现有最佳方法，body MPJPE分别降低4.2%、4.7%、6.1%；在BEDLAM与EgoBody的遮挡序列上，body与hand总体MPJPE分别降低7.0%和10.0%。

Conclusion: 视频生成先验可有效迁移为显式人体几何表征，全局几何对齐加局部证据增强的组合实现了鲁棒的全身-手部重建，代码将开源。

Abstract: Human mesh recovery (HMR) provides a geometric foundation for understanding human motion, but accurately reconstructing both body motion and fine hand articulation from videos remains challenging, especially in real-world scenes where occlusion and partial visibility are common. Video generation pretraining offers rich spatial and temporal priors for this task, but its focus on visual synthesis leaves a gap between these representations and explicit human geometry. We present DreamHMR, a general framework that adapts video generation priors for complete body-and-hand reconstruction. It follows a global-to-local strategy, first grounding video representations in human geometry and then refining body and hand detail with reliable local evidence. Global Body Representation Transfer trains the video backbone to predict complete human renderings, turning its native prediction task into a means of learning surface correspondence and posed geometry. Local Joint Feature Enhancement combines contextual estimates with reliable local evidence to recover fine body and hand detail, while limiting interference from occluders and background. Experiments on five datasets with four video backbones demonstrate strong reconstruction performance across backbone families. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our best model outperforms the best existing methods on all reported metrics of 3DPW, EMDB-1, and RICH, reducing body MPJPE by 4.2%, 4.7%, and 6.1%, respectively. In more challenging occlusion settings on held-out BEDLAM and EgoBody sequences, DreamHMR reduces overall body and hand MPJPE by 7.0% and 10.0%, respectively. Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [596] [StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20137)
*Dong, Zhuobai,Tu, Xiaobing,Zhang, Xiantao,Ren, Jinkui,Wang, Yinggui,Ma, Yue,Zhang, Linfeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamErase 通过滑动窗口因果注意力与注意力汇聚、训练期自rollout与KV缓存滚动，将双向视频擦除能力蒸馏为单向流式擦除器，实现单卡亚秒级延迟、最高26 FPS、可无限长视频的实时目标擦除，并提出了 LongErase 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频目标移除方法延迟极高（每段视频需数分钟）且采用非因果处理，无法支持实时交互。作者希望实现亚秒级延迟、支持任意长度、可交互的流式视频擦除。

Method: 先以掩码输入增强文生视频模型，生成高质量擦除与背景合成结果（但不做在线推理）；随后把该双向基础模型的擦除能力渐进迁移到高效的单向流式擦除器。针对长时程生成的三个挑战（训练短长度到长时程外推的域差、误差累积、上下文增长导致算力上升），设计带注意力汇聚的滑动窗口因果注意力，并在训练中结合注意力汇聚的自rollout与KV缓存滚动，在固定上下文窗口下模拟推理期外推，实现恒定速度的任意长视频生成。同时构建面向流式长视频目标移除的基准 LongErase。

Result: 单GPU上达到亚秒级延迟、最高26 FPS 的流式生成；相较现有视频目标擦除模型性能更优，并可泛化到真实场景；独有地支持无限长流式生成，用户输入掩码即可实时看到擦除结果。

Conclusion: 通过因果流式化 + 双向到单向的能力迁移，视频目标擦除从离线分钟级延迟推进到实时交互式流式生成，配合 LongErase 基准，为长视频实时编辑提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.

</details>


### [597] [Attention-Based Spatio-Temporal Approach for Fire and Smoke Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20141)
*Mirrashid, Alireza,Khoshbin, Mohammad,Atghaei, Ali,Shahbazi, Hassan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种融合空间特征与时序特征的视觉烟雾/火焰检测方法，采用三阶段级联结构逐步降低前一阶段误差，并引入Transformer模块提升精度，用于户外与工业场所火灾监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外热成像与烟雾传感器在户外场景难以部署，视觉方法成为必要替代；烟雾与火焰具有明显的时空演化特性，需要时空联合建模才能鲁棒检测。

Method: 三阶段流水线架构，各阶段以前一阶段误差为修正目标；并行提取空间外观特征与时序动态特征并融合；引入Transformer模块增强长程依赖建模与判别精度。

Result: 实验结果表明该方法在烟雾与火焰检测任务上具有良好性能，验证了时空特征融合与Transformer模块的有效性，可部署于提升工作场所安全性的应用中。（摘要未给出具体量化指标与数据集信息。）

Conclusion: 时空联合建模的视觉方案可有效替代传感器方法用于户外烟雾火焰检测，具备提升工业安全监测的实用潜力；但需补充定量对比、实时性评估与公开代码以增强说服力。

Abstract: In various industries, smoke and fire are two of the most important threats in the workplace. One of the common methods for detecting smoke and fire is the use of infrared thermal and smoke sensors, which cannot be used in outdoor applications. Therefore, the use of vision-based methods seems necessary. The problem of smoke and fire detection is spatiotemporal and requires spatiotemporal solutions. This paper presents a method that uses spatial features along with temporal-based features to detect smoke and fire in the scene. It consists of three main parts; the task of each part is to reduce the error of the previous part so that the final model has a robust performance. This method also uses transformer modules to increase the accuracy of the model. The results of our model show the proper performance of the proposed approach in solving the problem of smoke and fire detection and can be used to increase workplace safety.

</details>


### [598] [Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20158)
*Almpanakis, Konstantinos,Kreshuk, Anna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 out-of-batch regularization：在 CPU 内存中维护数据集级状态，用全局构造的 per-instance targets 替代 minibatch 内的正则化估计，使正则器几何不再依赖 batch size。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督联合嵌入学习中，正则化的目标是塑造整体表征分布，但大多数方法只在当前 minibatch 上计算，导致小 batch 时估计偏差大、表征分布受 batch size 影响。

Method: 维护数据集级的 CPU 侧状态（anchors），在 minibatch 训练时构造全局 per-instance 目标，从而估计近似的全数据集正则化梯度；将该框架分别应用于对比式 SimCLR 与非对比式 SIGReg 目标。

Result: 在自然图像与生物医学数据上，小 batch 时 anchors 比常规 minibatch 估计更接近全数据集正则化梯度；图像分类、受控不平衡下的少数类性能、实例检索与持续自监督预训练均一致优于对应 in-batch 目标，且增益在小 batch 下最大。

Conclusion: 数据集级正则化可与 minibatch 优化解耦，使 batch size 退化为纯优化选择，而不再影响正则器的几何结构。

Abstract: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.

</details>


### [599] [OneLA: Learning Many Worlds from Latent Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20160)
*Zhu, Ziyu,Sun, Zhaoxu,Jiang, Fan,Wang, Chiyu,Ni, Junfeng,Xu, Mu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OneLA 框架，用共享正交字典与统一预测目标从多域视频中学习连续隐动作，作为世界模型的共享控制接口，无需跨域对齐损失即可提升动作读出与跨域迁移生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型需要跨域统一控制空间，但各域动作接口差异大且动作标注稀缺；直接从视频学隐动作虽可规避监督，但外观、形态与动力学的差异会把域特定视觉线索与可迁移的转移结构纠缠在一起，导致共享隐动作学习困难。

Method: OneLA 以共享正交字典学习连续隐动作，配合统一的预测目标进行隐动作预训练，不使用任务特定设计或跨域对齐损失；隐动作作为世界模型的共享条件接口，再用轻量适配器把各域原生控制指令映射到同一空间；世界模型以隐动作与当前视觉状态为条件预测上下文相关的转移，实现可控 rollout。

Result: 跨域动作读出性能提升；动作循环迁移旋转误差相比最强对比基线降低 24.8%；联合训练比较中，真实场景生成的 Human Preference Score v3（HPSv3）提升 20.5%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，从多样视频学习隐动作空间可为通用世界模型提供灵活控制接口，是迈向跨域通用世界模型的一条可行路径；但结论主要基于动作读出与偏好评分类指标，缺乏真实机器人部署或闭环控制证据。

Abstract: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.

</details>


### [600] [Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20217)
*Sidiqi, Bilal A.,Wang, Yipei,Saeed, Shaheer U.,Huang, Shiqi,Alexander, Daniel C.,Hu, Yipeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作研究ViT医学影像基础模型的持续预训练：在预训练ViT编码器上用LoRA进行前列腺分割任务的持续预训练，以增强预训练与下游任务的对齐；并用CKA做逐层表征分析。6个下游任务中3个提升，其余持平；分割任务上持续预训练特征更接近微调特征，与性能提升相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MRI基础模型研究多聚焦预训练策略与多任务性能，较少关注预训练目标与下游任务目标之间的"任务对齐"问题。语言模型中两阶段天然对齐，而视觉应用中对齐不明显，因此作者希望通过持续预训练缩小这一差距。

Method: 采用持续预训练范式：在已预训练的ViT编码器上，通过LoRA低秩适配在前列腺分割任务上继续训练，以提升任务对齐与下游性能。使用CKA（Centered Kernel Alignment）进行逐层表征分析，量化表征漂移及其与任务结果的相关性。

Result: 在6个下游任务中，3个性能提升，其余与基线相当。表征分析显示：对分割任务而言，持续预训练编码器的特征与微调编码器特征的相似度高于原始预训练编码器，且该相似度与观测到的性能提升相关联。

Conclusion: 持续预训练结合LoRA可作为一种改善预训练-下游任务对齐的实用手段，CKA逐层表征分析为量化对齐程度、解释性能变化提供了可解释的诊断工具。

Abstract: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.

</details>


### [601] [Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20220)
*Dong, Zhuobai,Yi, Junchao,Guo, Hu Jian,Li, Linjie,Zhao, Rui,Wang, Alex Jinpeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Glance Forcing 蒸馏框架，将 PF-ODE 轨迹解耦为慢/快双专家并配以分阶段目标，仅用单条 PF-ODE 轨迹即可超越全量训练 SOTA，把轨迹收集成本从数千 GPU 小时降至约 1 A100 小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归因果视频生成是视频世界模型的骨干，当前主流做法是把双向扩散模型蒸馏为因果少步学生模型，但现有流程需离线收集 PF-ODE 轨迹，耗费数万 GPU 小时与 TB 级存储，转换成本过高；而把监督压缩到单样本这一极限设定会导致严重质量崩塌，根源在于教师轨迹在高噪声（语义布局与运动）与低噪声（细节纹理）区间曲率与优化行为本质不同，单一学生无法同时拟合而产生表征干扰。

Method: Glance Forcing：轻量蒸馏框架，将去噪轨迹解耦为互补的慢专家与快专家，各自由针对所处阶段定制的目标函数引导，同时完全冻结预训练教师；仅需单条 PF-ODE 轨迹进行监督，从而大幅削减轨迹收集开销。分析层面进一步提出少步蒸馏机制解释：PF-ODE 蒸馏主要负责拉直少步轨迹几何，而随后的分布匹配阶段独立决定分布质量。

Result: 仅使用一条 PF-ODE 轨迹即超过完全训练的 SOTA 基线，VBench Total 从 84.04 提升至 84.22；轨迹收集成本从数千 GPU 小时降至约 1 张 A100 的 1 小时；在动态程度、VisionReward 与指令跟随上增益更明显，并获得人类评估者相对强基线的稳定偏好。

Conclusion: 通过按噪声区间解耦专家与阶段特定目标，可在极端监督压缩下实现高效少步因果视频蒸馏，并揭示轨迹拉直与分布匹配两个环节的独立作用，为视频世界模型的高效因果化生成提供了低成本可行路径。

Abstract: Autoregressive generation underlies real-time, causal video synthesis and is the backbone of video world models. Today's dominant approach distills a bidirectional diffusion model into a causal few-step student, but existing pipelines make this conversion prohibitively expensive, requiring offline Probability Flow ODE} (PF-ODE) trajectories that cost tens of thousands of GPU-hours and terabytes of storage. We show it can be made dramatically more efficient. Pushing this efficiency to its extreme, we reduce trajectory supervision to a single sample, the strictest setting possible, and find that it causes severe quality collapse. We trace this to the teacher's trajectory geometry: the high-noise regime, governing semantic layout and motion, and the low-noise regime, governing fine texture exhibit fundamentally different curvature and optimization behavior, so a single monolithic student cannot jointly fit both, causing severe representation interference. Motivated by this, we propose Glance Forcing, a lightweight distillation framework that decouples the denoising trajectory into two complementary slow and fast experts, each guided by a tailored, stage-specific objective, while keeping the pretrained teacher entirely frozen. This decoupling further reveals a general mechanism underlying few-step distillation: PF-ODE distillation mainly straightens the few-step trajectory geometry, while the subsequent distribution-matching stage independently governs distributional quality. Using only one PF-ODE trajectory, Glance Forcing already surpasses the fully-trained state-of-the-art baseline, raising the VBench Total score from 84.04 to 84.22 while cutting trajectory-collection cost from thousands of GPU-hours to about one A100-GPU-hour, with markedly larger gains in dynamic degree, VisionReward, and instruction-following, and consistent preference from human raters over strong baselines.

</details>


### [602] [PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20240)
*Yang, Siqi,Wang, Yimu,Cai, Ziqi,Zhu, Chengxuan,Weng, Shuchen,Wu, Erwin,Yu, Zhaofei,Zhang, Kaipeng,Shi, Boxin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAWA：面向Minecraft多人世界建模的动作条件化全景数据集与双塔模型，同步采集玩家POV视频、世界稳定全景视频与动作，支持>64人并发并可在不重放游戏的情况下重渲染，并引入二次相位玩家编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多人世界模型需预测多个玩家独立动作对共享环境的改变，包括当前视野外的变化；POV视频只能看到进入视野后的变化，全景视频可作为世界状态的中间表示。然而现有数据集缺少Minecraft中同步的POV+全景视频+动作组合。

Method: 构建PAWA数据集与采集框架：分布式流水线解耦CPU游戏采集与GPU渲染，可扩展到64+玩家，并可在新观测配置下重渲染已录制会话而无需重放游戏；模型为双塔结构，联合预测POV与全景视频，通过跨注意力在同一世界坐标系下对齐朝向相同的token；提出二次相位玩家编码，在相同嵌入维度下提供远多于旋转变换编码的玩家码。

Result: 实验显示PAWA在POV预测质量上优于现有多人世界模型，同时能生成高保真全景预测。数据集与采集流水线开源。

Conclusion: 该工作为多人世界建模提供了可扩展的数据与模型范式，开源数据与流水线可支持后续多人世界模型研究。

Abstract: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.

</details>


### [603] [Contrastive uncertainty learning for robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20251)
*Sidiqi, Bilal,Wang, Yipei,Yan, Wen,Saeed, Shaheer U.,Alexander, Daniel C.,Hu, Yipeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Contrastive Uncertainty Learning（CUL），用预测不确定性直接引导表征学习，在3D前列腺MRI多结构分割中保持Dice不变的同时显著降低表面距离误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI解剖结构边界模糊，依赖全局重叠损失（如Dice）的自动分割方法对表面偏差不敏感，在模糊区域易产生显著误差；现有不确定性方法多把不确定性当作事后质量指标或预测过滤器，未用于指导表征学习。

Method: CUL是一个有监督框架，通过Monte Carlo Dropout估计体素级预测不确定性，并据此塑造嵌入空间的几何结构：低不确定性且预测正确的特征作为稳定锚点，高不确定性或误分类特征被主动排斥，避免困难边界处特征坍缩。同时利用不确定性引导样本选择。在589例3D前列腺MRI、8个解剖结构的分割任务上评估，骨干为ViT + UperNet解码器。

Result: 平均Dice为83.38%（基线83.35%，基本可比），但8个结构中6个的表面距离显著下降（p<0.001）。困难病例分析显示改善与退化病例间存在22倍不对称性（18.8% vs 0.9%）。消融显示：去掉不确定性引导的样本选择会消除移行区的改善；用边界损失替代对比目标还会额外消除膀胱的改善，说明不确定性引导采样与对比目标二者均为收益来源。

Conclusion: 不确定性引导的表征学习可有效降低安全关键医学分割中出现极端错误的风险，且不牺牲平均重叠性能；该机制不依赖事后过滤，而是直接塑造特征几何。

Abstract: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures) using a ViT with UperNet decoder architecture. Average Dice ($83.38\%$) remains comparable to the baseline ($83.35\%$), while surface distance decreases significantly ($p<0.001$) across 6 of 8 anatomical structures. A hard-case analysis reveals a $22{\times}$ asymmetry between significantly improved and degraded cases ($18.8\%$ vs $0.9\%$). Ablation studies show that removing uncertainty-guided sample selection eliminates improvements for the transition zone, while replacing the contrastive objective with a boundary loss additionally removes bladder improvements, demonstrating that both uncertainty-guided sampling and the contrastive objective are essential for the observed gains. These findings demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided representation learning is a useful mechanism for reducing the risk of extreme errors in safety-critical medical segmentation

</details>


### [604] [GLoD-LVSM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Continuous-LoD Scene Representations for Large View Synthesis Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20254)
*Lin, Weikai,Milef, Nicholas,Marshall, Carl S,Yang, Grant Kaijuin,Keeler, Todd,Zhu, Yuhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GLoD-LVSM 提出一种几何接地的连续细节层次场景表示，用于大视角合成模型（LVSM）的令牌压缩，在保持渲染质量的同时显著减少场景令牌数并加速渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVSM 可从稀疏视角重建场景并快速渲染新视角，但令牌冗余导致不必要的存储与渲染开销。现有压缩方法缺乏连续细节层次与几何引导。

Method: 1) 学习连续场来初始化可变数量的锚点以匹配预算，替代固定锚点初始化；2) 冷凝器将场景信息聚合到锚点，场与冷凝器端到端训练；3) 冷凝器推断参考令牌与锚点几何，通过几何接地注意力指导压缩，提升渲染质量并支持解码时的视锥剔除。

Result: 在渲染质量与场景令牌数的权衡上优于现有场景压缩基线；相比未压缩基模型，令牌数减少 33.4%、渲染加速 1.23×且无质量损失；放宽质量损失预算后令牌减少达 85.5%、加速 3.00×。分析显示视角合成监督涌现出场景深度与自组织锚点，锚点贴合表面并按局部纹理复杂度调整密度；该表示还支持场景语义理解。

Conclusion: GLoD-LVSM 以几何接地方式实现连续细节层次的紧凑场景表示，有效降低存储与渲染成本，并展现对下游语义任务的潜力。

Abstract: Large view synthesis models (LVSMs) reconstruct scenes from sparse views and render novel views quickly, but they incur unnecessary storage and rendering costs due to token redundancy. We present GLoD-LVSM, a compact, geometry-grounded scene representation for LVSMs with continuous levels of detail. First, instead of learning a fixed set of scene anchor initializations, GLoD-LVSM learns a continuous field that initializes a flexible number of anchors to match the desired budget. A condenser then aggregates scene information into these anchors, with both the field and condenser trained end-to-end. Second, the condenser infers reference-token and anchor geometry to guide compression through geometry-grounded attention, improving rendering quality and enabling frustum culling during decoding. Compared with existing LVSM scene-compression baselines, GLoD-LVSM achieves the best trade-off between rendering quality and scene token count. Compared with the uncompressed base model, GLoD-LVSM reduces the scene-token count by 33.4% and accelerates rendering by $1.23\times$ with no quality loss. Under a relaxed quality-loss budget, the reduction increases to 85.5%, with $3.00\times$ rendering speedup. Further analysis reveals that view-synthesis supervision yields emergent scene depth and self-organized anchors that align with surfaces and adapt their density to local texture complexity. Beyond rendering, we further show that our scene representation also supports scene-semantic understanding, highlighting its potential for broader downstream tasks.

</details>


### [605] [A Valid Watermark Is Not a Valid Identity: Spatial-Spectral Adversarial Face Evasion with Watermark Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20278)
*Chivata, Jefferson David Rodriguez,Ghiani, Davide,La Cava, Simone Maurizio,Micheletto, Marco,Orrù, Giulia,Marcialis, Gian Luca*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 黑盒设置下提出PGD-L2水印保持的人脸逃逸攻击：用空间+频谱保持项约束扰动，使识别相似度下降（逃逸率>92%），同时保持水印可恢复率（StegaFormer>93%，FaceSigns>99.7%）与视觉质量（PSNR>47dB）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面部水印仅支持溯源/篡改检测，不足以保证生物识别身份的可靠性；需要探究"水印有效但识别失效"的结构性漏洞。

Method: 黑盒水印设置（不访问水印模块）；PGD-L2对抗扰动，加入空间域与频谱域保持正则项，在降低人脸识别相似度的同时抑制像素级失真与高频变化，避免破坏隐藏水印信号。

Result: 两种水印方案、两种识别模型、两个数据集：逃逸率>92%（操作阈值下），水印恢复率StegaFormer>93%、FaceSigns>99.7%，ε₂=2.0时PSNR>47dB。

Conclusion: 揭示基于水印的人脸认证存在结构性缺陷——图像可同时水印有效、视觉保真，却生物识别不可靠；水印与人脸识别安全需联合评估。

Abstract: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.

</details>


### [606] [Event Cameras versus Frame Cameras for Synthetic-Aperture Imaging: A Simulation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20309)
*Hinterholzer, Jakob,Youssef, Mohamed,Bimber, Oliver*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在仿真中对比事件相机与帧相机用于合成孔径成像（SAI）去遮挡的效果，提出将每个事件按各自插值位姿直接投影到焦平面的新积分路径，并与机载光学切分渲染器对比。高速明亮场景下事件相机能重建目标而帧相机不能；但低速且等数据预算时事件相机无明显优势，且其数据率在最快最亮（最需要时）场景达到峰值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成孔径成像此前主要基于帧相机，作者想探究事件相机在SAI去遮挡中是否具有优势，并希望在完全相同的场景与相机运动下进行公平的传感器对比。

Method: 用Blender密集渲染序列；按EMVA 1288噪声模型生成工业全局快门相机的帧，用参数化为Sony IMX636的v2e仿真器生成事件流；帧用现有airborne optical sectioning渲染器积分；为事件新增积分路径，将每个事件按其插值位姿投影到焦平面，无需把事件分箱成帧。共进行三次主实验及一次暗光高速测试，并在等数据预算下对比两传感器。

Result: 明亮场景25 m/s下帧相机仅记录3张图像、无法去遮挡，事件相机即使经事件率控制器丢弃大部分事件仍能重建目标；5 lux、同速下事件相机也无法分辨目标；5 lux、5 m/s下两者重建质量相近。高速时受限事件流仍以与3帧相同的数据量呈现目标；1 m/s等数据预算下事件相机在重建质量上无优势。事件相机数据率依赖场景，且恰在最需要的最快最亮场景中最高。

Conclusion: 事件相机在高动态/高速明亮场景的SAI去遮挡中具有独特优势，可避免分箱并直接从事件重建，但在低速或等数据预算时优势不明显，且数据率需求与场景难度正相关。结论基于仿真，需真实硬件验证。

Abstract: Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) removes occluders such as foliage by integrating many views of a scene along a camera path. It has so far been used mainly with frame cameras. We ask whether an event camera has advantages for SAI, and answer the question in simulation, where both sensors see exactly the same scene and the same camera movement. A densely rendered Blender sequence is turned into frames with an EMVA~1288 noise model of an industrial global-shutter camera, and into an event stream with the v2e simulator parameterized like a Sony IMX636. The frames are integrated with the existing airborne optical sectioning renderer. For the events we add a new integration path that projects every single event onto the focal plane at its own interpolated pose, so no events have to be binned into frames. We compare the two sensors in three main runs and an additional dark high-speed test. In a bright scene at 25,m/s the frame camera records only three images on the path and cannot remove the occluder, while the event camera reconstructs the target, even after an event-rate controller drops most of its events to fit the camera link. At the same speed in a 5,lux scene the event camera no longer resolves the target either. In a 5,lux scene at 5,m/s both sensors reconstruct the target at similar quality. We also compare the data one traversal of the aperture costs. At high speed the capped event stream still shows the target at the same data volume as the three frames. At 1,m/s we compare both cameras at two matched data budgets, and there the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in reconstruction quality. The data rate of the event camera depends on the scene and is highest exactly in the fast bright scenes where it is needed most.

</details>


### [607] [Beyond Static Cues: Unified Dynamic Detection of MLLM Backdoors via Dual-Flow Trajectory Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20319)
*Huang, Yinzhen,Xie, Jiahe,Sun, Yitong,Zhang, Ruochen,Wei, Xingxing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EVO-Detect，将多模态大模型后门检测从静态快照范式转为动态输出演化范式，通过监视早期解码步的 Attention Flow 与 Logits Flow 两条轨迹并借助负对照归一化，实现对未知类型多模态后门攻击的统一检测，显著优于 BYE、TCAP 等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 已进入安全关键场景，但后门威胁严峻。现有防御从视觉 patch 线索演进到无监督内部注意力统计，仍受限于两个根本缺陷：依赖静态快照、依赖攻击特定启发式。多模态触发设计空间巨大（文本注入、亚感知噪声、跨模态协同触发），固定先验易被绕过，尤其在实际部署中攻击类型未知时。

Method: 核心洞察：成功攻击必然劫持解码轨迹——生成过程中内部模态贡献被扭曲，同时对输入扰动表现出异常的输出不变性。据此提出 EVO-Detect：在早期解码步监视内部信号的动态演化，设两条互补通道：(1) Attention Flow，度量图像—文本注意力分配随生成推进的演化；(2) Logits Flow，通过干预式消融量化输出分布对模态扰动的敏感度。将轨迹压缩为样本级紧凑指标，并与负对照签名做归一化，以降低自然扰动被误判为后门证据的概率。

Result: 在多种攻击族上大量评测，EVO-Detect 显著优于 BYE、TCAP 等当前最优基线（摘要未给出具体数值与数据集细节）。

Conclusion: 后门检测的有效判别信号不在静态内部统计，而在生成过程中的动态演化；注意力流动与 logits 敏感度的轨迹组合可作为攻击类型无关的统一检测依据。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, yet their susceptibility to backdoor attacks remains a formidable challenge. While existing defenses have evolved from visual-centric patch cues to unsupervised internal attention statistics, they are fundamentally constrained by a reliance on static snapshots and attack-specific heuristics. Given the intricate interplay between dual modalities, the vast design space for multimodal triggers allows diverse threats, such as textual injections, sub-perceptual noises, and coordinated cross-modal triggers, to easily circumvent such rigid priors, particularly when attack types are unknown in real-world applications. In this paper, we rethink backdoor detection by shifting the diagnostic paradigm from static observations to dynamic output evolution. We observe that a successful attack inevitably hijacks the model's decoding trajectory, skewing internal modal contributions during generation while maintaining an abnormal output invariance despite input perturbations. To capture this behavior, we propose EVO-Detect, a unified detection framework that monitors the dynamic evolution of internal signals during early decoding steps through two complementary channels: Attention Flow and Logits Flow. The attention branch measures how image-text attention allocation evolves during early generation, whereas the logits branch quantifies the sensitivity of the output distribution to modal perturbations through interventional ablations. We then convert these trajectories into compact sample-level metrics and normalize them against negative-control signatures so that natural perturbations are less likely to be mistaken for backdoor evidence. Extensive evaluations show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as BYE and TCAP across diverse attack families.

</details>


### [608] [Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20335)
*Chen, Yuheng,Chen, Yufan,Cai, Zhuojun,Liu, Ruiping,Zheng, Junwei,Wei, Jiale,Wen, Di,Fan, Weijia,Peng, Kunyu,Zhang, Jiaming,Stiefelhagen, Rainer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Read-Parse-Describe (RPD) 统一基准，将文档解析（布局、OCR、阅读顺序）与视觉元素描述生成整合为页级联合任务，并给出即插即用的空间感知增强器以提升布局感知生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档理解被拆分为布局分析、OCR、阅读顺序预测、图像描述等独立模块评估，割裂了科学图表、图注与视觉语义之间的联系，无法衡量模型能否输出结构忠实且语义可读的页级统一解析结果。

Method: 构建RPD数据集：输入页面图像，要求模型输出有序布局元素列表，含边界框、语义标签、阅读顺序索引、识别文本及视觉元素的替代文本描述；数据规模为2,402篇文档、18,163连续页、125,218布局元素、11,338视觉实例。另提出即插即用空间感知增强器：复用多层视觉特征，并向视觉-语言token注入网格感知空间引导，实现布局感知生成。

Result: 在端到端VLM与流水线解析器上实验，现有系统难以同时恢复阅读顺序与视觉语义；所提增强模型取得较强的联合性能。

Conclusion: 应超越孤立的文档解析模块，走向能联合执行读取、解析与描述的文档理解统一模型；数据集与代码将公开。

Abstract: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD

</details>


### [609] [InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20341)
*Hu, Yongzhen,Yu, Hao,Wang, Jiawei,Zeng, Xianming,Xu, Jianyun,Liu, Xingliang,Hu, Ruizhen,Zhou, Xiaowei,Bao, Hujun,Peng, Sida*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfiniSplat v2 通过解耦几何与属性预测、冻结几何分支、训练时用 GT 相机位姿对齐高斯并采用大角度目标视角监督，在六个数据集上取得前馈高斯重建的 SOTA 渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈高斯重建可从输入图像直接构建 3D 场景用于新视角渲染，但在大视角变化下从预测几何学习高斯属性仍是难点，属性学习存在瓶颈。

Method: 提出 InfiniSplat v2：架构与训练两方面改进——将几何预测与属性预测解耦并冻结几何分支；训练时利用真值相机位姿对齐预测高斯；引入大角度目标视角监督。

Result: 在六个数据集上，同一训练模型的前馈输出在姿态条件与无姿态两种设定下均取得评估方法中最佳平均 LPIPS 与 DISTS；姿态条件下平均 LPIPS 与 DISTS 较最强基线分别降低 25.8% 与 32.9%。并发现仅用图像重建监督学到的不透明度会抑制几何不一致的点。

Conclusion: 解耦几何与属性、位姿对齐与大角度监督可显著提升大视角变化下的前馈高斯渲染质量；不透明度可作为几何一致性的隐式过滤机制。

Abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

</details>


### [610] [ReferFlow: Beyond Final-Target Localization for Complex Referring Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20352)
*Gao, Tianyi,Fang, Han,Wei, Xin,Zhong, Yaoyao,Pan, Zhaoyan,Zhu, Weijie,Sun, Hongbo,Lin, Zhiyu,Yang, Kaicheng,Xu, Jinglin,Yuan, Ye,Li, Hao,Sun, Hao,Xin, Jingmin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轨迹级REC任务与ReferFlow-Bench（Refinement/Shift/Reset/Mixture四类轨迹），并给出ReferFlow方法：用状态化区域潜在推理表示区域状态、轨迹感知并行解码并行恢复坐标块、再用Grounding-Aware GRPO强化跨步一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指代理解（REC）基准多只评估最终目标定位，而复杂查询常包含依赖前置定位结果的中间视觉指代，最终答案式评测无法检验这一逐步grounding过程，因此需要轨迹级评测来暴露模型在连续步骤中保持指代一致性的能力。

Method: 1) 定义轨迹级REC：从单条复杂查询构造有序grounding步骤序列，逐步定位对应目标区域；2) 构建ReferFlow-Bench，覆盖Refinement、Shift、Reset、Mixture四类结构化区域转移；3) ReferFlow通过解耦“交错的文本-潜在轨迹生成”与“坐标解码”：Stateful Region Latent Reasoning将每个目标区域表示为对象索引的连续潜状态并施加显式视觉与空间监督；Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding在四个几何约束精修轮次中并行恢复所有坐标块，每块以其轨迹前缀为条件，减少框内串行依赖、消除框间自回归；4) 采用Grounding-Aware GRPO促进跨步grounding一致并学习自适应轨迹生成。

Result: 实验表明现有模型难以在连续步骤中一致地grounding中间视觉指代；ReferFlow在通用REC基准与ReferFlow-Bench上均取得领先性能。

Conclusion: 将REC从“仅评估最终目标”推进到“轨迹级、逐步可验证”的范式，并证明解耦轨迹生成与坐标解码、辅以grounding感知强化学习，是提升多步指代 grounding 一致性的有效路径；抽象未提及机器人实机或3D重建证据，因此价值主要体现在多模态grounding评测与方法层面。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models have made significant progress in referring expression comprehension (REC), yet most REC benchmarks still focus on final-target localization. Complex queries often involve intermediate visual references with different dependencies on prior grounding, but final-only evaluation leaves this process unexamined. To address this gap, we formulate trajectory-level REC, in which models receive an ordered sequence of grounding steps constructed from a single complex query and localize the target regions associated with each step. We instantiate this setting in ReferFlow-Bench, which characterizes structured region transitions through four trajectory types, namely Refinement, Shift, Reset, and Mixture. Experiments show that current models struggle to consistently ground intermediate visual references across successive steps. We further propose ReferFlow, which decouples interleaved text-latent trajectory generation from coordinate decoding. Specifically, Stateful Region Latent Reasoning represents each target region as an object-indexed state composed of continuous latents, with explicit visual and spatial supervision to preserve region information for subsequent grounding. Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding then recovers all coordinate blocks in parallel through four geometry-constrained refinement rounds, with each block conditioned on its corresponding trajectory prefix, thereby reducing within-box sequential dependencies and eliminating cross-box autoregression. We further apply Grounding-Aware GRPO to promote consistent grounding across steps and learn adaptive trajectory generation from complex REC queries. ReferFlow achieves leading performance on general REC benchmarks and ReferFlow-Bench.

</details>


### [611] [Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20384)
*Zhang, Xu,Wan, Jun,Zhang, Lefei,Zhang, Liangpei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PreActIR 是一个"预判式"图像复原智能体框架：用工具条件世界模型在执行前预测每个候选工具的退化残差、质量、保真度变化及危害风险与不确定性，再由独立验证器决定提交或回滚，从而减少无效调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合退化图像复原智能体只能"先执行再看结果"（execute-then-evaluate），失败调用浪费算力，有害输出要等到执行后才被发现（"too late"），且难以判断性能瓶颈来自选择器还是候选工具空间。

Method: (1) 工具条件世界模型：对每个候选工具预测残差退化、图像质量、保真度的变化，并输出危害风险与预测不确定性；(2) 智能体执行排序最高的候选工具；(3) 独立验证器在规划前对所执行工具的输出进行提交或回滚；(4) 审计性能瓶颈归因于选择器还是候选空间，并研究定向工具适配以扩展候选空间；评测中固定候选池、验证器与预算，并使用带参考标注的退化状态。

Result: 相比反应式"执行后评估"试错基线，PreActIR 真实工具调用减少 42.5%，被拒绝调用减少 63.4%，同时 Y-PSNR 提升 0.92 dB。

Conclusion: 在执行前预测工具后果可显著提升智能体式图像复原的效率与效果，且可回滚机制与瓶颈审计为智能体系统设计提供了可控分析框架。

Abstract: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

</details>


### [612] [STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20390)
*Wang, Shuo,Zhou, Sifan,Wang, Xiaobo,Fu, Tianyu,Zhao, Chenxu,Su, Anyang,Wang, Hanning,Jiang, Ping,Wu, Minghui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STP-GUI提出一种查询引导的空间感知token剪枝框架，在保留指令相关细粒度评分的同时以窗口级空间连贯选择实现激进token削减，用于Web-GUI智能体推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率截图与多轮历史造成视觉token数量过大、推理开销高；已有剪枝方法多面向自然图像并独立按重要性选token，会破坏识别按钮、图标等小GUI元素所需的局部视觉结构。

Method: 提出STP-GUI：查询引导的token剪枝，兼顾指令条件下的细粒度token打分与窗口级空间连贯选择；VLM主干冻结，仅用策略学习优化一个轻量选择器。

Result: Online-Mind2Web上，21% token保留率时保留全token性能的77.7%，推理时延降低31%，FLOPs降低57%；Android in the Wild上显示可迁移到移动GUI环境。

Conclusion: 空间连贯的窗口级剪枝可在激进token预算下取得较好的效率-性能折中，并具备跨Web与移动GUI的迁移性。

Abstract: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

</details>


### [613] [Where Should the Gaussians Go? Reusable Label-Aware Allocation for Budget-Constrained Gaussian Splatting of Cinematic CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20397)
*Xiang, Bowen,Su, Dingjie,Heiselman, Jon S.,Miga, Michael I.*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可复用的解剖标签感知高斯位置分配前端（神经先验与七参数VACF闭式解），在固定B个高斯基元预算下无须逐患者优化即可决定放置位置，显著提升CT血管掩膜PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅在CT电影级渲染中需保留血管结构，但目前表示仍依赖逐患者场景优化：致密化策略决定高斯位置，而实时显示又限制了高斯数量，位置分配这一关键环节缺乏可复用、跨患者的解决方案。

Method: 将患者CT、解剖标签与传输函数映射到2mm体素单元上的密度分布，并从中采样恰好B个位置，其余高斯属性仍逐患者拟合。前端仅学习一次：一种为基于人群训练的神经先验，另一种为可解释的七参数可见性感知闭式解（VACF），二者均从逐患者优化场景中蒸馏得到。

Result: 在20例留出患者、10K–100K高斯预算下，相同属性拟合条件下两者较均匀分配提升血管掩膜PSNR 4.5–7.1dB，较稠密体素对齐模型剪枝提升1.6–3.3dB；神经先验在各预算下与逐患者优化分配无显著差异，VACF在血管区域与神经先验差距≤0.6dB（19例外部患者为≤0.7dB）。作为位置优化初始化，10K时VACF血管指标优于逐患者致密化；25K时118s优化后的血管PSNR超过致密化248s的结果。渲染预设改变时，VACF可迁移到新颜色与光照，但对无标签传输函数失效，神经先验则相反。

Conclusion: 学习式、标签感知的高斯位置分配前端可在固定预算下替代逐患者优化分配，兼顾血管保真度与实时性，但不同前端对渲染预设变化的泛化方向互补，提示可组合使用。

Abstract: Anatomical labels help 3D Gaussian splatting preserve vessels in cinematic renderings of CT, but the representation is still found by optimising each patient's scene, where densification decides where Gaussians go, while real-time displays cap their number. We address one part of this process: deciding where a fixed budget of B Gaussians should be placed. We propose a reusable, labelaware allocation front end that maps a patient's CT, labels and transfer function to a density over 2mm cells and draws exactly B positions from it without per-patient optimisation; the other Gaussian attributes are still fitted per patient. The front end is learned once from per-patient optimised scenes and implemented as a population-trained neural prior and an interpretable seven-parameter visibility-aware closed form (VACF). With identical attribute fitting on 20 held-out patients at 10K-100K Gaussians, both raise vessel-masked PSNR over uniform allocation by 4.5-7.1dB and over pruning a dense voxel-aligned model by 1.6-3.3dB. The neural prior does not differ significantly from per-patient optimised allocation at any budget, and VACF is within 0.6dB of it on vessels; on 19 external patients the neural prior again matches it on vessels and VACF is within 0.7dB. As an initialisation for position optimisation, VACF allocation beats per-patient densification on vessels at 10K Gaussians and, at 25K, reaches a higher vessel PSNR after 118s of optimisation than densification after 248s. Under altered rendering presets, VACF transfers to new colours and lighting but not to a label-free transfer function, whereas the neural prior shows the opposite pattern.

</details>


### [614] [Hybrid supervised instance segmentation by learning label noise suppression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20412)
*Chen, Linwei,Fu, Ying,You, Shaodi,Liu, Hongzhe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合监督实例分割流程，利用两个辅助模型分别抑制前景/背景误标与实例误标噪声，从边界框标签生成高质量伪像素级标签，并结合类别感知空间注意力与自学习策略提升伪标签精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全监督实例分割依赖大规模像素级标注，成本高昂且耗时；弱监督/半监督方法虽降低标注成本，但性能损失明显。目标是在不大幅牺牲精度的情况下降低标注成本。

Method: 设计混合监督流程，结合廉价的边界框标签与少量精确像素级标签。引入两个辅助模型：一个抑制前景-背景误标噪声，另一个抑制实例间误标噪声；并采用类别感知空间注意力模块、类别约束模块、实例约束模块及自学习训练策略提升伪标签质量。

Result: 在 PASCAL VOC 2012 与 Cityscapes 数据集上，该方法以显著更低的标注成本达到具有竞争力的实例分割性能。

Conclusion: 混合监督加噪声抑制的伪标签生成可有效平衡标注成本与分割精度，为降低实例分割数据依赖提供可行路径。

Abstract: To reach top accuracy, current fully supervised instance segmentation methods severely rely on large-scale pixel-wise labeled datasets. They are usually expensive and time-consuming to obtain. Though weakly or semi-supervised methods utilize cheap bounding box labeled, image-level labeled or unlabeled samples to save the labeling cost, their performance is largely sacrificed. To save labeling cost without losing much performance, in this paper, we present a pipeline that can utilize economical bounding box labels and accurate pixel-wise labels in a hybrid way. Specifically, we design two ancillary models to learn label noise suppression and obtain accurate pseudo pixel-wise labels from bounding box labels for training. One is designed to suppress mislabeling between foreground and background, and the other is designed to suppress noise from mislabeling of instances. Moreover, we exploit category-aware spatial attention module, category constraint module, instance constraint module, and self-learning training approach to improve the accuracy of pseudo labels. Experiments on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and the Cityscapes datasets show that our method can achieve competitive performance with much less labeling cost.

</details>


### [615] [Infant Fingerprints: Quality Assessment & Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20432)
*Agnol, João L. H. Dall,Casanova, Dalcimar,Minetto, Rodrigo,Southier, Luiz F. P.,Teixeira, Marcelo,Filipak, Marcelo,Jain, Anil K.*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对婴幼儿指纹识别中因生理特征与采集条件导致的图像质量评估失配问题，本文在跨6个年龄组（新生儿至3个月）的纵向数据集上评估10种指纹质量评估方法，并提出参数调优流程以适配年龄相关特征；经识别实验、模板融合与潜指纹匹配验证，调优配置在多数方法与年龄组上优于默认配置，提升了大库筛选（gallery selection）的有效性与识别的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴幼儿指纹存在脊线宽度与间距小、非自主运动、皮肤残留、指尖压力不均等问题，导致面向成人的指纹质量标准（其假定特征分布对婴幼儿不成立）失效，因此需要评估并重新标定现有质量评估方法。

Method: 在覆盖6个年龄组（新生儿至3个月）的纵向数据集上评估10种指纹质量评估方法；设计参数调优流程，挖掘年龄特异性指纹特征以重新标定具有领域依赖假设的方法；对比默认与调优配置，通过识别实验评估质量引导的gallery选择效果，并进一步考察模板融合策略与潜指纹识别技术。

Result: 调优参数集在大多数方法和年龄组上优于默认配置；模板融合与潜指纹识别被用于探明最优方法可达到的最佳匹配率。

Conclusion: 对现有质量评估框架进行有针对性的重标定可提升gallery效用，并有助于实现更可靠的婴幼儿指纹识别。

Abstract: Infant fingerprint recognition is hindered by a combination of physiological characteristics, such as small ridge width and spacing, and acquisition challenges that include involuntary motion, skin residue, and uneven fingertip pressure. These factors undermine fingerprint quality standards originally designed for adults, which assume feature distributions that do not hold for infants. To address this gap, this paper evaluates ten fingerprint quality assessment methods on a longitudinal dataset that spans six age groups from newborns to three months, alongside a parameter tuning routine that uncovers age-specific fingerprint characteristics to recalibrate methods with domain-dependent assumptions.
