Both default and tuned configurations are compared through recognition experiments assessing the effectiveness of quality-guided gallery selection. Template-fusion strategies and latent fingerprint recognition technologies are further examined to identify the best possible matching rates achievable by the top-performing method. Results show that tuned parameter sets outperform default configurations for the majority of methods and age groups, indicating that targeted recalibration of existing frameworks improves gallery utility and contributes to more reliable infant fingerprint recognition.

</details>


### [616] [Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20494)
*Bajar, Imen,Arcolezi, Héber Hwang,Boutet, Antoine,Frindel, Carole,Maouche, Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了五个冻结的预训练脑MRI编码器在OASIS-2与MIRIAD两个纵向T1加权数据集上的隐私泄露风险，发现发布的学习嵌入仍高度保留个体身份与人口属性信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表示被日益用于在不暴露原始医学影像的前提下共享与复用信息，但学界尚不清楚这些表示究竟保留了多少患者特异性信息，缺乏系统性的实证评估。

Method: 在攻击者同时可获取发布嵌入、对应公开编码器和辅助MRI扫描的威胁模型下，选取涵盖不同架构、预训练目标与训练域的五个冻结编码器，在两个纵向T1加权数据集上开展患者链接（patient linkage）与敏感属性推断实验。

Result: 最高风险表示下，MIRIAD的rank-1患者链接率达99%，OASIS-2超过90%；嵌入中还保留人口属性信息，记录性别预测的平衡准确率在OASIS-2为90.9%、MIRIAD为95.5%，尽管编码器训练时并无身份识别目标。

Conclusion: 以学习嵌入替代原始脑MRI本身并不能消除患者链接或属性推断风险，该做法不足以单独建立匿名性，医学影像表示共享需配套额外隐私防护。

Abstract: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.

</details>


### [617] [OLiVES: An Outdoor Low-Light Video Benchmark for Enhancement and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20501)
*Li, Yini,Lin, Joanne,Blackham, David,Bull, David,Anantrasirichai, Nantheera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OLiVES：首个用专业电影级相机采集的室外低光动态视频基准数据集，含超2.5万对齐正常光/低光帧对与超4.6万VOS标注，联合支持低光视频增强与视频目标分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光视频处理因高质量真值数据稀缺而研究不足；现有公开数据集存在运动多样性有限、场景覆盖窄、退化较弱、依赖事件等辅助模态、低光输入与真值未对齐等问题，且通常只服务于增强或场景理解中的单一任务。

Method: 构建OLiVES基准数据集：室外低光动态场景，由专业电影级相机采集，覆盖自然纹理、动物、遮挡、动态活动与近景等多样内容；提供对齐的正常光-低光帧对与视频目标分割标注；并在其上对当前SOTA的LLVE与VOS方法进行基准评测。

Result: 提供超过25,000对齐正常光/低光帧对与超过46,000条VOS标注；在OLiVES上训练可同时提升低光视频增强与视频目标分割两项任务的性能。

Conclusion: OLiVES填补了室外低光动态视频数据空白，首次以电影级相机采集，并首次将LLVE与VOS联合评测，为该方向提供了新的基准与训练数据。

Abstract: Low-light video processing remains an underexplored problem in computer vision, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality ground-truth data. Existing public datasets exhibit several limitations, including restricted motion diversity, limited scene coverage, weak degradations, reliance on auxiliary modalities such as event data, and misalignment between low-light inputs and ground truth. Furthermore, current datasets typically address either low-light enhancement or scene understanding, whereas these tasks should be considered jointly. We introduce \textbf{OLiVES}, a benchmark dataset for outdoor low-light videos with dynamic scenes, designed to support both low-light video enhancement (LLVE) and video object segmentation (VOS). The dataset addresses key content gaps by incorporating a diverse range of natural textures, animals, occlusions, dynamic activities, and close-up scenes. To the best of our knowledge, OLiVES is the first outdoor low-light video dataset captured using professional cinema-grade cameras. It provides over 25,000 aligned normal- and low-light frame pairs, along with over 46,000 VOS annotations. We benchmark state-of-the-art LLVE and VOS methods on OLiVES and show that training on it improves performance on both tasks. The OLiVES project page is available at: https://anonymous-OLiVES.github.io/.

</details>


### [618] [VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20509)
*Ni, Hairong,Huang, Jiahe,Guo, Minghao,Matusik, Wojciech,Yu, Rose*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VascuSR：一种迭代式解剖感知扩散框架，用显式3D血管表示作为引导，对严重降采样的CT进行生成式超分，减少虚假/断连血管结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式超分在CT中虽能恢复锐利细节，但高频内容并非由低分辨率输入唯一确定，可能生成解剖学上不存在的血管细节（缺失、虚假或错误连接），这对后续血管分析不可接受。

Method: 提出显式3D血管表示以捕捉跨切片结构信息，并由轻量3D生成式细化器在该表示空间内更新血管结构；再用轻量解剖控制器把细化后的结构注入扩散解码器以引导逐切片超分，并通过迭代反馈用新生成的SR体更新引导。

Result: 在重新标注的MSD Task08与HVM数据集上，分割精度（Dice、clDice）和3D血管结构指标（连通性、平均中心线距离）优于插值与学习式SR基线，图像质量与SR主干相当；类平均连通分量数两数据集均降低逾20%，MSD中心线距离降低逾10%。

Conclusion: 将显式3D解剖先验与迭代扩散反馈结合，可显著抑制生成式超分中解剖学不支持的血管伪影，说明结构化引导是提升医学生成式重建结构可信度的有效途径。

Abstract: Generative super-resolution (SR) can recover sharp detail in computed tomography (CT) images from severely downsampled observations, but the missing high-frequency content is not uniquely determined by the low-resolution input. Consequently, visually plausible reconstructions may contain anatomically unsupported vascular detail, such as missing, spurious, or incorrectly connected vessels. To overcome this challenge, we introduce VascuSR, an iterative anatomy-aware diffusion framework that combines image reconstruction with explicit 3D vascular guidance. First, to provide richer anatomical guidance, we use an explicit 3D vascular representation that captures structural information beyond individual slices. This representation also simplifies vascular refinement by allowing a lightweight 3D generative refiner to focus on vascular structure rather than complex CT appearance. Second, to guide slice-wise SR, a lightweight anatomy controller injects the refined structure into the diffusion decoder, while iterative feedback updates this guidance from each new SR volume. On re-annotated MSD Task08 and HVM datasets, VascuSR outperforms interpolation and learning-based SR baselines in segmentation accuracy (Dice and clDice) and 3D vascular structure (connectivity and mean centerline distance), while maintaining image quality comparable to its SR backbone. Compared with learning-based baselines, VascuSR reduces class-averaged connected-component counts by over 20% on both datasets and mean centerline distance by over 10% on MSD.

</details>


### [619] [Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20543)
*Kong, Minghao,Yao, Deng,Zhang, Xi,Gao, Ying,Chen, Jiurun,Liu, Zirong,Wang, Rongjie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可靠性感知网络 RM-Net，处理 CMU-MOSEI 对齐多模态特征中连续片段缺失问题，保留时序位置、用学习 token 表示缺失、输出受观察质量门控的有界模态强度，并通过双视图连续段掩码训练；与 LoRA-BERT 文本专家融合后在留出集达 macro-F1 0.655（干净）与 0.634（40% 混合缺失），并用 Shapley 与位置遮挡提供解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态情感模型通常在完整话语上评估，但真实流中常丢失连续的文本、音频或视频片段；作者希望研究对齐特征上的局部缺失（local missingness）并提升模型在此情形下的可靠性与可解释性。

Method: 在 CMU-MOSEI 对齐特征上定义局部缺失设置；RM-Net 保留原始时序位置，用学习 token 表示未观察位置，输出有界的逐模态强度贡献并由观察质量门控；训练时采用连续段落的双视图掩码；推理阶段将 5 个 RM-Net 种子与 LoRA 适配的 BERT 文本专家按仅依赖可见内容 token 比例的门控权重融合。解释方面使用八个模态子集上的精确 Shapley 归因与位置级遮挡；另描述一套面向原始视频片段的词级对齐流程（不参与预测）。

Result: 留出集上融合模型 macro-F1 为 0.655（干净输入）与 0.634（40% 混合缺失）；双视图平均相较辅助头基线提升 0.024（95% 视频簇 bootstrap 区间 [0.003, 0.045]）；但该划分在开发中被查看过，非盲测。解释方面，最高排名位置的遮挡比随机位置更快降低预测类概率（验证集 AUC 差 0.113）。

Conclusion: RM-Net 通过保留位置、学习缺失 token、质量门控与双视图掩码训练，在局部缺失条件下取得稳定的多模态情感分类性能，并提供 Shapley/遮挡级可解释性；作者强调其留出集数字非盲测，需谨慎解读。该工作属于多模态情感计算与缺失鲁棒性方向，与 Physical AI/VLA/具身导航/3D 重建等核心方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.

</details>


### [620] [Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20556)
*Huang, Yubo,Zhang, Yuxuan,Liu, Jiaming,Zhao, Sirui,Chen, Enhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Speculative Sampling：用带噪声潜变量填充扩展双向注意力窗口并缓存预测增量交付，打破 chunk 边界导致的等待下界，使交互式视频生成中窗口大小成为可调决策变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频生成通常依赖小的双向 chunk 以降低响应延迟，但实验表明更大的 chunk 可提升视频质量并更好利用 GPU 并行性，仅小幅增加采样时间。因此需要一种兼顾大窗口建模能力与小窗口低延迟交互的策略。

Method: 以噪声潜变量作为 padding 扩展建模窗口，缓存相应预测结果，在条件不变时复用；预测增量式交付，未提交的未来保持可替换。并从延迟角度分析该机制消除了 chunk 边界带来的等待时间下界。

Result: 延迟分析显示等待时间下界被消除，优化重心从缩小 chunk 尺寸转向加速单 chunk 采样；双向窗口大小成为联合优化视觉质量与采样时间的决策变量。

Conclusion: 该方法为在交互式流式系统中服务大型双向模型提供了无需复杂流式后训练的路径。

Abstract: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.

</details>


### [621] [A$^3$PreCore: Robust Rigid Registration for Native FLAIR-Space Brain-Mask Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20561)
*Mirzabeigi, Elmira,Khalilzad, Zahra,Snowden-Richardson, Taylor,Arce, Jesus Eduardo Lugo,Gawryluk, Jodie R.,Christie, Brian R.,Faubert, Jocelyn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出A$^3$PreCore六自由度刚体配准策略，将T1脑掩膜可靠迁移至原生FLAIR空间，并引入E-QC多维质量控制框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T1到FLAIR刚体配准不稳定时，脑掩膜向原生FLAIR空间的可靠迁移常失败，需要更稳健的配准策略和更全面的质量评估手段。

Method: 将偏置校正后的T1加权图像通过归一化互信息对齐到原生FLAIR，同时保留已建立的T1空间解剖掩膜；并提出扩展定量质量控制E-QC，刻画掩膜范围、视野相对位置、FLAIR强度支持、边界支持、下部形态与成对几何不一致性。

Result: 78例配对数据中，fsl_anat出现严重刚体错配21/78（26.9%），A$^3$PreCore为0/78（McNemar p=9.54e-7）；57例无严重错配者中位Dice=0.993，配对ΔNMI中位数-0.00007（p=0.429）；与BET中位Dice=0.955；盲法神经科学家在35/40例（87.5%）中将A$^3$PreCore排第一；E-QC还发现全局描述符与质心位移无法揭示的方向性不一致。

Conclusion: A$^3$PreCore是稳健的原生FLAIR脑掩膜迁移策略，E-QC可作为多维掩膜表征与个体化几何质量控制的互补框架。

Abstract: Reliable brain-mask transfer into native fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) space can fail when T1-to-FLAIR rigid registration is unstable. We developed A$^3$PreCore, a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-registration strategy that aligns the full bias-corrected T1-weighted image to native FLAIR using normalized mutual information while preserving the established T1-space anatomical mask. We also introduced extended quantitative quality control (E-QC), which characterizes mask extent, field-of-view-relative position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary support, inferior morphology, and pairwise geometric disagreement. In 78 participants with paired T1-weighted and FLAIR imaging, A$^3$PreCore was compared with fsl_anat and the Brain Extraction Tool (BET). Gross rigid-body misregistration occurred in 21/78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%) and 0/78 A$^3$PreCore outputs (exact two-sided McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7). Among 57 participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration, A$^3$PreCore preserved close agreement (median Dice=0.993; median paired Delta NMI=-0.00007, p=0.429). A$^3$PreCore remained broadly concordant with BET (median Dice=0.955), with less inferior and extracranial extension in representative comparisons. Method-blinded neuroscientists ranked A$^3$PreCore first in 35/40 participants (87.5%). E-QC additionally exposed severe orientation-related disagreement not evident from global descriptors or centroid displacement alone. These findings support A$^3$PreCore as a robust native-FLAIR brain-mask transfer strategy and E-QC as a complementary framework for multidimensional mask characterization and participant-specific geometric quality control.

</details>


### [622] [Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20571)
*Wang, Weijie,Zhang, Haomin,Li, Ye,Liu, Akide,Zhang, Zeyu,Zhao, Haoyu,He, Yefei,Chen, Donny Y.,Chen, Feng,Zhuang, Bohan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ATAS 将剧本编译为带显式地点、相机与事件时间引用的镜头请求，构建静态场景记忆与动态事件记忆，生成前检索、生成后重建并注册，仅在审核与状态检查通过时更新记忆，从而提升长视频跨镜头时空一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体视频生成需要在非连续请求之间保持空间与时间一致：既要能回到同一场景（共享空间坐标），又要能重放特定时刻的事件（时间索引记录）。仅靠传递提示词或最近帧，缺乏共享空间框架与可索引的时间记录，无法支持场景重现与事件回溯。

Method: 提出 ATAS 框架：1）把剧本编译为带 location、camera、event-time 显式引用的镜头请求；2）生成前从两个记忆检索证据——注册静态几何的 scene memory 和按场景/事件/时间索引动态观测的 event memory；3）生成后对片段进行重建与注册；4）仅当 review 与 state checks 通过才接受观测并更新记忆，而影片交付不依赖记忆准入（解耦）。

Result: 在四种视频生成骨干上，ATAS 提升全部报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并在每个骨干上取得最高综合基准分；在目标图像空间重访上优于对比的智能体方法与 3D 引导方法，在事件重捕获的三项标准上领先，并在全部六项人类评价标准上获得最高分。

Conclusion: 显式的空间-时间引用加记忆检索与注册机制，可有效解决长时程生成中的跨镜头一致性，具备良好的模型无关泛化性（四种骨干均受益），为智能体式可控长视频生成提供了可复用范式。

Abstract: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.

</details>


### [623] [Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20584)
*Ouyang, Mingyu,Wang, Yiran,Hu, Siyuan,Yin, Xingyilang,Sun, Huiqiang,Wang, Guangzhi,Pu, Junfu,Cheng, Cheng,Chen, Honghao,Shan, Ying,Shou, Mike Zheng,Ng, Hwee Tou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Player-1后训练框架，通过合成经验与多环境RL扩展计算机使用智能体在游戏中的控制能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏智能体依赖大规模演示，动态状态覆盖有限，且可扩展的交互训练环境稀缺，因此需要超越演示的合成经验学习方案。

Method: 扩展动作空间（相对指针运动、持续输入、复合动作）；用6,044条精选游戏轨迹对计算机使用模型进行监督初始化；构建Player-1-Gym共16个合成2D/3D环境，提供可程序化验证奖励与随机化观测/控制动态，用PPO做多环境强化学习。

Result: Player-1-9B与Player-1-35B-A3B在MineDojo-300上较SFT策略分别提升27.8与17.7个百分点；9B版本达38.33%成功率，最强基线为12.63%；在ViZDoom-10与GameWorld上亦优于SFT。更广的合成环境覆盖提升迁移性，RL中复合动作使用率上升。

Conclusion: 从合成经验学习可显著超越监督初始化，且收益可泛化到RL训练套件之外，为通用数字控制提供可扩展路径。

Abstract: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.

</details>


### [624] [Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20590)
*Choi, Seungmi,Choi, Ji-Hyoun,Jo, Suhyun,Park, Tae-Gwon,Kim, Hui Yong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MFGS 提出端到端前馈多视图特征编码框架，直接压缩多视图特征而非显式高斯表示，实现高斯属性联合预测与可调渲染预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS场景编码采用"先生成后压缩"流程：先生成完整高斯表示，再分别编码几何与外观属性，涉及不可微操作，需要复杂的属性专用编解码设计，且限制了跨属性冗余的利用，压缩性能受限。

Method: MFGS 从输入图像提取多视图特征并编码为紧凑码流，通过端到端率失真训练学习同时表征几何与外观的紧凑特征，接收端从解码特征预测高斯属性；并引入重要性引导的高斯选择，使接收端可在同一码流下调整渲染所用高斯数量。

Result: 在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV 上，按 BD-rate 衡量相较"先生成后压缩"流程节省 99.76-99.86% 码率，总 GMACs 降低 52-55%，端到端加速约 12 倍。

Conclusion: MFGS 证明将编码对象从显式高斯表示前移至多视图特征，可联合挖掘跨属性冗余并支持速率-渲染预算灵活权衡，为前馈3D场景编码提供更高效的端到端范式。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.

</details>


### [625] [GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20592)
*Li, Haoyuan,Cao, Qihang,Zhou, Huanyuan,Hu, Xin,Chen, Sijia,Guo, Zihan,Xiang, Kun,Nie, Yunshuang,Tang, Tao,Zheng, Xinlong,Bian, Jia-Wang,Liu, Xianming,Liang, Xiaodan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoThinker-$F$ 通过将因果MLLM隐状态转化为预测性潜在世界表征，在不依赖外部3D编码器的情况下实现空间智能，推理速度提升最高3.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知多模态大模型依赖外部3D编码器提供结构先验，但推理时额外的编码器路径带来显著延迟与算力开销。

Method: 解耦两阶段训练：第一阶段冻结MLLM主干，用轻量Latent Frame Prediction (LFP)头从离线3D几何专家和下一帧语义目标学习；第二阶段移除外部专家，通过专门的Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion模块联合优化模型以生成并选择性整合自预测先验。

Result: 在多个空间智能基准上保持有竞争力的性能，同时消除对运行时外部3D几何编码器的依赖；推理加速最高3.6倍，延迟从1.45s降至0.40s。

Conclusion: 内部化时空感知是可行的：中间语义表征足以预测有用的当前几何与未来语义表征，无需精确复现专用3D编码器特征；该框架在保持空间推理能力的同时显著提升效率。

Abstract: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

</details>


### [626] [DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20598)
*Cao, Qihang,Li, Haoyuan,Guo, Zihan,Gao, Sensen,Gao, Zihui,Zhang, Huixin,He, Fan,Han, Jianhua,Xu, Hang,Liang, Xiaodan,Bian, Jia-Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynThinker统一框架，通过D-EMA参数约束与时空先验融合，缓解静态3D与动态4D能力间的干扰，在9个基准的统一模型上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型难以同时擅长静态3D与动态4D空间理解：3D后训练会削弱动态理解，4D专用模型缺乏静态3D推理。作者发现这种"空间-动态干扰"在参数组间高度不均匀，尤其对后层MLP敏感。

Method: 提出DynThinker：(1) D-EMA，按参数组可配置的指数移动平均，约束干扰敏感预训练参数的漂移，同时保留能力增强的灵活性；(2) SDF，在语义引导下将动态几何编码器的空间与时序先验选择性注入VLM中间表示。

Result: 在9个静态3D与动态4D基准的10项指标上取得最高平均分；ReVSI 56.0、DSR-Bench 67.2、DSI-Bench样本级51.2与组级40.1，四项评测均刷新所比较的开源模型SOTA。

Conclusion: 参数组级干扰分析与D-EMA+SDF组合可有效统一静态3D与动态4D空间推理，单模型兼顾两类能力。

Abstract: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

</details>


### [627] [CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20603)
*Xu, Xiaoli,Wu, Zhengtao,Xu, Zhengze,Liu, Tao,Du, Yongchao,Gao, Zuan,Wang, Xingjian,Yan, Hao,Chen, Mengting,Li, Wei,Zheng, Bo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CommerceGen-Studio 是一个面向电商 SKU 商用主图生成的端到端三阶段框架（信息抽取—语义改写—多条件生成），由 PERL-Agent、布局思维优化 LTO 与 SKU-DiT 组成，已在每天数百万张主图的规模上落地，并发布 CommerceGen-Bench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商主图需同时满足主体保真、商标完整与字符级文案准确，传统单阶段文生图难以在商用规模下稳定产出可发布的合规主图；作者希望以结构化流水线把异质 SKU 元数据转成可控的生成条件。

Method: 三阶段流水线：PERL-Agent 通过 VLM/LLM 迭代闭环加无参考评分量表，将异质 SKU 元数据蒸馏为卖点文本列表；LTO 用交替的领域策略优化让改写器兼顾 caption 与渲染图质量；SKU-DiT 在 RDR（Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce）渐进训练下，联合以白底产品图、商标裁剪图与结构化布局为条件进行生成。

Result: 每天生成数百万张主图，单图延迟数秒；在 CommerceGen-Bench 上，无论有无提示增强，两个编辑赛道均取得所比开源基线中的最高总分，并能与更大规模闭源模型持平，在指令遵循与产品融合两项决定可发布性的指标上超过其中若干。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了多条件扩散生成结合 LLM/VLM 智能体闭环，可支撑商用级电商主图生产，属于该方向较早实现商业规模运行的系统之一。

Abstract: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.

</details>


### [628] [VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20604)
*Liang, Ao,Liu, Youquan,Li, Mingxiao,Chow, Wei,Kong, Lingdong,Liao, Yue,Lu, Dongyue,Yang, Yu,Yin, Wei,Chen, Runnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VITAL 动作分词器，将动作目标直接从视觉运动（motion scaffold）导出并叠加规范化残差编码轨迹误差，用 flow matching 联合预测，NAVSIM v1 单步达 90.8 PDMS，v2 达 91.1 EPDMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型旨在把视觉预判转化为驾驶决策，但现有动作专家多在独立于视觉动态的轨迹表示上训练，导致动作目标与视觉运动脱耦。作者希望让动作目标直接由视觉运动导出，使视觉运动成为主要预测目标。

Method: 先验证简化设定：用记录的未来图像重建轨迹，发现即使无需未来预测，重建也能捕捉主导机动但残留厘米级误差。据此提出 VITAL：将视觉导出的运动骨架与一个小型残差结合的动作分词器，残差编码骨架遗留的轨迹误差并单独归一化。用 flow matching 使动作专家从当前图像、自车状态与导航指令联合预测两分量，推理时无需生成未来图像。同一残差坐标支持有界强化学习后训练，在固定视觉骨架下优化执行。

Result: 单步动作去噪下在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 达 90.8 PDMS，与十步分数差距仅 0.13 分，端到端推理速度提升 3.29 倍；无需重训即在 NAVSIM v2 navtest 达 91.1 EPDMS，navhard 达 38.6。

Conclusion: VITAL 表明直接从视觉运动派生动作表示可有效桥接视觉预判与驾驶决策，在保持骨架固定的前提下用归一化残差处理小尺度修正，并以极少去噪步数实现高精度、高效率的闭环驾驶策略，且具备跨数据集零重训泛化能力。

Abstract: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital

</details>


### [629] [Representation Conditioning for Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20608)
*Razavi, Saeed,Leng, Xingjian,Zheng, Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出representation conditioning（RECON），将预训练视觉编码器token注入扩散Transformer的后层，推理时用训练后保留的MLP头作为编码器代理，实现免新增参数的更快收敛，比SiT快63×、比REPA快25×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: REPA类表示对齐方法通过MLP投影头对中间层施加对齐损失，仅靠反向传播影响早期层；后期层只受速度预测损失监督，无法保证有效获取视觉编码器的语义信息。

Method: 训练时把预训练视觉编码器的token直接送入扩散Transformer的靠后层作为条件；推理时无干净图像，故复用原本训练后丢弃的MLP头，将其输出token投影到后层，从而不引入额外参数。

Result: 收敛显著加速：相对SiT提速63×，相对REPA提速25×；方法零新增参数，代码已开源。

Conclusion: RECON以极简方式弥补表示对齐方法在后层语义传递上的不足，兼顾效率与无参量开销，为扩散Transformer训练加速提供实用方案。

Abstract: Representation-alignment methods effectively accelerate the diffusion transformer training. REPA, for example, uses a pretrained vision encoder to supervise an intermediate layer through an MLP projection head which is discarded after training. It aims to import semantics from the vision encoder to the diffusion backbone. While this objective is achieved at early layers by back-propagating the alignment loss, there is no guarantee that later layers, supervised by the velocity prediction loss alone, can well access such semantics. We propose a simple solution, representation conditioning (RECON), to improve semantics in later layers. During training, we feed the pretrained vision encoder tokens into later layers; during inference, because we no longer have the clean image, we reuse the MLP head (as a proxy to the vision encoder) and project its output tokens to the later layers. Our method adds no parameters and leads to much faster convergence: RECON is $63\times$ faster than SiT and $25\times$ faster than REPA. Code is available at https://github.com/saeidrazavi/RECON

</details>


### [630] [Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20610)
*Koo, Jahyeok,Yu, Hyeonseo,Jang, Seungho,Jung, Jaewoo,Kang, Jiwon,Cho, Seokju,Kim, Seungryong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ask4NV 将 3D 语言理解作为新视角生成的互补监督，基于统一多模态模型（MoT 架构），把相机几何注入 VAE 与 ViT 表征，并用模态感知掩码的联合自注意力在生成中利用理解特征，在图像质量、几何一致性与 3D 语言理解上取得较好表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限观测生成新视角需同时保持外观与空间结构。现有方法多利用细粒度几何线索，却未显式建模目标身份、属性及物体间关系等高层语义与空间属性，因此作者探索 3D 语言理解能否为新视角生成提供互补监督。

Method: 提出 Ask4NV：以预训练统一多模态模型的 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 架构为基础，将相机几何同时引入 VAE 与 ViT 表征；通过联合自注意力与模态感知注意力掩码策略，在生成过程中利用理解分支的特征。

Result: 新视角生成在图像质量与几何一致性上表现较强，同时保持有竞争力的 3D 语言理解能力。进一步分析表明，联合训练提升了 VAE 表征的跨视角对应性以及 3D 感知特征空间中的相似度。

Conclusion: 3D 语言理解可为新视角生成提供有效的互补监督，理解与生成联合训练能带来表征层面的增益，验证了统一多模态建模在 3D 任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [631] [LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11160)
*Yu, Xiaobing,Qiu, Peijie,Yang, Jin,Dong, Xuanzhao,Ma, Weiwei,An, Zhaoqi,Zhao, Xiaoqi,Liu, Xiaofeng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LadderEdit：对终身编辑LLM中的每个LoRA适配器进行后压缩，低秩草图通过契约检验则保留，失败者逐级升秩，实现在5.2倍内存节省下逼近精确LoRA存储效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身编辑需存储上千条编辑，主流"每次编辑一个LoRA适配器"的方案虽保持行为但存储线性增长，亟需在保持覆盖与编辑契约的前提下压缩存储。

Method: 每条编辑先以低秩"草图"存储，在探测提示上检验其是否满足重写、泛化、局部性契约；通过者保留草图，失败者沿"梯子"逐级提升秩直至满足契约，实现按难度自适应分配秩。

Result: 在LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B上，于ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit基准，以5.2倍更少内存逼近精确LoRA存储，并在50,000条顺序编辑下仍有效。

Conclusion: 以难度自适应的秩分配替代统一定秩，在维持覆盖与编辑契约的同时显著压缩终身编辑的存储开销。

Abstract: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

</details>


### [632] [SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11371)
*Rao, Zhi,Zhou, Yucheng,Sun, Qianran,Huang, Yiqing,Yuan, Longcan,Hou, Jiayi,Yao, Chengwen,Cheng, Lin,Sun, Donghui,Chen, Xiaoxin,Wan, Jun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SignRAG 框架，通过层次化预训练、目标域检索增强与检索效用引导的强化微调，将 decoder-only LLM 用于无 gloss 手语翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无 gloss 手语翻译预训练范式主要围绕传统 encoder-decoder 语言模型设计，难以直接迁移到 decoder-only LLM，存在跨模态优化不平衡问题。

Method: 三部分统一框架：（1）层次化预训练，先学习语言学基础的手语表示，再联合对齐手语编码器与 LLM；（2）目标域检索库作为参数微调的补充，提供实例级翻译线索；（3）RUG-RFT 强化微调，以翻译质量奖励与检索效用奖励共同约束检索的使用，促进有益检索、抑制有害依赖。

Result: 在多个 SLT 基准上取得新的 SOTA；据称是首个在 CSL-Daily 全部报告指标上超越 gloss 监督方法的无 gloss 方法；代码与不同规模模型已开源。

Conclusion: 将检索增强与强化微调引入 decoder-only LLM 的手语翻译范式，验证了无 gloss 方法可超越 gloss 监督方法，并开源代码与模型以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.

</details>


### [633] [EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12248)
*Kim, Heeseung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoVoice，一个用于训练与评估"主动式第一人称语音助手"的框架：基于 HoloAssist 真实教学视频，通过音源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流，将连续第一人称视频会话重构为"每时刻决定沉默或给出语音指导"的决策格式，并用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进干预时机；实验表明现有模型难以产生适时且有意义的主动干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手正走向连续真实世界交互，需要靠第一人称视频与音频感知用户活动，并在未被明确询问时主动给出语音引导。然而现有主动式视频助手、口语对话系统和第一人称任务理解三条线各自发展，尚未解决"何时开口、说什么"的联合决策问题，也缺少相应训练与评测范式。

Method: 1) 从 HoloAssist 真实人类指导者录像出发，用音源分离（source separation）与语音重合成（speech resynthesis）构造干净音频流；2) 将每个视频会话转换为逐时刻二选一决策格式：保持沉默或给出语音指导；3) 用该数据微调一个 omni-modal LLM；4) 进一步用 direct preference optimization（DPO）优化其主动干预行为。

Result: 在闭源与开源模型的对比实验中，现有系统很少能产生时机恰当、内容有意义的主动干预；EgoVoice 在干预时机、内容相关性以及相对 zero-shot 基线的人类偏好上均有明显提升。

Conclusion: "何时说 + 说什么"的联合主动干预问题可由数据构造（分离/重合成 + 逐时刻决策标注）加 omni-modal LLM 微调与 DPO 偏好优化有效缓解，为主动式第一人称语音助手提供了可训练、可评测的框架；主要证据为自动指标与人类偏好，尚未涉及机器人本体部署。

Abstract: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

</details>


### [634] [Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12707)
*Li, Yueying,Fan, Jingxuan,Brantley, Kianté,Kakade, Sham M.,Zhang, Hanlin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种无需人工偏好标注的多模态奖励建模方法：在冻结的 Qwen3-VL 主干中间层上加一个线性头，用同图扰动对（网页caption vs 扰动caption）训练打分，仅用少量标注数据选层；性能超越 GPT-4o 且仅需约千分之一微调算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言奖励模型依赖昂贵的标注偏好对，标注间存在分歧，且以基准准确率作为评价标准。作者希望用极低成本、无标注的方式构建奖励模型，并揭示基准分数并不能真正刻画奖励函数所指定的内容。

Method: 冻结 Qwen3-VL 主干，在中间层接线性头；训练目标为让网页 caption 得分高于同一 caption 的扰动版本；标注数据仅用于选择层（中间层比最后一层高 5.8 分）；扰动采样器定义奖励；另用策略自身候选经验证器标注后对头部做 bootstrap 重训练。

Result: 32B 设置下单一配方免调参即超过或匹配 GPT-4o，VL-RewardBench 上领先 6.6 分；相同 pair 预算下扰动比 RLAIF-V 精选对高 3–5 分；两个在不相交扰动子集上训练的头部在基准上打平却在幻觉判断上差 6.4 分；重训练使 caption 幻觉降 5.1 CHAIR 点、图像生成通过率升 5.4，但所有奖励基准分数更低。

Conclusion: 中间层探针 + 免费同图扰动 + 验证器驱动 bootstrap 构成一套无需标注者、成本极低的多模态奖励建模配方；奖励由训练所用比较定义，而非由基准排名定义，提示基准本身无法识别奖励函数。

Abstract: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads trained on disjoint halves of the same perturbations tie on the benchmark and differ by 6.4 points in hallucination judging. Retraining the head on the policy's own verifier-labeled candidates cuts caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and lifts image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while scoring lower on every reward benchmark. Together, an intermediate-layer probe, free same-image perturbations, and a verifier-driven bootstrap turn give a recipe for multimodal reward modeling that needs no annotator, costs a fraction of fine-tuning, and is specified by the comparisons it is trained on rather than by a benchmark rank.

</details>


### [635] [Multi-Stream Attention Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13630)
*Qin, Xiaohan,Zhang, Xiangdong,Dai, Tuo,Zou, Sunan,Wu, Huaijin,Yang, Yebin,Xia, Zhuo,Yao, Lin,Liu, Yuliang,Yan, Junchi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR)，将 AttnRes 的深度轴单流软注意力扩展为多头深度注意力，用多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文派生多头多样性，并以轻量自适应混合生成单流层输入，在 18B/28B MoE 上 12 项下游基准一致超越标准残差、mHC 与 AttnRes，缩放律下达到 1.58× 等损失计算加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准残差连接为固定恒等映射，AttnRes 将网络深度检索建模为沿深度轴的单流 softmax 注意力，但单流限制了不同层对历史表示的多视角检索能力；受序列轴多头注意力成功的启发，希望将深度注意力多头化，同时避免多流存储与通信带来的开销。

Method: MSAR 在深度轴上执行多头注意力式检索：用多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文提取多个流的多样性，使不同头通过不同上下文视图检索历史表示，从而保留隐藏表示的完整性；检索到的流经轻量自适应混合合成单流层输入。该方法仅保留单流来源并按需扩展，因此支持多流计算而无需持久的多流存储或跨设备通信。

Result: 在 18B 与 28B MoE 规模的 12 个下游基准上，MSAR 一致优于标准残差连接、流形约束 Hyper-Connections (mHC) 与 AttnRes；缩放律实验中实现相对标准残差基线 1.58× 的等损失计算加速，高于 AttnRes 的 1.35× 与 mHC 的 1.30×。

Conclusion: MSAR 以极小的额外开销获得显著收益，是大规模预训练中具有前景的残差架构，其多头深度注意力与按需扩展的单流设计为残差连接提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.

</details>


### [636] [PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14635)
*Wang, Xinhao,Cui, Junbo,Liu, Zhenghao,Yao, Yuan,Li, Xiaohua,Gu, Yu,Yu, Ge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出并研究了一种新的LVLM失效模式——前提诱导的视觉固着幻觉(PVFH)，即模型被视觉上易混淆的证据锚定后接受错误文本前提，进而生成对不存在但视觉上合理物体的描述；作者构建了PVFH-Bench基准，在10个先进LVLM上验证了该脆弱性，并发现显式思维链推理会加剧该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM在多种多模态任务中取得进展，但物体幻觉仍持续削弱其在VQA、具身智能体、人机决策支持等场景中的可靠性。作者受认知科学中知觉偏差研究启发，希望揭示一种此前未被系统研究的失败模式：模型如何因前提诱导而被锚定在视觉易混淆证据上，最终"看见"并不存在的物体。

Method: 形式化定义PVFH为该类前提诱导的推理错误；构建PVFH-Bench基准，自动构造视觉易混淆但实际缺席的目标，并将核心幻觉设定与诊断子集配对，从而沿"物体识别→前提诱导视觉固着幻觉"的路径追踪模型行为；在10个SOTA LVLM上进行实验，并额外考察显式思维链推理的影响。

Result: 所有被评估的10个SOTA LVLM均对PVFH高度脆弱；显式思维链推理不仅未能缓解，反而会通过促使模型将弱视觉线索过度解读为幻觉物体的支持证据而进一步加剧该失败模式。

Conclusion: PVFH是一种普遍且严重的LVLM失效模式，现有模型缺乏抵御前提诱导视觉固着的能力，且常用的CoT推理策略可能适得其反。该工作提示需要针对推理与感知耦合的鲁棒性设计，其诊断基准为后续研究提供了评测基础。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.

</details>


### [637] [Omni-Modal LLMs Know More Than They Say](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16135)
*An, Na Min,Kim, Taekyung,Yu, Jaemyung,Shim, Hyunjung,Han, Dongyoon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现Omni-LLM存在"知道却无法表达"（knows-but-cannot-say）现象：非文本模态信息虽被正确感知，却难以在生成中表达。作者提出Token-level Modality Alignment (TMA)度量模态表征与回复表征的对齐度，发现非文本表征对齐更差、注意力更少；据此提出OmniCatalyst的"感知→推理"策略，用自生成文本补足非文本输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omni-LLM将LLM扩展到视觉、音频、IMU等异构模态，理应具备更广的多模态能力，但作者观察到这些模型即便正确感知了非文本模态信息，也常常无法在输出中表达出来（knows-but-cannot-say）。作者希望诊断这种"感知-表达断层"的成因，并给出缓解方案。

Method: 1) 提出Token-level Modality Alignment (TMA)，在token级别量化单模态表征与回复表征之间的对齐程度；2) 用TMA分析各模态表征与回复token的对齐度及注意力分配差异；3) 提出OmniCatalyst：一种简单的perceive→infer策略，先用自生成文本补充原始模态输入，使非文本知识更易被访问；4) 在七个Omni-LLM上验证，并测试多种训练策略的进一步提升。

Result: 在七个Omni-LLM上，OmniCatalyst一致提升性能（+7.29%），并使模态偏好更均衡；多样化的训练策略带来额外增益。进一步分析显示知识抽取阶段提高了TMA，说明对齐改善使非文本信息在回复生成时更易获取。

Conclusion: 非文本表征与回复token对齐不足、注意力分配偏低，是Omni-LLM模态偏好不均的可能原因；通过文本化补齐与知识抽取提升TMA，可让模型更好地用语言表达各模态知识。代码已开源。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) extend LLMs to process heterogeneous modalities (e.g., vision, audio, and IMU signals) alongside language, enabling a broader range of multimodal tasks. Yet we find that these models often fail to express information from non-textual modalities even when they perceive it correctly. We term this disconnect knows-but-cannot-say. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce Token-level Modality Alignment (TMA), which measures the alignment between individual modality representations and response representations. Our analysis shows that non-textual representations are less aligned with response tokens and receive less attention than textual representations, suggesting a potential explanation for uneven modality preferences. Motivated by these findings, we propose OmniCatalyst, a simple perceive $\rightarrow$ infer strategy that complements the original modality inputs with self-generated text, making non-textual knowledge more accessible. Across seven Omni-LLMs, OmniCatalyst consistently improves performance (+7.29%) and yields more balanced modality preferences, with further gains from diverse training strategies. Further analysis demonstrates that the knowledge extraction phases increase TMA, suggesting that improved alignment makes non-textual information more accessible during response generation. In summary, our findings uncover how Omni-LLMs can better express modality knowledge through language. Our code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/OmniLLM.

</details>


### [638] [Lost in Contrast: Instruction-Preserving Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16722)
*Zhang, Haonan,Jin, Ting,Tang, Wenzhong,Wang, Shuai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现视觉对比解码(VCD)会破坏"拒答"行为,提出指令保持解码(IP-VCD、IP-M3ID),在保留拒答指令效应的同时独立调节对比强度,在VizWiz和Food-101上以决策效用(DU)指标全面超越非IP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉对比解码通过"原图预测 − 参考条件预测"的差值来纠正答案,但这一减法同时把"有依据的拒答(abstention)"抹掉,导致模型从合理拒答变为错误作答。作者希望定位拒答丢失的环节,并在不牺牲对比纠错能力的前提下恢复拒答能力。

Method: 首先归因拒答丢失的两个阶段:(1)候选过滤式对比解码在比较前就把abstention token排除;(2)参考分支对拒答指令的响应在减法中被抵消。据此提出指令保持解码(instruction-preserving decoding):把"拒答指令对原图预测的影响"与"视觉对比项"分开计算,使指令效应完整保留,而对比强度仍可自由调节。以扰动图像和无图像预测作为参考,分别得到IP-VCD与IP-M3ID。

Result: 在同时奖励正确答案与有依据拒答的决策效用(DU)指标上,IP-VCD与IP-M3ID在VizWiz数据集九个模型中全部优于所有非IP基线;IP-VCD在Food-101上九个模型中有八个领先。候选度量与逐问题配对比较进一步表明,将指令效应与视觉对比项分开计算,可使对比解码同时支持正确答案与有依据拒答。

Conclusion: 拒答能力并非与对比解码不可兼容;问题在于指令效应被减法抵消及候选过滤提前剪枝。将指令效应与视觉对比解耦后,可同时获得对比纠错与可靠拒答,提升多模态模型在不确定性场景下的决策效用。

Abstract: Visual contrastive decoding corrects answers using the prediction difference between the original image and a reference condition, yet the same contrast also turns supported abstentions into incorrect answers. We find that abstentions are lost at two stages: contrastive decoding with candidate filtering can exclude the abstention token before any comparison takes place, and the reference branch's response to the abstention instruction is removed when the reference prediction is subtracted. We therefore propose instruction-preserving decoding, which keeps the effect of the abstention instruction on the original-image prediction intact while leaving the contrast strength freely adjustable. Using a perturbed image and an image-free prediction as references, we obtain IP-VCD and IP-M3ID. On decision utility (DU), which credits both correct answers and supported abstentions, both methods outperform all compared non-IP baselines on every one of nine models on VizWiz, and IP-VCD also leads on eight of nine models on Food-101. Candidate measurements and paired per-question comparisons show that computing the instruction effect and the visual contrast term separately lets contrastive decoding support both correct answers and supported abstentions.

</details>


### [639] [Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17908)
*Kimura, Subaru,Suzuki, Jun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种验证框架，用同一视觉语言模型（VLM）分别充当纯文本评判器（TOJ）与图像感知评判器（IAJ），在日-英漫画翻译数据集（页级与气泡级对齐的官方译文）上考察图像输入对翻译评估的影响。结果显示：加入页面图像能提升主 VLM 对刻意注入的视觉依赖型退化的检出，但 TOJ 与 IAJ 在错误数量与错误类别分布上存在分歧，人工校验未发现二者间稳定偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 漫画翻译中说话者身份、指代对象、场景语气等关键信息存在于气泡文本之外的页面图像中，翻译评估理应参考图像；然而主流漫画翻译评估仅依赖纯文本自动指标，图像输入的作用缺乏实证研究。作者希望在受控条件下量化"图像感知"对评估结果的实际影响。

Method: 构建实用验证框架：将同一 VLM 分别用作纯文本评判器（TOJ）和图像感知评判器（IAJ），以控制模型能力差异带来的混淆。数据采用日-英漫画数据集，官方译文在页级与语音气泡级对齐。首先向文本注入视觉依赖型退化，检验加图是否提升检出率；随后系统对比 TOJ 与 IAJ 的评估分歧，统计错误数量与错误类别分布的差异，并进行人工验证。

Result: 加入页面图像后，主 VLM 对刻意注入的视觉依赖型退化的检出能力提升；TOJ 与 IAJ 在错误计数和错误类别分布上表现不同；人工核验未能显示 TOJ 与 IAJ 之间存在一致性偏好，即图像感知评判并未在所有情形下更优。

Conclusion: 图像上下文对漫画翻译评估有可测量的价值，尤其在需要视觉线索的错误上，但"加图即更好"并不成立：图像感知评判会改变错误分布且不必然获得人类认可。评估设计应谨慎对待多模态输入的引入，需结合人工验证与任务特异性退化测试。

Abstract: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM's detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.

</details>


### [640] [Known-Voice Cloning and the Limits of Personality Transfer for Character Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18669)
*Kuch, Johanna Magdalena,van Lier, Maud,Don, Daksitha Senel Withanage,Gebhard, Patrick,Schneeberger, Tanja,André, Elisabeth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 两项研究考察零样本克隆熟人的声音是否能将人格印象系统性地转移到虚拟角色上，结果表明这种人格转移证据有限，且效应具有选择性和情境依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本语音克隆已能凭短录音复现可辨识的嗓音并赋予任意虚拟角色，此前研究提示熟悉的嗓音身份可能将相关人格印象带到机器人或虚拟角色上，但尚缺乏直接检验克隆熟人声音是否系统性转移人格印象的研究。若存在转移，则可能被用来操纵人们把虚拟角色当作具备社交能力的行为主体。

Method: 开展两项实验：研究1在真实大学场景中，使用参与学生熟悉的讲师的克隆声音；研究2在线上场景中，使用社交媒体内容创作者及其社群成员的声音。以身份激活、特质转移和人物重建等概念为理论框架，比较虚拟角色使用克隆熟悉声音与对照条件下的性格印象判断，并辅以质性回答分析。

Result: 两项研究中人格转移的证据都有限：观察到的效应具有选择性，未能跨特质或跨研究情境泛化。线上研究中，可辨识的嗓音身份线索激活了对说话者的预期，但并未重建更广泛的人物印象。质性反馈显示，判断常受感知到的人工性与声音—外貌是否匹配的影响。

Conclusion: 研究结果对"克隆声音会直接操纵人们将人工角色视为有能力的社会行为者"这一普遍担忧起到了缓和作用，说明熟悉嗓音带来的人格印象转移并不简单、直接。

Abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.

</details>


### [641] [Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18868)
*Hu, Wenbo,Pramanick, Shraman,Singh, Krishna Kumar,Peng, Nanyun,Chang, Kai-Wei,Lee, Yong Jae*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Tev-Gym 长时程智能体训练数据集（7 领域、1170 个可验证环境）与基于潜世界先验的密集渐进奖励构造方法，并用进度-潜力奖励塑形（PPRS）训练出 Tev-27B，在 ALE-CM 上匹配顶尖闭源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程自主智能体对自动化发现与递归自我改进至关重要，但开源模型在此类任务上表现不佳，根本原因是缺乏训练数据与可复现的训练配方：长程复杂任务难以构建与验证，奖励稀疏，二者均难以规模化。

Method: 1) Tev-Gym：采用"潜世界优先（latent-world-first）"范式，先构建任务域、工作流及各步期望状态的完整正确隐藏规范，再逐步渲染为智能体可见环境，实现复杂度可控与天然进度度量；2) 训练配方：PPRS 将进度度量转化为稠密逐步奖励，提升训练效率并使原本不可训练的任务可行；3) 基于该配方训练 Tev-27B。

Result: Tev-27B 在 Agents' Last Exam 的计算机与数学科学域（ALE-CM）Pass@5 上可比 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5；仅用 ALE 相关数据训练却能泛化至 Terminal-Bench 3.0/4.0 子集，超越 GLM 5.2 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash，并在 TB 2.1 等中等时程任务上达到 Claude Opus 4.8 水平。

Conclusion: 通过潜世界规范生成可验证的稠密渐进奖励数据，并以 PPRS 稠密化奖励，可有效突破长时程智能体训练的数据与奖励瓶颈，且具备跨基准泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. We address both. First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1.

</details>


### [642] [Vision-Language Models Integrate Conflicting Evidence Like Biased Bayesian Observers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19407)
*Barua, Josh,Mahowald, Kyle,Rudman, William*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出两参数贝叶斯线索组合模型，从"证据强度"与"整合偏置"两方面预测VLM在文本-图像冲突下的偏好，并跨退化条件与新型不可靠性迁移验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作仅用"模态偏置"（如盲信文本）描述VLM在冲突多模态输入下的行为，但无法解释偏好为何随模型、领域和输入条件变化，缺乏可预测的机制性解释。

Method: 从贝叶斯视角将VLM建模为对条件独立的各模态证据与先验信念进行组合，并引入模态特定的整合偏置，形成两参数线索组合模型；在未见过的输入退化组合上做预测，并在不重新拟合的情况下迁移到新形式的不可靠性。

Result: 模型能准确预测VLM在未见输入退化组合下的偏好，并可零重拟合迁移到新的不可靠性形式。

Conclusion: 将证据强度与整合偏置分离后，可解释VLM为何在更重视视觉证据的同时仍遵循文本，从而以单一组合规则统一先前关于文本主导与视觉主导的矛盾结论。

Abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile conflicting text and images. Prior work has characterized the resulting behavior in terms of modality biases--e.g., a "blind faith in text"--but why preferences vary across models, domains, and input conditions remains unclear. We develop a predictive account from a Bayesian perspective, positing that VLMs combine conditionally independent evidence from each modality with prior beliefs, subject to modality-specific biases. The resulting two-parameter cue combination model accurately predicts VLM preferences under unseen combinations of input degradation and transfers to new forms of unreliability without refitting. Separating evidence strength from integration bias explains how VLMs can follow text even while weighting visual evidence more heavily, reconciling reports of text and vision dominance under a single combination rule.

</details>


### [643] [Recognizing Dialogue Ambiguity via Candidate Set Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19723)
*Inadumi, Shun,Sangmyeong, Lee,Yoshino, Koichiro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出候选集视觉定位任务CSVG与基准CandVG，评估对话中候选物体集合的动态演化，发现更强定位能力未必带来更好CSVG表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实交互中歧义话语往往无法唯一确定指称对象，需要在对话中持续维护并更新"合理指称集合"，而非过早假定唯一解；现有交互式视觉定位工作只关注在上下文充分后定位唯一物体，忽略这一过程。

Method: 形式化定义Candidate Set Visual Grounding（CSVG）任务，即依据给定对话上下文估计与该上下文一致的物体集合；构建CandVG基准，按对话轮次评估候选集变化；对多个视觉语言模型进行评测，并测试针对CSVG设计的指令提示是否缓解缺陷。

Result: 更强的视觉定位能力并不必然带来更好的CSVG性能；模型难以预测完整候选集，主要受候选生成困难与早期轮次过早收敛到小候选集两方面限制；面向CSVG的指令可在大规模模型上部分缓解该问题。

Conclusion: 交互式视觉指称应被建模为候选集随对话持续更新的过程；CSVG/CandVG为评估这一能力提供了任务与基准，并指出当前VLM在候选生成与延迟决策上的系统性短板。

Abstract: Interpreting an ambiguous utterance in real-world interactions often requires context beyond a single utterance. When the utterance refers to objects in a visual scene, it is necessary to maintain and update the set of plausible referents as context accumulates, without assuming that the available information identifies a unique object. However, prior work on interactive visual grounding, which localizes objects referred to by linguistic expressions, has focused on identifying a unique object once sufficient dialogue context becomes available. To address this gap, we propose Candidate Set Visual Grounding (CSVG), a task for estimating the set of objects consistent with the given dialogue context. We further introduce CandVG, a benchmark that evaluates how the candidate set changes across dialogue turns. Our evaluation of vision-language models shows that stronger visual grounding capability does not necessarily yield better CSVG performance. In particular, models have difficulty predicting the complete candidate set, owing to challenges in candidate generation and premature commitment to a small set of candidates in early turns. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation can be partially mitigated in the evaluated large-scale models using instructions designed for CSVG.

</details>


### [644] [Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20399)
*Zhang, Jintian,He, Feng,Liang, Xinnian,Xu, Ziwen,Xu, Haoming,Huang, Haojing,Wu, Shuangzhi,Zhang, Ningyu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"记忆巩固"(Memory Consolidation)框架及Cortex方法，通过生成前瞻性查询将上下文条件下的输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩/结构化FFN更新，在4B-120B模型上实现上下文增益内化与原始能力保持的帕累托最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文可提升大模型性能，但移除上下文后增益即消失，缺乏将临时上下文收益持久内化的机制；作者借鉴生物系统记忆巩固，试图统一上下文指定编辑、技能学习与行为引导三类任务。

Method: 构建覆盖五类任务族、支持单次/批量/顺序更新的测试床；提出Cortex，自动生成前瞻性查询以预判上下文用途，并将上下文条件输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构化前馈网络更新。

Result: 在4B-120B稠密与MoE骨干（含纯文本与多模态模型）上，多数设置中Cortex位于巩固-保持帕累托前沿；14B模型经50次顺序事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural恢复88.9%上下文增益并保留99.8%非目标性能。

Conclusion: 上下文增益可通过参数化更新被有效内化，兼顾新知识获取与原始能力保持，为持续学习与模型编辑提供了统一范式与评测基准。

Abstract: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.

</details>


### [645] [Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20461)
*Nguyen, Nguyen,Zang, Yongyi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 semCER：保留 CER 的字符对齐与分母，但用 LLM 裁判为每次字素编辑赋严重度权重，从而区分"错别字"与"错误专名"；在英、越、中三种语言上验证其与人工评分的逐编辑相关性，并跨 16 种语言分析音调/变音符号错误的严重度差异，同时发布 6100 万条带裁判标签的编辑数据与蒸馏评分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCR 与视觉语言模型的标准指标 CER 将所有字符编辑等权计费，导致一个无关紧要的错别字与一个错误姓名受到同等惩罚，无法反映读者对转写质量的真实感受；同时缺少逐编辑的可解释分解，也难以跨语言刻画音调、变音符号等错误的实际严重性。

Method: semCER 沿用 CER 的字符级对齐与归一化分母（不做分词），对每个字素编辑用 LLM 裁判赋予一个严重度分数作为权重；用编辑级人工评分验证其权重，并将整体分数分解为具名编辑列表以供排序展示；同时发布 6100 万条经裁判的编辑、汇总的人工评分及蒸馏后的轻量评分器。

Result: 归一化 CER 在整段转写层面与读者评价的相关性可与 semCER 相当或更优，而 semCER 进一步提供具名编辑的分数分解；其逐编辑权重在英语、越南语、汉语中与读者评分相符，并能将读者认为最严重的编辑排在列表前部。在 CER 与 semCER 判定不一致的样本对上，读者更倾向 semCER（英、汉语）或持平（越南语）。跨 16 种语言，裁判对错误变音符号/声调的计费差异极大：西班牙语几乎为零，泰卢固语接近错一个字母的严重度。在可统计真实词的位置，通用 VLM 的错误字母显著高于随机水平，而传统流水线的错误接近随机。

Conclusion: semCER 在不改变 CER 对齐与分母框架的前提下，引入 LLM 裁判的严重度加权，使转写质量度量更贴近读者感知，并具备逐编辑可解释性与跨语言可迁移性；相关数据、人工评分与蒸馏评分器已开源，可作为 OCR/VLM 评估的替代或补充指标。

Abstract: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

</details>


### [646] [AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20474)
*Wang, Peidong,Chang, Ying,Ma, Zhiming,Yang, Xiaocui,Feng, Shi,Liu, Daqi,Yang, Yuzhe,Cao, Xu,Wang, Chuang,Su, Jian,Wang, Daling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AdaRSI：面向具身智能体的按需递归自我改进框架，先由编码智能体提升技能与harness，再通过从保存状态重试失败子步骤来归因失败根源，仅对仍不可靠的子步骤进行微调。在RoboCasa365全部50个任务上，以GR00T N1.5为执行器、无需人类演示，将未见复合任务成功率从4.6%提升至13.8%，且仅用28% GPU时间与22%自采集演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练VLA在未见长时程任务中常中途失败。现有具身RSI方法存在两类缺陷：一是围绕冻结执行器优化harness，无法补上缺失的动作能力；二是在持续失败上直接训练执行器，却不区分失败究竟源于"执行器如何被调用"还是"执行器本身能做什么"。论文因此追问：自改进具身系统何时才应改变执行器权重。

Method: 提出AdaRSI按需RSI框架：编码智能体先自我提升技能与harness；对持续失败，从保存状态重试失败子步骤进行失败归因，判断问题在调用方式还是能力；仅对仍不可靠的子步骤做微调，使用自行采集的演示并复用此前任务迁移的经验，从而在选择性地更新执行器权重。

Result: 在RoboCasa365全部50个目标任务上，执行器为GR00T N1.5且无人类演示：AdaRSI在三个套件上均提升VLA表现，未见复合任务成功率由4.6%升至13.8%。与微调所有子步骤相比，成功率略高，但GPU时间仅28%、自采集演示仅22%；去掉harness的微调训练更多却收益远低。

Conclusion: 按需、可归因的RSI——先改harness、仅在能力确实不足时改权重——是提升具身VLA长时程任务表现的高效路径，且harness改进与执行器微调互为必要，单靠后者效率与收益均显著劣化。

Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.

</details>


### [647] [PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20538)
*Sun, Qiushi,Gong, Jingyang,Liu, Yang,Chen, Qiaosheng,Yin, Zhangyue,Huang, Zixian,Hu, Hanxu,Xiong, Jing,Xu, Fangzhi,Tan, Haochen,Bai, Haoli,Shang, Lifeng,Li, Xiaoguang,Kao, Ben,Guo, Qipeng,Kong, Lingpeng,Gao, Jiahui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PrismaForge 层次化数据流水线，以合成 rubric 同时作为数据过滤器和强化学习奖励，在视觉编码任务上构建 PrismaCoder-2M 数据集并训练开源模型 PrismaCoder-9B/35B，达到开源 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态代码智能需模型生成图表、网页、动画等可视化产物，但专有模型数据与训练封闭；开源进展受限于数据量与质量，尤其质量更难，因为样本须同时满足程序正确、结构良好、渲染后视觉正确，而现有执行反馈（仅通/不通）、代码相似度、任务专用验证器都无法同时覆盖这三方面。

Method: 构建 PrismaForge 层次化数据流水线，核心是合成 rubric，将上述质量因素分解为可核查准则；同一 rubric 既作监督语料的筛选器，又作强化学习奖励信号驱动视觉编码任务训练。基于此合成与过滤数据，构建 PrismaCoder-2M 数据集，并训练 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B 两个模型。

Result: PrismaCoder-2M 为多模态代码智能领域最多样且规模最大的开源数据集；PrismaCoder-9B/35B 大幅领先开源 SOTA 并可媲美领先专有系统；分析表明基于 rubric 的流水线在不同骨干模型上均提升多模态编码性能。

Conclusion: 以 rubric 为中心的层次化数据流水线能同时解决多模态代码数据的筛选与奖励问题，显著推动开源多模态代码智能发展，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.

</details>


### [648] [MeddeX: A Retrieval-Augmented LLaMA-3 System with Gemini Vision for Evidence-Backed Medical Report Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20632)
*Pandhare, Rajdeep,Kundaikar, Rohit,Kojar, Yakub,Tiwari, Shreyansh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MeddeX 将 QLoRA 微调的 LLaMA-3(8B)、RAG 与 Gemini Vision 结合，构建医疗报告分析系统，支持多格式文档抽取、报告内检索、纵向对比与懒加载回填，并在 ROUGE/BLEU/BERTScore 上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床报告日益复杂，人工审阅耗时且易错、难以规模化，需要准确、简洁且有证据支撑的自动摘要与问答工具来减轻解读负担。

Method: 以 QLoRA 微调 LLaMA-3 8B 为语言骨干，结合 RAG 与多模态 Gemini Vision 层；设计混合抽取流水线处理文本型 PDF、扫描图 PDF 与放射影像，含垃圾文本检测以应对损坏与 UTF-16 文档；引入报告范围检索、纵向报告对比引擎与按需懒加载的自愈回填机制；工程上采用 FastAPI、Supabase 向量库与 Next.js 前端。

Result: 相对 LLaMA3-Med42-8B 基线取得一致提升：ROUGE-1 +9.2%、ROUGE-2 +10.0%、ROUGE-L +11.8%、BLEU +71.4%、BERTScore +0.8%。

Conclusion: MeddeX 表明领域微调对医疗报告摘要有效，是迈向临床决策支持的实际且稳健的一步，但评估仍限于文本摘要指标，缺乏临床落地与真实场景验证。

Abstract: Modern healthcare generates increasingly complex medical reports that challenge clinical professionals in terms of time and interpretive burden. Manual review processes are slow, error-prone, and difficult to scale. This paper presents MeddeX, a Medical Report Analyzer that combines a QLoRA fine-tuned LLaMA-3 (8B) model with Retrieval-Augmented Gen eration (RAG) and a multimodal Gemini Vision layer to deliver accurate, concise, and evidence-backed summaries of medical documents. The system handles text-native PDFs, scanned image based PDFs, and direct radiological images through an intelligent hybrid extraction pipeline that includes a novel garbage-text detection mechanism for corrupted and UTF-16-encoded doc uments. Beyond single-report Q&A, MeddeX introduces report scoped retrieval for precise contextual grounding, an automated longitudinal report comparison engine, and a self-healing backfill pipeline that lazily processes legacy documents on demand. A FastAPI backend, Supabase vector store, and Next.js fron tend complete the end-to-end architecture. Evaluation against the base LLaMA3-Med42-8B model demonstrates consistent improvements across ROUGE-1 (+9.2%), ROUGE-2 (+10.0%), ROUGE-L (+11.8%), BLEU (+71.4%), and BERTScore (+0.8%), validating the benefit of domain-specific fine-tuning. MeddeX represents a practical and robust step toward AI-assisted clinical decision support.

</details>


<div id='cs.HC'></div>

# cs.HC [[Back]](#toc)

### [649] [Hybrid Cinematography: Previsualizing and Managing Hallucination Risk in Generative Video Reshooting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12455)
*Nhan,Tran,Wadhwa, Neal,Davis, Abe,Stojanov, Stefan*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出"混合电影摄影"工作流：用可编辑3D镜头计划与实拍代理画面实时预演生成式重拍中的幻觉风险，使电影人在现场即可调整方案、补拍或选择接受幻觉，并通过移动AR应用与离线流水线验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频重拍可在拍摄后更改运镜，但需虚构未记录的内容；这类"幻觉"缺口常在现场之后才被发现，届时已无法补救。作者希望把幻觉风险的评估提前到拍摄现场、在制作者仍能采取行动时暴露出来。

Method: 1）可编辑的3D镜头计划（shot plan）作为生成条件的显式表示；2）以实拍take的代理（proxy）作为视觉与几何参照；3）预演系统对每一运镜做实时评估，定位take中缺乏支撑（即需生成填充）的区域；4）面向现场：移动AR应用支持计划、拍摄与回看，可迭代调整运镜、指导补拍（guided pickups）；5）面向已拍素材：离线流水线复用同一风险评估。

Result: 以移动AR应用（现场计划/拍摄/回看）与离线处理流水线两种形态完成系统实现；对经验丰富的电影人开展用户研究，显示风险预演会影响运镜决策，并揭示创作意图与生成幻觉之间的张力。

Conclusion: 幻觉风险可被前置为可交互的设计变量，物理拍摄与生成式重拍的混合工作流在保留创作自由的同时让风险可见、可协商。

Abstract: On a film set, the camera move is committed during a take. Generative video reshooting lets filmmakers change it afterward, but may require hallucinating unrecorded content, a gap sometimes discovered only after leaving the set. We present Hybrid Cinematography, a workflow that bridges physical capture and generative reshooting to manage hallucination risk while filmmakers can still act on it. Using an editable 3D shot plan and a proxy of the take, our previsualization evaluates hallucination risk in real time. Seeing where the take lacks support, filmmakers can iteratively adjust the plan, explore moves that balance capture and generation, shoot guided pickups, or knowingly accept hallucination. We demonstrate the workflow through a mobile augmented reality application for on-set planning, capture, and review, and an offline pipeline for existing video. A study with experienced filmmakers reveals how previsualizing risk informs camera decisions and exposes tensions between creative intent and generative hallucination.

</details>


### [650] [Refuses in Chat, Complies with Arms: LLM Refusal Does Not Survive Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14043)
*Sun, Edward,Leet, Christopher,Machcha, Sravanthi,Menon, Achyutha,Chan, Tzu Kit,Cui, Yuchen,Chooi, Jay*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出 RoboHarm 物理 AI 安全基准，测试七个前沿模型在文本、Code as Policies、视觉智能体（末端位姿/关节角）等接口下对有害机器人指令的拒绝率，发现接口从文本切换到真实机器人控制后拒绝率从 73% 骤降至 18–25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐在纯文本上表现可靠，但尚不清楚当同一模型获得机器人控制权时这种拒绝行为是否仍然成立；若安全对齐无法泛化到具身动作层面，物理世界将存在被忽视的安全缺口。

Method: 构建 RoboHarm 有害机器人指令基准，固定模型只改变接口（纯文本 → Code as Policies → 视觉智能体，控制末端位姿或关节角）；在双臂 YAM 机械臂的 MuJoCo 数字孪生中进行仿真，并在真实机器人上开展 612 次末端控制与 252 次关节控制试验；辅以机器人交互记录的案例研究。

Result: 仿真中拒绝率由文本请求的 73% 降至模型控制机器人时的 18–25%，即使告知物体身份也未改善；真实机器人上六款末端控制模型拒绝 612 次试验中的 18%（仿真为 19%），三款关节控制模型拒绝 252 次中的 41%（仿真为 31%）；GPT-5.6 Sol 拒绝全部文本请求，但在真机试验中零拒绝。案例研究显示模型或漏判危害、或识别危害但不推断后果、或明知后果仍执行，拒绝也常源自对物体身份的不确定而非对动作危害的判断。

Conclusion: 文本层面的安全对齐无法泛化到动作层面，当前模型在物理世界中存在机制尚不明确的安全鸿沟，需针对具身接口重新设计安全对齐与评测。

Abstract: Frontier language models reliably refuse to explain how to cause physical harm. We ask whether this refusal survives when the same models control a robot. We introduce RoboHarm, a physical AI safety benchmark of harmful robot instructions, and test seven frontier models on it. We hold each model fixed and vary only the interface, from text to Code as Policies to vision agents that command end-effector poses or joint angles. In a MuJoCo simulation twin of a bimanual YAM arm robot, refusal falls from 73% of text requests to 18-25% once the model controls the robot, even when it is told what the objects are.
