On the physical robot, six models with end-effector control refused 18% of 612 trials against 19% in sim, and three with joint control refused 41% of 252 against 31%. GPT-5.6 Sol refused every text request and none of its trials on the real robot. Case studies of the robot transcripts show that models miss the hazard, name it without inferring its consequences, or act despite recognizing it, and their refusals often hinge on uncertainty about what an object is rather than on the harm of the action. Safety alignment learned in text thus fails to generalize to action, leaving current models with a poorly understood safety gap in the physical world.

</details>


### [651] [Following Delegation Traces to Study Human Oversight in Interaction with Multimodal AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21948)
*Chiatti, Agnese,Matteucci, Matteo,Schiaffonati, Viola*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 通过 n=56 在线实验与 392 次 VQA 试次，发现信任显著预测委派策略，但二者可分离；提出"enacted delegation traces"框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 AI 成为日常协作伙伴后，用户如何将控制权交给系统（委派）这一问题日益重要，而现有研究多停留在自报信任与"意图委派"层面。

Method: 在线人类被试研究：56 名具备 AI 素养的参与者完成 392 次 VideoQA 试次；每次查看多模态 AI 回答后评定任务特定信任，并从三种未来任务策略（拒绝、验证后使用、完全委派）中选择；采用混合效应/逻辑回归分析信任、任务顺序对委派的影响。

Result: 交互后信任强烈预测委派选择（OR=14.97, 95% CI [7.14,31.37]），但信任与委派保持可区分；验证是主导策略且常与高信任共存；控制瞬时与个体层面信任后，委派随任务顺序增加（OR=1.22, 95% CI [1.02,1.45]），存在自报信任无法捕捉的经验成分。

Conclusion: 建议从"意图委派"转向对协作式人-AI 任务中委派实际发生方式的非侵入式观测，并提出 enacted delegation traces 作为未来多模态与 agentic AI 研究的方法论框架。

Abstract: As multimodal AI systems are becoming our everyday thought partners, the shift towards studying how users transfer control to these systems becomes especially urgent. In this paper, we report an overview of findings from an online study with n=56 AI-literate participants and 392 Video Question Answering trials. After inspecting each multimodal AI response, participants rated task-specific trust and selected one of three intended policies for an analogous future task: reject AI assistance, use it with verification, or delegate fully to the AI. Within participants, post-interaction trust strongly predicted the user's delegation choices (OR=14.97, 95% CI [7.14,31.37]). Trust and delegation nevertheless remained distinct. Verification was the dominant policy and often co-occurred with high trust. Delegation also increased with task order after adjustment for momentary and participant-level trust (OR=1.22, 95% CI [1.02,1.45]), indicating an experience-related component that self-reported trust ratings alone could not capture. These findings motivate a shift from intended delegation to a non-intrusive observation of how delegation is enacted in collaborative human-AI tasks. We therefore conclude by proposing enacted delegation traces as a methodological framework for future studies of multimodal and agentic AI use.

</details>


<div id='cs.GR'></div>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [652] [WorldBench: Evaluating LLMs on Three.js Voxel World Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10622)
*Bakshi, Krish*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: WorldBench：面向 LLM 生成 Three.js 开放世界代码的多模态评测基准与判定器，通过"探索运行世界+回读代码"双通道证据校验，显著减少对已删除特性的误判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 已能直接以代码生成完整可交互 3D 世界，但自动评分不可靠：现有判定器只用单一视角——视觉语言模型看几张渲染快照，或语言模型只读源码。作者在五个前沿模型生成的世界中发现两种视角在 32% 的必检项上结论不一致，且多为"代码写了但任何帧都没呈现"；固定视角还会漏掉小尺寸近景内容。因此需要一个能同时探索运行世界并核验代码、且不盲信任一通道的判定器。

Method: 提出 WorldBench，含基准与判定器。输入为一条描述"漂浮体素岛（含十个生物群系、物理、昼夜与季节循环）"的提示，判定器实际探索运行中的世界：控制世界时钟、环绕观察、派出导航智能体为每个生物群系取景，并回读源码以解释所见。双通道互证：代码引用仅当确为源文件文本时才计分；可测量的视觉主张须与实测像素核对。另做构造性变异测试（人为移除特性）检验判定器鲁棒性。评测 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、Kimi K3、Grok 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro 五个前沿模型。

Result: 单通道判定不可靠：纯代码判定对五个被移除特性中的四个给出满分，仅因其代码仍留在文件中。WorldBench 判定器将"被移除特性仍得分"从 7.11 分制的 5.44 降至 3.55，减少约三分之一，剩余误给分多为"代码存在但从未执行"。视觉与代码两通道在 32% 必检项上分歧。

Conclusion: 对开放式 LLM 生成 3D 世界代码的评测必须采用"运行探索+源码核验"的交叉验证范式，避免静态代码或固定快照带来的假阳性；代码、提示、测试与判定器配置已开源。

Abstract: Large language models can now write complete, interactive 3D worlds as code, but grading those worlds automatically is unreliable. Existing judges take one view of the output: a vision-language model scores a few rendered snapshots, or a language model reads the source. On worlds written by five frontier models we find that the two views disagree on 32% of required items, mostly code that no frame shows, and that fixed views miss small close-up contents. We present WorldBench, a benchmark and judge for open-ended, LLM-generated Three.js worlds. From one prompt describing a floating voxel island with ten biomes, physics, and day/night and seasonal cycles, the judge explores the running world, controlling its clock, orbiting it, and sending a navigator agent to frame each biome, and reads the code for what it sees. Neither channel is trusted on its own: a code quote counts only if it is text the source contains, and visual claims are checked against measured pixels where the property is measurable. A mutation test, in which we remove features by construction, shows that code-only judging gives full credit to four of five removed features, because their code remains in the file. Our judge cuts the points kept on removed features by a third (5.44 to 3.55 of 7.11), and what it still credits is mostly code that exists but never runs. We evaluate five frontier models: Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, Kimi K3, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Code, prompt, tests and judge configuration are available at https://github.com/KrishBakshi/worldbench

</details>


### [653] [Tabula Rasa: Monte Carlo estimation of unit-variance noise with controlled spatio-temporal correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11653)
*Ritschel, Tobias,Zhou, Yang,Milef, Nick,Dereviannykh, Mikhail,Liu, Chen,Hery, Christophe,Marshall, Carl*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出一种生成"方差可控、时间相关性可控"的时变高斯噪声的方法，将其表述为像素重建与方差估计的联合蒙特卡洛估计问题，并借助数据库领域的"sketching"思想实现；在下游任务中实现时间控制与时间一致性，且代码比先前方法更简单、更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渲染/生成类下游任务需要具有可控方差与可控时间相关性的时变噪声，用于实现时间维度的控制（如逐帧强度调节）与时间一致性（如避免闪烁）。已有噪声生成方法实现复杂、效率低，缺少同时对方差与时间相关性进行显式控制的统一框架。

Method: 核心思想是将问题重构为联合蒙特卡洛估计：同时估计经典像素重建量与噪声方差。方差估计借用数据库文献中的"sketching"（草图/概要数据结构）概念——用低维随机概要近似高维统计量，从而在采样过程中直接、低成本地估计方差，并通过采样过程的时间结构控制噪声的时间相关性。

Result: 摘要仅给出定性结论：方法可在下游任务中实现时间控制，且相比先前方法代码更简单、运行更快；未提供定量指标、实验设置或对比基线。

Conclusion: 通过"sketching"辅助的联合蒙特卡洛估计，可将时变高斯噪声的方差与时间相关性统一纳入可控生成框架，为下游时间控制与时间一致性任务提供更简洁高效的实现。

Abstract: We suggest a method to generate time-varying Gaussian noise with controlled variance and controlled temporal correlation. This noise is used in several downstream tasks for temporal control and temporal coherence. The core technical idea is to phrase this problem as joint Monte-Carlo estimation of both a classic pixel reconstruction and estimation of variance using the concept of "sketching" from the database literature. We demonstrate that our method allows temporal control for downstream tasks with simpler and faster code than previous methods.

</details>


### [654] [Co-DSL: Human-LLM Co-design of Reusable Spatial Concepts for Layout Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15290)
*Jones, R. Kenny,Wu, Jiajun,Agrawala, Maneesh*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: Co-DSL：让用户与LLM共同设计可复用空间概念库，再由LLM编写布局程序生成"概念图"并用求解器搜索满足约束的布局，跨五个空间布局域验证了其可捕捉固定算子系统难以表达的模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有布局生成系统的操作/算子集合是预先固定的，LLM只能在这些算子上做组合，难以捕捉用户个性化、领域特定的空间布局模式；同时让LLM直接输出完整布局程序可靠性差。作者希望用户能以轻量交互方式定义可复用的空间概念，并让LLM只负责声明"哪些概念应成立"，把具体搜索交给求解器。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 概念库共建——用户给出自然语言描述，LLM 生成初始实现，用户在示例场景上观察执行行为并给出轻量反馈，LLM 据此修订概念实现逻辑，形成个性化算子库；(2) 布局编程——给定库，LLM 编写布局程序以响应新需求，执行程序实例化为"概念图"（concept-graph），即库概念的声明式组合；LLM 只需指定应满足哪些概念，再由求解器搜索满足这些概念的布局。

Result: 在五个空间布局域的实验中发现：(a) Co-DSL 库使 LLM 能捕捉此前固定算子系统难以处理的布局模式；(b) 概念图表示是 LLM 可靠组合概念的必要条件（消融验证）；(c) Co-DSL 让 LLM 编写出带高层参数控制的可生成式布局程序，用户可操纵这些参数探索一族相关布局而无需重新提示。

Conclusion: 以"用户—LLM 共建概念库 + 概念图声明式表示 + 求解器搜索"替代固定算子+端到端生成，可提升布局生成的表达力、组合可靠性与可控性；概念图作为中间表示是关键设计，参数化布局程序为用户提供可探索的设计空间。

Abstract: We present Co-DSL, a framework in which users and LLMs co-design reusable spatial concepts for layout generation. In the first stage, our system allows users to create a library of personalized operations. To add a concept, a user provides a description, which the LLM converts into an initial implementation. The user can then observe the concept's execution behavior over example scenarios and provide lightweight feedback to the LLM, which revises the concept's implementation logic. In the second stage, given a library, an LLM can author a layout program that meets a new layout request from a user. Executing a layout program instantiates a concept-graph, a declarative composition of library concepts. In this way, we require the LLM only to specify which concepts should hold, while we use a solver to search for a layout that satisfies them. Across five spatial layout domains, we find that Co-DSL libraries let LLMs capture layout patterns that are challenging for prior fixed-operation systems, and demonstrate that our concept-graph representation is needed for LLMs to reliably compose concepts together. We further find that Co-DSL lets LLMs author generative layout programs that expose high-level parametric controls users can manipulate to explore a distribution of related layouts without re-prompting.

</details>


### [655] [Integrating 3D Posture Neutralization with Statistical Shape Modeling for Head-Neck-Shoulder Ergonomic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17671)
*Luo, Jinbo,Ren, Hang,Yang, Yadie,Zhang, Jie*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出将姿态中性化与统计形状建模(SSM)结合的框架，对200名中国成年人头-颈-肩(HNS)区域3D扫描进行姿态归一后建模，得到标准化模板与群体形状变异模式，用于参数化人因工程设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 头-颈-肩区域对颈托、头盔等头戴/颈戴人因产品设计至关重要，但直接扫描数据混杂了受试者颈椎姿态，导致形状统计被姿态变形污染，无法反映真实解剖变异。

Method: 采集200名中国成年人自然姿态下的单次3D HNS扫描；对每个扫描先做姿态中性化：拟合参数化头-颈模型以解耦颈椎位姿与解剖形态，将颈椎位姿重置到统一中立构型，随后在标准化后的数据上建立统计形状模型，得到标准化模板与群体变异主模态。

Result: 获得捕获解剖形状变异（而非姿态形变）的HNS形状空间，包含标准化模板与群体级变异模式；并展示了该模型如何支持群体覆盖度分析与兼顾解剖多样性、保持中立颈椎姿态的产品设计。

Conclusion: 姿态中性化与SSM结合可为头颈肩参数化人因设计提供基线，但样本限于中国成年人且为静态几何统计，未涉及动态姿态、力学或实际产品验证。

Abstract: The design of ergonomic products and workspaces requires a deep understanding of human anatomy and posture. In particular, the head-neck-shoulder region is critical for many applications such as cervical orthoses, helmets, and other head-worn or neck-worn devices. This paper presents a framework that integrates posture neutralization with statistical shape modeling (SSM) for the head-neck-shoulder (HNS) region. We acquire a single three-dimensional (3D) scan of the head-neck-shoulder region from each of 200 Chinese adults in a natural posture for each subject. Every scan is then posture-neutralized before SSM. We fit a parametric head-neck model to each scan to separate cervical pose from anatomy, and reset the cervical pose to a common neutral configuration, so that the resulting model captures anatomical shape variation rather than posture-induced deformation. The resulting shape space yields a standardized template and population-wide modes of variation, providing baselines for parametric ergonomic design. We further discuss how the model supports population coverage analysis and the design of products that accommodate anatomical diversity while maintaining neutral cervical posture.

</details>


### [656] [DiffGIPC: Differentiable Mixed-Coordinate Contact Dynamics on GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19091)
*Huang, Kemeng,Ren, Bowen,Lu, Xinyu,Li, Minchen,komura, Taku*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: DiffGIPC：面向接触丰富的可微逆问题，提出GPU加速的可微IPC框架，用仿射体（每体12自由度）导数与耦合FEM-仿射伴随系统替代全空间FEM，兼顾非穿透与摩擦耦合，前向+反向相比DiffIPC提速约150x（全空间FEM）与4133.3x（仿射体）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的逆问题（形状设计、初始状态优化、关节控制）需要高效梯度与可靠的非穿透约束。现有可微方法用罚函数或速度级约束，会穿透或位置漂移；IPC用几何障碍与CCD保证非穿透，但全空间FEM下前后向反复评估代价高，尤其近刚体部件保留大量顶点自由度。

Method: 提出DiffGIPC：(1) 仿射体导数，每个仿射体仅保留12个运动DoF，支持rest-shape设计、初始状态优化与关节控制；(2) 梯度中显式建模几何、位置、驱动变化经碰撞与摩擦对其他物体的影响；(3) 每帧构建一个耦合的FEM-仿射伴随系统，缩减反向系统规模同时不丢弃逆问题依赖；(4) GPU优化反向计算以降低重复梯度评估开销；(5) 可复用PyTorch接口，将物理参数对接到用户自定义参数映射与损失（设计、辨识、运动、位置、关节控制）。

Result: 实验显示，前向仿真与反向微分合计相比DiffIPC峰值提速约150.0x（全空间FEM设定）与4133.3x（仿射体设定）。

Conclusion: DiffGIPC在保持IPC式非穿透/摩擦接触与物理耦合依赖的前提下，通过仿射体参数化、耦合伴随系统与GPU加速显著提升可微接触仿真的梯度效率，为接触丰富的设计、辨识与控制提供可复用工具链。

Abstract: Contact-rich inverse problems require efficient gradients and reliable enforcement of non-penetration. Existing differentiable methods provide fast simulation and rigid-deformable coupling, but contact treatments based on penalties or velocity-level constraints can permit penetration or positional drift. Incremental Potential Contact (IPC) maintains non-penetration through geometric barriers and {continuous collision detection (CCD)}. However, repeated forward and backward evaluations remain costly in full-space finite-element (FEM) implementations, particularly when nearly rigid components retain many vertex {degrees of freedom (DoFs)}. We present DiffGIPC, a GPU-accelerated differentiable IPC framework for optimizing interacting deformable and nearly rigid bodies. Our affine-body derivatives enable {rest-shape} design, initial-state optimization, and articulated control while retaining only twelve motion DoFs per affine body. These gradients account for how changes in geometry, placement, and actuation affect other objects through collision and friction. We preserve these interactions in one coupled FEM-affine adjoint system per frame, reducing the backward-system size without discarding the dependencies that drive the inverse problem. GPU-optimized backward computation further reduces the cost of repeated gradient evaluations. A reusable PyTorch interface connects supported physical parameters to user-defined parameter maps and losses across design, identification, motion, placement, and articulated control. Experiments demonstrate peak speedups over DiffIPC of approximately 150.0x with full-space FEM and 4133.3x with affine bodies for combined forward simulation and backward differentiation.

</details>


### [657] [ResStreamGS: Residual-Sensitive Dual-Stream Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Volumetric Video Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21121)
*Liu, Haoran,Wu, Di,Luo, Wang,Na, Hengyuan,Hu, Miao,Quan, Guocong*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: ResStreamGS：一种残差敏感的双流移动端体视频流框架，按高斯时序行为区分稳定/残差敏感基元，稳定高斯每GOP只传一次，仅残差敏感高斯进入逐帧硬件可解码视频流，在复杂全景体视频上大幅提升编码后质量并降低带宽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS（如V³）的移动体视频流方案将所有高斯视为逐帧变化信号，对大部分区域时序稳定的全景内容不适用；逐帧适配与编码会在时序稳定区域引入质量退化。

Method: 轻量探针适配（lightweight probe adaptation）识别残差敏感基元；在每个GOP内复用稳定高斯，稳定部分每GOP仅传输一次，仅残差敏感高斯保留在逐帧、可由硬件解码的视频流中，形成双流残差敏感框架。

Result: 复杂全景体视频上，编码后PSNR较受控的V³风格全高斯基线提升7.51–8.35 dB，均摊负载最多降低56.5%，在Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G上达30.883 FPS。

Conclusion: 按高斯时序行为进行区分式编码可在受限带宽与算力下显著改善移动端自由视点体视频的质量-码率权衡，实现实时解码播放。

Abstract: Real-time mobile volumetric video enables immersive free-viewpoint experiences, but delivering high-quality 3D content under constrained bandwidth and computation remains challenging. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems, such as V$^3$, enable efficient mobile streaming by encoding time-varying Gaussian attributes with commodity video codecs and hardware decoding. However, existing pipelines treat all Gaussians as frame-varying signals, which is poorly suited to full-scene content where large portions remain temporally stable. Our empirical study shows that frame-wise adaptation and video coding of all Gaussians cause quality degradation in complex full-scene content, particularly in temporally stable regions. To address this issue, we propose ResStreamGS, a residual-sensitive dual-stream framework that processes Gaussians according to their temporal behavior. ResStreamGS identifies residual-sensitive primitives through lightweight probe adaptation and reuses stable Gaussians within each Group of Pictures (GOP). Stable Gaussians are transmitted once per GOP, while only residual-sensitive Gaussians remain in the frame-wise hardware-decodable video stream. Experiments on complex full-scene volumetric videos show that ResStreamGS improves post-codec PSNR by 7.51--8.35~dB over a controlled V$^3$-style all-Gaussians baseline, reduces amortized payload by up to 56.5%, and achieves 30.883~FPS on a Qualcomm Snapdragon 778G platform.

</details>


### [658] [From Sketch to Scene: Relightable Garment Reconstruction from Marked Sketches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21865)
*Doğan, Ahmet Neçirvan,Başaran, Eren Acar,Sezgin, Metin,Montazeri, Zahra*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 将带星形(高光)与月形(阴影)稀疏标注的服装草图加简短纹理文本,转换为可重打光、可编辑的带纹理3D网格场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有草图到3D流程无法表达光照意图,把绘制的明暗烘焙为纹理中的暗色颜料,导致光源不可移动;而草图本身天然包含空间结构与设计者对高光/阴影位置的意图。

Method: 基于与美术学生的启发式调研确定两个最常用符号作为标注。系统从标注草图预测场景方向光,并单独预测一个位移场,使月形标注区域在该光照下自然落入阴影,而非在纹理中涂暗;再结合文本提示生成纹理。

Result: 输出为带显式方向光的纹理化3D网格,作为可在生成后重新打光与编辑的三维场景。

Conclusion: 通过将明暗意图分解为光照预测与几何位移,而非烘焙进纹理,草图到3D生成获得了可重打光与可编辑的物理合理表达。

Abstract: Sketching is one of the most natural ways for people to express visual ideas. Unlike the text prompts that most generative systems rely on today, a sketch captures spatial structure and intent directly, including where a designer wants highlights and shadows to appear. Yet current sketch-to-3D pipelines have no input for that intent: they bake the drawn shading into the texture as dark paint, and the light cannot be moved. We propose a system that transforms a rough garment sketch, marked with sparse annotations (a star for a highlight and a moon for a shadow), and a short text prompt describing the texture, into a textured 3D mesh with an explicit directional light, as a scene that can be relit and edited after generation. The two symbols are the most frequent proposals in an elicitation study with art students. From the marked sketch the system predicts the scene's directional light and, separately, a displacement field that bends the surface so that the moon-marked regions fall into shadow under that light, rather than being painted dark in the texture.

</details>

### [659] [Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21452)
*Wang, Siyin,Yu, Wenyi,Chiba, Terumi,Chen, Xianzhao,Tian, Xiaohai,Zhang, Jun,Lu, Lu,Zhang, Chao*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: ELLSA 2 是一个端到端全双工对话模型，联合优化语音交互与流式手势-表情生成，通过分块自回归合成器结合预训练声学特征与听/说隐状态，并引入上下文语义调用与模板引导，实现对话感知的共语手势生成，同时构建数据与评测流程，用参考型 MLLM 作为自动评判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面对面交谈需要同时协调说话与倾听过程中的语音、手势和表情。现有全双工语音对话模型主要关注语言层面的听说切换，缺少在语音沉默时仍持续产生非言语行为（手势、表情）的能力；同时共语手势生成研究多与对话系统解耦，缺少对话感知的数据与评测标准。

Method: 提出 ELLSA 2：以对话骨干网络与语音合成器分别提供听/说隐状态，与预训练声学特征一起输入自回归分块合成器，实现流式、连续的非言语生成（即使说话通道静默）；引入上下文语义调用（contextual semantic calls）判定"是否调用"某语义手势，再用模板引导决定"如何实现"，将语义决策与动作实现解耦；建立对话感知共语手势的数据整理与评测流程，并研究基于参考的 MLLM 自动评判。

Result: ELLSA 2 与开源全双工语音交互模型相比保持很强竞争力，在对话感知手势与表情指标上优于级联基线；语义模板引导显著提升语义手势质量；参考型自动评分与人类判断存在较强系统级相关性，可作为全双工与语义手势评估的初步指标。

Conclusion: 该工作将对话建模从"语音应答"推进到协调的多模态交互，把全双工语音与流式手势-表情生成统一在一个端到端框架内，并提供对话感知的评测范式。

Abstract: Human face-to-face conversation requires coordinating speech, gestures and expressions across both speaking and listening. We present ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation. An autoregressive, chunk-wise synthesizer combines pretrained acoustic features with distinct listening and speaking hidden states from the dialogue backbone and speech synthesizer, enabling continuous non-verbal generation even when the model is verbally silent. To translate dialogue understanding into vivid semantic gestures, we introduce contextual semantic calls and template guidance, separating whether to invoke an available semantic gesture from how to realize it. We also establish a curated data and evaluation pipeline for dialog-aware co-speech gesture generation and investigate reference-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as automatic judges. Experiments show that ELLSA 2 remains highly competitive with open-source full-duplex speech interaction models and outperforms cascaded baselines across dialog-aware gesture and expression metrics. Semantic template guidance further significantly improves semantic gesture quality. Strong system-level correlations with human judgments support these reference-based scores as useful preliminary metrics for full-duplex and semantic gesture assessment. Together, these results advance dialogue modeling from spoken responses toward coordinated multimodal interaction.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [660] [SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11361)
*Dahan, Aviad,Khatib, Rajaei,Bitton, Yonatan,Szpektor, Idan,Wolf, Lior,Giryes, Raja*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出SepGen，将预训练音视频生成器扩展为单次联合采样中同时输出视频、混合音轨及每个带标注声源的独立波形，支持生成与分离两种模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D音视频场景的新视角渲染要求每个声源是可单独访问的波形，以便定位与传播后再混音；但现有联合音视频生成器的音轨仅为不可分离的混合音频。

Method: 基于预训练音视频生成器，用源标注（caption）条件化，在一次联合采样中生成视频、混合音轨和逐声源stem；生成模式下由caption定义每个stem内容（如双人对话按原轮流顺序分轨），分离模式下保持输入混音干净、由caption指定要提取的内容。

Result: 在文本合成场景上评估生成，在其他生成器渲染场景及语音、音乐、音效真实录音上评估分离；给定混音与含台词文本的caption时，SepGen超过语言条件分离器，语音上优势最明显，移除台词后仍保持领先。

Conclusion: 统一生成与分离的联合采样框架可为4D音视频场景提供可单独传播的声源波形，代码、权重与数据集已公开。

Abstract: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/

</details>


### [661] [AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13072)
*Pan, Shaohua,Liu, Xiao*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出免训练、免反演的提示驱动音视频联合编辑框架 AV-FlowEdit，利用源-目标流差异同时提供跨模态编辑方向与保持线索，并用跨模态事件感知谱轨迹保持策略抑制采样漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频扩散模型只能生成同步内容，编辑已有片段时难以在实现目标修改的同时保持非目标结构与跨模态对应关系；已有编辑方法通常需要模型训练、外部掩码或基于优化的反演，成本高且易破坏预训练跨模态交互。

Method: 核心洞察是源-目标流差异同时编码跨模态编辑方向与保持线索；在共享扰动下用该差异联合更新视频与音频分支，支持纯视觉、纯音频与联合编辑。为抑制采样累积漂移，提出 Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation，融合流显著性、对齐的音频活动、多尺度低频位移与扩散阶段调度，自适应保护无支持区域同时放行目标视听事件。全程无需训练、外部掩码或优化反演。

Result: 实验显示较好的提示对齐与时间一致性，音频质量与跨模态连贯性具有竞争力；消融与对比隐式支持各组件（流显著性、音频活动、低频保持、阶段调度）的必要性。

Conclusion: AV-FlowEdit 以无训练、无反演方式实现提示驱动音视频联合编辑，验证了流差异作为统一编辑方向与保持信号的可行性，为跨模态内容编辑提供轻量方案。

Abstract: Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.

</details>


### [662] [Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning for Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation: From Physical Alignment to Scene Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14077)
*Li, Jia,Yu, Yinfeng*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出两阶段多模态学习框架（物理对齐 ICGE + 场景聚合 CMSA）解决动态音视导航 D-AVN 问题，在 Replica/Matterport3D 上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中声源常为移动目标，而现有 AVN 方法依赖语义听觉特征，难以泛化到未见声类且缺乏细粒度空间推理能力，故提出 D-AVN 问题与物理对齐的新框架。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段物理对齐，用 Intensity-Calibrated Geometry Encoder (ICGE) 将声音强度与视觉几何做物理先验对齐，获取类别无关的空间对应；第二阶段场景聚合，用 Transformer 的 Cross-Modal Scene Aggregator (CMSA) 动态整合多模态特征构建状态表示用于策略学习。

Result: 在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 上实现 SOTA 成功率，且在复杂环境和未见声类场景下泛化性与导航效率显著提升。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的强度-几何对齐可替代语义听觉特征，提升动态音视导航的泛化与效率，是一套有效的两阶段多模态学习范式。

Abstract: Embodied Audio-Visual Navigation (AVN) requires an agent to locate sound targets by jointly leveraging visual and auditory cues. While prior work has achieved notable success with static sound sources, real-world scenarios often involve moving targets, giving rise to the more challenging problem of \textbf{Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation (D-AVN)}. Existing approaches largely rely on semantic auditory features, which limits generalization to unheard sound categories and hinders fine-grained spatial reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose a novel \textbf{Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning} framework for D-AVN. In the Physical Alignment stage, the proposed \textbf{Intensity-Calibrated Geometry Encoder (ICGE)} performs physics-informed alignment of sound intensity with visual geometry to capture category-agnostic spatial correspondence. In the Scene Aggregation stage, a Transformer-based \textbf{Cross-Modal Scene Aggregator (CMSA)} dynamically integrates multi-modal features to construct a robust state representation for policy learning. Extensive experiments on Replica and Matterport3D demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art success rates, while significantly improving generalization and navigation efficiency in complex environments and under unheard sound scenarios.

</details>


### [663] [Unsupervised Data Drift Monitoring for Deployed Deepfake Speech Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16826)
*Prokeš, Lukáš,Staněk, Vojtěch,Firc, Anton,Malinka, Kamil*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出一种无监督漂移监测器，基于已部署深度伪造语音检测器的内部嵌入，用正则化马氏距离与真/假参考对比，划分可信、模糊与新异区域，从而在无标签条件下对陌生输入预警或转人工复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造语音检测器通常以固定基准上的二分类精度评估，但实际部署中攻击手法、编解码、说话人与录音条件持续变化，且运行期没有标签，因此难以判断检测器何时处于"熟悉"条件、何时结果可信。作者主张应把部署后的检测器视为可靠性问题而非单纯分类问题。

Method: 在检测器内部嵌入空间上做无监督漂移监测：分别以真样本（bona fide）与伪造样本（spoof）参考集为基准，计算输入到两类参考的正则化马氏距离，据此定义嵌入空间中的可信区、模糊区与新异区；落入不可信区域的输入被标记为警报或路由至人工复核。在3个数据集、4个现代检测器上进行评估。

Result: 监测器能对数据集不匹配（分布漂移）成功报警，并显著降低"将深度伪造误判为真实而接受"这一安全关键错误，代价是自动覆盖率下降。结果还显示漂移同时作用于两个类别：即使在域内设置下，真实录音也可能偏离训练参考，导致警报率上升。

Conclusion: 部署中的深度伪造语音检测器不应仅被视为二分类器，而应作为可靠性/漂移监测问题来处理；基于嵌入空间的区域划分是无需标签即可提示运行条件是否熟悉的有效手段。

Abstract: Deepfake speech detectors are typically evaluated as binary classifiers on fixed benchmarks, but deployed systems face evolving attacks, codecs, speakers, and recording conditions, with labels unavailable during operation. This makes it difficult to know when a detector operates in familiar conditions and can be relied on. We propose an unsupervised drift monitor that operates on the internal embeddings of a deployed detector. The monitor compares each input against bona fide and spoof references using regularized Mahalanobis distances. These distances define trusted, ambiguous, and novel regions of the detector embedding space, allowing unfamiliar inputs to be routed for review. We evaluate the monitor on four modern detectors on three datasets. The monitor raises alerts for dataset mismatches and substantially reduces the security-critical case of accepting deepfakes at the cost of reduced automatic coverage. The results also show that drift affects both classes: bona fide recordings can move away from the training reference, increasing alert rates even in in-domain settings. Our findings suggest that deployed deepfake speech detectors should be treated not only as a binary classification, but also as a reliability problem.

</details>


### [664] [An Initial Study of Physiological Markers for Deepfake Speech Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18934)
*Staněk, Vojtěch,Frič, Michal,Malinka, Kamil,Firc, Anton*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用36个手工设计的生理标记（呼吸、发声、时间协调三类）检测深度伪造语音，用逻辑回归与SVM在英语数据上评估，域内EER为21.40%，跨域为32.77%，并借助逻辑回归系数提供可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度伪造语音检测器主要针对合成伪影，在未见攻击或录音条件下性能下降。人类语音包含源于语音产生系统的呼吸、发声与时间协调等生理特征，合成器难以忠实复现，因此作者假设可通过检测这些生理模式的不一致性来识别伪造语音。

Method: 构建36个手工生理标记，分为呼吸、发声、时间三类；在合并的英语录音上提取标记向量，使用逻辑回归与SVM分类器进行检测，并分析逻辑回归系数以判断标记值偏高时倾向真实还是伪造语音。

Result: 域内最佳系统达到21.40%的等错误率（EER）；逻辑回归在跨域数据集对上达到32.77%的EER。

Conclusion: 结果初步表明生理标记可为深度伪造语音检测提供有用且可解释的信号，但整体检测精度仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Conventional deepfake speech detectors primarily target synthesis artifacts and often degrade under unseen attacks or recording conditions. Human speech, however, contains physiological markers associated with respiration, phonation, and temporal coordination arising from the speech-production system that synthesizers may not reproduce faithfully. This motivates the hypothesis that deepfake speech can be detected by identifying inconsistencies in these patterns, which we test using 36 handcrafted physiological markers organized into respiratory, vocal, and temporal categories. We evaluate the marker vectors with logistic regression and SVM classifiers on pooled English recordings. The best in-domain system achieves a 21.40% equal error rate (EER), while logistic regression achieves 32.77% on the out-of-domain dataset pair. Since the markers describe specific speech-production properties, the logistic-regression coefficients indicate whether higher marker values push the classifier toward bona fide or deepfake speech. These results provide initial evidence that physiological markers offer a useful, interpretable signal for deepfake speech detection.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [665] [Distributionally Robust Adaptive Iterative Covariance Steering for Small-Body Proximity Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12774)
*Khatana, Vivek,Gahlawat, Aditya,Hovakimyan, Naira,Voulgaris, Petros*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 将迭代协方差转向(iCS)与L1分布鲁棒自适应控制($L_1$-DRAC)结合，为小天体近距离自主操作提供风险感知的连续推力制导与避撞，并在1000次配对蒙特卡洛中验证了违反率与碰撞率的大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小天体近距离操作面临引力、太阳辐射压(SRP)不确定性与随机扰动，标称规划模型与真实动力学存在失配，需在分布鲁棒意义下保证规避约束的可行性并补偿不确定性。

Method: iCS规划满足分布鲁棒CVaR禁飞区约束的标称反馈策略；$L_1$-DRAC补偿动力学不确定性，并通过Wasserstein半径将残余分布失配反馈给规划器，形成规划-自适应控制的耦合闭环。

Result: 在含引力、SRP与扩散失配的1000次配对蒙特卡洛中，$L_1$-DRAC将禁飞区违反率从32.7%降至0.2%，物理碰撞率从16.4%降至0，且未触发执行器饱和。

Conclusion: 分布鲁棒规划与自适应控制的紧耦合可显著提升不确定性下小天体近距离操作的安全裕度，但验证仅为仿真蒙特卡洛，缺少硬件/在轨飞行实证。

Abstract: Autonomous small-body proximity operations require continuous-thrust guidance under uncertain gravity, solar-radiation pressure (SRP), and stochastic disturbances. We combine iterative covariance steering (iCS) with $L_1$ distributionally robust adaptive control ($L_1$-DRAC) to provide risk-aware collision avoidance despite mismatch between the nominal planning model and the true dynamics. Iterative covariance steering plans a nominal feedback policy satisfying distributionally robust conditional value-at-risk keep-out constraints, while $L_1$-DRAC compensates for dynamics uncertainty and bounds the residual distributional mismatch through a Wasserstein radius used by the planner. In $\mathbf{1000}$ paired Monte Carlo trials with gravity, SRP, and diffusion mismatch, $L_1$-DRAC adaptive control reduces the keep-out violation rate from $\mathbf{32.7\%}$ to $\mathbf{0.2\%}$ and the physical collision rate from $\mathbf{16.4\%}$ to zero, without actuator saturation.

</details>


### [666] [Aerodynamic Promptness of Tilting-Propeller Multirotors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16532)
*Franchi, Antonio*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该工作建立了多旋翼平台的气动敏捷性几何理论：在"带符号桨速+机构构型"的乘积执行器流形上引入Riemann度量，通过执行器映射微分、音乐同构与对偶微分构造扳率权限映射，其行列式平方根定义为气动敏捷性，并联系到动态反馈线性化与Holocopter/Voliro架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多旋翼的推力方向取决于可倾斜机构构型，桨速与机构速率在物理量纲与尺度上不一致，现有分配/秩分析缺乏统一几何框架来刻画"扳率生成能力"及其方向性与条件数。作者希望给出一个内在的、可解释的几何理论，统一固定桨、机械耦合倾斜与独立倾斜等情形。

Method: 以执行器状态（带符号桨速与机构构型）构成乘积流形，保留带符号二次桨律与构型相关推力方向的非线性执行器映射；在该流形上定义Riemann度量以统一比较桨加速度与机构角速率；将执行器映射微分、度量诱导的音乐同构及其对偶微分复合，得到从扳余向量到扳率向量的任务速率权限映射；在任务坐标下取该矩阵行列式平方根为气动敏捷性，并利用其谱分析方向权限与条件性；进一步导出度量水平逆、扳纤维正交投影算子与任务保持的内部运动，并与动态反馈线性化建立内在联系，最后专门化到Holocopter与Voliro结构。

Result: 给出气动敏捷性的严格定义：其正性等价于局部扳率满射；其谱分解给出方向性权限与条件数；构造出度量水平逆、扳纤维正交投影与不改变瞬时扳的任务保持内部运动，可用于在不改变当前扳的前提下调节敏捷性；并将既有分配与秩构造纳入同一执行器流形几何，说明Holocopter（独立倾斜、径向布置）与Voliro的架构特例。

Conclusion: 该文提供了一个几何化、可解释的敏捷性理论框架，把可倾斜多旋翼的控制权限分析统一为执行器流形上的度量与映射问题，为冗余执行器的内部运动调节与动态反馈线性化提供理论工具；但结论以理论推导与架构特化为主，缺少实机验证与开源实现。

Abstract: This work develops a geometric theory of aerodynamic promptness for multirotor platforms whose propeller directions depend on a smooth orientation-mechanism configuration. The actuator state consists of the actual signed propeller speeds and the mechanism configuration, and the nonlinear actuator map retains both the signed-quadratic propeller law and the configuration-dependent thrust directions. Constant direction maps represent fixed propellers, while shared dependence on mechanism coordinates represents mechanically coupled tilts. A Riemannian metric on the product actuator manifold compares propeller accelerations and orientation-mechanism rates through physically interpretable scales. Composing the actuator-map differential, the musical isomorphism induced by this metric, and the dual differential defines a task-rate authority map from wrench covectors to wrench-rate vectors. In fixed task coordinates, the square root of the determinant of its matrix defines aerodynamic promptness. Positive promptness is equivalent to local wrench-rate surjectivity, while the associated spectrum resolves directional authority and conditioning. The same construction yields the metric horizontal inverse, the orthogonal projector onto wrench-fiber directions, and task-preserving internal motions that regulate promptness without changing the instantaneous wrench. The construction is related intrinsically to dynamic feedback linearization and specialized to the independently tilting, radially arranged Holocopter and Voliro architectures, clarifying how their established allocation and rank constructions fit within the same actuator-manifold geometry.

</details>


### [667] [Multi-Agent Deferred-Decision Trajectory Optimization with Anytime-Valid Target Retention for Moving Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17003)
*Siahkali, Farbod,Hou, Mengxue,Gupta, Vijay*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出滚动时域延迟决策轨迹优化（DDTO）控制器，融合保形终端位置预测、序贯候选剔除、容量约束分配与候选条件规划，用于目标身份与终端位置双重不确定的多智能体终端拦截，并给出覆盖/保留与失败概率的理论界，100组场景中严格预算下捕获率79%、放宽后85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体终端拦截中，真实目标身份未知、且各候选目标的终端位置不确定，导致分配与控制相互耦合：过早承诺候选会浪费控制预算并失去真实目标。需要一种能延迟决策、同时保证统计有效性的规划框架。

Method: 1) 用保形预测（conformal prediction）构建终端位置的预测集；2) 序贯候选剔除，逐步排除不可能的候选；3) 容量约束分配把有限智能体分配给尚存候选；4) 候选条件规划（candidate-contingent planning）与滚动时域重规划；5) 理论分析：在终端与身份残差可交换、可预测查询条件下，证明固定时间覆盖与随时有效目标保留；6) 最后一步重规划时，界定"收紧集合DDTO计划通过非线性 rollout 验证但捕获失败"的联合概率；7) 对无已验证计划的智能体施加兜底制导（fallback guidance）。

Result: 理论上给出固定时间终端位置覆盖、随时有效目标保留，以及最终重规划步上验证通过但捕获失败的联合概率上界。实验在100组配对场景中，严格控制代价预算下捕获79%目标，放宽预算后捕获85%。

Conclusion: 将保形预测与滚动时域条件规划结合，可在目标身份与终端位置双重不确定下提供具有统计保证的延迟决策拦截策略，兜底制导保证闭环可行性；但真实机器人验证与更复杂动力学下的泛化仍待考察。

Abstract: We study multi-agent terminal interception when one of several moving candidates is the unknown target and both target identity and candidate terminal locations are uncertain. We develop a receding-horizon deferred-decision trajectory optimization (DDTO) controller that combines conformal terminal-location prediction, sequential candidate rejection, capacity-constrained assignment, and candidate-contingent planning. Under exchangeability conditions for terminal and identity residuals, with predictable querying, we establish fixed-time terminal-location coverage and anytime-valid target retention. At the final replan, when one control step remains, we bound the joint probability that a tightened-set DDTO plan passes nonlinear rollout verification but capture fails. The closed-loop controller applies fallback guidance to any agent without a verified DDTO plan and, across 100 paired scenarios, captures 79% of targets under the strict control-effort budget and 85% when that budget is relaxed.

</details>


### [668] [Reach-Avoid Certificates for Contact-based Stochastic Hybrid Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17308)
*Xia, Tianyi,Cosner, Ryan K.*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该工作研究随机混合系统的无限时域认证式reach-avoid控制：连续流由SDE支配、跳变由受控随机核支配，且控制仅出现在复位核中。作者提出reach-avoid contact certificates（条件仅施加于sublevel corridor），配合相容复位策略即可满足"以至少规定概率先达目标后避危险"的规格，并用逐点安全滤波器将验证拓展到控制。进一步证明执行非Zeno并给出期望安定时间与跳变次数界。证书搜索被建模为可微字典上的线性规划加独立验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机混合系统的reach-avoid认证控制已有工作多假设自发/受控跳变时刻、有限时域或离散时间动力学，缺乏无限时域下控制仅作用于复位核情形的可证明保证；需要面向该设定给出无限时域概率规格的证书与控制方法。

Method: 引入reach-avoid contact certificates，其流条件与跳变条件仅需在sublevel corridor上满足；证明任何满足兼容复位策略的证书满足规格；构造逐点安全滤波器约束任意名义控制器以实现由验证到控制的扩展；证明执行非Zeno并给出期望安定时间与复位次数上界；将证书搜索表述为任意二阶可微字典上的线性规划，随后独立验证。

Result: 认证区域覆盖真实区域的93.6%；在200回合的运球（dribbling ball）问题中，基于证书的安全滤波器达成目标并将碰撞次数从68降至0。

Conclusion: 该方法为控制仅存在于复位核的随机混合系统提供了无限时域reach-avoid认证保证，兼具形式化证明与可计算方法，并通过安全滤波器实现控制层面的保障，实验验证有效。

Abstract: This work studies certified reach-avoid control of stochastic hybrid systems in which a stochastic differential equation governs continuous flow and a controlled stochastic kernel governs guard-triggered resets. The input appears only in the reset kernel, where it determines the post-jump distribution. Certificates for such systems have so far assumed spontaneous or controller-chosen jump times, a finite horizon, or discrete-time dynamics; we certify, over the infinite horizon, that the target is reached before the unsafe set with at least a prescribed probability. First, we introduce reach-avoid contact certificates, whose flow and jump conditions are imposed only on a sublevel corridor, and prove that any such certificate with a compatible reset policy meets the specification; a pointwise safety filter extends this guarantee from verification to control by constraining arbitrary nominal controllers. Next, we prove that executions are non-Zeno and bound the expected settling time and reset count. We frame certificate search as a linear program over any twice-differentiable dictionary followed by independent verification. We illustrate our approach via comparisons where the certified region is a subset covering 93.6\% of the ground truth and where our certificate-based safety filter reaches the goal while reducing collisions from 68 to zero across 200 episodes of a dribbling ball problem.

</details>


### [669] [Filtering for Liveness: Recurrence via Backup Reachability Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17337)
*van Wijk, David E. J.,Ong, Pio,Ames, Aaron D.,Burdick, Joel W.*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于控制屏障函数(CBF)的滤波器框架，通过“备份可达性CBF+时间触发机制”保证闭环轨迹对指定集合的循环重现（recurrence），允许必要时的临时离开，同时尽量保留名义控制器行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CBF方法强制集合前向不变性，无法表达“允许离开但需按时返回”的活性（liveness）需求，而诸如无人机竞速中信标可见性、不相交区域间穿行等任务本质需要临时离开集合。

Method: 受CBF安全滤波范式启发，构建控制器滤波框架：一是备份可达性CBF，保持返回指定集合的能力在允许时限内；二是基于时间的触发机制，仅当名义行为将违反返回时限时才调用reach controller，从而以最小修正保证recurrence。

Result: 框架可在保证recurrence的同时尽可能保持名义行为，支持需要临时脱离集合的控制目标（如不相交区域间穿越）；在带信标可见性recurrence约束的无人机竞速示例中验证有效。

Conclusion: 将CBF从不变性约束推广到recurrence活性约束，为需要周期性回归的时序任务提供了一种最小侵入式滤波工具，但验证限于仿真级无人机案例。

Abstract: Liveness requires a dynamical system to repeatedly accomplish a desired objective over time. In this work, we consider a particular form of liveness known as recurrence, which requires the closed-loop trajectory to regularly revisit a prescribed set, with no more than a specified amount of time between visits. Inspired by the control barrier function (CBF) safety-filter paradigm, we develop a controller-filtering framework that makes adjustments to a nominal controller only when necessary to guarantee recurrence. Unlike conventional CBF methods, which enforce set forward invariance, our framework allows the trajectory to leave the set while guaranteeing its timely return. To achieve this, our framework combines two components: a backup reachability CBF that preserves the ability to return to the prescribed set within the allowable time, and a timing-based mechanism that invokes a reaching controller only when the nominal behavior would otherwise fail to meet the return-time requirement. The resulting framework guarantees recurrence while preserving the nominal behavior when possible, enabling control objectives that require temporary excursions from the set, such as traversal between disjoint regions. Our method is successfully utilized in a drone racing example with a recurrence constraint on beacon visibility.

</details>


### [670] [A Response to the Reply Presented in "A Fair Comparison of Sliding-Mode and Immersion-and-Invariance Observers"](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20815)
*Cervantes-Pérez, Luis,Santibáñez, Víctor,Sandoval, Jesús,Ortega, Romeo,Romero, José Guadalupe*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该技术报告针对带非线性摩擦的摆式系统，扩展了位置反馈速度观测器与自适应跟踪控制器的实验评估，比较了I&I自适应控制方案与自适应修正超螺旋观测器方案的增益整定准则，实验表明这些准则虽能衰减但无法在所有场景下消除抖振。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作（Muñoz-Vázquez与Sánchez-Torres的答复、Cervantes-Pérez等人的实验、Romero与Ortega等人的I&I自适应控制及整定准则、Dávila等人的自适应修正超螺旋观测器）之间存在整定准则有效性的争议，需要实验证据澄清这些准则能否普遍消除抖振。

Method: 在带非线性摩擦的摆式系统上进行实验对比：一方采用Romero等人的I&I自适应控制方案（增益按Ortega等人准则整定），另一方采用Dávila等人的自适应修正超螺旋观测器（增益按Muñoz-Vázquez与Sánchez-Torres准则选取），评估抖振表现。

Result: 实验结果显示，上述整定准则在某些场景下能衰减抖振，但一般而言无法消除抖振。

Conclusion: 现有针对位置反馈速度观测器与自适应跟踪控制器的增益整定准则不具备普遍消除抖振的能力，需要进一步研究更鲁棒的整定或控制策略。

Abstract: In response to the reply presented in [Mu\~noz-V\'azquez and S\'anchez-Torres(2026)], this technical report extends the experimental evaluation of position-feedback velocity observers and adaptive tracking controllers for a pendular system with nonlinear friction reported in [Cervantes-P\'erez et al.(2026)]. The immersion and invariance (I&I) adaptive control scheme proposed in [Romero et al.(2025)], whose gains are tuned according to the guidelines presented in [Ortega et al.(2025)], is compared with a control scheme employing the adaptive modi?ed super-twisting observer of [D\'avila et al.(2006)], whose observer gains are selected according to the guidelines proposed in [Mu\~noz-V\'azquez and S\'anchez-Torres(2026)]. Although these "tuning guidelines" attenuate chattering in certain scenarios, the experimental results reported here show that they do not eliminate it in general.

</details>


### [671] [Robust Multi-Agent Pursuit with Preemptive Communication via Reachability-Based Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22198)
*Book, Madison,Bradley, Justin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种控制-通信一体化策略：在间歇通信下，各智能体基于最后收到的邻居状态计算可达集，并用控制屏障函数（CBF）求解安全控制输入；当通信陈旧度有界时证明智能体间碰撞可避免，并通过"不确定性风险"与"运动学风险"指标决定是否抢占式发送状态。追逃仿真中较周期性与事件触发基线减少77.5%消息量且零碰撞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署中的资源受限机器人无法提供连续、完美的状态共享，而仅靠鲁棒控制不足以实现韧性部署；需要把鲁棒通信策略与安全控制统一起来，在间歇通信条件下仍保证智能体间安全。

Method: 统一控制/通信框架：每个智能体根据最近接收到的邻居状态外推其可达集，随传输间隔可达集膨胀；基于控制屏障函数求解保证避碰的安全输入，并用刻画不确定性与运动学风险的新指标决定何时抢占式广播自身状态。

Result: 证明在通信陈旧度有界条件下可保证智能体间避碰；多种追逃场景仿真中，抢占式通信相比周期性和事件触发基线减少77.5%消息量，且碰撞数为零。

Conclusion: 抢占式、风险驱动的通信调度可在显著降低通信开销的同时保持安全保证，为资源受限多机器人系统的控制-通信协同设计提供了可行路径；目前证据限于仿真，尚需实物验证。

Abstract: Safe multi-agent coordination typically assumes what real-world, deployed, resource-constrained robots cannot provide: continuous, perfect state sharing. Robust control strategies must be complemented with robust communication strategies to deliver resilient deployments. In this work, we propose a unified control/communication strategy that provides safe control to guarantee inter-agent safety under intermittent communication and demonstrate its effectiveness in a pursuit-evasion scenario. Each agent computes the reachable set of neighboring agents based on the last state information received, then solves for a safe control input based on control barrier functions to ensure agents avoid collision. We prove that inter-agent collision avoidance is guaranteed provided communication staleness remains bounded. As the reachable set inflates between state transmissions, each agent reasons about when to preemptively transmit its state information to neighboring agents based on novel metrics characterizing uncertainty risk and kinematic risk. We implement and simulate a variety of pursuit-evasion scenarios and show that preemptive communication reduces messages by 77.5% compared to periodic and event-triggered baselines with zero collisions.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [672] [Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10989)
*Zhu, Jialin,Liu, Xing,He, Feixiang,Wang, He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明了 Drifting Model 与 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) 的等价性，并据此提出改进方法 MBDMD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Drifting Model 在一步生成上潜力大，已有工作揭示其与扩散/流式生成模型 (DFSGMs) 的联系，但其与广泛使用的蒸馏方法 DMD/DMD2 之间的精确对应关系尚未建立，尽管两者优化目标公式几乎相同。

Method: 将预训练 DFSGM 的速度场/噪声场转换为 Drifting Model 中的吸引场，并从生成分布估计排斥场，从而证明 Drifting Model 的训练与 DMD 自然等价；基于该等价视角提出 Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD)。

Result: 建立了两者的精确对应关系，并据此推导出多带宽分布匹配蒸馏方法 MBDMD（摘要未给出定量实验数据）。

Conclusion: Drifting Model 训练在特定构造下等价于分布匹配蒸馏，该等价性为改进 DMD 提供新视角，催生 MBDMD。

Abstract: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation method- Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) (Yin et al., 2024b;a) to the best of our knowledge, even though their optimization objective formulas are virtually identical. In this paper, we prove that by converting the velocity-field / noise-field from the pre-trained DFSGMs into the attraction force field in Drifting Models and estimating the repulsion force field from the generative distribution, training the Drifting Model is naturally equivalent to the Distribution Matching Distillation. With this equivalent concept, we propose an improved method based on DMD from the Drifting Model's perspective- Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD).

</details>


### [673] [ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11140)
*Ma, Weiwei,Yu, Xiaobing,Qiu, Peijie,Yang, Jin,An, Zhaoqi,Dong, Xuanzhao,Zhao, Xiaoqi,Liu, Xiaofeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ActiveMedAgent，将临床"由廉价到昂贵"的序列诊断逻辑引入多模态医疗 AI：在冻结的 VLM 上跟踪诊断概率分布，按"诊断增益减成本"为每次证据采集打分，并用离线轨迹训练轻量 MLP 控制器决定何时追加证据、何时下结论。三个基准上优于无引导采集与全模态基线，并发现"信息过载"效应——175 例中少通道反而正确而全模态失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床诊断本质是序列化的：只有当额外证据有望消除诊断不确定性时，医生才从廉价检查升级到昂贵检查。现有医疗多模态 AI 多采用"一次性喂入全部模态"的静态范式，既忽略采集成本，也忽视冗余证据带来的信息过载与噪声干扰。

Method: 以冻结的、仅通过 API 访问的 VLM 为感知后端，维持候选诊断上的概率分布；对每个可采集通道计算"单步诊断效用 − 采集成本"的得分，构建带评分的采集轨迹；再用这些轨迹离线训练一个轻量 MLP 控制器，学习何时请求新证据、何时终止并给出最终诊断。

Result: 在三个常用医疗基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习一致优于无引导采集与全模态基线；并观察到信息过载效应：175 个案例中智能体以更少通道给出正确诊断，而全模态基线失败，说明"学会省略什么"与"学会采集什么"同等重要。

Conclusion: 成本感知的序列采集策略可有效提升多模态医疗诊断的准确性与效率，即便底层 VLM 冻结、仅经 API 调用；选择性省略冗余模态是提升鲁棒性的关键设计原则，提示主动式、有代价意识的证据获取优于无差别全模态输入。

Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

</details>


### [674] [Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11315)
*Wang, Shiwen,Zhao, Pengxiang,Yuan, Xiaoming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HSVDQuant 将低秩分支辅助的 W4A4 训练后量化建模为耦合校准问题，通过"去膨胀 Hessian"与激活噪声代理联合优化，在极低秩下超越高秩 SVDQuant。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的 W4A4 PTQ 中，低秩分支可补偿误差，但现有方法要么将低秩补偿与残差量化分离优化（需更高秩），要么依赖二阶权重更新而不显式建模激活量化误差，后者在 4-bit 下尤为严重。

Method: 将低秩辅助 W4A4 PTQ 统一表述为耦合校准问题，从联合目标推导基于优化的求解器：消去输出侧低秩因子得到"去膨胀（deflated）Hessian"，对已被低秩分量捕获的残差误差进行折减；同时引入激活噪声代理项以抑制激活量化误差。

Result: 在 5 个扩散骨干上，rank-4 HSVDQuant 的 PSNR/LPIPS 一致优于 rank-4 SVDQuant；在 SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell、FLUX.1-dev 上以 8× 更小秩、最高 6.25× 更快量化超越 rank-32 SVDQuant；在 Qwen3-8B 上 rank-4 将 MMLU 从 61.50% 提升至 68.17%。

Conclusion: HSVDQuant 以统一耦合优化框架实现更优的 W4A4 量化性能，同时显著降低秩需求与量化开销。

Abstract: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present HSVDQuant, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a deflated Hessian that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 HSVDQuant consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 HSVDQuant improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50% to 68.17% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, HSVDQuant achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.

</details>


### [675] [Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11362)
*Mo, Hao,Yang, Liying,Yao, Shumin,Yu, Xinxing,Liu, Ajian,Mao, Xudong,Liang, Yanyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bernoulli Flow Models（BFM），用一个连续的全局 Bernoulli 概率流路径统一建模二值数据生成，并推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移，从而在低 NFE 推理时无需蒸馏或额外训练即可稳定采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值扩散模型生成高质量样本所需函数评估次数（NFE）很高，推理代价大。现有方法定义离散单步前向路径再求逆向后验，在低 NFE 需要跨步采样时用单步似然近似真实多步似然，导致样本质量严重下降，且存在训练-推理的结构性不匹配。

Method: BFM 摒弃顺序单步马尔可夫扩散链，改为在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局 Bernoulli 概率流路径，并由此推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移。降低推理 NFE 只需在新时间网格上重新计算解析后验，而非基于跳步的近似，从而消除离散链的结构性训练-推理不匹配，实现自洽的低 NFE 采样。

Result: BFM 对激进的 NFE 压缩高度鲁棒。在 LSUN Churches 256×256 上，用 256 步训练的 BFM 仅用 16 步采样即达到 FID 9.22，而最先进的离散基线退化到 204.10。在标准全步推理下，BFM 也与连续与离散生成基线保持竞争力。

Conclusion: BFM 为快速二值数据生成提供了一个理论上严格、自洽且实际有效的框架，通过连续概率流与解析后验转移解耦生成动力学与固定离散时间步，显著缓解低 NFE 采样中的质量退化问题。

Abstract: Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.

</details>


### [676] [CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11394)
*An, Chihun,Jang, Ikbeom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CoPoE（疾病坐标专家乘积）框架，将多模态阿尔茨海默病证据映射到由遗传风险 R、分子病理 P、神经退行 N、临床分期 S 构成的四轴结构化潜空间，每个可用模态参数化一个对角高斯专家，用掩码 Product-of-Experts 仅融合可用模态，缺失模态不参与融合路径，从而在任意非空模态子集下得到可分解后验，且无需合成填补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床队列中模态缺失高度不规则，现有融合方法要么合成缺失输入、引入人工代理数据，要么把可用信号汇入不可解释的潜空间，既牺牲可靠性又损失可解释性。

Method: 疾病坐标系框架：将潜空间划分为 R/P/N/S 四个生物学与临床轴；每个观测模态对完整的 RPNS 向量参数化一个对角高斯专家；采用带掩码的 Product-of-Experts 融合，仅对可用模态求乘积，缺失模态不贡献因子，从而在 RPNS 路径上无需合成填补即可得到稳健、可分解的后验。

Result: 在 ADNI 数据集上、共享的非 PET 嵌入基准下，于全部 15 个观测模态子集评估中取得最优的全模态性能与最高平均 AUROC，并显著改善原始概率的 ECE、Brier 分数与 NLL；PET 监督探针显示全模态下病理（P）模块出现证据富集，且在撤除直接体液生物样本输入时仍保留 tau 相关信号。

Conclusion: 掩码专家乘积式疾病坐标融合为不规则缺失的多模态诊断提供了无需填补、可解释且稳健的后验推断路径，具备临床可解释性与跨模态子集的泛化能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CoPoE.

</details>


### [677] [Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12102)
*Lin, Shanchuan,Peng, Yansong,Wang, Fu-Yun,Fan, Haoqi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 data-space iteration：一种不含流离散化的少步生成框架，从噪声出发让同一生成器在数据空间中直接迭代精炼预测，每步都被训练为输出其容量所允许的最佳样本，可与 DMD 最小改动结合。ImageNet 256×256 上优于标准离散化基线，并匹敌需日程搜索的变体，无需日程专用训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配采样需大量网络评估；蒸馏到一步会显著掉质量，少步成为实用工作区间。现有少步方法沿概率流迭代，依赖人工固定且难以调优的时间步离散化，且当不同样本或空间位置的精炼难度不同时，固定离散化会受限。

Method: 取消流离散化，改为数据空间迭代：起始于噪声，共享生成器直接在数据空间精炼自身预测，每个迭代步骤的训练目标都是产出其容量允许的最优样本；该形式与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）整合仅需极小改动，从而可在匹配的训练条件下对迭代方式进行受控对比。

Result: 在类别条件 ImageNet 256×256 上，data-space iteration 优于标准离散化基线，并达到或超过通过日程搜索选出的变体，且不依赖日程专用训练。

Conclusion: 数据空间迭代是离散化流空间迭代的简单有效替代方案，适用于快速生成，去除了对启发式时间步日程的依赖，便于统一训练与对比。

Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

</details>


### [678] [Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12189)
*Wiese, Jannik,Schusterbauer, Johannes,Martorella, Tommaso,Ommer, Björn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出单阶段端到端扩散模型 JWS，直接在雷达空间做概率降水临近预报，结合掩码异步扩散与 scoring-rule 目标，实现少步生成，在 SEVIR 与 MeteoNet 上达到 SOTA 且训练与推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的概率降水临近预报方法依赖独立训练的有损压缩模块或确定性预报组件，导致训练与推理流程复杂，且迭代去噪带来高昂推理成本。

Method: 单阶段端到端扩散框架：直接在雷达空间建模以简化训练/推理并规避压缩引入的不确定性；Masked Asynchronous Diffusion 采用时间步采样，在保持干净上下文的同时使扩散训练适配高维时空数据；配合简洁的 scoring-rule 目标对齐概率预报训练并支持少步生成。

Result: 在 SEVIR 和 MeteoNet 基准上取得最先进的概率预报性能，同时降低训练与推理开销；最小模型以显著更少参数仍具竞争力，推理速度提升 17 倍以上。

Conclusion: 直接在雷达空间做单阶段扩散建模并引入异步掩码扩散与 scoring-rule 目标，可同时提升概率临近预报精度与效率，是压缩-扩散两阶段范式的有效替代。

Abstract: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

</details>


### [679] [Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12737)
*Wiest, Davide,Ariq, Ahanaf Hasan,Chowdhury, Abdul Monaf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KPSA 从经验神经正切核的分块分解出发，度量归一化的参数组敏感度并嵌入查询空间，用轻量核回归为未见输入估计敏感度，用于参数组/激活归因，实现输入依赖的可扩展条件可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度归因（反向传播）能给出输入相关的参数敏感度，但对多样本计算代价极高；静态重要性分数虽便宜却丢弃了输入依赖性。作者希望同时保留二者优点：廉价地为任意新输入估计参数组敏感度。

Method: 由经验神经正切核（empirical NTK）的分块分解导出 KPSA（Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas）：计算归一化的参数组敏感度，将源样本嵌入显式查询空间，训练轻量核以对未见输入预测敏感度；理论分析给出区分有限源误差与不可约表示误差的界，及基于 margin 的 top-k 恢复保证；并扩展到 transformer MLP 特征的激活归因。

Result: 在视觉、时序预测、蛋白建模上，参数预算 0.02%–0.1%（五倍范围）时，所选参数组达到一阶反向传播 oracle 扰动敏感度的 39%–85%；视觉与预测中出现跨深度、随输入系统变化的稀疏敏感度回路。激活归因任务上，视觉中保留 oracle 与常数基线差距的 81%，批量查询吞吐从 551 提升至 2,041 图像/秒，峰值 GPU 显存从 4.55GB 降至 0.44GB；蛋白任务恢复该差距的 68%。消融显示 KPSA 空间中的最近邻检索亦可保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 紧凑的核图谱能以摊销方式存储输入依赖的参数敏感度，在显著降低计算与显存开销的同时逼近反向传播 oracle，是迈向可扩展条件可解释性的一步；代码已开源。

Abstract: Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa .

</details>


### [680] [Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12848)
*Blessing, Denis,Celik, Onur,Neumann, Gerhard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出定点点流匹配（FFM）：一种无需训练数据的强化学习流程策略训练/微调方法，借助目标流恒等式将演员更新写为不动点迭代，以流匹配式回归目标拟合，评论家的动作梯度作为回归目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最大熵与行为约束RL的最优策略服从玻尔兹曼分布，该分布复杂且多模态；流策略+流匹配虽擅长表达此类分布，但依赖训练数据，而在线RL中通常不可得。

Method: 利用最优策略满足的「目标流恒等式」，将actor更新转化为不动点迭代；采用流匹配风格的回归目标，回归目标为critic的动作梯度；证明最优策略是该迭代的不动点；可在离线→在线设定下微调预训练流策略，也可从零在线训练。

Result: 大量实验表明FFM能在离线到在线场景中有效微调预训练流策略，并在在线RL中实现高效、准确的从零流策略训练。

Conclusion: 定点点流匹配为无需训练数据地学习表达能力强的流式策略提供了有原则的方法。

Abstract: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.

</details>


### [681] [Probabilistic Ship Trajectory Forecasting using Transformer Models on AIS Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13557)
*Schöller, Frederik E. T.*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用Transformer与Performer模型预测受限水域水面船舶轨迹，通过核密度估计生成局部位置热图并经CNN编码后输入模型，结合分位数损失获得预测区间，性能显著优于先前工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上航行（无论人工驾驶还是自主水面艇）都需要提前预判他船轨迹，以便碰撞规避等子程序及时评估态势并反应。既有方法多仅依赖目标船自身历史位置，忽略了局部水域内其他船舶的运动先验，且缺乏对预测不确定性的建模，难以支撑及时的避碰决策。

Method: 基于公开AIS位置数据，构建Transformer与Performer两种序列预测架构；将目标船周围局部区域其他船舶的历史运动统计以位置热图形式表达，热图由核密度估计（KDE）生成，并用CNN编码后作为额外输入条件注入Transformer类模型；训练目标采用分位数损失（quantile loss），从而得到模型感知的预测区间而非单点估计。

Result: 所提架构在受限水域船舶轨迹预测上大幅优于先前工作；引入局部热图后，模型能预测仅凭目标船历史位置无法指示的运动（如转向、避让等行为）。分位数损失使模型高效输出校准的预测区间。

Conclusion: 将局部交通先验热图与Transformer/Performer序列模型结合，并配合分位数损失，可有效提升受限水域船舶轨迹预测精度与不确定性表达能力，为自主水面艇的碰撞规避提供了可行方案。热图式社会/环境先验的引入思路对其他多智能体运动预测任务具有借鉴意义。

Abstract: Anticipation of vessel trajectories is an essential task when navigating at sea. This applies to both human navigators and autonomous surface vessels. Trajectory forecasting enables sub-routines such as collision avoidance to assess the situation and react accordingly in time. This paper investigates Transformer and Performer models for trajectory prediction of surface vessels in confined waters. Using widely available position data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS), candidate models are trained and evaluated. Historical information on how other vessels have moved in the local area surrounding each agent is conveyed using positional heat maps. The heat maps are generated using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) and encoded with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) before entering the Transformer models. The models are trained with quantile loss to efficiently obtain a model-aware prediction interval, as this is crucial for timely collision avoidance. The proposed model architectures are shown to greatly outperform previous work while the inclusion of local heat maps enables the prediction of vessel movement that is not otherwise indicated from the previous positions.

</details>


### [682] [Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13812)
*Deveney, Teo,Bogensperger, Lea,Wong, Hok Shing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 β-Flow：一种以相关系数 β 和置信度参数 κ 索引的通用即插即用采样器，统一了 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验，用于线性逆问题求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 flow-matching/diffusion 逆问题先验方法多为针对单一轨迹先验定制，即插即用方法又隐式去相关，导致先验过宽、稀疏观测下性能差；缺少统一框架刻画不同采样器的隐含偏差。

Method: 每步只需一次去噪网络前向，随后做不依赖网络梯度的高斯条件化（精确 Kalman 更新）；通过相关系数 β 在 flow、diffusion、去相关先验间插值，置信度 κ 控制路径分布约束强度。并证明多类现有引导采样器可视为该方法的特例或近似。

Result: 在 4 个数据集、7 个逆问题上 PSNR 与 SSIM 达到一致性的 SOTA 水平；验证了先验控制的有效性：观测信息少时高相关严格先验更优，观测信息多时低相关更优。

Conclusion: β-Flow 为扩散/流先验逆问题提供了统一、无需梯度的即插即用框架，并通过 β 与 κ 显式调控先验—似然互补关系。

Abstract: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $\beta$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $\beta$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $\kappa$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.

</details>


### [683] [Posterior Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13994)
*Ma, Chenrui,Xiao, Xi,Zhao, Lin,Jiang, Xinru,Wang, Tianyang,Shen, Yanning,Fioretto, Ferdinando*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Posterior Flow Matching (PFM)，在流匹配中同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差（高斯后验），使同一次模型评估既给出传输预测又给出端点不确定性；由学到的矩导出均值驱动 ODE 与方差自适应 SDE，在图像、点云、分子、动作生成上提升质量并提供全程端点后验读数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配只学习噪声到数据的传输，其均值预测无法直接给出中间状态处剩余端点不确定性，生成过程中缺乏不确定性诊断能力。

Method: 以高斯后验建模条件速度均值与逐分量方差，单次评估同时输出传输预测与端点方差；据此构建均值驱动 ODE 与由后验驱动、局部噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应的 SDE。

Result: 在图像、点云、分子与动作生成任务上均提升生成质量，并可在整个生成过程中读取端点后验信息。

Conclusion: PFM 是通用生成框架，将不确定性估计内生于流匹配采样过程，兼顾生成质量与可诊断性。

Abstract: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

</details>


### [684] [Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14017)
*Buades, Antoni,Lisani, Jose-Luis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Barycentric Anchored Search：利用预训练权重与两个微调检查点构造重心候选权重，并在锚定方向上做免梯度搜索，用少量 OOD 验证数据自适应选择合并权重，在 CLIP ViT-B/32 上提升分布偏移鲁棒性且保持 ImageNet 精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调视觉模型在分布偏移下性能下降；Model Soup 需要大量检查点，Model Stock 使用固定几何合并规则，无法利用验证反馈自适应调整，因此需要一种仅用两个检查点、免梯度、推理开销不变的权重空间后处理方案。

Method: 以预训练初始化为锚点，对两个源域微调检查点构造重心候选权重，并沿候选到预训练模型的连线方向进行小规模无导数搜索（受 Nelder-Mead 与 Torczon 多方向单纯形搜索启发，但限定在权重合并几何上）；用少量 OOD 数据验证子集选择候选，再在留出集与额外 OOD 基准及 ImageNet 验证集上评估。

Result: CLIP ViT-B/32 实验显示，搜索显著提升 ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch 等留出 OOD 性能，同时 ImageNet 精度保持可比；对未参与选择过程的 OOD 数据集也具迁移增益，优于原始微调检查点、朴素 model soup 与 Model Stock。

Conclusion: 在锚定权重空间中的轻量优化可作为固定权重平均、几何合并或单模型选择的实用替代方案，但需注意其验证选择依赖 OOD 数据，存在基准过拟合与验证集规模敏感性风险。

Abstract: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

</details>


### [685] [PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14031)
*Ba, Yang,Mancenido, Michelle V.,Pan, Rong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PLDiv：基于持续景观（persistence landscape）的多样性度量，从数据几何表示刻画数据集的结构组织，无需任务监督即可给出可解释的结构多样性标量，用于监测语义冗余与语义坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据流水线混合人类与AI生成数据，数据集增长常表现为语义冗余累积而非语义覆盖扩展，降低整体质量；现有多样性指标局限于词汇变化、熵或成对相似度，难以刻画数据分布的"形状"。

Method: PLDiv 将数据集转为几何表示，用持续景观（persistence landscape，拓扑数据分析工具）刻画"数据邻域随邻近样本逐步连接时如何演化"，从而给出可解释的标量结构多样性度量；无需任务特定监督。

Result: 在文本生成与图像嵌入的内在多样性度量、指令数据集与推理轨迹的语义坍缩检测中，PLDiv 与评测基线相比具竞争力，并在语义坍缩时与多样性标签高度一致；可支持合成数据监控、数据集构建、数据增强与生成模型评估等应用。

Conclusion: 结构多样性可从几何/拓扑层面被有效量化，PLDiv 为数据质量监控与生成模型评估提供了任务无关、可解释的通用度量工具。

Abstract: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

</details>


### [686] [A Geometric Perspective on Reward Function Updates in Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14041)
*Diwan, Anish,Peters, Jan,Arenz, Oleg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从占用测度空间（occupancy space）视角重新审视逆向强化学习的奖励梯度更新，指出e-测地线方向的几何性质决定IRL对偶梯度，据此提出以轨迹上平均Fisher信息预条件对偶梯度，该梯度等价于旧奖励与目标奖励的凸插值，从而实现低开销的自然梯度式更新，并从镜像下降角度分析其收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典IRL以拉格朗日对偶+梯度下降联合优化奖励参数与策略，但基于梯度的奖励更新只刻画了部分图景，忽略了占用空间中的问题几何结构，导致更新效率与理论刻画不足。

Method: 1) 建立IRL奖励更新的占用空间视角，利用最优解及其在占用空间中的几何已知这一洞察；2) 证明沿e-测地线（占用空间直线）趋向最优占用的几何直接影响对偶问题在奖励参数空间的梯度；3) 用占用轨迹上的平均Fisher信息对偶梯度做预条件；4) 揭示该预条件梯度是旧奖励与新目标奖励的凸插值，得到自然梯度式高效更新；5) 用镜像下降（MD）框架分析奖励更新，并给出收敛性结论。

Result: 所提预条件梯度被证明等价于奖励的凸插值，更新计算开销增加很小；从MD角度表明由此奖励驱动的策略搜索近似为策略上的熵正则镜像下降；并给出了几何感知IRL算法的收敛性结果。

Conclusion: 该工作为IRL提供几何感知的奖励更新理论与算法，联系自然梯度与镜像下降，兼具理论刻画与实用效率，但主要停留在理论/算法层面，缺少实际任务与真实系统验证。

Abstract: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is classically solved using Lagrangian optimisation, by jointly optimising a primal-dual problem with gradient descent to obtain the optimal reward function parameters and corresponding optimal policy. While this algorithmic view of IRL has been highly influential, gradient-based reward updates only paint a partial picture, largely ignoring the geometry of the problem in occupancy space. In this paper, we present an occupancy-space view of reward updates in IRL. We leverage the insight that both the optimal solution and its geometry in occupancy space are known, and show that the geometry along the e-geodesic (straight line in occupancy space) toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the gradient of the IRL dual problem in reward parameter space. This perspective naturally suggests preconditioning the dual gradient with the average Fisher information along the occupancy trajectory. We show that this preconditioned gradient is just a convex interpolation of the old reward and a new target reward, yielding efficient natural-gradient-style updates with little additional computational overhead. We then analyse these occupancy-space reward updates from a Mirror Descent (MD) perspective, and show that policy search over the resulting rewards induces approximate entropic MD on the policy. Finally, we conclude with convergence results of such geometry-aware IRL algorithms.

</details>


### [687] [Agreement versus Softmax under Spatial Disambiguation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14210)
*Zakrzewski, Michał,Shpir, Mariia,Rumezhak, Taras,Karpiv, Volodymyr*

Main category: cs.LG
