TL;DR: 在 ScanRefer 验证集上重新检验 3D 视觉定位中 Unique/Multiple 查询的校准问题，发现物体级 softmax 的误校准在两个子集上相近，而跨 epoch 一致性指标（fixed-final）会人为夸大差距（ECE 0.041 vs 0.272），并撤回此前关于 H1 非单调模式的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作常以跨 epoch 一致性（agreement）替代逐查询 logits 来评估校准，但其在空间歧义（Multiple）场景下的有效性缺乏严格验证，可能得出误导性结论。

Method: 在完整 ScanRefer 验证集（9,508 查询，GeoClassifier + 真值 proposals）上对比两类信号：物体级 softmax 的 ECE，以及 fixed-final 与 modal-vote 两种跨 epoch agreement 的 ECE；采用 scene-bootstrap 区间检验差距是否显著，并统计 Multiple 错误类型（同类别错实例、几何漏检 H2、错类别 H1）。

Result: 物体级 softmax 在 Unique 与 Multiple 上 ECE 接近（0.068 vs 0.102，bootstrap 区间含零）；fixed-final agreement 报告 ECE 0.041 vs 0.272（差距 +0.231），modal-vote 为 0.045 vs 0.318。Multiple 错误中同类别错实例占 45.6%，H2 几何漏检 59.6%，H1 错类别 16.7%。默认 fixed-final 协议下未出现 H1 非单调模式，该结论被撤回。无 logit 的阈值方法对空间困难查询排序效果差。

Conclusion: 跨 epoch agreement 会放大 Unique 与 Multiple 的校准差异，不宜作为逐查询 logits 的替代；若仅有 agreement 记录，应在 Multiple 子集上校准弃权，并同时报告错实例率与 H1 率。

Abstract: ScanRefer Multiple queries require spatial disambiguation: several instances of the target class are present, and the referencer must pick one. When per-query logits were never logged, a common substitute is cross-epoch agreement. On the full ScanRefer validation set (9,508 queries; GeoClassifier with ground-truth proposals), object-level softmax is similarly miscalibrated on Unique and Multiple (ECE 0.068 vs. 0.102; the scene-bootstrap gap interval includes zero). Fixed-final agreement on the same checkpoints reports ECE 0.041 vs. 0.272 (gap +0.231). Modal-vote agreement is 0.045 vs. 0.318. Most Multiple errors are same-class wrong-instance (45.6%); geometric miss (H2) is 59.6%, and wrong-category (H1) is 16.7%. A non-monotone H1 pattern does not appear under the default fixed-final protocol, and we retract it. Logit-free thresholds rank spatially hard queries poorly. If only agreement was logged, calibrate abstention on Multiple and report wrong-instance rates with H1.

</details>


### [688] [Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14302)
*Zarifis, Stelios,Filntisis, Panagiotis,Retsinas, George,Maragos, Petros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DySCOVER：自监督主动视觉学习框架，机器人通过视觉好奇心（重建误差）与预测好奇心（世界模型预测误差）双内在奖励驱动策略，主动采集更丰富的视觉经验以提升视觉表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物视觉并非从固定数据集中习得，而是在移动与交互中通过动作的视觉后果学习。受此发展视角启发，作者希望验证机器人能否通过好奇心驱动的主动交互改善视觉学习，并探究仅靠视觉新颖性是否足够。

Method: 机器人观测RGB帧，训练视觉自编码器对观测进行编码与重构，并训练循环世界模型在给定当前潜在状态与动作的条件下预测下一潜在状态；策略仅由内在奖励驱动：重建误差奖励视觉新颖观测，世界模型预测误差奖励后果尚不可预测的转移，从而偏向更复杂、经验更丰富的轨迹。以机械臂为具身智能体进行实验。

Result: 在初始条件、经验容量、具身形态与场景内容的多项变体中，加入预测好奇心相比仅使用视觉好奇心都能稳定提升视觉模型，说明预测误差可引导出超越单纯视觉新颖性的经验分布。

Conclusion: 预测好奇心能够为主动视觉学习提供超越基于重建的好奇心的增益，构成一种可扩展的自监督具身视觉学习范式。

Abstract: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

</details>


### [689] [Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14342)
*Ru, Yingdong,Zhuang, Lipeng,He, Zhuo,Camarasa, Gerardo Aragon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ContinuousCloth：连续时间、物理信息神经布料求解器，将弹簧-质点ODE嵌入神经轨迹模型，支持任意时刻查询并可通过自动微分获得位移、速度、加速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典时间步进模拟器只能在离散积分网格上输出轨迹，无法在任意时间戳查询，且高精度求解代价大；作者希望在保证物理精度的同时大幅降低运行时间，并将物理先验用于稀疏含噪观测下的下游任务。

Method: 连续时间物理信息神经求解器，把弹簧-质点ODE约束嵌入神经轨迹表示；支持任意时间戳查询，利用自动微分计算位移、速度与加速度。在纯物理设置下与高精度求解器对比六种边界条件场景；并与稀疏含噪观测融合，用于插值与参数估计。

Result: 纯物理设置下轨迹精度与高精度求解器相当，运行时间最高减少17.4倍；融合稀疏含噪观测时，仿真中插值误差比纯数据神经基线降低7.3倍，真实布料序列降低2.4倍；高噪声条件下参数误差比可微求解器基线低2.6倍。

Conclusion: 将弹簧-质点ODE作为强归纳偏置嵌入连续时间神经轨迹模型，可兼顾精度与效率，并在稀疏含噪真实观测下提升插值与参数估计的鲁棒性。

Abstract: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

</details>


### [690] [Design Choices for Multimodal Transformer Learning with Missing and Longitudinal Healthcare Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14436)
*Mendes, Rita Cordeiro,Pereira, Maria Manuel,Santiago, Carlos,Barata, Catarina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了Transformer多模态融合中的关键设计选择——模态级与特征级tokenization、attention masking与imputation处理缺失、以及时间信息的编码策略——在三个癌症纵向数据集上的生存预测表现。结论：多模态优于单模态，但缺失数据严重损害预测，tokenization粒度与模态内缺失处理是可靠预测的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习可整合异质数据提升预测，但真实数据集普遍不完整（缺失模态、模态内缺失），而现有Transformer融合方法对"如何处理缺失信息"缺乏系统性的设计准则；此外纵向数据的时间建模方式（时序表示）也缺少实证比较。

Method: 基于三个癌症纵向数据集，系统消融Transformer融合的若干设计维度：(1) tokenization粒度（modality-level vs feature-level）；(2) 缺失处理策略（attention masking vs imputation），覆盖自然缺失与人工合成缺失；(3) 时序信息表示与建模方式；并以单模态/多模态配置对比，任务为二分类生存预测与离散时间生存预测（多种时间编码）。

Result: 多模态配置优于单模态；但缺失数据显著降低预测性能，且不同tokenization粒度与模态内缺失处理策略带来的差异明显，说明这些设计选择对鲁棒性至关重要。

Conclusion: 在多模态纵向生存预测中，缺失数据处理不应被视为次要工程细节；合理的tokenization粒度与模态内缺失处理是获得可靠预测的必要条件，本文提供了可复用的设计经验与实证基准。

Abstract: Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. Our results show that while multimodal outperforms unimodal results, missing data heavily impacts predictions and thus effective design choices such as tokenization granularity, and intra-missing handling is essential for reliable prediction.

</details>


### [691] [HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14961)
*Chlasta, Karol,Struzik, Piotr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一融合网络 HiPAD，参加 MPDD-AVG 2026 抑郁检测全部六个子赛道；发现约150词的人格描述所携带的抑郁信号超过音频、视频与步态之和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁检测多模态挑战中，各模态（步态、音视频）与人格描述的贡献缺乏在固定架构下的可比评估，需要排除模型差异来研究数据本身的信号分布。

Method: 单一融合架构：各可用模态经共享 BiLSTM 编码，缺失模态零填充；仅当步态/音频/视频至少两种存在时启用跨模态注意力；人格描述不参与注意力，以拼接方式融合。通过该统一架构在六个子赛道做三项研究：(1) 人格描述四级消融 L0–L3；(2) 用 LoRA(7B)/QLoRA(72B) 在 PHQ-8/9 数据上域适应人格编码器，并与冻结 RoBERTa-large 对比；(3) 手工临床特征(eGeMAPS、OpenFace AU)与通用深度特征(wav2vec2、DenseNet)对比。

Result: 步态+人格单独使用 TLS 0.647，优于任何含音视频的配置；去除全部人格衍生特征（含 Big Five 分数）使 TLS 下降 0.499–0.507 并降至随机水平；LoRA/QLoRA 域适应使二分类 Cohen's κ 提升 0.13，但扭曲 PHQ-9 回归导致整体分数下降，冻结 RoBERTa-large 在此样本量下更优；音视频赛道上手工特征优于通用深度特征；系统跨赛道 G-Score 0.482。

Conclusion: 在每队列不足100名被试的条件下，限制因素是表征规模与输出校准，而非架构选择；人格描述信号在此设定下占主导。

Abstract: We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen's $\kappa$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. The unified system reaches a cross-track G-Score of 0.482; with under 100 subjects per cohort, the limiting factors are the size of the representation and the calibration of the outputs, not the choice of architecture.

</details>


### [692] [LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15267)
*Yalovetzky, Romina,Balestriero, Randall,LeCun, Yann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LeHami 将 JEPA 的预测器替换为动作条件哈密顿流，在结构化相空间 (q,p) 上用精确辛 leapfrog 积分，从几何上保证 rollout 不收缩，并在视觉摆环境中改善长时程速度预测与子帧步长泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA 直接在隐空间学习世界模型，但无约束自回归预测器在长时程 rollout 中会收缩潜分布，导致误差累积与表征退化。作者希望用几何结构提供推理时（而非仅训练时正则化）的保证。

Method: 把标准预测器替换为动作条件哈密顿流，潜状态组织为 (q,p) 相空间；动量型分量由学到的位置型表征的时间导数获得，形成显式二阶状态；用精确辛 leapfrog 步积分，逐步保持相空间体积。该构造与学到的参数和动作序列无关地排除了均匀收缩、渐近稳定不动点与不同潜状态合并。

Result: 在保守与驱动式视觉摆环境中，长时程速度预测显著优于无约束 JEPA 世界模型；基线潜体积收缩处，本方法实测保持体积近似恒定；学到的流在未见子帧步长积分与数值时间反演下仍准确。

Conclusion: 几何结构可为潜世界模型提供与表征正则化互补的推理时保证，说明物理归纳偏置（辛结构）是提升长时程预测可靠性的有效途径。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

</details>


### [693] [CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15327)
*Geng, Mengzhe,Lam, Max W. Y.,Cao, Yuewen,Hu, Shoukang,Xu, Jing,Tessier, Marc,Li, Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出CIViC四门协议，用条件输入与对照干预来判断多模态预测器是否真正使用了目标音频信息。在三个代理任务（静态人脸栅格、合成音频混合、SpeakerVid）上，消融/替换音频的效果方向互相矛盾，说明输出激活、留出误差与端点控制支持不同的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去除音频会改变视觉预测器的输出，但这并不能证明任务确实依赖了目标音频信息；现有解释方法缺少将"解释"与"干预、留出任务比较或端点控制"挂钩的严格检验。

Method: 提出CIViC（Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks）四门协议，把解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制绑定。在三个代理任务上验证：行为者不相交的人脸栅格测试（跨行为者音频替换、常数音频时序端点、四个匹配种子）、合成音频特征混合（条件增强拟合 vs 仅音频拟合，比较1000步RMSE）、以及源视频不相交的SpeakerVid代理（五特征置零拟合 vs 对齐音频，比较全帧灰度RMSE与片段漂移误差）。

Result: 静态人脸栅格中跨行为者音频替换以较小效应满足预设检测规则，但在另一时序端点上常数音频拟合在四个匹配种子上优于音频训练拟合；合成混合中条件增强拟合的1000步RMSE更高（0.1807 vs 0.1707），差距随训练缩小；SpeakerVid代理中五特征置零拟合在四个留出条件、五个配对种子上全帧灰度RMSE低于对齐音频，而对齐音频在片段漂移误差上更优。

Conclusion: 仅凭输出激活、留出误差或端点控制任一项不足以判定模型是否使用了目标音频；不同检验会导向不同解释，需多门协议交叉验证。结果是对当前多模态音频-视觉解释性评估方法的有力警示。

Abstract: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor's output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. In the SpeakerVid proxy, the five-feature-zero fit (five low-level audio summaries zeroed; identity, dialogue, and condition inputs retained) has lower whole-frame grayscale RMSE than aligned audio across four held-out conditions and five paired seeds, while aligned audio has lower segment-drift error. The results show that output activation, held-out error, and endpoint controls support different interpretations across these proxy tasks.

</details>


### [694] [Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15401)
*Liu, Xin,Jiang, Yutong,Su, Jian,Wang, Ziheng,Wang, Chuang,Li, Haoran,Zhao, Dongbin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VLMeg 将 VLM 从"精确奖励回归器"转为"成功检测器"，通过探索增强的关键观测门控实现无真值奖励的从零强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将 VLM 训练为奖励回归器的方法存在两个问题：需要大量标注，且主要面向预训练策略微调，在更难的从零强化学习场景中表现不佳。根本原因在于"回归精确奖励"与 VLM 擅长的多模态 VQA 能力不匹配。

Method: 提出 VLMeg。核心为探索增强的关键观测门控：(1) 依据当前 episode 与生成的成功轨迹的相似度判断其是否"值得评判"；(2) 在该 episode 中选取混淆度最低的关键观测交给 VLM 评估作为 episode 级奖励。门控机制既避免冗余调用又提升检测精度；针对可评判 episode 稀疏的问题，引入基于生成轨迹的探索激励，提升向可评判轨迹探索的效率，从而触发更多 VLM 奖励。

Result: 在 MetaWorld 的 12 个无奖励任务上实现 SOTA 从零强化学习，超越先进 VLM 基线；在 3 个真实世界实验中无需任何真值奖励即可有效 RL。

Conclusion: 把 VLM 用作成功检测器而非奖励回归器，契合其多模态 VQA 能力，配合门控与探索激励，可高效支撑无奖励的从零强化学习并迁移到真实环境。

Abstract: VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

</details>


### [695] [Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15570)
*Khanbayov, Rasul,Kurban, Hasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究截断式LLM采样器的比较问题：指出几乎所有已部署的截断规则都保留概率排序词表的前缀，故任意两种规则在每个解码步互相嵌套，由此得到每步距离的闭式解与耦合，进而给出序列级分离证书；证书在某些条件下等于总变差距离，但实验显示其下界几乎恒为0.998以上，几乎无法单独判定优劣，真正有用的是耦合带来的成对无偏估计器，可将方差降低1.2-3.8倍，并据此给出各基准解析一分差异所需的样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较两个截断采样器（如top-p与top-k）通常需耗费约六千A100小时，且事先无法预知两者差距大小；作者希望在不做大规模测量的前提下给出可计算的差异上界与更高效的比较方法。

Method: 1）观察到几乎全部已部署的截断规则保留按概率排序词表的前缀，因此任意两条规则在每一步解码互为嵌套集合；2）利用嵌套性推导每步的两个分布间距离闭式解，并构造耦合使得两个采样器在首次分歧前输出完全相同的文本；3）对整段生成累积该每步界，得到序列级“分离证书”：对任意有界结果都能约束两采样器差异，且只需比较过程本身已经产生的日志即可计算；4）当两条规则在整段生成中互不超越时，证书恰等于序列级总变差距离；5）将该耦合用于构造无偏成对估计器，替代prompt级配对以降低方差；6）在六个开放权重模型、四个数学与科学基准上系统测试超参网格，并基于估计的prompt间方差分量与置信上界反推所需样本量。

Result: 在六个开放权重模型的四个数学/科学基准的全部测试超参网格上，分离证书均不低于0.998，说明仅靠界几乎无法判定两个采样器是否真的不同；但同族两成员（如不同p值）可以非常接近。耦合给出的无偏成对估计器相较prompt级配对将方差降低1.2-3.8倍。按默认配对的方差与prompt间分量的点估计，分辨一个百分点差异在GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上需每prompt 8-32个样本，AIME 2025约需210个；若取该分量的置信上界，GPQA-Diamond需超过32个，而AIME 2025在任何样本量下都无法分辨。作者还指出精确性极为脆弱：要证明差异很小，需要每一步两个保留质量高度一致。

Conclusion: 选择截断采样器在很大程度上是一个“测量问题”而非纯设计问题：精确比较代价高且易碎，单靠理论界难以判定优劣；实用的贡献是嵌套耦合带来的低方差成对估计器，以及由此给出的样本量预算指南。代码已开源。

Abstract: Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

</details>


### [696] [ML-CLAPPS: A Probabilistic Framework for Imbalanced Multilabel Learning under Class Prioritization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15816)
*Hazan, Priel,Almog, Nir,Keidar, Noam,Yaniv, Yael,Schuster, Assaf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可学习的多标签类别优先概率采样器 ML-CLAPPS，用用户定义的重要性向量控制训练样本分布，在真实多标签 ECG 图像数据上缓解类别不平衡并优先提升临床高危类别的识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签场景下的类别不平衡因标签共现而比二分类/多分类更难处理；临床 ECG 分类还要求无论患病率高低都优先保证高危类别的高召回，以降低漏诊代价。现有方法难以同时兼顾多标签不平衡与用户可控的类别优先级。

Method: ML-CLAPPS 是一种可学习的采样器，通过学习训练实例上的概率分布来调控模型对不同类别的曝光量；用户提供重要性向量（IV），采样分布据此向重要类别倾斜，从而在多标签共现结构下实现类别优先。

Result: 在真实世界多标签 ECG 图像数据集上达到 SOTA 性能；实验显示模型的实际类别曝光与指定 IV 对齐，且提高某类别的重要性会带来其分类性能的相应提升。

Conclusion: 可学习采样可作为一种通用机制，在多标签不平衡下实现显式、可控的类别优先，适合需要优先保障高危类别召回的临床部署场景。

Abstract: Real-world datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, degrading the performance of deep learning models, particularly on rare classes. While imbalance is well studied in binary and multiclass settings, it is substantially more challenging in multilabel problems due to complex label co-occurrence. In clinical applications such as ECG classification, this challenge is coupled with a second critical challenge: the need to prioritize high-risk conditions, regardless of their prevalence, to mitigate the high cost of false negatives. We introduce the Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS), a learnable sampler that optimizes a distribution over training instances to control the model's exposure to different classes. This approach addresses multilabel imbalance while enabling prioritization of significant conditions via a user-defined importance vector (IV). Empirical evaluation on a real-world multilabel ECG image dataset demonstrates that ML-CLAPPS achieves state-of-the-art performance. We show that it aligns class exposure with the specified IV, and that increasing a class's importance leads to corresponding improvements in its classification performance, enabling explicit prioritization of clinically critical conditions.

</details>


### [697] [Representational Difference Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15997)
*Mugisha, Abdulkarim,Irakiza, Divin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出表征差异蒸馏(RDD)，用两个非对称亲和矩阵定位师生表征结构不一致区域，并集中蒸馏信号于错配样本上，CIFAR-100上达75.58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关系型与对比型蒸馏方法对所有样本一视同仁，在匹配良好与匹配较差的表征区域上投入相同梯度，忽略了师生表征结构差异的空间分布，导致蒸馏效率受限。

Method: RDD诊断师生表征在结构上何处不一致，并用两个非对称亲和矩阵刻画错配的两个相反方向：其一识别学生错误认为相似的样本，其二识别学生尚未学到的教师关系；这些亲和度决定蒸馏损失对齐哪些样本对以及每个错配样本的校正强度。并探索了课程式与采样式变体。

Result: CIFAR-100上resnet32x4→resnet8x4达75.58%测试精度，与CRD(75.45%)持平，优于KD与RKD；实验发现对损失加权比数据筛选更有效。

Conclusion: 将蒸馏信号聚焦于师生表征的结构性错配区域是有效的知识蒸馏思路，且损失加权优于样本过滤，为关系型蒸馏提供了非对称差异建模视角。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.

</details>


### [698] [Learning $\omega$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16419)
*Falkiewicz, Maciej,Lavda, Frantzeska,Ramapuram, Jason,Kalousis, Alexandros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出重要性加权条件流匹配 (IW-CFM)，通过对冻结的条件/无条件流模型计算密度比来对 CFM 训练样本重新加权，从而显式学习 CFG 所隐含的 ω 次幂条件分布，并在合成数据与 ImageNet 上验证其优于数值匹配的 CFG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG 常被解释为从 ω 次幂条件分布采样（取 ω=γ），但实际并非精确采样该分布。作者希望探究能否显式地学习这一幂次目标分布，从而获得更可控、更精确的引导生成机制。

Method: IW-CFM 利用冻结的条件与无条件流模型计算密度比，对条件流匹配样本重新加权；理论上在精确归一化权重下，该目标梯度等价于在幂次目标上的流匹配梯度。实践中采用自归一化估计与正则化经验近似以处理高维数据；在 ImageNet 上额外引入摊销式轻量修正器（corrector）进行对齐，并做 CLIP 秩次探索性分析。

Result: 合成分布上，IW-CFM 能恢复解析幂次目标，而数值匹配的 CFG（γ=ω）存在可见偏差；ImageNet 上，摊销轻量修正器相较固定引导和匹配引导的 CFG 与对应加权/过滤参考分布对齐更好；CLIP 分析显示提示特定对比整体偏移的同时存在类间异质响应，包括非单调轨迹。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了研究与近似"模型定义幂次条件分布"的实用路径，表明显式学习幂次目标可作为 CFG 的替代或校正方案。

Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $\gamma$ is commonly motivated by the $\omega$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $\omega=\gamma$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $\gamma=\omega$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

</details>


### [699] [DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16597)
*Ageev, Ruslan,Tang, Huaze,Miao, Runqing,Li, Jiarong,Ding, Wenbo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DEFlow 将深度均衡模型引入流策略，用隐式欧拉积分联合求解中间动作，避免反向传播通过求解器，在保证可解密度的同时在多目标导航与操作任务上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表达性流策略可表征多种高价值动作，但在少积分步采样时仍保持可处理的动作密度十分困难。显式欧拉采样在少量步数下精度与似然估计均受限，本文希望用隐式积分与均衡求解来兼顾采样效率与密度可解性。

Method: 提出 DEFlow 深度均衡流策略：以隐式欧拉积分替代显式欧拉采样，将所有中间动作作为均衡系统联合求解；结合隐式微分与离散变量变换公式计算最终动作密度，使其可在 soft actor-critic 中进行离策略训练，且无需对求解器迭代反向传播。

Result: 在四个 Multi-Goal docking 变体上，平均成功覆盖率相对最强基线提升约 10%；在五个操作任务中的四个取得最高平均时间平均回报，并在五个 MuJoCo 任务上整体保持竞争力。代价是额外的非线性与线性求解开销。

Conclusion: 结果表明隐式流策略适用于同时要求多样性与精确性的任务，为少步采样下的表达性策略提供了可行方案，但需权衡求解开销。

Abstract: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

</details>


### [700] [DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16618)
*Zhang, Runhua,Niu, Yingjie,Li, Chao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DR-APO 提出将策略改进与策略表示解耦，通过优势引导的目标改进与表示兼容的直接动作拟合，为高斯、扩散、流匹配策略提供统一优化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法为表示特定型，缺乏统一优化接口。基于似然的目标扩展到多步生成策略时，优化与生成内部过程耦合，累积似然比会削弱更新信号；而生成策略专用方法依赖多候选生成与 critic 选择，提升整体回报但对策略本身改进有限。

Method: DR-APO（Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization）：将策略改进与策略表示解耦，采用优势引导的目标改进（advantage-guided target improvement）与表示兼容的直接动作拟合（direct action fitting），作为高斯、扩散、流匹配策略共享的优化原则。

Result: 在五个 MuJoCo-v5 任务上，高斯策略与 SAC 竞争力相当；扩散与流匹配策略在仅策略（policy-only）性能上取得最佳总体表现。NavDP 后训练将仿真成功率从 70.33% 提升至 89.55%，真实世界导航从 25% 提升至 65%。

Conclusion: 证明了跨高斯、扩散、流匹配策略的统一策略改进原则，覆盖从连续控制学习到具身策略后训练的场景。

Abstract: Policy representations in reinforcement learning have expanded beyond Gaussian policies to diffusion and flow-matching based generative policies. However, existing RL methods remain representation-specific, lacking a unified optimization interface for emerging generative policies. In particular, extending likelihood-based objectives to multi-step generative policies couples optimization to their internal generation process, where accumulated likelihood ratios can weaken the update signal. Meanwhile, generative-policy-specific methods often rely on multi-candidate generation and critic-based selection, improving overall return while providing limited improvement to the policy itself. We introduce DR-APO (Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization), which decouples policy improvement from policy representation through advantage-guided target improvement and representation-compatible direct action fitting, providing a shared optimization principle for Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies. Across five MuJoCo-v5 tasks, DR-APO remains competitive with SAC for Gaussian policies and achieves the best aggregate policy-only performance for both diffusion and flow-matching policies. NavDP post-training improves the Success Rate (SR) from 70.33% to 89.55% in simulation and from 25% to 65% in real-world navigation. These results demonstrate a unified policy-improvement principle across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, from continuous-control learning to embodied-policy post-training.

</details>


### [701] [MAGNET: Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network for Connectome Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17014)
*Dey, Protyay,Roy, Ayush,Cho, Hyuna,Kim, Won Hwa,Lokhande, Vishnu Suresh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MAGNET，一种流形感知的图扩散网络，通过归一化Cholesky表示保证相关矩阵有效性，并结合类别锚定条件、摊销结构桥和相关性保持腐蚀，实现类别条件化的脑功能连接组生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能脑连接组的生成不仅是有效性（相关矩阵约束）问题，更关键的是在粗粒度标签下恢复被掩盖的类条件几何结构。已有流形感知方法虽保证几何有效，但难以捕获类条件保真度与临床异质性。

Method: MAGNET使用归一化Cholesky表示相关矩阵流形以保证有效性；将噪声隐状态提升为ROI级别的区域tokens，并在脑图谱区域上施加关系归纳偏置进行去噪；引入三项结构设计：类别锚定条件、摊销结构桥、相关性保持腐蚀。

Result: 在ABIDE、ADNI、OASIS-3三个队列上，MAGNET相比先前流形感知方法在类条件保真度（α,β-F1）提升7-21%，采样效率更优；仅在严格二分类标签训练下，零样本设置中仍能保持临床异质性，子类协方差对齐（λ-MSE）改善超30%。

Conclusion: 几何有效性是连接组合成临床可用性的必要但非充分条件；使扩散去噪过程具备类别条件与流形感知能力，其价值超出高度弯曲的脑连接组生成，可推广至一般场景。

Abstract: Functional brain connectome represents neural connectivity as a matrix of pairwise interactions between brain regions. Generation of functional connectomes is not only a question of validity; rather, having satisfied the constraints on the correlation matrix, the next step is to recover the class-conditional geometry buried under coarse labels. We propose MAGNET, a Manifold-Aware Graph Diffusion Network which uses a normalized-Cholesky representation of the manifold of correlation matrices that guarantees validity. MAGNET lifts noisy latent states into ROI-level region tokens and performs denoising with a relational inductive bias over brain atlas regions. To deal with structural problems induced by coarse labels, MAGNET employs class-anchored conditioning, amortized structural bridge, and relevance-preserving corruption. Across ABIDE, ADNI, and OASIS-3, MAGNET consistently achieves favorable results compared to previous manifold-aware approaches, demonstrating improvements of 7-21% in class-conditional fidelity ($\alpha,\beta$-F1) across three cohorts and better sampling efficiency. Moreover, while training only with strict binary labels, MAGNET is capable of maintaining clinical heterogeneity through fine substructure of the connectomes in a zero-shot setting, improving subclass covariance alignment ($\lambda$-MSE) by over 30%. These results suggest that geometric validity is a necessary but insufficient condition for clinical utility in connectome synthesis. Moreover, efforts in making the diffusion denoising class-conditional manifold aware finds utility beyond the highly curved brain connectome generation as this is a critical problem in various general settings. The code repository can be found at https://github.com/protyayofficial/MAGNET.

</details>


### [702] [C{\AE}NL: Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning with Objective-Aligned Representation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17509)
*Alqithami, Saad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CÆNL 框架，将主动学习的标签获取与表示学习耦合，用动态坍塌正则化（DCR）约束类内/类间散度残差，在 ImageNet-100 60% 标注下比纯熵采样提升约 1.7-1.8 个百分点并显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动学习会改变用于获取后续标签的表示，这种获取与表示之间的交互此前缺乏系统分析。作者希望显式建模该耦合，并厘清"几何良好是否等价于输入鲁棒"这一问题。

Method: 提出 Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning（CÆNL），将流程分为采样/获取、动态坍塌正则化（DCR）及其系数策略三部分。DCR 对归一化类内散度与类间散度残差相对冻结参考值施加惩罚，并附加独立类分离保护项。系数策略涵盖固定、调度、确定性反馈与学习式反馈四种。理论部分给出一致性不变性、条件局部下降与系数界，并论证仅靠干净几何不能保证输入鲁棒性。

Result: 六种子分类比较外，另做 104 次运行（独立控制选择 + 两个骨干各十种子评估）。ImageNet-100 60% 标注、熵采样 + DCR + MACC-Lite：ResNet-50 达 73.420±0.512%，ResNet-18 达 73.086±0.397%，比纯熵高 1.742/1.834 个百分点，配对 t 与精确符号翻转检验经 Holm 校正后仍显著。独立调参的常数略高，但配对比较既未证明自适应更优也未证明等价。六种子谱分析显示小幅固定正则 C4 损失下降、CIFAR-10 扩散 FID 变差、AudioCaps 描述效果不确定；早期实验在 L∞ 8/255 下 AutoAttack 精度近零，学习式控制无额外收益。

Conclusion: 结果支持所评估的分类联合处理方案，同时表明基于几何的正则化效果具有任务依赖性——在分类上稳定增益，但在鲁棒性与生成任务上未必如此。

Abstract: Active learning changes the representations used to acquire subsequent labels. We study this interaction through Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning (C{\AE}NL), which separates acquisition, Dynamic Collapse Regularization (DCR), and its coefficient policy. DCR penalizes a normalized within-class to between-class scatter residual above a frozen reference, with a separate class-separation safeguard. Fixed, scheduled, deterministic-feedback, and learned-feedback policies apply this objective. The analysis establishes scatter invariances, conditional local descent, and coefficient bounds, and shows why clean geometry alone cannot guarantee input robustness. Six-seed classification comparisons are complemented by a 104-run study with separate control selection and ten-seed evaluations on each of two backbones. At 60% annotations on ImageNet-100, entropy acquisition with DCR and MACC-Lite reaches 73.420 +/- 0.512% accuracy on ResNet-50 and 73.086 +/- 0.397% on ResNet-18 (mean +/- seed SD), exceeding entropy alone by 1.742 and 1.834 percentage points. Both gains survive Holm correction under paired-t and exact sign-flip tests, with unchanged feedback settings across backbones. Independently tuned constants attain slightly higher mean accuracy; the paired comparisons establish neither adaptive superiority nor equivalence. Separate six-seed spectral studies yield a small fixed-regularization C4 loss reduction, worse CIFAR-10 diffusion FID, and inconclusive AudioCaps captioning effects. Earlier classification studies find near-zero AutoAttack accuracy at L-infinity radius 8/255 and no added benefit from learned control. The results support the evaluated combined classification treatment and identify the task dependence of geometry-informed regularization.

</details>


### [703] [Calibrated Disambiguation for Partial Multi-label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17635)
*Li, Zhuoming,Jia, Yuheng,Yu, Mi,Miao, Zicong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PML-CD：将课程学习式部分多标签学习的权重函数刻画为置信度校准问题，用可迁移校准器从置信度直方图预测最优课程权重，并加原型对齐正则，在四个数据集上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分多标签学习（PML）中实例被过度标注，含有相关与不相关标签。现有方法依赖课程学习与记忆效应去噪，但权重函数非自适应且缺乏最优加权的理论指导。

Method: 首先形式化课程式去歧义的最优权重函数，证明其等价于模型预测置信度的校准，从而为课程设计提供理论依据；进而设计可迁移校准器（transferable calibrator），以正样本置信度直方图为输入、输出最优课程权重用于训练；另提出原型对齐正则（prototype alignment regularization）提升性能。

Result: 在 Pascal VOC、MS-COCO、NUS-WIDE、CUB 四个数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进的 PML 方法。

Conclusion: 通过置信度校准视角为课程式去歧义提供理论指导，PML-CD 实现了自适应乐观权重并取得领先性能。

Abstract: Partial multi-label learning (PML) aims to train a classifier on datasets whose instances are over-annotated with not only relevant labels but also irrelevant labels, which is common when datasets are collected from crowd-sourcing platform. Existing works primarily approach it from a curriculum learning perspective, leveraging the memorization effect to disambiguate noisy labels and produce robust predictions. However, these methods are based on non-adaptive weighting functions and lack theoretical guidance for optimal weighting. To overcome these issues, a calibrated disambiguation model named PML-CD is proposed. We first formulate the optimal weighting function for curriculum-based disambiguation, which is equivalent to the calibration of the model's predicted confidences, thus providing guidance for curriculum designing. To obtain the optimal weighting function from PML dataset during the training, a transferable calibrator is designed, which takes the histogram of positive samples' confidences as input, and outputs the optimal curriculum weighting for training. Prototype alignment regularization is also proposed to promote the model's performance. Experiments conducted on Pascal VOC, MS-COCO, NUS-WIDE and CUB have verified that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art PML methods.

</details>


### [704] [Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17709)
*Ciftci, Yusuf Umut,Kang, Joonwon,Sathya, Ajay Suresha,Bansal, Somil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCRIM（State CRIticality Measure），将模仿学习中的状态关键性形式化为"专家动作受有界扰动后下游价值的最坏退化"，通过对抗扰动策略与价值评论家估计每个演示状态的关键性分数，用于重加权行为克隆损失和数据筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆通常把每个演示状态等同对待，但少数关键状态上即使很小的动作偏差也会导致任务失败，而多数状态上的错误可恢复。需要一种可量化的状态关键性度量，以把学习容量和算力集中到真正决定成败的状态上。

Method: 将状态关键性定义为在给定状态下对专家动作施加有界扰动所导致的下游价值最坏退化量；围绕固定的模仿策略训练一个对抗性扰动策略和一个价值评论家，从而对每个演示状态给出关键性分数；该分数用于重加权行为克隆损失，以及挑选紧凑的高价值演示子集进行数据策划。

Result: 在多种仿真和真实世界机器人操作任务上验证：SCRIM 能改善策略训练、提升整体任务成功率，支持高效数据选择（用显著更少的演示数据保持性能），并给出关于演示中哪些时刻对任务成功最关键的可解释分析。

Conclusion: 状态关键性可作为模仿学习中的通用、可解释信号，统一服务于损失重加权与数据策划，在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上均带来性能与数据效率收益。

Abstract: Imitation learning typically treats every demonstration state as equally important, optimizing a behavior-cloning objective uniformly across the dataset. Yet not all states are created equal: in a small number of critical states, even a slight deviation from the expert action can lead to a failure, while in many other states such errors are recoverable and inconsequential. We formalize state criticality in imitation learning as the worst-case degradation in downstream value induced by a bounded perturbation of the expert action at a given state. We then propose SCRIM, a practical State CRIticality Measure that estimates this quantity by training an adversarial disturbance policy and a value critic around a fixed imitation policy. SCRIM assigns each demonstration state a score reflecting how vulnerable the task outcome is to small, policy-relevant action errors. We show that these scores can be used to reweight behavior-cloning losses, improving imitation at consequential states and increasing overall task performance. We further show that SCRIM enables data curation by selecting compact, high-value subsets of demonstrations that preserve performance while substantially reducing the amount of training data. We evaluate SCRIM across various simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, and demonstrate that SCRIM improves policy training, enables efficient data selection, and provides interpretable insights into which moments in a demonstration are most critical for task success. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/

</details>


### [705] [Sea-Net: A Small and Inherently Interpretable Neural Network for Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17939)
*Rehman, Ubaid Ur,Mondal, Tanmoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SEA-Net，用轻量多尺度深度可分离卷积编码器 + 改进 MIL 池化头，在保持时序分类精度与时间可解释性的同时大幅压缩参数量，面向 MCU 等资源受限平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有可解释时序分类方法 MILLET（InceptionTime + Conjunctive Pooling）参数约 424K，难以部署于资源受限微控制器，且精度（0.888）与解释质量（0.681 NDCG@n）仍有提升空间。作者希望在不牺牲分类与时间解释性能的前提下显著减小模型规模。

Method: SEA-Net 采用小型多尺度深度可分离卷积的 TSC 编码器，替换原有 InceptionTime 编码器，并改进 MIL 池化头。给出两种变体：1）bottleneck 编码器 + Top-k 池化（41K 参数）；2）gated 编码器 + Top-k 池化（62K 参数）。针对 MILLET 池化策略的局限进行改进，兼顾分类头与时间区间解释输出。

Result: bottleneck + Top-k 版本达到 0.931 准确率与 0.765 NDCG@n，仅 41K 参数；gated + Top-k 版本达到 0.955 准确率与 0.750 NDCG@n，62K 参数。相比 MILLET（0.888 / 0.681 NDCG@n，约 424K 参数）在精度与解释分数上均更优，参数量约为其 1/7–1/10。

Conclusion: 轻量架构可在显著降低模型规模的同时维持较强的分类性能与时间解释能力，为边缘设备上的可解释时序分类提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Traditional time-series classification methods often operate as black boxes, providing a class prediction without indicating which time point or time interval within the series led to that prediction. To improve temporal interpretability, MILLET (Multiple Instance Learning with Temporal Explanation), which combines an InceptionTime encoder with Conjunctive Pooling, provides both classification and temporal explanations. However, MILLET contains approximately 424 K parameters, making it unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained micro-controllers, and it achieves an overall time-series accuracy of 0.888 and an explanation score of 0.681 NDCG@n. We therefore propose SEA-Net, a lightweight architecture using small multi-scale depthwise-separable convolutional TSC encoders and improved Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) pooling heads. Our SEA-Net bottleneck encoder with Top-k pooling achieves 0.931 accuracy and 0.765 NDCG@n with only 41 K parameters. Another variant, using a gated encoder with Top-k pooling, achieves 0.955 accuracy and 0.750 NDCG@n with 62 K parameters. These results demonstrate that lightweight architectures can maintain strong classification performance and temporal explanations while substantially reducing model size. The proposed variants address specific limitations of the pooling strategy used by MILLET, providing a practical direction for interpretable time-series classification on resource-constrained edge devices.

</details>


### [706] [Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17998)
*Panetta, Francesco,Di Valerio, Federico,Proietti, Michela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将"经验打包与回放"（EPR）引入脉冲神经网络，用脉冲激活图（SAM）生成的空间注意力挑选信息量最大的图像块进行回放，替代存储整图，在Split CIFAR10/100上实现更优的精度-存储折衷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深层SNN在低延迟约束下顺序学习任务时存在灾难性遗忘；完整图像回放虽然有效但存储开销大，因此需要一种内存高效的连续学习策略。

Method: 提出EPR框架：以Batch Normalization Through Time稳定的VGG9 SNN为骨干；利用SAM得到仅基于脉冲活动的前向解释，将解释在时间维度聚合成空间注意力图，据此选择最具信息量的图像块用于回放，而非保存完整图像。

Result: 在Split CIFAR10与Split CIFAR100上，SAM引导的EPR在紧张内存预算下改善了精度-内存权衡，性能具有竞争力且所需存储显著减少。

Conclusion: 基于脉冲激活图解释的patch级回放是SNN低存储连续学习的有效途径，可作为神经形态计算中内存受限场景的通用组件。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

</details>


### [707] [SYNPRED: A Synergistic Approach to Multimodal Learning for Clinical Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18110)
*Janíčková, Ivana,Tan, Yen Y.,Helbich, Thomas H.,Seeböck, Philipp,Di Marco, Julieta,Bago-Horvath, Zsuzsanna,Heber, Ulrike,Spiegel, Thomas,Langs, Georg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出协同多模态VAE框架SYNPRED，将任务相关的单模态与跨模态信息从实例级任务无关变异中解耦，用于医学影像+RNA的治疗响应预测，并在模态缺失时仍具优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态医学数据提供互补信息，但现有对比学习方法主要挖掘模态间共享信息，未能充分利用与任务相关的模态特异互补信号；同时临床场景中模态缺失常见，需要兼顾鲁棒性。

Method: 基于变分自编码器的协同多模态框架，将潜空间分解为任务相关的单模态因子与多模态共享因子，并将任务无关的实例特异性变异分离出去，从而在预测中利用跨模态互补信号；支持测试时模态缺失下的单模态推断。

Result: 在医学影像与RNA数据的治疗响应预测任务上，与基于对齐的方法及多模态VAE的最新方法相比，多模态预测性能提升，且在多模态训练后单模态预测也获得一致增益。

Conclusion: 显式的任务相关/无关解耦可有效利用模态互补性，提升多模态及单模态预测，并具备模态缺失鲁棒性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal medical data captures complementary aspects of disease. It provides a comprehensive basis for diagnosis and the identification of biological associations linked to progression or treatment response. Established contrastive learning approaches exploit shared information across modalities, but fall short in exploiting complementary, modality-specific signals relevant for a task. Here, we propose a synergistic multimodal variational autoencoder (VAE) framework that separates task-relevant unimodal and multimodal information from instance-specific variation task-irrelevant, allowing complementary signals across modalities to be leveraged for prediction. The method yields benefits even if modalities are missing at test time. We evaluate the method on a treatment response prediction task using medical imaging and RNA data. Empirical comparison with alignment-based and multimodal VAE state-of-the-art approaches demonstrates improved multimodal prediction performance, and consistent benefits for prediction from a single modality after multimodal training. The full code can be found here: https://github.com/cirmuw/SYNPRED.

</details>


### [708] [A Controlled Evaluation of Curvature Inspired Scalar Feature Scaling for Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18227)
*Gupta, Sunny,Sethi, Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文审计了名为 HyperDG 的域泛化实现，发现其并非真正的双曲/曲率学习，而只是在训练时用可学习正标量缩放欧氏特征；在 PACS、VLCS、Office Home、TerraIncognita 上以 384 次运行进行评估，宏平均点估计比 DomainBed ERM 低 1.61 个百分点，但精确符号翻转检验 p=.125，无调整后显著差异证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域特定曲率在域泛化中颇具吸引力，但"曲率学习"一词可指截然不同的计算。作者希望澄清一个被命名为 HyperDG 的具体实现实际执行了什么，并判断其对 ERM 是否真有增益，从而给出一个有边界的阴性结果，避免把标量缩放包误认为真正的双曲表示学习。

Method: 代码审计确认：训练时用可学习正标量缩放欧氏编码器特征，推理时在不缩放欧氏特征上使用普通线性分类器；不含洛伦兹/庞加莱表示、测地线预测或 SAM 内循环。在 PACS、VLCS、Office Home、TerraIncognita 四个数据集上评估六种条件，共 384 次运行（6 条件 × 4 留出目标 × 4 随机种子）。仅用三个源验证环境选择检查点；推理时先在每个留出目标内对成对种子差取平均，以"目标"而非 16 个种子×目标观测作为每数据集聚类单元。采用等数据集宏平均点估计、聚类 95% CI、精确四数据集符号翻转检验及 Holm 校正；域特异性对比为分离的可学习源尺度（无方差惩罚）对比单一共享源尺度，并做 TOST 等效性检验。

Result: 完整实现的等数据集宏平均点估计比原生 DomainBed ERM 低 1.61 个百分点（95% 聚类 CI [-3.17, -0.04]）。四个数据集的点估计均偏向 ERM，但精确四数据集符号翻转检验 p=.125，Holm 调整后 p=.250，因此声称没有调整后差异证据。域特异性对比为 -0.13 pp（95% CI [-0.53, 0.27]），其 90% CI 落在修订阶段 ±1 pp 最小实际关注效应内（TOST p=.003），仅支持"源选择套件宏平均"上的等效性，不适用于每个数据集、目标或最终步端点。

Conclusion: 该研究为这一标量训练包提供了有界的阴性结果：它未显示相对 ERM 的调整后优势，也未证明域特异性带来的增益；同时明确其并不测试或反驳真正的双曲表示学习。结论的适用范围限于所评估的源选择套件宏平均，不应外推至所有数据集、目标或端点。

Abstract: Domain-specific curvature is an appealing idea for domain generalization (DG), but curvature learning can denote substantially different computations. This paper evaluates one deliberately narrow implementation: the code calls it HyperDG, but it rescales Euclidean encoder features during training by learned positive scalars and uses an ordinary linear classifier on unscaled Euclidean features at inference. It does not implement a Lorentz or Poincar\'e representation, geodesic prediction, or a Sharpness-Aware Minimization inner loop. We audit the executed objective and evaluate six conditions on PACS, VLCS, Office Home, and TerraIncognita. The completed design contains 384 runs: six conditions, four held-out targets, and four run seeds per dataset. Checkpoints are selected using only the three source-validation environments. Inference first averages paired seed differences within each held-out target; targets, rather than 16 seed-by-target observations, are the per-dataset clusters. The full implementation's equal-dataset macro point estimate is 1.61 percentage points below native DomainBed ERM (95% clustered CI [-3.17, -0.04]). All four dataset point estimates favor ERM, but an exact four-dataset sign-flip test gives p = .125 and Holm-adjusted p = .250; we therefore claim no adjusted evidence of a difference. The cleaner domain-specificity contrast, separate learned source scales without their variance penalty versus one shared learned source scale, is -0.13 pp (95% CI [-0.53, 0.27]). Its 90% CI lies within a revision-stage $\pm 1$ pp smallest effect of practical interest (TOST p = .003), supporting equivalence only for the source-selected suite macro, not every dataset, target, or final-step endpoint. The study thus supplies a bounded negative result for this scalar training package; it does not test or refute genuine hyperbolic representation learning.

</details>


### [709] [Unbalanced W-Flow: Unbalanced Wasserstein Drifting under Finite-Batch Marginal Fluctuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18552)
*Jeon, Jongwook,Park, Mingue,Choi, Jiwon,Kim, Jaihoon,Min, Yunhong,Sung, Minhyuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UW-Flow 用去偏非平衡 Sinkhorn 散度替换 W-Flow 的平衡 Sinkhorn 能量，导出对应的 Wasserstein 速度场，在有限 minibatch 下误差更小，并在 MNIST/CIFAR-10/ImageNet-100 上提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教师无关的一步生成模型（如 W-Flow）直接从分布目标学习，其中 Sinkhorn 散度效果最好，但其基于平衡最优传输，精确边缘约束在有限 minibatch 波动下会产生不良传输。作者希望用边缘松弛来缓解该问题。

Method: 将 UW-Flow 定义为用去偏非平衡 Sinkhorn 散度替代平衡 Sinkhorn 能量，推导相应 Wasserstein 速度场；保留 W-Flow 的 cross-minus-self 结构，可在适当假设下恢复平衡极限并保持目标可辨识性。理论分析逐 minibatch 比较平衡与非平衡传输速度场与总体速度场的误差，给出边缘松弛误差更小的条件，并分析分离匹配模态下平衡敏感度随模态间距增长而 UOT 敏感度受局部传输几何控制。

Result: 在固定支撑与连续双模态分布上的受控实验验证了理论预测；在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-100 上，等训练预算下 UW-Flow 生成质量优于基线，无条件生成增益最大，类别条件设定下也有一致改进。

Conclusion: 边缘松弛（非平衡 OT）作为一步生成模型的分布目标可降低有限批量下的速度估计误差，从而提升生成性能，是一种替换平衡 Sinkhorn 的实用且理论可解释的方案。

Abstract: Teacher-free one-step generative models such as W-Flow learn directly from distributional objectives, with the Sinkhorn divergence providing the strongest empirical performance among the energies studied in W-Flow. However, Sinkhorn divergence is based on balanced optimal transport, whose exact marginal constraints can induce undesirable transport under finite minibatch fluctuations. We introduce UW-Flow, which replaces the balanced Sinkhorn energy with a debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence and derives the corresponding Wasserstein velocity. The resulting dynamics retain W-Flow's cross-minus-self structure, recover the balanced limit, and preserve target identifiability under suitable assumptions. We further characterize the finite-batch velocity error of balanced and unbalanced transport by comparing each minibatch field with its population counterpart. Our analysis identifies conditions under which marginal relaxation yields smaller minibatch-to-population velocity error, and shows that for separated matched modes, balanced sensitivity grows with inter-mode separation while the corresponding Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) sensitivity remains controlled by local transport geometry. Controlled experiments on fixed-support and continuous two-mode distributions support these predictions. On MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-100, UW-Flow improves generation under matched training budgets, with the largest gains in unconditional generation and consistent improvements in the class-conditional setting.

</details>


### [710] [Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18677)
*Balim, Haldun,Du, Yilun,Li, Na*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GTP将扩散模型作为动作序列的生成式提案分布，结合学到的动力学、奖励与价值模型进行轨迹级精炼，在连续控制与长程操作任务上匹配或超越无模型、扩散策略与基于模型的基线，并指出生成模型应被视为规划中的结构化提案分布而非策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线决策存在高效推理与长程推理之间的矛盾：价值类方法依赖短视界自举，限制长期信息传播；轨迹优化方法显式规划但每步都要解高维优化问题。作者希望找到兼顾两者的折中方案。

Method: 提出生成式轨迹规划（GTP）框架：不从零优化动作序列，而是从扩散先验采样候选轨迹，再借助学习到的动力学模型、奖励模型和价值模型对候选序列迭代精炼，实现高效的轨迹级推理。

Result: 在连续控制与长程操作任务上，GTP达到或超过SOTA的无模型方法、扩散策略及基于模型基线；在强基线性能退化的场景下仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: 生成模型更适合被理解为规划中的结构化提案分布，而非直接作为策略，为生成式建模与基于模型决策的融合提供了新视角。

Abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

</details>


### [711] [Scaling Online Optimal Transport Minibatches for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18838)
*Chen, Peter,Levine, Sergey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可扩展的在线熵最优传输(OT)近似方法，使flow matching能在每步使用远大于现有规模的源-目标minibatch耦合，并从理论上证明其相对独立配对可严格降低全随机梯度方差与积分误差，实验上验证更大耦合持续提升训练稳定性与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow model扩展的核心瓶颈是训练与积分的稳定性，而稳定性关键取决于源样本与数据的配对方式。独立随机配对随机性大，minibatch OT可降低随机性，但在更大、更高维数据集上小minibatch收益受限，而每步把耦合扩展到大规模minibatch计算代价过高；同时OT耦合对完整随机梯度与积分误差的影响缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 提出可扩展的在线熵最优传输（entropic OT）近似，支持显著更大的源-目标耦合规模；并针对无正则化OT与熵正则OT两种情形给出理论分析，证明相对独立配对在全随机梯度方差与积分误差上的严格下降，进一步刻画这些收益随在线耦合minibatch增大而增强的规律。

Result: 理论方面补齐了无正则与熵正则OT的方差与积分误差分析缺口；实验方面在单细胞基因插值流与图像流训练上验证了理论预测，更大的在线耦合规模持续改善训练稳定性与最终生成性能。

Conclusion: 在线大规模OT耦合是提升flow matching训练稳定性与生成质量的有效且可扩展的途径，理论与实验一致表明耦合规模越大收益越明显，为大规模flow model训练提供了实用方案。

Abstract: A central challenge in scaling flow models is maintaining stability in training and integration. In flow matching, this stability depends critically on how source samples are paired with data. Independent random pairing introduces substantial stochasticity, motivating minibatch optimal transport (OT) to construct online source-target couplings that reduce this randomness (Tong et al., 2024). However, as applications extend to larger and higher-dimensional datasets, small minibatches can limit these benefits, while scaling the coupling to substantially larger minibatches at every iteration is computationally prohibitive. Moreover, how OT coupling affects the full stochastic gradient and integration remains theoretically unresolved. In this work, we develop a scalable online entropic OT approximation that enables substantially larger source-target couplings while preserving the benefits of OT. We close the theoretical gap for both unregularized and entropic OT by proving strict reductions in full stochastic-gradient variance and integration error relative to independent pairing, and further characterize how these improvements strengthen as the online coupling minibatch grows. Experiments on single-cell gene interpolation-flow and image-flow training validate these predictions, showing that larger online couplings consistently improve training stability and final generation performance.

</details>


### [712] [Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19220)
*Hannagan, Thomas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文分析连续思维机（CTM）分类ImageNet图像时的动力学机制，发现其每个思维步骤都是具有平衡放大的非正规吸引映射，思维轨迹由一串移动的局部唯一吸引不动点刻画，且注意力调度高度通用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTM在多个领域表现出未被解释的"涌现思维过程"，作者希望揭示其内部机制，理解它如何在ImageNet上完成分类计算。

Method: 从动力系统角度分析CTM的循环计算：检验每个思维步骤的神经状态映射的吸引性与非正规性（balanced amplification, Murphy & Miller 2009）；用Banach不动点定理刻画局部唯一吸引不动点并追踪其随步骤移动形成的轨迹；通过打乱跨图像查询、以及用与图像无关的增量预测下一步查询，量化注意力调度的通用性。

Result: 吸引性在初始化时已存在，训练显著增强非正规性；思维轨迹是移动不动点所描绘的曲线，被"滞后一拍"跟随，其大部分运动跨图像共享，表现为沿神经元传播的行波；每步打乱跨图像查询仅损失7%分类精度，而图像无关的增量能以R²=0.98（留出验证）预测下一步查询。

Conclusion: CTM似乎找到了处理所有ImageNet图像的单一策略：思维轨迹与注意力调度基本通用，图像特异性信息主要不体现在轨迹形状与查询序列中。

Abstract: The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) is a recurrent network that attends to inputs and makes predictions based on the synchronization between its neurons. On tasks spanning many domains, it displays emergent thought processes that have not been explained. We report a number of findings about how the CTM classifies images, focusing on ImageNet. Each thinking step is an attracting but strongly non-normal map exhibiting balanced amplification (Murphy and Miller, 2009); while attraction is already present at CTM initialization, training highly promotes non-normality. By Banach's theorem, the neural state has a locally unique attracting fixed point, which moves at every step, and the thought trajectory is the curve these fixed points trace, followed one tick behind. Most of that curve's motion is shared across images, and visible as a previously reported traveling wave of activity across neurons. The attention schedule along the thought is largely generic: shuffling queries across images at every tick costs only 7 percent of classification accuracy, while image-independent increments predict the next query with R^2 = 0.98 (held out). Our results suggest that the CTM has found a single strategy to process all ImageNet images.

</details>


### [713] [Integrated Novelty Detection Systems: From Sensor Networks to Multi-Novelty Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19347)
*Tematelewo, Irené*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述式地处理两类新颖性/异常检测场景：一是天气传感器网络中被阻塞雨量计的检测，评估CMM、PSWQ(Fz-filter)、核回归与高斯方法四种现有质控方法并指出其在检测成簇故障传感器上的缺陷，进而提出三种融合概率故障检测与一致性诊断的新质控技术；二是计算机视觉中的多类型新颖性检测，提出NOVEL-SS数据集与DCA（Detect, Characterize, Accommodate）基线系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建可靠的监测系统需要有效的新颖性（异常）检测能力。天气传感器网络中阻塞雨量计会直接影响数据可靠性、粮食安全与灾害管理，而现有质控方法在成簇故障时表现不佳；计算机视觉系统则多聚焦单一新颖性场景，缺乏处理多类型新颖性的集成系统。

Method: 天气传感器网络部分：对比评估四种现有质控方法（条件混合模型CMM、PSWQ/Fz-filter、核回归、高斯方法），并据此提出三种结合概率故障检测与一致性诊断框架的新型质控技术。计算机视觉部分：构建源自Snapshot Serengeti相机陷阱数据的NOVEL-SS数据集（涵盖多种新颖性形式），并提出DCA基线系统，通过检测、刻画与适应三个环节应对多类型新颖性。

Result: 论文报告现有四种质控方法在检测被阻塞雨量计方面存在局限，尤其在成簇故障传感器场景；所提三种新方法旨在提高及时检测能力并降低误报。计算机视觉方面，NOVEL-SS数据集与DCA系统为多类型新颖性检测提供数据与方法基础（摘要未给出量化指标）。

Conclusion: 该工作力图提升天气传感器网络与计算机视觉两类应用中新颖性检测系统的鲁棒性与适应性，为跨域异常检测研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Novelty detection is crucial in various technological and scientific domains. Its importance spans from ensuring the reliability of sensor networks to enhancing the adaptability of computer vision systems. As AI systems become increasingly sophisticated and complex, effective anomaly detection is essential for maintaining reliability and accuracy. This work addresses novelty detection in weather sensor networks and computer vision. In weather sensor networks, particularly for monitoring rainfall, detecting blocked rain gauges can significantly impact data reliability, food security, and disaster management. This work evaluates four existing quality control methods for detecting blocked rain gauges and demonstrates their limitations, particularly in detecting clusters of faulty sensors. By comparing methods such as the Conditional Mixture Model (CMM), PSWQ (Fz-filter), Kernel Regression, and Gaussian Method, we identify their shortcomings and propose three novel quality control techniques that integrate probabilistic fault detection and consistency-based diagnosis framework to improve timely detection of blocked sensors, while reducing false alarms. In the realm of computer vision, current systems often fail to handle multiple types of novelty due to their focus on single-novelty scenarios. We highlight the need for integrated systems capable of handling multiple types of novelty. To support this, we introduce the Novel Snapshot Serengeti (NOVEL-SS) dataset, derived from the Snapshot Serengeti camera trap data, which includes various forms of novelty. We also present the DCA (Detect, Characterize, and Accommodate) baseline system, designed to handle multiple novelty by detecting, characterizing, and accommodating them. This work aims to advance the robustness and adaptability of novelty detection systems across both weather sensor networks and computer vision applications.

</details>


### [714] [Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19378)
*Jebraeeli, Vahid,Krim, Hamid,Fujii, Keisuke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出受System 1/System 2启发的双回路推理机制：快速回路用现有证据消解可解残差，剩余"认知残差"触发中速回路主动获取新证据并以残差缩减度量信息价值；嵌套解空间下中速回路最优解可证不劣于快速回路，实验中以约一半计算量稳定超越快速回路，并在更干净观测下优于分级分类器与learning-to-defer方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复合学习目标下，残差误差包含"证据不足"与"能力不足"两类成分，传统单次前向推理无法区分并加以利用；尤其在分布偏移与扰动条件下，需要一种原则性机制来识别哪些残差可通过额外信息消解，从而主动获取有价值的新证据而非盲目增加算力。

Method: 将推理形式化为服务共同目标的嵌套双回路机制：外层快速（System 1类）回路在给定证据下求残差最优解；若仍存在认知残差，则由中速（System 2类）回路主动采集额外证据，并以残差缩减量作为信息价值的度量进行决策；在嵌套解空间假设下对两回路最优解给出理论比较。

Result: 理论上证明中速回路最优解不劣于快速回路最优解；实验上双回路模型在约中速回路一半计算量下持续优于快速回路，在未见过的corruption下依然有效；当提供更干净的观测时，在同等计算开销下超越分级分类器（staged classifiers）与learning-to-defer方法。

Conclusion: 残差的层级化分解为"何时值得追加计算/获取信息"提供了可证明且可度量的原则，双回路机制在计算效率与鲁棒性之间取得良好折衷，是通向自适应推理与主动感知的一个通用框架。

Abstract: We seek a hierarchical resolution of residual error under a composite learning objective as a principled mechanism for identifying and exploiting additional information, particularly under distribution shift and perturbation. Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we formulate this principle as a two-loop mechanism serving a common inference goal. A fast, System 1-like loop resolves the residual addressable by the available evidence; the remaining epistemic residual triggers a medium speed, System 2-like loop that actively acquires additional evidence and measures its informational value through residual reduction. Over nested solution spaces, the medium-loop optimum is provably no worse than the fast-loop optimum. Experiments show that the resulting two-loop model consistently improves upon the fast loop at approximately half the computation of the medium loop, including under unseen corruptions, and, when provided a cleaner observation, outperforms staged classifiers and learning-to-defer methods at equal computational cost.

</details>


### [715] [Train to Stitch: Topology-Preserving Regularization for Interoperable Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19401)
*Malhotra, Akshay,Zilberstein, Nicolas,Hamidi-Rad, Shahab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用拓扑正则化对齐两个独立训练的自编码器隐空间，无需训练期协调即可实现模型互通。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练模型普及背景下，希望不同神经网络可在几乎无通信条件下无缝组合；以数据压缩为例，独立选择架构并分别训练编码器与解码器仍能协同工作，将改变模型的构建与部署方式。

Method: 引入拓扑正则化项，约束两个独立训练的自编码器隐空间结构一致性；并给出条件性理论分析，说明结构一致性可转化为独立学习表示间的近似几何兼容性。

Result: 在多个数据集上的重建实验验证了方法有效性，显著缩小了模型间的互操作差距（interoperability gap）。

Conclusion: 拓扑对齐是实现免协调、可插拔编解码器互通的有前景途径。

Abstract: As large, powerful pre-trained models become more prevalent, there is growing interest in developing methods that allow different neural networks to be seamlessly combined with little or no direct communication between them. Take autoencoder-based data compression as an example: the ability to independently choose architectures and train encoder and decoder models, while still ensuring they work together, could fundamentally transform how such models are built, deployed, and updated. In this work, we introduce a novel approach that leverages topological regularization to align the latent spaces of two independently trained autoencoder models, entirely eliminating the need for coordination during training. We provide a conditional theoretical analysis showing how the structural agreement encouraged by our regularizer can translate into approximate geometric compatibility between independently learned representations. Reconstruction experiments validate this approach empirically, substantially narrowing the interoperability gap across multiple datasets.

</details>


### [716] [Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19683)
*Sun, Yuwei,Zhu, Siyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种记忆增强的潜空间世界模型，在JEPA式预测基础上引入内容可寻址记忆库，通过多时间尺度共享潜空间与自适应层归一化条件化预测，并用槽多样性与时间均衡两项损失防止表征坍缩、提升长时程规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于潜动力学的世界模型存在表征坍缩、计算开销大、长时程规划能力有限三大问题，阻碍了其在具身规划中的可扩展应用。

Method: 在JEPA风格潜空间预测中增加内容可寻址记忆库；直接从观测学习高层表征，在共享潜空间内以多时间尺度运行，并通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）进行条件化；设计槽多样性损失与时间利用率均衡损失两项互补目标函数，防止表征坍缩并保证记忆有效使用。

Result: 在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher、OGBCube四个任务上，以轻量级架构取得SOTA性能，在长时程规划任务上优于常规潜空间世界模型。

Conclusion: 记忆增强+多时间尺度潜空间建模为轻量、抗坍缩的世界模型提供了一条可行路径，但证据以仿真基准为主，缺乏真实机器人验证与计算效率的量化对比。

Abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

</details>


### [717] [What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19731)
*Barth, Julia,Sommer, Armin,Thaman, Kunvar,Schilling, Jannik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究目标误泛化(goal misgeneralization)中目标信息在策略内部的"丢失深度",提出三种策略-目标错位形式:功能性目标替换、策略捷径、线索竞争,并据此匹配不同的恢复手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作只观察到智能体分布外表现合理但未追求既定目标,却很少解释"既定目标在误泛化策略中究竟发生了什么、在哪一层失效"。

Method: 在3个Procgen环境和5个机器人任务上,通过追踪目标信息在内部是否仍可获得、对策略的影响强度、以及在动作选择中扮演的角色,区分三种错位模式;并针对不同深度分别尝试"引导重定向"与"下游重连线"两类干预。

Result: 目标到达决策层时(线索竞争),引导重定向将目标达成率从16.0%提升至95.3%;目标到达策略层但未达决策层时(动作捷径环境),仅下游重连线可将31.6%提升至84.3%;目标完全惰性时两种方法均无效。

Conclusion: 目标误泛化并非单一的目标表征失败,而是发生在不同深度的多种策略对齐失败,失效深度决定了何种恢复手段有效。

Abstract: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.

</details>


### [718] [On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19892)
*Piórczyński, Mikołaj,Masarczyk, Wojciech,Sójka, Damian,Cygert, Sebastian,Twardowski, Bartłomiej*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过实验证明，基于表征的测试时自适应（TTA）无法恢复生成式多模态大模型（MLLM）在常见损坏下的性能，原因是MLLM视觉token序列的损坏偏移近乎正交，样本盲、位置共享的单点纠正存在理论上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP类对比模型上的TTA虽能缓解分布偏移，但生成式MLLM因顺序token生成而不同；作者想探究表征空间TTA能否迁移到MLLM以提升损坏鲁棒性。

Method: 在MLLM上测试表征式TTA，并故意违反标准TTA假设（离线使用目标数据）进行样本盲特征对齐；通过分析视觉token序列的偏移方向（正交性/嵌入空间覆盖度）与CLIP池化分类嵌入的共享域偏移方向作对比。

Result: 即使离线利用目标数据进行样本盲对齐，准确率仅获边际提升；MLLM视觉token偏移近乎正交并铺满整个嵌入空间，而CLIP受益于单一池化嵌入中的共享偏移方向。

Conclusion: 这些发现界定了任何样本盲、位置共享、单编码器位置的纠正所能达到的上限，表明仅靠表征空间干预可能不足以保障MLLM的损坏鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.

</details>


### [719] [CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19911)
*Li, Zhi,Liu, Haowei,Yang, Hongchen,Wang, Xiaoxuan,Gao, Song,He, Zhenli,Zhou, Wei,Yao, Shaowen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出闭环对抗鲁棒性蒸馏框架 CARD：先做强到弱蒸馏，再用可靠的学生反馈（逆对抗反馈 + 师生差异最大化）精炼鲁棒教师，最后用精炼教师继续训练同一学生，并给出样本级充分条件与分布级风险上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性蒸馏把鲁棒教师视为固定知识源，单向传递鲁棒性，蒸馏完成后师生交互终止，浪费了学生可提供的反馈。但直接做无差别的弱到强迁移会把学生错误传播给教师，因此需要一个可靠、可控的反馈机制。

Method: CARD 为一个闭环框架：第一阶段执行强到弱对抗蒸馏得到学生；第二阶段用可靠性增强的学生反馈精炼教师——将逆对抗学生反馈与师生差异最大化相结合；第三阶段在基础蒸馏目标不变的前提下，用精炼后的教师继续训练同一学生。理论上给出样本级弱到强可靠反馈迁移的充分条件，并推导精炼教师风险的分布级上界。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet-10 上，跨多种师生架构与基础蒸馏方法，CARD 在多数设置下提升对抗鲁棒性，且总体上保持干净精度。理论部分给出了可靠反馈迁移的充分条件和精炼教师风险上界。

Conclusion: 蒸馏后的学生可以为教师提供有用反馈，鲁棒性迁移可超越传统单向师到生范式，形成师生互惠的闭环。

Abstract: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.

</details>


### [720] [Resolution Allocation with Learnable Resizing and Spectral Filter Parameterization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20274)
*Wu, Wei,Larson, Eric C.*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了可学习下采样率与空间域/谱域卷积核参数化之间的交互，发现谱域卷积核从学习到的分辨率分配中获益更大，且该增益在保留面积匹配后仍然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可学习下采样与谱域滤波参数化各自提升了卷积网络的灵活性，但二者之间的交互尚未被系统检验，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在裁剪缩放（cropped resizing）实现下，联合考查空间域与谱域学习的卷积核以及可学习的下采样比率，在 EuroSAT、CIFAR-10、STL-10 三个数据集和两种模型规模上进行对照实验，并额外做保留总面积匹配的对照。

Result: 谱域与空间域卷积核对学习到的分辨率分配响应不同，谱域核增益更大，在留出测试集上准确率增益差异为 +0.013 至 +0.028；该差异部分源于谱域核保留更大空间面积带来的收益，但在总面积匹配时差异仍为正。幅度及对复杂度预算的依赖随模型规模和缩放实现而变。

Conclusion: 谱域参数化卷积核与可学习分辨率分配存在正向协同，为设计更灵活的卷积架构提供了实证依据，但该效应的大小依赖模型规模与具体缩放实现。

Abstract: Learnable downsampling and spectral-domain filter parameterizations have each made convolutional networks more flexible, but their interaction has not been systematically examined. We bridge this gap by examining convolutional kernels learned in the spatial and spectral domains, together with learned downsampling ratios under a cropped resizing implementation. We find that spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for the spectral kernel. We observe this consistently on three datasets (EuroSAT, CIFAR-10 and STL-10) and at two model sizes (differences in accuracy gain of +0.013 to +0.028 on held-out test sets). Part of this difference reflects the greater gain of the spectral kernel from retaining more spatial area, but the difference remains positive when total retained area is matched. This pattern is observed across datasets and model sizes, although its magnitude and dependence on the complexity budget vary with model size and the resizing implementation.

</details>


### [721] [NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20349)
*Wen, Yaozhi,Zhao, Kun,Wei, Wei,Chen, Haoyang,Wang, Kangning,Sun, Yi,Gu, Shaowei,Liu, Dingkun,Qiu, Shuang,He, Huiguang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 NeuroDETR：一种离散时空多尺度框架，通过结构化 tokenization 与事件感知特征精炼，实现无需预设边界的异步 EEG 事件检测（分类+起止点定位）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际 BCI 需要在连续记录中直接识别事件类别与时间边界，而推理时无预设事件边界；核心难点在于从持续背景活动中提取事件相关模式。

Method: 1) 多尺度时间码本捕捉短促响应与持续动态；2) Spatial-Pyramid VQ 分层编码跨通道空间结构；二者构成紧凑"事件记忆"，联合分类事件并回归 onset/offset；3) tokenization 前使用 FOCAL 事件感知稀疏注意力，以预测的事件存在性引导时间特征精炼与空间聚合。

Result: 在覆盖多种范式的 8 个 EEG 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。

Conclusion: 为在持续交互与监测中识别有意义神经活动的 BCI 系统提供了基础。

Abstract: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the development of BCI systems that recognize meaningful neural activity during continuous interaction and monitoring.

</details>


### [722] [Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20533)
*Baade, Alan,Sargent, Kyle,Sitzmann, Vincent,Chan, Eric Ryan,Johnson, Justin,Fei-Fei, Li,Wetzstein, Gordon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自监督表征学习方法，通过分解数据点互信息（PMI）得到训练目标，用生成模型的预测信息差来估计，从而学习适合生成建模的 latent tokenizer；理论/实验证明其可避免维度坍缩与特征抑制，并给出 tokenizer 与生成模型联合的算力最优缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希望获得能直接作为生成模型 tokenizer 的表征学习方法，同时规避 DINO、LeJEPA 等方法在训练中出现的维度坍缩与特征抑制问题，并让表征质量随算力可预测地提升。

Method: 以点互信息分解构造表征损失，用学习到的生成模型在条件预测之间的信息差来估计该 PMI；将其作为自监督目标训练 tokenizer，并从理论上论证设计合理性；在 ImageNet 与 GPIC 上分析 tokenizer encoder 的缩放律，同时首次联合分析 tokenizer 与生成模型的 FLOP 效率。
