Given the full instruction directly, low-level policies achieve 85.4% on single-subgoal tasks, but drop to near zero on extended tasks. While orchestration remedies this, it remains bounded by physical execution errors of the low-level policy rather than high-level planning and achieves only ~25%. Tool selection orchestration with GPT-Policy on GPT-6 Astra significantly outperforms learned-policy methods, but incurs significant time and cost budget and succeeds only ~62%. Real-world experiments across two embodiments confirm the collapse of the low-level policy and the gain from orchestration. Project website: https://ladder.insait.ai

</details>


### [1030] [LynxScenes: A Large-Scale Real-World Benchmark for Outdoor Wheel-Legged Robot Perception, Navigation, Imagination and Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18093)
*Tian, Jun,Wu, Hao,Chen, Ruo,Liao, Yili,Lin, Hongyi,Yu, Jincheng,Li, Chao,Niu, Yingjie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LynxScenes：基于轮腿机器人LYNX M20采集的大规模真实世界多任务数据集与基准，约10万段30秒导航片段（833.6小时、3294.7公里、300万标注帧），含4鱼眼+双LiDAR+IMU/里程计/机器人状态，提供2082万个带朝向3D框（27类）、1389万道路结构标注、20条三层级导航指令并关联未来轨迹，支持指令条件轨迹预测、BEV感知、未来场景预测与多视图重建四类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外人机共享空间中运行的轮腿机器人需同时具备精确感知、社会合规导航、未来场景推理与场景重建能力；但现有数据集通常只孤立支持其中某一能力，且很少在真实轮腿平台上提供稠密的空间与行为级监督。论文希望用一个统一的大规模真实数据集填补这一空白。

Method: 以LYNX M20轮腿机器人为采集平台，同步记录4个鱼眼相机、双LiDAR、IMU、里程计与机器人状态，构建约10万段30秒片段的数据集；标注包括27类2082万个带朝向3D框、1389万条道路结构标注、20类三层级导航指令并对齐连续未来轨迹。设置四项任务：指令条件轨迹预测、BEV下3D物体与道路结构感知、未来场景预测、多视图场景重建。针对轨迹预测提出基于log-replay的伪闭环评测器，从安全性、行进效率与指令遵从性三方面评估。

Result: 在导航、感知、世界模型与重建等代表性方法上进行了广泛评测，结果显示近距离户外机器人导航仍存在显著挑战。数据集与评测工具包计划公开发布。

Conclusion: LynxScenes以真实轮腿平台上的稠密空间与行为级监督，将感知、导航、世界模型与重建统合到一个基准中，为户外轮腿机器人的近程导航研究提供数据与评测基础；伪闭环评测弥补了纯轨迹模仿指标的不足。

Abstract: Wheel-legged robots operating in outdoor spaces shared with humans require accurate perception, socially compliant navigation, future-scene reasoning, and scene reconstruction. However, existing datasets typically support these capabilities in isolation and rarely provide dense spatial and behavior-level supervision on real wheel-legged platforms. We introduce LynxScenes, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark collected with a LYNX M20 wheel-legged robot. It contains approximately 100K 30-s navigation clips spanning 833.6 h and 3,294.7 km, with 3.0M annotated frames. The synchronized recordings include four fisheye cameras, dual LiDARs, IMU, odometry, and robot states. Annotations comprise 20.82M oriented 3D boxes across 27 categories, 13.89M road-structure annotations, and 20 navigation instructions organized into three layers and aligned with continuous future trajectories. LynxScenes supports four complementary tasks: instruction-conditioned trajectory prediction, BEV-based perception of 3D objects and road structures, future scene prediction, and multi-view scene reconstruction. For trajectory prediction, we further introduce a log-replay-based pseudo-closed-loop evaluator that measures safety, progress, and instruction compliance beyond trajectory imitation. Extensive evaluations across representative navigation, perception, world-model, and reconstruction methods reveal substantial remaining challenges in close-range outdoor robot navigation. The dataset and evaluation toolkit are planned for public release.

</details>


### [1031] [ForeTac: Predictive Contact Guidance for Generative Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18118)
*Chen, Zhiyuan,Chen, Shuai,Zhou, Haoran,Zhao, Yizhe,Yang, Kaiyuan,Duan, Zhixiang,Xu, Shaoqing,Cao, Ran,Xiang, Diyun,You, Yangwei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForeTac 提出"表征-预测-评估-引导"闭环的触觉预测引导框架：冻结预训练策略，用可微触觉预测器预测候选动作的触觉后果，并以成功/失败交互中学到的接触质量目标反向引导动作生成。在四项真机任务上，成功率由 36.3% 提升至 71.3%，接触成功率由 20.0% 提升至 66.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉相似动作可能导致接触丢失、卡阻、滑移或不可逆损坏，而触觉反馈常在关键状态转变之后才到达，属于滞后信号。因此接触富集操作需要在执行前"预见并评估"候选动作的接触后果，而非事后被动响应。

Method: 以 represent-predict-evaluate-guide 循环组织：(1) 编码当前触觉状态；(2) 动作条件触觉预测器预测候选动作序列的触觉未来；(3) 用从真实成功/失败交互中学得的接触质量目标评估预测触觉轨迹；(4) 部署时梯度经触觉预测器回传以引导动作生成，而预训练策略（扩散/流匹配）参数保持冻结。本质上是以触觉世界模型作为可微引导信号。

Result: 四项真机任务（平面与曲面擦拭、卡片划动、易碎物体抓取）上，相比仅视觉 Diffusion Policy，平均任务成功率 36.3%→71.3%，平均 CSR 20.0%→66.3%。消融支持触觉表征与动作条件预见的作用，并表明预测触觉保持接触质量排序（ordering）一致。

Conclusion: 触觉预测可用作执行前的可微接触引导，在冻结策略之上即插即用地提升接触富集操作的成功率与接触质量；预测触觉保留质量排序，说明该信号可用于候选动作排序与筛选。

Abstract: Visually similar actions can produce contact loss, jamming, slippage, or irreversible damage, while tactile feedback may arrive after a critical transition. Contact-rich manipulation therefore requires generative policies to anticipate and evaluate whether candidate actions will produce desirable contact outcomes, then adjust action generation before execution. We present ForeTac, a predictive contact-guidance framework organized as a represent-predict-evaluate-guide loop. ForeTac encodes the current tactile state, predicts the tactile consequences of a candidate action sequence, and evaluates the predicted trajectory using a contact-quality objective learned from successful and failed physical interactions. At deployment, its gradient propagates through the tactile predictor to guide action generation while the pretrained model parameters remain frozen. We evaluate ForeTac on four real-robot tasks (planar and curved-surface wiping, card swiping, and fragile-object grasping) with diffusion and flow-matching policies. Across these tasks, ForeTac raises the average task success rate from 36.3% to 71.3% and the average contact success rate (CSR) from 20.0% to 66.3% compared with vision-only Diffusion Policy. Component analyses support the tactile representation and action-conditioned foresight, and show that predicted touch preserves contact-quality ordering. Project page: https://foretac.github.io/.

</details>


### [1032] [MARTS: A Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying of Diseased Tomato Plants in Greenhouses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18123)
*Singh, Rajmeet,Kaur, Manveen,Adamu, Yusuf,Kshetrimayum, Lochan,Hussain, Irfan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MARTS：集成Husky A200移动底盘、UR5机械臂与模块化喷雾末端执行器的低成本温室机器人，实现"植株级病害检测→叶片级定点喷雾"闭环，商用温室实测312片病叶、定位成功率92.4%、喷药量较播撒式减少71%，喷雾子系统成本412美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温室番茄病害防治仍以播撒式喷药为主，存在三大痛点：无法区分健康与病态组织（药液浪费与农药过量）、作业人员暴露于有害气溶胶、效果高度依赖操作者经验。核心动机是将已有的叶片级视觉检测能力（TLDVLM）真正落到执行端，在商品化硬件上以低成本实现叶片级精准定点喷雾，形成感知-执行闭环。

Method: 硬件以Clearpath Husky A200移动底盘、UR5机械臂、腕部Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D相机和自研模块化喷雾末端（单台12 V微型隔膜泵）构成。检测复用已发表的TLDVLM（Grounding DINO + SAM-2 + LoRA微调BLIP-2，10类97.27%准确率），本文专注执行、控制与系统集成。ROS流水线将二维检测提升为三维目标，基于拟合的叶片法向在120 mm标准距离生成避障喷嘴位姿，并按病斑面积缩放泵脉冲时长（水敏纸标定显示脉冲-体积线性关系R²=0.994）。MuJoCo中验证自适应底盘重定位策略。在阿联酋Al Ain的SILAL商业温室对自然感染樱桃番茄开展12次自主试验。

Result: 水敏纸标定脉冲-体积线性度R²=0.994；MuJoCo仿真中自适应底盘重定位实现18个航点100%覆盖，最大姿态误差1.1°。真实温室12次自主试验处理312片病叶：目标命中成功率92.4%，喷雾中心平均误差18.7 mm，相邻叶片过喷率6.1%，农药用量较播撒式降低71%，单叶平均周期4.8 s，喷雾子系统成本412美元（较同类系统低6–10倍）。

Conclusion: 在商品化硬件上可实现准确的叶片级定点喷雾，验证了"检测-3D定位-按病斑定量施药"闭环在商业温室中的可行性，兼顾精度、成本与减药收益。局限在于检测模块复用既有工作、未与播撒式在病害防治效果上做对照，部署规模有限（单一温室、12次试验）。

Abstract: Broadcast spraying remains the dominant method of disease control in greenhouse tomato production, yet it treats healthy and diseased tissue alike, exposes workers to hazardous aerosols, and depends on operator skill. This paper presents MARTS (Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying), a low-cost robotic platform that closes the loop from plant-level disease detection to leaf-localised spray delivery in commercial greenhouses. MARTS integrates a Clearpath Husky A200 mobile base, a UR5 manipulator, a novel modular spraying end-effector built around a single 12 V micro-diaphragm pump, and a wrist-mounted Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D camera. Disease detection reuses our previously published Tomato Leaf Disease Vision Language Model (TLDVLM; Grounding DINO, SAM-2 and LoRA-tuned BLIP-2, 97.27% accuracy over 10 classes); this work focuses on actuation, control and system integration. A ROS pipeline lifts detections into 3D targets, generates collision-aware nozzle poses at a 120 mm stand-off using fitted leaf normals, and scales pump pulse duration to lesion area. Water-sensitive paper calibration showed a linear pulse-volume relationship (R^2 = 0.994). In MuJoCo simulation, an adaptive base-repositioning strategy achieved 100% coverage of 18 waypoints with a maximum orientation error of 1.1 deg. Deployed at the SILAL commercial greenhouse (Al Ain, UAE) on cherry tomatoes under natural infection, MARTS treated 312 diseased leaves in 12 autonomous trials with 92.4% targeting success, 18.7 mm mean spray-centre error, 6.1% adjacent-leaf overspray, and a 71% reduction in pesticide volume versus broadcast spraying. Mean cycle time was 4.8 s per leaf, and the spraying subsystem costs USD 412, 6-10x lower than comparable systems, showing that accurate leaf-level targeting is achievable on commodity hardware.

</details>


### [1033] [SkipWorld: Latent Skip Planning with Distilled World Models for Efficient Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18135)
*Yang, Yifei,Fan, Zehua,Yan, Zike,Li, Zhongyu,Wang, Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkipWorld 提出潜空间跳跃规划框架：用 Latent AutoRoll 做闭环一致的潜空间自回归 rollout，用 SkipDistill 蒸馏出可跳步预测长程潜状态的跳跃世界模型，再用 Skip-then-Refine 双模型粗到细规划器先筛后精排候选轨迹，在四个导航数据集上提升精度并大幅降低规划耗时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于世界模型的视觉导航依赖对未来状态的预测进行动作规划，但长时程 rollout 存在两个瓶颈：（1）训练时使用真实视觉历史、部署时却是闭环自回归预测，导致训练-推理不一致；（2）对大量候选轨迹逐步 rollout 计算代价高昂。因此需要一种既保持轨迹评估精度又能减少冗余 rollout 的规划框架。

Method: SkipWorld 由三部分组成：(i) Latent AutoRoll：在潜空间中递归展开未来状态，训练世界模型以缓解训练与闭环推理的失配；(ii) SkipDistill：把潜空间自回归模型蒸馏为跳跃世界模型，直接预测长跨度的未来潜状态；(iii) Skip-then-Refine Planning：双模型粗到细规划，先用跳跃模型快速过滤候选轨迹，再用更强的自回归模型对入选候选做重排序，从而在保留精确轨迹评估的同时减少冗余 rollout 计算。

Result: 在 RECON、HuRoN、SCAND、TartanDrive 四个数据集上，与 NWM 相比，SkipWorld 将平均 ATE 降低 4.2%、RPE 降低 2.7%，规划时间减少 62.4%，实现 2.7 倍加速。

Conclusion: 潜空间跳跃预测 + 蒸馏 + 粗到细重排序的组合，可在保持甚至提升轨迹评估精度的同时显著压缩长时程视觉导航的规划计算量，说明长跨度潜状态预测是缓解世界模型闭环 rollout 成本的有效手段。

Abstract: World-model-based visual navigation enables action planning by predicting future states under candidate trajectories. However, long-horizon rollout remains challenging: models are often trained with ground-truth visual histories but deployed in closed-loop prediction, and evaluating many candidates with step-by-step rollout is computationally expensive. We propose SkipWorld, a latent skip planning framework for efficient visual navigation. SkipWorld introduces three components: (i) Latent AutoRoll, which trains a world model to recursively roll out future states in latent space, reducing the mismatch between training and closed-loop inference; (ii) SkipDistill, which distills the latent autoregressive model into a skip world model that directly predicts long-stride future latent states; and (iii) Skip-then-Refine Planning, a dual-model coarse-to-fine planner that first filters candidate trajectories with the skip model and then reranks selected candidates with the stronger autoregressive model. This design preserves accurate trajectory evaluation while reducing redundant rollout computation. Experiments on RECON, HuRoN, SCAND, and TartanDrive show that, compared with NWM, SkipWorld reduces the average ATE by 4.2% and RPE by 2.7%, while decreasing planning time by 62.4% with a 2.7-fold speedup.

</details>


### [1034] [Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18147)
*Aurand, Joshua,Serifi, Agon,Christen, Sammy,Grandia, Ruben,Knoop, Espen,Hutter, Marco,Bächer, Moritz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个实时表达性腿部运动框架，通过定制采样策略训练风格编码器并条件化自回归扩散模型，实现对速度与风格的独立控制，无需显式风格标签，可泛化至未见风格，并在仿真人形与真实机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的运动控制器通常依赖显式风格标签进行训练，难以高效利用大规模非结构化运动数据，也无法泛化到未见风格，且难以独立控制速度与风格。

Method: 用定制采样策略将风格与功能性运动解耦，训练风格编码器；其输出条件化自回归扩散模型，生成运动学参考；该参考由强化学习控制器跟踪。引入注意力偏置机制与速度指令校正策略以提升可控性与风格化强度；推理时用户提供风格参考片段与手柄速度指令。

Result: 在基于物理的仿真人形角色和真实机器人上展示了鲁棒的实时控制与连续风格调制，可泛化到未见风格，并能利用大规模非结构化运动数据。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了腿部运动的实时表达性控制，解耦速度与风格，减少对显式风格标签的依赖，具备真实机器人部署能力与实用价值。

Abstract: We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation. The results can be best seen in our supplemental video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4).

</details>


### [1035] [Force Sensor-Based Picking Pattern Analysis and Two-Jaw Gripper Design for Cherry Tomato Robotic Harvesting in Greenhouse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18160)
*Singh, Rajmeet,Kaur, Manveen,Adamu, Yusuf,Hussain, Irfan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种力数据驱动的自主樱桃番茄采摘框架：用佩戴式六轴力/力矩传感器采集150次人工采摘动作的动力学特征，据此设计指尖局部柔顺的Finray夹爪（TPU 95A+PLA双刚度）与电流控扭策略，并在UR5+Husky A200平台上于商业温室完成50次自主试验，成功率86.0%、损伤率2.3%、单果周期8.4 s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温室樱桃番茄果实成簇密集、表皮脆弱，既需轻柔又需有效脱蒂，现有末端执行器（真空、旋转、夹持、吸切）成功率低或损伤高，缺乏基于真实人力动力学数据的采摘策略设计依据。

Method: 在食指佩戴ATI六轴力/力矩传感器，采集抓取、扭转、侧向拉拽三种基本动作各50次（共150次）的动力学签名，提取峰值法向力（3.92/0.45 N）、绕果柄轴主扭矩（19.20±2.10 Nmm）等参数；据此设计指尖局部Finray柔顺夹爪（TPU 95A柔顺区+PLA刚性本体）并做FEA应力验证；采用Dynamixel XM430-W350电流控扭实现测量抓取力与45°腕部扭转，构建"抓-扭-拉"混合策略，在Isaac Sim与阿布扎比SILAL商业温室完成仿真与50次自主试验。

Result: FEA显示3.92 N载荷下最大von Mises应力0.24 MPa，低于番茄表皮损伤阈值；自主试验成功率86.0%、果损率2.3%、单果周期8.4 s，优于真空（66.3%）、旋转（70.1%）、夹持（76.0%）与吸切（52.4%）末端执行器。

Conclusion: 力数据驱动的双刚度柔顺夹爪与抓-扭-拉策略在特定温室与品种条件下具备初步可行性，但结论仅限于所测试场景，泛化性与规模化仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Robotic harvesting of cherry tomatoes in greenhouses remains challenging due to dense fruit clusters, delicate skin, and the need for gentle yet effective detachment. This study presents a force-data-driven framework for autonomous cherry tomato harvesting that integrates six-axis force/torque sensing, a bio-inspired compliant gripper, and deployment on a mobile robotic platform. A wearable ATI six-axis force/torque sensor mounted on the index finger captured kinetic signatures of three elemental picking patterns (gripping, twisting, and lateral pulling) across 150 manual trials (50 per pattern) in laboratory and greenhouse settings. Gripping required a peak normal force of 3.92 and 0.45 N, twisting produced a dominant torque of 19.20 2.10 Nmm about the pedicel axis with minimal truss disturbance, and pure lateral pulling alone was insufficient for reliable detachment. These measurements informed a novel fingertip-localised Finray gripper, with compliant TPU 95A Finray geometry restricted to the fruit-contact region and a rigid PLA body, emulating the dual-stiffness human fingertip. A Dynamixel XM430-W350 servomotor under current-based torque control applies the measured gripping force and a 45{\deg} wrist twist. Finite element analysis showed a maximum von Mises stress of 0.24 MPa under the 3.92 N load, below the bruising threshold of cherry tomato skin. Integrated on a UR5 arm and Clearpath Husky A200 base, the system was validated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and in 50 autonomous trials at the SILAL commercial greenhouse, Abu Dhabi, UAE. The hybrid grip-twist-pull strategy achieved an 86.0% picking success rate, 2.3% fruit damage, and an 8.4 s cycle time per fruit, outperforming vacuum (66.3%), rotating (70.1%), clamping (76.0%), and suction-cutting (52.4%) end-effectors. These results demonstrate preliminary feasibility under the tested facility and cultivar conditions

</details>


### [1036] [RESTA: Time-Scaling Augmentation for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18163)
*Jiang, Yunpeng,Hu, Jianshu,Fang, Han,Guan, Zhiyuan,Weng, Paul,Ban, Yutong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RESTA通过轨迹反转与时间步长重采样两种时间尺度数据增强，提升机器人模仿学习的数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习依赖昂贵示教，且示教通常仅覆盖单一任务方向与固定时间分辨率，数据效率低。

Method: 将互为反向目标的配对任务中的示教反转并重标注，作为近似配对任务先验而非物理对称；同时随机/固定地调整观测与动作采样步长，并把步长偏移作为策略条件输入。

Result: 在16个双臂配对任务上，每任务25与50条独立示教时平均成功率78.4%与85.2%，匹敌或超过用两倍示教（77.3%/85.4%）的基线；反转在低数据下最有效，步长增强在随机时间表下提升成功率。

Conclusion: 时间尺度增强（反转+步长）可显著提升机器人模仿学习数据效率，尤其适用于低数据与随机时间调度场景。

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning commonly rely on costly demonstrations recorded in one task direction and at one temporal resolution. We propose Reversal and Stride-based Trajectory Augmentation (RESTA), which exploits time-scaling data augmentation to improve data efficiency through trajectory reversal and temporal resampling. Trajectory-reversal augmentation reverses and relabels demonstrations between paired tasks with opposite objectives, reusing recorded rollouts without additional environment interaction. Because contact-rich manipulation is not exactly reversible, we treat reversal as an approximate paired-task prior rather than a physical symmetry. Temporal-stride augmentation varies observation and action sampling strides and conditions the policy on the resulting offsets, enabling fixed or randomized temporal schedules. Experiments across 16 paired bimanual manipulation tasks show that trajectory reversal is particularly effective in the low-data regime and that temporal-stride augmentation improves success under randomized temporal schedules. With 25 and 50 independently collected demonstrations per task, RESTA achieves 78.4% and 85.2% average success, respectively, matching or exceeding baselines trained with twice as many demonstrations (77.3% and 85.4%). These results show that RESTA can improve data efficiency in robot imitation learning.

</details>


### [1037] [Beyond Planning: Differentiable Control-in-the-loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18167)
*Wang, Zhidong,Li, Zirui,Shan, Zitong,Mao, Zhiqi,Huang, Qihang,Chen, Zhan,Liang, Jingsong,Yu, Han,Lv, Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DIVA 将可辨识的执行器级车辆动力学模型嵌入端到端自动驾驶训练回路，用学习式控制解码器替代手调跟踪控制器，实现从感知到车辆状态的可微链路，在 Bench2Drive 闭环上取得 86.7 驾驶得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶虽已能直接从原始传感器数据规划轨迹，但"规划到控制"仍依赖手工调参的跟踪控制器，切断了从车辆运动回传到网络的梯度路径。该鸿沟源于四个问题：车辆动力学不可微、粗采样专家标签带来的混叠监督、高频率控制与低频重规划的速率失配、以及训练与部署间的车辆模型差异。

Method: 提出 DIVA：1) 将可辨识的执行器级车辆模型嵌入端到端驾驶网络训练循环，构建感知→车辆状态的可微链路；2) 用学习式控制解码器替代外部控制器，直接对滚动展开的车辆状态监督，绕开混叠的控制输入标签；3) 速率一致的控制输入参数化，统一异构采样率并支持异步执行（仅控制周期 3.8 ms）；4) 在线策略重辨识应对训练期分布偏移，在线扰动观测器应对部署期模型失配。

Result: 在闭环 Bench2Drive 基准上驾驶得分 86.7，较主流 SOTA 提升 3.3 分；平均 jerk 近乎减半，刹车切换减少 64%；在部署时存在显著车辆模型失配的情况下仍保持更优的路径跟踪精度。

Conclusion: 通过将可微可辨识车辆动力学与学习式控制解码器结合，DIVA 打通了端到端自动驾驶中规划与控制的梯度断点，并兼顾速率一致性与模型失配鲁棒性，在闭环基准上以更平顺、更稳定的控制取得 SOTA 表现。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved remarkable progress by planning trajectories directly from raw sensor data. Yet the step from planning to control still relies on hand-tuned tracking controllers that block the gradient path from vehicle motion back to the network. This gap stems from non-differentiable vehicle dynamics, aliased supervision from coarsely sampled expert labels, rate mismatch between high-rate control and low-rate re-planning, and vehicle model discrepancies between training and deployment. This paper proposes DIVA (Differentiable Identified Vehicle dynamics for end-to-end Autonomous driving) to close this gap. An identified actuator-level vehicle model is embedded in the training loop of the end-to-end driving network, forming a differentiable chain from perception to vehicle states. A learning-based control decoder replaces the external controller and is supervised on the rolled-out vehicle states, bypassing the aliased control-input labels. A rate-consistent control-input parameterization reconciles the heterogeneous sampling rates and enables asynchronous execution with a 3.8 ms control-only cycle. On-policy re-identification and an online disturbance observer address training-time distribution shift and deployment-time model mismatch respectively. On the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark, DIVA achieves a driving score of 86.7, surpassing the widely adopted state-of-the-art approach by 3.3 points while nearly halving mean jerk and reducing brake switching by 64%, and maintains superior path tracking accuracy under significant vehicle model mismatch at deployment.

</details>


### [1038] [OneDemo: Unified Policy Learning and Data Generation from a Single Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18188)
*Qian, Ying,Hu, Jianshu,Fang, Han,Li, Shuguang,Ban, Yutong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OneDemo将单条成功演示的编辑过程建模为结构化强化学习问题，通过学习"何时切换物体中心轨迹段"与"如何几何适配每段"，从稀疏成功奖励中习得编辑策略，从而把单条演示扩展为多样成功轨迹，兼作任务策略与可复用演示生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略学习受限于高质量专家演示的采集成本；现有演示增强方法依赖人工设计变换规则或复杂轨迹规划，需要大量任务特定的工程与人力投入，难以泛化到新任务配置。

Method: 把演示编辑形式化为结构化强化学习：以物体为中心的轨迹分段为编辑单元，编辑器策略在稀疏的任务成功奖励下学习段间的切换时机（when）与每段几何变换的适配方式（how）；训练所得编辑器既可直接作为任务策略，也可作为演示生成器，为新任务配置批量产出成功演示。

Result: 15个Meta-World任务上平均53.7k环境交互内达到92.7%成功率；9个DexMimicGen任务上生成演示平均成功率98.4%，在同等数据规模下用生成数据训练的BC-RNN策略平均成功率达99.6%。

Conclusion: 学习编辑单条成功演示为策略学习与可扩展演示生成提供了结构化且有效的基座，避免了手工变换规则与任务特定规划，说明稀疏成功奖励足以驱动可复用的演示编辑，具备向数据高效模仿学习与规模化数据生成扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Learning robot policies from demonstrations is often limited by the cost of collecting diverse, high-quality expert data. While an appealing alternative is to expand a single successful demonstration into a diverse set of successful trajectories, existing augmentation methods typically rely on manually designed transformation rules or complex trajectory planning, requiring substantial task-specific engineering and human effort. We introduce OneDemo, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to edit a single successful demonstration for new task configurations. We formulate demonstration editing as a structured reinforcement learning problem, in which an editor learns, from sparse task-success rewards, both when to transition between object-centric trajectory segments and how to geometrically adapt each segment. The learned editor serves both as a task policy and as a reusable demonstration generator. Across 15 Meta-World tasks, OneDemo reaches a 92.7% success rate within 53.7k environment interactions on average. Across 9 DexMimicGen tasks, it generates successful demonstrations with a 98.4% average success rate, and BC-RNN policies trained on the generated data achieve 99.6% average success at matched dataset scale. These results show that learning to edit a single successful demonstration provides a structured and effective basis for both policy learning and scalable demonstration generation.

</details>


### [1039] [Cross-Embodiment Affordance Transfer for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18194)
*Yaseen, Sawera,Thill, Serge,Raja, Rekha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以机器人物理属性为条件的可供性预测框架：将人类标注的可供性翻译为机器人可执行的可供性。输入物体3D点云与机器人几何/约束描述子，用仿真中多次接近试验的执行结果作为监督，在UR5e+两种平行夹爪上验证，优于无机器人信息的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类标注的可供性反映人手交互可能性，而非特定机器人的物理约束；被标注为可抓取的区域对机器人可能几何不可达或机械不可行，这一错配鲜有显式建模。

Method: 条件化可供性预测网络：输入物体3D点云与编码机器人几何与约束的描述子，输出机器人物理可执行的表面区域；训练监督结合人类标注可供性与仿真中多次采样接近试验的执行结果，明确执行成功与否界定区域可执行性。

Result: 在家庭物体数据集上，使用UR5e机械臂与两种平行夹爪配置评估，框架优于不接收机器人信息的基线模型，验证了可供性预测必须以机器人为条件。

Conclusion: 人类标注本身不足以学习机器人可执行的可供性表征，可供性预测须显式条件化于具体机器人的物理属性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.

</details>


### [1040] [I2O2I-Nav: A Benchmark with a Modular Agent for Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor-to-Indoor Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18307)
*Shu, Zhengjie,Li, Wanyu,Xiao, Di,Jiang, Lingxin,Jiang, Lai,Hu, Kaidi,Tang, Xincheng,Hu, Wenkang,Wang, Haoran,Zhang, Jinchuan,Chen, Chang,Li, Wei,Pan, Jia,Yang, Ruigang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出物理仿真基准 I2O2I-Nav（20个真实复合场景、115,000+平米、3DGS与碰撞几何对齐），设三级评测（单一基元→两阶段组合→完整四阶段室内-室外-室内任务），并提出 MODULAR-Agent 协调冻结导航策略。完整四阶段成功率仅从1.15%提升到4.02%，揭示长时程组合与完成判定困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务与配送机器人需完成跨越室内外的长时程导航任务，但现有具身导航基准多评估孤立阶段或部分跨域路径，难以衡量异构导航能力在连续执行下如何组合。

Method: 构建物理使能基准 I2O2I-Nav：20个真实复合场景、超115,000平米、多楼多层，3DGS渲染与碰撞几何对齐；三级评测（独立基元、两阶段组合、完整四阶段I2O2I任务），每阶段从前一阶段实际终点出发，用阶段条件指标追踪完成度与失败定位。方法上提出 MODULAR-Agent，通过完成校验、阶段交接和有界恢复协调多个冻结导航策略。

Result: 1,374 回合评测：MODULAR-Agent 在单个基元上达40.5–76%成功率，完整I2O2I仍偏低；相比使用相同底层策略的固定策略链，I2O与O2I成功率提升一倍以上，完整任务成功率从1.15%升至4.02%。阶段分析显示更多任务能到达最终物体导航阶段，但该阶段条件成功率仍低。

Conclusion: 连续组合是长时程室内外导航的核心瓶颈，模块化协调与完成校验带来显著但有限的提升；长时程阶段执行与完成判定仍是主要挑战。

Abstract: Service and delivery robots often need to complete long-horizon navigation missions spanning indoor and outdoor environments. Existing embodied navigation benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated stages or partial cross-domain journeys, providing limited support for assessing how heterogeneous navigation capabilities compose under continuous execution. We introduce I2O2I-Nav, a physics-enabled benchmark of 20 real-world composite scenes spanning over 115,000 square meters across multiple buildings and floors, with aligned 3DGS rendering and collision geometry. Its three-level evaluation progresses from independent primitives to two-stage compositions and complete four-stage I2O2I missions. Each stage starts from its predecessor's actual endpoint, while stage-conditional metrics track completion and localize failures along the mission. We further propose the MODULAR-Agent that coordinates frozen navigation policies through completion verification, stage handoffs, and bounded recovery. Evaluation across 1,374 episodes highlights the difficulty of continuous composition. The MODULAR-Agent achieves 40.5-76% success on individual primitives, but full I2O2I success remains low. Compared with a fixed policy chain using the same underlying policies, it more than doubles success on both Indoor-to-Outdoor (I2O) and Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I), while improving full-mission success from 1.15% to 4.02%. Stage-wise analysis shows that the MODULAR-Agent enables more missions to reach the final object-navigation stage, where conditional success remains low, revealing challenges in both long-horizon stage execution and completion decisions.

</details>


### [1041] [CoSMO: Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18321)
*Wang, Shuqi,Zheng, Yiwei,Zhang, Pingrui,Gao, Yue,Yin, Xiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CoSMO 框架，利用共形预测将 VLM 嵌入转化为校准后的覆盖率集与安全感知障碍膨胀，在动态扩展的危险词汇表下支持开放世界安全导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义建图依赖 VLM 的置信度，但该置信度校准差，难以用于安全关键规划；共形预测虽提供覆盖率保证，却假设固定标签集与平稳数据，无法适应开放世界与分布漂移。

Method: 将 VLM 语义嵌入映射为共形覆盖率集，在动态扩展的危险类别词表上构建语义安全地图，并据此进行安全感知的障碍膨胀；方法在分布偏移与延迟专家反馈条件下仍维持覆盖率保证。

Result: 在 Matterport3D 上相比纯几何基线减少 61.6% 的语义碰撞；四足机器人真机实验中达到 90.73% 的长期经验覆盖率，接近 90% 目标。

Conclusion: CoSMO 表明共形预测可有效桥接 VLM 语义不确定性与安全导航需求，实现开放世界下具备形式化覆盖率保证的语义安全建图与导航。

Abstract: Safe autonomous navigation requires not only geometric obstacle avoidance but also semantic awareness. Different object categories demand different safety clearances, and the set of relevant categories may expand as the robot explores novel environments. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich semantic representations for building maps of unknown scenes, yet their confidence scores are poorly calibrated, making raw predictions unreliable for safety-critical planning. Conformal prediction (CP) can provide coverage guarantees, but existing methods assume a fixed label set and stationary data, limiting their use in open-world settings. We propose Conformal Semantic Mapping for Open-World Safe Robot Navigation (CoSMO), a semantic safety mapping framework that transforms VLM embeddings into calibrated coverage sets and safety-aware obstacle dilations over a dynamically expanding hazard vocabulary, even under distribution shift. Experiments on the Matterport3D (MP3D) dataset show that CoSMO reduces semantic collisions by 61.6% relative to a geometry-only baseline, while maintaining formal coverage guarantees even under delayed expert feedback. Real-world experiments on a quadruped robot further demonstrate generalization by achieving long-run empirical coverage of 90.73% against the 90% target. Project website: https://yangming911.github.io/cosmo-page/.

</details>


### [1042] [Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18352)
*Wen, Youpeng,Wang, Gang,Huang, Tianyu,Zhang, Weiwei,Huang, Zhijian,Chen, Wei,Chen, Xieyuanli,Liu, Yunhui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Orchestra 将多步指令分解为有序子任务，分离规划与执行管理，通过共享上下文与进度评估器驱动动作策略，显著提升长程任务序列执行成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人需要按正确顺序操作正确物体，并在场景变化中保持任务进度意识。现有在原子指令与短轨迹上训练的策略难以泛化到长子任务序列。

Method: Orchestra 作为 agent harness，将完整多模态指令分解为有序子任务，跟踪已完成步骤并更新物体与目标位置；维护含当前子任务、空间 grounding 与近期观测的共享上下文；动作策略据此生成动作，独立训练的进度评估器决定何时推进到下一子任务。并构建 RMBench-Compose 基准。

Result: 在九个 RMBench 任务上平均成功率 68.22%，超 Mem-0 达 26.22 个百分点；RMBench-Compose 上 ASL 为 7.35 子任务，为 HarnessVLA 的 2.46 倍；四个真实多步任务上相比 base π0.5 策略 ASL 提升 25.0%。

Conclusion: Orchestra 有效支撑机器人执行更长的子任务序列，同时保持请求的子任务顺序与指定物体操作，代码与项目页已公开。

Abstract: A robot following a multi-step instruction needs to act on the right objects in the right order, even as the scene changes. It must also maintain awareness of task progress and determine when to advance. To address these challenges, we introduce Orchestra, an agent harness that separates task planning and execution management from action generation. Orchestra decomposes a complete multimodal instruction into ordered subtasks, tracks completed steps, and updates the locations of relevant objects and destinations during execution. It maintains a shared context containing the active subtask, spatial grounding, and recent observations. An action policy uses this context to generate actions, while a separately trained progress evaluator estimates when to advance to the next subtask. To evaluate whether robots trained on atomic instructions and short trajectories can execute longer subtask sequences, we introduce a benchmark named RMBench-Compose. Orchestra achieves a mean success rate of $68.22\%$ across nine RMBench tasks, outperforming Mem-0 by $26.22$ percentage points. On RMBench-Compose, it achieves an Average Success Length (ASL) of $7.35$ subtasks, $2.46$ times that of HarnessVLA. Across four real-world multi-step tasks, it improves mean ASL by $25.0\%$ over Orchestra using the base $\pi_{0.5}$ policy. These results show that Orchestra helps robots carry out longer sequences of subtasks while preserving the requested subtask order and acting on the specified objects. Our code and project page are available at https://youpengwen.github.io/Orchestra.

</details>


### [1043] [Visual Sevoing from Lines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18363)
*Andreff, Nicolas,Espiau, Bernard,Horaud, Radu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于直线的视觉伺服新方法，定义“双归一化Plücker坐标”表示，实现图像直线对齐控制律，具备旋转-平移部分解耦、运动方程解析求逆与全局渐近稳定性，并在正交三面体场景下完成仿真与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直线特征比点特征更鲁棒（对部分遮挡、纹理缺失不敏感），但传统直线表示难以定义合理的“图像直线对齐”误差，导致控制律复杂、解耦性与稳定性分析困难。作者希望从理论几何层面重新审视直线表示，找到更适合视觉伺服的形式。

Method: 对主要直线表示（如Plücker坐标等）进行理论与几何分析，据此提出双归一化Plücker坐标（binormalized Plücker coordinates）；基于该表示定义图像直线对齐误差，推导控制律，并分析其性质：旋转与平移的部分解耦、运动方程的解析求逆、全局渐近稳定条件。

Result: 控制律在仿真与真实实验中得到验证，实验场景为正交三面体（orthogonal trihedron）；实现了直线对齐收敛，且具备上述解耦、解析求逆与全局渐近稳定性等理论保证。

Conclusion: 双归一化Plücker坐标为直线视觉伺服提供了统一的、几何上自然的表示，使图像直线对齐误差定义明确，并获得具有良好理论性质（部分解耦、解析求逆、全局渐近稳定）的控制律，为基于直线的视觉伺服提供了新范式。

Abstract: In this work, we present a fundamentally new approach to visual servoing using lines. It is based on a theoretical and geometrical study of the main line representations which allowed us to define a new representation, the so-called binormalized Plucker coordinates. They are particularly well suited to visual servoing. Indeed, they allow the definition of a proper image line alignment concept. The control law which realizes such an alignment has moreover several properties: partial decoupling between rotation and translation, analytical inversion of the motion equations and global asymptotic stability conditions. This control law was validated both in simulation and experimentally in the specific case of an orthogonal trihedron.

</details>


### [1044] [DR-VLA: Learning Human-Like Quadruped Navigation from Egocentric Web Videos via Domain-Invariant Scene Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18373)
*Tian, Jun,Niu, Yingjie,Chen, Ruo,Lin, Hongyi,Li, Chao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DR-VLA 提出混合 Transformer 框架，通过领域不变场景表示（DISR）迁移人类自中心导航经验，结合 VLM 理解、潜在世界模型与流匹配动作专家；配套 EgoLynx 数据集（1 万小时网络视频+2000 段真机四足配送遥操作）与 QNS 指标，实现四足机器人社交合规户外导航，并在 NAVSIM v1 上达 92.1 PDMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人户外配送需理解复杂场景、预判变化并遵守社交规范，但机器人演示数据采集成本高、难以规模化；自中心网络视频含大量人类导航经验，却因视角与运动差异难以直接迁移。作者因此希望通过领域不变表示桥接人类视频与机器人导航，实现可泛化的 VLA 式导航策略。

Method: 提出 DR-VLA：Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，融合视觉语言理解专家、潜在世界模型专家与流匹配动作专家；使用 DISR（领域不变场景表示）作为未来预测目标与跨域桥梁。构建 EgoLynx 数据集：EgoLynx-Web（1 万小时自中心网络视频）+ EgoLynx-Robot（2000 段真实配送遥操作片段）。先在无动作标签的 EgoLynx-Web 上预训练理解与世界专家，再在机器人观测上适配、用 EgoLynx-Robot 训练动作专家输出可执行轨迹。同时提出 QNS 伪闭环指标（安全性、指令合规、舒适性、进度）。

Result: 在留出的 EgoLynx-Robot 测试集上，QNS 相对最优对比方法提升约 5%，开环终点朝向误差（FHE）降低 14.6%。消融显示网络视频预训练提升泛化性，各关键组件均有贡献；作为未来预测目标，DISR 优于 5 种通用视觉表示，接近使用专用几何标签/点云的任务特定 3D 感知。在 NAVSIM v1 上无网络预训练单独训练可达 92.1 PDMS，显示框架可扩展至自动驾驶。

Conclusion: DR-VLA 证明通过领域不变场景表示可从大规模自中心人类视频迁移导航经验至四足机器人及自动驾驶，减少对昂贵机器人演示的依赖，并提供了数据集与评测指标，具备跨域泛化潜力。

Abstract: Quadruped robots performing outdoor deliveries must interpret complex scenes, anticipate changes, and navigate in socially compliant ways. Robot demonstrations are costly to collect at the scale needed for generalization. Egocentric web videos offer abundant human navigation experience, but differences in viewpoint and motion make this experience difficult to transfer to robots. We introduce DR-VLA, a Mixture-of-Transformers framework that transfers human navigation experience through a domain-invariant scene representation (DISR). The framework combines vision-language understanding and latent world modeling with a flow-matching action expert. We introduce EgoLynx, comprising 10,000 hours of curated egocentric web video (EgoLynx-Web) and 2,000 clips of teleoperated robot navigation collected during real-world deliveries (EgoLynx-Robot). We pretrain the understanding and world experts on EgoLynx-Web without action labels, then adapt the model to robot observations and train the action expert on EgoLynx-Robot to predict executable trajectories. We also propose the Quadruped Navigation Score (QNS), a pseudo-closed-loop metric combining safety, instruction compliance, comfort, and progress. On the held-out EgoLynx-Robot test split, DR-VLA improves QNS by approximately 5% and reduces open-loop final heading error (FHE) by 14.6%, each relative to the best competing result for that metric. Ablations show that web-video pretraining improves generalization and that the model's key components contribute to performance. As a future-prediction target, DISR outperforms five generic visual representations and yields performance close to task-specific 3D perception without dedicated geometric labels or point clouds for target construction. Trained separately on NAVSIM v1 without web pretraining, DR-VLA achieves 92.1 PDMS, suggesting that the framework also applies to autonomous driving.

</details>


### [1045] [Benchmarking Interaction-Oriented Aerial Mobility across Heterogeneous Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18381)
*Duan, Zhibo,Kong, Hanlin,Ma, Tianran,Wu, Yuze,Xu, Yuxuan,Hoi, Kenghou,Xie, Changheng,Zhou, Xin,Gao, Jianzhe,Gao, Fei,Wang, Wenguan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CrossFly 是一个面向异构环境中长时程"交互导向"空中移动操作基准，含 15K 轨迹、20+ 重建场景与 Indoor↔Outdoor 跨域轨迹，并提出 Interaction Readiness Rate (IRR) 指标评估导航终态是否具备下游操作条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中基准多局限于单一环境（室内或室外），无法评估智能体在连续环境切换下的表现；且涉及交互时通常将智能体直接初始化在目标附近，导致"导航→交互"的过渡环节缺乏评估。

Method: 在统一仿真与评测框架下构建 CrossFly 基准：15K 轨迹、20+ 重建场景，覆盖 Indoor、Outdoor 及 Indoor↔Outdoor 三类轨迹；提出 Interaction Readiness Rate (IRR)，在不假设特定操作策略的前提下衡量终端导航状态是否为下游交互提供合适条件；并给出 CrossFly-Agent 与五个代表性空中 VLA 智能体作对比。

Result: Indoor↔Outdoor 设置显著难于单环境设置，在未见场景上最高成功率仅 9.7%；下游操作案例研究验证了"交互导向到达"与后续物理交互之间的相关性。

Conclusion: CrossFly 揭示了异构环境长时程空中移动-交互任务的巨大挑战，为迈向统一移动与物理交互的空中具身智能提供评测平台。

Abstract: Aerial mobile manipulation requires unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to traverse heterogeneous environments such as indoor and outdoor domains, and connect navigation with subsequent physical interaction within the same trajectories. Existing aerial benchmarks are typically confined to single-environment settings, limiting evaluation of agents across continuous environmental transitions. When interaction is evaluated, agents are often initialized near the target, leaving the transition from navigation to interaction largely unassessed. This work introduces CrossFly, a benchmark for long-horizon interaction-oriented aerial mobility across heterogeneous environments. CrossFly contains 15K trajectories across more than 20 reconstructed scenes under a unified simulation and evaluation framework, covering Indoor, Outdoor, and Indoor$\leftrightarrow$Outdoor trajectories. It further introduces Interaction Readiness Rate (IRR) to assess whether terminal navigation states provide suitable conditions for downstream interaction without assuming a specific manipulation policy. Experiments with five representative aerial vision-language-action (VLA) agents and the proposed CrossFly-Agent show that Indoor$\leftrightarrow$Outdoor settings are more challenging than single-environment settings, with the highest success rate reaching 9.7% on unseen scenes. A downstream manipulation case study further validates the relevance of interaction-oriented arrival to subsequent physical interaction. We hope CrossFly helps advance aerial embodied intelligence toward unified mobility and physical interaction in heterogeneous environments.

</details>


### [1046] [Intent-guided Adaptive Stiffening for Visuomotor Policies under Unknown Resistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18386)
*Cufino, Francesco,Mariniello, Carmela,Selvaggio, Mario,Sochopoulos, Andreas,Ruggiero, Fabio*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种置于未修改视觉运动策略之下的“残余增刚层”，利用策略指令动作与机器人实际动作之间的偏差无传感器地辨识阻力，并由四模态监督器沿策略动作块给出的单一方向提升刚度，在拧瓶盖与推T型螺母两项真实任务上把成功率从52%提升到90%，且峰值偏轴力比统一刚性控制器低61%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拧盖、滑动接触件等任务需要沿高摩擦方向施加力以克服阻力，而生成式视觉运动策略只预测运动、不决定其可实现的“权限”，该权限由底层阻抗控制器决定：当阻力超过柔性控制器在有限跟踪误差下能输出的力时，任务无论预测多准都无法完成。所需力还依赖观测无法揭示的接触状态，难以预先估计。

Method: 在未修改的策略下方加一个残余增刚层：无需力觉，通过策略指令运动与实际实现运动之间的失配来识别阻力；四模态监督器依据策略自身动作块读出单一方向，沿该方向提高刚度，任务推进期间保持，完成后释放。无需柔顺标签、无需重训练、无需重新采集示教。

Result: 在拧瓶盖和推T型螺母沿T型槽抵抗非均匀摩擦两项真实任务上，六个阻力等级（其中两个未在示教中出现）评估：成功率从52%提升至90%；相同阻力下峰值偏轴力比统一刚性控制器减少61%。

Conclusion: 该残余增刚层以极低工程代价（无重训练、无额外数据、无传感器）将策略的运动预测与实现该运动所需的力权限解耦，显著提升高摩擦/受阻任务的成功率并降低偏轴力，为受阻抗限制的视觉运动策略提供了可插拔的增强方案。

Abstract: Manipulation tasks such as unscrewing a cap or sliding a part in contact with a surface require imposing force along a high-friction direction: the robot must overcome a resistance rather than yield to it. Generative visuomotor policies predict the motion for such tasks but not the authority needed to realize it, and that authority is bounded by the impedance controller beneath them: when the resistance exceeds what a compliant controller can exert under a bounded tracking error, the task is unattainable however accurate the prediction is. The required amount cannot be anticipated either, since it depends on a contact state the observation does not reveal. In this paper, we propose a residual stiffening layer placed underneath an unmodified policy. Resistance is recognized, without force sensing, from the mismatch between the motion the policy commands and the motion the robot realizes, and a four-mode supervisor raises the stiffness along a single direction read off the policy's own action chunk, retains it while the task progresses and releases it afterwards. The layer needs no compliance labels, no retraining and no re-collected demonstrations. On two real tasks, unscrewing a bottle cap and pushing a T-nut along a T-slot groove against non-homogeneous friction, evaluated at six resistance levels of which two were withheld from the demonstrations, the layer raises the success rate from 52% to 90% while producing 61% less peak off-axis force than a uniformly stiff controller at the same resistance.

</details>


### [1047] [CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18425)
*Huo, Jiaxi,Ricioppo, Petre,Lizzio, Fausto Francesco*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CALM：一种去中心化多无人机协同空中搬运控制器，用MAPPO训练的共享策略结合目标估计、扩张状态观测器、篮筐质量估计与前馈形成偏航补偿，跟踪移动地面机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机共同搬运共享载荷时，风扰、载荷运动与带噪目标广播使系统强耦合，传统模型方法难以兼顾鲁棒性与协同性。

Method: 参数共享MARL策略（MAPPO）+ 目标运动估计 + 每机ESO扰动观测 + 篮筐质量估计 + 预判式编队偏航前馈（利用估计目标运动提前旋转编队，降低篮筐偏航滞后且不增加净指令力）；训练用扰动条件化critic集中式，执行完全去中心化。

Result: 在留出轨迹上，平均位置/姿态误差低于所有基线，包括匹配机械臂基线（7.68 vs 10.95 cm，3.3 vs 4.7°）、缆索悬挂实现与两种模型法控制器；在全信息路径退化条件下与机械臂基线统计相当或更优。

Conclusion: 学习式去中心化控制与经典估计/前馈结合，可有效提升多机空中搬运在扰动与信息退化下的跟踪精度，提供真实系统验证。

Abstract: Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7$^\circ$), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at https://petreric.github.io/CALM/.

</details>


### [1048] [PACT: Posture-Aligned Co-Design Technique for Hand Configuration and Retargeting in Multi-Finger Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18443)
*Sasazaki, Koyo,Funabashi, Satoshi,Ponnivalavan, Pranav,Schmitz, Alexander,Ogata, Tetsuya,Sugano, Shigeki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACT通过联合优化17自由度灵巧手的机械参数与非线性姿态重定向器，使机器人手忠实复现人类抓取姿态，并完成实物制造与遥操作/模仿学习验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥操作演示的保真度取决于机械手能否忠实复现操作者姿态，但传统设计往往在硬件定型后才选择重定向律，且手部构型本身不贴合人类抓取姿态，导致人机对应误差大、抓取质量差。

Method: 以人类抓取姿态（DexYCB）为目标，联合优化17舵机手的连杆长度、关节偏移、安装角、基座位置与非线性姿态重定向器（线性人-机关节映射、逐关节姿态IK权重、阻尼）；约束条件包括舵机干涉、装配间隙与平展手掌外凸，保证可装配；强制全手指关键点（MCP/PIP/DIP/指尖）对应。据此制造PACT Hand并进行遥操作与模仿学习实验。

Result: 关键点运动学RMSE 3.9 mm（LEAP Hand基线12.8 mm）；所有抓取姿态指尖误差≤10 mm（基线仅21.6%姿态达标）；相同逐关节力矩限制下举升载荷2 kg vs 1 kg；纸杯变形为基线1/7，接近人手水平；YCB日常物体抓取成功率86% vs 64%；用PACT采集的演示训练模仿学习策略，在罐体抓放任务未见位置上达75%成功率。

Conclusion: 硬件参数与重定向器协同设计能显著提升人-机姿态保真度与抓取/操作性能，为高质量遥操作演示与模仿学习数据采集提供可行方案。

Abstract: The fidelity of teleoperated demonstrations used for imitation learning is determined by how faithfully a robot hand can replicate the operator's posture. The posture retargeting law that the robot will execute is typically selected only once the hardware has been finalized, and conventional hand designs often neglect human-like grasping postures. We introduce PACT, an optimization based on human grasping postures that jointly optimizes the mechanical parameters of a 17-servo robot hand (link lengths, joint offsets, mounting angles, and base placements) and its nonlinear posture retargeter (a linear human-to-robot joint map, per-joint posture-IK weights, and damping). The optimization enforces full-finger correspondence (MCP, PIP, DIP, and tip of each finger) to human poses from the DexYCB dataset, and is constrained by servo interference, assembly clearances, and flat-hand protrusion, so the resulting design can be physically assembled. We fabricate the PACT Hand and validate it through teleoperation experiments and an imitation-learning demonstration. The hand reproduces all human hand keypoints with a kinematic RMSE of 3.9 mm, compared to 12.8 mm for the LEAP Hand baseline, and keeps all fingertips within 10 mm on every grasping posture, while the baseline achieves this for only 21.6% of the poses. Under matched per-joint torque limits, it lifts twice the baseline payload, 2 kg against 1 kg, and deforms a held paper cup seven times less, reaching a deformation level comparable to a human hand. It also achieves an 86% grasping success rate on YCB daily objects, compared to 64% for the baseline. Finally, as a demonstration, an imitation-learning policy trained on demonstrations collected with the PACT Hand achieved a 75% success rate at held-out placements in a can pick-and-place task. Project page: https://pact-hand-2027.github.io

</details>


### [1049] [MemoryVLN: From Ego-Aware Memory Representation to Cross-Context Memory Reuse in Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18478)
*Wei, Xueyao,Wang, Yifei,Li, Delun,Wang, Shaoan,Yu, Junzhi,Song, Wenjie,Chen, Xingyu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MemoryVLN 提出以记忆构建与管理为核心的长时程视觉语言导航系统，通过长序列压缩、自我中心记忆表示、分层记忆库与记忆增强检索，在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上分别取得 2% 与 6.5% 的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在具身视觉语言导航（VLN）上潜力显著，但在长时程轨迹上性能退化，原因包括上下文长度限制、历史观测冗余以及跨时间空间对齐不稳定，导致长导航历史难以压缩、过去空间经验难以可靠复用。

Method: 1）记忆构建：Long Sequence Compression 采用遗忘曲线启发的时序采样，在有限 token 预算下保留密集近期证据与稀疏但有代表性的远期观测；Ego-Aware Memory Representation 融合 2D 语义 token、3D 几何 token 与 6D 智能体位姿，使每条记忆同时编码"看到了什么"与"在哪里看到"。2）记忆管理：Hierarchical Memory Bank 通过跨上下文热启动与置信度控制回写维护回合内与上下文级记忆；Memory Enhancement 依据当前导航状态检索 Top-K 相关记忆并与当前视觉 token 融合。

Result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上相较最先进基线取得一致的显著提升，成功率分别提高约 2% 与 6.5%。

Conclusion: 将原始导航历史转化为紧凑、空间接地、可选择性检索且可复用的导航经验，是缓解长时程 VLN 中上下文长度与空间对齐问题的有效途径；但方法验证局限于仿真基准，尚缺真实机器人部署与开源验证。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MemoryVLN}, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. During memory construction, \emph{Long Sequence Compression} employs forgetting-curve-inspired temporal sampling to preserve dense recent evidence and sparse yet representative distant observations under a limited token budget. \emph{Ego-Aware Memory Representation} further integrates 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses, allowing each memory to encode both what was observed and where it was observed. During memory management, \emph{Hierarchical Memory Bank} maintains in-episode and context-level memories through cross-context warm-start and confidence-controlled write-back. \emph{Memory Enhancement} then retrieves the Top-$K$ relevant memories according to the current navigation state and fuses them with the current visual tokens. Together, these mechanisms transform raw navigation history into compact, spatially grounded, selectively retrievable, and reusable navigation experience. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate consistent improvements over the state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin (i.e., 2\% and 6.5\% in successful rate).

</details>


### [1050] [RTISSLAM: In-air Imaging Sonar SLAM using a Robust Pose Graph and Occupancy Grid Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18479)
*Steckel, Jan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RTISSLAM: 面向嵌入式3D成像声呐的纯声呐SLAM系统，后端采用BatSLAM 2.0位姿图，地图为占据栅格；用DMAS+CFAR生成能量景图作地点描述子进行序列验证回环，声学里程计在线标定轮式里程计，重访处度量配准，栅格按关键帧存储并锚定到图节点随回环更新。仿真办公室中轨迹误差由8.2 m降至0.31 m，而激光式栅格SLAM在同一声呐数据上失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中声呐在黑暗、烟雾、粉尘及玻璃附近仍可工作，是相机与激光雷达失效时的补充传感器；但经典声呐SLAM依赖几何特征或稀疏量测占据栅格，难以应对室内声呐主导的镜面反射，需要一种鲁棒的纯声呐建图与定位方案。

Method: 以BatSLAM 2.0位姿图为后端、占据栅格为地图；延时乘加(DMAS)波束形成配合逐距离CFAR生成能量景图(energyscape)作为地点描述子，经序列验证得到回环；声学里程计在线标定轮式里程计；重访经度量配准；栅格按关键帧存储并锚定位姿图节点，随每次回环整体更新。

Result: 在含镜面墙壁的仿真世界中，RTISSLAM将办公室场景轨迹误差从轮式里程计的8.2 m降至0.31 m；同一声呐数据下，激光式栅格SLAM建图失败。

Conclusion: RTISSLAM证明纯声呐SLAM在镜面反射主导的室内环境中可行，能量景图地点描述子与位姿图-栅格锚定机制带来显著精度提升；但结论目前仅限仿真，缺乏真实机器人验证与开源。

Abstract: Sonar was one of the first sensors with which mobile robots built maps, and in-air sonar keeps working where cameras and lidar fail, in darkness, smoke, dust and next to glass. Classical sonar SLAM, however, relied on geometric features or occupancy grids built from sparse range readings, and both struggle with the specular reflections that dominate indoor sonar. In this letter, we introduce RTISSLAM, a novel sonar-only SLAM system for an embedded 3D imaging sonar, which combines the robust pose graph of BatSLAM 2.0 as back-end with an occupancy grid as map. Energyscapes from delay-multiply-and-sum beamforming with a range-wise CFAR serve as place descriptors for sequence-verified loop closures, acoustic odometry calibrates the wheel odometry online, recognized revisits are registered metrically, and the grid is stored per keyframe and anchored to the pose-graph nodes, so that it follows every loop closure. In simulated worlds with specular walls, RTISSLAM reduces the trajectory error of the wheel odometry from \SI{8.2}{\meter} to \SI{0.31}{\meter} in an office, while lidar-style grid SLAM on the same sonar data fails.

</details>


### [1051] [APTree: Extended Behavior Trees for Adaptive and Scalable Automated Robotic Task Planning in Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18523)
*Sherkat, Shermin,Wortmann, Thomas,Wortmann, Andreas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出APTree模型驱动框架，用行为树作为执行模型，在运行时协调多种符号规划器自动生成并组合模块化任务计划，配合DSL及执行引擎，并在livMatS仿生壳体真实建造场景验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离场建筑预制中的机器人任务规划主要依赖人工，效率低且阻碍机器人方案推广；现有方法难以支持可扩展、模块化的自动任务规划与运行时局部重规划。

Method: 以行为树作为执行模型的模型驱动框架APTree，运行时反复调用并协调异构符号规划器，实现模块化任务计划的自动生成与组合；配套设计用于任务计划形式化规约与验证的领域特定语言（DSL）及兼容执行引擎。

Result: 在真实livMatS仿生壳体展亭上建模建筑机器人制造领域，可在设计期与运行时检测注入的规约与规划错误，并通过协调三种符号规划器在多个规划模块上自动生成大规模任务计划；机器检验的形式化分析表明，在规划器可靠性与生成计划非干扰等显式假设下，组合执行与局部重规划是安全的。

Conclusion: APTree使建筑从业者无需深入了解符号规划技术或框架内部实现，即可使用自动化任务规划，为可靠计划组合提供显式条件。

Abstract: Task planning for robots in off-site construction prefabrication is primarily manual, leading to planning inefficiencies and reluctance to adopt robotic solutions. Existing approaches provide limited support for scalable, modular automated task planning and localized runtime replanning. This paper proposes APTree, a model-driven framework that integrates automated task planning with modular task execution using behavior trees as the execution model. APTree repeatedly applies and coordinates heterogeneous symbolic planners to automatically generate and compose modular task plans at runtime. To support this approach, we develop a domain-specific language for the formal specification and validation of task plans, together with a compatible execution engine. We evaluate APTree on the real-world livMatS Biomimetic Shell pavilion, where it models the construction robotic fabrication domain, detects injected specification and planning errors at design time and runtime, and automatically generates large-scale task plans by coordinating three symbolic planners across numerous planning modules. A machine-checked formal analysis further shows that composed execution and local replanning are safe under explicitly stated assumptions, including planner soundness and non-interference of generated plans, providing practitioners with explicit conditions for dependable plan composition. APTree thus enables construction practitioners to leverage automated task planning without requiring detailed knowledge of symbolic planning techniques or APTree's internal implementation.

</details>


### [1052] [Behavioural self-monitoring for autonomous earth observation agents: The attribute reliability monitor (ARM)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18548)
*Mousist, Alejandro D.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出属性可靠性监视器ARM，在时间维度累积怀疑证据以评估单个语义属性，采用黑盒外部行为监测，无需模型内部状态，实现属性的选择性暂停。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统中的语言与视觉语言模型在工况变化时语义输出可靠性下降，且无法访问内部状态或参考答案，需要仅凭外部可观测响应判断何时怀疑输出。

Method: ARM框架：累积时间上的怀疑证据评估单个语义属性；支持不同检测器与时间监测方法，干预策略交由消费系统；初版实现基于为卫星热红外影像定制的视觉语言模型，纯黑盒监测，仅用可观测响应，不依赖内部状态、置信度或参考真值。

Result: 在受控输入退化下，回答之间的不一致为属性的选择性暂停提供证据，展示了外部行为监测可支撑模型输出的持续使用，并区分操作层面的怀疑与语义正确性。

Conclusion: 黑盒外部行为监测可作为一种通用机制，为模型输出的继续使用提供依据，但需区分运营怀疑与语义正确，干预策略仍由下游系统决定。

Abstract: Language and vision language models can support autonomous systems, but changing operating conditions may compromise the reliability of their semantic outputs. This work introduces the Attribute Reliability Monitor (ARM), a framework that accumulates evidence of suspicion over time to assess individual semantic attributes. ARM accommodates different detectors and temporal monitoring methods, while leaving intervention policies to the consuming system. An initial implementation was evaluated using a specialized vision language model developed for satellite thermal infrared imagery. Monitoring followed a black box approach, using only observable responses without access to internal model states, confidence scores, or external reference answers. Under controlled input degradation, disagreement between responses provided evidence for selective suspension of attributes. The results illustrate how external behavioral monitoring can inform continued use of model outputs, while distinguishing operational suspicion from semantic correctness.

</details>


### [1053] [WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18568)
*Wang, Haomin,Ji, Anqiong,Wang, Ke,Liu, Zhongshan,Ying, Ru,Zheng, Ran,Zhang, Zhipeng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WAVE-0 通过轻量级潜空间世界模型将预训练 VLA 与未来预测连接，用反事实排序目标训练，无需像素重建或大规模视频预训练，在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 系列及真机上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略虽具备通用操作能力，但生成动作时未显式建模环境后果；已有的世界动作模型（WAM）多依赖昂贵的视频生成，潜空间方法或仅把预测未来作为辅助目标，或需要从次优视觉转移中通过大规模视频预训练推断潜动作，代价高。

Method: WAVE-0 在预训练 VLA 之上引入 257M 的轻量潜世界模型：将 VLM 生成的潜动作计划翻译为预测的未来表示，用以条件化动作专家，统一潜规划、未来预测与动作生成；世界模型直接以真值机器人动作训练，采用反事实排序目标，无需像素重建与大规模视频预训练。

Result: RoboTwin 2.0 成功率 91.47%，LIBERO 98.7%，LIBERO-Plus/Pro/Para 分别为 88.0%、61.4%、75.0%；真机任务将 π0.5 成功率从 38.3% 提升到 73.3%。

Conclusion: 通过让预期动作后果直接指导动作生成，WAVE-0 以低成本潜世界模型显著增强操作性能与跨分布偏移泛化能力，验证了 VLA 与 WAM 融合的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies excel at generalist robotic manipulation but generate actions without explicitly modeling their environmental consequences. World action models (WAMs) incorporate future prediction, yet most rely on costly video generation, while latent alternatives either use predicted futures only as auxiliary targets or infer latent actions from suboptimal visual transitions through costly large-scale video pretraining. We introduce WAVE-0 (World-model-Augmented VLA Execution), a framework that bridges VLAs and WAMs through a lightweight latent world model. By connecting the semantic understanding of pretrained VLAs with explicit future prediction, WAVE-0 allows anticipated action consequences to directly guide action generation. Built on a pretrained VLA, its 257M world model translates VLM-generated latent action plans into predicted future representations that condition the action expert, unifying latent planning, future prediction, and action generation. The world model is trained directly on ground-truth robot actions with a counterfactual ranking objective, requiring neither pixel reconstruction nor large-scale video pretraining. WAVE-0 achieves success rates of 91.47% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 98.7% on LIBERO, along with 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively. On real-world tasks, it improves the success rate of $\pi_{0.5}$ from 38.3% to 73.3%. These results demonstrate strong manipulation performance and generalization across diverse distribution shifts.

</details>


### [1054] [ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18596)
*Kim, Changyeon,Lee, Kimin,Narang, Yashraj,Guo, Yijie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ACCRUE，一种持续离线策略强化学习框架，通过在任务间继承轻量 actor 与 critic 网络实现机器人基础模型的高效持续学习与近零遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人基础模型经 RL 后训练可超越示教性能，但实际部署需同时满足两点：高效学习新任务、且不遗忘已有技能。现有持续 RL 方法或依赖 on-policy 更新导致前向迁移有限，或采用 off-policy 但只关注单任务样本效率，未解决跨任务的学习器持续性（learner persistence）问题。

Method: ACCRUE 在任务间携带轻量 actor 和 critic 网络：继承的 critic 仅在当前任务转移数据上适配并指导当前任务 actor 学习；先前行为通过对缓存目标做 actor 蒸馏、仅保留少量回放片段来保持；采用固定视觉特征以维持继承学习器与回放缓冲对基础策略更新的兼容性。

Result: 在仿真与真实机器人硬件上的接触密集型装配序列中，ACCRUE 加速后续任务学习，遗忘接近零，并将真实机器人训练时间缩短 31.0%–68.5%。

Conclusion: 跨任务继承 off-policy 学习器并配合蒸馏式回放，可同时实现前向迁移与抗遗忘，为机器人基础模型的持续强化学习提供实用方案，并在真实硬件上验证了显著效率收益。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

</details>


### [1055] [Grid or Nodes? Probing Object Memory in World Models Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18637)
*McMillen, Justin,Yilmaz, Yasin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FloWM（基于空间特征网格的学习式世界模型）与oracle馈送的Kalman节点记忆在FloWM积木世界中对比：网格记忆在视野外检索、对角运动与快速运动上均显著劣于显式节点记忆，显示学习式世界模型的空间记忆存在结构性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型必须记住离开视野的物体。学习式世界模型FloWM以空间特征网格+五个内置速度位移来隐式保持物体，而节点记忆以数值方式显式表示位置与速度。论文旨在检验这类隐式网格记忆与显式状态记忆在视野外物体跟踪上的差异与局限。

Method: 在FloWM自带的block world中对比两种记忆：FloWM网格（单一单元探针 vs 自带探针读取）与节点记忆（采用oracle馈送的Kalman tracker）。评估视野内/外检索率、内存占用、对角运动、超出五速度集的运动、更快速度及微调后的表现。

Result: 单单元探针仅找到66%视野外积木，FloWM自带探针达89%；FloWM视野内高8分（无输入帧，归因于预测回写）。视野外tracker以14KB达FloWM（5.6MB）水平且无需探针。对角运动下FloWM微调后仅11%，而tracker保持93%；更快积木两者都失效，增加一个允许速度使tracker达94%，而FloWM需25份网格副本才能等价。

Conclusion: 显式节点记忆在视野外检索、外推运动与内存效率上远超隐式网格世界模型，但仍需学习型节点记忆替代oracle，并处理噪声、长时间遮挡与反弹。

Abstract: A robot's world model must remember objects that leave the camera's view. FloWM, a learned world model, keeps them in a spatial grid of features that it moves with five built-in velocities. A node memory instead keeps each object's position and velocity as numbers. We compare them in FloWM's own block world, with an oracle-fed Kalman tracker as the node memory. How the grid is read changes its score: a single-cell probe finds 66% of out-of-view blocks, while FloWM's own probe 89%. FloWM also scores 8 points higher in view although no frame is shown, which we attribute to its write-back of its own predictions. Out of view, the tracker reaches FloWM's range in 14KB against 5.6MB, with no probe. On diagonal motion, outside its five velocities, FloWM finds 11% of blocks even after fine-tuning, while the unchanged tracker keeps 93%. Faster blocks defeat both until one more allowed speed takes the tracker to 94%, where FloWM's built-in shifts would need 25 copies of its grid. A learned node memory must still replace the oracles and handle velocity under noise, long gaps, and the bounce.

</details>


### [1056] [ForkCast: Predictive Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Policies via Counterfactual Futures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18650)
*Wen, Chenru,Zeng, Huajian,Ding, Haokai,Kang, Jian,Duan, Anqing,Zhou, Dawei,Song, Dezhen,Zuo, Xingxing*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForkCast：一种在冻结VLA策略上基于反事实未来预测的恢复框架，通过比较Commit/Reobserve/Replan三类候选的未来任务进度决定是否以及如何干预，无需失败检测器和阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在物体滑落或视觉遮挡下执行会被打断，现有恢复方式要么在训练中学得，要么依赖监控器检测失败后触发脚本化修复，缺乏统一的"是否干预+如何干预"的决策机制。

Method: 在每个决策点评估三个候选：执行名义动作块（Commit）、调整相机视角（Reobserve）、重规划机械臂轨迹（Replan）。用候选条件化的世界模型在同一未来时域预测各候选的潜在结果，并由共享的任务进度头打分；通过将策略自身延续与修复候选放在同一比较中，仅凭任务进度比较即可同时决定干预与否及方式，不更新VLA骨干。

Result: 在五个注入遮挡与物体滑落的RoboTwin 2.0仿真任务上，pooled成功率从冻结π0.5的13.3%提升到30.0%；无需更新ForkCast即可迁移到另外两个VLA骨干；在真机候选轨迹上适配后，在干净与受限可见性条件下均优于基策略。

Conclusion: 反事实未来比较可作为VLA策略的通用预测式恢复机制，兼顾"是否干预"与"如何干预"，且具备跨骨干与真机迁移能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform manipulation tasks using camera images and language instructions, but object slip or visual occlusion can disrupt execution. Recovery is typically learned during policy training or delegated to a monitor that triggers a scripted repair after detecting a failure. We introduce ForkCast, a predictive recovery framework that compares counterfactual futures to determine whether and how to intervene in a frozen VLA policy. At each decision point, ForkCast evaluates three candidates: executing the policy's nominal action chunk (Commit), adjusting the camera viewpoint (Reobserve), and replanning the arm trajectory (Replan). A candidate-conditioned world model forecasts the latent outcome of each candidate at a common future horizon, and a shared task-progress head scores the predicted outcomes. By evaluating the policy's own continuation alongside the repair candidates, a single comparison based on task progress determines both whether and how to intervene, without a failure detector, an intervention threshold, or updates to the VLA backbone. On five simulated RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with injected occlusion and object slip, ForkCast increases pooled success from 13.3% for the frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ policy to 30.0% and transfers to two additional VLA backbones without updating ForkCast. After adaptation on real-robot candidate rollouts, ForkCast also improves success over the base policy under both clean and visibility-limited conditions. Code will be released to benefit the research community.

</details>


### [1057] [Perception Beyond the Visible: Incompleteness-Aware Scene Understanding for Robot Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18670)
*Mohan, Rohit*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场/愿景型论文（research vision），提出"不完备感知的场景理解"（incompleteness-aware scene understanding）研究议程，围绕证据不完备、知识不完备、传感器可靠性不完备三大挑战，整合非模态感知、语义占据预测、开放世界理解、标签高效学习与不确定性引导多模态融合，并展望以信念为中心的4D场景表示与主动感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有感知系统通常只建模可见区域、使用固定语义类别、并假设传感器测量可靠；在遮挡、新物体出现、传感器退化等条件下这些假设失效，从而威胁机器人自主性的可靠性。作者因此需要一个系统性的研究框架来显式处理"不完备性"。

Method: 本文为研究愿景陈述，而非新的具体方法：作者将问题归纳为三类不完备（证据、知识、传感器可靠性），并回顾自身在amodal perception、语义占据预测、开放世界场景理解、标签高效学习、不确定性引导多模态融合方面的既有工作，据此提出向"信念中心4D场景表示"（联合建模几何、语义、运动与不确定性）发展的路线，以及主动感知与安全自适应策略。全文为概念组织与方向规划，未提供统一实验或定量验证。

Result: 无新增实验结果；结论性内容为对已有贡献的归纳与对未来方向的论证。所主张的目标产物是"校准良好且可付诸行动"的场景表示，以支撑动态开放世界中的可靠自主性。

Conclusion: 该愿景为具身感知提供了一个有价值的组织框架（三类不完备 + 信念中心表示 + 主动降不确定），方向上与开放世界、不确定性感知、多模态融合高度契合；但作为愿景型论文，缺少可复现方法细节、定量证据与开源实现，实用价值取决于其具体子工作。

Abstract: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.

</details>


### [1058] [UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18697)
*Xu, Jingbo,Fang, Jianjie,Li, Zhuohang,Song, Zihao,Wang, Zhaolu,Liu, Xvyuan,Zhang, Xin,Su, Haisheng,Tang, Yinzhou,Gao, Chen,Wu, Wei,Li, Yong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: UniW(A)M 用扩散 Transformer 上的混合专家架构统一世界模型与世界-动作模型，共享动力学专家并复用原子能力专家，配合自适应接口路由器 PAIR 按执行片段选择 WAM 接口，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与三个真机任务上取得 88.3% 平均真机成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型（预测未来）与世界-动作模型（生成可执行动作）虽从具身轨迹中学到共享的物理动力学与交互语义，却通常被孤立训练，导致预测与控制之间无法复用知识。核心挑战是在共享动力学的同时保留各范式所需的差异化建模能力。

Method: 提出 UniW(A)M：基于扩散 Transformer 的世界-（动作）混合专家模型。共享专家捕获通用动力学，原子能力专家跨接口复用，同时每个接口保留自身的条件通路；部署时引入插件式自适应接口路由器 PAIR，仅用少量目标任务片段场景学习，为每个执行片段选择合适的 WAM 接口，在冻结骨干的前提下平衡任务成功率与执行效率。

Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和三个真机操作任务上评估：真机平均成功率 88.3%，最强基线为 76.7%；在 WorldArena 上三个任务的动作条件世界建模均领先；AC-WM 协同训练对所有动作接口的动作生成均有增益；PAIR 将 OOD 成功率从 63.3% 提升至 76.7%。

Conclusion: 统一的世界-（动作）模型框架可在共享物理动力学与保留各接口专属条件建模之间取得平衡，协同训练双向受益，自适应接口路由显著提升分布外泛化成功率。

Abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

</details>


### [1059] [RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18699)
*Deng, Yunfu,Shin, Sangwoo,Pavse, Brahma S.,Hanna, Josiah P.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RoboFQE，用拟合 Q 评估（FQE）结合预训练视觉基础模型与学习到的终端成功标注，从离线轨迹离线评估机器人策略，无需行为策略密度估计，在长时程视觉操作任务上优于视频世界模型评估器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器人策略评估依赖真实执行、仿真器或学习型世界模型生成新轨迹（rollout），基础设施成本高；仿真与世界模型评估还存在预测误差随评估时域累积的问题。作者因此探索用 off-policy evaluation（OPE）替代 rollout 式评估，并弥合标准 OPE 基准与连续控制视觉操作任务之间的差距。

Method: RoboFQE：在离线机器人轨迹上估计目标策略的折扣期望回报。核心是 fitted Q-evaluation 配合预训练视觉基础模型（视觉编码器）作为状态表征，并引入学习到的终端成功标注（terminal success annotation）来替代真值奖励标签；不需估计行为策略密度。在仿真与真实操作任务上做受控实验，并做消融（预训练编码器 vs 从零训练、学习式成功标注 vs 真值奖励）。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务上，RoboFQE 给出准确的折扣回报估计并保持策略排序；在视频世界模型评估器因自回归预测误差而退化的长时程操作任务上仍表现良好。消融显示：预训练视觉编码器显著优于从零训练方案，长时程任务上优势尤其明显；学习式终端成功标注可在无真值奖励标签条件下评估，精度仅轻微下降。

Conclusion: OPE（具体为 FQE + 视觉基础模型 + 学习式成功标注）可作为 rollout 式机器人策略评估的可扩展替代方案，减少对仿真器/世界模型及真值奖励的依赖，并在长时程视觉操作上更稳健。

Abstract: Evaluating robot policies before deployment typically requires producing new trajectories through real-world execution, simulators, or learned world models. These rollout-based approaches impose infrastructure requirements; simulator and world-model evaluators additionally face prediction errors that can compound over the evaluation horizon. In this paper, we study off-policy evaluation as an alternative to rollout-based robot-policy evaluation methods. Specifically, we introduce RoboFQE, an evaluator that estimates the discounted expected return of a target policy from offline robot trajectories without estimating a behavior-policy density, combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model and learned terminal success annotation to bridge the gap between standard OPE benchmarks and continuous-control visual manipulation. Controlled experiments across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoboFQE produces accurate discounted-return estimates and preserves policy rankings even on long-horizon manipulation tasks where video world-model evaluators are degraded by autoregressive prediction errors. Ablation experiments show that pretrained vision encoders substantially outperform from-scratch alternatives, particularly on long-horizon tasks, and that learned terminal success annotation enables evaluation without ground-truth reward labels with only slight reduction of accuracy.

</details>


### [1060] [Steertuning Policies from a Few Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18711)
*Yan, Billy,Tu, Isaac,Lee, Kelly,Chang, Blake,Ma, Kenny,Patel, Kanad,Kabra, Dhawal,Patel, Neer,Wu, Kevin,Pinto, Lerrel,Guzey, Irmak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Steertuning 系统：用 100 小时第一人称人类交互数据预训练 400M 扩散策略，结合 5 次新任务演示、2 分钟微调与基于最近邻演示的动作引导采样，在 12 个新环境 12 个任务上达到 71% 成功率，全流程不到 5 分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习通常依赖大量机器人演示才能获得鲁棒、可适应的策略，部署到新任务、新环境时数据成本极高。论文希望用人类第一人称数据替代/减少机器人演示，实现极少样本、极短时间内的新任务适配。

Method: (1) 在自建 100 小时密集标注、随机交互的第一人称人类数据集上预训练 400M 参数扩散策略，提升背景鲁棒性与空间/物体泛化；(2) 给定 5 次新任务演示，仅微调 2 分钟（2000 次更新），并在反向采样过程中用观测最接近部署环境的演示进行动作 steer（引导）；(3) 设计面向跨本体迁移的数据处理管线。

Result: 在 12 个新环境、12 个任务（从实验室到新家厨房）上取得 71% 成功率；从新任务数据采集到机器人策略部署全流程少于 5 分钟；将公开数据集、模型权重、代码与机器人视频。

Conclusion: 人类第一人称交互预训练 + 少量演示微调 + 演示引导采样的组合，可在极低数据与时间成本下实现跨环境、跨任务的机器人策略快速适配，为少样本真实机器人学习提供可行路径。

Abstract: Current recipes for robot learning require massive amounts of robot demonstrations to obtain robust and adaptive policies. In this work, we introduce Steertuning, a system that enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from 5 human demonstrations in under 5 Steertuning consists of two parts. (1) We pretrain a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on our egocentric human dataset, which consists of 100 hours of densely annotated random interactions. This pretraining makes Steertuning robust to background differences and enables spatial and object generalization when deployed on new tasks. (2) Given 5 demonstrations of a new task, we finetune our model for only 2 minutes (2000 training updates) and steer the policy's actions during reverse sampling using the demonstration whose observation is closest to that of the deployment environment. Together with a carefully designed data processing pipeline for embodiment transfer, this enables Steertuning to achieve a 71% success rate across 12 tasks in 12 new environments, ranging from lab settings to kitchens in new homes. The entire process, from data collection for a new task to robot policy deployment, takes less than 5 minutes. Our full dataset, model weights, codebase, and robot videos will be made available at our website: https://steertuning.github.io.

</details>


### [1061] [GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18774)
*Sidorov, Gennady,Kornilov, Valerii,Grankin, Denis,Fedotova, Polina,Postnikov, Aleksey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GreenWAM 是一个机器人世界基础模型，统一"世界预测"与"策略"两种角色：定义覆盖 20 个机器人本体的共享解剖动作空间，在视觉、动作条件、世界-动作三种模式下联合训练，并将动作专家从生成器中拆分用于策略。在 WorldArena 1.0 上取得顶级轨迹/深度/3D 精度，进入 RoboTwin 2.0 榜单前列，零样本 LIBERO-plus 成功率最高，并在真实人形机器人上优于 π0.5 与 Cosmos 3 Edge 适配策略，可蒸馏为单步策略实现实时控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人模型通常只针对"世界预测"或"策略"单一角色构建与评估，且各机器人以自有格式记录动作，导致模型无法跨本体复用。本文追问：单一世界模型能否同时承担两种角色并跨不同躯体迁移，其关键要素是什么。

Method: (1) 共享解剖动作空间：用统一关节坐标描述 20 个机器人家族（从双臂到灵巧人形）；(2) 在这些家族上以视觉、动作条件、世界-动作三种模式联合训练；(3) 策略侧将动作专家（action expert）从生成器中拆分。并进一步蒸馏为单步策略以支持实时控制，另做受控实验。

Result: 作为世界模型，在 WorldArena 1.0 上轨迹、深度、3D 精度达到顶级，优于所有对比的世界-动作模型与视频生成器；作为策略，进入 RoboTwin 2.0 榜单前列，在 LIBERO-plus 零样本成功率最高，在 CALVIN 与 LIBERO 上与专用 VLA、世界-动作策略相当。适配真实人形机器人后成功率高于由 π0.5 与 Cosmos 3 Edge 适配的策略。受控实验三点结论：机器人专门化同时提升世界预测与控制；动作专家在适配初期拆分更有利；策略适配中保留世界模型模式可保持对场景变化的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 统一的世界基础模型可同时充当世界模型与策略，跨本体共享动作空间与多模式联合训练是实现该统一的关键；该模型在多项基准与真实人形上显示竞争力，并可通过蒸馏获得实时单步策略。

Abstract: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $\pi_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.

</details>


### [1062] [EqC: Equilibrium Energy Control for Introspective Lifelong Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18790)
*Yang, Haodong,Huang, Runhan,Zhang, Bowen,Lei, Iofai,Zhang, Zunzhe,Zhang, Xiangcheng,Zhu, Shaoting,Mou, Linzhan,Liu, Yicheng,Zhao, Hang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC) 框架，用条件能量景观把生成式动作精炼建模为寻优过程，以能量一致性作为"能力边界"自省信号，驱动 Energy-Gated DAgger 触发专家接管并聚合恢复轨迹；已集成进 Diffusion Transformer 与 flow-matching VLA 策略，在仿真与真实双臂操作上性能相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期自主不仅依赖有效的动作生成，还需要策略能识别自身行为何时不再被充分支持，并主动借助外部帮助改进。现有生成式策略（扩散/flow-matching）缺乏对自身"能力边界"的显式度量，导致难以判断何时需要干预。

Method: 构建显式条件能量景观，将生成式动作精炼视为平衡态寻优；精炼轨迹的几何特性反映生成行为与所学景观的一致性，得到 competence 信号；据此设计 Energy-Gated DAgger：持续的能量一致性违规触发专家接管，恢复轨迹被聚合用于后续策略更新。方法可自然嵌入 Diffusion Transformer 策略与 flow-matching VLA 策略。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界双臂操作任务中，EqC 的控制性能与鲁棒性达到或优于基线，并能在策略能力边界附近及时触发干预；真实世界研究显示干预使系统可自主处理的情境范围逐步扩展。

Conclusion: EqC 提供了一条从静态生成式控制器走向自改进机器人系统的实用路径：以能量一致性为自省信号，将专家干预有选择地引入并转化为持续学习数据。

Abstract: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.

</details>


### [1063] [SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18792)
*Wang, Xinyi,Li, Bangzheng,Wang, Hanyu,Zhang, Lin,Cui, Andrea Yaoyun,Tang, Zhenggang,Buch, Shyamal,Xu, Dejia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SEAR（Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics）框架与基准，让前沿语言模型代理通过写控制代码、实时控制或自动微调 VLA 模型三种模式自主改进机器人，并在 7 个模型、330 个仿真任务与 5 个真实任务上系统区分"真正学习"与"反复尝试"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作宣称语言模型代理能自我进化机器人，但无法区分代理是真正保留并迁移了学习成果，还是仅仅通过更多次尝试、更大预算、特权状态或运气取得了表面提升；也缺乏对新任务、新仿真器和真实机器人的迁移验证。
