Method: SEAR 框架支持三种代理模式：code-as-policy（写代码作为策略）、agent-as-policy（在控制回路中实时行动）、auto-research（作为研究者微调 VLA 模型）。配套基准引入对照条件，将保留经验与重复尝试、熟悉任务、仿真器特权状态、更大预算和运气分离；在 7 个前沿语言模型、330 个仿真任务和 5 个物理任务、累计超四年代理运行时间上进行评测。

Result: 三点发现：(1) 机器人代理的学习曲线同时取决于总时间预算与任务相对模型能力的难度，难任务值得长会话，简单任务用短尝试重掷即可；(2) 控制代码与共享例程可跨任务和仿真器迁移，任务特定解法不能，真机上代理自主练习与人类设计新场景间存在性能差距；(3) 不同模型进化方式不同，有的擅实时行动，有的擅先写代码，纯文本模型可与同等多模态模型持平，说明代理推理与工具使用比感知更关键。基准与代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了区分真实学习与表面提升的受控评测范式，揭示自我进化机器人代理的能力边界、迁移性与模型差异，并开源基准与代码以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

</details>


### [1064] [EgoMatrix: Physically Faithful Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Egocentric Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18822)
*Wang, Ziheng,Shao, Yanming,Mao, Ting,Chen, Kaihan,Wang, Yiqun,Wu, Xuanye,Mu, Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EgoMatrix 是一个端到端数据引擎，将单目第一人称人类视频转换为可直接在真实机器人上回放的双臂灵巧操作轨迹及配对的机器人观测视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人遥操作采集灵巧操作数据难以规模化，第一人称人类视频是潜在替代来源，但存在两大瓶颈：(1) 单目 RGB 下手-物交互（HOI）重建不准确；(2) 难以获得高质量、视觉上可信的机器人演示观测，导致人类视频无法作为可靠训练数据。

Method: 方法分三步：(1) 重建 HOI，重点保证相对几何与接触关系而非精确度量级场景恢复；(2) 通过重定向（retargeting）与强化学习（RL）在仿真中复现演示任务，并联合渲染机器手与物体，生成与状态/控制记录同步的物理一致观测；(3) 在多样且任务兼容的背景中渲染同一轨迹以扩充配对训练数据，同时保持机器人与物体的运动与接触不变。整体为端到端 monocular egocentric video → 双臂轨迹 + 配对机器人观测视频 的流水线。

Result: 在 TACO、OakInk2 及自采数据上，仿真端到端成功率 54.84%，最强基线仅 14.52%；重建在两个公开基准的多数指标上达到 SOTA；定性结果显示手-物交互比此前方法更真实；特征空间分析表明其观测比 GPT-6 Astra 更接近真实机器人观测。

Conclusion: EgoMatrix 通过"相对几何+接触优先"的 HOI 重建、仿真中 RL 重定向复现、以及可换背景的联合渲染，把第一人称人类视频转化为可回放、可训练的双臂灵巧操作数据，为 VLA/机器人学习提供可扩展的数据增强管线。

Abstract: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation data. However, two challenges limit their use as reliable training data: accurate hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB and high-quality robot demonstrations, especially visual observations. We present EgoMatrix, an end-to-end data engine that converts monocular egocentric human videos into bimanual dexterous trajectories and paired robot observation videos, with the trajectories directly replayable on real robots. It reconstructs HOI with emphasis on relative geometry and contact rather than exact metric scene recovery, then uses retargeting and reinforcement learning (RL) to reproduce the demonstrated tasks in simulation. We jointly render robot hands and objects from these simulated trajectories to produce physically faithful observations synchronized with state and control records. Rendering the same trajectories in diverse, task-compatible backgrounds expands paired training data while preserving robot-object motion and contact. Across TACO, OakInk2, and self-collected data, EgoMatrix achieves 54.84% end-to-end success in simulation versus 14.52% for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction reaches state-of-the-art performance on most metrics of the two public benchmarks. Qualitative results show more faithful hand-object interactions than prior methods, while feature-space analysis shows closer alignment with real-robot observations than GPT-6 Astra. Our project page is available at https://spikew726.github.io/EgoMatrix/.

</details>


### [1065] [WorldOracle: Benchmarking Action-Conditioned World Models against Real-World Executions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18826)
*Duan, Haoyi,Chen, Liliang,Wang, Nan,Zhang, Yang,Lu, Yuhang,Chen, Xiaotong,Tseng, Wei-Cheng,Gao, Shenyuan,Li, Zhaoshuo,Jin, Jingyi,Jannaty, Pooya,Shah, Dhruv,Zhu, Yuke,Liu, Ming-Yu,Yao, Maoqing,Ren, Guanghui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WorldOracle 是一个针对动作条件世界模型 (ACWM) 的基准，通过与真实执行配对来评测预测 rollout 的物理后果与任务状态转移，覆盖四个维度并在七个代表性模型上揭示各自优势与失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型缺乏与真实世界执行直接对齐的系统性评测手段，难以判断预测 rollout 是否真正复现真实物理后果与任务状态转移，因此需要一个配对真实执行的基准。

Method: 构建 WorldOracle 基准：给定相同初始观测与低层动作序列，对比预测 rollout 与真实执行；从物理状态正确性、交互空间对齐、关键交互区域保真度、多视角动作一致性四个互补维度评测；整理覆盖不同交互动力学与具身形态的真实训练与评测套件，包含长时段多段情节及成功与失败执行。

Result: 在七个代表性 ACWM 上开展实验，揭示了各模型不同的优势与失效模式。

Conclusion: WorldOracle 为衡量与推进面向操作的动作条件世界建模提供了系统基础，并将公开数据集、评测代码与排行榜。

Abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We will release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard.

</details>


### [1066] [RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18835)
*Chen, Kaiyuan,Xie, Shuangyu,Yoo, Uksang,Zhu, Xinyue,Magner, Cael,Zhu, Alvin,Kim, Daehwa,Heiden, Eric,Coumans, Erwin,Macklin, Miles,Huang, Spencer,Goldberg, Ken*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RoboSimStudio (RSS)，一个基于 Newton 物理引擎的交互式仿真工具包，将求解器、接触模型与物理参数显式化并可编辑，支持人类与编码智能体快速搭建并迭代优化 Real2Sim 仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人与被操纵物体之间的接触力学、耦合接触动力学、形变、刚度与摩擦难以精确建模；现有仿真流程中求解器与接触模型多为默认隐式选择，用户难以依据观测行为调整物理参数以完成 Real2Sim。

Method: 基于开放 Newton 物理仿真系统实现 RSS，将求解器、接触模型及物理参数暴露为可编辑接口；开展三类实验：(1) 视觉评估引导的人工 Real2Sim，(2) 力反馈引导的人工 Real2Sim，(3) 智能体驱动的 Real2Sim2Real 闭环。

Result: 摘要未给出定量指标，仅报告三类实验流程（视觉评估、力反馈、agentic Real2Sim2Real）的实现与演示，提供代码、视频与项目网站。

Conclusion: 通过显式化并开放物理建模选择，RSS 让人类与智能体都能高效完成仿真构建与迭代精化，为接触丰富场景的 Real2Sim 提供可交互工具基础。

Abstract: It has been difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to quickly create and iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io

</details>


### [1067] [LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18843)
*Cui, Andrea Yaoyun,Wang, Hanyu,Wang, Xinyi,Li, Bangzheng,Zhang, Lin,Tang, Zhenggang,Buch, Shyamal,Xu, Dejia,Tancik, Matthew*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LIBERO-RIG 是一个只扰动机器人硬件与部署配置、保持 LIBERO 任务不变的鲁棒性基准，涵盖 11 类扰动轴 × 5 个严重度，共 210 个测试条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略评测几乎都固定机器人本体与相机配置，而实际部署中相机被撞动、标定漂移、控制频率变化、夹爪垫磨损等硬件扰动普遍存在，这类"机器人侧"泛化能力缺乏系统化度量。

Method: 在四个 LIBERO 任务套件上仅扰动机器人硬件与设置，设计 11 条扰动轴（相机安装与光学、相机-机械臂标定、执行增益、控制频率、本体感知噪声、基座位姿、桌面高度、夹爪垫等），每条 5 个严重度等级，共 210 个条件；对 9 个近期 VLA 模型在每个条件下评测 500 个 episode，并配以统计显著性检验；同时发布基准与逐 episode 固定扰动参数清单。

Result: 综合成功率从中等严重度的 0.932 降至 0.767，最高严重度降至 0.509；退化程度在不同扰动轴与动作接口间差异显著；仅用视觉扰动训练无法缓解那些不改变相机图像的故障（如执行增益、控制频率、标定漂移）。

Conclusion: 机器人侧硬件与配置扰动是 VLA 泛化的重要且独立的失效来源，与视觉域随机化不重叠；LIBERO-RIG 为该方向提供了标准化、可复现的评测协议。

Abstract: Robot policies are expected to generalize across deployment environments, including variations in the robot itself: cameras are bumped and remounted, calibrations drift, controllers run at different rates, and end-effector pads wear down. We present LIBERO-RIG, a benchmark that perturbs only the robot's hardware and setup while holding every LIBERO task fixed. The benchmark spans eleven perturbation axes, including camera mounting and optics, camera-to-arm calibration, actuation gain, control rate, proprioceptive noise, base pose, table height, and gripper pads. Each axis has five severity levels, yielding 210 conditions across the four LIBERO suites. We evaluate nine recent vision-language-action models using 500 episodes per condition and substantiate each finding with rigorous statistical tests. Pooled success falls from 0.932 to 0.767 at the middle severity and 0.509 at the highest severity. Performance degradation varies substantially across perturbation axes and action interfaces, and training on visual perturbations does not mitigate faults that leave camera images unchanged. We release the benchmark together with manifests specifying the fixed perturbation parameters for each episode.

</details>


### [1068] [Contact Trajectory Prompting: In-Context Transfer of Contact-Rich Behaviors from a Single Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18848)
*Nie, Xian,Zang, Yujie,Zheng, Yuhang,Zheng, Yupeng,Gu, Songen,Chen, Wendi,Wen, Chuan,Lu, Cewu,Ding, Wenchao,Yan, Junchi,Yan, Shuicheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP)，将单次演示中的运动与接触信息编码为有序接触轨迹提示，实现接触密集型操作行为的一次性迁移，真机擦洗/旋转/插入任务整体成功率 78.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文机器人学习可从演示中获取新行为而无需更新参数，但仅靠视觉与运动学信息无法区分"动作相似而交互强度或模式不同"的接触密集型行为，缺少对物理交互本身的行为规格。

Method: 将单条演示中的运动与接触信息编码为有序的接触轨迹提示（contact trajectory prompt），捕捉其时间演化；执行时策略利用在线感知反馈从提示中检索与交互相关的信息，以演示的接触行为为条件进行闭环动作生成。

Result: 在训练未见物体上的真机擦洗、旋转、插入任务中整体成功率 78.7%，较最强基线高 13.0 个百分点；仅更换参考演示即可遵循交互强度与方向的接触规格（如中间档擦洗力、顺/逆时针旋盖）。

Conclusion: 接触轨迹可作为有效的行为规格，将上下文机器人学习从运动模仿扩展到物理交互迁移。

Abstract: In-context robot learning enables robots to acquire new behaviors from demonstrations without test-time parameter updates. However, visual and kinematic specifications alone may not distinguish contact-rich behaviors that share similar motions but require different interaction intensities or patterns. We propose Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP), a framework for one-shot transfer of contact-rich manipulation behaviors. CTP encodes motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered contact trajectory prompt that captures their temporal evolution and specifies the desired physical interaction behavior. During execution, the policy uses online sensory feedback to retrieve interaction-relevant information from the prompt, conditioning closed-loop action generation on the demonstrated contact behavior. Across real-world wiping, rotation, and insertion tasks on objects excluded from training, CTP achieves 78.7% overall success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 13.0 percentage points. Changing only the reference demonstration enables CTP to follow contact specifications for both intensity and direction, including an intermediate wiping force level and clockwise or counterclockwise cap rotation. These results demonstrate that contact trajectories serve as effective behavioral specifications, extending in-context robot learning beyond motion imitation to physical interaction transfer. Project website: https://ctp-robotics.github.io/project_page.

</details>


### [1069] [Collaborative Planning for UAV-UGV Teams under Operational Constraints via Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18850)
*Deng, Zihao,Li, Qianhuang,Wigness, Maggie,Rogers, John,Kim, Donghyun,Zhang, Hao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MEND 将 UAV-UGV 协同规划建模为条件掩码生成过程，用神经符号扩散在推理时以逻辑诱导的可采纳性指标重加权动作分布，并以误差有界的熵最小化调度确定解掩顺序，在仿真、真实地图与实机机器人队伍上验证了受限协同规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV 覆盖快但受机载能量限制，UGV 可作移动充电站却受路网通行性约束；二者协同需要在执行中满足操作约束并支持并行协调动作。现有掩码扩散模型（MDM）存在两点不足：熵引导调度假设分布对齐，且扩散时优化依赖可微约束，难以直接施加硬性运行约束。

Method: 提出 Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion (MEND)：把协同规划表述为条件掩码生成过程以产生上下文感知的 UAV-UGV 动作序列；引入神经符号扩散范式，在执行阶段用逻辑诱导的可采纳性指示量对学习到的动作分布重加权，从而强制满足操作约束；并提出误差有界推理调度，基于约束感知动作分布选择预测熵最小的位置来构造解掩顺序。

Result: 在仿真环境、真实世界地图以及实体机器人团队上的大量实验表明，MEND 在满足操作约束的同时提升了 UAV-UGV 协同规划效果。

Conclusion: 在执行期将符号逻辑约束注入掩码扩散策略，并以误差有界熵调度引导解掩，是兼顾约束合规性与协同规划最优性的可行路径，且具备实机可迁移性。

Abstract: Collaborative planning under operational constraints is essential for heterogeneous robot teams in large-scale missions. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) provide rapid area coverage but are limited by onboard energy, while Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) can serve as mobile recharging stations yet are constrained by road-network traversability. Effective collaboration must enforce operational constraints during execution while enabling parallel, coordinated actions. Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have shown promise through token unmasking but have two key limitations: entropy-guided scheduling assumes distributional alignment and reliance on differentiable constraints for diffusion-time optimization. We propose Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion (MEND), which formulates collaborative planning as a conditional masked generative process to generate context-aware action sequences for UAV-UGV teams. MEND introduces a neuro-symbolic diffusion paradigm that constrains conditional masked diffusion policies at execution by reweighting the learned action distribution with a logic-induced admissibility indicator, thereby enforcing compliance with operational constraints. MEND introduces an error-bounded inference scheduling at execution that constructs the unmasking schedule by selecting positions with minimal predictive entropy over the constraint-aware action distribution, enhancing collaborative planning optimality under operational constraints. Extensive experimental results in simulation, on real-world maps, and with physical robot teams demonstrate that MEND advances UAV-UGV collaborative planning under operational constraints.

</details>


### [1070] [ForceWAM: Decoupling Future and Response Learning from Demo and Play Data for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18852)
*Xu, Zijun,Chen, Wendi,Wang, Xinkai,Zou, Jiachen,Chen, Hongjin,Liu, Hairuo,Lin, Bokai,Ma, Shihao,Ma, Ke,Zhang, Zhiwei,Yan, Zhuohao,Wu, Ke,Song, Haoming,Li, Xueqi,Wen, Chuan,Zhao, Jieru,Ding, Wenchao,Lu, Cewu,Yang, Lixin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForceWAM 是一种力世界行动模型，将"任务兼容的交互结果预测"（世界模型：联合预测未来视频与六轴力/力矩轨迹）与"局部动作如何改变接触"（逆动力学模型 IDM，从任务数据与无目标 play 数据中学习）解耦。部署时 IDM 将世界模型生成的未来轨迹实时映射为动作，并在世界模型更新之间复用新力反馈。真机力调节滑动、有无扰动的翻箱、套环任务达 85–95% 平均成功率，加入 play 数据带来 15–45 个百分点提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务演示数据能说明如何完成接触密集任务，但对"交互力如何随不同动作变化"的覆盖有限；而与任务无关的 play 数据虽提供了更广的接触动力学经验，却缺少任务目标。本文动机在于同时利用这两类数据：用演示学习任务层面的运动-接触演化，用 play 补足力响应知识。

Method: ForceWAM 将知识解耦为两部分。(1) 力世界模型：仅从成功演示中学习，联合预测未来视频与六轴力/力矩轨迹，刻画任务中运动与接触的期望演化。(2) 逆动力学模型 IDM：同时从任务数据与 play 数据学习，将当前观测与记录的视觉-力旋量未来映射为机器人动作，从而把 play 的力响应知识注入目标导向执行。部署时 IDM 反应式地将生成未来转化为动作，并在两次世界模型更新之间结合新力反馈重复使用。

Result: 在真机力调节滑动、有/无扰动的翻箱、套环三类任务上，ForceWAM 取得 85–95% 平均成功率，超过世界模型类与反应式基线。消融显示加入任务无关 play 数据使成功率提升 15–45 个百分点。项目页与代码：https://force-wam.github.io/。

Conclusion: 通过学习"任务结果预测"与"力响应-动作映射"的解耦，并融合演示与 play 数据，ForceWAM 显著提升接触密集任务的执行鲁棒性与成功率，证明任务无关 play 数据对学习接触丰富执行具有重要价值。

Abstract: Expert demonstrations show how to complete contact-rich tasks, but provide limited coverage of how interaction forces respond to different actions. Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. To fully leverage these two types of data, we introduce ForceWAM, a force world action model that decouples knowledge of task-compatible interaction outcomes from knowledge of how local actions change contact. A world model learns from successful demonstrations to jointly predict future video and six-axis force/torque trajectories. Together, these futures describe the expected evolution of motion and contact during the task. A separate inverse dynamics model (IDM) learns from both task and play, mapping current observations and recorded visual-wrench futures to their associated robot actions. Play data thus provide knowledge of force responses for goal-directed execution. At deployment, the IDM reactively translates generated futures into actions, reusing them with fresh wrench feedback between world-model updates. Across real-robot force-regulated sliding, box flipping with and without disturbances, and ring placement, ForceWAM achieves $85$-$95\%$ mean success, surpassing world-modeling and reactive baselines. Our experiments further show that adding task-agnostic play data improves success by $15$-$45$ percentage points, demonstrating its value for learning contact-rich execution. Project page and code are available at https://force-wam.github.io/.

</details>


### [1071] [Interaction Latents as Actions for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18855)
*Zheng, Yuhang,Zang, Yujie,Liu, Yuchen,Zheng, Yupeng,Jiang, Zhennan,Xing, Zebin,Tian, Shuai,Gu, Songen,Guo, Jingxiang,Gao, Chen,Xia, Zhongpu,Yan, Shuicheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ILA（Interaction Latents as Actions），将运动、接触与施力演化联合编码为可解码的交互潜动作单元，作为动作生成、评估与离线改进的共享表示，在四类真实任务上平均成功率提升21.0–36.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富操作中，机器人不仅要决定"往哪动"，还要决定"接触与力如何演化"。但现有策略多把动作表示为运动轨迹，触觉仅作为输入或辅助预测目标，未在动作表示中显式编码接触动力学，导致接触演化信息在动作空间中缺失，也缺乏可复用的统一表示支撑评估与离线改进。

Method: 用时间条件隐式解码器，通过视觉条件下的联合动作-触觉重建学习可解码交互潜变量；将其作为流匹配生成目标，用于预训练VLA与世界动作模型（WAM）的后训练，以及从零训练流匹配策略；共享解码器将潜变量映射为可执行动作。离线改进阶段，从专家演示编码潜变量训练触觉条件专家参考模型，构造专家一致性奖励引导成功轨迹的加权学习，并用观测兼容的专家参考修正失败轨迹中的低奖励预测。

Result: 在三类策略家族上，ILA相对触觉条件直接动作基线在四个真实任务上的平均成功率提升21.0–36.5个百分点；消融显示在动作目标中编码接触演化优于仅做触觉条件化，且同一潜空间可支撑专家引导的离线改进。

Conclusion: 把接触动力学显式编码进动作表示（而非仅作条件输入）能实质提升接触丰富操作性能，并让生成、评估与离线改进共享同一潜空间，为触觉操作策略提供统一动作抽象。

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to coordinate not only where to move, but also how contact and force should evolve throughout an interaction. Yet most robot policies represent actions primarily as motion trajectories, using tactile signals as inputs or auxiliary prediction targets without explicitly encoding contact dynamics in the action representation. We propose ILA (Interaction Latents as Actions), which uses decodable interaction latents that jointly capture the evolution of motion, contact, and force application as policy action units, providing a shared representation for action generation, evaluation, and offline improvement. We learn these latents through visually conditioned joint action-tactile reconstruction with a time-conditioned implicit decoder. Using them as flow-matching generation targets supports post-training of pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs), as well as training flow-matching policies from scratch. A shared decoder maps generated latents to executable actions. For offline improvement, we learn a tactile-conditioned expert reference model from interaction latents encoded from expert demonstrations. The resulting expert-consistency rewards guide weighted learning from successful rollouts, while observation-compatible expert references guide correction of low-reward predictions from failed rollouts. Across three policy families, ILA improves success rates averaged over four real-world tasks by 21.0-36.5 percentage points relative to tactile-conditioned direct-action baselines. Ablations highlight the benefit of encoding contact evolution in action targets beyond tactile conditioning, while the same latent space supports expert-guided offline improvement. Project website: https://mrsecant.github.io/ILA/.

</details>


### [1072] [AutoAgent0: An Agentic Runtime for Safe Closed-Loop Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18866)
*Liu, Jiageng,Zhao, Seth Z.,Zhou, Zewei,Huerta, Alejandro,Bayer-Calvert, Aidan,Bao, Yuxin,Lin, Haotian,Spataru, Robert,Cui, Zijun,Hong, Yining,Zhou, Bolei,Ma, Jiaqi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将闭环自动驾驶安全建模为测试时执行问题，提出 AutoAgent0：一个智能体式运行时与测试框架，通过互补检测技能、规则化轨迹验证与反馈驱动的恢复规划，在不重训练底层策略的前提下提升多专家的闭环鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶策略虽进展迅速，但闭环执行中误差会累积，尤其在未见场景下会将车辆推入同一策略难以恢复的状态。作者认为瓶颈不在于单帧规划精度，而在于闭环执行的可靠性与恢复能力，因此将闭环驾驶安全重构为"测试时执行"问题。

Method: 提出 AutoAgent0 智能体运行时框架，包装现有驾驶专家：1) 独立检测模块用互补感知技能构建场景上下文，缓解感知误差；2) 规则化验证器基于该上下文在执行前校验候选轨迹；3) 当标称轨迹不可靠时，编排器触发 Recovery Planning，由智能体循环从动作原语构造备选方案，并用验证反馈迭代精化。整体为"独立场景评估 + 可行性检查 + 在线恢复"的组合设计。

Result: 在 Fail2Drive 与 NavSafe-∞ 两个基准上，长尾与安全关键场景中的闭环鲁棒性优于单专家执行。结果表明运行时监督可在不重训练底层策略的情况下提升多个驾驶专家的闭环鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 运行时监督与智能体式恢复是提升闭环驾驶安全的有效且策略无关的路径，可与多种现有驾驶专家组合，避免重训练成本。局限在于验证规则与动作原语的覆盖度，以及未展示真实车辆部署证据。

Abstract: Safe autonomous driving requires more than accurate planning at a single frame: it demands reliable closed-loop execution in dynamic environments. Although end-to-end driving policies have advanced rapidly, the accumulated closed-loop errors, especially in unseen scenarios, can push vehicles into states from which the same policy struggles to recover. We address the challenge by treating closed-loop driving safety as a test-time execution problem. We introduce AutoAgent0, an agentic runtime and harness framework that augments existing driving experts with complementary detection skills, rule-based action verification, and feedback-driven recovery. To address inaccurate scene perception, an independent detection module constructs scene context using complementary perception skills, and a rule-based verifier checks proposed trajectories against this context before execution. When the nominal trajectories are unreliable, the orchestrator of the runtime activates Recovery Planning, where an agentic loop constructs alternative action proposals from action primitives and iteratively refines them using verification feedback. This design combines independent scene assessment with feasibility checks and online recovery, addressing both perception errors and the limited recovery capabilities of individual experts. Evaluations on Fail2Drive and NavSafe-$\infty$ demonstrate improved closed-loop robustness over single-expert execution in long-tail and safety-critical scenarios. These results demonstrate that runtime supervision can improve closed-loop robustness across multiple driving experts without retraining the underlying policies.

</details>


### [1073] [EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18867)
*Li, Wenyi,Chi, Yizhe,Zheng, Youjie,Liu, Chunyu,Wang, Xiaoqiu,Gao, Mingju,Jiang, Zheng,Hong, Deyao,Xiao, Calvin,Yang, Kaisen,Na, Qinhuai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出自进化编码智能体 EmbodiedEvo，通过将物理反馈蒸馏为可复用的代码技能与诊断经验，实现跨场景经验迁移，在 RoboDojo-Sim 上超越所有官方验证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体可借助程序化机器人接口在单场景内闭环自适应，但该适应过程消耗大量交互与推理预算，且新智能体无法复用旧经验，导致跨场景经验无法保留，学习效率低下。

Method: 对智能体轨迹进行分析，发现预算主要消耗在建立有效操作与识别其前置条件上；据此设计 EmbodiedEvo，在单个 Playground 场景中完成任务时将物理反馈蒸馏为可复用代码 Skills 与诊断性 Lessons，随后冻结经验供未见场景中的独立智能体复用，且不更新模型权重。

Result: 在 RoboDojo-Sim 上平均得分 44.48、成功率 37.82%，超过所有官方验证结果；配对比显示记忆依赖任务提升最大，协调流程成功复用，但精细接触控制仍困难；强模型经验可提升弱执行器（Astra 经验使 Sol、Luna 成功率分别提高 8.86 与 5.50 个百分点）；相比原始交互历史，Skills 与 Lessons 在性能相当情况下执行成本降低 53.0%。

Conclusion: 经验蒸馏与冻结复用可有效提升编码智能体的跨场景具身控制表现并显著降低执行成本，验证了无权重更新条件下的经验迁移可行性，但精细接触控制仍是待解难点。

Abstract: Coding agents can construct executable programs and revise them through feedback, offering a foundation for embodied control without target-task fine-tuning. Through a programmatic robot interface, the agent observes the scene, executes control programs, and adapts them to the resulting physical state, serving as the closed-loop policy. However, this within-episode adaptation does not automatically preserve experience across scenes. Our trajectory analysis shows that agents spend interaction and inference budgets establishing effective operations and identifying their preconditions, while fresh agents cannot reuse these discoveries. This motivates EmbodiedEvo, a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons. Experience is acquired on one Playground scene per task, then frozen for independent agents in unseen scenes, without updating model weights. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.

</details>


### [1074] [What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18869)
*Yan, Mingxuan,Gong, Litian,Huang, Dihong,Li, Zhixu,Zhang, Tianyu,Zhang, Wenqian,Jiang, Hefeifei,Li, Peihao,Zhang, Jian,Zhao, Mengfei,Tang, Yikai,Zhai, Hai,Wang, Zehao,Liang, Ruijian,Huang, Yanjia,Shao, Lin,Liu, Changliu,Hang, Kaiyu,Fan, Zhiwen,Tomizuka, Masayoshi,Yang, Jianfei,Li, Jiachen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了VLA预训练中演示质量的三种使用方式（加权、过滤、条件化），基于AXIS-Bench的5000条自然次优人类演示与24个目标任务，发现"approach-aware回合条件化"优于普通行为克隆，并给出标签粒度与质量标签使用的设计建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA预训练常用大量人类演示，但演示质量参差不齐（自然次优）。已有工作不清楚在预训练中该如何利用演示质量信息：是加权、过滤还是条件化？标签应在回合级还是片段级？质量标签在微调与推理时是否有用？缺乏受控比较与可复现基准。

Method: 构建AXIS-Bench：基于众包仿真演示，记录物体与接触状态，可在同一轨迹上重算多种质量标签（不同奖励定义、不同标签粒度）；轨迹可回放，支持工作区对齐渲染与自定义真实世界目标任务。在此基准上对三种VLA，在匹配演示与训练预算下，对比加权/过滤/条件化、不同奖励定义与标签粒度，并考察预训练数据规模、质量标签在微调与推理阶段的作用。

Result: 跨三个VLA：approach-aware回合条件化在平均成功率上优于普通行为克隆；条件化偏好回合级标签，过滤偏好chunk级标签，且存在模型依赖的反转；在条件化预训练后，恒定标签微调能提升平均成功率，且推理阶段用带标签或不带标签均可。真实世界实验中，仿真预训练将成功率从9.6%提升至31.7%（+22.1个百分点）。

Conclusion: 演示质量应通过条件化（尤其approach-aware、回合级）而非简单加权来利用；质量标签在微调阶段比推理阶段更关键且更稳健；AXIS-Bench为受控比较与真实世界迁移提供了可复现工具。属于VLA演示增强与数据质量方向的实证性工作，但真实世界证据规模有限（单一实验、相较仿真对比偏少）。

Abstract: How should demonstration quality be used during vision-language-action (VLA) pretraining to improve performance after target-task fine-tuning? We compare weighting, filtering, and conditioning across reward definitions and label granularities using 5,000 naturally suboptimal human demonstrations and 24 target tasks. Within each VLA, we match demonstrations and training budgets. Additional comparisons examine pretraining data size and the roles of quality tags during fine-tuning and inference. Across three VLAs, we find that approach-aware episode conditioning improves mean success over plain behavioral cloning; conditioning and filtering favor episode and chunk labels, respectively, on average, with model-dependent reversals; and constant-tag fine-tuning improves mean success after conditioned pretraining with either tagged or untagged inference. We introduce AXIS-Bench to support these controlled comparisons. Built on crowdsourced simulation demonstrations, it provides recorded object and contact states for recomputing quality labels on shared trajectories. Replayable trajectories support workspace-aligned rendering and user-defined real-world target tasks. In our real-world experiment, simulation pretraining raises success from 9.6\% to 31.7\%. Project page: https://axis-bench.github.io/.

</details>


### [1075] [EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18872)
*Zhou, Yunsong,Jiang, Xuekun,Shen, Haiqi,Liu, Hangxu,Shi, Chaojian,Liu, Yujie,Li, Jingyuan,Yang, Haoran,Cao, Jiafei,Zhou, Dongzhan,Wang, Dong,Mu, Yao,Shen, Chunhua,Zhang, Weinan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可穿戴系统与Calibrate-Complete-Constrain管线，构建100小时自我中心视觉-运动-触觉人体loco-manipulation数据集EgoExplorer，实现全身运动、手指关节与触觉的联合重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集仅提供运动、姿态与物体交互的局部视图，缺乏跨环境可扩展的轻量级采集方案，难以支撑人形loco-manipulation从人类演示中学习。

Method: 可穿戴采集系统 + Calibrate-Complete-Constrain管线：先用可复用标定固定人体几何与传感器安装关系以解耦安装偏移与关节运动；再以时序先验补全未观测关节运动；最后通过分层约束保证测量一致性、时序连续性与几何一致性。

Result: 相对最强基线，人体点误差降低71.9%；手部稳定性与接触估计匹配评测均有提升；并初步探索多模态生成、条件控制与人形重定向全身控制仿真。

Conclusion: 稀疏身体传感下可实现全身运动、手指articulation与触觉的高质量联合观测，为人类演示驱动的人形loco-manipulation提供数据与重定向基础。

Abstract: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.

</details>


### [1076] [LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18873)
*Guo, Wenxuan,Liang, Yingping,Wang, Zhaoguo,Li, Ziyuan,Ma, Angyuan,Wu, Zhenyu,Wang, Chengkun,Yu, Bingyao,Chen, Ze,Zhang, Borui,Xu, Xiuwei,Zhang, Meng,Zhou, Erjin,Lu, Jiwen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LoopWAM 提出闭环 world-action model，用自身与其它部署策略的混合质量 rollout 联合学习行为与动作条件世界建模，通过来源相关噪声采样、质量引导与质量加权监督实现闭环自我改进，在 RoboChallenge Table30-V2、RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365 及折衣任务上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠扩大专家示范无法让通用机器人策略在部署中持续变强。真实 rollout 同时包含成功、次优与失败：全量模仿会强化劣质行为，而过滤失败又会丢弃物理交互及其后果的证据，因此需要一种能直接利用全质量谱经验的闭环学习范式。

Method: LoopWAM 将视频与动作 token 在并行去噪过程中全程交互，使学到的后果直接指导动作生成。核心设计包括：来源相关噪声采样（source-dependent noise sampling）统一行为学习与动作条件世界建模；质量引导（quality steering）与质量加权监督（quality-weighted supervision）在保留全质量视频监督的同时调节动作模仿强度；训练数据来自模型自身及其他已部署策略的 rollout。

Result: RoboChallenge Table30-V2 上三轮部署-训练迭代将成功率从 23.67% 提升至 43.33%（+19.7pp），最终得分 56.80；无需额外具身预训练即在 RoboTwin 2.0 取得 94.5% 平均成功率、RoboCasa365 取得 49.5% 总体成功率，三基准综合最优；单任务后训练的折衣任务上两轮部署驱动改进将成功率从 13.20% 提升至 55.56%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，混合质量经验可在多任务学习与单任务后训练两种设定下支持闭环持续改进，为部署驱动的通用机器人策略提升提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce LoopWAM, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67% to 43.33%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 49.5% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20% to 55.56%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. Project page: https://loop-wam.github.io/

</details>


### [1077] [ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18874)
*Xu, Bingxin,Bao, Wenrui,Liu, Xinxin,Zhou, Jiawei,Shang, Yuzhang,Ferrara, Emilio*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ChunkAct 将 action chunking 引入 LLM-agentic robotics：在线一次 LLM 调用启动由记忆编译出的原语链式 chunk 并自主执行，仅失败时交还控制权；离线将记忆编译为 chunk，使测试时执行无需记忆。LLM 计算量随"决策数"而非"原语数"增长。LIBERO-Pro 上成功率提升 5.0 点，LLM 调用减少 2.9 倍、输入 token 减少 4.4 倍、输出 token 减少 2.3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 置于机器人控制回路中，通过记忆编排感知、运动与 VLA 工具，可免重训泛化到新任务，但效率代价高：每个原语都需基于完整交互历史做一轮 LLM 推理，episode 成本随原语数量线性增长。作者观察到这种推理高度冗余——一旦子目标确定，其后续原语已由记忆规定的例行流程决定。

Method: 提出 ChunkAct，为 agentic robotics 引入 action chunking。在线阶段：单次 LLM 调用启动一串链式原语 chunk，chunk 自主执行，仅在失败时返回控制权。离线阶段：将记忆编译成这些 chunk，使测试时执行为 memory-free，规划器只保留给真正需要推理的决策，从而将 LLM 计算量与决策数而非原语数绑定。

Result: 在 LIBERO-Pro 上，相较 agentic robotics 的 SOTA，任务成功率提升 5.0 点，同时 LLM 调用减少 2.9 倍、输入 token 减少 4.4 倍、输出 token 减少 2.3 倍。

Conclusion: 通过把冗余的逐步推理压缩为可自主执行的 action chunk，ChunkAct 在保持 agentic 泛化能力的同时显著降低 LLM 推理开销，说明 agentic 机器人中"按决策而非按原语"分配 LLM 计算是可行且有效的方向。

Abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.

</details>


### [1078] [$\lambda_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18950)
*humanoid Team*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HumanVerse（500小时开放世界人类全身移动操作数据集，同步自我中心视频+身体与手部运动）与human-to-humanoid数据对齐/在线精修流水线，并据此训练人形基础模型λ0，在Unitree G1上实现零样本全身移动操作迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人的全身移动操作需要与环境进行协调的全身交互，但机器人示范数据采集成本高昂。人类示范（如自我中心视频）虽可规模化，却普遍缺失下身移动与姿态信息，且存在具身差异与控制器动力学不匹配，导致末端执行器精度不足，难以直接用于人形机器人学习。

Method: 1）构建HumanVerse数据集：500小时开放世界人类移动操作数据，自我中心视角视频与同步全身/手部运动配对；2）human-to-humanoid流水线：对齐相机视角与手臂外观，离线精修运动参考与控制器输入，在保持全身协调的同时降低末端执行器误差；3）以机器人对齐的人类示范作mid-training监督，训练全身移动操作人形基础模型λ0。

Result: 在Unitree G1上实现零样本迁移，无需目标任务机器人示范，覆盖代表性全身操作与长距离移动操作任务；SIMPLE基准成功率90.0%，真实世界移动操作任务跨任务平均成功率62.5%；增加全身人类数据可持续提升下游任务进展。

Conclusion: 高质量、机器人对齐的全身人类示范数据可规模化支撑人形基础模型训练，为更丰富的物理世界交互提供可行路径，并为后续全身人类数据采集与humanoid foundation model研究提供指导。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop $\lambda_0$, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. $\lambda_0$ achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/

</details>


### [1079] [Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18991)
*Fey, Nolan,Nguyen, Khai,Prabhu, Yash,Margolis, Gabriel B.,Agrawal, Pulkit*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Contact-UAN：一种残差世界模型，在保留仿真器物理先验的同时校正执行器动力学，通过接触一致的仿真回放解决人形机器人力交互的sim-to-real差距，仅用6.5分钟真实数据即实现力矩、力跟踪与鲁棒跳跃的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真训练的人形策略虽能定性迁移到硬件，但力学交互难以迁移，根源在于执行器力矩相关的sim-to-real差距，导致力矩效率、负载调节与抗冲击鲁棒性下降。

Method: 提出Contact-UAN残差世界模型：保留仿真器物理先验，仅校正执行器动力学以对齐仿真与真实rollout；提出接触一致回放，避免残差模型把重置artifact当成执行器误差来学；仅用本体感知推断仿真侧支撑足位姿，使回放以一致接触力初始化。

Result: 仅用6.5分钟真实行走数据训练的UAN可泛化到需要精确力/冲量调节的任务：奔跑力矩降低20%，力跟踪误差降低43%，实现极限柔顺、准确阻抗控制与动态鲁棒跳跃，策略无缝迁移真机。

Conclusion: 接触一致的可微残差建模是弥合执行器层面sim-to-real差距的有效途径，且以极少真实数据即可支撑强力学交互的人形locomotion。

Abstract: Humanoid policies trained in simulation can transfer qualitatively to hardware while failing to transfer the force interactions learned during training, compromising torque efficiency, load regulation, and robustness to impacts. This failure can arise from actuator sim-to-real gaps because forces depend on actuator torques. We introduce Contact-UAN, a residual world model that preserves a simulator's physics priors while correcting actuator dynamics to align simulated rollouts with recorded hardware rollouts. For humanoid motion with contact, this requires contact-consistent replay: if hardware playback in simulation begins with misaligned contact wrenches, the residual model learns to correct reset artifacts rather than actuator discrepancies. Using only onboard proprioception, Contact-UAN infers the simulator-side stance-foot pose needed to initialize replay with consistent contact forces. We show that a UAN trained on 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data generalizes to tasks that benefit from accurate force and impulse regulation and produces policies that transfer seamlessly to the real world, yielding 20% lower running torque, 43% lower force-tracking error, extreme compliance, accurate impedance control, and dynamic, robust jumps.

</details>


### [1080] [RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19044)
*Rajyaguru, Naitri,Tajne, Aryan,Jardim, Stephen,Fermuller, Cornelia,Aloimonos, Yiannis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RingNav 是一种仅 10.6k 参数的视觉航向估计器，将记忆约束在圆流形 S¹ 上，只学习相邻帧间的转角并在圆上直接复合航向，在 TartanAir 挑战上显著降低转角与累积航向误差，并可部署于 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 与 GAP8 等超低功耗平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微型机器人计算与内存受限，而现有视觉导航系统常维护超出任务需求的状态量。作者追问：持久记忆是否可以由任务本身塑形，从而用极小的状态空间完成航向估计。

Method: 提出 RingNav：10.6k 参数的视觉航向估计模型，将记忆显式约束在圆周流形 S¹ 上；网络不直接回归绝对航向，而是只学习相邻图像间的转角，航向通过对转角的圆上加和直接复合得到，从而获得结构化的状态更新。

Result: 在 TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge 上，相比同样规模的 learned-memory 基线，平均绝对转角误差降低 27%，4 秒累积航向误差降低 15%；相同帧转角严格为零，序列反转时更新精确抵消。无需微调即可迁移到真实无人机实验，在严重视觉退化下仍可持续估计航向；在 Raspberry Pi Zero 2W 上达 27.3Hz，在超低功耗 GAP8 处理器上达 33.4Hz。

Conclusion: 将记忆约束在任务相关的低维流形（S¹）上，可用极小参数量实现鲁棒、可迁移且满足严格几何一致性的航向估计，适合超低功耗边缘机器人部署。

Abstract: Tiny robots have limited computation and memory, yet visual navigation systems often maintain more state than a task requires. We ask whether persistent memory can instead be shaped by the task. We present \textbf{RingNav}, a \(10.6\)k--parameter visual heading estimator that constrains its memory to the circular manifold \(S^1\). RingNav learns only the turn between consecutive images, while heading is composed directly on the circle. On the TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge, RingNav reduces mean absolute turn error by \(27\%\) and accumulated heading error over $4$ sec by \(15\%\) relative to a similarly sized learned-memory model. The structured update also gives exactly zero turn for identical frames and exact cancellation under sequence reversal. Without fine-tuning, RingNav transfers to real-world drone experiments and continues estimating heading under severe visual degradation. RingNav runs at $27.3$Hz on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and can be deployed on an ultra-low power GAP8 processor at $33.4$Hz.

</details>


### [1081] [Tread: A Visuo-Inertial Framework for Terrain and Locomotion Context-Aware Gait-Phase and Speed Estimation in Wearable Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19067)
*Sarkar, Debadrata,Bachhar, Akash,Arora, Aman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个视觉-惯性框架，用胸部相机与四个下肢IMU构建因果流水线，统一估计地形、运动模式、步态相位与行走速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴辅助机器人需要连续估计地形、运动模式、步态相位与速度，但现有方法多为分离的、地形专用的模型，数据采集协议不统一，缺乏统一框架与共同协议下的数据集。

Method: 设计因果级联流水线：Anticipatory Terrain Perception (ATP) 对即将到来的地形进行分类并预测地形切换；Terrain-Aware Locomotion Mode Identification (TALMI) 用平地/楼梯专家模型识别运动模式，并将后验保留为 Probabilistic Locomotion Context (PLC) 向量；PLC 输入共享的 Gait Kinematic Encoder (GKE)，输出50 Hz双侧步态相位与2 Hz行走速度。所有惯性模型以传感器融合欧拉角而非原始加速度计/陀螺仪信号为输入，降低对IMU佩戴差异的依赖，并采用留一被试评估。

Result: ATP地形分类准确率96.3%，平均提前1.46 s预测地形切换；TALMI平地与楼梯专家准确率分别为93.7%和98.8%，平均切换延迟低于200 ms；步态相位RMSE在平地、上楼梯、下楼梯分别为1.75%、2.97%、4.55%，速度估计覆盖3.5-5.5 km/h，RMSE为0.218 km/h。

Conclusion: 该视觉-惯性因果流水线实现了地形预判、运动模式识别、步态相位与速度估计的一体化，并在留一被试协议下取得较高精度；欧拉角输入策略增强了跨佩戴条件的鲁棒性，可支撑辅助机器人的连续状态感知。

Abstract: A wearable assistive robot must continuously estimate terrain, locomotion mode, gait phase, and walking speed. These quantities are commonly addressed by separate, terrain-specific models, with datasets rarely collected under a common protocol. This paper presents a visuo-inertial framework that connects these estimates through a causal pipeline using a chest-mounted camera and four lower-limb inertial measurement units (IMUs). Anticipatory Terrain Perception (ATP) classifies incoming terrain with 96.3% accuracy and anticipates terrain transitions by 1.46 s on average. Terrain-Aware Locomotion Mode Identification (TALMI) achieves 93.7% and 98.8% accuracy for its level-ground and stairs experts respectively, with mean transition latencies being below 200 ms. The relevant TALMI posterior is retained as a Probabilistic Locomotion Context (PLC) vector and provided to a shared Gait Kinematic Encoder (GKE), which supports 50-Hz bilateral gait-phase estimation and 2-Hz walking-speed estimation. Leave-one-subject-out evaluation yields gait-phase RMSEs of 1.75%, 2.97%, and 4.55% for level walking, stair ascent, and stair descent respectively while estimating speed over 3.5-5.5 km/h with a RMSE of 0.218 km/h. All inertial sensing based models use sensor-fused Euler angles as input rather than raw accelerometer and gyroscope signals, reducing dependence on sensor mounting variation.

</details>


### [1082] [Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View Planning for Highly Occluded Target Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19082)
*Yildiz, Ayse Gul,Raja, Rekha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出退滚动时域下一最佳视角规划器RH-NBV，通过评估未来视角序列而非单步视角，在强遮挡下显著提升目标信息恢复，并在UR5e真机与仿真上验证优于单步NBV与随机搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被遮挡目标的主动感知中，单视角信息不完整，而传统局部NBV仅按即时效用选取视角，会忽略"当前信息少但能开启后续高信息视角"的候选，导致在重遮挡下陷入信息死角。

Method: 将局部目标感知建模为短时域序列视角规划问题；提出退滚动时域NBV规划器（RH-NBV），对候选的视角序列（而非孤立单视角）进行前瞻评估来选取下一视角。在UR5e机械臂+眼在手上RGB-D相机上，分别于仿真与真实机器人平台上，与基于梯度的NBV和随机搜索对比；对象包括受控遮挡的咖啡杯、Stanford bunny及具自然自遮挡的番茄植株，并做时域消融实验。

Result: 重遮挡下RH-NBV目标信息恢复大幅提升：最严重遮挡咖啡杯配置上ROI覆盖率达63.8%（单步NBV基线34.2%），遮挡表面召回率85.5%（基线7.4%）。受控时域消融表明增益来自多步推理而非额外算力；遮挡弱时，短视NBV仍具竞争力且代价明显更低。

Conclusion: 基于短时域序列评估的RH-NBV在强遮挡目标上收益最大，为主动目标感知提供了有效的多步视角规划方案，但其优势随可见性提升而收窄，需按遮挡程度权衡成本。

Abstract: Robotic systems that must acquire information about a specific target often face severe occlusion from sur- rounding structures or from the target itself, such that a single camera viewpoint provides only partial information. Active perception must therefore select viewpoints that progressively reveal unobserved regions. However, conventional local next- best-view (NBV) methods typically select viewpoints according to their immediate utility, which can overlook views that provide limited information initially but enable more informative obser- vations from subsequent viewpoints. We formulated local target perception as a short-horizon sequential view-planning problem and proposed a Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View (RH-NBV) planner that evaluates candidate sequences of future viewpoints rather than isolated views. RH-NBV is evaluated on a UR5e manipulator with an eye-in-hand RGB-D camera in simulation as well as on physical robot against a gradient-based NBV planner, and random search, using a coffee mug and Stanford bunny under controlled occlusion and a tomato plant with natural self-occlusion. Under heavy occlusion, RH-NBV achieves substantially higher target information recovery, reaching 63.8% ROI coverage versus 34.2% and 85.5% occluded-surface recall versus 7.4% for the single-step NBV baselines on the most occluded mug configuration. A controlled horizon ablation shows that this improvement arises from multi-step reasoning rather than additional computation. RH-NBV provides the greatest benefit for strongly occluded targets, while myopic NBV remains competitive and substantially cheaper when visibility is less constrained.

</details>


### [1083] [DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19089)
*Luo, Zhexi,Xu, Zhixuan,Yang, Rui,Xiao, Zeyu,Hou, Yiwen,Shao, Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexMimic：通过价值引导重置分配（Value-Guided Reset Allocation）联合训练跨轨迹的通用灵巧手-物体跟踪策略，并配套基准，验证了跟踪成功率、训练/微调效率、零样本泛化能力及真机部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人手-物体交互（HOI）数据集是获取灵巧操作技能的重要来源，但现有基于物理的方法多为单条轨迹训练专用策略，导致技能难以大规模复用，缺乏可泛化的通用跟踪策略。

Method: 提出 DexMimic 通用灵巧手-物体跟踪策略，跨多条 HOI 轨迹联合训练；核心为 Value-Guided Reset Allocation：在线自适应调整初始化分布，优先分配给训练不足（undertrained）的阶段，并选择具有更高期望跟踪回报的重置起始状态。同时构建覆盖训练、微调与泛化的基准。

Result: 实验显示跟踪成功率与训练效率提升、微调更快，并具备对未见轨迹与物体的零样本泛化潜力；更大训练集进一步提升效率与泛化性；并在真实灵巧操作平台上完成验证。

Conclusion: 将 HOI 轨迹跟踪从专用策略范式转向通用策略联合训练，价值引导的重置分配是关键机制，兼具仿真基准与真机证据，为规模化灵巧技能复用提供可行路径。

Abstract: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success and training efficiency, faster fine-tuning, and the potential for zero-shot generalization to unseen trajectories and objects; larger training sets further improve efficiency and generalization. Finally, we validate DexMimic on a real-world dexterous manipulation platform.

</details>


### [1084] [Benchmarking 3D Reconstruction for Under-Ice Robotic Perception in Arctic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19097)
*Orbán, Klára,Nedungadi, Ashwin,Kogălniceanu, Ana-Ştefania,Sava, Bianca-Marcela,Cieply, Bastian,Simon, Raul-Alexandru,Benţa, Kuderna-Iulian,Lüdtke, Stefan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个基于视觉的冰下三维重建基准，利用MOSAiC真实数据与Unreal引擎合成数据评估SfM与单目深度估计，并通过与上视多波束声呐的跨模态配准实现定量比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 北极海冰向季节性无冰状态转变，冰下海冰形态对海-冰-气热交换建模与冰下栖息地监测至关重要；现有多波束声呐虽能提供大尺度几何，却缺乏光谱与高分辨率纹理信息，难以刻画精细形态特征，而冰下视觉传感条件退化、视觉特征稀疏，亟需评估视觉方法在此环境下的可行性。

Method: 构建冰下视觉三维重建基准：数据包含MOSAiC考察的真实观测数据与基于Unreal Engine的水下机器人仿真器生成的合成数据；评估方法涵盖Structure-From-Motion与单目深度估计；采用与上视多波束声呐的跨模态配准实现定量比较与真值对齐。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，主要产出为真实+合成数据构成的数据集与评测协议，以及在跨模态配准框架下对SfM与单目深度估计方法的定量比较。

Conclusion: 该工作为冰下视觉三维重建建立了可复现的评测基准，为将视觉感知与声呐几何融合、提升冰下形态与光学属性刻画能力提供了基础，但方法层面的具体收益需在正文中验证。

Abstract: As the Arctic transitions toward a seasonally ice-free state, capturing the complex morphology of submerged sea ice is crucial for advancing models of ocean-ice-atmosphere heat exchange and monitoring under-ice habitats. Currently, sub-surface ice mapping is predominantly achieved through acoustic sensors such as multibeam sonar. While sonar provides robust large-scale geometry, it lacks spectral and high-resolution textural information required to record fine morphological features - a critical limitation in under-ice environments, where sparse visual features and degraded sensing conditions challenge the capture of detailed structural and optical surface properties. We present a benchmark for vision-based under-ice 3D reconstruction using real-world data from the MOSAiC expedition and synthetic data generated in an Unreal Engine-based underwater robotics simulator. The benchmark evaluates Structure-From-Motion (SfM) and monocular depth estimation, with quantitative comparison enabled through cross-modal registration to upward-looking multibeam sonar.

</details>


### [1085] [Learning in Orbit: Onboard Training and Closed-Loop Attitude Control with a Thermal Segmentation Model on a Spacecraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19122)
*Lupu, Elena Sorina,Grauer, Hannah,Leeds, Phaedrus,Ranganathan, Nikhil,Lee, Connor,Kishore, Sulekha,Smith, Cailyn,Cortes, Shon,Hardy, Brian,Bycroft, Benjamen,Rowen, Darren W.,Chung, Soon-Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在6U立方星上基于NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX实现热红外分割模型的在轨训练与推理，并用其输出闭环控制姿态跟踪月球，验证了LEO环境下商用硬件+开源软件支撑学习型自主航天管线的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深空任务受通信延迟与带宽限制，需航天器在轨自主运行；而学习型算法上星部署缺乏真实飞行验证，硬件算力与环境约束（辐射、功耗、热）下的可靠性证据不足。

Method: 硬件：6U CubeSat + NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX GPU。软件：ROS 2 Foxy作为数据传输中间件，集成具强数据完整性与自愈能力的开源文件系统。任务：(1)热分割模型在轨训练与推理；(2)以实时热像分割结果闭环控制姿态跟踪月球。历时约一年共12次在轨实验。

Result: 完成12次在轨实验，验证了在轨训练/推理与基于分割的闭环姿态控制可稳定运行；证明现代学习管线、商用现货硬件与开源软件能在LEO算力与环境约束下可靠工作。

Conclusion: 该飞行部署拓展了自主航天系统的最先进水平，为学习型算法上星提供了可复制的软硬件范式；对地面机器人/具身系统的空间极端约束部署亦有参考价值。

Abstract: Deep space missions increasingly require spacecraft capable of autonomously operating in environments with communication delays and bandwidth limitations. A key enabler of such autonomy is the ability to run learning-based algorithms directly onboard. In this work, we present a flight deployment on a 6U CubeSat that demonstrates (1) onboard training and inference of a thermal segmentation model on an NVIDIA Jetson TX2 NX GPU in space and (2) closed-loop attitude control using the segmentation model on a real-time, thermal image feed to track the Moon. In addition to this demonstration, we implement ROS 2 Foxy as a data transport middleware and integrate an open-source file system that provides strong data integrity guarantees and self-healing features. Over the course of approximately one year, we performed 12 experiments on the spacecraft, advancing the state of the art in autonomous spacecraft systems by showing how modern learning-based pipelines, commercially available hardware, and open-source software can operate reliably under the compute and environmental constraints of Low Earth Orbit (LEO).

</details>


### [1086] [Collective Learning for Unified Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Dynamics Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19141)
*Liu, Shaocheng,Meng, Yuan,Bing, Zhenshan,Knoll, Alois*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACE：两阶段集体学习框架，将共享任务空间意图与本体相关转移动态解耦，用离线轨迹预训练表示层加带预测动态适配器的决策层，在多样机器人状态式笛卡尔操作上避免性能崩溃，零样本仿真成功率89%，并在KUKA实机上验证sim-to-real可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多本体集体学习可聚合多机器人经验以发现共享任务结构，但当不同本体通过不同转移动态实现同一笛卡尔指令时，朴素聚合会平均掉不兼容的动作模式，导致策略歧义与在动态离群本体上的性能崩溃。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段表示层在离线轨迹上预训练，从集体数据中抽取任务级上下文；第二阶段决策层引入预测动态适配器，通过强制隐状态预测未来转移，将策略锚定在执动机器人的转移行为上，充当隐空间正则化器，同时保持实时推理、无需在线规划。

Result: 仿真本体评估显示方法防止了不同机器人上的性能崩溃：整体成功率超93%，动态分布外零样本仿真机器人上达89%，优于Transformer行为克隆（82%）与扩散策略基线（66%）；物理KUKA部署进一步验证了完整状态式流程在零样本sim-to-real迁移下的可行性。

Conclusion: 以"共享任务意图/本体相关动态"显式分离为核心的集体学习可有效缓解多本体策略歧义，仿真与实机结果支持其跨本体泛化能力。

Abstract: Learning a collective policy for state-based Cartesian manipulation across diverse robotic embodiments presents a fundamental challenge due to embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. Collective learning aggregates multi-robot experience to discover shared task structure, yet naive aggregation can average incompatible action modes when different embodiments realize the same Cartesian command through different transition behavior. This leads to strategy ambiguity and performance collapse on dynamically outlying embodiments. To address this, we propose PACE, a two-stage collective learning framework that separates shared task-space intent from embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. The first stage employs a representation layer pre-trained on offline trajectories to extract task-level context from collective data. The second stage introduces a decision layer equipped with a predictive dynamics adapter. By forcing the latent state to predict future transitions, this adapter acts as a latent regularizer that grounds the policy in the transition behavior of the executing robot while preserving real-time inference without online planning. Evaluations across simulated embodiments demonstrate that our method prevents performance collapse on distinct robots. It achieves over 93\% overall success and 89\% on dynamically out-of-distribution zero-shot simulated robots, outperforming the Transformer behavior cloning (82\%) and diffusion policy baselines (66\%). Physical KUKA deployment further validates the feasibility of the full state-based pipeline under zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [1087] [Post-Training, Finetuning, and Steering:A Field Guide for Curating Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19143)
*Attarian, Maria,Ruan, Yifan,Voelcker, Claas,Cao, Chenyang,Zhang, Amy,Stone, Peter,Rhinehart, Nicholas,Gilitschenski, Igor*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 系统研究VLA模型在新任务适配时，不同适配方法在on/off-policy、离线/在线、最优/次优数据场景下的表现差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型零样本跨任务迁移能力有限，需适配方法提升新任务表现，但已有大量适配方法，如何依据可用轨迹选择最优方法尚不明确，存在方法选择空白。

Method: 在LIBERO仿真套件与Franka真实平台上，对适配方法进行多维度对比评估：on-policy与off-policy数据、离线与在线适配、数据是否包含最优或次优轨迹。

Result: 离线场景中，有失败数据时critic-based steering优于监督微调；但用离线RL训练critic函数未能超越简单Monte-Carlo方法。在线场景中，critic-based steering采样效率显著高于policy-gradient微调，但性能上限低于完整微调。

Conclusion: 适配方法选择依赖数据场景，critic-based steering在离线有失败数据及在线采样效率上具优势，但性能上限受限，Monte-Carlo方法可作有效替代。

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action models have enabled impressive cross-task transfer in zero-shot settings, \emph{adaptation} methods are often necessary to achieve consistent performance on novel tasks. However, even though a wealth of methods for adaptation have been proposed, it is unclear how to choose the best method based on available trajectories. We close this gap by studying the impact of the adaptation method under a variety of common data scenarios: on- and off-policy data, offline vs online adaptation, and whether the data contains optimal or suboptimal trajectories. Our evaluation spans simulated tasks in the LIBERO suite and real tasks on a Franka platform. In the offline data regime, critic-based steering approaches outperform supervised finetuning when failure data is available. However, offline RL techniques for training critic functions fail to outperform simpler Monte-Carlo-based approaches. Finally, in the online setting, critic-based steering is significantly more sample efficient compared to policy-gradient-based finetuning methods, but has a lower performance ceiling than full finetuning.

</details>


### [1088] [FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19155)
*Cao, Zhi,Hong, Yining,Yang, Jiaolong,Choi, Yejin,Fei-Fei, Li,Wu, Jiajun,Huang, Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EgoForce大规模人类触觉数据集 + FACT机器人基础模型，采用“视觉规划→力觉精修”级联架构，在少量机器人数据微调下实现力感知灵巧操作，成功率较T-Rex最高提升60个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作需要预判与调节交互力，但人类演示数据虽可扩展、却普遍缺少力/触觉测量，导致人-机器人协同预训练难以力感知扩展。

Method: 1) 构建EgoForce大规模人类触觉数据集，捕捉富力信息操作经验，与机器人演示联合预训练；2) FACT基础模型分两级级联：Track-Guided Coarse Planner联合预测动作、未来视频与视觉轨迹，未来视频与轨迹作为共享任务表征促进跨本体知识迁移与粗动作生成；3) Force-Action Joint Refiner在粗规划基础上联合预测未来力并精修动作，使预期力与动作相互塑造。

Result: 在含工具使用、乐器演奏、精密实验流程等10项需细粒度协同与力反馈的任务上评测；仅用10条机器人轨迹与90条人类轨迹微调，FACT优于基线，较T-Rex成功率提升最高达60个百分点。消融显示人类预训练数据中的力监督对下游微调性能至关重要，视觉轨迹预测与未来力预测联合训练可提升灵巧执行；人机数据比例实验表明FACT从人类演示中学习的效果几乎与机器人演示相当。

Conclusion: 力感知的人类数据可有效替代昂贵的机器人数据采集，为力感知人-机器人协同预训练提供可扩展路径与力-动作互塑的灵巧操作建模框架。

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data collection for dexterous manipulation, but most human datasets lack force measurements. Dexterous manipulation requires not only visual and proprioceptive understanding but also the ability to anticipate and regulate interaction forces. To scale force-aware human-robot co-training, we introduce EgoForce, a large-scale human tactile dataset capturing force-rich manipulation experience, and combine it with robot demonstrations for pretraining. We present FACT, a robot foundation model that cascades from prospective visual planning to force-aware refinement for dexterous manipulation. FACT comprises two jointly trained components. A Track-Guided Coarse Planner jointly predicts actions, future video, and visual tracks. Future video and visual tracks also provide a shared task representation that facilitates cross-embodiment knowledge transfer and coarse action generation. Building on this coarse plan, a Force-Action Joint Refiner jointly predicts future force and refines the coarse action, allowing anticipated force and action to shape each other during refinement. We evaluate the model on ten tasks requiring fine-grained coordination and force feedback, including tool use, musical instruments, and precision laboratory procedures. Using as few as 10 robot trajectories with 90 human trajectories for fine-tuning, FACT outperforms both baselines, with success-rate gains of up to 60 percentage points over T-Rex. Ablations show that force supervision in human pretraining data is crucial for downstream robot performance after fine-tuning, while visual track prediction and training with future-force prediction improve dexterous execution. Experiments varying the human-robot data ratio during fine-tuning further suggest that FACT learns from human demonstrations nearly as effectively as from robot demonstrations.

</details>


### [1089] [A Mode-Unified, Continuous, and Biomimetic Control Strategy of a Robotic Lower Limb Prosthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19183)
*Kim, Hanjun,Zhou, Sixu,Shim, John,Guo, Xinyuan,Herrin, Kinsey R.,Young, Aaron J.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出模式统一的假肢控制器：以地形坡度和步态相位为连续变量，用RBF插值融合上/下坡分段多项式模型，生成连续坡度相关阻抗参数并嵌入单一FSM控制器，10名大腿截肢者实验验证了跨越平地、坡道与楼梯的连续地形自适应行走。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿生下肢假肢控制器多针对离散运动模式（平地、坡道、楼梯）分别设计并独立整定参数，模式切换与参数集切换繁琐，且难以覆盖训练数据中未出现的坡度/楼梯条件，缺乏在多种地形间连续、统一的生物力学参数化与控制架构。

Method: 将膝、踝生物力学表示为地形坡度与步态相位的连续函数；对上升与下降工况分别做局部多项式优化，再用径向基函数（RBF）插值统一，避免全局多项式精度损失；将统一生物力学模型转换为连续、坡度相关的阻抗参数；在单一有限状态机（FSM）控制器中实现，采用双侧传感进行步态状态估计；10名大腿截肢者参与实验评估。

Result: RBF统一模型保留分段模型精度并优于全局多项式表示。实验复现了统一模型预测的主要坡度相关生物力学趋势：膝关节相关指标一致性高（r² = 0.82–0.99），踝关节运动学 r² = 0.78–0.96；并成功泛化到训练用健全人数据中未包含的13°坡道与15°楼梯条件。

Conclusion: 统一的生物力学参数化可在无需为每种运动模式单独整定阻抗参数集的前提下，支撑跨多样地形的假肢控制架构，并保留健全人生物力学关键特征；方法具备向未见过坡度/楼梯条件的泛化能力。

Abstract: Existing biomimetic lower-limb prosthesis controllers are commonly designed for discrete locomotion modes, requiring separate parameterizations for level walking, ramps, and stairs. We present a mode-unified prosthesis control framework that represents knee and ankle biomechanics continuously as functions of terrain slope and gait phase across those locomotion conditions. Locally optimized ascent and descent polynomial models were unified using radial basis function (RBF) interpolation, preserving the accuracy of the partitioned models while outperforming a global polynomial representation. The resulting biomechanics were transformed into continuous and slope-dependent impedance parameters and implemented within a single finite-state-machine (FSM) controller using bilateral sensing for gait-state estimation. Experiments with 10 individuals with transfemoral amputation demonstrated terrain-adaptive locomotion from level walking through ramps and stairs up to 35 degrees, including 13 degree ramp and 15 degree stair conditions absent from the underlying able-bodied (AB) dataset. Experimental results reproduced the principal slope-dependent biomechanical trends predicted by the unified model, with high agreement for knee-related measures (r-square = 0.82 - 0.99) and ankle kinematics (r-square= 0.78 - 0.96). These findings demonstrated that unified biomechanical parameterization enables a prosthesis control architecture across diverse terrain conditions while preserving key features of AB biomechanics without requiring independently tuned impedance parameter sets for each locomotion mode.

</details>


### [1090] [End-to-End Vision-Language-Action Policies for Autonomous Lunar Rover Docking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19224)
*Huang, Sitan,Gao, Grace*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究为月球车自主对接设计了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并在高保真月球仿真中与模块化导航流水线进行闭环对比，提出自适应执行时域以平衡算力与安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月球表面导航面临极端光照对比与部署期感知扰动；传统模块化流水线的测量误差会在手工设计组件间传播而削弱鲁棒性。VLA模型凭借互联网规模视觉-语言预训练带来的常识推理与视觉理解能力，有望在有限任务数据下实现稳健泛化，但其在月球表面操作中的适用性与性能尚未被刻画。

Method: 设计面向自主月球车对接的VLA策略；构建可扩展训练框架，在高保真月球仿真环境中生成具备安全意识的专家演示；在闭环评估中与模块化导航基线对比，并在训练未见过的感知扰动下测试；提出自适应执行时域机制，由策略判断开路状态下可安全行驶的距离，从而动态调整执行跨度。

Result: 闭环评估中，该策略在训练未见感知扰动下性能与模块化基线相当；自适应时域执行在评估场景中相较固定时域降低了推理频率，同时将危险接触率控制在更低水平。

Conclusion: VLA策略在月球表面导航任务中具备可行性，可在有限任务数据下与模块化流水线竞争，并通过自适应执行时域在算力消耗与闭环安全性之间取得更优折中。

Abstract: Surface navigation on the Moon is subject to extreme illumination contrast and deployment-time perceptual disturbances. While modular navigation pipelines have long supported planetary rover navigation, robustness is compromised by measurement errors that propagate through hand-engineered components. End-to-end learned policies are an alternative approach to navigation, which maps observations directly to control actions without intermediate components. Vision-language-action models, in particular, have driven significant breakthroughs in robotics and autonomous vehicle research. By leveraging internet-scale vision-language pretraining, these models can be exploited for their commonsense reasoning and visual understanding to provide robust generalization with limited task-specific data. However, their applicability and performance have yet to be characterized for lunar surface operations. In this study, we design a vision-language-action policy for autonomous lunar rover docking and characterize its performance relative to a modular navigation pipeline. We develop a scalable training framework that generates safety-aware expert demonstrations in a high-fidelity lunar simulation environment. In closed-loop evaluations, our policy performs competitively relative to the modular baseline under perceptual disturbances unseen during training. To address the tradeoff between compute consumption and closed-loop safety, the policy adapts its execution horizon by determining how far the rover may safely travel in open loop. Adaptive-horizon execution reduces inference frequency while limiting hazard-contact rates relative to fixed horizons in the evaluated scenarios.

</details>


### [1091] [PACER: Process-Aware VLA Policy Learning from Human Corrections for Robotic Disassembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19248)
*Liu, Chang,Tian, Sibo,Gong, Litian,Fan, Zhiwen,Li, Jiachen,Liang, Xiao,Zheng, Minghui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PACER：一种过程感知的纠错与证据重加权框架，通过SFT从机器人自身rollout轨迹与人工纠正中学习，按任务进度及轨迹来源/结果对有效动作块加权，用于EoL产品的机器人拆解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EoL产品机器人拆解需应对产品差异、前置序列约束与接触密集操作，而拆解数据有限且昂贵，SFT难以覆盖环境变化与产品不确定性导致的分布偏移。策略自身rollout记录了接近尝试，人工纠正示教了错误恢复，但这些经验难以有效转化为策略性能。

Method: PACER（Process-Aware Correction and Evidence Reweighting）在原生监督动作损失中对有效动作块加权：权重由朝向目标的进度（progress）以及每条轨迹的来源（自身rollout/人工纠正）与结果共同决定。每个加权设置训练一个策略，再通过held-out验证从中选择一个最终策略。

Result: 在UR5e主板拆解的5类元件上评估，PACER在held-out基准上取得87/100次成功接近-交接试验，而普通post-SFT仅为54/100。

Conclusion: 将策略rollout与人工纠正作为带来源与结果标签的证据、结合过程进度进行重加权监督，可显著提升拆解策略在分布偏移下的接触密集操作成功率，为数据受限场景下的机器人技能适应提供可行路径。

Abstract: Robotic disassembly of end-of-life (EoL) products requires robots to accommodate product variation, follow prerequisite sequences, and approach components precisely for contact-rich manipulation. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides a practical path for adaptation, but limited and costly disassembly data cannot capture the distribution shifts arising from changing environments and product uncertainties. The policy's own rollouts record its approach attempts, and human corrections demonstrate recovery from its errors, but turning these experiences into better policy performance remains challenging. We introduce PACER, a Process-Aware Correction and Evidence Reweighting framework that learns from these experiences through SFT, using progress toward the target and each trace's source and outcome to weight valid action chunks in the native supervised action loss. PACER trains one policy per weighting setting and selects one of the resulting policies through held-out validation. We evaluate PACER on UR5e motherboard disassembly across five component classes, where it achieves 87/100 successful approach-and-handoff trials on the held-out benchmark, compared with 54/100 for vanilla post-SFT.

</details>


### [1092] [Full-Order Safety for Nonlinear Reduced-Order MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19250)
*Pabon, Luis,Köhler, Johannes,Kasichainula, Revant,Pavone, Marco*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CoRE-MPC，一种以非线性降阶模型（ROM）为预测模型的鲁棒 MPC 框架，通过沿 ROM 传播两个误差半径来保证全阶系统的递推可行性与约束满足，无需在线计算全阶模型，并在 80 维振子链、Burgers 方程与 9768 维有限元软体机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性系统的 MPC 计算量过大，采用降阶模型（ROM）可提升可解性，但 ROM 的建模误差可能导致真实全阶系统违反约束。已有 certified/鲁棒方案要么不可行，要么过于保守，缺乏既高效又有保证的方法。

Method: CoRE-MPC：以非线性 ROM 规划，将 ROM 对预测误差动态的影响显式建模，通过两个误差半径（error radii）随 ROM 状态一同传播，得到预测误差的保证上界，从而在仅使用 ROM 的前提下给出全阶系统的递推可行性与约束满足保证；适用于广泛的非线性降阶技术，在线阶段无需评估全阶模型。

Result: 仿真验证于 80 状态振子链、Burgers 方程、9768 状态有限元软体机器人。两状态 ROM 配合数据驱动边界可让全部 1628 个节点避开墙壁，20 ms 控制周期下中位求解时间低于 1 ms；相比全阶鲁棒 MPC 快 13–61 倍，闭环代价仅高 27–35%；现有 certified 方案则不可行或至少保守两倍。

Conclusion: CoRE-MPC 在保持安全保证的同时显著提升计算效率，为高维非线性系统的实时鲁棒控制提供了兼顾可行性与性能的实用框架。

Abstract: Reduced-order models (ROMs) make model predictive control (MPC) of high-dimensional nonlinear systems tractable, but the resulting modeling error can lead to constraint violations on the real system. We introduce CoRE-MPC, a robust MPC formulation that plans with a nonlinear ROM and guarantees recursive feasibility and constraint satisfaction for the full-order system. It can be applied with a broad class of nonlinear model reduction techniques and the resulting MPC does not require evaluating the full-order model online, thus ensuring computational efficiency. The key insight is in how the ROM affects the dynamics of the prediction error. We account for this with two error radii that are propagated alongside the ROM and provide a guaranteed bound on the prediction error. The approach is validated in simulation on an 80-state oscillator chain, a Burgers equation, and a 9,768-state finite-element soft robot, where a two-state ROM with data-driven bounds keeps all 1,628 nodes clear of a wall at a median solve time below 1 ms for a 20 ms control period. Across these examples, CoRE-MPC is 13 to 61 times faster than full-order robust MPC at only 27 to 35% higher closed-loop cost, whereas existing certified schemes are either infeasible or at least twice as conservative. Code: [released upon publication].

</details>


### [1093] [MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19262)
*Abouagour, Mohamed,Nam, Junhyun,Jo, Wonse,Min, Byung-Cheol*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MIND 将持久语言指令编译为语义与目标选择依赖，与事件足迹求交后仅刷新受影响判断，从而在环境变化下维持目标房间决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在执行持久语言指令时环境会持续变化，若在每个事件后重算所有房间判断，语义评估开销过大；需要一种只更新受影响判断的维护机制，同时不改变最终决策。

Method: MIND 用语言模型把每条指令编译为语义资格依赖与目标选择依赖；控制器将语义依赖与事件足迹求交，仅刷新受影响的判断，并分别更新可达性与目标选择。在固定确定性评估、规划与选择下，保守的依赖与足迹覆盖可证明保持全量重算的决策。实验覆盖 240 条五事件 ProcTHOR 序列、冻结评估器（Phi-4、Qwen3-14B）、32 个闭环 AI2-THOR 回合，以及 Unitree G1 真实机器人实验。

Result: ProcTHOR 上平均语义评估从 30.6 降至 11.2，1,200 个事件后决策全部保持；冻结评估器实验同样保持全部 1,200 个决策，但不提升评估器本身的任务准确率；AI2-THOR 32 回合最终目标决策与全量重算完全一致；G1 实验展示跨房间转换的目标复用与重选无需额外语义评估，并在障碍与物体移除后以 4 次评估触发弃权（全量重算为 15–18 次）。

Conclusion: MIND 以依赖-足迹求交实现了决策等价的增量维护，显著降低语义评估次数，并在仿真与真实人形平台上验证了有效性；其局限在于不改善底层评估器准确率。

Abstract: Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.

</details>


### [1094] [Learning Keypoint Constraints from Visual Demonstrations for Safe Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19295)
*Qiu, Zheng,Zhang, Zhouyu,Zhong, Ninghan,Chou, Glen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Keypoint Constraint Learning（KCL）框架，从RGB-D视觉示范中用稀疏3D关键点与语义掩码质心表示示范，学习关键点动力学并在降维状态空间中通过KKT最优性条件推断距离与朝向几何约束，再结合预测误差推导的鲁棒裕度进行不确定性下的安全规划，并给出感知与动力学误差对约束恢复影响的理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视觉示范中学习任务相关运动约束并将其用于安全规划，是模仿学习与安全控制的核心难题；直接在原始RGB-D高维观测空间中学习约束不可解，因此需要一个可控的降维几何表示来使约束学习可处理，并需明确感知误差与动力学误差如何传播到恢复出的约束上。

Method: 1）通过分割、视觉特征聚类与点跟踪，将示范表示为稀疏的以物体为中心的3D关键点及语义掩码质心；2）在该降维几何空间中学习关键点动力学；3）在降维状态空间内施加KKT最优性条件，推断使专家轨迹可行且近似局部最优的距离约束与朝向约束；4）规划时利用累积预测误差得到的鲁棒裕度处理不确定性；5）理论分析关键点感知误差与学习动力学误差对约束恢复的影响。

Result: 在从导航到刚体/可变形物体操作的视觉示范上评估，KCL能够恢复多阶段几何约束，并在下游安全规划任务上优于基线方法。

Conclusion: KCL表明，在由关键点构成的降维几何空间中施加KKT条件可以有效提取可解释、任务相关的运动约束，并支撑不确定性下的安全规划；感知与动力学误差的影响可被理论刻画并转化为鲁棒裕度。

Abstract: We present Keypoint Constraint Learning (KCL), a framework for learning task-relevant motion constraints from visual demonstrations and for planning safely with the extracted constraints. To make constraint learning tractable from RGB-D observations, we represent demonstrations using sparse 3D object-centric keypoints and semantic mask centroids extracted through segmentation, visual feature clustering, and point tracking. In this reduced geometric space, we learn keypoint dynamics and infer distance- and orientation-based constraints that make the expert trajectories feasible and approximately locally optimal by enforcing KKT optimality conditions in the reduced state space. We then plan with the learned constraints under uncertainty, using robustness margins derived from accumulated prediction error, and provide a theoretical analysis of how keypoint perception error and learned dynamics error affect the recovered constraints. We evaluate KCL on visual demonstrations from navigation to rigid/deformable manipulation, showing that it recovers multi-stage geometric constraints and outperforms baselines in downstream safe planning.

</details>


### [1095] [Probabilistic Physics Digital Twin for Human-Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19336)
*Hu, Yushen,Chandirasekar, Harshvardhan,Kushwaha, Apurv,King, Jonathan,Chen, Zhu-Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"概率数字孪生"：将质量、摩擦、质心等物理参数表示为概率分布而非定值，通过在分布上模拟动作预测结果区间及似然，用于指导人机决策与规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建精确数字孪生需要准确的物理参数（质量、摩擦、质心），但真实环境中这些参数往往难以获取，导致仿真与现实的偏差。

Method: 以概率分布而非固定值表示不确定物理属性，构成概率数字孪生；在该分布上采样并模拟动作，得到可能结果的分布及其概率，从而筛选在物理不确定性下仍有效的动作；并设计向用户传达模拟结果的人机交互界面与显式考虑不确定性的机器人规划策略。

Result: 在人机交互场景中演示了该框架，包括结果可视化界面与不确定性感知的规划策略。

Conclusion: 以概率方式建模物理不确定性，可让数字孪生输出结果分布而非单一预测，从而支持对不确定性鲁棒的人的决策与机器人规划。

Abstract: Digital twins are increasingly used in robotics to simulate interactions, predict action outcomes, and support planning. However, constructing accurate digital twins requires precise estimates of physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of mass, which are often difficult to obtain in real-world environments. We propose probabilistic digital twins, which represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions rather than fixed values. By simulating actions across these distributions, the twin predicts a range of possible outcomes and their likelihoods. These probabilistic simulations can guide both human and robot actions by identifying actions that are effective despite physical uncertainty. We demonstrate this framework through human-robot interaction scenarios, including interfaces that communicate simulated outcomes to users and robot planning strategies that explicitly account for uncertainty.

</details>


### [1096] [Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19393)
*Bao, Lingfan,Zhu, Hanshang,Pan, Yan,Wang, Jincheng,Yu, Jingyang,Peng, Tianhu,Jia, Yiyang,Kanoulas, Dimitrios,Zhou, Chengxu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出残差学习框架，为冻结的全身跟踪器添加针对幅度、能量、体态扩张、倾斜和骨盆高度等表现性特征的补偿目标，并用运动感知门控分配补偿能力，再通过蒸馏得到统一策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身跟踪器以关节/关键点跟踪误差和物理稳定性为目标，但更低平均位置误差不等于更好保留动作的动态与姿态表现特征，存在表现性保真度缺口。

Method: 在冻结跟踪器上训练残差策略：补偿目标覆盖幅度、能量、体态扩张、体态倾斜、骨盆高度；运动感知门控按身体部位活跃度分配修正容量，活跃部位给更大修正范围，其余受限；对每类动作训练专用残差策略并蒸馏为跨类别共享的统一策略。

Result: 在Unitree G1上针对八类动作进行仿真与实物实验，表现性动态与姿态特征保留优于对应基线。

Conclusion: 以表现性特征为导向的残差补偿与门控机制可在不破坏原有跟踪行为的前提下提升人形机器人动作表现保真度，且可蒸馏为统一策略。

Abstract: Whole-body control plays a crucial role in enabling humanoid robots to execute expressive motions. Faithful execution requires preserving both the intended action and its expressive characteristics. Existing whole-body trackers typically balance joint and keypoint tracking with physical stability across diverse motions, but these objectives do not necessarily prioritize the expressive characteristics of each action. Our analysis shows that lower average positional tracking error does not guarantee better preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics. To address this gap, we propose a residual learning framework with compensation objectives targeting amplitude, energy, body expansion, body lean, and pelvis height. To concentrate compensation while limiting interference with the underlying tracking behavior, motion-aware gating allocates correction capacity according to body-part activity, preserving larger correction ranges in more active parts and restricting them elsewhere. For each frozen tracker, we train motion-specific residual policies and distill them into a unified policy shared across motion categories. Simulation and physical experiments on the Unitree G1 across eight motion categories demonstrate superior preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics compared with the corresponding baselines.

</details>


### [1097] [A Master-to-Simulation Interface with Demonstration-Trajectory Guidance for Vascular Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19395)
*Zou, Mingyu,Guo, Shuxiang,Cao, Sheng,Li, Pengcheng,Guo, Jian,Wang, Bin,Din, Mingchao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将真实机器人主控制器与SOFA物理仿真平台连接，构建血管介入交互系统，并在体模实验中复用成功操作轨迹作为视觉引导，验证主从控制回路并比较三种引导条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人血管介入可降低医生辐射暴露并提升操作稳定性，但传统透视图像空间信息有限，导航引导困难，需要一种简单有效的视觉辅助策略。

Method: 搭建真实机器人主控制器与SOFA物理仿真平台的交互系统，实现主控制器到SOFA的控制回路；在物理体模实验中，将成功操作轨迹复用为视觉引导，并对比无引导、中心线引导与成功轨迹引导三种条件。

Result: 主从控制回路在速度模式下指令传递可靠；体模实验中中心线引导相较无引导无明显改善，而成功轨迹引导效果显著：任务完成时间、碰撞次数、回退次数与旋转次数分别降低约66.8%、34.3%、55.6%和66.7%。

Conclusion: 基于器械-血管交互获得的成功轨迹可提供实用的引导线索，为机器人血管介入实验提供了一种简单有效的视觉辅助策略。
