Abstract: Robotic vascular intervention can reduce radiation exposure to physicians and improve manipulation stability, but effective guidance remains challenging because conventional fluoroscopic images provide limited spatial information. This paper developed a vascular intervention interactive system that connects a real robotic master controller with the SOFA(Simulation Open Framework Architecture) physical simulation platform and reused successful operation trajectories as visual guidance in physical phantom experiments. Experiments were conducted to validate the master-to-SOFA control loop and to compare three guidance conditions: no guidance, centerline guidance, and successful-trajectory guidance. The control validation results showed reliable command delivery under velocity-mode operation. In the physical phantom experiment, centerline guidance showed no obvious improvement over no guidance. In contrast, successful trajectory guidance provided a clear performance benefit. Compared with the no-guidance condition, it reduced task completion time, collision number, rollback number, and rotation number by approximately 66.8%, 34.3%, 55.6%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results indicate that successful trajectories obtained under instrument-vessel interaction can provide practical guidance cues, offering a simple and effective visual assistance strategy for robotic vascular intervention experiments.

</details>


### [1098] [Topology-Preserving Multi-Usage Pipe Centerline Refinement under Permanent Tubular Occupancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19403)
*Quan, Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该技术报告研究多组管道布线后的几何精修阶段：在固定拓扑与可行粗布局下，于永久性间隙约束中优化分支管中心线，用"主干共享/交汇点分裂"混合参数化结合软几何代价与硬间隙接受，在8组×8端子算例上实现全部硬约束通过、曲率半径比 κr≲1 与约95%的软目标下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散多组管道布线器把通道放在网格或粗图上，得到的中心线拓扑可行但含大量轴对齐拐角。对于增材制造液压歧管等永久占用流道，这些拐角会损害几何光顺性与流动质量。经典机器人路径平滑通常只处理单条临时开放轨迹，无法直接适用于此处具有声明终端用途、有限管径与静态跨组占用的分支歧管结构。

Method: 将精修问题形式化，指出单一共享分支点无法消解多用途交汇冲突，提出"主干共享/交汇点分裂"混合参数化；以软几何代价驱动优化，同时以硬约束方式接受间隙（capsule clearance）检验。

Result: 在多组测试集（8组×8端子，r=2）带胶囊间隙下，精修达到100%硬约束接受成功率，曲率半径比 κr≲1，软目标相对下降约95%。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了从固定拓扑出发、面向永久间隙的分支管中心线精修框架，几何目标下效果显著；基于物理的压降优化被有意留待后续PDE阶段处理，本文目标保持纯几何性质。

Abstract: Discrete multi-group pipe routers place channels on a grid or coarse graph. The resulting centerlines are topologically feasible but typically contain many axis-aligned corners. For permanently occupied fluid tubes---as in additively manufactured hydraulic manifolds---those corners are undesirable: they degrade geometric fairness and, in practice, flow quality. This technical report studies the downstream geometric stage that starts from a fixed routing topology and a feasible coarse layout, and refines tubular centerlines under permanent clearance. Unlike classical robotic path smoothing, which usually fair one temporary open trajectory, our setting is a branched manifold with declared terminal usages, finite tube radii, and static cross-group occupancy. We formalize the refinement problem, highlight the multi-usage junction conflict that a single shared branch point cannot resolve, and outline a hybrid trunk-share / junction-split parameterization with soft geometric costs and hard clearance acceptance. On a multi-group suite ($8$ groups $\times$ $8$ terminals, $r{=}2$) with capsule clearance, the refine reaches full hard-accept success, $\kappa r\lesssim 1$, and about a $95\%$ relative drop in the soft objective. Physics-based pressure-drop optimization is intentionally deferred to a later PDE stage; here the objective remains geometric.

</details>


### [1099] [A VR Training System for Robot-Assisted Vascular Intervention with Dual-Mode Control and Model-Based Interaction Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19413)
*Shang, Yining,Guo, Shuxiang,Cao, Sheng,Li, Pengcheng,Wang, Bin,Ding, Mingchao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出异步双模式指令映射结合无传感器交互估计的VR机器人血管介入训练系统，并用15名新手实验验证训练迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人辅助血管介入的VR训练需要精确的机器人控制与有效的导丝—血管交互反馈，但现有系统在指令映射模式单一、缺乏力/接触传感条件下难以提供交互强度反馈。

Method: 系统支持速度控制导航与位置驱动增量操作两种异步指令模式；将导丝形变与Hunt–Crossley型接触响应结合并做时间滤波以估计交互强度，并基于轨迹的可视化支持术后复盘；通过专用测试验证指令分发模式，在混合场景导航中验证估计响应，并用轨迹分析计算归一化累积创伤功（CTW）。

Result: 三种速度挡位与位置模式呈现不同指令分发模式；混合场景导航中估计响应在直插时较低、导丝在血管模型中弯曲时升高；轨迹分析给出CTW=15.166（归一化单位）并定位交互升高区域；15名新手初步研究中，实体模型任务成功率由53.3%提升至93.3%，平均完成时间由132.4 s降至96.7 s。

Conclusion: 该系统实现了双模式操作与形变敏感反馈，并显示出改善后续实体模型任务表现的潜力，但样本量小、缺乏力传感真值验证，属初步验证。

Abstract: Virtual reality training for robot-assisted vascular intervention requires accurate robotic control and effective feedback on guidewire--vessel interactions. This paper presents a VR training system combining asynchronous dual-mode command mapping with sensorless interaction estimation. The system supports velocity-controlled navigation and position-driven incremental manipulation. Guidewire deformation and a Hunt--Crossley-type contact response are combined and temporally filtered to estimate interaction intensity, while trajectory-based visualization supports post-procedure review. Tests confirmed distinct command-dispatch patterns across three velocity gears and the position mode. During hybrid-scene navigation, the estimated response remained low during straight insertion and increased as the guidewire bent within the vascular model. Trajectory analysis yielded a model-derived cumulative trauma work (CTW) value of 15.166 in normalized units and localized regions of elevated interaction. In a preliminary study with 15 novices, physical-phantom task success increased from 53.3% to 93.3% after VR training, while mean completion time decreased from 132.4 s to 96.7 s. These results demonstrate the system's dual-mode operation, deformation-sensitive feedback, and potential to improve subsequent physical-phantom task performance.

</details>


### [1100] [From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19420)
*Zhang, Yue,Lin, Han,Wang, Zun,Huang, Yidong,Khan, Zaid,Bansal, Mohit*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WEDGE 提出以预训练智能体的失败模式（weakness）为信号来指导具身导航训练环境的生成：用 LLM 从成功/失败轨迹对比中提出可执行的弱点特征，自动验证并选取成功率差距最大的弱点，再映射到可控环境因素，在困难区间内定向生成训练环境。三类导航智能体上，弱点条件化的适应一致优于随机与难例基线，并可从 ProcTHOR 迁移到 HM3D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真环境虽能规模化生成训练数据，但"更多数据"不等于"该智能体所需的数据"。现有环境生成管线只优化通用属性（真实性、多样性、任务覆盖度），而不同预训练策略的失败原因各不相同，导致通用数据无法针对性弥补特定策略的短板。

Method: WEDGE 是一个弱点引导的导航学习框架，按轮次迭代：给定预训练策略，用 LLM 从对比的成功与失败 rollout 中提出可执行的弱点特征（weakness features），在诊断集上自动验证，并按成功率差距选择最强且已验证的弱点；随后将该弱点映射到控制它的环境因素，通过变化这些因素在策略表现吃力的难度区间内构造环境，从而产生定向训练经验用于适应。适应后重新诊断，形成迭代循环。

Result: 在三个具有不同适应机制的导航智能体上，发现各自的弱点画像不同，且受益于不同的训练环境。在 ProcTHOR 上，弱点条件化适应一致优于匹配的随机环境与难例环境；Uni-NaVid 与 Gemini 在 ProcTHOR 适应后的增益还能迁移到 HM3D。迭代再诊断显示，随着策略提升，主导弱点会持续存在或发生转移，从而为后续环境构造提供更新后的指导。

Conclusion: 策略失败不只是诊断信号，更是可操作的指导，可用于构造针对策略当前弱点的训练环境。该工作把"失败模式分析"与"环境生成"闭环耦合，为具身智能体提供了策略特异性的数据生成范式。

Abstract: Simulated environments enable scalable training data generation for embodied agents, but more data does not necessarily provide what a particular agent needs to learn. Existing environment-generation pipelines largely optimize generic properties such as realism, diversity, or task coverage, while different pretrained policies can fail for different environmental reasons. We therefore introduce WEDGE, a framework for weakness-guided navigation learning in which the failure modes of a pretrained agent guide the generation of training environments at each adaptation round. Given a pretrained policy, WEDGE uses an LLM to propose executable weakness features from contrasting successful and failed rollouts, automatically validates them on the diagnostic set, and selects the strongest validated weakness based on its success-rate gap. The validated weaknesses are then mapped to the environmental factors that control them. WEDGE varies these factors to construct environments in the difficulty regimes where the policy struggles, producing targeted training experience for adaptation. Across three navigation agents with different adaptation mechanisms, we find that policies exhibit distinct weakness profiles and benefit from different training environments. Weakness-conditioned adaptation consistently outperforms matched random and hard-example alternatives on ProcTHOR, while the resulting gains for Uni-NaVid and Gemini also extend to HM3D after ProcTHOR adaptation. Iterative re-diagnosis further shows that dominant weaknesses can persist or shift as the policy improves, providing updated guidance for subsequent environment construction. Together, these results show that policy failures are not only diagnostic signals, but actionable guidance for constructing training environments that target a policy's current weaknesses.

</details>


### [1101] [$S^3$-Nav: Structured Spatial-Semantic Decision Making for Language-Guided Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19431)
*Lee, Chaemin,Cho, Hae Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 S³-Nav 框架，将持久化空间-语义状态、面向决策的证据视图与执行权限分离，用于部分可观测下的语言引导机器人导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言引导导航在部分可观测下需要保留足够环境证据，但高维完整表征会推高策略推理成本。作者希望解耦"机器人必须记住什么"与"策略需要查看什么"，在控制决策复杂度的同时不丢弃可供后续推理与验证的具身证据。

Method: 增量构建持久化空间-语义状态；向高层策略仅暴露容量受控、任务条件化的证据视图；高层导航输出视为暂定，需在物理执行或任务终止前，依据持久语义证据与当前几何观测进行独立 grounding 与验证。形成"状态—决策证据—执行权限"三层分离。

Result: 在多个环境及物体目标、关系目标任务上评估，分离持久状态、决策证据与执行权限可提升闭环导航可靠性，同时降低策略推理成本。摘要未给出量化指标，亦未明确说明是否包含真实机器人部署。

Conclusion: 结构化分离持久状态、任务条件化证据与执行验证是提升语言引导导航可靠性与效率的有效设计原则，具备向具身决策系统推广的潜力。

Abstract: This paper presents $S^3$-Nav, a structured spatial-semantic decision-making framework for language-guided robot navigation under partial observability. Rather than assuming a complete environment representation in advance, $S^3$-Nav incrementally constructs persistent spatial-semantic state while exposing only a capacity-controlled, task-conditioned view to the high-level policy. This separation decouples what the robot must retain from what the policy needs to inspect, allowing decision complexity to be controlled without discarding grounded evidence required for subsequent reasoning and validation. High-level navigation outputs remain provisional and are independently grounded and validated against persistent semantic evidence and current geometric observations before physical execution or task termination. Evaluations across multiple environments and object- and relation-goal tasks demonstrate that separating persistent state, decision-facing evidence, and execution authority improves closed-loop navigation reliability while reducing policy reasoning cost.

</details>


### [1102] [Paraphrase Consensus Is Not Self-Consistency: Instruction Reliance and Robustness in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19438)
*Li, Hanlong,Tan, Sihan,Ashizawa, Takeshi,Yen, Benjamin,Nakadai, Kazuhiro*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LIBERO上微调的VLA策略对指令措辞极度敏感（改写指令使OpenVLA成功率下降38.0点）；提示集成与改写众数选择无法恢复损失，而基于改写指令的LoRA后训练可将损失降至+2.0点，且不改变策略对指令的整体依赖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在LIBERO等基准上训练与评测使用同一组固定指令文本，导致评测高估了指令泛化能力；作者希望量化"改写指令"带来的性能塌缩，并检验常见的推理期缓解手段（提示集成、置信度选择、众数聚合）是否有效，进而寻找训练期的修复方案。

Method: 以base OpenVLA及另外三个策略、四个任务套件为对象，系统比较训练指令 vs 改写指令下的成功率；测试test-time prompt ensembling、K个改写的medoid动作聚合、置信度选择、单改写多样本medoid等推理期聚合方法；提出"错误指令探针"(wrong-instruction probe)量化策略成功率对指令的依赖份额；最后用改写指令做LoRA后训练，并以匹配控制组、两个随机种子、OpenVLA-OFT及留出措辞做验证。

Result: 改写指令使base OpenVLA下降38.0点；提示集成在任何设置下均无法恢复；含训练指令的K改写medoid下降16.8点，不含时medoid为-32.4点、置信度选择为-28.0点；单改写多样本medoid优于贪心解码但仍低于训练指令27.6点，说明聚合只降方差、不消共享偏差。错误指令探针显示，改写带来的损失仅在指令依赖份额高的策略上出现，强策略损失的份额远小于base OpenVLA。改写指令LoRA后训练将效果从-32.0点（匹配控制组）改善至+2.0点，跨两个种子、跨OpenVLA-OFT复现，可迁移到留出措辞，且策略对指令的依赖度不变。

Conclusion: VLA的指令泛化缺陷无法靠推理期聚合修补，因其源于改写共同携带的偏差；训练期用改写指令做轻量LoRA后训练是可行修复路径，且不牺牲策略对指令的敏感性与依赖。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies fine-tuned on LIBERO are trained and evaluated on the same ten instruction strings, and rewording the instruction changes base OpenVLA's success by -38.0 points. Test-time prompt ensembling, which improves language models, does not recover this loss in any setting we ran. Paraphrase consensus (the medoid action over K paraphrases) costs base OpenVLA 16.8 points when the training instruction is a member. Without it, the medoid of the paraphrases scores -32.4 points relative to the training instruction, and confidence-based selection scores -28.0. The same medoid over samples of one paraphrase improves on greedy decoding but stays -27.6 points below the training instruction, consistent with aggregation reducing variance without removing the bias the paraphrases share. A wrong-instruction probe measures how much of a policy's success depends on the instruction. Across three policies and four suites, paraphrases cost a policy only where this share is high, and the stronger policies lose a much smaller fraction of it than base OpenVLA. LoRA post-training on paraphrased instructions reduces the one-paraphrase effect to +2.0 points, against -32.0 for a matched control, reproduces across two seeds and on OpenVLA-OFT, transfers to withheld phrasings, and leaves the policy's reliance on the instruction unchanged.

</details>


### [1103] [Spacecraft Pose Tracking via Kinematic Prediction and Selective Event Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19465)
*Zhang, Yonglong,Yao, Guanning,Zhang, Shuo,Yang, Yifan,Liu†, Yang,Xie, Zongwu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Observation-Aligned Event Innovation (OA-EI)：用事件相机对恒定体旋量传播的位姿预测做旋转与归一化图像平面平移的局部校正，保留轴向深度；配合有界 Scale Gate 与确定性活动因子，空事件窗口时退化为原预测。在 FRESH 四条物理事件轨迹、20 个 rollout 起点、3 个训练种子上，7.7 秒时旋转/平移误差从 41.63°/57.28 mm 降至 15.73°/22.41 mm，失败率 20.0%→1.67%，Jetson Orin Nano 中位更新耗时 44.56 ms（P95 58.77 ms）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航天器追踪初始化后运动预测只能短时有效，事件支持集变化导致预测漂移。需要一种轻量、可实时运行的事件驱动校正机制，仅修正预测中不可靠的分量，而不重建完整状态。

Method: 恒定体旋量模型传播完整位姿；事件编码器输出旋转校正与归一化图像平面平移校正，轴向深度沿用传播值。候选校正幅度由有界 Scale Gate 与确定性活动因子确定，事件窗口为空时保持原预测。评估使用 FRESH 四条物理事件轨迹、20 个 rollout 起点、3 个训练种子，rollout 由两个参考位姿起步后转为自估计。

Result: 7.7 秒处旋转误差 41.63°→15.73°（降 62.2%），平移误差 57.28 mm→22.41 mm（降 60.9%），失败率 20.0%→1.67%。消融显示含旋转的接口整体位姿精度更优；缩放与活动支持组合在各事件保留水平下误差最低。Jetson Orin Nano 上内存更新中位 44.56 ms、P95 58.77 ms。

Conclusion: 事件驱动的局部残差校正可在不重估深度的情况下显著提升短时航天器位姿预测精度与鲁棒性，并满足嵌入式平台的实时性约束。

Abstract: In initialized spacecraft tracking, a short-horizon motion prediction remains available as event support changes. Observation-Aligned Event Innovation (OA-EI) uses events to correct selected components of this prediction. A constant-body-twist model propagates the complete pose; the event encoder proposes rotational and normalized image-plane translation corrections, retaining propagated axial depth. Candidate magnitudes come from a bounded Scale Gate and a deterministic activity factor, with empty windows returning the prediction unchanged. Evaluation uses four FRESH physical-event trajectories, twenty rollout starts, and three training seeds. Each rollout starts from two reference poses and then uses self-estimates. At 7.7 seconds, rotation and translation errors fall from 41.63{\deg}/57.28 mm for prediction alone to 15.73{\deg}/22.41 mm for OA-EI, reductions of 62.2% and 60.9%. Failure rates fall from 20.0% to 1.67%. Matched ablations favor the rotation-bearing interface for overall pose accuracy; combining scaling with activity support gives the lowest errors at every tested event-retention level. On Jetson Orin Nano, the measured in-memory update takes 44.56 milliseconds at the median and 58.77 milliseconds at P95.

</details>


### [1104] [Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19479)
*Ma, Liqian,Saxena, Vaibhav,Mishra, Utkarsh Aashu,Cheng, Shuo,Chen, Yongxin,Xu, Danfei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MetaGenSim将"仿真器作为固定数据源"的范式重新表述为"主动生成式仿真"（Active Generative Simulation）问题，即优化仿真器的数据生成分布以最大化下游真实世界性能；方法上通过元梯度训练一个辅助评分网络（rater network），在用户指定的仿真参数空间内自动发现高价值数据生成分布，无需人工参数对齐。在仿真与真实机器人操作任务中，真实全任务成功率相对均匀生成提升150%，并达到专家手工对齐水平；验证了轻量代理策略筛选的分布可迁移至VLA微调，且在无精确sim-real任务对齐时可通过原子技能拼接与物体-容器组合利用部分对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sim-and-real协同训练是缓解真实演示数据稀缺、扩展机器人学习的有效手段，但现有方法把仿真器当作固定数据源：要么均匀采样、要么离线检索、要么依赖领域专家手工做参数对齐，导致仿真数据与真实任务需求不匹配、生成效用低且难以规模化。作者希望把"应该生成什么样的仿真数据"从人工设计问题转化为可优化的分布优化问题，从而让仿真器主动服务于下游真实世界性能。

Method: 提出MetaGenSim：将问题形式化为主动生成式仿真，即在用户指定的仿真参数空间内优化数据生成分布，目标是最大化下游真实世界表现。框架用元梯度（meta-gradient）训练一个辅助rater网络，用其评分来指导数据生成分布的自动搜索与更新，从而无需人工参数对齐即可自动发现高效用生成分布；筛选得到的分布可用于轻量代理策略训练，并可迁移到VLA微调。

Result: 在仿真与真实操作任务上，MetaGenSim优于均匀生成与检索式基线，真实全任务成功率相对均匀生成取得150%的相对提升，并与专家手工对齐的效果相当；使用轻量代理策略筛选出的分布可有效迁移到VLA微调；当缺少精确的sim-and-real任务对齐时，方法仍可通过原子技能拼接与物体-容器组合利用部分对齐。

Conclusion: 仿真器不应被视为固定数据源，而应被当作可优化的生成分布；用元学习自动搜索高价值仿真数据分布，能在不依赖专家手工对齐的情况下显著提升sim-to-real协同训练的下游真实性能，并具备迁移到VLA训练与部分对齐场景的潜力。

Abstract: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: https://meta-gensim.github.io

</details>


### [1105] [IMU-Bench: Benchmarking Wrist IMU Representations Across Kinematic, Semantic and Clinical Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19481)
*Li, Yiquan,Bradshaw, Aidan,Gao, Chenfeng,Ahuja, Karan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出IMU-Bench，包含8个数据集上的10个任务，系统评测6种自监督预训练方法在手腕IMU多任务学习与跨任务迁移中的表现，并指出监督迁移的互补性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴IMU基准虽覆盖多任务，但未明确单一任务的监督信号如何影响向其他任务的迁移，以及各任务能否共享统一表征，因此需要系统性的多任务与跨任务迁移基准。

Method: 构建IMU-Bench，整合8个数据集、10个任务，涵盖分类、位姿与速度估计、IMU-语言检索；在无标签的真实与仿真手腕运动上预训练6种自监督方法（含作者提出的掩码自编码器InrtlWrist），通过冻结探针与微调两种协议评测，并开展迁移与联合训练实验。

Result: InrtlWrist在10个任务中9个取得最佳或并列最佳的冻结探针性能；在9/10任务上微调优于从零训练，包括全身位姿、里程计与检索；迁移与联合训练实验显示，对某一目标的监督收益可能损害其他任务，监督源仅在运动学估计内可迁移，冻结探针下无一方法在语言检索上接近预训练编码器，联合训练增益以牺牲配对任务为代价。

Conclusion: 广谱下游可用性与任务监督的互补性是两个不同概念，多任务IMU表征需要区分二者；基准的代码、任务卡片与榜单已公开。

Abstract: Wrist-worn inertial measurement units (IMUs) provide a common sensing modality for tasks ranging from activity and gesture recognition to pose estimation, inertial odometry and clinical motor assessment. Existing wearable benchmarks evaluate performance across multiple tasks, but leave open how supervision for one task affects transfer to others and whether these tasks benefit from a shared representation. We present IMU-Bench, a benchmark of ten tasks from eight datasets for studying IMU multi-task performance and cross-task transfer. We compare six self-supervised methods pretrained on unlabeled recorded and simulated wrist motion, evaluating classification, pose and velocity estimation, and IMU-language retrieval. We find that our masked autoencoder, InrtlWrist, achieves the best or joint-best frozen-probe performance on nine of ten tasks, and fine-tuning improves on training from scratch on nine of ten tasks, including full-body pose, odometry and retrieval. Across transfer and joint-training experiments, supervision that benefits one target can reduce performance on others, with supervised sources transferring within kinematic estimation while, under frozen probing, none approaches the pretrained encoder on language retrieval, and joint-training gains that come at a cost to the paired task. These findings distinguish broad downstream usefulness from complementary task supervision. Code, task cards and a leaderboard are publicly available.

</details>


### [1106] [Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19495)
*Liu, Yunze,Wang, Jing,Wu, Shenrui,He, Wenkun,Zhan, Guanqi,Ma, Xianzheng,Chen, Junyu,Ge, Wenhang,Tang, Haozhan,Gu, Yuchao,Zhang, Zhuoyang,Wang, Zekai,Niu, Dantong,Dong, Zhen,Zhu, Yuke,Darrell, Trevor,Fan, Linxi "Jim",Han, Song,Cai, Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出首个联合编码视觉-语言-动作（VLA）三模态的检索嵌入模型 Robota-Embed，用于机器人任务上下文检索，并在两个下游应用（Embed2ICL 上下文学习、Embed2Evolve 任务记忆演化）中显著提升策略成功率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人任务上下文的检索需要同时匹配任务、执行阶段以及应跟随的后续动作。现有嵌入模型（如 Gemini Embedding 2）缺乏原生动作模态编码，难以对齐"当前状态查询"与"历史未来延续"，因此无法为机器人提供可用的上下文。作者希望构建一个动作感知的统一检索空间来支撑机器人 in-context learning。

Method: 构建 1,695,684 条清洗后训练锚点的多源语料；提出 Robota-Embed，用预测式检索训练（predictive retrieval training）对齐当前状态查询与记录的未来延续，将视觉、语言、动作三模态联合编码。同时提出 Robota-Embed-Bench（4,000 查询 + 共享 8,000 条目图库）。在下游：Embed2ICL 用检索到的经验做免训练与基于训练的策略条件化；Embed2Evolve 用执行反馈增长任务局部记忆，围绕冻结的 GPT-6 Astra 策略精化上下文使用。

Result: 检索指标 clip-level R@1 47.33%、episode-level R@1 81.77%，分别超过无动作的 Gemini Embedding 2 达 22.09 和 33.47 个百分点；消融显示移除原生动作比移除视觉对检索损害更大。Embed2ICL 将 DROID-Sim 成功率从 47.0% 提到 56.3%，LIBERO 困难子集从 86.4% 提到 92.8%，并改善真机任务进度。Embed2Evolve 在五个 ManiSkill 任务上达 68% 成功率，对比 GPT-6 Astra Direct 的 24% 及同协议下用 Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B 独立演化 harness 的 33%，且相对后者每次测试 rollout 的 policy token 用量减少约 79.5%（含成功与失败）。

Conclusion: 统一、动作感知的检索空间可同时支撑机器人 in-context learning 与任务局部上下文演化，说明检索可以作为 VLA 策略的有效、token 高效的外部记忆机制。

Abstract: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.

</details>


### [1107] [HiFun: a Hierarchical Framework for Efficient Functional Dexterous Manipulation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19518)
*Huang, Linyi,Huai, Guowei,Liu, Weibin,Jiang, Shulong,Tan, Ping,Zhang, Weixuan,Zhang, Hui,Song, Jie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HiFun，一种真实世界层级强化学习框架，将功能性灵巧操作分解为"精确接触执行的手部技能"与"臂-手协调策略"，实现实时人类干预的恢复学习与 DMP 数据增广，六个真实任务上一小时训练达 98.3% 平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多指灵巧手虽具人类级灵巧性潜力，但功能性操作仍困难：成功依赖精确接触、臂手协同与执行错误后的反应式恢复。接触动力学难以在仿真中精确建模，故需真实世界学习；然而全臂-手控制空间的真实演示代价高、噪声大，微小偏差会导致接触滑移或过早施力，因此离标称接触态的恢复能力对稳健执行至关重要。

Method: HiFun 层级真实世界 RL 框架。核心思路是将控制复杂度解耦为两层：功能手技能（functional hand skill）负责精确接触执行；臂-手协调策略负责手臂控制与手部技能激活。该解耦设计支持有效的实时人类干预以进行反应式恢复学习，并借助动态运动基元（DMP）增广实现高效数据采集。

Result: 在两种灵巧手上的六个真实世界任务中，HiFun 在一小时在线训练内达到 98.3% 平均成功率，并对动态扰动保持稳健。

Conclusion: 层级解耦 + 实时人类干预 + DMP 增广的组合，使真实世界灵巧操作学习兼具高效率与高鲁棒性，为功能性灵巧操作提供可行范式。

Abstract: While multi-fingered dexterous robot hands have the potential to provide human-level dexterity, using them for functional manipulation remains difficult because task success depends on precise contact, coordinated arm-hand motion, and reactive recovery from execution errors. Precise contact depends on complex contact dynamics that are difficult to model accurately in simulation, motivating real-world learning. However, real-world demonstrations in the full arm-hand control space are costly and noisy because each trajectory must coordinate arm motion with high-DoF multi-finger contact. Small execution deviations can further cause slipped contact or premature force application, making recovery from off-nominal contact states important for robust execution. To deal with these challenges, we propose HiFun, a hierarchical real-world RL framework for functional dexterous manipulation tasks. Our key insight is to decouple the control complexity into a functional hand skill for precise contact execution and an arm-hand coordination policy for arm control and hand-skill activation. This design enables effective real-time human intervention for reactive recovery learning and efficient data collection with Dynamic Movement Primitive (DMP) augmentation. Across six real-world tasks on two dexterous hands, HiFun achieves 98.3% average success within one hour of online training and remains robust to dynamic disturbances. The project page is available at https://hly-123.github.io/HiFun/.

</details>


### [1108] [Dungeon and Visibility World Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19523)
*Mériaux, Edwin,Loría, Antonio,Dudek, Gregory*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 开源框架 Dungeon and Visibility World Generator 可生成 2D/3D 可控几何环境（正交、多边形/多面体、曲线几何，六类构造族），并内置 Rust 视线（LOS）引擎，支持连续自由空间与离散占据栅格两种表示下的可见性查询，记录配置、几何、栅格与可见性结果以保证可复现性；作者在六类几何上展示生成效果，分析几何与分辨率对可见性的影响，并评测生成时间与可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人探索、覆盖与多智能体部署算法的评测依赖几何与可见性可控、且可复现的环境；现有环境生成工具在几何家族覆盖、可见性计算的可控性与结果留痕方面不足。

Method: 构建开源环境生成框架：支持正交、多边形/多面体、曲线几何；提供分散房间、簇、蜿蜒通道、洞穴、分支、环路六类构造族；通过可配置参数与概率分布控制房间尺寸、通道结构、障碍物与空间布局；每个环境同时输出连续自由空间几何与离散占据表示；用 Rust 实现可见性引擎，在两种表示上支持任意智能体位置的 LOS 查询；完整记录配置、生成几何、占据栅格与可见性结果以保证实验可复现。

Result: 在六类几何上完成生成演示；量化了几何类型与空间分辨率对可见区域的影响；给出生成时间与可复现性的评测（摘要未给具体数值）。

Conclusion: 该框架为机器人探索、覆盖与多智能体部署算法提供了可配置、可复现的环境与可见性评测基础，但定位为仿真/评测基础设施，未涉及真实机器人验证或学习型方法创新。

Abstract: Robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms require reproducible environments with controllable geometry and visibility. This paper presents the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for constructing two- and three-dimensional environments and evaluating geometric line-of-sight. The framework supports orthogonal, polygonal or polyhedral, and curvilinear geometries, with six construction families covering scattered rooms, clusters, winding passages, caverns, branches, and loops. Room dimensions, passage structures, obstacles, and spatial placement can be controlled through configurable parameters and probability distributions. Each generated environment provides continuous free-space geometry and a corresponding discrete occupancy representation. A Rust-based visibility engine supports line-of-sight queries in both representations, enabling the evaluation of observable regions from arbitrary agent positions. The framework records configurations, generated geometries, occupancy grids, and visibility results to support reproducible experiments. We demonstrate the generator across all six geometry classes, examine how geometry and spatial resolution affect visibility, and evaluate generation time and reproducibility. The resulting framework provides a configurable foundation for evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms in diverse environments.

</details>


### [1109] [Dual-arm Cooperation for Tabletop Wiping with Temporal Object Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19527)
*Zhang, Pengqi,Yu, Longchang,Li, Daohan,Yan, Liang,Liu, Hangxin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出双臂协同桌面擦拭框架：一臂重排遮挡物、一臂执行覆盖式擦拭，用几何感知MILP+LBBD做任务规划，KOMO生成无碰撞运动，真实实验中将规划时间缩短约9倍、执行时间缩短约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表面清洁策略只覆盖空闲区域并绕开障碍物，导致被物体遮挡的区域无法被擦拭，可达覆盖受限且效率低。作者希望通过显式引入物体重排动作，让另一条手臂在物体被移开后擦拭原本不可达的区域。

Method: 先构建擦拭与物体重排的动作原语集合；在此基础上提出Geo-MILP几何感知任务规划器，以混合整数线性规划形式化问题，并集成逻辑型Benders分解(LBBD)迭代优化动作顺序与时序以消解几何冲突；最后用K-Order Markov Optimization (KOMO)生成平滑无碰撞的运动轨迹以保证可执行性。

Result: 仿真与物理实验表明，该框架通过让机械臂接触被遮挡区域提升了可达覆盖率，并在时间效率上显著优于TAMP基线：规划时间最多减少9倍，执行makespan约减少40%。

Conclusion: 将物体重排与表面擦拭在统一的任务-运动规划框架内协同优化，可突破传统覆盖清洁的可达性上限，同时大幅提升规划与执行效率，具备真实双臂平台上的可行性。

Abstract: We devise a dual-arm cooperative planning framework for wiping table surface in the presence of scattered objects. Unlike conventional surface-cleaning strategies that only cover free areas and detour around obstacles, our framework explicitly assigns one arm to rearrange objects while the other performs coverage wiping, thereby enabling access to previously obstructed regions. Specifically, we first construct a set of wiping and object-rearrangement action primitives. Based on these primitives, we introduce Geo-MILP, a geometry-aware task planner formulated as Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP). By integrating Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD), Geo-MILP iteratively optimizes action sequencingand timing to resolve geometric conflicts, promoting efficient cooperation between wiping and object rearrangement. We then employ K-Order Markov Optimization (KOMO) to generate smooth, collision-free motions to ensure feasible execution. Simulation and physical experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework not only increases reachable coverage by enabling access to obstructed areas, but also significantly improves time efficiency compared to Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) baselines, reducing planning time by up to 9 times and execution makespan by approximately 40%.

</details>


### [1110] [GS-PRM: Gaussian Visual Roadmap for Image-Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19541)
*Siddique, Ashraf,Han, Kyung Min,Kim, Young J.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GS-PRM：直接用3DGS渲染构建高斯视觉路线图（里程碑+局部连接+视觉参考），无需占据栅格或SDF；提出RC-free配置/路径、全景深度保守净空与正交边缘渲染扫掠体检测，并给出条件可靠性、确定性查询完备性与概率构造完备性；仿真+真实环境长程导航，成功率最高2倍、完成时耗时最多降57.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像目标导航需要全局规划器连接视觉指定端点，并为局部策略提供可跟随观测。3DGS可提供配准的RGB/不透明度/深度渲染，但不显式编码可导航拓扑；传统路线图依赖占据栅格或SDF，与3DGS的渲染表征脱节且引入额外建模误差。作者希望直接从渲染构建拓扑路线图。

Method: GS-PRM：以3DGS渲染直接构建里程碑、局部连接与视觉参考。定义render-based collision-free (RC-free)配置与路径；用全景深度提供保守净空用于里程碑校验与自适应覆盖，用边缘对齐正交渲染检测机器人扫掠体；给出条件可靠性、确定性查询完备性充分条件与概率构造完备性；配合目标条件策略执行长程导航。

Result: 在仿真与真实环境中验证长程导航。与SOTA的3DGS导航系统相比，GS-PRM导航系统平均成功率最高提升至2倍，在两系统均完成任务时行程时间最多减少57.2%。

Conclusion: GS-PRM表明可直接从3DGS渲染构建无碰撞保证的视觉路线图，实现免占据栅格/SDF的全局规划，具备理论完备性保证与真实机器人长程导航实证，为3DGS与导航规划结合提供新范式。

Abstract: Image-goal navigation requires a global planner that connects visually specified endpoints while providing observations that a local policy can follow. Three-dimensional Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides map-registered RGB, opacity, and depth renderings, but does not explicitly encode navigable topology. We introduce GS-PRM, a Gaussian visual roadmap whose milestones, local connections, and visual references are constructed directly through 3DGS rendering without deriving an occupancy grid or signed distance field. We define render-based collision-free (RC-free) configurations and paths. Panoramic depth supplies conservative clearance for milestone validation and adaptive coverage, while edge-aligned orthographic rendering tests the robot's swept volume. We establish conditional soundness and sufficient conditions for deterministic query completeness and probabilistic construction completeness of GS-PRM. To validate the performance of GS-PRM, we conduct experiments in both simulated and real-world environments, demonstrating long-horizon navigation using goal-conditioned policies guided by GS-PRM. Compared with a state-of-the-art 3DGS-based navigation system, our GS-PRM-based navigation system achieves up to a twice higher average success rate and reduces travel time by up to 57.2% when both systems complete the navigation task.

</details>


### [1111] [Back on Track: Deployment-time Policy Improvement via World Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19579)
*Crosby, Colton,Wang, Hao,Schwager, Mac,Bansal, Somil*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出离线训练的监测-干预框架，仅通过黑盒查询在部署阶段提升策略：用少量标注的 on-policy rollout 学习 policy-conditioned liveness value 监测进度，失速时用共享该 value 作为目标的短时域规划器在潜世界模型中搜索纠正动作，随后交还控制权给原策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿 visuomotor policy 部署时会以自身无法预测或恢复的方式失败；常规改进手段（采集更多数据、重训练、改架构）耗时耗资源，故希望在部署时以黑盒方式直接提升策略表现与鲁棒性。

Method: 离线训练的黑盒监控+干预框架。1) 用有限标注 on-policy rollouts 学习 policy-conditioned liveness value 度量任务进度；2) 用这些 rollouts 加 play data 训练紧凑潜世界模型；3) 部署时 value 持续监测，检测到进度损失后短时域规划器以同一 value 为目标在潜世界模型中搜索纠正动作，之后控制返回原策略。

Result: 在 LIBERO-Goal 任务集与 Franka Panda 机械臂上，以 VLA 模型 π0.5 和 diffusion policy 作为名义策略，任务成功率显著提升，并支持实时控制。

Conclusion: 黑盒、离线训练的监控-干预机制可作为通用即插即用模块增强已有 visuomotor 策略的部署鲁棒性，无需修改策略架构或重训练，且能实时运行。

Abstract: State-of-the-art visuomotor policies are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks, yet can fail during deployment in ways they cannot predict or recover from on their own. Improving their performance and robustness typically requires collecting more data, retraining, or modifying the policy architecture, all of which are time- and resource-intensive in practice. We instead propose an offline-trained monitoring-and-intervention framework that improves a policy during deployment using only black-box query access. From a limited set of labeled on-policy rollouts, we learn a policy-conditioned liveness value that measures the nominal policy's progress toward task completion; we additionally train a compact latent world model using these rollouts together with play data. At deployment, the liveness value continuously monitors execution. When it detects a loss of progress, a short-horizon planner searches the world model for corrective actions using the same value as its planning objective, after which control returns to the nominal policy. We evaluate our method on the LIBERO-Goal task suite and on a Franka Panda manipulator, using the vision-language-action model $\pi_{0.5}$ and a diffusion policy as nominal policies, and demonstrate significant improvements in task success rates, while supporting real-time control. Additional results and videos are available on the project website (https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/).

</details>


### [1112] [RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19594)
*Ren, Keqiang,Ye, Xuecheng,Liu, Hanyu,Wang, Zhihua,Jian, Tao,Ma, Yunsheng,Wen, Jiayi,Li, Xinran,Song, Zhigong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboSpan 是一个 29-DoF 全身遥操作与示教平台；配套的分层模块化框架 HMF 将动作空间解耦为手部精细操作、手臂位姿与移动底盘三支，并用 COMET 跨模块交叉注意力协调，结合 VLM 层级任务分解与全掌 2D 触觉表征，在长程全身接触密集任务上成功率较主流基线提升 20% 以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全身移动操作面临两个根本问题：运动/手臂/手部模块间的运动异质性，以及长程多阶段任务中的误差逐步累积；同时现有遥操作平台缺乏集成的灵巧触觉感知，难以支撑协同的全身决策。

Method: 提出 RoboSpan 高自由度全身遥操作与示教平台；设计分层模块化框架 HMF，把 29-DoF 动作空间功能解耦为手部精细操作、手臂位姿调整、移动底盘空间配置三条支路；核心模块 COMET（Coordinated Modular Embodied Transformer）通过模块间交叉注意力实现动态信息交换与动作协调；用 VLM 驱动的层级任务分解在结构上抑制时序误差传播；用全掌 2D 触觉表征编码分布式接触信号，实现跨模块触觉赋能。

Result: 在实体 29-DoF 机器人上，方法在多种长程全身任务中任务成功率比主流基线高 20% 以上，并在接触密集操作中显著提升稳定性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 模块化解耦 + 跨模块注意力 + VLM 层级分解 + 全掌触觉的组合可有效缓解全身移动操作的运动异质性与长程误差累积，是全身灵巧操作与遥操作示教方向的可复用范式。

Abstract: Whole-body mobile manipulation suffers from two fundamental challenges: inherent motion heterogeneity across locomotion, arm, and hand modules, and progressive error accumulation over long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Existing teleoperation platforms also lack integrated dexterous tactile sensing to support coordinated whole-body decision-making. This paper presents RoboSpan, a high-DoF whole-body teleoperation and demonstration platform, and the Hierarchical Modular Framework (HMF) for learning modular coordination policies. HMF functionally decouples the 29-DoF action space into fine hand manipulation, arm pose adjustment, and mobile-base spatial configuration branches, and introduces the Coordinated Modular Embodied Transformer (COMET) with inter-modular cross-attention to enable dynamic information exchange and action coordination. Vision-language model driven hierarchical task decomposition structurally suppresses temporal error propagation, while a full-palm 2D tactile representation encodes distributed contact signals for cross-module tactile empowerment. Experiments on a physical 29-DoF robot demonstrate that the proposed method achieves over 20\% higher task success rate than mainstream baselines across a range of long-horizon whole-body tasks, markedly improving stability and robustness in contact-rich manipulation.

</details>


### [1113] [Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19600)
*Wang, Zixuan,Li, Jia-Ning,Tang, Yinzhou,Yu, Yanzhao,Wu, Biao,Fang, Meng,Li, Xin,Zhong, Yiwu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作系统诊断长时程移动操作中预训练子任务VLA的性能崩溃（原子任务80%成功率，组合后仅19%），识别出任务规划、导航与基座定位、局部操作三大失效来源，并提出fail-ure-guided agentic干预框架（演示规划引导、自适应视觉记忆、可达性感知基座调整、末端执行器调整），在RoboCasa365上从19%提升至49%（留出种子），BEHAVIOR-1K从14%到37%，真机从5/20到13/20。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练VLA在局部原子操作上表现良好，但其能力无法平滑迁移到长时程移动操作（80%→19%），说明瓶颈不在局部操作本身，而在于执行全过程的多环节失效。作者主张应定位并干预当前瓶颈，而非一味扩展底层策略。

Method: 1) 系统性失败诊断，将长时程移动操作分解为任务规划、导航与基座定位、局部操作三类主导失效模式；2) 基于诊断构建failure-guided agentic干预框架，在固定子任务VLA外围加入演示式规划引导、自适应视觉记忆、可达性感知的基座调整、局部末端执行器调整四种模块化干预。

Result: RoboCasa365：渐进式干预使成功率由19%提升至47%，完整系统在留出episode种子上达49%，基线仅18%；BEHAVIOR-1K由14%提升至37%；真机任务由5/20提升至13/20。

Conclusion: 可靠的移动操作可通过诊断并干预当前瓶颈来实现，而非统一扩展底层策略；模块化agentic干预在仿真与真机均取得显著提升，代码将开源。

Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on local robot manipulation, yet their success does not readily translate to long-horizon mobile manipulation. In our experiments, a pretrained subtask VLA achieves 80% success rate on atomic manipulation tasks but only 19% when these skills are composed into mobile manipulation. We argue that this gap stems from failures across the execution process rather than from local manipulation capability alone. To uncover these bottlenecks, we systematically diagnose failures in long-horizon mobile manipulation and identify three dominant regimes: task planning, navigation and base positioning, and local manipulation. Based on this diagnosis, we develop failure-guided agentic intervention that augments a fixed subtask VLA with demonstration-based planning guidance, adaptive visual memory, accessibility-aware base adjustment, and local end-effector adjustment. On RoboCasa365, these interventions progressively improve task success from 19% to 47%, with the finalized system reaching 49% on held-out episode seeds, compared with 18% for the baseline. The same design improves performance from 14% to 37% on BEHAVIOR-1K and from 5/20 to 13/20 on real-robot tasks. These results suggest that reliable mobile manipulation can be advanced by diagnosing and intervening on the current bottleneck, rather than uniformly scaling the underlying policy. Our code will be released at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/Cracking-Mobile-Manipulation.git.

</details>


### [1114] [ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19604)
*Han, Xuan,Jin, Zinuo,Li, Tianlin,Lou, Yunfan,Liu, Xin,Xue, Yuchen,He, Yuanpeng,Yao, Boxian,Zhan, Shuhan,Wu, Ruihai,Pang, Zhibo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForceBench：统一六轴腕力反馈集成评测的仿真基准，含8任务1600条同步示范；共享π0.5骨干下比较1个无力基线与6种力集成设计，Prompt Fusion仿真平均成功率35.31%（基线23.25%），真机8系统5任务中Prompt Fusion与Dual-Path Fusion达63.00%（基线40.00%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 力反馈可为VLA策略提供物理观测以指导动作选择与执行，但现有系统在任务、示范与控制设置上不一致，导致力集成设计难以可靠比较，亟需统一协议的评测基准。

Method: 构建仿真基准ForceBench：8个任务覆盖物理属性推断、阻力依赖交互、接触丰富装配三类；1,600条同步示范与任务特定成功判据；在共享π0.5骨干上统一评测1个无力基线与6种力集成设计；并做真机8系统5任务验证。

Result: 仿真中Prompt Fusion最高平均成功率35.31%（基线23.25%），三类任务均提升；预测与时序设计收益集中在物理属性推断，两种时序设计在装配上低于基线。真机中Prompt Fusion与Dual-Path Fusion均达63.00%（基线40.00%），但仅Prompt Fusion在所有任务上均有提升。

Conclusion: ForceBench可有效识别力集成在不同操作需求下的收益与局限，具备实用评测价值；力集成设计选择需任务相关，时序类设计在接触丰富装配中可能失效。

Abstract: Force feedback provides vision-language-action (VLA) policies with physical observations that can guide action selection and execution. However, differences in tasks, demonstrations, and control settings across existing systems hinder reliable comparisons of force integration designs. We introduce ForceBench, a simulation benchmark for evaluating six-axis wrist-force integration under a unified protocol. ForceBench combines eight tasks spanning physical-property inference, resistance-dependent interaction, and contact-rich assembly with 1,600 synchronized demonstrations and task-specific success criteria. We compare one no-force baseline and six force integration designs on a shared $\pi_{0.5}$ backbone. Prompt Fusion achieves the highest observed mean simulation success of 35.31%, compared with 23.25% for the baseline, and improves success rates across all three task categories. Predictive and temporal gains in simulation concentrate on physical-property inference, while both temporal designs underperform the baseline on assembly. Real-world evaluation of eight systems across five tasks supports the main qualitative trends: Prompt Fusion and Dual-Path Fusion achieve 63.00% mean success, compared with 40.00% for the baseline, but only Prompt Fusion improves every task. These findings support ForceBench's practical value for identifying the benefits and limitations of force integration across manipulation demands. The project page is available at https://forcebench-platform.github.io/.

</details>


### [1115] [PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19615)
*Oh, Hyunsik,Jeon, Seunghun,Youm, Donghoon,Hur, Jungwoo,Kim, Hyeongjun,Lee, Jeong Hyun,Jung, Moonkyu,Hwangbo, Jemin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PolyMorph提出形态条件化的统一运动策略框架，将URDF转为关节-连杆模块，结合循环编码器、图Transformer与逐关节解码器，实现跨双足/三足/四足及未见形态的单一策略泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习虽已实现腿式机器人鲁棒运动，但策略通常绑定特定形态，当腿数、执行器或机械属性改变时需重新工程化，缺乏跨形态的通用性。

Method: 将每个机器人URDF解析为关节-连杆模块；采用循环编码器+图基Transformer+逐关节解码器生成动作；引入形态归一化奖励、自适应机器人采样及基于URDF的PD增益初始化以稳定训练。

Result: 在仿真中对双足、三足、四足及未见形态变体和平台进行评测，并将策略部署于真实四足平台的多种构型；单一策略无需逐机器人重训即可跨形态泛化。

Conclusion: 形态条件化建模可有效统一异构腿式机器人的运动控制，一个策略覆盖多形态并具备真实部署能力，减少逐机器人工程开销。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

</details>


### [1116] [Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control for Robotic Arms: Language-to-Code Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19617)
*Huang, Fan,Tong, Dezhong,Chen, Changyu,Kwak, Haewoon,An, Jisun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作提出"指令条件化运动控制"(ICMC)框架，将参数设定、指令生成与代码合成解耦，使机器人执行结果可追溯至指令与程序；并在MuJoCo UR5e取放/字母重排任务上对比一次生成与ICMC，用GRPO训练开放权重指令策略，同时揭示"日志奖励率"与"独立验证任务成功率"之间的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言驱动机器人控制中，执行结果难以追溯到具体指令与程序，且训练日志中的奖励信号可能与真实任务成败不一致。作者希望通过解耦参数、指令与代码，使控制过程可解释、可审计，并建立独立评估协议以区分"日志奖励"与"真实任务成功"。

Method: ICMC将参数设定、指令生成、代码合成三阶段分离。在MuJoCo中对UR5e机械臂做立方体取放与字母重排任务，比较一次生成与ICMC(在o1、o4-mini上)。随后通过冻结的代码生成器，用GRPO训练开放权重指令策略，任务为将立方体放置到2个和5个立方体构成的字母布局上，每条指令平均采样5个程序的奖励。并进行日志审计，检查二值正标签与几何失败信息的对应关系，并提出独立评估协议，按固定规格校验任务完成度。

Result: 训练中记录到的正奖励率从31.6%升至35.3%(253/800→282/800)。日志审计发现正二值标签与几何失败信息共存：该次运行至少19例、密集奖励运行18例、单程序运行5例。个别案例中5个奖励均为1.0，但日志报告0.9515 m偏差超出0.05 m容差，判定来自程序自身输出流。作者强调这些是记录奖励率而非独立验证成功率，且为单条训练轨迹的描述性结果。

Conclusion: ICMC使语言驱动机器人控制的执行结果可追溯至指令与程序，但日志奖励率不能等同于真实任务成功率；作者提出独立评估协议，将机器人控制与成功评估分离，以支持可复现评测。

Abstract: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC) separates parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis for language-driven robot control, making execution outcomes traceable to instructions and programs. We compare one-shot generation with ICMC under o1 and o4-mini on cube pick-and-place and letter-reshaping tasks for a UR5e arm in MuJoCo. We then train an open-weight instruction policy by GRPO through a frozen code generator on cube placement onto two- and five-cube letter layouts, averaging the rewards of five programs per instruction. The logged positive-reward rate rose from 31.6% to 35.3% (253/800 to 282/800) between the first and last five training steps. A log audit identifies positive binary labels associated with geometric-failure messages: at least 19 in that run, 18 in the dense-reward run, and 5 in the run with one program per instruction. In one case, all five rewards were 1.0 while the log reports a 0.9515 m miss against a 0.05 m tolerance; the verdict came from the program's own output stream. We distinguish logged reward rates from independently verified task success and report descriptive results for each configuration's single training trajectory. We introduce an independent evaluation protocol that checks task completion against fixed specifications, separating robot control from success assessment to support reproducible evaluation.

</details>


### [1117] [F2A-ObjectNav: An Adaptive Agentic Architecture for Object-Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19618)
*Mirghasemi, Seyed Ali,Taheri, Alireza*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 F2A-ObjectNav，一种由规则 Supervisor 协调探索、检测、目标验证、语义引导与 Mission Memory 的自适应具身目标导航架构，在两阶段（固定模块消融→自适应）开发流程下于 AI2-THOR/RoboTHOR/ProcTHOR 各 25 回合评测，SR/SPL 为 0.84/0.52、0.40/0.22、0.44/0.37。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定模块化目标导航流水线在导航性能、验证可靠性、执行时间与模型成本之间存在互斥权衡，不存在跨环境普遍最优的单一配置，因此需要可自适应切换策略的智能体架构。

Method: Stage I 用固定模块框架系统消融探索、目标检测与目标验证方法的组合；Stage II 提出 F2A-ObjectNav：规则式 Supervisor 协调导航探索、检测、验证、语义引导与 Mission Memory，采用事件驱动恢复、策略重规划、候选实例管理与条件式语义引导，常态下保持轻量执行；并额外定义架构级行为指标（语义引导使用率、策略切换、恢复激活、记忆支持行为、决策稳定性）。

Result: 在 AI2-THOR、RoboTHOR、ProcTHOR 各 25 回合中，SR/SPL 分别为 0.84/0.52、0.40/0.22、0.44/0.37；行为指标显示三环境自适应干预模式不同，RoboTHOR 与 ProcTHOR 的干预频率高于 AI2-THOR，模拟器中真实感较弱场景收益有限。

Conclusion: 规则式自适应协调可缓解固定流水线的性能—成本权衡，但仅在部分环境（AI2-THOR）取得高成功率，跨环境泛化与真实机器人部署仍待验证。

Abstract: Object-goal navigation requires an embodied agent to explore an unfamiliar environment, identify a target object, navigate toward candidate instances, and reliably determine whether the observed object satisfies the mission goal. This work investigates this problem through a two-stage development process. In Stage I, a fixed modular framework is used to examine combinations of exploration, object detection, and target validation methods. The results reveal clear trade-offs among navigation performance, validation reliability, execution time, and model-related cost, with no single fixed configuration remaining preferable across all evaluated conditions. These observations motivate F2A-ObjectNav (Fixed-to-Adaptive Object-Goal Navigation), an adaptive agentic architecture in which a rule-based Supervisor coordinates specialized components for navigation and exploration, object detection, target validation, semantic guidance, and Mission Memory. The architecture uses event-driven recovery, strategy revision, candidate management, and conditional semantic guidance while retaining lightweight execution during normal operation. F2A-ObjectNav is evaluated over 25 episodes in each of AI2-THOR, RoboTHOR, and ProcTHOR, achieving success rate (SR) / success-weighted path length (SPL) values of 0.84/0.52, 0.40/0.22, and 0.44/0.37, respectively. In addition to task-level metrics, architecture-specific behavioral metrics are used to characterize semantic-guidance usage, strategy switching, recovery activation, memory-supported behavior, and decision stability. The results show different patterns of adaptive intervention across the three environments, with higher intervention frequencies observed in RoboTHOR and ProcTHOR than in AI2-THOR.

</details>


### [1118] [E2DRL: End-to-End Differentiable Reinforcement Learning for 3D Obstacle Avoidance in Quadruped Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19627)
*Fan, Cheng,Zhou, Bingyang,Yang, Gang,Zhuang, Zixuan,Zhang, Aoqian,Yang, Pengzhi,Liu, Xin,Wang, Chunzheng,Tan, Yan Rui,Shi, Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: E2DRL：用软化的可微障碍物交互公式化（多关键点穿透惩罚+速度条件stop-gradient整形）打通可微强化学习到3D视觉避障，结合SAPO特权教师蒸馏为深度递归学生，并经地形感知门控与基础运动策略融合，在Unitree Go2上完成端到端可微RL避障的首次真机验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微强化学习（DRL）在机器人策略学习中潜力大，但此前仅限盲走或2D仿真任务。扩展到端到端视觉避障的核心障碍在于：硬性碰撞约束与接触即终止会破坏一阶梯度，使优化器陷入局部极小，无法获得有效训练信号。

Method: 1) 提出软化可微障碍交互：在多个身体关键点上施加穿透惩罚，并用速度条件stop-gradient整形，为3D避障提供一阶训练信号；2) 在可微仿真器中用SAPO（Soft Analytic Policy Optimization）训练特权教师；3) 通过DAgger将教师蒸馏为基于深度图的递归学生策略；4) 用地形感知门控模块与基础运动策略融合，形成可部署的感知-控制一体化系统。

Result: 仿真中样本效率高于PPO，速度跟踪性能与3D避障能力优于PPO及基于Duality的DCBF NMPC；在Unitree Go2上完成静态与动态环境下的真机验证，为端到端可微RL做3D避障的首次sim-to-real验证。

Conclusion: 通过软化可微障碍交互与教师-学生蒸馏，可微RL可成功扩展到真实四足的端到端视觉避障，打通了从可微仿真训练到真机部署的完整链路。

Abstract: Differentiable reinforcement learning shows strong promise for robot policy learning, but its application to legged locomotion has remained limited to blind walking or simulated 2D tasks. Extending it to end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance is challenging because hard collision constraints and early termination upon contact corrupt first-order gradients, trapping optimizers in local minima. We present E2DRL, which addresses this with a soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation: penetration penalties across multiple body keypoints with velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping to provide the first-order training signals for 3D obstacle avoidance. To realize a deployable perception-control system, a privileged teacher trained via Soft Analytic Policy Optimization (SAPO) in a differentiable simulator is distilled into a recurrent depth-based student via DAgger, then blended with a base locomotion policy using a terrain-aware gating module for deployment. In simulation, E2DRL achieves higher sample efficiency than PPO and demonstrates superior velocity-tracking performance and 3D obstacle-avoidance capability compared with both PPO and Duality-based DCBF NMPC. We present the first sim-to-real validation of end-to-end differentiable RL for 3D obstacle avoidance on a Unitree Go2 in static and dynamic environments.

</details>


### [1119] [Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19635)
*Hu, Yuhang,Lyu, Junlin,Fang, Yuan,Shen, Xiaoying,Zhang, Lechen,Lin, Jiong,Goldfeder, Judah,Tian, Steven,Lipson, Hod*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出将机器人注视行为解耦为三部分：异步视觉语言模型选择注视目标、反应式感知模块维持注视、Realistic Gaze Transformer（RGT）生成目标条件化的头眼运动。RGT是基于Transformer-VAE的模型，在无标记人体录制数据重定向到机器人11自由度关节空间上训练（自监督预训练+自回归微调）。双秒基准上RGT-Base取得最低七关节MSE，并给出物理演示，但自然度与开放词汇目标选择精度待评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类注视由眼、头、眼睑耦合运动驱动，注视在交互中引导注意力；而人形机器人需要在选定注视目标的同时生成自然的朝向运动。固定跟踪规则无法建模人类注视的时间结构，因此需要将"选目标"与"生成运动"解耦的框架。

Method: 异步视觉语言模型选择场景指涉目标；反应式感知模块维持注视锁定；RGT（Transformer-VAE）在无标记人体记录重定向至11-DoF关节空间上训练，先自监督预训练编码全头历史，再自回归微调暴露自身预测；推理时用4维双眼轨迹条件化颈部与眼部协调运动，辅助眨眼预测器在回放中触发眼睑模板。

Result: 在两秒基准中所有控制器使用同一真值目标时，RGT-Base取得所报告的最低整体七关节MSE；物理演示展示了目标选择与控制流水线的集成。证据支撑机器人空间运动学保真度与RGT实时推理；感知自然度与开放词汇目标选择精度仍待受控评测。

Conclusion: 该工作通过解耦式架构实现从开放词汇目标选择到类人注视运动生成的机器人流水线，验证了机器人空间中的运动学保真与实时推理，但自然度与目标选择精度尚未经受控评估。

Abstract: Gaze coordinates attention in human interaction through coupled eye, head, and eyelid motion. A humanoid robot must choose where to look while generating a suitable movement toward that target; fixed tracking rules alone do not model the temporal structure of human gaze. We separate these tasks with an asynchronous vision-language model that selects a scene referent, a reactive perception module that maintains fixation, and a Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) that generates target-conditioned motion. RGT is a Transformer-VAE trained on markerless human recordings retargeted to the robot's 11-DoF joint space: self-supervised pretraining encodes recent full-head history, and autoregressive fine-tuning exposes the model to its own predictions during rollout. At inference, a four-dimensional binocular-eye trajectory conditions coordinated neck and eye motion; an auxiliary blink predictor triggers eyelid templates during playback. On a two-second benchmark in which all controllers receive the same ground-truth target, RGT-Base obtains the lowest reported overall seven-joint MSE, and physical demonstrations show the integrated targeting and control pipeline. The evidence establishes robot-space kinematic fidelity and real-time RGT inference; perceived naturalness and open-vocabulary target-selection accuracy remain questions for controlled evaluation.

</details>


### [1120] [Accelerating VLA Inference with Perturbation Informed Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19656)
*Lee, Jehun,Lee, Hajun,Ryu, Jimin,Lee, Youhan,Kang, Beomseok,Choi, Jonghyun,Kim, Jae-Joon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法PICES，利用扰动噪声生成的动作块差异，联合选择动作块与执行视界，在提升成功率的同时将策略推理时间最多加速2.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作分块VLA在固定视界执行下，短视界导致策略调用频繁、推理开销大，长视界又牺牲精细修正能力，二者存在权衡但缺乏自适应选择机制。

Method: PICES为免训练方法：单次策略调用中，动作专家基于同一条件特征，从多个初始噪声及其局部扰动副本生成一批动作块；比较各名义块与其扰动对应动作之间的差异，据此为每个候选确定执行视界并挑选一个名义块执行。

Result: 在仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务上，相对固定视界基线在Jetson Orin和Thor上实现最高2.3倍wall-clock策略推理加速，且成功率提升。

Conclusion: 通过扰动诱导的动作块差异可无训练地自适应联合选择动作块与执行视界，兼顾推理效率与操作精度，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.

</details>


### [1121] [ACRO: Actor-Critic Rollout Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19677)
*Lee, Junhoo,Kim, Seungyeon,Kim, Baekseung,Kim, Minkyu,Jeon, Suhyun,Kim, Jimyeong,Kwak, Nojun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ACRO 提出一个 Actor–Critic 推演编排层，为固定 VLA 策略判断何时干预、从轨迹何处重新进入，从而在相同物理执行预算下提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定 VLA 策略在执行中常因早期错误或不可恢复状态导致失败，而重新执行或人工干预代价高。核心动机是：在不重新训练策略的前提下，通过"何时继续/何时干预、从何处重新开始"的编排决策，把已有策略能力转化为更高的任务成功率。

Method: 1) 引入 ACRO（Actor–Critic Rollout Orchestration）层，位于固定 VLA Actor 之上；2) 用策略 rollout 训练 Critic，估计成功前景，据此决定干预时机并在已执行轨迹上选择"再进入目标"；3) 以物理可行性（可执行、运动可达）和剩余时间充足性作为干预筛选项；4) Trajectory Retraction 将已走过的路径"回撤"捷径化，把机器人送回该目标点；5) 同一 VLA 在新鲜观测下从该点恢复执行。

Result: 在 GR00T N1.7 与 π0.5 上、跨 SimplerEnv、RoboCasa 与真机操作评测：在相同物理执行预算（含所有返回运动开销）下，成功率分别提升 10.4、7.3、21.7 个百分点；随执行预算增加还能完成更多任务。

Conclusion: 控制策略"何时"与"从何处"恢复执行，可显著放大固定 VLA 的既有能力，是一种与策略解耦、通用性较强的编排机制；启示是将编排/重试决策作为 VLA 部署的独立可优化维度。

Abstract: Executing a vision-language-action (VLA) policy involves deciding when to continue an attempt and when to intervene to improve its chances of success. We introduce ACRO, an Actor--Critic rollout orchestration layer that makes these decisions for a fixed VLA. ACRO seeks interventions that offer a more promising continuation, are physically feasible, and leave sufficient time to complete the task. A Critic learned from policy rollouts estimates success prospects to decide when to intervene and select a re-entry target along the executed trajectory. Trajectory Retraction shortcuts the visited path to return the robot to that target, where the same VLA resumes execution from a fresh observation. We evaluate ACRO with GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ across SimplerEnv, RoboCasa, and real-robot manipulation. Under the same physical execution budget, including all return motion, ACRO improves success by 10.4, 7.3, and 21.7 percentage points, respectively. It also completes additional tasks as the execution budget grows. These results show that controlling when and where a policy resumes can turn its existing capabilities into more successful task executions. Project page: https://junhoo.me/acro

</details>


### [1122] [Uncertainty-Driven Self-Play for Robust Multi-Agent Driving Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19714)
*Marvi, Sajad,Schmidt, Julian,Canevaro, Alessandro,Jordan, Julian,Valada, Abhinav*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出不确定性驱动的自博弈训练方案：一半智能体被奖励去提高邻居的认知不确定性，另一半则在对抗中学习安全驾驶，从而无需手工设计场景即自动生成课程，实现零样本跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶策略的鲁棒性与跨域泛化仍是运动规划的核心难题。标准自博弈缺乏难度导向的课程设计，而人工场景设计成本高、覆盖有限。作者希望用策略自身的认知不确定性作为场景难度的自动代理，驱动探索者定向挖掘失败案例。

Method: 对抗式自博弈：将智能体分为探索者与被挑战者两组，前者以增大对手（邻居）认知不确定性为奖励，后者以安全驾驶为目标；探索者持续寻找对手低置信区域，形成自动难度课程。分析中验证认知不确定性与失败率的相关性，并以 LSTM 隐状态覆盖率衡量行为多样性。

Result: 策略在 nuplan Val14 零样本迁移达 99.12%（标准自博弈 97.97%），Argoverse 2 达 82.39%（78.03%），Waymo 上亦优于标准自博弈；隐状态覆盖率高 85%；最高认知不确定组在碰撞、驶出道路与 DNF 上的综合失败率是最低不确定组的 14.8 倍，说明不确定性可作为校准良好的难度检测器。

Conclusion: 认知不确定性可同时充当场景难度的无标注代理与自博弈课程生成信号，显著提升零样本跨数据集泛化与行为多样性，为自动驾驶运动规划提供了一种可扩展的自动课程学习范式。

Abstract: Learning robust driving policies that generalize beyond their training domain remains a central challenge in motion planning. We propose an uncertainty-driven self-play scheme, in which half of the agents are rewarded for increasing their neighbors' epistemic uncertainty, while the other half learn to drive safely as the exploring agents continuously seek out their weaknesses. Epistemic uncertainty indicates where the policy is least confident and serves as an automatic proxy for scenario difficulty. Exploring agents use this signal to seek out hard cases, generating a challenging curriculum without manual scenario design. The resulting policy outperforms standard self-play, achieving best-in-class zero-shot transfer to nuplan Val14 (99.12% vs. 97.97%) and Argoverse 2 (82.39% vs. 78.03%) without fine-tuning, while also improving performance over standard self-play on Waymo. Our diversity-driven approach achieves 85% higher LSTM hidden-state coverage than the baseline, indicating a much richer set of behaviors. Further analysis shows that epistemic uncertainty serves as a calibrated difficulty detector, with highest-uncertain agents exhibiting 14.8 times the combined failure rate across collision, off-road, and DNF, of lowest-uncertain agents, enabling automatic prioritization of challenging scenarios without ground-truth labels.

</details>


### [1123] [One-shot Human Video-Guided Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19746)
*Chen, Qi,Wu, Yuwei,Chen, Quan,Gao, Kunpeng,Chen, Jin,Sun, Che,Gao, Zhi,Jia, Yunde*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CapPro：仅用单段人类演示视频，通过阶段感知的视频表示与视频条件适配模块，使预训练VLA策略泛化到未见操作任务，无需目标任务机器人数据或微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型依赖大规模机器人数据与基础模型取得进展，但难以快速适应训练分布之外的新任务；现有方法需任务专用机器人演示与额外训练，成本高，限制了开放世界场景的可扩展性。作者希望降低对目标任务机器人数据的依赖。

Method: CapPro含两模块：(1) 阶段感知人类视频表示模块，通过可学习视觉token选择构建紧凑视频表示，并在阶段字幕监督下学习任务相关query表示；(2) 视频条件适配模块，将紧凑视频与query派生表示联合注入预训练VLA策略的动作条件上下文，同时基本保留原动作生成骨干。人类视频提供任务级执行引导而非需对齐本体的可模仿轨迹。

Result: 在源任务与未见目标任务上的实验表明，CapPro在未见目标任务组上平均性能提升，同时在源任务上保持可比性能。

Conclusion: 人类视频引导可有效支持跨任务的VLA适配，减少对目标任务机器人演示与微调的依赖，为开放世界VLA泛化提供可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale robot datasets and foundation models for general-purpose robot manipulation. However, their ability to rapidly adapt to novel manipulation tasks beyond the training distribution remains limited. Existing approaches often require task-specific robot demonstrations and additional training, which are labor- and compute-intensive, limiting the scalability of VLA adaptation to open-world scenarios. To reduce this dependence on target-task robot data, we propose CapPro, a framework that enables a VLA policy to adapt to previously unseen manipulation tasks using only a single human demonstration video. CapPro consists of two components. First, a phase-aware human video representation module constructs a compact video representation through learned visual token selection and learns task-relevant query representations under phase-caption supervision. Second, a video-conditioned adaptation module jointly incorporates the compact video and query-derived representations into the action-conditioning context of the pretrained VLA policy. % This design introduces task-specific guidance while largely preserving the original VLA action-generation backbone. In this way, the human demonstration provides task-specific execution guidance rather than an embodiment-aligned trajectory to imitate, without requiring target-task robot demonstrations or target-task fine-tuning. Experiments across source and unseen target tasks show that CapPro improves average performance across unseen target groups while maintaining comparable performance on the source tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of human-video guidance for cross-task VLA adaptation.

</details>


### [1124] [Coordi-pi: Coordination-Aware Dual-Hand Action Representation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19753)
*Meng, Yiming,Shao, Yanming,Shen, Weijie,Lin, Kunyang,Sun, Jiayu,Luo, Ping,Mu, Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Coordi-π，将双臂灵巧操作的动作表示改为左右手“动作token交错序列”，用可学习手别嵌入与“序列位置-控制时刻”分解式RoPE显式编码双手身份与时间同步，在DexJoCo五项任务及四个真机任务上超越π0.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂灵巧操作的动作空间高维且具结构，但现有双臂VLA策略普遍把左右臂-手动作在每个控制时刻直接拼接成单一向量，导致跨手交互与同步关系仅隐式存在，模型难以学习协调性。

Method: 将右侧与左侧臂-手动作分别视为独立动作token并组织成交错序列，从而在动作序列中显式暴露两侧；引入可学习的手别嵌入区分左右手；设计“序列位置—控制时刻”分解式旋转位置编码（RoPE），把序列位置与控制时刻解耦，使同一控制时刻的动作共享时间坐标但保持不同序列位置。

Result: 在DexJoCo全部五个双臂灵巧操作任务上，rand-obj与rand-full设定均达SOTA；相对π0.5平均成功率由31.9%提升至51.3%（rand-obj），由18.3%提升至32.3%（rand-full）。在四个真实双臂灵巧操作任务上亦稳定优于π0.5。

Conclusion: 结构化的交错动作token表示加上手别嵌入与分解式RoPE，是提升双臂灵巧VLA协调性的一种有效且可迁移的动作空间设计，仿真与真机均验证其增益。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but extending them to bimanual dexterous manipulation introduces a high-dimensional and structured action space. Existing bimanual VLA policies commonly concatenate right- and left-side arm--hand actions at each control timestep, leaving cross-hand interactions implicit within a single action vector. We introduce Coordi-$\pi$, a structured action representation for bimanual dexterous manipulation. Coordi-$\pi$ represents the right- and left-side arm--hand actions as individual action tokens and organizes them into an interleaved sequence, explicitly exposing the two sides within the action sequence. To explicitly encode hand identity and temporal synchronization in this interleaved representation, a learnable hand-identity embedding distinguishes the two sides, while sequence--control-timestep factorized rotary positional encoding (RoPE) separates sequence position from control timestep, allowing actions at the same control timestep to share a temporal coordinate while retaining distinct sequence positions. Across all five bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks in DexJoCo, Coordi-$\pi$ achieves state-of-the-art performance under both \textit{rand-obj} and \textit{rand-full}, improving the average success rate over $\pi_{0.5}$ from 31.9\% to 51.3\% and from 18.3\% to 32.3\%, respectively. Coordi-$\pi$ also consistently outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ across four real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [1125] [Mixed-Reality Feedback Control: Towards Blending of Control and Digital Twinning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19759)
*Soydan, Melisa,Gleirscher, Mario*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种在多个“现实”（仿真、实体装置等）同时运行的被控对象之间混合（融合/解耦）控制输入与反馈信号的框架，以支持数字孪生与联合仿真中的原型、验证与确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合仿真与数字孪生被用于控制系统的原型与V&V，但跨越多种现实（仿真/实物）的反馈回路需要控制工程建模技术提供更专门的支持；现有建模方法对多现实的信号处理支持不足，因此需要将这一工作沿系统生命周期 streamlined 化。

Method: 提出一个用于在同时运行的多个被控对象（multiple realities）之间混合控制信号（输入/反馈，即刺激/响应）的框架，核心操作是融合（fusing）与解耦（defusing）控制输入与反馈信号。

Result: 摘要为框架性/概念性陈述，未给出具体实验结果、定量指标或机器人实证。

Conclusion: 该框架旨在为控制工程中跨多现实的数字孪生/联合仿真提供统一的信号混合建模支持，简化系统生命周期中的相关工作。

Abstract: Technologies, such as co-simulation, in particular, digital twins (DTs) are used for comprehensive and reliable prototyping, verification and validation (V&V) of control systems. There, the combination of feedback loops across multiple realities (e.g., simulations, physical setups) enables various forms of experimentation with robots and autonomous systems. However, the handling of multiple realities requires a more specific support by the modelling techniques used in control engineering. To streamline the latter in the system life cycle, we propose a framework for mixing (i.e., fusing, defusing) control input and feedback signals (i.e., stimuli, responses) in simultaneously operated plants for multiple realities.

</details>


### [1126] [Refine Actions If Needed: Adaptive Action Chunk Refinement for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19765)
*Liu, Hanlin,Zhou, Zichen,Zhang, Jiacheng,Na, Liuyuan,Jin, Jin,Chen, Guangyan,Yue, Yufeng,Li, Gen,Ding, Fangqiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAIN 框架，通过预测不同精炼层级下的动作误差，在精炼前动态决定是否精炼及精炼程度，从而在保持低推理延迟的同时提升操作任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量操作策略推理延迟低但存在预测误差，迭代生成策略成功率高但重复网络评估增加延迟。需要在两者间取得平衡，但不同状态所需的精炼程度不同，因此需要自适应决定是否及精炼多少。

Method: 训练一个集成模型，通过将动作提案及其精炼版本与离线专家动作对比来预测各精炼层级的误差，无需显式精炼需求标签；通过校准平衡不确定性、计算量与时间一致性，实现动作提案的精炼决策。

Result: 在 8 个 ManiSkill 任务和 4 个真实机器人任务上评估。仿真中成功率达 66.6%，接近最优扩散策略且策略延迟降低 5.71 倍。真实机器人上成功率从 ACT 的 55.0% 提升至 72.5%，平均成功完成时间相当。匹配对照显示动态路由在减少 26.6% 精炼器评估的同时维持最强固定精炼成功水平。

Conclusion: RAIN 通过误差预测实现自适应精炼决策，在显著降低推理延迟的同时提升操作任务成功率，仿真与真实机器人实验均验证了有效性。

Abstract: Computationally lightweight manipulation policies predict executable actions with low inference latency, but prediction errors can limit task success. Iterative generative policies can achieve higher task success rates, but repeated network evaluations increase inference latency. Refining action proposals from computationally lightweight policies can combine these strengths, but the amount of refinement needed varies across states. We introduce RAIN (Refine Actions If Needed), a framework that predicts action errors at different refinement levels to decide whether and how much to refine each executable proposal, before performing any refinement. We train an ensemble to predict these errors by comparing action proposals and their refined versions with expert actions from offline demonstrations, without requiring explicit labels of refinement needs. Calibration balances uncertainty, computation, and temporal consistency. We evaluate RAIN on eight ManiSkill tasks and four real-robot tasks. In simulation, our policy achieves 66.6% success, approaching the best evaluated diffusion-policy success rate with 5.71 times lower policy latency. On the real robot, success increases from 55.0% with Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) to 72.5%, with comparable average successful completion time. Matched controls show that dynamic routing maintains the strongest observed fixed-refinement success level with 26.6% fewer refiner evaluations. Project page: https://rain-policy.github.io/.

</details>


### [1127] [Design and Characterization of a Unified Continuum Robot Actuation Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19798)
*Xu, Yunti,Mangan, Aedan,Potdar, Miheer,Lu, Alex,Morimoto, Tania K.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 模块化统一驱动平台，将驱动硬件/软件与连续体机器人设计解耦，支持多类连续体机器人、大自由度扩展及与串联机械臂的混合架构；在开源手术机器人系统上验证，达到亚毫米平移精度与小于5°旋转误差，并演示遥操作与双手操作两个手术用例，全部开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人可灵巧进入受限空间（微创手术、工业检测），但驱动系统通常针对特定机器人构型与任务定制，导致跨论文、跨机构、跨应用难以复用。作者希望提供一个统一的驱动平台，将驱动硬件与软件从机器人本体设计中解耦，提升复用性与可扩展性。

Method: 提出统一驱动平台：模块化驱动单元，覆盖多类连续体机器人；可扩展至大自由度数量；可与传统串联机械臂集成构成混合架构。平台配ROS软件栈。通过开源手术机器人系统进行验证，对驱动模块进行实验表征，并在两个手术场景中演示：受限环境下的连续体相机遥操作，以及2.53 mm同心管机器人镊子与常规腕式器械的双手操作。

Result: 驱动模块实验表征显示：在30 mm平移范围与180°旋转范围内分别达到亚毫米平移精度和小于5°旋转误差；成功演示两例手术使用场景（受限空间相机遥操作、同心管镊子+腕式器械双手操作）；硬件设计与ROS软件全部开源。

Conclusion: 该统一驱动平台实现了驱动系统与连续体机器人本体的解耦，具备模块化、大自由度可扩展性与混合架构集成能力，并在手术机器人上验证了精度与可行性；开源发布以促进复用与后续研究。

Abstract: Continuum robots enable dexterous access to confined spaces in applications such as minimally invasive surgery and industrial inspection. However, their actuation systems are often custom-designed for specific robot architectures and tasks, limiting reuse across publications, institutions, and applications. This paper presents a unified actuation platform that decouples actuation hardware and software from continuum robot design. The platform provides modular actuation across continuum robot classes, scales to a large number of degrees of freedom (DOFs), and integrates with conventional serial manipulators for hybrid architectures. We validate the platform on an open-sourced surgical robotic system and experimentally characterize the actuation modules, achieving sub-millimeter translational accuracy and less than $5^\circ$ rotational error over ranges of $30$~mm and $180^\circ$, respectively. We further demonstrate the platform in two surgical use cases: teleoperation of a continuum camera in a constrained environment and bimanual manipulation using $2.53$~mm concentric-tube-robot-based forceps alongside a conventional wristed instrument. All hardware designs and ROS-based software are open-sourced to facilitate reuse and further research in continuum and surgical robotics.

</details>


### [1128] [Learning from Demonstrations meets Symbolic Control - A Supervisory Control Architecture for Formal Certification of Learned Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19815)
*Kumar, Ashok,Anand, Mahathi,Schoellig, Angela,Swikir, Abdalla*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出符号化监督控制架构，为基于动力系统（DS）的学习演示运动自动生成失效安全备份计划，直接从机器人动力学证书化安全性、可达性与执行器可行性，实现非保守干预，并在2D/3D数据集与真实机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DS-based LfD虽能生成灵活机器人运动，但其安全与目标收敛的形式化保证依赖证书生成，且通常与学习模型绑定，难以在复杂动态环境中稳定成立。作者希望将形式化保证从学习动力学中解耦。

Method: 提出符号化监督控制架构：名义控制器跟踪学习到的DS；监督控制器监控安全性与目标收敛，当名义控制器违反必要约束时触发干预。备份计划与失效安全策略基于机器人动力学自动生成，独立于学习DS，从而证书化安全性、可达性和执行器可行性。

Result: 在仿真与真实机器人上、使用多种2D与3D数据集（含手写数据集）进行验证，结果表明即使在复杂动态环境中，该架构也能为学习运动提供形式化保证并有效干预。

Conclusion: 学习运动与形式化安全保证可解耦：通过独立于学习DS的符号化监督层自动合成失效安全备份，可在保证安全、可达与执行器可行的同时保留DS运动的灵活性。

Abstract: Dynamical system (DS)-based learning from demonstration generates flexible robot motions, but existing guarantees rely on certificate generation to obtain formal guarantees of safety and goal convergence. We propose a symbolic supervisory control architecture that automatically generates a fail-safe backup plan, certifying safety, reachability, and actuator feasibility directly from the robot's dynamics, independent of the learned DS. A nominal controller tracks the learned DS, while the supervisory controller monitors safety and target convergence, providing non-conservative intervention when the nominal controller violates necessary constraints. Experimental results include simulations and real robot deployment with various 2D and 3D datasets, including handwriting datasets, validating the effectiveness of our approach in providing formal guarantees with learned motion even in complex, dynamic environments.

</details>


### [1129] [What Matters for World Modeling in Vision-Language-Action Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19825)
*Ma, Qisen,Chen, Yixiang,Xu, Yuan,Li, Peiyan,Yang, Jiabing,Wang, Kai,Yang, Jianhua,Si, Jianlou,Huang, Jun,Liu, Jing,Liu, Nianfeng,Huang, Yan,Wang, Liang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 统一框架下拆解四类世界模型与VLA集成范式（隐式对齐、显式查询、MoT专家、外部预测器），跨域系统评测后发现：世界表示有效性依赖于范式，解耦式MoT Future Expert综合最优且OOD鲁棒性突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型与VLA结合是热点方向，但现有工作在表示形式、集成方式、策略骨干上同时变化，导致无法判断哪一因素真正起作用，缺少控制变量的公平比较。

Method: 将已有工作归为四类范式（Implicit Future Alignment、Explicit Future Query、MoT Future Expert、External World Predictor），在同一统一框架内逐一实现，并组合不同世界表示与策略骨干，在域内、OOD、长时程、动态、少样本及真实世界场景下做消融式系统评测。

Result: 四条结论：(1) 世界表示效果依赖范式，但2D语义表示带来跨范式稳健增益；(2) 无普适最优范式，解耦的MoT Future Expert整体表现有竞争力，OOD鲁棒性尤佳；(3) 世界建模对基于标准VLM的策略稳定有益，解耦设计对预训练VLA兼容性更好；(4) 相对仅动作基线在多设置下均有提升，长时程与动态任务增益显著。

Conclusion: 该工作为VLA中世界模型集成提供受控对比的方法论框架与经验性设计准则，回答了“什么因素真正重要”，为后续范式选择与表示/骨干搭配提供依据。

Abstract: Integrating world models into Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) has emerged as a promising direction, enabling policies to anticipate future dynamics beyond reactive observation-to-action mapping. However, existing approaches vary simultaneously in their world representations, integration paradigms, and policy backbones, making it difficult to determine what truly matters for effective world model integration. To disentangle these factors, we categorize existing efforts into four representative paradigms, namely Implicit Future Alignment, Explicit Future Query, MoT Future Expert, and External World Predictor. We instantiate each within a unified framework and systematically evaluate these paradigms with diverse world representations and policy backbones across in-domain, out-of-domain, long-horizon, dynamic, few-shot, and real-world settings. Our study yields four main findings: 1) world representation effectiveness is paradigm-dependent, whereas 2D semantic representations offer robust, cross-paradigm gains; 2) no single paradigm is universally optimal, yet the decoupled MoT Future Expert offers competitive overall performance, particularly in OOD robustness; 3) world modeling consistently benefits policies built on standard VLMs, while decoupled designs exhibit greater compatibility with pretrained VLAs; and 4) world modeling improves performance over action-only baselines across multiple settings, with notable gains on long-horizon and dynamic tasks. Project page and video demonstrations are available at https://dylanmqs.github.io/WM-in-VLAs/.

</details>


### [1130] [FOMI: A Force-Feedback Manipulation Interface for Teaching Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19839)
*Shen, Yishu,Luo, Yiming,Wang, Ruilin,Yang, Bowen,Yang, Shuai,Xu, Fangyi,Shen, Yujun,Zhang, Fu,Zhou, Boyu,Xu, Yinghao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FOMI：基于剪叉式无传感器力反馈的手持操作接口，用于无机器人采集中接触丰富任务的人类示范采集与遥操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无机器人手持采集可扩展获取人类示范，但现有手持接口缺乏直观力反馈，导致接触丰富任务（contact-rich）示范采集困难，操作者难以实时调整动作。

Method: 提出剪叉（scissor-shaped）机构的手持力反馈接口 FOMI，通过传动连杆将物体交互力直接传至操作者双手，无需力传感器；配套构建示范采集系统（传感器标定、数据采集、时间同步），并将 FOMI 的位姿变化与夹爪开合映射到机器人末端位姿与夹爪指令以支持遥操作。

Result: 在四类接触丰富任务上，FOMI 相比最优基线在无机器人采集与遥操作中分别提升约 29% 与 18% 的采集效率；两种模式下采集的示范均可训练出高成功率的接触丰富操作策略。

Conclusion: 无传感器、机械式力反馈的手持接口可有效提升接触丰富示范的采集效率与质量，并兼顾遥操作，为策略学习提供可扩展数据来源。

Abstract: Robot-free collection with handheld interfaces enables scalable acquisition of human demonstrations for policy learning. However, existing handheld interfaces often provide limited intuitive force feedback, making contact-rich demonstration collection challenging for human operators. To address this, we present FOMI, a force-feedback manipulation interface with a scissor-shaped mechanism, which transmits object interaction forces directly to the operator's hands through actuation links without force sensors. This intuitive force feedback supports real-time action adjustment during robot-free collection of contact-rich demonstrations. Around FOMI, we build a demonstration collection system that integrates sensor calibration, data acquisition, and synchronization for robot-free collection. By further mapping pose changes and gripper opening of FOMI to robot end-effector poses and gripper commands, the system also supports teleoperation. Across four contact-rich tasks, FOMI improves collection efficiency by approximately 29% and 18% over the best baselines in robot-free collection and teleoperation, respectively. Demonstrations collected with FOMI in both modes enable policies to perform challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks with high success rates.

</details>


### [1131] [Active Perception of Upper-Limb Functional Mobility through Human-Robot Handovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19896)
*Semeraro, Francesco,Lagomarsino, Marta,Ranavolo, Alberto,Ajoudani, Arash*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作将上肢功能活动度的估计建模为主动感知问题，用损伤系数参数化关节活动范围缩减，构建贝叶斯在线估计流程，使机器人在反复递物（handover）交互中主动探测并逐步更新对人类关节级能力的信念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上肢损伤者重返工作岗位过程漫长，共享工作空间中的协作机器人与人形机器人需要根据人类伙伴的身体能力调整自身行为。这要求机器人无需依赖外部临床评估，就能在与人类交互过程中自主估计与任务相关的人体运动能力。

Method: 将上肢功能性移动能力估计形式化为主动感知问题：用损伤系数（impairment coefficients）刻画健康关节限位的缩减，从而建模任务可用的上肢功能活动范围；将该表示集成进机器人交互时使用的人体模型中；据此提出在线主动感知流程——机器人通过反复的递物请求主动探测用户，并对损伤系数维护一个贝叶斯信念并渐进更新，从而持续细化对用户关节级能力的内部模型（主动探测而非被动观察）。

Result: 通过仿真研究以及使用机器人平台与人工模拟（enacted）人类损伤的概念验证物理实验进行验证，结果表明该流程能够在真实的人-机器人递物过程中准确恢复损伤系数。

Conclusion: 主动感知式的人体功能能力在线估计可以在日常人机交互中实现，为面向康复/重返岗位场景的自适应协作机器人行为提供了无需临床评估的自主建模途径；但验证规模较小（仿真加概念验证），尚需更大规模真实用户研究。

Abstract: The reintegration of people in the workplace after an upper-limb injury is often a long process. Collaborative robots and humanoids operating in shared workspaces must adapt their behavior to the physical capabilities of their human partners. Achieving this requires robots to autonomously estimate task-relevant human mobility during interaction, without relying on external clinical assessments. In this work, we formulate the estimation of upper-limb functional mobility as an active perception problem. We model task-available upper-limb functional ranges of motion through impairment coefficients that parameterize reductions of healthy joint limits, and integrate this representation into a human model used by the robot during interaction. Based on this formulation, we propose an online active perception pipeline in which the robot actively probes the user through repeated handover requests while progressively updating a Bayesian belief over the impairment coefficients.
