This enables the robot to continuously refine its internal model of the user's joint-level capabilities through interaction rather than passive observation. The proposed framework was evaluated through simulation studies and a proof-of-concept physical validation with a robotic platform and enacted human impairments, demonstrating that the pipeline can accurately recover the impairment coefficients during real human-robot handovers.

</details>


### [1132] [MUCO: A Mani-Unit-Structured Manipulation Framework for Compositional Long-Horizon Robot Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19913)
*Wei, Xiangyi,Yao, Hanzhe,Shang, Jingwen,Wu, Zhenhong,Li, Yang,Wang, Changbo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"操作单元"(MU)作为可复用局部技能,用MU-Centric Orchestration (MUCO) 在语言+视觉下编排MU序列、匹配冻结能力注册表中的策略模型并通过视觉验证控制状态转移,在RLBench、RoboTwin 2.0及5个真实任务上优于基线,实现跨任务复用与异构策略组合而无需联合训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整长时程轨迹式学习与执行导致数据采集成本高、能力复用受限、局部失败向后级联。作者希望以可复用的局部操作为基本单元,解耦技能学习与任务编排,从而实现能力复用、失败隔离与异构策略组合。

Method: 将每个MU定义为局部目标+启动条件+可观测的成功/失败判据,单独学习与验证;将问题形式化为MU-Structured Manipulation (MUSM),并以MUCO实现:给定语言与视觉输入构建MU序列,为每个MU在冻结能力注册表中匹配兼容策略模型,选择标定成功率最高者执行;视觉验证MU结果并据此决定重试或回退到其他模型,已通过的MU不重复执行;用规范化键(canonical keys)实现跨任务等价MU的checkpoint复用。

Result: 在RLBench、RoboTwin 2.0及5个真实世界任务上,MUCO在完整任务成功率、经验证进度、失败抑制能力上优于基线,错误传播更低;展示了跨任务MU复用与异构策略组合能力,无需联合训练、共享backbone或统一动作表示。

Conclusion: 以MU为中间抽象的分层编排可有效缓解长时程操作中的数据成本、复用受限与级联失败问题,支持即插即用的异构策略组合与跨任务技能复用。

Abstract: Learning and executing long-horizon robot manipulation as complete task trajectories raises data-collection costs, lim?its capability reuse, and causes local failures to cascade into later task stages. We introduce manipulation units (MUs) as reusable operations, each defined by a local goal, an initi?ation condition, and observable success and failure criteria. MUs are learned and verified individually. During execution, consecutive MUs remain coupled through shared environ?ment dynamics. We formulate MU-Structured Manipulation (MUSM) and realize it through MU-Centric Orchestration (MUCO). Given language and vision, MUCO constructs an MU sequence, matches each MU to compatible policy models in a frozen capability registry, and dispatches the model with the highest calibrated success rate. Visual verification checks MU outcomes against success and failure criteria and governs transitions, enabling retry or fallback to another model from the current state without re-executing verified MUs. Canonical keys enable checkpoint reuse for equivalent MUs across tasks without new demonstrations or updates. We evaluate MUCO on RLBench, RoboTwin 2.0, and five real-world tasks. MUCO achieves higher complete-task success and verified progress, stronger failure containment, and lower error propagation than baselines. Results demonstrate cross-task MU reuse and het?erogeneous policy composition without joint training, shared backbones, or common action representations.

</details>


### [1133] [Complementary Future Token Pruning for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19957)
*Kim, Baekseung,Lee, Junhoo,Hong, Sohyeon,Jeon, Suhyun,Kim, Minkyu,Kim, Seungyeon,Han, Donghoon,Kwak, Nojun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CF-Prune是一个无需训练的未来帧token剪枝框架，用于加速世界动作模型（WAM）的推理，在35%-50%剪枝率下实现1.19-1.33倍加速且成功率不降反升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）联合预测未来视觉状态与机器人动作，但密集的未来帧token带来显著的推理延迟，阻碍实时部署。核心洞察是：未来视觉预测是为动作生成服务的，因此不必保留高保真视频合成所需的所有视觉细节，从而可以通过token剪枝加速推理。

Method: 提出CF-Prune，一个针对预训练WAM的免训练未来帧token剪枝框架。它在初始去噪前向传播中结合指令注意力与动作注意力，即使在未来帧与动作表示噪声很大的情况下也能识别任务相关token；并引入基于熵的相位识别机制，在精度敏感阶段保留密集计算，以缓解剪枝带来的性能退化。

Result: 在RoboLab、RoboCasa和真实世界操作任务上均取得一致的推理加速。35%剪枝率下平均加速1.19-1.27倍，且任务成功率提升；50%剪枝率下在两个仿真基准上平均加速1.29-1.33倍，总体成功率与基线差距在1.0个百分点以内。

Conclusion: CF-Prune表明，面向动作生成的未来帧token存在大量冗余，通过注意力引导的免训练剪枝与去噪相位自适应计算，可在几乎不损失成功率甚至提升成功率的前提下显著加速WAM推理，为世界模型的实时机器人部署提供了实用路径。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual states and robot actions, but processing dense future-frame tokens incurs substantial inference latency. We propose CF-Prune, a training-free framework for pruning future-frame tokens in pretrained WAMs. Our key insight is that future visual predictions support action generation and therefore need not preserve every visual detail required for high-fidelity video synthesis. CF-Prune combines instruction and action attention to identify task-relevant tokens during the initial denoising forward pass, even when future-frame and action representations remain highly noisy. An entropy-based phase identification mechanism further retains dense computation during precision phases to mitigate pruning-induced performance degradation. Experiments on RoboLab, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate consistent inference speedups. At a 35% pruning ratio, CF-Prune achieves average speedups of 1.19-1.27x while improving task success rates. At a 50% pruning ratio, it achieves 1.29-1.33x average speedups on both simulation benchmarks, with overall success rates within 1.0 percentage point of the baseline.

</details>


### [1134] [MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20019)
*Liu, Ziyan,Liu, Jiting,Zhong, Weihong,Yu, Wenda,Chen, Yeqiu,Li, Jason,Peng, Xiaojiang,Hu, Shuyuan,Wang, Kai,Zhao, Bo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MorphAct 提出上下文参数化框架，用两个耦合生成器为视觉语言与动作模块动态生成上下文相关的低秩参数更新，缓解多任务间梯度冲突，在 LIBERO、Meta-World 及真机上取得最高 16.30% / 14% 提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略使用跨交互上下文固定的共享参数，当不同操作任务偏好相互竞争的参数调整时，混合拟合会导致单任务适配不足。作者通过 atomic-task 诊断发现视觉语言参数与动作参数中存在相互冲突的更新方向：对某任务有效的更新会增大其他任务的损失。

Method: MorphAct 是一个上下文参数化框架，随交互上下文动态调整策略参数。两个耦合生成器分别产生视觉语言与动作模块的上下文相关低秩更新；耦合方式遵循策略计算依赖：视觉语言更新塑造用于条件化动作侧参数生成的表征。两个生成器通过原生动作目标联合训练，无需操作标签或专家适配器目标。

Result: 在三种 VLA 主干网络上于 LIBERO 与 Meta-World 均提升性能，增益最高达 16.30%；真实世界评测中相对 π0.5 提升最高约 14%。消融实验验证了上下文参数生成与表征耦合的收益。

Conclusion: 将参数生成条件化到交互上下文并耦合视觉语言与动作侧生成，可有效缓解共享参数下的任务冲突，且无需额外标注即可端到端训练，具备跨主干与真机迁移能力。

Abstract: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. Our atomic-task diagnostics reveal competing update directions in both vision-language and action parameters, with source-improving updates increasing loss on other tasks. This motivates MorphAct, a contextual parameterization framework that dynamically adjusts robot policy parameters as interaction contexts change. Two coupled generators produce context-dependent low-rank updates for the vision-language and action modules. Their coupling follows the policy's computational dependency: vision-language updates shape the representations that condition action-side parameter generation. Both generators are trained jointly through the native action objective, without operation labels or expert-adapter targets. MorphAct improves performance across three VLA backbones on LIBERO and Meta-World, with gains of up to 16.30%. In real-world evaluation, it achieves gains of up to 14% over $\pi_{0.5}$. Ablations support the benefits of contextual parameter generation and representation coupling.

</details>


### [1135] [FoveaVLA: Foveation Actions Replace the Wrist Camera in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20064)
*Chen, Bingao,Zha, Lihan,Liu, C. Karen,Tevet, Guy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FoveaVLA用"学习式注视动作"替代腕部相机：策略在输出动作块的同时预测下一查询时刻需要观察的交互区域，并接收该区域的全分辨率裁剪图配合全局视图，在DROID+RoboInter上后训练π0.5，真实任务成功率70.8%–77.1%，显著超过带腕相机的52.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕部相机虽提供近距离细节，但视野被限制在末端执行器周围；外置相机可见全场景，却只能以低分辨率输入策略，导致操作所需的精细细节丢失。作者希望在不增加腕相机硬件的前提下，同时获得全局上下文与高分辨率交互细节。

Method: 提出FoveaVLA，以学习的foveation动作取代腕相机。策略在预测每个动作块（action chunk）时，同步预测下一次策略查询时应观察的交互区域；随后从原始分辨率图像中裁剪该区域，与全视图一起输入策略。基于π0.5构建Single（单外置立体相机）和Dual（双外置立体相机）两种配置，输入包含全视图与注视区域的RGB和深度。使用DROID数据集并借助RoboInter交互标注进行后训练。

Result: 在四个真实世界任务套件上，FoveaVLA-Single取得70.8%成功率（单个外置RGB-D视图），FoveaVLA-Dual取得77.1%，基线带腕相机的π0.5为52.1%。两者在普通抓取放置任务上与基线持平，在存在干扰物、布料操作和远距离物体场景下成功率提升明显。

Conclusion: 通过学习式注视动作动态选择高分辨率观察区域，可在仅使用外置相机的条件下超越传统腕相机方案，为VLA的感知-动作耦合提供了一种兼顾全局上下文与局部细节的简洁替代范式。

Abstract: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $\pi_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $\pi_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.

</details>


### [1136] [HM3D-M3: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent, Multi-Modal, Multi-Object Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20121)
*Ding, Hongyu,Xu, Kanyu,Chen, Mingjia,Chen, Zixuan,Shi, Jieqi,Huo, Jing,Zhang, Yifan,Gao, Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HM3D-M3 基准，首次在同一 episode 中统一多机器人、多模态、多目标导航，并给出 HiGA（分层目标分配器）与 LaViRA-M3（免训练 VLM 智能体团队）两个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准将多智能体、多模态、多目标导航分开研究，缺少三者融合的统一评测；而真实场景中人往往一次性向机器人团队下达多个、形式各异（类别名、照片、语音描述）的目标。

Method: 构建 HM3D-M3：K 个智能体从分散位置出发，在真实感室内场景中搜索 M 个无序目标，目标可为开放词汇类别、实例图像或实例描述。提供 1000 个验证 episode、3926 个目标、379 个开放词汇类别、10 万条观测-分配训练样本，以及 goal-level SR 与 makespan 归一化 SPL 两项团队级指标。提出两个基线：HiGA（冻结开放词汇导航策略之上的可训练分层目标分配器）和 LaViRA-M3（共享建图与进度分析的免训练 VLM 智能体团队），并部署于异构三机器人团队。

Result: 适配的多机器人方法与零样本方法 SR 为 16–27%，两个基线达到 38–41%，且优势互补、失败模式各异；LaViRA-M3 已在异构三机器人团队上完成部署验证。

Conclusion: HM3D-M3 填补了多智能体×多模态×多目标导航联合评测的空白，为机器人团队协作寻物提供统一数据、指标与强基线，并展示了真机异构多机器人部署的可行性。

Abstract: Rapid progress in AI agents and robotics makes it a matter of the near future that humans are served by a team of robots. Such a team will receive several goals at once, each specified in whatever form is convenient for the human, such as a category name, a photo, or a spoken description. Existing benchmarks study multi-agent, multi-modal, and multi-object goal navigation in isolation, and a benchmark that places all three in one episode is missing. To fill this gap, we introduce HM3D-M3. A team of K agents starts at distributed locations in a photorealistic indoor scene and searches for an unordered set of M object goals, each given as an open-vocabulary category, an instance image, or an instance description. HM3D-M3 provides 1,000 validation episodes over 3,926 goals from 379 open-vocabulary categories, 100K observation-assignment training samples, and two team-level metrics, goal-level SR and makespan-normalized SPL. We further contribute two baselines. HiGA is a trained hierarchical goal assigner on top of a frozen open-vocabulary navigation policy, and LaViRA-M3 is a training-free team of VLM agents with shared mapping and progress analysis. Adapted multi-robot and zero-shot methods reach 16--27% SR, while our baselines reach 38--41% with complementary strengths and distinct failure modes. Furthermore, we deploy LaViRA-M3 on a heterogeneous three-robot team. Project page: https://robo-lavira.github.io/hm3d-m3/

</details>


### [1137] [Tactile-Guided Robot Learning: From Representation Learning to Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20134)
*Nazari, Kiyanoush,Li, Luchen,Fang, Haoshu,Fazeli, Nima,Li, Zhibin,Iida, Fumiya,Thuruthel, Thomas George*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这是一篇以"学习为中心"视角综述触觉引导技能学习的论文，按触觉在感知-学习-控制流程中的功能角色组织，覆盖触觉表征与策略学习、触觉基础模型、预测与自适应控制、跨物体/任务/传感器/本体/仿真到现实的泛化，并指出未来触觉基础模型与世界模型方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉感知已成为鲁棒、自适应、灵巧机器人操作的核心。然而现有综述多聚焦触觉硬件与感知，未能充分综合快速发展的"基于学习的触觉操作"这一转向。作者希望从学习中心视角系统梳理触觉在学习与控制流程中的功能角色。

Method: 文献综述方法：以触觉在学习与控制管线中的功能角色为组织维度，分主题梳理触觉表征学习与策略学习、触觉基础模型、预测性与自适应控制，以及跨物体、任务、传感器、本体和仿真到现实迁移的泛化问题；归纳共性设计原则与开放挑战，并附带在线文献数据库。

Result: 识别出若干共性设计原则与关键挑战：可迁移物理表征的学习、语义推理与接触级控制的融合、跨异构数据与硬件的触觉学习规模化；并勾勒出可预测、可推理、可适应物理交互的触觉基础模型与世界模型等新兴方向。

Conclusion: 综述刻画了触觉从任务专用反馈信号向通用具身智能核心模态的转变，为触觉引导操作的学习方法提供了统一框架与未来路线图。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is becoming central to robust, adaptive, and dexterous robotic manipulation. Beyond its traditional role in contact detection and reactive control, touch is increasingly used to learn transferable representations, condition manipulation policies, and support embodied physical reasoning. Yet existing surveys largely emphasize tactile hardware and perception, leaving the rapid shift toward learning-based tactile manipulation insufficiently synthesized. This paper reviews tactile-guided skill learning from a learning-centric perspective, organized by the functional role of touch across the learning and control pipeline. We examine tactile representation and policy learning, tactile foundation models, predictive and adaptive control, and generalization across objects, tasks, sensors, embodiments, and simulation-to-real transfer. Across these directions, we identify common design principles and remaining challenges in learning transferable physical representations, integrating semantic reasoning with contact-level control, and scaling tactile learning across heterogeneous data and hardware. Finally, we outline emerging directions toward tactile foundation and world models that can predict, reason about, and adapt physical interactions. Together, this review characterizes the transition of touch from a task-specific feedback signal toward a core modality for general-purpose embodied intelligence. An accompanying database of the reviewed literature and associated resources is available at https://sites.google.com/view/touch-in-robot-learning-review.

</details>


### [1138] [Enabling Tidying Tasks in Robotic Vacuum Cleaners via a Geometry-Induced Self-Locking Deployable Linkage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20150)
*Song, Eunseok,Kim, inwoong,Lim, Sohee,Kim, Taehyeong,Kim, Yongkook,Lim, Hyeontaek,Son, Hyungmin,Hyung, Seungyong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 一种用于扫地机器人的两阶段可展开自锁连杆机构：全展开时内部三连杆子链接近共线奇异性，传动比趋零实现几何自锁，单电机完成展开与锁定，被动扳机解锁回收，第二电机调节高度；实机集成并完成100次循环、50 N静载与140次整理试验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扫地机器人受尺寸、成本与耐用性限制，需在少量驱动器的前提下扩展功能。可展开连杆虽满足这些约束，但其可反向驱动性导致维持承载姿态必须持续输出电机力矩，能耗与发热均不可接受，因此需要一种在几何层面实现自锁的展开机构。

Method: 设计两阶段可展开连杆：全展开位姿下内部三连杆子链接近共线近奇异构型，输入-输出传动比趋近于零，使板载载荷仅产生极小残余反向驱动力矩，由传动链摩擦与轻量磁定位器吸收。单电机驱动展开与锁定，底盘被动扳机释放锁以回收，第二电机仅调节展开高度；给出解析保持条件并集成至商用扫地机器人。

Result: 100次循环重复性测试；准静态负载测试中锁定板在电机断电条件下承载50 N；在规范协议下对7类家用物品完成140次推式整理试验，并与商用带机械臂扫地机器人对比。同时推导了解析保持条件并讨论其作为被动柔顺与关节式操作之间中间设计点的局限。

Conclusion: 基于近奇异几何自锁的低驱动可展开机构可在严格尺寸、成本与耐久约束下为扫地机器人增加承载与整理功能，形成被动柔顺与主动操作之间的折中设计点。

Abstract: Robotic vacuum cleaners must extend their functionality within tight limits on size, cost, and durability. Deployable linkages with few actuators meet these limits, but their backdrivability makes it difficult to hold a load-bearing posture without continuous motor torque. We introduce a two-stage deployable linkage that is self-locking, in the sense used for toggle and singularity-based linkages, through its own geometry: at full deployment an internal three-link subchain approaches a collinear, near-singular configuration where the input--output transmission ratio approaches zero, so that plate loads produce a small residual back-driving torque, absorbed by drive-train friction and a lightweight magnetic detent. A single actuator performs deployment and locking, a passive chassis-mounted trigger releases the lock for retraction, and a second actuator adjusts only the deployment height. We integrate the mechanism into a commercial robotic vacuum cleaner and validate it through a 100-cycle repeatability test, a quasi-static load test in which the locked plate held 50\,N with the motor de-energized, and 140 pushing-type tidying trials on seven household objects against a commercial arm-equipped vacuum robot under a documented protocol. We derive the analytical holding condition and discuss its limits as an intermediate design point between passive compliance and articulated manipulation.

</details>


### [1139] [Atomic-WAM: Execution-Grounded Atomic-Motion Reasoning for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20157)
*Shi, Shijun,Liu, Zhe,Hou, Zhi,Chen, Yinan,Zhang, Tao,Hu, Kai,Liu, Yong,Zhang, Jiangning*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Atomic-WAM 提出"先理解后执行"框架：由视觉语言推理器生成原子动作描述，引导世界动作模型预测未来视频与动作块，并用 Execution-Grounded GRPO 后训练推理器以提升可执行性，在 RoboLab 真到仿评测中默认指令成功率 39.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务级指令对下一步物理交互描述不足，存在语义欠定与状态相关动作选择问题，需要中间语义层把任务推理与动作生成连接起来。

Method: 将任务指令与视觉上下文交给 VLM 推理器输出"原子动作"描述，作为条件引导 WAM 联合预测未来视频与动作块；构建自动标注流水线，从多视角 DROID 演示中提取时间对齐、接触丰富的监督；对推理器采用 Execution-Grounded GRPO（EG-GRPO）后训练，冻结 WAM，用动作合理性与执行成功作为奖励，使原子动作描述可被 WAM 执行。

Result: 在 RoboLab 的真到仿（real-to-sim）评测中，默认指令任务成功率 39.6%，模糊指令下 31.6%。

Conclusion: 引入原子动作描述作为任务推理与动作生成之间的接口，并用执行反馈强化推理器，可提升世界动作模型在模糊指令下的控制表现，但绝对成功率仍偏低，且缺乏真机验证。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) typically adapt video foundation models to robotic control through joint video and action prediction. However, task-level instructions may leave the next physical interaction underspecified, requiring semantic grounding and state-dependent motion selection. To this end, we introduce Atomic-WAM, an understand-then-execute framework that connects task reasoning to action generation through atomic-motion descriptions. Specifically, a vision-language reasoner describes the next local motion from the task instruction and visual context, guiding a WAM to predict future video and an action chunk. Furthermore, an automatic annotation pipeline curates temporally aligned, contact-enriched supervision from multi-view DROID demonstrations. To make atomic-motion predictions executable by the WAM, we post-train the reasoner with Execution-Grounded GRPO (EG-GRPO). With the WAM fixed, EG-GRPO adapts the reasoner through rewards for motion appropriateness and execution success. Finally, Atomic-WAM achieves 39.6% task success under default instructions and 31.6% under vague instructions in a real-to-sim evaluation on RoboLab. Project page: https://ssj9596.github.io/Atomic-WAM-project

</details>


### [1140] [Investigating Behavior Cloning from Few Demonstrations for Autonomous Driving based on Bird's-Eye View in Simulated Cities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20203)
*Antonelo, Eric Aislan,Couto, Gustavo Claudio Karl,Möller, Christian,Fernandes, Pedro Henrique*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在CARLA中用BEV输入的加权行为克隆（核密度估计调整样本权重）提升模仿驾驶，尤其是红绿灯等稀有动作，跨测试环境路由完成率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆在自动驾驶中常用，但专家演示稀缺时，稀有但关键的动作（红灯停、绿灯行）样本极少，标准BC难以学好，且先前CARLA工作未充分解决信号灯合规问题。

Method: 以BEV俯视图为输入，用CNN结合额外状态变量输出转向与加速度；引入核密度估计器，依据动作密度重加权训练样本，提高稀有动作的损失权重。

Result: CARLA实验表明，加权BC相比标准BC显著提升驾驶性能与路由完成率，在未见测试环境中的收益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 基于动作密度的样本重加权是学习稀有关键驾驶行为的有效手段，有助于提升自动驾驶策略的泛化性与导航能力，但验证仅限仿真。

Abstract: This paper investigates the use of Behavior Cloning (BC) for autonomous driving from a bird's-eye view (BEV) perspective in simulated urban environments. BC uses supervised learning to mimic expert driving behaviors. Previous works have applied BC in the CARLA simulator but did not fully address the challenges of traffic light compliance. Our approach enhances BC by integrating a kernel density estimator to adjust training sample weights based on action density, thereby improving the learning of rare but critical actions such as stopping at red lights and accelerating at green lights, specially in scenarios of scarce number of expert demonstrations. Using BEV inputs, which provide an abstract top-down view of the driving environment, our method simplifies the policy learning process. The trained convolutional neural network (CNN) outputs steering and acceleration actions based on these BEV inputs and additional state variables. Experimental results in the CARLA simulator demonstrate that our weighted BC method significantly improves driving performance, achieving higher route completion compared to standard BC. This weighted approach proved to be crucial in learning correct driving behaviors, particularly in test environments not encountered during training, highlighting its potential for enhancing autonomous vehicle navigation.

</details>


### [1141] [ObjDream: Guiding Vision-Language-Action Models with Object-Level Understanding and Future State Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20223)
*Ma, Huailiang,Li, Yuxuan,Zhao, Ziyi,Wang, Xinkai,Li, Mingyu,Guo, Xinyu,Zhu, Lifeng,Song, Aiguo,Lu, Cewu,Sun, Jianhua*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ObjDream：以对象为中心的VLA框架，用时空对象编码器构建时序对象槽（身份/状态分离），并将其注入VLM token序列，配合身份引导注意力路由与动作条件对象动态预测，提升分布偏移下的操作泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA多沿用预训练视觉-语言骨干的图像级视觉表征，缺乏细粒度对象理解，在物体布局分布外、杂乱与背景变化下鲁棒性下降。

Method: 时空对象编码器将观测组织为时序对象槽，以独立通道表征持久对象身份与动态状态；结构化对象表示插入VLM token序列，通过身份引导路由调制注意力至对应对象token；训练期加入动作条件对象动力学模块，预测紧凑的未来对象状态，显式监督动作下的状态演化，推理时无需未来预测。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0上提升了多类分布偏移与场景扰动下的泛化；真实机器人实验表明可迁移至新物体摆放与背景变化下的物理操作场景。

Conclusion: 面向对象的显式状态建模与未来对象状态监督，是提升VLA操作泛化与鲁棒性的有效途径，且不增加推理开销。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling robots to generate actions from visual observations and language instructions. However, most existing VLA models still operate on image-level visual representations inherited from pretrained vision-language backbones, while lacking fine-grained object understanding for manipulation. As a result, their robustness can degrade under out-of-distribution object layouts, clutter, and background variations. To address these limitations, we introduce ObjDream, an object-centric VLA framework centered on object-level understanding and future object state prediction. ObjDream uses a spatio-temporal object encoder to organize visual observations into temporal object slots, where persistent object identity and dynamic object state are represented through separate channels. These structured object representations are inserted into the token sequence of the vision-language model (VLM), where identity-guided routing modulates VLM attention to the corresponding object tokens. In addition, an action-conditioned object dynamics module predicts compact future object states relevant to manipulation during training, explicitly supervising object state evolution under robot actions without requiring future prediction at inference. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 show that ObjDream improves generalization under diverse distribution shifts and scene perturbations. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate that ObjDream transfers to physical manipulation settings with novel object arrangements and background changes.

</details>


### [1142] [Smart Fusion for Adaptive Visual-IMU Weighting in cuVSLAM Sparse Bundle Adjustment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20226)
*Lee, Wonju,Molloy, Dara,Kumar, Abhilash Nand,Castelo, Onias,Trslic, Petar,Adley, David,Ferguson, Conor,Rabeti, Hesam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出在 cuVSLAM 的稀疏光束法平差中引入标量 α 放大视觉信息矩阵，将视觉-惯性权重选择简化为二值决策，并用 914 参数的 MLP 视觉质量估计器在线预测 α 所在区间，EuRoC 与 TUM-VI 上平均 APE RMSE 分别降低 27.7% 与 14.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: cuVSLAM 中视觉与 IMU 残差按预标定噪声协方差固定加权融合于 SBA，运行时无法自适应调整视觉-惯性平衡；而不同场景下哪一模态更可信差异显著，固定权重导致精度次优。

Method: 引入标量 α≥1 相对 IMU 预积分约束放大视觉信息矩阵，并在候选集 {1,2,5,10,20} 上观察到两段式性能区间（IMU-TRUST：α∈{1,2}；VISION-TRUST：α∈{10,20}；α=5 为过渡），从而把 α 选择化为二值判别。训练轻量 MLP 视觉质量估计器（914 个可训练参数），输入为由跟踪器已有统计量构成的 10 维视觉质量特征，输出每次 SBA 的区间预测。

Result: 在各区间内 α 差异带来的影响远小于区间之间差异，支持二值化选择；该方法在 EuRoC MAV 上使平均 RMSE APE 降低 27.7%，在 TUM-VI Room 上经留一交叉验证降低 14.9%。

Conclusion: 通过在线预测视觉-惯性可信区间的二值权重选择，可在不增加复杂标定流程的前提下显著提升 VSLAM 轨迹精度，且实现代价低（仅 914 参数）。

Abstract: In cuVSLAM, visual and inertial measurement unit (IMU) residuals are fused in sparse bundle adjustment (SBA) with a weighting fixed by pre-calibrated noise covariances, leaving no mechanism to adapt the visual-inertial balance at runtime. We introduce a scalar $\alpha\geq1$ that upscales the visual information matrix relative to the IMU preintegration constraint. Across the candidate set $\{1.0,2.0,5.0,10.0,20.0\}$, the resulting trajectories form two empirical performance regimes. The IMU-TRUST regime contains $\alpha\in\{1,2\}$ near the calibrated baseline, while the VISION-TRUST regime contains $\alpha\in\{10,20\}$. The intermediate value $\alpha=5$ is treated as a transition case. Differences within each regime are small relative to those observed between the regimes. This structure motivates reducing $\alpha$-selection to a binary decision. We train a lightweight Visual Quality Estimator (VQE), implemented as a multilayer perceptron with 914 trainable parameters. It maps a 10-dimensional visual quality feature vector assembled from statistics already maintained by the tracker to a per-SBA regime prediction. The proposed method reduces mean RMSE APE by $27.7\%$ and by $14.9\%$ under leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) on EuRoC MAV and TUM-VI Room, respectively.

</details>


### [1143] [Learning Navigation from Multimodal Demonstrations with Geometric Candidate Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20241)
*Peng, Chengyang,Zhang, Zhihao,Pant, Upama,Wang, Yiming,Redmill, Keith A.,Hereid, Ayonga*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出分层神经网络策略，从局部几何中计算候选运动模式，并用示教数据学习模式选择与执行，从而解决离线导航示教多模态导致的平均化不安全路径问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线导航示教本质上是多模态的：同一观测下常存在多个有效动作（如从障碍两侧绕行）。行为克隆会把这些动作平均化，导致次优甚至不安全的路径。已有离线模仿学习方法需从数据中自行发掘这些备选模式，但相近状态对应不同路径时当前动作可能重叠，难以区分。作者指出导航中的备选方案有明确的几何成因，可由单次观测直接计算。

Method: 方法为分层策略。首先由局部几何计算候选模式集合；高层策略基于目标与上一时刻所选择的模式，在候选模式中进行选择；底层策略将选中的模式转换为具体动作；整体通过离线示教数据学习"跟随哪个模式"与"如何执行该模式"。

Result: 仿真中，在已见与未见测试用例上成功率均超过95%；四个离线学习基线最好仅43%与20%；使用相同模式但不学习的启发式方法为79%与67%。仿真训练的策略还成功迁移到LimX Tron 1双足机器人。

Conclusion: 利用局部几何显式构造候选模式并分层学习选择与执行，可有效缓解行为克隆的平均化问题，显著提升离线导航的多模态决策能力，并具备从仿真到真实双足平台的迁移能力。

Abstract: Offline navigation demonstrations are multimodal, because one observation often allows several valid actions, such as passing an obstacle on either side. Behavior cloning averages these actions, potentially leading to unsafe routes. Multimodal policies must discover the alternatives from the data, but similar states can lead to different routes whose current actions overlap. In navigation, the alternatives have a geometric cause and can be computed from one observation. We propose a hierarchical neural-network policy that computes candidate modes from local geometry and learns from demonstrations which mode to follow and how. A high-level policy selects a mode using the goal and its previous choice among a set of candidate modes, and a low-level policy turns it into an action. In simulation, the policy succeeds in over 95\% of seen and unseen test cases, compared with at most 43\% and 20\% for four offline learning baselines and 79\% and 67\% for a heuristic that uses the same modes without learning. The simulation-trained policy also transfers to a LimX Tron 1 bipedal robot.

</details>


### [1144] [Safe Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Safety Critic and Differentiable Action Shields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20255)
*Ju, Siwei,Peters, Jan,Arenz, Oleg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出递推时域安全评论家（receding-horizon safety critic），从 rollout 标签学习预测未来 H 步内是否终止，结合 CBF 约束与 CVaR 集成，导出闭式可微安全滤波器并与 PPO 联合训练，提升四足运动在扰动与地形偏移下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人强化学习虽假设马尔可夫性，但安全失效往往不是瞬时发生，而是策略在扰动与域偏移下进入陌生状态后经多步累积演化而成。传统单步安全评论家无法提前预判这种"渐进式"失效，因此需要具备前瞻性的安全评估机制。

Method: 1) 学习递推时域安全评论家，预测当前状态在未来递推时域内是否保持非终止；2) 训练目标为复合损失：时域二分类 + 受控制障碍函数（CBF）启发的时序一致性 + 平滑正则；3) 用保守 CVaR 估计聚合评论家集成以建模不确定性；4) 基于该评论家推导闭式、可微的 CBF 型安全滤波器，最小化修改策略动作以提升预测安全性；5) 集成进 PPO，并加入 anticipation loss 缓解训练中策略-滤波器不匹配。

Result: 在仿真四足运动任务中，方法在动作噪声、外部扰动和地形偏移下提升了鲁棒性，减少了灾难性失效，同时保持有竞争力的回报。

Conclusion: 递推时域安全评论家结合 CBF 型滤波器为 RL 策略提供了前瞻性、可微的安全保障，验证了多步安全预判在腿足运动中的有效性；局限在于仅仿真验证，缺乏真实机器人部署证据。

Abstract: Despite the Markov assumption, safety failures in robot reinforcement learning rarely occur instantaneously; they typically emerge over several steps as the policy enters unfamiliar states under disturbances and domain shift. We address this limitation by learning a receding-horizon safety critic that predicts whether a state will remain non-terminating over the next receding horizon, enabling anticipatory detection of impending locomotion failures. The critic is trained from rollout-derived horizon labels with a composite objective that combines horizon classification, control-barrier-function-inspired temporal consistency, and smoothness regularization, and we aggregate an ensemble of critics with a conservative Conditional Value at Risk estimate to account for uncertainty. Building on the learned critic, we derive a closed-form, differentiable CBF-style safety filter that minimally modifies the policy action to improve predicted safety, and integrate it into PPO with an anticipation loss to reduce policy-filter mismatch during training. In simulated quadruped locomotion, our method improves robustness under action noise, external perturbations, and terrain shifts, reducing catastrophic failures while maintaining competitive returns.

</details>


### [1145] [Learning-Based Adaptive MPC for Magnetorquer-Only Satellite Attitude Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20280)
*Schwartz, Patrick,Cauligi, Abhishek*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出学习型自适应MPC算法，融合仿真训练的磁场模型并在线更新，为纳卫星（CubeSat）规划三轴姿态轨迹，在地球与天王星轨道仿真中控制器成功率分别提升5%和61%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳卫星（如CubeSat）具备外太阳系科学探索潜力，但体积约束导致姿态控制与科学载荷能力相互折损。磁力矩器作为紧凑三轴执行器是折中方案，却存在控制权限随磁场强度下降、且需完全已知行星磁场的缺陷，尤其在远距离外行星环境中问题突出。

Method: 构建学习型自适应模型预测控制（MPC）框架：在仿真中用低保真磁场数据训练一个磁场模型，将其嵌入MPC的动力学预测中，从而在规划旋转轨迹时显式考虑控制权限损失；在线采集测量后采用简单的末层（last-layer）更新方案自适应修正该磁场模型，使MPC快速逼近真实行星磁场并规划更优姿态轨迹。在地球轨道与天王星轨道两类场景进行系统级仿真验证。

Result: 学习型自适应MPC相较基线显著提升控制器成功率：地球轨道场景提升5%，天王星轨道场景提升61%，表明磁场模型在线自适应对弱磁场外行星任务收益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 将低保真仿真训练的磁场模型与在线末层自适应结合，可有效缓解磁力矩器控制权限不足问题，为外太阳系纳卫星姿态控制提供可行方案；未来可向更高保真磁场模型与实星验证拓展。

Abstract: Nanosatellites (e.g., CubeSats) have the potential to carry out useful science and exploration activities for outer solar system exploration, but their small size leads to tradeoffs between attitude control and science capabilities. Magnetorquers offer a unique compromise as compact actuators that enable three-axis attitude control, but suffer from a loss of control authority and require full knowledge of the planetary magnetic field. In this work, we present a learning-based adaptive model predictive control (MPC) algorithm that plans rotational trajectories for the satellite while accounting for this loss of control authority. Key to our approach is the inclusion of a learned magnetic field model that is trained in simulation using low-fidelity magnetic field data. Using measurements collected online, our proposed algorithm adapts this learned magnetic field model using a simple last-layer update scheme, allowing the MPC controller to quickly adapt to the true planetary magnetic field model and more effectively plan attitude trajectories. We demonstrate the results of our proposed approach for two use cases, (1) Earth-orbit and (2) Uranus-orbit, and show that our learning-based adaptive MPC algorithm improves controller success for these system simulations by 5% and 61%, respectively.

</details>


### [1146] [Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20318)
*Alfarra, Motasem,Mazzaglia, Pietro,Peschl, Markus,Dijkman, Daniel,Louizos, Christos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TEMPO，一种面向机器人运动策略的测试时自适应方法，仅用冻结 critic 作为部署性能代理，通过熵正则化与优先级记忆回放稳定无奖励在线更新，在 MuJoCo Playground 与实体 Go2 上取得一致增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 运动策略在部署时遇分布偏移（崎岖/湿滑地形、负载变化、感知退化）会失效，而机上延迟与内存受限使重训练或人工标定不可行。

Method: 基线仅在不访问奖励的情况下更新 actor，以冻结预训练 critic 作为部署性能代理；TEMPO 在此基础上引入 (i) 对 critic 预测分布的熵促进正则项，抑制过度自信外推；(ii) 受优先回放启发的基于分数的记忆机制，优先采样低价值“困难”观测，并用重要性采样把有限算力集中于最具信息量的部署条件。

Result: 在 MuJoCo Playground 的 Go1、Go2、G1 上，跨四类代表性偏移与多种架构取得一致提升，单设备设定下最高提升约 80%；在加装小腿负载的实体 Unitree Go2 上，全机上自适应在真实回合中优于未自适应基线。

Conclusion: 无奖励的自监督测试时自适应可作为部署期策略鲁棒化的可行路径，熵正则化与记忆引导采样是稳定 critic 驱动更新的关键组件，并已在真机上初步验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

</details>


### [1147] [TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20320)
*Zhu, Fucai,Zhang, Xidong,Zhang, Yichi,Wang, Yipan,Wang, Fubo,Wu, Zibin,Li, Kaiqi,Jiao, Jianhao,Lu, Shihan,Hu, Di,Xu, Mengdi,Zhu, Siyu,Long, Xiaoxiao,Yao, Yao,Cao, Xun,Xu, Zhuo,Hashimoto, Koichi,Chen, Qifeng,Li, Zhe,Yang, Jianfei,Lu, Haofei,Kragic, Danica,Yan, Shuicheng,Duan, Jianghua,Wang, Michael Yu,Yuan, Weihao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TacClaw-Infinity：依托TacClaw触觉手持采集接口构建的大规模结构化VTLA数据集，含>10000小时、100万episode、10亿帧、1000+任务，并提供轨迹重建、多模态质控与结构化标注管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习依赖多样人类示范，但触觉操作数据难以规模化，现有数据集缺乏一致的质量控制与结构化监督信号。

Method: TacClaw为UMI风格手持触觉接口，无需目标机器人即可同步采集视觉、指尖触觉与末端轨迹；通过全球分布式采集（家庭、实验室、工厂、零售、户外）与可扩展管线完成轨迹重建、多模态质控、embodiment-aware过滤，以及以接触为中心的分割、子任务描述与空间grounding标注。

Result: 数据规模达>10000小时/100万episode/10亿帧/1000+任务类型；数据层面评估采集接口、动作空间兼容性与结构化标注，模型层面在三种异构机器人上实现无机器人专属示范的跨embodiment迁移。

Conclusion: 该工作为接触密集型操作提供了可扩展的触觉-视觉-语言-动作数据基础设施，验证了跨本体迁移可行性，但摘要未给出量化成功率或消融细节。

Abstract: Large-scale robot learning increasingly relies on diverse human demonstrations, yet tactile manipulation data remain difficult to scale, and existing multimodal datasets often lack consistent quality control and structured supervision. We present TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale structured Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) dataset for contact-rich manipulation, collected with TacClaw, a tactile-enabled UMI-style handheld interface that records synchronized visual observations, fingertip tactile signals, and end-effector trajectories without requiring a target robot during data collection. TacClaw-Infinity is built through a distributed worldwide collection across homes, laboratories, industrial workplaces, retail stores, and outdoor environments including tasks contributed by academic and industrial collaborators. Together, these efforts yield over 10,000 hours, 1 million episodes, and 1 billion frames spanning more than 1,000 task types. We develop a scalable pipeline for trajectory reconstruction, multimodal quality control, embodiment-aware filtering, and structured annotation, covering contact-centric segmentation, subtask description, and spatial grounding. We validate TacClaw-Infinity at both the data and model levels: At the data level, we assess the collection interface, the action-space compatibility of the curated demonstrations, and the structured annotations, while for the model level, we demonstrate cross-embodiment transfer across three heterogeneous robots without robot-specific demonstrations.

</details>


### [1148] [VIGOR-MPC: Vision-Guided Objective Regulation MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20333)
*Trisovic, Jelena,Rickenbach, Rahel,Landert, Marek,Minos, Panagiotis,Zeilinger, Melanie N.*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VIGOR-MPC 提出模块化师生框架，将特权长时域MPC蒸馏为视觉驱动的轻量短时域MPC，实现仅靠机载视觉的导航跟踪，计算量降低90%以上并泛化到未见赛道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机载视觉感知存在噪声、变长和被遮挡上下文的问题，同时机载算力需在感知与控制间共享，限制了实时可执行的规划时域。目标是仅凭机载视觉完成导航任务的参考轨迹跟踪，同时保持长时域规划的优越性与实时性。

Method: 提出VIGOR-MPC，师生模块化框架，对感知管线不可知。教师端在仿真中拥有全状态知识，使用多轨迹MPC公式保证智能体始终处于视场内，进行长时域规划；学生端仅观测感知模块输出的噪声、遮挡上下文，通过多级循环映射在线推断MPC代价参数，以恢复教师行为。学生为计算量小的短时域MPC。

Result: 在仿真与真机的视觉自主竞速任务上评估：仅用机载赛道感知，VIGOR-MPC泛化到训练未见赛道，圈速接近特权长时域教师，每步计算量降低超过90%。

Conclusion: 通过从特权长时域MPC蒸馏到视觉条件化的短时域MPC，可在有限机载算力下获得接近长时域最优的规划性能，验证了感知-控制算力权衡问题的可行解，并具备仿真到硬件的迁移能力。

Abstract: Controlling an agent in an environment solely perceived through onboard vision is challenging: perception yields noisy, variable-length, and partially occluded context, while onboard compute is shared between perception and control, limiting the planning horizon executable in real time. We propose VIGOR-MPC, a modular student-teacher framework, agnostic to the perception pipeline, which addresses reference tracking across navigation tasks by distilling a privileged, field-of-view-aware long-horizon MPC into a computationally lightweight short-horizon MPC whose cost parameters are determined online from vision. The teacher operates in simulation with full state knowledge and a multi-trajectory formulation that guarantees the agent can stay within its field of view. The student observes only the noisy, occluded context produced by a perception module and learns, via a multi-level recurrent mapping, to infer cost parameters that aim to recover the teacher's behavior despite missing information. We evaluate VIGOR-MPC on vision-based autonomous racing in simulation and on hardware. Using only onboard perception of the track, VIGOR-MPC generalizes to tracks unseen during training and approaches the lap times of the privileged long-horizon teacher while reducing per-step computation by over 90%.

</details>


### [1149] [AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20336)
*Zhang, Jiawei,Liu, Chang,Deng, Litao,Zhang, Tao,Jin, Qin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AutoRSR 提出高度自动化的 real-to-sim-to-real 框架，将多视角扫描的真实工作空间重建为可复用仿真资产，自动提取物体资产、度量尺度配准到机器人基座坐标系，并通过轨迹插值与域随机化从少量参考动作扩展出可执行操作轨迹，无需人工标注、标定或遥操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人操作数据采集成本高（人力与机器人时间），仿真虽有可扩展性，但把真实工作空间转为可学习的仿真环境仍需大量人工：物体提取、资产处理、坐标标定、轨迹指定。作者希望大幅降低这一环节的人力成本。

Method: AutoRSR 输入多视角观测、机器人状态与开放词汇语义查询：先重建工作空间并提取单个物体资产，将重建场景以度量尺度自动配准到机器人基座坐标系；再基于少量参考运动生成可执行操作轨迹，通过轨迹插值与域随机化进行规模化扩展。扫描与语义查询之后，整条流水线无需人工物体标注、场景-机器人标定或遥操作。

Result: 在三个真实操作任务上，每任务用 1K 自动生成 episode 训练的策略达到 73.3–86.7% 真实世界成功率，与用 150 条人类遥操作演示训练的 pi 0.5 相当，同时将数据生成所需人类时间减少一个数量级。

Conclusion: 真实观测可被转化为度量对齐、可执行且可扩展的仿真数据，并显著降低人力投入，为具身机器人学习的规模化数据生成提供了自动化路径。

Abstract: Scaling embodied robot learning requires large and diverse manipulation datasets, but collecting real-world demonstrations remains expensive in human effort and robot time. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, yet converting a real workspace into a robot-learning-ready environment still requires substantial manual effort for object extraction, asset processing, coordinate calibration, and trajectory specification. We present AutoRSR, a highly automated real-to-sim-to real framework that converts scanned real-world workspaces into reusable embodied simulation assets and scalable manipulation data. Given multi-view observations, robot states, and open-vocabulary semantic queries, AutoRSR reconstructs the workspace, extracts individual object assets, and automatically registers the reconstructed scene to the robot base frame at metric scale. Starting from a small number of reference motions, AutoRSR then generates executable manipulation trajectories and scales them through trajectory interpolation and domain randomization. After workspace scanning and semantic queries, the remaining pipeline requires no manual object annotation, scene-to-robot calibration, or robot teleoperation. Across three real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained on 1K automatically generated episodes per task achieve 73.3--86.7% real-world success rates, comparable to pi 0.5 trained from 150 human teleoperated demonstrations, while reducing the human time required for data generation by an order of magnitude. These results demonstrate that real-world observations can be converted into metrically aligned, executable, and scalable simulation data with substantially reduced human effort.

</details>


### [1150] [Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20351)
*Kallakuri, Nagasrikanth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出体无关（body-free）的人类演示记录范式：从手机等简单设备捕获物体的位姿轨迹、接触区间与带溯源的3D重建，而非重定向人手运动；将机器人URDF与描述符对该记录求解，在仿真中以物体运动为真值对每个(机器人, 片段)配对判定pass/具名失败/拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示目前主要用于视觉-语言-动作模型的预训练，难以复用于面向目标本体或特定任务的后训练，而后者是机器人在工业与通用环境中规模化部署的前提。因此希望用手机等可扩展设备采集的人类演示，直接作为身体结构与能力均不同的机器人的后训练数据。

Method: 关键在于重定向物体而非重定向手：一次捕获产生体无关记录（物体随时间位姿、接触区间、带溯源的3D重建物体）。给定URDF与简短描述符的机器人对该记录求解，并在仿真中以演示的物体运动为真值评分，得到human-to-simulation一段的逐机器人迁移度量；每个(机器人, 片段)在运动前即给出pass、具名失败模式或拒绝及理由。

Result: 系统已在持续增长的集合上运行，本文分析样本为8个机器人上求解的42次捕获、共157个配对：31.2% pass、52.2% fail、14.0% refused、2.5% 不可审计（运动学可行性±50 mm/±15 deg，仿真中）。拒绝可靠：被检查拒绝却仍运行的配对全部失败（13/13；其中5个来自公开模型中焊死手部的机体）。描述文件无法被证明可筛选机器人，其结果预测力几乎等同于随机猜测。尚无策略在该记录上训练。

Conclusion: 该记录决定机器人可在什么上做后训练；策略随后能否在真实机器人上工作属于sim-to-robot问题，留待下游回答。当前缺少策略训练与真机验证，描述符筛选作用未获支持。

Abstract: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.

</details>


### [1151] [When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20429)
*Yi, Zeji,Dasgupta, Soham,Zhang, Xinyang,Sreenath, Koushil,Qu, Guannan,Chen, Xi,Simchowitz, Max,Shi, Guanya*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文挑战机器人基础模型普遍采用连续动作表示的共识，系统比较了离散与连续动作策略（单步回归 vs 多步 flow）在从零单任务、多任务 VLA 训练、仿真与真机中的表现，发现离散动作（哪怕朴素均匀分箱量化）在成功率上可匹配甚至超越连续策略，且其瓶颈并非精度而是乘积分布分解误差，可通过离散 flow 迭代计算或 CFG 锐化来转化为优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 预测离散 token，而机器人基础模型却普遍将动作表示为连续向量，作者质疑"连续动作参数化优于离散"这一默认共识，希望验证离散动作预测是否被低估。

Method: 在从零单任务与多任务 VLA 训练两种设定下，对比连续与离散策略的单步回归和多步 flow 变体；离散侧采用均匀分箱量化；分析分解误差来源，并引入离散 flow 的迭代计算与 classifier-free guidance 的分布锐化两类干预；同时尝试通过模拟连续 flow matching 的 corruption 过程显式注入几何信息。评估覆盖仿真与真实硬件。

Result: 所有设定下，离散动作预测（含最朴素的均匀分箱量化）在任务成功率上可匹配甚至超过连续动作策略；离散策略的挑战来自跨时间与动作维度的乘积分布预测导致的分解误差，而非动作精度；配合离散 flow 迭代计算或 CFG 分布锐化，可在预测的动作 chunk 内实现更灵敏的动作变化；显式注入几何信息未带来一致提升。

Conclusion: 机器人动作预测未必需要与其他 AI 领域不同的设计决策，离散动作预测可作为当前连续参数化的有力替代方案。

Abstract: Though modern AI models like LLMs predict discrete tokens, today's robotic foundation models represent actions as continuous vectors. In this paper, we challenge this common consensus by asking if continuous action parametrizations are superior to their discrete counterparts. We conduct an extensive comparison of single-step regression and multi-step flow variants of both continuous and discrete policies in both from-scratch single-task and multi-task VLA training, in both simulation and on real hardware. In all regimes, we find that discrete action prediction, even the most naive, uniform-bin quantization, can match or even outperform continuous-action policies in task success rate. Moreover, we find that the challenge to discrete action policies is \emph{not} action precision, but rather factorization error introduced by product-distribution predictions across time and action dimensions. We show that, when paired with the correct interventions---iterative computation through discrete flows, or distribution sharpening through classifier-free guidance---discrete flow policies can turn this weakness into a strength, enabling more responsive action changes during a predicted action chunk. Lastly, we show that attempts to explicitly inject geometric information into discrete policies, e.g. through corruption processes that emulate continuous flow matching, do \emph{not} yield consistent improvements. Taken together, our findings question existing assumptions that robotic action prediction requires distinct design decisions compared to other AI domains, and motivates the possibility of discrete action prediction as a compelling alternative to today's continuous action parametrizations. Link for the webpage \href{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}{https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/}

</details>
