Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

</details>


### [1153] [DD-GBP: Anytime Multi-Arm Planning and Continuous Execution via Distributed Dynamic Gaussian Belief Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20460)
*Jin, Zhao,Dai, Fengyi,Yin, Yuetong,Wang, Yunan,Chen, Wenjie,Hu, Chuxiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分布式动态高斯信念传播（DD-GBP），用GP参数化在并行局部推理中直接规划多臂长时域轨迹，实现高成功率、抗通信丢包及>60Hz实时求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂动态环境下多机械臂长时域任务的在线安全执行仍具挑战，集中式规划难以兼顾实时性、可扩展性与对移动障碍及通信退化的鲁棒性。

Method: 分布式动态高斯信念传播：各机器人维护局部树状因子图，通过活跃臂间链路异步交换消息；动态子网重构与事件触发更新降低通信与推理开销；统一GP参数化耦合自适应规划时域、插值时间因子与连续执行。

Result: 50个长时域多目标四臂动障场景中，无碰撞全目标完成率92.5%，优于六个代表性基线；90%丢包下仍达86.0%；相对Syn-GBP显著抑制速度/加速度极端峰值；单工作站30臂无障测试成功率99.87%、平均热启动求解15.80ms（>60Hz）。

Conclusion: 方法在在线长时域多臂动态规划上达到新的SOTA，并给出局部推理精度、随时早停、触发重规划一致性与GP一致执行的理论分析，具备双臂动态干扰下的实机部署可行性。

Abstract: Safely executing long-horizon multi-arm tasks online in complex dynamic environments remains challenging. We propose a new distributed dynamic Gaussian belief propagation (DD-GBP) method that directly plans joint-space trajectories through parallel local inference. A unified Gaussian-process (GP) parameterization connects adaptive planning horizons, interpolation-time factors, and continuous execution. Each robot maintains a local tree-structured factor graph and exchanges messages asynchronously over active inter-arm links. Dynamic subnet reconstruction and event-triggered updates reduce communication and inference costs while responding to moving obstacles. We also provide theoretical analyses of local inference accuracy, anytime early stopping, triggered-replanning consistency, and GP-consistent execution. In 50 long-horizon, multi-target four-arm scenes with moving obstacles, DD-GBP achieves $92.5\%$ collision-free all-target completion and the highest success rate among six representative baselines. Scenario ablations demonstrate long-horizon safety and robustness to communication impairment and extreme conditions; success remains $86.0\%$ under $90\%$ packet loss. Execution results further show substantially suppressed extreme velocity and acceleration peaks relative to Syn-GBP. On one workstation, obstacle-free tests with 30 coexisting arms retain $99.87\%$ success and a $15.80$ ms mean warm solve, exceeding 60 Hz and outperforming the compared methods in scalability. Dual-arm transport experiments under dynamic interference demonstrate online response and practical deployability. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish a new state of the art for online long-horizon multi-arm planning in dynamic scenes.

</details>


### [1154] [Tiered-Resolution Volumetric Mapping for Real-Time Simultaneous Planning and Mapping on Natural Outdoor Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20476)
*Carvalho, Afonso E.,Portugal, David,Peixoto, Paulo,Kantor, George*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种分层分辨率建图机制，将LiDAR数据同时以两种分辨率整合进单一地图：在机器人当前规划路径周围的走廊内使用精细分辨率，其余区域使用粗糙分辨率，并让规划结果反馈给建图以动态调整叶子分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时体积建图的开销主要来自在最高分辨率下整合与存储信息，但实际地图中只有极小部分位于规划器真正考虑或接近的路径上。传统导航流程中规划只消费建图结果而不提供反馈，造成大量无用精细计算与存储。

Method: 提出"分层分辨率建图"机制，在单一地图结构中同时以精细与粗糙两种分辨率整合LiDAR，精细区域限定为围绕机器人当前规划的走廊。与传统单向流程不同，引入规划→建图的反馈回路，使规划信息动态决定在不同叶节点分辨率上整合数据。在两个真实世界遥操作数据集上，离线回放并与独立的全分辨率地图对照评分。

Result: 相比均匀精细地图，分层地图体积缩小13-15倍，整合CPU时间减少6-8倍，同时生成路径的单位长度代价与精细分辨率地图相近。均匀粗糙地图虽能获得同样的大小节省，但在较难场景中路径质量崩溃（每米代价上升210%），因其过度离散化了机器人必须穿越的地形。分层方案以接近粗糙地图的低开销，避免了其失效模式。

Conclusion: 通过规划与建图的反馈闭环、按需分配精细分辨率，可在几乎不损失路径质量的前提下大幅降低体积建图的存储与计算开销，为实时规划机器人提供高效的分层建图方案。

Abstract: Real-time volumetric mapping for a planning robot is dominated by the cost of integrating and storing information at the finest resolution, yet only a small fraction of any map ever lies on or near a path the planner actually considers. We exploit this with a tiered-resolution mapping mechanism that integrates LiDAR into a single map structure at two resolutions simultaneously: fine inside a corridor around the robot's current plan, and coarse everywhere else. As opposed to traditional navigation pipelines where path planning uses the mapping result and provides no feedback, we propose a feedback loop where planning also informs mapping to dynamically integrate information at different leaf resolutions. Across two real-world teleoperated datasets, replayed and scored offline against an independent full-resolution map, the tiered maps are 13-15x smaller and require 6-8x less integration CPU time than a uniform fine map, while producing paths at a similar cost per meter as the ones generated from fine resolution maps on both scenarios. A uniform coarse map reaches the same size savings but its path quality collapses (+210% cost per meter) on the harder scenario, because it over-discretizes terrain the robot must traverse. Tiering approximates the coarse map's cheapness without its failure mode.

</details>


### [1155] [Towards Certifiable State Estimation under Observability Degeneracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20490)
*Song, Baoshan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 建立了候选驱动的对偶认证框架，在感知退化导致SDP松弛秩扩张的情况下仍可实现非凸状态估计的全局最优性验证，避免了直接半定求解，并在退化测量下的鲁棒配准中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人非凸状态估计中，可认证优化能给出全局最优性保证，但在严重感知退化时凸SDP松弛经内点法求解会出现秩扩张，使直接半定求解与谱舍入在代数上失效。需要一种不引入秩扩张的全局认证途径。

Method: 1) 从epigraph视角证明：感知退化虽将原始最优集扩张为平坦等代价面，但代价紧性与乘子恢复仍严格成立，从而无需直接半定求解即可完成全局验证；2) 提出基于解重映射的可观测性感知局部搜索，并配合闭式对偶乘子恢复方案，时延达亚微秒级；3) 推导模型自适应对偶安全阈值，由可观测Hessian的最小非零特征值与未消除残差泄漏参数化，避免弱可观测下的最优候选被误拒。

Result: 理论上证明了退化条件下代价紧性与对偶乘子恢复的保持性；所提对偶乘子恢复达到亚微秒级时延；自适应阈值可抑制弱可观测下的误拒。实验在退化测量条件下的鲁棒配准任务上验证了该通用框架。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种在感知退化下仍成立的通用候选驱动对偶认证框架，规避了秩扩张带来的代数失效问题，为机器人非凸状态估计的全局最优性验证提供了实用且低时延的工具。

Abstract: Certifiable optimization provides global optimality guarantees for non-convex state estimation in robotics. However, under severe physical sensing degeneracy, convex Semidefinite Programming relaxations solved via Interior-Point Methods suffer from rank expansion, rendering direct semidefinite solving and spectral rounding algebraically invalid. In this paper, we establish a universal candidate-driven dual certification framework that resolves this challenge without incurring rank expansion. First, from an epigraph perspective, we prove that while sensing degeneracy expands the primal optimal set into a flat equi-cost face, cost tightness and multiplier recovery remain strictly intact, enabling global verification without direct semidefinite solving. Second, we propose an observability-aware local search using solution remapping, coupled with a closed-form dual multiplier recovery scheme that executes in sub-microsecond latency. Third, we derive a model-specific adaptive dual safety threshold parameterized by the minimum non-zero eigenvalue of the observable Hessian and uneradicated residual leakage, preventing false rejections of optimal candidates under weak observability. We validate our universal framework with robust registration under degenerate measurements.

</details>


### [1156] [Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning with Human Interventions for Precise Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20504)
*Li, Xiaoman,Yang, Zhiqiang,Hu, Jiayu,Kong, Jipeng,Zhang, Yang,Zhang, Jingwei,Yan, Fangzheng,Shen, Chunhua,Bai, Chenjia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GR-BC离线迭代后训练框架，用任务条件下的目标可达图与逆向搜索计算每段动作的“剩余步数势能”，据此对动作块重加权，从而在混合质量数据中复用可恢复片段、抑制局部倒退动作，无需奖励模型或进度标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时序精细操作的后训练数据质量参差：即使成功的演示与人工干预 rollout 也包含绕路、犹豫、失败尝试和次优恢复。核心难题在于判断哪些动作块真正推动任务进展，而非对不完美轨迹统一克隆或整体丢弃。

Method: 构建任务条件下的目标可达图，节点覆盖演示与迭代收集的 rollout（含成功、失败与人工干预片段）；通过逆向图搜索在数据支撑范围内估计到达任务成功的最小剩余步数势能，并依据动作块执行后势能下降幅度赋予其权重，实现基于后果的重加权。新 rollout 仅需追加进图并重跑搜索，迭代进行，无需训练奖励模型、动作条件 critic 或进度预测器。

Result: 在四个精细操作任务、三种 VLA 主干上，GR-BC 均优于单轮监督微调；数轮离线迭代后成功率达到 91%，且不使用轨迹对比或进度标签。

Conclusion: 以“后果/势能下降”作为动作块加权的信号，可把数据质量评估转化为图上的可达性搜索问题，为 VLA 后训练提供无需额外模型的轻量迭代方案，并有效挖掘失败与干预数据中的可恢复价值。

Abstract: Long-horizon precise manipulation produces mixed-quality data for post-training vision-language-action (VLA) models: even successful demonstrations and intervention-assisted rollouts may contain detours, hesitations, failed attempts, and imperfect recoveries. The key challenge is to identify which action chunks actually advance the task, rather than uniformly cloning or discarding imperfect trajectories. We propose Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning (GR-BC), an offline iterative post-training framework that builds a task-conditioned goal-reachability graph over demonstrations and iteratively collected rollouts, including both successful and failed episodes with human interventions. Reverse graph search computes minimal remaining steps to task success within the dataset support, and each action chunk is weighted by how much its execution reduces this potential. This consequence-based weighting reuses recoverable segments from failed trajectories, leverages interventions as recovery paths, and down-weights locally regressive chunks even inside successful trajectories. New rollouts are incorporated by appending them to the graph and rerunning search, without training a reward model, action-conditioned critic, or progress predictor. Across four precise manipulation tasks and three VLA backbones, GR-BC improves single-round supervised fine-tuning and reaches 91% success after a few offline iterations, without trajectory comparisons or progress labels. More details and videos are available at: https://gr-bc.github.io

</details>


### [1157] [Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20524)
*Liang, Yushen,Peng, Yue,Jin, Baosheng,Zhang, Tianluo,Zhang, Xinyu,Zhou, Shuyi,Chen, Zhuoran,Liu, Xinqi,Wan, Shenji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Temporal Flow Policy (TFP)，将物理时间作为策略记忆的显式维度：用观测与历史记忆决定状态转移的内容与时间尺度，用实测时间间隔决定状态推进多远，并以扩散/流匹配策略的原生模仿目标训练。在Diffusion Policy与π0.5上验证，真实机器人定时/记忆任务与LIBERO均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略记忆随观测序列演化，隐含地把每次更新视为等量物理时间；但相同观测历史可跨越不同时长并对应不同动作，说明物理时间是策略记忆中缺失的维度。

Method: TFP学习记忆动力学：由观测与先验记忆确定每次转移的内容与时间尺度，由经过的物理时间决定记忆状态推进的幅度；该记忆状态用于条件化扩散策略与流匹配策略，并沿用其原生模仿学习目标训练。通过受控的消融对比（TFP vs 循环记忆、状态空间记忆、将时间间隔输入学习门控的变体）评估。

Result: 在Diffusion Policy与π0.5上，TFP平均成功率高于同等时间间隔条件的循环与状态空间记忆，也高于把间隔送入学习门控的变体；记忆读出可恢复事件发生后的时间以及遮挡后的运动信息；改变输入间隔会系统性地延迟或提前动作。真实机器人定时或记忆任务与LIBERO评测均显示优势。

Conclusion: 机器人记忆不应被视为存储的观测历史，而应被视为一种保留过去事件、并随物理时间演化的状态。

Abstract: Existing robot policy memories typically evolve with observation sequences, implicitly treating each update as the same amount of physical time. Yet identical observation histories can span different durations and require different actions, exposing physical time as a missing dimension of policy memory. We introduce Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which learns memory dynamics to retain past events and evolve the memory state over measured time intervals. Observations and prior memory determine the content and time scales of each transition; elapsed time determines how far the state advances. TFP conditions diffusion and flow-matching policies through this memory state and is trained with their native imitation objectives. We evaluate TFP with Diffusion Policy and $\pi_{0.5}$ through controlled comparisons of memory designs. These experiments show that successful timing depends on both measured intervals and retained history. TFP achieves higher average success than the recurrent and state-space memories we equip with the same intervals and than a variant that feeds the interval to a learned gate. Memory readouts recover the time since an event and motion information after occlusion. Changing the supplied intervals systematically delays or advances actions, linking time inputs to behavior. Real-robot tasks requiring timing or memory, together with LIBERO evaluations, demonstrate benefits in physical and general manipulation. These results suggest viewing robot memory not as stored observation history, but as a state that retains past events and evolves with physical time.

</details>


### [1158] [EarlyCommit: Calibrated Word-by-Word Commitment for Robots Acting Before You Finish Speaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20531)
*Khan, Muhammad Haris*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EarlyCommit：开源工具，让机器人在指令未说完时即可基于逐词文本编码打分提交目标，用校准阈值 τ 控制误选风险，并提供流式语音前端与逐词真值数据生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能在指令结束前数词就锁定目标物体，而机器人通常等待整句说完才决策，导致交互延迟与不自然。作者希望让机器人在语音流中尽早、可控风险地提交目标。

Method: 构建流式语音前端；用微调文本编码器在每识别一个词后对场景中每个物体打分；当最优物体校准概率达到用户设定阈值 τ 时提交动作，否则继续等待或提问；同时提供场景/指令生成器（含精确逐词真值）以及训练、校准与评估脚本。

Result: 在含训练未见词的指令上，EarlyCommit 正确提交频率为关键词匹配的 1.6–2 倍；τ=0.9 时提交正确率≥92%；消费级 GPU 上每词耗时 31–35 ms。

Conclusion: 逐词流式提交配合概率校准，可在指令未完成时实现低延迟、风险可控的目标锁定，且开源工具链支持复现与扩展，但实验限于文本打分与离线/仿真场景，尚未展示真实机器人闭环部署。

Abstract: Human listeners can often identify the intended object several words before an instruction ends. Robots, however, are typically designed to wait until the speaker has finished before deciding how to act. We present EarlyCommit, an open-source tool that lets a robot commit to the intended object while the instruction is being spoken. After every recognized word, a fine-tuned text encoder scores each object in the scene. The robot acts when the calibrated probability of the best object reaches a threshold tau set by the user, so 1 - tau is the accepted risk of choosing the wrong object. Otherwise, it waits or asks. The tool includes a streaming speech front end, a scene and instruction generator with exact word-by-word ground truth, and scripts to train, calibrate, and evaluate. On instructions containing words never seen in training, EarlyCommit commits correctly 1.6 to 2 times as often as keyword matching, is right at least 92 percent of the time when it commits at tau = 0.9, and needs 31 to 35 ms per word on consumer GPUs.

</details>


### [1159] [KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20552)
*Wu, Qi,Zhao, Lulu,Hahn, Sanghyun,Yennu, Rishi,Yang, Emmy,Zhang, Dingqi,Pang, Tao,Wang, Jiuguang,Fang, Kuan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: KinoGen 通过"运动学原生"的视频生成框架，从仿真渲染出发生成双视角视频并拟合回机器人构型空间，直接产出可定制的人形 loco-manipulation 参考轨迹，无需人体代理与重定向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频生成的方法多以人体为代理（human body proxy），需要额外重定向（retargeting），且生成的轨迹未必落在机器人构型空间内，易出现穿模、脚滑、接触丢失，也难以精确指定目标物体位姿。

Method: 以目标机器人与物体在仿真任务实例中的标定渲染为条件，驱动预训练视频生成器；对生成的双视角视频，用同一批模型做拟合以恢复参考轨迹，使参考天然位于机器人构型空间。用身体、手、物体先验初始化重建，再针对跨视角证据做直接优化精化。用户编辑关键帧（即另一个渲染状态）即可指定目标物体位姿，围绕该关键帧重生成视频并得到精确满足该位姿的参考。

Result: 在 8 个 loco-manipulation 任务上，相比基于视频的基线，穿模与脚滑更低，保留超过 90% 的标注接触；定制化参考在每一项指定目标上都满足要求，且穿模显著低于直接插值。合成参考训练的跟踪策略部署于 Unitree G1 人形机器人（配灵巧手）。

Conclusion: 将视频生成与仿真标定渲染耦合、把生成结果直接拟合回配置空间，可在无需人体代理/重定向的情况下获得可定制、接触一致的人形 loco-manipulation 参考，并成功迁移到实机策略。

Abstract: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage: https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/.

</details>


### [1160] [PingpongDuo: Agile Humanoid Table Tennis Doubles with Safe Team Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20579)
*Jiang, Haoran,Zhong, Yichao,Zhang, Kai,Liu, Cheng,Pan, Yixuan,Yang, Zhenjie,Wang, Jingbo,Li, Tianyu,Chen, Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分层框架 PingpongDuo，实现人形机器人双打乒乓球的敏捷跑位与安全协同击球，仿真成功率提升13.2%，真机完成2.15 m救球-回位循环（2.4 s，峰值2.23 m/s）并连续对打10拍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形乒乓球双打与单打不同：队友须严格交替击球且共享有限工作空间。快速移动会牺牲击球精度，队友移动不协调则会带来碰撞风险，因此需要同时兼顾敏捷性、击球精度与团队安全协同的框架。

Method: 分层框架：团队层规划器联合选择跑位目标，并用学习到的风险评估过滤高风险方案，优先保留当前击球者的目标；个体层将步法与击球技能解耦，由人类双打比赛采集的步法参考引导，并以彼此产生的状态互相训练以支持快速切换；球拍臂残差模块结合经真实球飞行与接触测量校准的模拟器回球反馈，在移动后精细化击球。

Result: 仿真中回球成功率比SOTA基线提升13.2%，清空区跑位误差约2 cm；真机实验中机器人以2.4 s完成2.15 m救球-回位循环、峰值速度2.23 m/s，两台机器人实现严格交替的10次以上连续击球。

Conclusion: 该工作表明分层规划加风险过滤与技能解耦可让人形机器人团队在高动态、共享空间的乒乓球双打中兼顾敏捷、精准与安全协同，具备可迁移至其他多机器人敏捷协作任务的潜力。

Abstract: Unlike singles, humanoid table tennis doubles requires teammates to strike in strict alternation while sharing a confined workspace. Rapid repositioning can compromise striking accuracy, while uncoordinated teammate movements introduce collision risks. We present PingpongDuo, a hierarchical framework for agile humanoid doubles with safe team coordination. At the team level, a planner jointly selects positioning targets and uses learned risk estimates to filter risky proposals, preferentially preserving the current striker's target. At the individual level, separate footwork and striking skills combine agile movement with precise racket control. The skills are guided by human motion references, including footwork collected from human doubles play, and trained from states produced by one another to support rapid transitions. A racket-arm residual further refines strikes after movement using return feedback from a simulator calibrated with real ball-flight and contact measurements. In simulation, PingpongDuo improves the ball-return success rate by 13.2% over the state-of-the-art baseline, while achieving approximately 2 cm positioning error during clearance. In real-world experiments, a robot completes a 2.15 m clearance-and-recovery cycle in 2.4 s with a peak speed of 2.23 m/s, while two robots sustain more than 10 consecutive strikes in strict alternation.

</details>


### [1161] [CoWear: Towards Collaborative Wearable Inertial Localization with Multiple Smart Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20596)
*She, Zhuoyuan,Zhang, Zhanpeng,Chen, Yapeng,Wang, Jiale,Xie, Xin,Xia, Ming*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoWear——一个由智能手机、智能手表与智能眼镜同步采集的协作式惯性定位数据集与参考框架，包含30+参与者、300+行走会话、30+小时/100公里轨迹且每台设备均有动捕真值；通过角色专属位移估计器+陀螺积分+不确定性融合实现多设备协同定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级智能设备佩戴于不同身体部位，观测的是同一人体运动的不同视角，但现有惯性定位基准极少提供同步的异构可穿戴设备数据及设备级运动真值，因而无法系统研究跨设备协作定位。

Method: 构建CoWear数据集：30+参与者、300+行走会话、总计30+小时与100km设备轨迹，每台设备独立动捕跟踪。协作定位框架：为各设备训练角色专属估计器，预测同步时间窗内共同参考设备的位移；用陀螺仪积分将预测旋转到世界坐标系，并按学习到的不确定性进行融合。分别以手机、眼镜、手表作为参考目标进行实验。

Result: 多设备融合在位移估计与轨迹推演（trajectory rollout）精度上均稳定优于单设备估计，且在三种不同参考设备设定下保持一致。

Conclusion: CoWear提供了研究异构消费级可穿戴设备协作惯性定位的数据集与可复现基线，验证了跨身体部位设备融合的有效性。

Abstract: Consumer smart devices observe the same human motion from different body locations, yet existing inertial-localization benchmarks rarely provide synchronized heterogeneous wearables with device-specific motion ground truth. We present CoWear, a dataset and reference framework for collaborative inertial localization using a smartphone, smartwatch, and smart glasses. The dataset contains over 30 participants, over 300 walking sessions, and more than 30 hours and 100 km of aggregate device trajectories, with each device individually tracked by motion capture. To enable collaboration across distinct body motions, we train role-specific estimators to predict the displacement of a common reference device over synchronized temporal windows. Their predictions are transformed to the world frame using gyroscope integration and fused according to learned uncertainty. Experiments using phone, glasses, and watch as reference targets show that multi-device fusion consistently improves both displacement and trajectory rollout accuracy over individual-device estimation. CoWear provides a dataset and reproducible baseline for studying collaborative inertial localization across heterogeneous consumer wearables.

</details>


### [1162] [Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20606)
*Cheng, Huixuan,Zhang, Bike,Sastry, Shankar,Sreenath, Koushil*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作研究能否直接在权重空间对高性能人形控制网络进行生成式建模：采用线性自编码器压缩actor网络参数到紧凑隐空间，再用Diffusion Transformer建模该隐空间分布，在Unitree G1的RL网络集合上训练后可生成可部署的行走、舞蹈、回旋踢等动作网络；并发现第一层权重中存在与机器人运动学先验一致的结构规律，在RL与IL下均出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形控制网络通常由常规训练流程获得，而对其学习权重的分布进行直接建模、并在权重空间生成可用网络的研究很少。作者希望验证高性能人形控制网络能否被生成式建模，并借此理解这类网络权重中编码的信息。

Method: 线性自编码器 + Diffusion Transformer 的潜在扩散框架：先用线性自编码器将actor网络参数压缩为紧凑隐向量，再用DiT建模隐向量分布；训练数据为针对Unitree G1机器人通过强化学习收集的网络集合；生成阶段解码隐向量得到可直接部署的控制网络权重。此外对学到的权重空间做结构分析。

Result: 生成的网络可在真实世界部署，执行行走、舞蹈、回旋踢等多种运动；在权重空间中发现第一层权重存在稳定反映机器人运动学先验的结构性规律，且该先验在RL与IL两种训练方式下均会出现，提示其可能并非特定优化过程的产物，而是与人形具身相关的共性知识。

Conclusion: 结果证明在人形网络权重空间中进行生成式建模是可行的，并为理解其学习权重所编码的信息提供了初步洞察，同时暗示具身相关的运动学先验在不同优化范式下普遍存在。

Abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

</details>


### [1163] [Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20607)
*Gong, Zhefei,Jiang, Hefeifei,Wang, Zehao,Li, Jiachen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HiRe-MoMa 分层残差框架，用策略无关残差+分层解耦+专家引导价值对齐，在真实 TIAGo++ 平台上以约 30 分钟在线交互实现移动操作系统的稳定、样本高效微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动操作（MoMa）是自主机器人系统的核心，但真实世界微调困难：动作空间维度高，移动底盘与机械臂等异构模块耦合强；同时真实交互数据昂贵，样本效率低。已有方法难以在冻结基座策略上稳定、低成本地适配真实平台。

Method: 1) 分层残差架构：在冻结的基座策略上做残差微调；2) 策略无关残差（Policy-Agnostic Residual）学习加性修正，不依赖基座策略结构；3) 分层解耦（Hierarchical Decoupling）将残差拆为移动底盘头与机械臂头，采用单向条件化，缓解梯度干扰并匹配平台物理层级；4) 专家引导价值对齐（Expert-Guided Value Alignment）利用覆盖率低于 20% 的稀疏人工干预重塑 critic 的价值地形，引导自主探索。

Result: 在真实 TIAGo++ 平台上的大量实验显示，HiRe-MoMa 在约 30 分钟在线交互后即可稳定提升任务性能，且与基座策略架构无关；稀疏专家干预（<20% 覆盖）显著提升样本效率。

Conclusion: HiRe-MoMa 是首批面向真实世界移动操作的高效在线微调框架之一，为动态、以人为中心环境中部署复杂机器人系统提供了实用范式。

Abstract: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) is a cornerstone of autonomous robotic systems, yet real-world fine-tuning remains a formidable challenge because of high-dimensional action spaces and intricate coupling between heterogeneous modules. In this paper, we propose HiRe-MoMa (Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation), a systematic framework for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of complex MoMa systems. At its core, HiRe-MoMa adopts a Hierarchical Residual Architecture that fine-tunes a frozen base policy. A Policy-Agnostic Residual learns additive corrections atop the base policy, while Hierarchical Decoupling splits the residual into mobile-base and manipulator-arm heads with unidirectional conditioning, mitigating gradient interference and aligning corrections with the platform's physical hierarchy. To improve sample efficiency in data-expensive real-world settings, we propose Expert-Guided Value Alignment, which leverages sparse human interventions with under 20% training coverage to reshape the critic's value landscape, effectively guiding autonomous exploration through expert priors. Extensive real-world experiments on the TIAGo++ platform demonstrate that HiRe-MoMa consistently enhances task performance with only around 30 minutes of online interaction, regardless of the base policy architecture. To our knowledge, this is among the first frameworks to enable efficient on-robot fine-tuning for mobile manipulation in the real world, providing a practical paradigm for deploying complex robotic systems in dynamic, human-centric environments. Further details can be found on our project website: https://hire-moma.github.io/

</details>


### [1164] [SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20609)
*Xie, Shaoyuan,Zhang, Zihan,Wang, Jingxuan,Qu, Jiashu,Liang, Xiaoqing,Kong, Lingdong,Lu, Junchi,Christensen, Henrik I.,Chen, Qi Alfred*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出评测基准与SafeDriveVLA：显式预测三级导航遵从模式，并用导航条件化的世界模型"做梦"辅助冲突推理，在Bench2Drive上达88.16 DS、68.64% SR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型继承LLM常识并支持自由形式自然语言导航指令，但开放式接口带来新的安全脆弱面：驾驶员可能给出当前场景下不安全的指令，恶意用户也可故意给出危险指令。现有VLA既难以闭环完成语言指令导航，又在冲突信号下性能骤降，缺乏同时评估导航跟随与冲突感知及对抗鲁棒性的基准。

Method: 1) 首个同时评测导航跟随、冲突感知与对抗鲁棒性的基准套件；2) SafeDriveVLA：显式预测三级导航遵从模式（navigation-compliance mode），将冲突推理与动作生成解耦；3) 采用导航条件化的世界模型dreaming来为该模式预测提供信息，与前人rollout专家/规划动作不同，该方法严格模拟"跟随导航信号"的后果以判断何时跟随是安全的。

Result: 在Bench2Drive上取得88.16 Driving Score（DS）与68.64% Success Rate（SR）；相比最佳SimLingo变体，闭环语言跟随提升49.3%，不安全指令下的碰撞数由60降至38。现有VLA表现不佳：SimLingo在闭环中未完成任何语言指令变道，所有模型在冲突信号下均显著退化。

Conclusion: 将冲突/遵从性推理从动作生成中显式解耦，并结合"跟随导航"式世界模型推演，可同时提升指令跟随能力与不安全指令下的安全性，为自动驾驶VLA的开放语言接口提供了可行且可评测的安全路径。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [1165] [Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11666)
*Zhao, Jianfei,Wang, Yifan,Zhang, Feng,Sun, Xin,Feng, Chong,Tan, Zhixing,Luo, Yang,Pan, Boyuan,Kai, Xu,Hu, Yao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ARR（自回归检索器）是一种多模态检索模型，在检索过程中交替执行“选取信息性条目”与“更新查询嵌入”，并用最终嵌入对全库排序；通过分步对比监督（SFT）与以条目为动作、以相关条目最终倒数排名为奖励的强化学习（RL）联合训练，配合查询侧适配器以适配固定条目索引。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态检索通常对查询只编码一次，独立索引条目并按嵌入相似度排序。该范式检索高效，但查询表示在检索过程中保持不变，即使已检索到的条目本可帮助澄清信息需求，也无法被利用，因此限制了检索的可迭代性与精度。

Method: 提出 AutoRegressive Retriever（ARR）：交替进行条目检索与查询嵌入更新，最后用最终嵌入对集合排序。监督微调阶段用分步对比监督教会编码器利用反馈；强化学习阶段把反馈条目视为动作，以相关条目的最终倒数排名（reciprocal rank）为奖励优化条目选择；引入查询侧适配器，使优化可在固定条目索引下进行。

Result: 在域内与零样本基准上均取得较强检索性能，平均优于所比较的基线。进一步分析表明：推理时的反馈可提升检索效果；且带反馈的训练也改善了初始查询嵌入（即在观察到任何条目之前）。

Conclusion: 查询侧的自回归反馈可以作为检索的有效增益机制，且反馈训练能同时改善初始查询表示，说明“边检索边细化查询”具有独立的表征学习价值。该工作属于多模态检索与信息检索范畴，与物理AI/机器人/三维重建等核心方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

</details>


### [1166] [FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17841)
*Shukla, Tripti,Somasundaram, Shwetha,Gupta, Akshat,Garg, Rohit,Duff, Paul,Anderson, Ian*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 FASHION-RQ 自动化框架，利用 RQ-VAE 学到的层级离散表征从商品目录结构直接挖掘用户类型查询与相关集，构建免人工标注的可扩展基准 FASHION-RQBENCH，含排序、相关性分类、细粒度同级区分、改写鲁棒性四类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时尚检索评测缺乏能覆盖真实场景细粒度、开放式查询的基准；现有基准依赖人工标注、预定义分类体系或合成提示，可扩展性与语义覆盖受限。

Method: 基于 RQ-VAE 的残差量化层级语义聚类结构，从目录中自动派生查询和相关集；设计四个互补任务（排序、相关性分类、细粒度同级判别、改写鲁棒性）及查询级与属性级相关性指标，并进行人类研究验证。

Result: 在近期检索模型上实验表明该基准可区分不同查询类型和属性下的模型能力；人类研究显示基准查询在自然度上与真实用户查询相当，且意图清晰度更高。

Conclusion: FASHION-RQ 提供免标注、可扩展的时尚检索评测方案，验证了其面向真实场景评测的有效性，代码与数据集将在接收后公开。

Abstract: Evaluating fashion retrieval systems remains challenging due to the limited availability of benchmarks that capture the fine-grained, open-ended queries encountered in real-world search and recommendation. Existing benchmarks often rely on manual curation, predefined taxonomies, or synthetic prompts, limiting scalability and semantic coverage. We introduce FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval, an automated framework that derives user-type queries and relevance sets directly from catalog structure. Our key insight is that hierarchical discrete representations learned by Residual Quantized Variational Autoencoders (RQ-VAE) organize products into semantically coherent clusters at progressively finer granularities. We leverage this structure to construct FASHION-RQBENCH, a scalable benchmark without manual query annotation or predefined taxonomies. We propose four complementary tasks for evaluating ranking, relevance classification, fine-grained sibling discrimination, and paraphrase robustness, alongside query- and attribute-level relevance metrics. Experiments across recent retrieval models demonstrate that FASHION-RQBENCH differentiates model capabilities across query types and attributes. A human study further shows that benchmark queries achieve comparable naturalness and higher intent clarity than real user queries, supporting their validity for real-world evaluation. The code and FASHION-RQBENCH dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [1167] [FlyHack: Stress-Testing Mechanistic Claims in a Connectome-Constrained Visual Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13018)
*Dhawan, Aashish*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 对果蝇运动视觉连接组约束模型 flyvis 的 50 模型集成进行压力测试，发现其三阶段 reverse-phi 响应、对抗方向反转阈值与机制归因结论均强烈依赖对照模型、干预方式、电路表示与训练解，主张将这类模型产出的机制性结论限定在特定模型族/干预/表示范围内使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接组约束神经网络使生物组件可直接干预，但其机制性结论可能受对照模型、干预方式、电路表示和训练解影响；本文旨在系统检验这些依赖性的稳健程度。

Method: 使用果蝇运动视觉模型 flyvis 的 50 模型集成，配合任务匹配的因果 CNN 对照与重复干预实验；在行为层面考察三阶段 reverse-phi 反转、阈值化方向反转及 stationary-sawtooth 响应；在机制层面比较一阶边归因补丁（含零对齐评分变体）与干预真值的匹配；并做贪心细胞类型搜索、T4/T5 输出沉默与连接集剪枝，附加双侧响应幅度校验。

Result: 三阶段 reverse-phi 反转强烈依赖周期与速度，且任务匹配 CNN 同样出现，但两类模型均无法复现果蝇的 stationary-sawtooth 响应；对抗方向反转所需扰动界在 flyvis 为 0.21–0.27 倍刺激对比度，CNN 为 0.13–0.25，与参数匹配 CNN 的差距在更大 CNN 上基本消失。归因评分方式显著影响结果：held-out-mean 替换下，一阶边归因补丁达 pooled AUROC 0.970、Spearman 0.872，而其零对齐评分仅为 0.933 / 0.126。电路结论随表示与集成员变化：贪心细胞类型集仅在 50 个模型中的 25 个满足模型相对 T4/T5 调谐准则，T4/T5 输出沉默在 40 个模型中只有至多 2/8 视频片段保留被测试的 optic-flow 行为；六个首次成功的模型其连接集可剪枝至 13–31 个新增类，但加入双侧响应幅度校验后仅两个细胞类型集仍满足调谐阈值。

Conclusion: 连接组约束模型使机制假设可直接检验，但其结论必须限定于具体的模型族、干预方式、电路表示与训练解，应更窄地使用此类模型。

Abstract: Connectome-constrained neural networks make biological components directly accessible to intervention, but their mechanistic conclusions can still depend on the comparison model, intervention, circuit representation and trained solution. We stress-test these dependencies in flyvis, a \emph{Drosophila} motion-vision model, using its 50-model ensemble, task-matched causal CNN controls and replicated interventions. At the level of model behaviour, three-level reverse-phi reversal in flyvis is strongly period- and velocity-dependent and also appears in task-matched CNNs; neither family reproduces the fly's stationary-sawtooth response. Adversarial direction reversal requires a perturbation bound of 0.21--0.27 times stimulus contrast in flyvis versus 0.13--0.25 in CNNs, but the gap over a parameter-matched CNN largely closes for larger CNNs. At the level of mechanism, matching attribution to the intervention matters: for held-out-mean replacement, first-order edge attribution patching reaches pooled AUROC 0.970 and Spearman 0.872, versus 0.933 and 0.126 when its zero-aligned score is evaluated against the same ground truth. Circuit conclusions also vary with representation and ensemble member. Greedy cell-type sets meet a model-relative T4/T5 tuning criterion in 25 of 50 models, while T4/T5 output silencing reduces the tested optic-flow behaviour to at most two of eight clips in 40. In six models where the cell-type search first succeeds, the corresponding connection sets can be pruned to 13--31 added classes; under an additional two-sided response-amplitude check, only two of those six first-success cell-type sets still meet the tuning threshold. These results support a narrower use of connectome-constrained models: they make mechanistic hypotheses directly testable, but the resulting claims must be scoped to the model family, intervention, representation and trained solution.

</details>

### [1168] [ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13357)
*Chen, Kuan-Yu,Wang, Kuan-Chen,Tsao, Yu,Ding, Jian-Jiun*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出无量化、全卷积的深度水印框架 ECGWmark，在连续全分辨率潜空间嵌入患者元数据，通过帧级局部机制与可微生理损失提升抗时移鲁棒性并保持诊断语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程心电（telecardiology）中 ECG 信号安全传输困难：传统数学水印对循环相移等时间去同步极其脆弱；而面向音频的深度水印依赖有损量化，会破坏对临床诊断至关重要的高频微形态细节。因此需要一种既抗时间去同步又无损保留诊断细节的医学时序水印方案。

Method: ECGWmark 采用全卷积、无量化（quantization-free）架构，在连续全分辨率潜空间中直接嵌入水印，避免量化对高频细节的破坏；引入帧级局部（localized frame-level）机制以增强对严重时间去同步（如循环相移）的鲁棒性；并设计由临床分类器引导的可微 Physiological Loss，以约束水印嵌入不破坏诊断语义。

Result: 在 MIT-BIH 基准数据库上，ECGWmark 在评估的循环时间偏移下信道比特提取准确率保持 90% 以上。严格的跨患者（inter-patient）诊断评估中，Class-V 敏感度由 71.97% 变为 76.50%，Macro-F1 由 35.25% 变为 34.71%，Class-S 敏感度由 8.89% 降至 1.39%，呈现混合的类别级效应。

Conclusion: ECGWmark 在抗时间去同步的水印提取上表现稳健，但其对诊断性能的影响并非一致正面：部分类别敏感度提升，而 Macro-F1 与 Class-S 敏感度下降，说明生理损失对诊断语义的保护在不同类别间存在权衡，需在更广泛数据与类别上进一步验证。

Abstract: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.

</details>

### [1169] [False Claims, Credible Images: A Red-Teaming Benchmark for Commercial Image Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11112)
*Ye, Zeyu,Li, Yanchun,He, Sibei,Xie, Meng,Zhang, Hangtao,Wang, Xianlong,Zeng, Li,Chen, Jiahao,Wang, Yichen,Wang, Junhui,Zhou, Ziqi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出EpiReal-Bench基准（1万条虚假声明提示+1万张生成图，覆盖10类声明与10种可信视觉格式）及EpiReal-Attack黑盒优化攻击框架，揭示商用图像生成模型在视觉虚假信息对齐上的盲区，攻击可将虚假信息生成率从>70%推高至95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像生成模型已能产出难以与真实证据区分的文本丰富视觉材料，但同样能力可被用于伪造视觉虚假信息。作者发现模型在被直接询问时能判定某声明为假，却仍将其渲染为可信的视觉证据，说明当前对齐只判断"图像显示了什么"而非"图像断言了什么"。现有红队基准聚焦暴力/暴露等传统有害内容，缺乏对视觉虚假信息对齐边界（尤其是商用模型）的系统评估。

Method: 构建EpiReal-Bench：包含10k虚假声明提示与10k对应生成图像，横跨10个真实世界声明类别与10种可信视觉格式。提出EpiReal-Attack：技能引导的黑盒优化框架，结合Pareto选择与多模态反馈，搜索既能绕过安全对齐、又保持视觉真实感、文本可读性与语义保真度的指令。在四个商用模型上开展实验。

Result: 超过70%的虚假声明提示可让商用模型生成忠实呈现该虚假信息的图像，EpiReal-Attack将该比例提升至95%。

Conclusion: 商用图像生成器在视觉虚假信息维度上对齐严重不足，攻击成本低、传播廉价且难以辨伪，构成被忽视的安全风险，亟需针对"图像断言内容"而非仅"图像内容"的对齐与防护机制。

Abstract: Image-generation models can now produce text-rich, natural-looking visual artifacts that are hard to distinguish from real-world evidence, such as news reports and textbook pages. Yet, the same capability introduces a new risk: these models can just as easily fabricate visual misinformation. Even commercial models (e.g., GPT-Image-2) readily produce it. Curiously, we find that these models can recognize a claim as false when asked, yet still render that very claim as credible visual evidence. This discrepancy points to a blind spot in current alignment: safeguards judge what an image shows, not what it asserts; however, existing red-teaming benchmarks target conventional harmful content, such as violent or explicit imagery, and say little about where the alignment boundaries lie for visual misinformation, especially in commercial models. To fill this gap, we introduce EpiReal-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating visual misinformation risks in commercial image generators, comprising 10k false-claim prompts and 10k corresponding generated images that span 10 real-world claim categories and 10 credible visual formats. We further introduce EpiReal-Attack, a skill-guided black-box optimization framework that uses Pareto-based selection and multimodal feedback to identify commands that bypass alignment safeguards while preserving visual realism, textual legibility, and semantic fidelity. Experiments on four commercial models reveal that more than 70% of false-claim prompts elicit images that faithfully depict the corresponding misinformation, and EpiReal-Attack pushes this rate to 95%. Most worryingly, these models are only a click away, and their outputs are cheap to spread yet hard to disbelieve, leaving this dimension of alignment largely unguarded.

</details>


### [1170] [WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12952)
*Cao, Jie,Li, Qi,Cheong, Chaklam,Jin, Yutong,Yu, Enze,Zhang, Zelin,Ni, Jianbing*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: WaveMark：在扩散模型初始噪声的小波域嵌入带密钥的消息副本，跨空间位置、小波方向与尺度分布冗余载体，以提升抗去水印攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成的高逼真图像需要来源溯源与知识产权保护，但SOTA去水印攻击可在几乎不损失感知质量的前提下抹除水印信号，导致现有水印方案在滥用归因中失效。

Method: 提出WaveMark小波域水印方法：将消息嵌入扩散模型的初始噪声；在每个载体中将四个潜通道系数分组，通过幅值投影编码随机化比特，形成显式解码裕度；同一消息比特的带密钥副本被冗余分布到空间位置、小波方向与尺度上，从而在载体被扰动后仍可鲁棒恢复。

Result: 在SD2.1上以SDP与MS-COCO Captions数据集、14种攻击进行评测：无攻击时比特准确率(BA)达100.0%，图像质量与所比较基线相当；在SOTA的MarkNull与MarkNull-A攻击下仍保持88%以上BA，优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 小波域、多尺度多方向冗余的初始噪声水印可在保持图像质量的同时显著提升对强去水印攻击的抵抗力，为扩散模型生成内容的溯源与版权保护提供了更可靠的信号嵌入方案。

Abstract: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation. This vulnerability limits the effectiveness of watermarks for intellectual property protection and misuse attribution. We propose WaveMark, a novel wavelet-domain watermarking method that embeds messages in a diffusion model's initial noise. To support robust recovery from perturbed carriers, WaveMark distributes keyed replicas of message bits across spatial positions, wavelet orientations, and scales. Each carrier groups coefficients from four latent channels and encodes a randomized bit through magnitude projection, providing an explicit decoding margin. We evaluate WaveMark with SD2.1 on SDP and MS-COCO Captions under 14 attacks. WaveMark achieves 100.0% bit accuracy (BA) without attacks, while maintaining image quality comparable to the evaluated baselines. Under SOTA MarkNull and MarkNull-A, it retains over 88% BA, outperforming all baselines.

</details>


### [1171] [Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13051)
*Dey, Arnab,Islam, Mohammad Mahfuzul*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文研究标签翻转后门攻击（FLIP）的防御评估问题：在固定检测器、标签与指标的条件下，仅改变特征空间，并以"重训练受害模型后的攻击成功率"而非检测AUROC来评判防御。结论是特征空间决定防御成败，检测分数与模型安全性脱钩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FLIP仅通过翻转少量标签（CIFAR-10上3%）即可让ResNet-32将99.7%的触发源类样本误判为攻击者目标类，且不接触图像。现有防御多在"用同一批毒化标签训练出的模型"内部搜索毒化痕迹，效果不佳。作者意在厘清：是检测检验本身有缺陷，还是其所依赖的特征空间有缺陷。

Method: 采用受控变量法：保持检测流程、标签与评价指标不变，仅更换特征空间，并以"防御保留样本上重训练后的受害模型"作为判据。对比三类空间——毒化模型自身特征、未见任何标签的冻结DINOv2特征、使用干净标签训练的同一网络（作为oracle上界）。复现FLIP作者推荐的SPECTRE防御，并提出基于冻结特征的"原型审计"（prototype audit），用编码器几何与干净标签统计出的一个计数指标（在攻击执行前即可计算）区分审计能完全消除攻击与仅部分消除的类别对。

Result: 在dog→cat上，同一最近邻检验在毒化模型特征上AUROC仅0.546，在冻结DINOv2特征上为0.967，在干净标签训练模型上为0.995（oracle对照）。SPECTRE复现得90.94/0.97（原文91.47/1.7）。价格评估：truck→deer上SPECTRE每类删除20%样本，而原型审计仅删6%即获得更高干净精度与更低攻击成功率。但在三组更难类别对上，该审计仍留下约四分之一的攻击。预先计算的计数指标可区分两类情形，但仅基于单个零计数样本对。两处反直觉结果：Confident Learning在四对中的两对取得更高AUROC，却在dog→cat上留下2.6倍攻击成功率；原型族作为最佳静态方案，是首个被自适应攻击绕过的防御；且超过某一点后，检出更多毒化样本不再降低攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 应在"未学习过标签"的特征空间中检查标签，并以重训练后的模型而非检测分数来评判防御。检测分数更高不等于模型更安全；静态防御存在天花板，易被自适应攻击突破。该工作对后门防御评测范式提出方法论层面的修正。

Abstract: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class. The usual defenses look for the poison inside a model trained on those same labels. So when they struggle, is the problem the test they run, or the space they run it in? We answer with a controlled swap: we keep the test, the labels and the metric fixed, change only the feature space, and judge each defense by retraining the victim on what it keeps. The space decides. On dog$\to$cat the same nearest-neighbor check scores AUROC 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features that never saw a label, and 0.995 on the same network trained on clean labels, an oracle control rather than a defense. We reproduce SPECTRE, the defense FLIP's authors recommend, to 90.94 / 0.97 against its published 91.47 / 1.7, then price it: on truck$\to$deer it deletes 20% of every class, while a prototype audit on the frozen features deletes 6% for higher clean accuracy and lower attack success. On three harder pairs that audit leaves about a quarter of the attack standing. A count read off encoder geometry and clean labels, before any attack is run, separates the pair where the audit removes the attack from those where it only partly does, though on a single zero-count pair. Three results warn against the easy story. A better detection score does not mean a safer model: on two of four pairs Confident Learning scores the higher AUROC, and on dog$\to$cat leaves 2.6 times the attack success. The prototype family, our best static performer, is the first an adaptive attacker slips past. And past a point, catching more poisons stops reducing attack success. Check labels in a space that never learned them, and judge a defense by the retrained model, not by its detection score.

</details>


### [1172] [From Acoustic Sensing to Physical Actions: A Comprehensive Survey of Security Risks in Edge-Deployed Audio LLM-Based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15390)
*Wang, Binhong,Kang, Haidong,Zhang, Yanfeng,Dai, Hong-Ning,Yu, Guo,Gao, Shangce*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该综述提出"声学感知到行动"(S2A)系统模型，沿"声学感知→智能体状态→外部执行"路径梳理Audio LLM智能体的攻击、防御与评测，指出跨阶段转换处的安全缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Audio LLM已嵌入智能家居、车载、可穿戴与具身系统，声学输入可经感知传播到持久状态和实际执行，使安全分析必须从模型行为扩展到系统条件。现有综述分别讨论声学安全、LLM智能体和边缘部署，未刻画三者交互。

Method: 提出Acoustic Sensing-to-Action (S2A)系统模型，追溯声学感知到外部执行的安全影响，并纳入边缘-云运行时与生命周期变化；用该模型对声学、智能体与边缘系统文献中的攻击、防御、评测方法进行综合。

Result: 综合表明安全缺口既出现在各组件内部，也出现在阶段之间的转换处；为单一阶段开发的防护不必然提供部署系统的端到端保证。

Conclusion: 需要沿"感知到行动"追踪声学影响、覆盖持久状态、系统边界与部署条件变化的安全评测方法。

Abstract: Audio Large Language Models (Audio LLMs) are embedded in agents for smart homes, vehicles, wearables, and embodied systems, where acoustic inputs can propagate from perception into persistent state and consequential execution. This setting extends security analysis beyond model behavior to the system conditions that determine how acoustic inputs can influence agent behavior and external actions. Existing surveys examine acoustic security, LLM-based agents, and edge deployment in isolation, leaving their security interactions in deployed Audio LLM-based agents insufficiently characterized. This survey introduces an Acoustic Sensing-to-Action (S2A) system model that traces these security implications along the path from acoustic sensing to external execution, while accounting for edge-cloud runtime and lifecycle transformation. We use the model to synthesize attacks, defenses, and evaluation methods across the acoustic, agent, and edge-system literature. The synthesis shows that security gaps can emerge within components and at the transitions between stages, where protections developed for one stage do not necessarily provide end-to-end assurance in the deployed system. These findings motivate security evaluation that follows acoustic influence from sensing to action across persistent state, system boundaries, and changing deployment conditions in real-world agents.

</details>


### [1173] [Adversarial Robustness of Camera-Radar Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16012)
*Zhou, Ce,Wu, Yubo,Nguyen, Khang,Xiao, Liyang,Hou, Thomas,Yan, Qiben*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对自动驾驶中相机-雷达融合的对抗鲁棒性进行了系统性测量研究，在nuScenes上构建统一评估流水线，施加8种图像扰动与3种雷达点云扰动，跨3D检测与深度估计两项任务评测5种融合算法，揭示了"相机敏感、雷达迟钝"的鲁棒性不对称性，并据此提出四项设计启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机-雷达融合已被广泛用于自动驾驶感知，但其在对抗条件下的鲁棒性尚缺乏系统研究；作者希望回答"多传感器融合是否天然带来鲁棒性"这一问题，并找出失效根源以指导未来设计。

Method: 在nuScenes数据集上搭建统一评测流水线，对相机图像施加8种扰动、对雷达点云施加3种扰动；选取5种相机-雷达融合算法，在3D目标检测与深度估计两项任务上，用标准指标量化干净与受攻击输入下的性能，并做归因分析。

Result: 发现明显的鲁棒性不对称：中等强度的相机扰动即可大幅降低检测与深度估计性能；雷达扰动影响较小且依赖任务，检测模型退化尤其有限。归因为融合架构对稠密相机特征的强依赖，以及稀疏雷达测量上的滤波、关联与置信度加权机制。

Conclusion: 传感器融合并不自动保证鲁棒性，必须在对抗条件下显式考量各模态的贡献与可靠性；基于四项实证发现提出模态可靠性估计、跨模态一致性校验、自适应融合与严重退化下的优雅降级等设计启示。

Abstract: Autonomous driving (AD) relies on multi-sensor perception to interpret the surrounding environment. However, the robustness of camera--radar fusion under adversarial conditions remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic measurement study of the robustness of camera--radar sensor fusion in AD. We construct a unified evaluation pipeline on the nuScenes dataset that simulates attacks on both sensing modalities, including eight camera-image perturbations and three radar point-cloud perturbations. We evaluate five camera--radar fusion algorithms across two perception tasks, 3D object detection and depth estimation, and quantify their performance under clean and attacked inputs using standard metrics. Our evaluation reveals a clear asymmetry in the robustness of fusion systems. Camera perturbations substantially degrade both object detection and depth estimation, and moderate attack strengths are already sufficient to cause severe performance degradation. In contrast, the evaluated radar perturbations produce smaller and task-dependent effects, with object-detection models showing particularly limited degradation. Our analysis attributes this difference to the strong dependence of existing fusion architectures on dense camera features, together with the filtering, association, and confidence-weighting mechanisms commonly applied to sparse radar measurements. These results demonstrate that sensor fusion does not inherently guarantee robustness and that the contribution and reliability of each sensing modality must be explicitly considered under adversarial conditions. Based on four empirical findings, we derive measurement-guided design implications for future robust camera--radar fusion, including modality-specific reliability estimation, cross-modal consistency checking, adaptive fusion, and graceful failover under severe sensor degradation.

</details>


### [1174] [Beyond User-Side Defenses: Image Protection in Open-Weight Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16835)
*Kang, Jihye,Park, Jiwon,Ahn, Namhyuk*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出模型侧图像保护的四项要求（防护有效性、干净保真度、兼容性、抗篡改性），并引入长时程攻击模拟以增强抗去除能力；实验显示单一防护工具在提升抗重对齐的同时损害干净保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重部署使模型提供方难以对图像保护实施有效控制，现有防护手段在实用约束下受限，需明确模型侧保护的设计目标并研究其可行边界。

Method: 形式化提出四项保护要求（protection effectiveness、clean fidelity、compatibility、tamper resistance），并加入长时程（long-horizon）攻击模拟来考察防护被逐步去除的鲁棒性。

Result: 以单一保护工具进行的实验表明，其抗再对齐（re-alignment）去除能力有所提升，但以牺牲干净图像保真度为代价。

Conclusion: 模型侧防护存在有效性—保真度的权衡，当前单一工具难以兼顾，需进一步研究面向实用部署的模型侧保护机制。

Abstract: Model providers can support image protection, but open-weight deployment introduces practical constraints. We propose four requirements: protection effectiveness, clean fidelity, compatibility, and tamper resistance. We incorporate long-horizon attack simulations to strengthen resistance to protection removal. Experiments with a single protection tool show improved resistance to re-alignment at a cost to clean fidelity, motivating further research toward practical model-side protection.

</details>


### [1175] [DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18609)
*Jian, Chengtao,Yang, Kai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 DPOison-VL：首个针对 VLM-DPO 的"干净"偏好投毒攻击，仅通过在少量训练图像上施加不可感知扰动，保持 prompt/response/偏好标注语义不变，即可操纵模型对齐；用双层优化与梯度对齐代理构造毒样本，并提出偏好位移分数与偏好反转充分条件。2% 毒数据即可达 98% ASR，且具备跨模型迁移性，同时基本保持干净精度与通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO 已成为 VLM 对齐的主流方法，但多模态偏好数据的安全性几乎未被探索。已有偏好投毒攻击要么篡改显式监督信号，要么依赖可见触发器，容易被人工检查发现。作者希望验证：在提示、回答与偏好标注都完全语义完好、无法被人眼察觉的情况下，是否仍能静默地重定向 VLM 的对齐方向。

Method: 将毒样本构造形式化为双层优化（bilevel optimization），推导梯度对齐代理目标，高效地把图像扰动导向攻击者指定的偏好方向；提出 preference displacement score 用于有原则的毒样本选择，并在固定毒数据预算下给出其一阶最优性证明；进一步推导偏好反转（preference inversion）的充分条件。攻击只修改少量训练图像的像素级扰动，不动文本与标注。

Result: 在多种攻击任务、不同 VLM 架构与规模以及多个基线对比中，DPOison-VL 仅用 2% 毒数据即达到最高 98% 攻击成功率（ASR），并展现出跨模型迁移性，同时在大体上保持了干净精度与通用效用。

Conclusion: VLM-DPO 存在关键安全漏洞：偏好训练数据中不可感知的图像扰动即可静默重定向对齐行为，说明多模态偏好数据的鲁棒性与数据溯源需要被纳入对齐流程的安全考量。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98\% ASR with only 2\% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.

</details>


### [1176] [DarKnight: Retrieval-Guided Agentic Framework for Breaking Dark Web CAPTCHA Gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19830)
*Wu, Binghui,Yi, Yeo Zi,Tan, Darren,Baser, Manit,Csikor, Levente,Divakaran, Dinil Mon*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: DarKnight：面向暗网市场凭据监控的本地化自改进智能体 CAPTCHA 求解框架，用小型开源权重 VLM 在单张工作站 GPU 上运行，通过双信号 RAG 与自适应预处理管线学习站点判定，在最难防守市场达 83.2%，超过基线 37.2 个百分点并优于前沿商用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTI 调查员需突破暗网市场的多样化 CAPTCHA 以持续采集泄露凭据与入侵清单。现有方案要么依赖不可扩展的逐站点微调，要么依赖商用 VLM API，后者带来"操作主权"丧失：供应商政策、Tor 出口封禁、政府监管或模型更新均可能导致求解器一夜失效，且按调用计费随每次会话与重试累积。作者因此追求无需按市场训练、无第三方依赖、可在调查员自有 Tor 爬虫内本地部署的求解方案。

Method: 提出 DarKnight 自改进智能体框架。针对每张 CAPTCHA：检索相似图像上历史成功与失败尝试（双信号 RAG），据此动态组合图像特定的预处理管线，并利用站点返回的通过/失败判定作为信号进行学习。整体采用智能体式工具选择（agentic tool selection），运行于单张工作站 GPU，使用本地托管的开源权重小型 VLM。

Result: 在四个真实暗网市场案例研究中，智能体工具选择优于参数规模扩展。可部署的开源权重 VLM 结合 DarKnight 在最重防守市场达到 83.2%，较其基座模型提升 37.2 个百分点，并超过前沿 Claude Opus 5（44%）。DarKnight 以 7.6% 的退化代价回收了 48.2% 的基线失败，表明选择性工具使用可避免统一预处理造成的大部分性能退化。

Conclusion: 小型开源权重 VLM 配合智能体式选择性工具使用，可在本地单卡条件下实现强于前沿商用大模型与更大参数模型的 CAPTCHA 求解性能，同时保证操作主权与零按调用成本。结果表明"选择性工具编排"比单纯扩大参数更有效，且能缓解统一预处理带来的退化，为暗网监控等受限环境下的自动化采集提供了可部署路径。

Abstract: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) investigators who monitor dark web marketplaces for leaked credentials and breach listings must pass the diverse CAPTCHAs that operators deploy to block automated collection. Existing solvers either need unscalable per-site fine-tuning or rely on commercial Vision-Language Model (VLM) APIs, which surrender operational sovereignty: provider policies, Tor-exit blocking, government regulation, or model updates outside the investigator's control can halt or alter the solver overnight, and per-call costs recur with every session and retry. We present DarKnight, a self-improving agentic framework designed to run on a single workstation GPU inside an investigator's Tor crawler and solve CAPTCHAs with small, locally hosted open-weight VLMs that no provider decision can withdraw, without per-market training or third-party services. For each CAPTCHA, DarKnight retrieves successful and failed past attempts on similar images (dual-signal RAG), composes an image-specific preprocessing pipeline, and learns from the site's pass/fail verdict. In a case study on four real-world dark web marketplaces, agentic tool selection outperformed parameter scaling. A deployable open-weight VLM with DarKnight reached 83.2\% on the most heavily defended market, 37.2 percentage points above its base model, outperforming even the frontier Claude Opus~5 (44%). DarKnight recovered 48.2% of baseline failures at a 7.6% degeneration cost, indicating that selective tool use can avoid much of the degradation caused by uniform preprocessing.

</details>

### [1177] [MARGoS: A Configuration-Driven Platform for Reproducible MARL Experiments in ARGoS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13772)
*Backert, Tom Philipp,Soorati, Mohammad D.,Ghofrani, Javad*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MARGoS：面向ARGoS+MARL群体机器人实验的配置驱动可复现平台，将实验输入提升为平台管理的一等工件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL群体机器人领域实验组装依赖手工对齐仿真文件、训练脚本、配置值、路径、种子与环境细节，复用与复现脆弱且缺乏标准化支持，即便在同一课题组内也难以复用与交接。

Method: 基于ARGoS构建轻量级配置驱动平台MARGoS，将实验定义输入作为平台管理的工件，通过配置哈希、端到端种子传播、冻结（不可变）配置、结构化日志、环境指纹与可导出实验包实现复现、共享、回放与跨机器验证；采用架构、效率、可复现性、可用性、协作五维评估。

Result: 五维评估支持其主张：将实验变异管理作为平台职责，可使ARGoS+MARL实验更易复用、复现与交接。

Conclusion: 将可复现性工程化下沉为平台责任，为群体机器人MARL实验提供标准化复用与交接机制，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has become a prominent research direction, particularly within collective robotics, where the ARGoS simulator is widely used to study emergent swarm behavior. Yet despite this growth, systematic support for reuse and reproducibility in MARL-based swarm robotics remains limited and insufficiently standardized: a single experiment is assembled from manually aligned simulator files, training scripts, configuration values, paths, seeds, and environment details, so reuse and reproduction stay fragile even within one research group. To address this gap, we introduce MARGoS, a lightweight, configuration-driven platform developed in this project that elevates these experiment-defining inputs to first-class, platform-managed artifacts. MARGoS enables reproducible experimentation through configuration hashing, end-to-end seed propagation, frozen (immutable) configurations, structured logging, environment fingerprinting, and exportable experiment bundles that facilitate sharing, replay, and verification of results across machines and over time. A five-dimension evaluation (architecture, efficiency, reproducibility, usability, and collaboration) supports our claim that managing experiment variation as a platform responsibility makes ARGoS+MARL experiments easier to reuse, reproduce, and hand off. Our code is available at https://github.com/tombackert/margos.

</details>


### [1178] [OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14157)
*Yan, Chenyang,Zhang, Yingying,Cheng, Kanzhi,Sun, Qiushi,Pan, Zhengyuan,Ma, Zheng,Yan, Hang,Wang, Yian,Chen, Nuo,Cao, Jialin,Gong, Xingdong,Song, Wenpo,Chen, Han,Ding, Zichen,Xu, Fangzhi,Huang, Shujian,Dai, Xinyu,Liu, Yichen,Yao, Tiankuo,Wang, Bo,Kao, Ben,Zhang, Jianbing,Lu, Lewei,Lin, Dahua*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OpenMobile-2 是一个完全开放训练环境与配方的前沿移动端智能体，通过构建含 110+ 应用的 MobileGym++ 环境、约 12K 监督轨迹与 2K+ 可验证 RL 任务、以及 GUI 与 App 原生工具混合调用机制，在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld 与真实设备 SPA-Bench 上取得有竞争力的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动端智能体领域缺乏完全开放的训练环境、大规模可验证数据与统一评测基准，前沿能力被少数闭源系统垄断，社区难以复现和推进。同时现有方法仅依赖 GUI 操作，未探索应用原生工具与 GUI 动作混合使用的可能性，限制了长程复杂任务的效率与成功率。

Method: 1) 环境：MobileGym++ 提供 35 个仿真商业风格应用，支持跨应用工作流与可控重置/验证，联合 Android 模拟器新配置应用组成 110+ 应用测试场。2) 数据：构建约 12K 移动交互轨迹用于 SFT，以及 2K+ 带自动奖励的可执行任务作为最大开源可验证 RL 数据。3) 混合交互：在 50+ 应用中暴露 300+ 应用原生工具，允许智能体在单任务内交替执行 GUI 动作与工具调用。4) 基准：提出 MobileGym++ Bench 支持 GUI-only 与混合模式共享任务评测。

Result: OpenMobile-2 在 AndroidWorld 上达 79.9、MobileWorld 上达 50.4；在真实设备 SPA-Bench 上从 31.9 提升至 59.6，接近翻倍，展示出向真机迁移的潜力。

Conclusion: 完全开放的移动智能体训练环境、数据与混合 GUI-工具范式可有效提升性能并迁移至真实设备，为社区提供了可复现的基础设施与配方；但该工作聚焦移动 GUI 智能体，与具身操作、物理仿真及 3D 重建等物理 AI 核心方向关联较弱。

Abstract: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

</details>


### [1179] [Assessing the Quality of Concrete Scenarios Generated from Scenario Classes for Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18169)
*Putze, Lina,de Graaff, Thies,Becker, Jan Steffen,Neurohr, Christian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文针对自动驾驶场景库的质量评估问题，将场景距离度量聚合为“质量函数”，用于量化具体场景集合的多样性，并在虚拟验证工具链中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于场景的自动驾驶开发已成为主流，但从场景类生成具体场景时，其集合多样性的评估缺乏系统性方法；尤其在场景空间未被显式给出（约束系统形式化）时，如何评价具体场景集合质量尚不明确。

Method: 将场景距离度量聚合为质量函数（quality functions）以量化具体场景集合的多样性；针对以约束系统形式化、具体场景空间隐式未知的情形，基于一组期望属性构造质量函数候选，并给出属性满足性证明；在抽象的场景化虚拟验证工具链中开展实验。

Result: 实验中使用质量函数比较采样/变异方法的有效性、考察不同场景距离度量的选择，并研究时间维度因素对具体场景集合质量的影响。

Conclusion: 质量函数为自动驾驶场景生成提供了一种可证明、可量化的多样性评估手段，可用于指导采样变异方法选择与距离度量设计。

Abstract: A scenario-based development approach has become state of the art for automated driving systems. Once a set of scenario classes covering the operational design domain is available, concrete scenarios are generated from these scenario classes, e.g., to be used for hazard analysis and risk assessment or for the system's verification and validation. For such applications, a high diversity among the generated concrete scenarios is paramount. The question arises how the quality of collections of concrete scenarios can be assessed in such a setting. In this work, we aggregate scenario distance measures into so-called quality functions that quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections in the context of automated driving. In particular, we consider the case where scenario classes are formalized as constraint systems and the associated concrete scenario space is not explicitly known. Based on a set of desired properties we construct candidates for such quality functions and give proofs for their property fulfillment. To show the practical relevance of quality functions, we perform a variety of experiments in the context of an abstract scenario-based virtual verification toolchain for automated driving systems. More specifically, we use quality functions to compare the effectiveness of variation methods for sampling, examine the choice of different scenario distance measures, and investigate the effects of temporal aspects on concrete scenario collection quality.

</details>


### [1180] [Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection in Android Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20807)
*Freitas, Davi,Miranda, Breno,Iyoda, Juliano*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 R-DLD——一种低成本机器人辅助的 Android 应用数据丢失检测基础设施，通过物理机器人与手机传感器直接交互实现非侵入式测试，在 77 个随机应用中发现 341 个数据丢失问题，开发者响应率 100%，其中 89.55% 确认、35.82% 已修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机硬件与操作系统版本高度碎片化，需跨多配置测试；同时非侵入式（贴近终端用户操作）的测试目前多靠人工完成，成本高、繁琐且易错。机器人自动化可同时应对配置多样性与非侵入测试需求，实现快速、准确、可重复的验证。

Method: 构建 R-DLD 机器人辅助测试基础设施，使用低成本材料搭建物理机器人，直接与智能手机传感器/屏幕交互以模拟真实用户操作，在 Android 应用上自动执行数据丢失（data loss）检测流程。

Result: 在实证评估中，R-DLD 从 Android 应用商店随机选取的 77 个应用中成功识别 341 个数据丢失问题；所有上报缺陷均获开发者回应，89.55% 确认存在数据丢失，35.82% 随后被修复。

Conclusion: 机器人支持的物理交互式测试可在移动应用质量保障中实现非侵入、更真实且可重复的缺陷检测，并以高开发者确认率与可观修复率验证了其工业实用价值。

Abstract: Smartphones have become integral to modern life due to their diverse applications. However, the development of applications for these devices faces significant challenges, primarily due to two factors: (i) the diverse hardware and operating system versions that require testing across multiple configurations; and (ii) the imperative activity of testing the smartphone in a non-invasive way (similar to an end-user interaction), which is expensive, tedious and error-prone as it is usually carried out manually. In this context, robotic automation has emerged as an effective solution for addressing the diversity of smartphone systems and versions, and in performing some testing tasks non-invasively. In addition, automated robots facilitate quick, accurate, and repetitive testing, thus enabling developers to validate their applications across various configurations effectively. This results in a less invasive verification and in a significant reduction in time spent on manual testing, thus accelerating the development cycle. Our work proposes R-DLD (Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection), a robot-assisted infrastructure for data loss detection in Android applications, offeringless invasive and more realistic tests by interacting directly with smartphone sensors. The robot is constructed using cost-effective materials, facilitating its adoption in testing environments. In our empirical evaluation R-DLD successfully identified 341 data loss issues in 77 randomly selected apps from an Android store. All reported bugs received responses from the developer, with 89.55% confirming the data loss problems, while 35.82% have being subsequently fixed.

</details>

### [1181] [Variational Filtering for Bayesian Last Layers with an Independent Binary Probit Surrogate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16578)
*Markovic, Dimitrije,Heins, Conor,Tschantz, Alexander,Buckley, Christopher L.*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 IBProbit 变分滤波算法，将最后一层参数建模为线性高斯状态空间模型，用独立二元 probit 代理实现共轭闭式更新；在 DINOv3 上校准与收敛均优于 AdamW+温度缩放和 VBLL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度下降训练的深度分类器需多次遍历数据、校准不佳；事后温度缩放只能修正校准，无法影响训练期精度或收敛。作者希望一种在线、贝叶斯式更新规则同时改善精度、校准与收敛速度。

Method: 将分类器最后一层参数视为线性高斯状态空间模型的隐状态；每个 mini-batch 经精确预测步加闭式变分更新，用独立二元 probit（IBProbit）代理类别似然以获得共轭性；过程噪声在特征漂移下稳定更新并防止预测分布坍缩为点估计。同一流程既可用于冻结骨干上的线性探针，也可用于全网微调。

Result: 在 DINOv3 骨干上与 AdamW+交叉熵+事后温度缩放、VBLL 两个基线同协议对比：最大骨干上线性探针在 5 个下游任务全部取得最佳精度与 NLL，最小骨干上 5 个中 2 个最佳；最大骨干 CIFAR 探针 OOD 检测中，TPR=95% 时 FPR 相对更优基线降低 1.4–3.2 倍（三组数据集对全部有效）；ImageNet-1k 全网微调时，以一半墙钟时间达到交叉熵基线的最终性能。

Conclusion: 变分滤波作为最后层的在线更新机制，可同时提升分类精度、校准质量与收敛效率，且对骨干无关、可即插即用地替换常规监督头。

Abstract: Modern deep classifiers trained by gradient descent need many passes over the data to become accurate, and even then are not always well calibrated; post-hoc temperature scaling corrects calibration after training but cannot influence training-time accuracy or convergence. We propose a variational filtering algorithm for the last layer of deep classifiers, whose parameters are treated as the latent state of a linear-Gaussian state-space model. Each mini-batch is assimilated by an exact prediction step followed by a closed-form variational update, made conjugate by an independent binary probit (IBProbit) surrogate for the categorical likelihood. The filter's process noise stabilises the updates under feature drift and keeps the predictive distribution from collapsing to a point estimate, allowing the same procedure to be used for linear probing on a frozen backbone and for full-network fine-tuning. We evaluate on DINOv3 backbones against two baselines tuned under an identical protocol: AdamW with cross-entropy and post-hoc temperature scaling, and Variational Bayesian Last Layers (VBLL). As a linear probe on frozen features, IBProbit attains the best accuracy and negative log-likelihood on all five downstream tasks at the largest backbone, and on two of the five at the smallest. In out-of-distribution detection with CIFAR probes on the largest backbone, IBProbit reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% true-positive rate by a factor of 1.4 to 3.2 relative to the better of the two baselines, on all three dataset pairs. When the whole network is fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k, IBProbit reaches the final performance of the cross-entropy baseline in half the wall-clock time.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [1182] [Digital Twin for Pre-Deployment Validation of AI-Driven Safety-Critical Industrial Edge Control Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11934)
*Cavallero, Sara,Tonini, Federico,Chahoud, Tony,Cuozzo, Giampaolo,Borsatti, Davide,Cerroni, Walter,Fodrini, Maurizio,Marini, Riccardo*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 面向工业环境提出模块化数字孪生（DT）框架，统一建模物理过程、5G无线通信与应用逻辑，并在BI-REX试点产线以5G自主移动机器人（AMR）运输危险液体的真实PoC验证；DT可复现真实部署行为并评估AI应用在本地/边缘/云端的部署影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DT方案多只关注工业过程或通信网络，缺乏"集成+应用感知"的视角，无法在统一架构内联合评估物理过程、无线通信与应用逻辑，导致难以在部署前预测时延敏感工业控制回路的可行性。

Method: 提出模块化的工业DT框架，将物理过程、无线通信（5G）与应用逻辑纳入统一架构；在BI-REX试点产线搭建真实PoC：5G连接的AMR运输危险液体，由AI驱动应用远程控制；用DT复现真实部署行为，并对AI应用的本地（on-premise）、边缘与远程云三种部署位置进行对照分析。

Result: DT预测与PoC实测在网络级指标（RSRP、时延）和端到端应用指标（应用级RTT）上高度一致；分析表明网络建模的不准确性会显著影响时延敏感工业控制回路的可行性。

Conclusion: 集成DT可作为下一代工业系统部署前设计与验证的工具；但网络模型误差会传导至控制回路可行性判断，说明建模精度是集成DT落地的关键前提。

Abstract: Industrial environments are increasingly characterized by the tight interaction among physical processes, communication infrastructures, and intelligent applications. In this context, Digital Twins (DTs) have emerged as a key technology for system analysis and optimization. However, existing DT solutions typically focus either on industrial processes or communication networks, while lacking an integrated and application-aware perspective. To fill this gap, this paper proposes a modular DT framework for industrial environments that jointly models physical processes, wireless communications, and application logic within a unified architecture. The feasibility of the proposed framework is experimentally validated through a real-world Proof-of-Concept (PoC) implemented in the BI-REX pilot line, involving a 5G-connected Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) transporting hazardous liquids and remotely controlled by an AI-driven application. The proposed DT is used to reproduce the behaviour of the real deployment and to investigate the impact of different placements of the AI application, including on-premise, edge, and remote cloud execution scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate a close agreement between DT predictions and PoC measurements in terms of both network-level metrics, such as Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) and latency, and end- to-end application metrics, including application-level Round- Trip-Time (RTT). Moreover, the analysis shows how inaccuracies of network modeling can critically affect the feasibility of latency-sensitive industrial control loops, highlighting the potential of integrated DTs as tools for the pre-deployment design and validation of next-generation industrial systems.

</details>


### [1183] [Semantic Edge-Cloud Communication for Real-Time Urban Traffic Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14187)
*Onsu, Murat Arda,Dogru, Arman,Lohan, Poonam,Kantarci, Burak,Syed, Aisha*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出基于语义通信的边缘-云协同框架，实现对城市交通数字孪生的实时重建：边缘端仅提取并传输任务相关的语义交通信息而非原始视频流，从而大幅降低带宽与延迟开销，实验显示传输开销节省超过99%、轨迹重建平均误差仅0.12 m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市交通系统日益复杂，需要实时交通感知、主动碰撞预测与智能管理；AI驱动的交通管理依赖包含碰撞、近碰撞、违章等关键场景的高质量多样化数据。数字孪生可提供同步的虚拟镜像用于实时监控、碰撞预测与场景生成，但持续用边缘监控摄像头同步高保真城市交通数字孪生需要大量边缘-云通信，直接传输原始视频流会带来严重的带宽与延迟瓶颈。

Method: 提出面向实时城市交通数字孪生的语义通信边缘-云框架：利用边缘智能提取并传输仅与任务相关的语义交通信息，替代完整视频流，在保留重建所需关键动态的同时显著降低通信开销。

Result: 实验表明传输开销节省超过99%，平均轨迹重建误差仅0.12 m，验证了该框架在AI驱动的城市交通数字孪生应用中具备高效、可扩展、低延迟的特性。

Conclusion: 语义通信驱动的边缘-云框架可在保证数字孪生重建精度的同时大幅压缩通信负载，为实时城市交通数字孪生与AI交通管理提供可扩展的低延迟解决方案。

Abstract: Urban traffic systems are becoming increasingly complex, demanding real-time traffic perception, proactive collision prediction, and intelligent management to improve safety and reduce congestion. Although AI-driven traffic management has shown strong promise, its success relies on diverse, high-quality data spanning critical scenarios such as collisions, near-collisions, and traffic rule violations. Digital twins offer a powerful solution by enabling synchronized virtual replicas of physical traffic environments for real-time monitoring, collision prediction, traffic-flow optimization, and diverse realistic scenario generation. However, continuously synchronizing a high-fidelity urban traffic digital twin through edge surveillance cameras requires substantial edge-cloud communication, and transmitting raw video streams leads to severe bandwidth and latency constraints. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a semantic communication-based edge-cloud framework for real-time urban traffic digital twin applications. By leveraging edge intelligence to extract and transmit only task-relevant semantic traffic information instead of full video feeds, the proposed framework significantly reduces communication overhead while preserving the essential dynamics needed for accurate real-time digital twin reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate more than 99% transmission savings and an average trajectory reconstruction error of only 0.12 m, confirming the proposed framework as an effective, scalable, and low-latency solution for AI-enabled urban traffic digital twin applications.

</details>

# cs.CG [[Back]](#toc)

### [1184] [FPTAS for Polygonal Multi-Robot Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20244)
*Bandyapadhyay, Sayan,Lochet, William,Saurabh, Saket,Xue, Jie*

Main category: cs.CG

TL;DR: 该论文首次为常数个多边形机器人在多边形环境中的多机器人运动规划问题，针对最小和、最小最大和最小完工时间三种目标，给出了完全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人运动规划是机器人学的核心问题，但对于一般情形（多个机器人、任意多边形机器人），此前仅对 k=2 的单位正方形机器人有 FPTAS，或只给出固定 k 个机器人的双准则近似算法，存在公开的开放问题待解决。

Method: 针对固定数量 k 的机器人，算法在任意固定维度 d 下可推广至多面体环境与多面体机器人，构造出三类目标（min-sum 总路程、min-max 单机器人最大路程、min-makespan 最大速度 1 下的总时间）下的完全多项式时间近似方案，且算法相较前人工作显著更简单。

Result: 首次给出适用于任意固定数量 k 机器人的 FPTAS，覆盖 min-sum、min-max、min-makespan 三种目标，并直接推广到任意固定维度 d 的多面体环境与多面体机器人，解决了 Agarwal 等人 [SODA'24, SODA'26] 提出的开放问题。

Conclusion: 该工作在多机器人运动规划的理论复杂度上取得突破，统一并扩展了先前仅针对单位正方形/圆盘机器人的结果，同时提供了更简洁的算法。

Abstract: We study multi-robot motion planning in a polygonal environment with polygonal robots. The setting of the problem consists of a polygonal domain $\mathcal{W}$ with $n$ vertices and $k$ robots $R_1,\dots,R_k$ translating in $\mathcal{W}$ each of which is represented by a polygon of constant complexity. Given a source configuration $\mathbf{s}$ and a target configuration $\mathbf{t}$ of the robots in $\mathcal{W}$, the goal of the problem is to find a collision-free motion plan from $\mathbf{s}$ to $\mathbf{t}$ that is shortest with respect to some cost function. We present the first fully polynomial-time approximation schemes (FPTAS) for motion planning with any fixed number $k$ of robots, under the min-sum objective, the min-max objective, and the min-makespan objective. Here, the min-sum variant aims to minimize the total traveling distance of all robots, the min-max variant aims to minimize the maximum traveling distance of a single robot, and the min-makespan variant aims to minimize the total time cost under the assumption that all robots move with a maximum speed $1$. The algorithm directly generalizes to the problem in any fixed dimension $d$, with a polytope environment and polytope robots. Our result settles an open question of Agarwal, Halperin, Sharir, Steiger [SODA'24] and Agarwal, Holmgren, Steiger [SODA'26], who gave an FPTAS for $k=2$ unit-square robots and a bicriteria-approximation algorithm for a fixed number $k$ of unit-square or unit-disk robots, respectively. Compared to the previous results, our algorithm is substantially simpler.

</details>
