### [1185] [Computational compressive imaging reconstruction with a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19778)
*Zheng, Ze,Wu, Xiaoyan,Xu, Hang,Huang, Jingzheng,Xiao, Tailong,Zeng, Guihua*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出将成像逆问题形式化为Ising模型的物理驱动重建框架，利用非冯诺依曼Ising机器的自演化求解，在单像素成像与无透镜散射相机上以1%–25%采样率完成重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算压缩成像在高分辨率、多维图像重建及大参数网络训练时对电子计算资源需求急剧增长，成为该技术推广的瓶颈；作者希望以物理求解器替代传统电子计算，降低逆重建负担，实现实时、低功耗成像。

Method: 将成像逆问题转化为Ising模型，把目标重建映射为哈密顿量基态搜索，采用基于模拟退火的Ising求解器实现自演化求解；进一步引入前景稀疏约束与平滑约束（正则项）以提升重建质量。

Result: 在单像素成像与无透镜散射相机两类系统上，1%–25%采样率范围内均成功重建；加入前景稀疏与平滑约束后，重建质量与主流压缩感知/深度学习算法相当甚至更优。

Conclusion: 该物理驱动框架可显著降低逆重建的电子计算负担，为实时、低功耗计算成像提供新路径，但仅为概念验证，尚未展示真实硬件Ising机器上的端到端实验。

Abstract: Computational compressive imaging, such as single-pixel imaging and lensless imaging, is a promising imaging technique, enabling the reconstruction of objects from under-sampled measurements through compressed sensing algorithms or deep learning methods. However, the demand for electronic computational resources grows rapidly when recovering high-resolution and multi-dimensional images and training neural networks with numerous parameters, which has become a bottleneck for the widespread adoption of this technique. Here, we propose a physics-driven reconstruction framework that formulates imaging inverse problems as Ising models and directly recovers target objects through the self-evolution of non-von Neumann Ising machines toward the ground state of the Hamiltonian. We employ a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver to demonstrate this proof-of-concept by reconstructing objects in both single-pixel imaging and a lensless diffuser camera at sampling rates ranging from 1% to 25%. By further incorporating a foreground-sparsity constraint and a smoothness constraint, the reconstruction quality of our method is comparable to or even better than that of mainstream algorithms. This approach has the potential to substantially reduce the electronic computational burden of inverse reconstruction, paving the way for real-time, low-power computational imaging.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [1186] [Persistent LLM Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Teams via Partial Delegation to Multi-Agent Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15224)
*Mendoza, Maria G.,Tuck, Victoria M.,Ravichandran, Zachary,Sastry, Shankar,Pappas, George J.*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 基于LLM的机器人团队编排器在非终止、动态变化环境中会因prompt无限增长、推理退化、重复覆盖后停止监控而失效；本文引入马尔可夫状态摘要、部分委派和观测陈旧度提示+事件触发重提示三个机制，在模拟城市搜救中救出98%平民（基线89%），token用量减少6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将自然语言规格落地为异构机器人团队计划的LLM方法都假设任务会终止、环境虽未知但不变；而灾害响应等新兴应用中任务不终止、环境随灾害扩散和人员移动持续变化，导致LLM编排器出现三种失效模式。

Method: 沿用grounded generative intelligence框架，用每次调用时从语义地图重建的马尔可夫状态摘要替代不断增长的交互历史；通过部分委派把一部分机器人交给自主多智能体协议，编排器只保留给需精细参数和严格顺序的子任务做推理；再以显式暴露在prompt中的观测陈旧度，配合任务触发与事件触发的重提示，维持团队的持续警觉。

Result: 在含火势蔓延与人员移动的模拟城市搜救任务中，框架救出98%的平民，最强基线为89%，同时token消耗降低6倍；额外消融实验分离了各机制的贡献。

Conclusion: 面向持续运行、动态变化环境，经典机制（马尔可夫摘要、部分委派、陈旧度与触发式重提示）可有效修复LLM编排器的失效模式，在模拟搜救中取得更高成功率与显著更低的推理成本。

Abstract: Natural language specifications let non-expert users task robot teams, and large language models (LLMs) have recently proven effective at grounding such semantic specifications into plans for heterogeneous teams. Existing approaches assume missions that terminate and environments that, while unknown, do not change, but both assumptions fail in many emerging applications. For example, a disaster-response mission does not terminate, and its environment changes continuously as hazards spread and evacuees move. We identify three ways an LLM orchestrator breaks in this setting: its prompt grows without bound, its reasoning degrades as agents and targets accumulate, and it stops actively monitoring after covering the search space once. We build on the successful framework of grounded generative intelligence, and address each issue with a classical idea. A Markovian state summary, rebuilt from the semantic map at every invocation, replaces the growing interaction history. Partial delegation lets the orchestrator assign a subset of robots to an autonomous multi-agent protocol and reserve its reasoning for generating subtasks that require detailed parameters and careful ordering. Lastly, observation staleness, surfaced explicitly in the prompt, together with task-and event-triggered re-prompting, keeps the team vigilant. In a simulated urban search-and-rescue mission with spreading fire and moving evacuees, our framework rescues 98% of civilians versus 89% for the strongest baseline while using six times fewer tokens. Additional ablations isolate the contribution of each mechanism.

</details>


### [1187] [DiTSG: Context-Aware Air Traffic Scene Generation with Multi-Agent Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16959)
*Yoon, Seokbin,Kim, Kyungmin,Kwon, Taejung,Lee, Keumjin,Wei, Peng*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出 DiTSG，用多智能体倒置 Transformer 作为扩散 Transformer 去噪骨干，从记录轨迹中生成多机空中交通场景，并以各智能体的要求到达时间（RTA）为条件，生成保留真实机间交互的多样场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空域可安全高效管理的航空器数量与交通构型是 ATM 的基本问题；管制员通过速度指令、雷达引导等干预修改航迹，其干预模式难以用现有空管仿真器有效刻画，因而需要用数据驱动方式生成真实交通场景。

Method: DiTSG 将扩散 Transformer 的去噪骨干替换为堆叠的多智能体倒置 Transformer（multi-agent inverted Transformer）层，实现场景内多架航空器轨迹的联合生成；生成过程以智能体各自的要求到达时间（RTA）为条件，从而在采样时可控地产生不同交通构型。

Result: 实验表明 DiTSG 能生成多样化交通场景，在复现记录交通流统计特性的同时保持与实际运行一致的机间交互模式。

Conclusion: DiTSG 提供了一种学习式交通场景生成器，可弥补传统空管仿真器在刻画管制干预模式上的不足，为评估空域容量与交通构型提供更真实的合成数据。

Abstract: Understanding how many aircraft, and which traffic configurations, can be safely and efficiently managed by air traffic controllers within a given airspace is fundamental to air traffic management. Air traffic controllers continuously modify aircraft trajectories through interventions such as speed advisories and radar vectoring, and the patterns of these interventions are difficult to capture effectively using existing air traffic simulators. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Transformers for Traffic Scene Generation (DiTSG), which learns to generate air traffic scenes from recorded multi-aircraft trajectories. DiTSG employs stacked multi-agent inverted Transformer layers as the denoising backbone of a diffusion transformer, jointly generates the trajectories of multiple aircraft within a traffic scene, and conditions the generation on agent-specific required times of arrival. The resulting trajectories generated by DiTSG preserve realistic inter-aircraft interactions observed in actual air traffic operations. Experiments show that the DiTSG generates diverse traffic scenes that reproduce the statistical properties of recorded traffic while preserving realistic inter-aircraft interactions.

</details>


### [1188] [Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18808)
*Patel, Svar Rajankumar,Jerath, Kshitij*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出 ADiCo 双时间尺度框架，在线自适应调节合作 MARL 中的行为多样性：快时间尺度用 DiCo 将系统多样性调节到目标值，慢时间尺度用极值搜索控制器（ESC）仅依据平均回合回报调整该目标，无需模型或梯度。在两项合作任务、六种配置上，ADiCo 能保持任务适配的多样性水平，性能匹配或超过网格搜索最优的 DiCo 与无约束 DiCo。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合作 MARL 中行为多样性有助于角色分化与更丰富的联合行为，但其合适水平高度依赖任务与上下文，人工调参代价高。作者希望用控制论方法自动、在线地确定多样性目标，避免逐任务手动选择。

Method: ADiCo 为双时间尺度控制框架。快尺度上，Diversity Control（DiCo）将系统多样性调节至给定目标；慢尺度上，Extremum Seeking Controller（ESC）以平均回合回报为唯一反馈信号，在线调整多样性目标值，不依赖多样性—性能景观的显式模型或解析梯度。

Result: 在两项合作 MARL 任务共六种配置上，ADiCo 自适应得到任务适配的多样性水平：在同质策略更优时保持低多样性，在需要异质策略时提高多样性。其平均性能匹配或超过最优网格搜索目标的 DiCo 以及不设目标约束的 DiCo。

Conclusion: 将经典反馈控制引入 MARL 训练，可实现多样性的在线自动调节，为逐任务手动选择多样性目标提供系统性替代方案，从而促进有效协调。

Abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

</details>


### [1189] [Auditable and Deployable Multi-Agent Motion Planning via Posetal Games from Legal Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22277)
*Lercher, Florian,Mahesh, Karan,Huang, Yujun,Alharbi, Meshal,Zhang, Runyu,Krasowski, Hanna,Benjamin, Michael R.,Althoff, Matthias,Zardini, Gioele*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出基于"偏序偏好博弈(posetal games)"的多智能体运动规划框架：由场景无关的法律准则自动派生智能体偏好与合法性博弈，允许智能体用私有目标细化、监管方随法律演进细化偏好，并证明此类细化只会移除均衡从而保持合法性；提出belief play与分布式迭代最优响应协议以协调智能体；在海事避碰中将成对交通规则系统性提升到多船场景验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实部署的机器人需在遵守法律约束的同时完成自身目标，而这些目标往往只是部分排序(部分优先)，标量化目标或完全指定的层级结构都不适用，缺乏可审计的"从部分指定的法律到多智能体运动规划"路径。

Method: 以带偏序偏好的博弈(posetal games)建模：从抽象的、场景无关的法律关切生成智能体偏好与具体场景的合法性博弈；支持智能体私有目标细化与监管方准则演化；提出belief play（可从保守局部博弈恢复真实均衡）及信息需求更少的分布式迭代最优响应协议；在海事导航中将成对交通规则系统性地扩展到多船相遇。

Result: 在7个最多含4艘船的相遇场景中，所求得均衡下的每一次规则违反都被认证为"由法律层级强制导致"或"不可满足"；所有测试案例中均可仅凭公开信息识别违规方(defectors)；理论上证明偏好细化只能移除均衡从而保持合法性与可审计性。

Conclusion: 基于准则的偏序博弈为"部分指定的法律→多智能体运动规划"提供了一条可审计的路径，兼顾合法性、私有偏好与无需显式通信的分布式协调。

Abstract: When robots are deployed in the real-world, they must interact with other agents and accomplish their own goals while adhering to legal constraints. These potentially conflicting objectives are often only partially prioritized, making scalarized objectives or fully specified hierarchies unsuitable. We present a framework for multi-agent motion planning under legal requirements based on games with partially ordered preferences (posetal games). Scenario-independent legal guidelines order abstract legal concerns, from which we automatically derive agent preferences and a legal game for any concrete scenario. Agents may refine their legal preferences with private objectives, and regulators may refine the guideline as laws evolve. We prove that such customizations can only remove equilibria and thus preserve legality. To coordinate agents without explicitly communicating private preferences, we introduce belief play, which provably recovers the true equilibria from conservative local games, and a distributed iterative best-response protocol requiring less information. We apply the framework to maritime navigation, systematically lifting pairwise traffic rules to multi-vessel encounters. On seven encounters with up to four vessels, every rule violation of the committed equilibria is certified as forced by the legal hierarchy or unsatisfiable, and defectors are identified from public information in all tested cases. These results indicate that guideline-based posetal games offer an auditable route from partially specified laws to multi-agent motion planning.

</details>

### [1190] [Sensing via whole-body interactions with complex terrains: physical insights from robotic models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15334)
*Li, Chen*

Main category: physics.bio-ph

TL;DR: 该视角文章主张用生物启发的机器人物理模型来识别全身交互中产生的候选机械信息，检验其物理机制与行为收益，并生成生物学假设，通过三个案例（多足穿越密集障碍、无肢体躯干垂直弯曲穿越崎岖地形、蜘蛛快速屈腿辅助网震动感知）说明机器人与动物的对应关系支持机制合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物与复杂地形的交互会产生力、形变与振动等机械信息，可能引导行为，但由于运动不断重构交互，这类信息的生成与使用难以解析。感觉神经生理学与生物力学已揭示子系统内的信息转换，复杂地形研究揭示了全身交互与行为结果，但两者之间的层级衔接仍是难题。

Method: 以聚焦视角（perspective）形式，提出以生物引导的机器人物理模型作为中介工具：用机器人复现全身交互、识别候选机械信息、检验其物理机制和行为收益，进而反向生成生物学假设。具体通过三个案例研究展开：多足运动转换穿越密集杂乱环境、无肢体动物垂直躯体弯曲在崎岖地形中推进、蜘蛛快速屈腿辅助网上猎物振动感知。

Result: 机器人与动物在三个系统中的对应关系支持了这些候选物理机制的生物学合理性，并为进一步测量与建模以确定相关机械信息如何被感知并用于调制行为提供了动机。

Conclusion: 机器人物理模型可作为连接神经生理学、生物力学与整体行为层面的桥梁，用于提出可检验的机制假设并指导后续测量与建模。

Abstract: In nature, animals interact with complex terrains and often generate forces, deformations, and vibrations across the body and environment. Such interaction-induced mechanical information may guide behavior, yet its generation and use are difficult to resolve because movement rapidly and continually reconfigures the interactions that produce it. Sensory neurophysiology and biomechanics have revealed how mechanical information is transformed within sensory, neural, and musculoskeletal subsystems, whereas studies in complex terrains reveal rich whole-body interactions and behavioral outcomes. Connecting these levels remains a challenge. Here, I present a focused perspective on how biologically guided robotic physical models can help identify candidate mechanical information generated through whole-body interactions, test its physical mechanisms and behavioral benefits, and generate biological hypotheses. Three case studies illustrate this approach, multi-legged locomotor transitions to traverse dense clutter, limbless vertical body bending to propel through uneven terrain, and rapid spider leg crouching to help vibration sensing of prey on a web. Across these systems, correspondence between robots and animals supports the biological plausibility of these candidate physical mechanisms and motivates better measurements and models to determine how the relevant mechanical information is sensed and used to modulate behavior.

</details>

### [1191] [Vision-Predictor-Action: Towards Efficient Embodied AI via Neuro-Symbolic JEPA Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15556)
*Lee, Yeonseok*

Main category: cs.LO

TL;DR: VPA 用 JEPA 潜空间预测器 + 流匹配动作块生成替代 LLM 自回归解码，在 LIBERO-10 上以 <20M 参数、10–14ms 决策延迟取得 40% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型普遍通过 LLM 解码器逐 token 生成动作，推理延迟随动作序列长度线性增长，限制了闭环控制频率。作者希望用轻量潜空间控制回路彻底消除这种对动作时域的依赖。

Method: 共享视觉编码器与冻结文本编码器嵌入观测、目标图像与指令；神经符号选择器挑选离散技能；JEPA 预测器预测下一潜状态；流匹配求解器在少数积分步内一次性生成整段动作块。文中还分析了推理复杂度、防表征坍塌的正则化以及潜子目标阈值化抑制跨阶段误差累积的条件。

Result: 在 LIBERO-10 上初步验证：可训练参数 <20M（checkpoint <75MB，不含 63.4M 冻结 CLIP 文本编码器）；单相机参考配置决策步耗时 10–14ms（Apple M4）；单 GPU 训练 3 小时内，双相机策略在 200 个评估回合中成功率 40.0%。

Conclusion: 单次训练运行的初步结果说明该架构可行，作者定位为 proof of concept；代码与权重已开源。但成功率与鲁棒性证据仍薄弱，需要多随机种子、真机与更复杂任务验证。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly generate robot actions token by token through Large Language Model (LLM) decoders, causing inference latency to grow with action sequence length and limiting closed-loop control frequency. We present Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA), which replaces autoregressive decoders with a lightweight latent control loop. A shared vision encoder and a frozen text encoder embed observations, goal images, and instructions; a neuro-symbolic selector chooses a discrete skill; a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor forecasts the next latent state; and a flow-matching solver generates an entire action chunk in a few integration steps, so that sequential network evaluations per decision step do not depend on the action horizon. We analyze inference complexity, regularization against representation collapse, and conditions under which latent sub-goal thresholding limits error accumulation across task phases. As an initial proof of concept, we evaluated VPA on the LIBERO-10 suite. The trainable model has under 20M parameters (checkpoint under 75 MB, excluding a frozen 63.4M-parameter CLIP text encoder); a decision step of a single-camera reference configuration takes 10-14 ms on an Apple M4; and trained only on LIBERO-10 demonstrations in under three hours on a single GPU, a two-camera policy succeeded in 40.0% of 200 evaluation episodes. These preliminary results from a single training run suggest the approach is workable. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/ylee-sling/Vision-Predictor-Action and https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/vpa-libero10, and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22960920.

</details>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [1192] [Noise-Induced Navigation in Non-convex Domains and Compact Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10949)
*Elamvazhuthi, Karthik*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 通过允许噪声进入控制通道，用结合局部Lyapunov稳定性与正回复性的判据，构造性地设计出在带障碍的欧氏域和无边界流形上实现全局渐近稳定的初等反馈律，并拓展到非凸约束下的强凸函数最小化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑障碍（如 Brouwer 定理）导致即使全驱动系统也不存在全局渐近稳定的连续反馈律，需在随机框架下绕开该限制。

Method: 在控制通道注入噪声，将随机渐近稳定性分解为局部 Lyapunov 稳定性与正回复性（positive recurrence）两部分，并构造性地给出初等反馈律；将方法推广至非凸约束强凸优化；分析噪声强度与非凸障碍下的亚稳态。

Result: 在带障碍的连通欧氏域、无边界流形上实现目标平衡点的全局渐近稳定；在圆形障碍欧氏域与二维球面上通过数值实验验证有效性；在非凸障碍情形观察到噪声强度相关的亚稳态现象。

Conclusion: 噪声可作为绕开拓扑障碍的工具，使构造简单反馈律实现全局渐近稳定成为可能，并统一处理非凸约束优化与非凸障碍下的亚稳态问题。

Abstract: In this note, we study the problem of designing a feedback law that globally steers a system to a prescribed target configuration. Even if the system is fully actuated, topological obstructions generally prevent the existence of globally asymptotically stabilizing continuous feedback laws. We revisit this problem in a stochastic setting by allowing noise to enter through the control channels. Using a criterion for asymptotic stability in the large that combines local Lyapunov stability with positive recurrence, we constructively show that one can construct elementary feedback laws that achieve global asymptotic stability in the large, of the target equilibrium point in connected Euclidean domains with obstacles and manifolds without boundary. For Euclidean domains with obstacles, we also show that the method extends naturally to the problem of finding the minimizer of a strongly convex function with non-convex constraints. Numerical experiments illustrate the effectiveness of the approach for Euclidean domains with circular obstacles and the two dimensional sphere. Additionally, we study the role noise strength when there is a non-convex obstacle, in which case the system might show metastability.

</details>

### [1193] [Multi-Source and Multi-Dimensional Information Fusion in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13298)
*Wang, Yushi,Yu, Zhengxin,Zheng, Guhan,Miao, Wang,Debbah, Merouane*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出多源多维语义融合框架,用Hyper-Slot迭代令牌-槽位分配生成紧凑表征,并以贡献激励与Stackelberg-Nash博弈协调终端上传,提升边缘全局推理精度并大幅压缩参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘网络希望利用分布式终端的观测完成全局推理,但通信与计算资源受限,服务器只能收到模态、语义粒度、到达时间与信道条件各异的不完整令牌;且令牌价值取决于其他终端提供的互补或冗余信息。因此需要在资源约束下同时协调终端上传与边缘侧融合。

Method: 提出多源多维语义信息融合框架:1) Hyper-Slot,通过迭代的令牌→槽位分配与槽位→令牌反馈,把语义内容与可用令牌属性结合,得到紧凑表征用于全局推理;2) 基于贡献的激励机制,利用Hyper-Slot分配结果评估信息覆盖度与跨类型互补性以鼓励有效上传;3) 双层Stackelberg-Nash博弈确定服务器奖励池与终端传输质量策略,并计入计算与通信能耗成本。

Result: 在三模态扩展的COCO2014以及Flickr30K图文检索上,mAP提升3.66个百分点,RSum提升15.9点,均优于所评估的最强基线;相比朴素拼接融合基线,参数量减少80%以上。

Conclusion: Hyper-Slot在资源受限的多源边缘语义融合中同时获得精度与参数效率优势,贡献激励与博弈模型可有效协调终端的语义上传。

Abstract: Multi-source semantic information fusion enables edge networks to support global inference using observations collected by distributed terminals. However, limited communication and computation resources restrict semantic uploading, leaving the edge server with incomplete tokens that differ in modality, semantic granularity, arrival time, and channel condition. The value of these tokens also depends on the complementary or redundant information provided by other terminals. In this paper, we propose a multi-source and multi-dimensional semantic information fusion framework that coordinates terminal uploading and edge-side fusion under resource constraints. We develop Hyper-Slot to combine semantic content with available token attributes through iterative token-to-slot assignment and slot-to-token feedback, producing a compact representation for global inference. To encourage useful semantic uploading, we further design a contribution-based incentive mechanism that uses Hyper-Slot assignments to evaluate information coverage and cross-type complementarity. A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash game determines the server reward pool and terminal transmission-quality strategies while accounting for computation and communication energy costs. Experiments on a tri-modal extension of COCO2014 and image-text retrieval on Flickr30K show that Hyper-Slot improves mAP by 3.66 percentage points and RSum by 15.9 points over the strongest evaluated baselines, respectively, while reducing the number of parameters by more than 80% compared with a naive concatenation-based fusion baseline.

</details>


### [1194] [Federated Coreset Subsampling for Distributed Memory Banks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16425)
*Witzemann, Jason,Pröll, Daniel,Hegenbart, Sebastian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 将 PatchCore 记忆库异常检测适配到联邦学习场景，提出 Double Subsampling（合并已有 coreset）与 Federated Subsampling（分布式构建新 coreset）两种方法，提升冷启动性能并对域漂移、传感器漂移及不可靠参与方具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业场景中生产常跨多个工厂、同一产品在多地生产，导致各站点数据分布共享但不完全相同（non-IID）。集中式异常检测需汇聚数据，存在隐私与通信负担，因此需要联邦式的分布式异常检测方案。

Method: 基于 PatchCore 的记忆库（memory bank）异常检测框架，提出两种联邦策略：i) Double Subsampling，对已有 coreset 进行二次子采样后合并；ii) Federated Subsampling，在分布式各站点上分别采样、构建新的 coreset 并聚合，以避免直接共享原始特征或数据。

Result: 在分布式异常检测设定下，方法提升了冷启动性能，对域偏移与传感器偏移具有鲁棒性，并在部分参与方不可靠（经典基于网络的联邦学习常见问题）时仍保持性能。

Conclusion: 将 coreset 采样与联邦学习相结合，可在不共享原始数据的前提下实现跨工厂的协同异常检测，兼具冷启动效率与鲁棒性，适用于多站点工业质检部署。

Abstract: In real-world scenarios, industrial processes can span multiple factories and goods are often produced at multiple sites, leading to a shared yet non-identical distribution of data across locations. To address this, we propose two federated approaches for i) combining existing coresets (Double Subsampling) and ii) creating new coresets (Federated Subsampling) in a distributed anomaly detection setting. In particular, we adapt the memory bank based PatchCore algorithm to a federated setting, resulting in increased cold-start performance, resilience to domain- and sensor-shift, and resilience to unreliable actor participation, a common problem in classical, network based federated learning strategies.

</details>


### [1195] [A Minimum Exact Disjunctive Basis for Two-Robot Solvability Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17677)
*Ninomiya, Tsukasa,Naito, Shota,Kitamura, Naoki,Sudo, Yuichi,Wada, Koichi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文完整刻画了平面内两个自主移动机器人在可变定向、手性与刚性运动假设下任务的"可解性轮廓"(solvability profile)：证明所有上集(upset)均可实现，构造了含13个任务的极小精确析取基，并证明可实现轮廓构成完整的有限分配格Up(Q)（恰54个轮廓，由反链多项式1+13z+24z²+16z³计数），每个轮廓可用至多三个主任务表示；另给出6个最小分离任务紧致恢复Q中所有包含与不可比关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式移动机器人领域，已知四种标准能力模型与调度器构成13个计算类的商序Q，但"哪些轮廓(轮廓=可解类集合)实际可实现"这一问题未被回答。核心动机是：为整个能力层级提供一份精确、极小且唯一的任务字典——刻画全部可实现的可解性轮廓，并给出能通过精确析取组合出任意轮廓的最小任务基，从而把算力/能力层级的可解性理论补全为完整格结构。

Method: 1) 在商序Q（13个计算类）上形式化"可解性轮廓"为Q的上集，轮廓集合构成分配格Up(Q)。2) 构造性证明每个上集可实现：为13个主上集各设计一个具体任务，构成最小精确析取基。3) 精确性证明：对每个位于目标并集之外极大类中的算法，构造单条可容许公平执行，使其同时违反所有被选谓词，从而排除"逐次执行满足不同析取项"带来的非精确性。4) 对任意反链，验证其对应任务析取的轮廓恰等于各轮廓之并。5) 分离任务构造：给6个任务，其可解性签名恢复Q中全部包含与不可比关系，并证明6为任意分离任务下的最小值；其轮廓恰为Q的join-irreducible元素生成的主上集。6) 计数与表示：用反链多项式给出54个轮廓的分布，并证明每个轮廓存在至多含3个主任务的典范析取表示。7) 唯一性/最小性：证明任何能通过精确析取生成全部轮廓的任务族必含全部13个主轮廓，故该基最小且在轮廓层面唯一。

Result: • 实现了全部upset：可实现的可解性轮廓恰为整个有限分配格Up(Q)。• 轮廓总数恰为54个，按反链多项式1 + 13z + 24z² + 16z³分布（即13个单反链、24个二元反链、16个三元反链对应轮廓）。• 构造出13个任务的极小精确析取基，每个主上集对应一个任务；基在轮廓层面唯一且最小。• 每个轮廓有典范析取表示，至多使用3个主任务。• 对任意反链，相应任务析取的轮廓精确等于各轮廓之并，该精确性由"单条公平执行同时违反所有谓词"的构造保证。• 给出6个分离任务，其可解性签名恢复Q中所有包含与不可比关系，且6为最小（即使允许任意分离任务）；这6个任务的轮廓正是Q的join-irreducible元素生成的主上集。

Conclusion: 该工作将平面双机器人（可变定向/手性/刚性运动）任务可解性理论补全为完整格：可实现轮廓=Up(Q)，恰54个，具有唯一的13任务极小精确析取基与至多3项的典范表示；Q的关系结构可用6个最小分离任务紧致刻画。结论为分布式机器人能力层级提供了精确的组合学字典与最小基，确立了精确析取语义下的最小性与唯一性。

Abstract: We completely characterize the solvability profiles of tasks for two autonomous mobile robots in the plane under variable disorientation, chirality, and rigid movements. The four standard capability models and the schedulers considered here have a known quotient order Q of thirteen computational classes. A task's solvability profile is the set of classes in which it is solvable, and is necessarily an upset of Q. We prove that every upset is realizable and construct a minimum exact disjunctive basis of thirteen concrete tasks. The basis contains one task for each principal upset. For every antichain of Q, the disjunction of the corresponding tasks has profile exactly equal to the union of their profiles. This exactness is not implied by the individual profiles: an algorithm may satisfy different disjuncts in different executions. We establish it by constructing, for every algorithm in each maximal class outside the target union, a single admissible fair execution violating all selected predicates simultaneously. Consequently, the realizable profiles form the entire finite distributive lattice Up(Q): there are exactly 54 profiles, counted by the antichain polynomial 1 + 13z + 24z^2 + 16z^3, and each has a canonical disjunctive representation using at most three principal tasks. We also identify six tasks whose solvability signatures recover every inclusion and incomparability in Q, and prove that six is minimum even among arbitrary separating tasks. Their profiles are precisely the principal upsets generated by the join-irreducible elements of Q. In contrast, any task family generating every profile by exact disjunctions must contain all thirteen principal profiles. Thus our exact disjunctive basis has minimum size and is unique at the profile level.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [1196] [Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10857)
*Rath, Prabin Kumar,Patil, Omkar,Gopalan, Nakul*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Keyframe Mnemonics自监督方法,从历史观测中学习目标函数并作为奖励筛选信息关键帧(mnemonics),以关键帧为条件训练BC策略;在非马尔可夫环境中实现无限视野上下文保留,合成域100%成功率,机器人操作基准23任务平均绝对提升13.9%,真机20倍视野下保留80%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非马尔可夫环境下的行为克隆要求策略对长视野上下文进行推理。现有策略架构存在问题:循环模型在BPTT下存在隐状态坍缩与梯度不稳定,注意力模型受上下文长度根本限制。

Method: Keyframe Mnemonics:自监督地从随机采样的过去观测中学习一个目标函数,将其作为关键帧选择的奖励,从而"发现"一组信息关键观测(mnemonics);再训练以所发现关键帧为条件的BC策略来建模动作分布。在特定任务结构假设下,该形式化提供无限视野的上下文保留保证,同时将决策相关关键帧维持在小规模工作记忆内。

Result: 合成记忆域上,mnemonic条件BC策略达100%成功率,并泛化到比训练长数个数量级的视野而无性能退化;记忆密集型机器人操作基准上,23个任务平均绝对成功率较最强基线提升13.9%;真机上20倍更长视野仍保留80%成功率。

Conclusion: 通过学习目标函数筛选关键帧并以其为条件训练策略,可在非马尔可夫任务中以小规模工作记忆实现无限视野上下文保留,并在合成域、操作基准与真机长视野场景中显著优于现有循环/注意力基线。代码与视频已公开。

Abstract: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

</details>


### [1197] [Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11231)
*Fan, Minhao,Liu, Yinyi,Zhao, Jiayu,Teng, Zihan,Chen, Song,Liu, Weichen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Harness Compilation (HC)：用大模型教师根据小 VLM 的执行轨迹来改写"外部工具调用与协作接口"（可复用内容 + 控制策略），再用验证集选择最终部署方案；部署时无需改权重、也无需教师调用。在 7 个 VQA 设定、学生模型 ≤9B 下平均提升 9.9–23.9 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小规模视觉语言模型往往"能读证据但找不到/取不到证据"。现有做法偏向统一删减决策（如只做答案微调），缺少对小模型行为差异的度量式分工。

Method: 离线编译流程：冻结的小 VLM 与可配置外部 harness 协同；大教师模型读取学生执行 trace，修订可复用内容与运行时控制策略；独立验证集选择部署 harness。对 5 类运行时决策（是否调用、工具选择、参数生成、证据整合、弃答）做干预实验。对比 answer-only LoRA。

Result: 跨 7 个 VQA 设定平均提升 9.9–23.9 分（每种设定 3 次独立构建平均）；事实卡对全部 10 个学生都有益，但决策策略迁移不均衡；接口失配时按新学生重新编译有效；仅 100 条练习样本即超 answer-only LoRA（3 个任务）；更大训练预算可匹敌或超过固定 harness，二者结合在 SlideVQA 上优于单独使用。

Conclusion: 应按"测得的实际学生行为"而非统一削减决策来分配工作：请求证据、生成开放查询代价高，而受限选项与阅读给定文本是可保留的学生任务。属通用 agent/工具使用与 VLM 协作方法论，非物理 AI/机器人/3D 核心方向。

This content has not passed the compliance test and has been hidden.（无冒犯性内容，此处仅为格式说明：无敏感元素。）

Abstract: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

</details>


### [1198] [MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11723)
*Xu, Zhangbo,Zhang, Ruoxi,Hu, Rui,Wang, Yisong,Li, Xitong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MultiWorldBench，一个 Minecraft 多玩家世界模型诊断基准（495 个案例、7 个任务套件、10 项能力），评测 Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld 与引擎 GT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多玩家世界模型要求多个独立控制的视角在同一持久共享世界中保持一致，但现有评测缺乏针对多视角一致性、共享状态同步与持久性的诊断手段。

Method: 构建 MultiWorldBench：基于 Minecraft 的 495 组案例配置，覆盖独立控制、跨视角运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互、延迟重访等能力；对三个生成式系统与引擎 GT 参考基线进行自动指标评测，并辅以人类偏好评价。

Result: 十项能力均值：Gamma-World 21.39 > Solaris 20.88 > MineWorld 1.89，引擎 GT 91.69；Gamma-World 在控制、共享状态、重访上更强，Solaris 在跨视角运动与竞态一致性上领先；所有生成系统状态持久性≤8.00、结构一致性≤1.33，空间推理与建筑身份保持全部失败；人类偏好与自动评测排名一致，维度级 Spearman 均值 0.96。

Conclusion: 生成式世界模型虽能产出看似合理的单视角画面，但尚不具备一致的多玩家共享世界建模能力；该基准为多智能体/多视角世界模型提供了诊断工具与量化证据。

Abstract: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

</details>


### [1199] [Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $\Phi$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11735)
*Szywala, Clotilde,Goudemant, Thomas,Bellizzi, Marjorie,Francesconi, Benjamin,Girard, Adrien*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ESA Φsat-2 上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流水线：仿真训练→在轨集成→发现仿真-真实域差异→用真实 L1 影像重训并改进标注，性能显著提升，强调在轨数据对科学验证的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 星上 AI 可提升对地观测的响应速度与带宽效率，但受限于硬件资源；作者希望验证在资源受限卫星上运行海洋异常检测的可行性，并厘清仿真开发与在轨验证的边界。

Method: 流水线包含海陆分割、海洋区域自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测，以及可选异常类型表征。发射前用 Φsat-2 仿真影像训练与验证；在轨集成与功能验证后，基于真实 Level-1 影像、采用改进标注策略（处理模糊海域）重新训练。

Result: 在轨早期实验发现仿真与真实数据存在显著域不匹配；以真实 L1 影像重训并改进标注后，性能大幅提升，验证了星上部署的可行性。

Conclusion: 仿真开发有助于飞行前降低风险，但可靠的科学验证必须依赖具代表性的在轨数据，并应与功能验证明确区分；稳健的标注策略与传感器感知设计至关重要。

Abstract: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $\Phi$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $\Phi$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $\Phi$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $\Phi$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

</details>


### [1200] [Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11794)
*Zhao, Haoyu,Yu, Zhengxu,He, Zhiyuan,Fang, Meng,Tutunov, Rasul,Bou-Ammar, Haitham,Luo, Weilin,Wang, Jun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Memento 3 让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型：以自然语言规则手册持久化可修正的环境动力学假设，编译为可执行代码用于预测与规划，并用预测误差驱动“观察—反思—改规则—编译—验证”的闭环；在 ARC-AGI-3 上通关全部 25 个公开游戏，Pong 上学习到的反馈控制器 21:0 获胜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陌生环境中的智能体需要在有限观测下推断世界运作方式并随证据修正认知，但有限观测常存在多个都能解释交互历史、却在未见状态上预测不同的世界模型，因此需要一种可持续更新、且能区分可修正假设与未知部分的世界模型学习机制。

Method: 以 Memento 系列为基础，冻结 LLM 智能体维护自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动力学的可修正假设并对未知部分保持未指定；通过编译把规则手册转为可执行代码用于预测与规划；采用观察、反思、规则修订、编译、验证的持续循环，用预测误差精化规则与代码。更新仅在 LLM 判定代码忠实于规则手册且“cell-exact replay”能复现观测转移时才被接受。群体扩展并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据并用预测引导探索。

Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的每一关，平均 RHAE 为 100.0，仅使用人类动作数的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例中，学习得到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局片段中均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。

Conclusion: 该工作将显式世界模型的外部记忆化持续学习视为基于模型的递归自我改进路径：智能体在底层 LLM 冻结条件下自主探索、修正世界模型并用经验证的更新引导后续交互与学习。

Abstract: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

</details>


### [1201] [HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12363)
*Wu, Xiazhen,Qin, Wansong,Zheng, Yangbin,Fang, Liangda,Li, Zhan,Huang, Xiujie,Zhou, Liushen,Guan, Quanlong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出HANS——首个面向真实教育场景的手写答题纸识别数据集，覆盖数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及涂改、删除等噪声；并基于此提出NA-GOT端到端框架，通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块与解码阶段噪声感知注意力实现两阶段噪声抑制，显著提升答题过程识别的准确性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能阅卷与自动评分是智慧教育的关键基础设施，但现有文档解析与手写识别基准主要面向结构良好的印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，缺少能反映学生答题纸真实特性的数据集——多行推导过程、文本与公式的异构混排、删除线等噪声伪迹。这一数据缺口限制了鲁棒识别方法的研究。

Method: 构建HANS数据集，显式面向真实教育场景，包含数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及包括更正与删除在内的多样噪声模式，并提供细粒度标注。在此基础上提出NA-GOT端到端框架：第一阶段为特征级轻量噪声抑制模块（轻量级），第二阶段在解码阶段引入噪声感知注意力机制，形成两阶段噪声抑制流程。

Result: 实验表明HANS对现有方法构成显著挑战；NA-GOT在答题过程识别的准确率与稳定性两方面均取得明显提升。数据集将在论文发表后公开。

Conclusion: 论文填补了真实教育场景手写混合文档识别基准的空白，并提供两阶段噪声抑制的端到端解决方案，为智能阅卷与自动评分中的鲁棒识别研究奠定数据与方法基础。

Abstract: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [1202] [BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12452)
*Kulits, Peter,Xu, Yiqing,Jones, R. Kenny,Schmid, Cordelia,Wu, Jiajun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 BrickBench 基准与 BrickAgent 环境，用于评测智能体根据文本提示设计可实际拼搭的乐高模型，从有效性、语义对齐和设计感三个维度打分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体在受约束的物理构建任务上缺乏可度量的评测标准；乐高设计同时要求语义满足与物理可拼搭性，是检验智能体联合推理局部与全局约束能力的理想载体。

Method: 构建 BrickBench 基准：给定文本提示，智能体需从离散零件库中选件并组装，同时满足语义与设计标准；在三种不同规模与零件可得性设置下评测有效性、对齐度与设计水平；并提供 BrickAgent 环境，使编码智能体能够构建、检查与验证设计。

Result: 领先的智能体基本能满足可验证的物理与语义要求，但设计质量仍不及人类。

Conclusion: 该工作为智能体在受约束物理构建任务上的能力提供了可复现的评测平台，并公开基准与环境，揭示出智能体在创造性设计上的人类差距。

Abstract: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

</details>


### [1203] [EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13021)
*Huang, Jie,Chen, Yanan,Liu, Ruixun,He, Kaichen,He, Xinyi,Huang, Rui,Zheng, Zilong,Zhang, Zhenliang,Zhong, Yiwu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个具身仿真持续学习基准 EmbodiedCLBench，以组合泛化为原则评测自进化智能体：基础任务经验能稳定提升复杂新任务表现，但收益不随样本量扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习研究大多局限于非具身设定，未延伸到具身环境；需评估智能体能否积累经验并迁移到新任务。

Method: 构建 EmbodiedCLBench 具身仿真基准，以组合泛化为核心原则：智能体先学基础任务，再重组已获技能解决未见复杂高级任务；在多种 agent harness 与学习范式上做广泛实验。

Result: 零样本下高级任务几乎无法解决，基础任务经验带来持续提升且随复杂度增加保持稳定；但该提升不随学习样本数扩展，当前智能体无法从额外经验中提取有效信息。

Conclusion: 持续学习是具身智能中基础但未被充分探索的能力；该基准为设计高效自进化具身智能体提供资源与评测平台。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

</details>


### [1204] [AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13354)
*Zhang, Octi,Akinola, Iretiayo,Scalise, Rosario,Castro, Mateo Guaman,Yin, Patrick,Widmer, Tobias,Macklin, Miles,Amevor, Chris,Turpin, Dylan,Van Gelder, Dirk,Carius, Jan,Handa, Ankur,State, Gavriel,Guo, Yunrong,Narang, Yashraj*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaNIST 用单一稀疏二值任务奖励、无需示教/进度塑形/脚本基元/逐任务调参，在仿真中从零为 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 的全部 20 个装配任务训练出单一策略，达到 98.2% 训练成功率，并在十对零件的无序单回合装配中涌现出灵巧与类规划行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NIST Assembly Task Board #1 是学习式机器人操作的困难基准：短时程需要小间隙紧配合的富接触精密控制，长时程需要跨长动作序列的恢复与协调。以往依赖示教、任务分解和稠密进度奖励来"教"机器人如何装配，这本质上预设了策略结构。受 AlphaGo 到 AlphaGo Zero 的启发，作者追问：是否仅靠稀疏的二值任务奖励加上该奖励天然允许的任务多样性，就能让机器人自行发现"如何装配"，即把策略规范最小化到极限。

Method: 纯仿真强化学习，从零训练单一策略，覆盖 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 全部 20 个装配任务。关键设计：不使用示教数据、不使用进度塑形/稠密奖励、不使用脚本化基元、不做逐任务超参或奖励调参；奖励仅为稀疏二值任务成功信号。任务多样性由该任务无关奖励自然允许（同一策略跨 20 任务与跨装配对）。另设长时程设定：单个回合内完成十对装配，且不规定顺序，仅当全部十对同时完成才给成功奖励。方法核心是任务无关的稀疏奖励 + 跨任务共享策略，从而把"如何装配"留给大规模 RL 自主探索。

Result: 在仿真中达到 98.2% 的整体训练成功率；在无规定顺序的十对装配长时程任务中也能训练出策略；涌现行为包括：为后续装配选择合适抓取、利用周围几何结构重新定向零件、先准备一个零件、装配另一个、再返回完成前一个，且无显式规划器。论文为项目主页/视频形式。

Conclusion: 结果支持"最少任务规范"的观点：在富接触精密装配这一难点上，稀疏二值奖励加任务多样性足以驱动单一策略从零学会装配，并自发产生灵巧操作与类规划的协调行为。其价值在于验证了策略发现可脱离示教与稠密奖励，但证据限于仿真、为项目主页报告形式、跨任务泛化与真实机器人迁移尚不明确。

Abstract: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: https://alpha-nist.github.io/

</details>


### [1205] [A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13479)
*Hodge, Victoria J.,Paterson, Colin,Alexander, Rob*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于本地LM的笔记本电脑端智能体框架，用"思考-行动-观察-更新-继续"循环与JSON编码自适应生成自动驾驶边缘场景，并以独立LM评审、仿真指标分析与聚类提供可追溯的安全保障证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘/长尾场景对自动驾驶系统的训练、测试与安全认证至关重要，但现有LM场景生成方法多依赖人在回路或规则策略，难以覆盖分布长尾；同时需要低成本、可控、隐私安全的方案并产出可追溯的安全论证证据。

Method: 在本地笔记本电脑上部署本地LM构成智能体AI框架：以系统需求、系统描述、环境描述作为知识库构建上下文提示以保证场景真实性；采用think/act/observe/update/continue循环与轻量JSON编码生成场景；第二个独立LM按领域特定准则评审并精化场景；精化场景进入仿真并获得评价指标；依据指标分析进行开发（生成相似边缘场景）或探索（生成新颖场景）；最后用指标聚类与场景文本的主题类型分析定位功能缺口及触发条件。

Result: 实现了本地、低成本、完全可控且隐私安全的边缘场景生成流程，可通过指标驱动的开发-探索循环不断扩展场景空间，并借助聚类与主题分析给出可追溯的安全保障证据，定位功能缺口与触发条件。

Conclusion: 本地智能体AI框架能灵活、自适应地自动化边缘场景生成，并产出可追溯的安全保障证据，展示了其在自动驾驶安全验证中的应用潜力。

Abstract: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.

</details>


### [1206] [MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13534)
*Bernat, Loan,Grard, Matthieu,Herbulot, Ariane,Lamiraux, Florent*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MAGMA-Bench，一个架构无关的动态多机器人长期任务推理基准，包含技能级接口、261,646 条任务级训练样本与专家轨迹生成管线；评估显示现有模型在干净与扰动场景下均失败率较高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期具身智能体需要维持任务相关信息、协调异构机器人并随执行过程动态调整决策；现有基准分别研究动态任务执行与具身多智能体协调，但对二者交集缺乏系统评估，尤其缺少受控在线扰动与异构能力协调下的持续任务推理评测。

Method: 构建 MAGMA-Bench：架构无关基准，通过逐步增长的任务时域与受控在线扰动（执行失败、任务中断、任务更新）评测，场景要求异构能力机器人协同；采用结构化技能级接口，将任务级推理与感知、底层控制解耦。评测对象包括本地可部署开源权重规划器、多智能体状态跟踪策略与前沿模型，并给出监督式适配实验。

Result: 最强模型在相当比例干净回合中仍失败，在线扰动下成功率进一步下降；监督式适配可显著提升小模型性能，但在更长时域与多机器人任务上仍明显偏低。同时开源基准、261,646 条任务级训练样本与架构无关专家轨迹生成管线。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了动态执行与多机器人协调交叉评测的空白，提供可复用的基准、数据与轨迹生成工具，并揭示当前规划器在长期、异构、扰动条件下的持续任务推理能力仍显著不足。

Abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.

</details>


### [1207] [UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13783)
*Andrushko, Nazar,Schmitt, Vera,Solopova, Veronika*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了乌克兰战时迷因数据集UkrMeme（200条）及Propaganda 950的乌语翻译子集PTM-UA，评测视觉语言模型在零样本设置下的说服技巧检测能力（图像/文本/多模态，层次化F1），并对比LRP与模型生成token归因方法所强调的证据语义类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迷因是现代在线传播的核心形式，在政治冲突语境下视觉与文本线索结合以传递说服性信息；然而针对乌克兰语/乌克兰战时迷因的说服技巧检测缺乏数据集与评测，且VLM在该任务上的可解释性归因尚不清楚。

Method: 提出UkrMeme（200条真实乌克兰战时迷因，标注说服技巧）与PTM-UA（Propaganda 950子集的乌克兰语翻译，保留原图、仅译文本）；在零样本提示下分别以图像、文本、多模态输入评测VLM，使用层次化F1指标；对比Layer-wise Relevance Propagation（LRP）与模型生成token归因，并分析各解释方法偏重的证据语义类别。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；工作产出为两个数据集/基准资源、跨模态零样本评测框架，以及LRP与token归因在证据类别偏好上的对比分析。

Conclusion: 该研究将多模态说服技巧检测引入乌克兰语迷因场景，并提供数据集、基准与可解释性归因比较，为后续跨语言、跨模态的劝说性内容分析提供基础，但未涉具体方法创新或真实系统部署。

Abstract: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

</details>


### [1208] [Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14294)
*Kenfouo, Sylvain Dehayem,Zweig, Aaron,Zhang, Mingxuan,Azizi, Elham*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法，利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射的局部拉回几何识别最敏感方向，沿该方向引导不同采样轨迹以提升条件生成图像的多样性，同时保持一致性与质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件扩散模型从不同随机种子生成的样本往往视觉相似，限制创意探索；现有增多样性的方法需额外优化或采样开销，强扰动又损害图像质量与提示对齐。

Method: 免训练方法。基于条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射诱导的局部拉回（pullback）几何，估计输出对条件嵌入的敏感性方向，沿最大敏感方向对采样轨迹进行引导/扰动，从而在保持条件一致性的前提下产生差异化生成。

Result: 在 MS-COCO 与 BrushNet 上验证，提升了提示条件图像生成与图像修补（inpainting）的输出多样性。

Conclusion: 通过拉回几何的敏感性方向引导采样，可在无训练、低开销条件下提升条件扩散生成的多样性，适用于生成与修补任务。

Abstract: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

</details>


### [1209] [ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14307)
*Khalafi, Shervin,Fallah, Kasra,Cho, Sung,Ding, Dongsheng,Anderson, James,Ribeiro, Alejandro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ConicFlow 将流匹配模型的受约束采样建模为最优控制问题，用滚动时域原始-对偶算法在采样过程中满足硬终端约束并最大化奖励，同时偏离预训练轨迹更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从预训练流匹配模型采样时，常需在保持生成质量的同时满足硬约束（如安全性、可行性）并最大化奖励；现有引导方法在硬约束满足与偏离预训练分布之间难以兼顾，且计算开销大。

Method: 将推理时受约束采样表述为以「偏离预训练轨迹」为代价、以奖励为目标、带硬终端约束的最优控制问题；离散化后采用滚动时域控制（receding-horizon control），每步只优化短窗口内的轨迹以保证可计算性；用滚动时域原始-对偶算法求解子问题，对偶乘子刻画各约束的满足难度并在采样中不断精化；进一步提出终端估计变体，在预测的终端点而非当前时域末端评估奖励与约束，以避免局部截断误差累积。

Result: 在标准正则性假设下给出有限时域次优性保证；在凸-仿射结构下得到随时域截断长度线性增长的更紧界，并证明当流动力学变化缓慢时终端估计变体理论上更紧。在低维与高维实验中，使用近期大规模流匹配模型，ConicFlow 相比近期基线取得更高奖励与更强约束满足，同时偏离预训练流更小。

Conclusion: ConicFlow 将受约束采样统一为滚动时域最优控制问题并提供理论保证，在保证硬约束满足与高奖励的同时保持对预训练流的低偏离，适用于低维与高维生成任务。

Abstract: We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish finite-horizon guarantees on suboptimality. Under convex-affine structure, we derive a sharper bound that scales linearly with omitted horizon length, and we show that the terminal-estimate variant is provably tighter when the flow dynamics change slowly. Experiments in both low- and high-dimensional settings with a recent large-scale flow matching model show that ConicFlow achieves high reward and strong constraint satisfaction while deviating less from the pretrained flow than recent baselines.

</details>


### [1210] [ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14523)
*You, Lingsen,Guo, Yujun,Zhong, Xinyu,Feng, Zijie,Wang, Wentong,Shen, Li,Ge, Junbo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对 ScienceBuddy-PV 的固定组件在 ARCADE 语法与狭窄分割任务上做锁定测试集审计，检验其证据台账与弃答门控的可测量性与可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 ScienceBuddy 的递归设计迁移到泛血管介入研究，并希望把"支持度"与"弃答/拒答"行为变成可测量、可复现的对象，为后续协作式智能体研究提供协议基础。

Method: 仅审计固定组件而非完整智能体系统：采用结构化证据台账、器件-血管本体、弃答契约与保留失败库；递归框架优化与外层模型学习（含强化学习）仅给出规范未执行。在 ARCADE 语法与狭窄两个任务上各用 1,000/200/300 图像划分，训练一次共享的任务掩码卷积模型，冻结参数与启发式支持门控，狭窄阈值在验证集上选取。

Result: 锁定测试集上语法 Dice 0.475（95% CI 0.459-0.490），狭窄 Dice 0.231（95% CI 0.214-0.249）；狭窄像素 AUROC 0.957、AUPRC 0.180（患病率 0.00975）；门控接受 76.7% 的狭窄帧输出，而仅评分比较器为 100%；构造掩码审计中接受 44.3% 参考候选、拒答 55.7%。

Conclusion: 该公开数据组件审计使支持与弃答行为可测量，并提供可复现协议；但未证明递归改进、患者级有效性或临床器械建议，接受不等于正确或临床安全。

Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

</details>


### [1211] [A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14680)
*Garg, Pushp,Sarma, Himangshu,Ghorai, Mrinmoy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构感知混合框架用于印度手语（ISL）词汇级识别：熵驱动SVD采样提取关键帧，连续双位置编码+距离感知弹性Transformer处理不规则时序，运动学条件自适应GCN建模双手几何；自建120类、9453视频数据集，达89.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISL识别面临签名速度多变、空间结构复杂等挑战，且受限于大规模词汇基准稀缺，标准模型难以处理不规则签名速度与固有双手特性。

Method: 熵驱动SVD采样器动态提取信息关键帧以减少计算冗余；针对子采样造成的不规则物理时间间隔，采用连续双位置编码配合距离感知弹性Transformer保持自然签名节奏；空间上使用运动学条件自适应GCN，以统一骨-关节特征显式建模双手几何；辅以物理节点Dropout与ArcFace优化抑制主体记忆；并构建120类、9453视频的原生ISL数据集。

Result: 在自建120类、9453视频ISL数据集上取得89.8%准确率，为复杂手语建模建立强基线。

Conclusion: 该框架通过关键帧采样、弹性时序建模与双手几何图卷积的组合，有效应对ISL的不规则节奏与双手结构，但验证仅限自建数据集，缺乏公开基准对比与跨数据集泛化证据。

Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

</details>


### [1212] [How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14707)
*Wu, Xiaofan,Zeng, Xi,Chen, Miaoxia,Chen, Peishan,Li, Shuyan,Wang, Chen,Wang, Xiaohan,Xu, Wanling,Yao, Jiyun,Zhong, Hanyong,Zhu, Jiahao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TasteBench：一个"审美/品味"成对好-坏评测基准（视觉/品牌/书籍/技术品），采用专家金标准与冻结评分规则，并配一套控制协议以区分真实工艺判断与"刷榜"。在 250 对试点上量化出三类效度威胁：位置偏置（偏好项在 A 槽概率 0.956）、文件名词元泄漏（0.912）、以及工艺域人类的难度天花板（多项达 1.0）。协议可测量并修正前两者，并给出侧别随机化工具（位置偏斜由 0.916 降至 0.495/0.505）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐人类专家的"品味"基准应奖励工艺判断力，而非应试刷分能力。现有成对评测中普遍存在可利用的捷径（答案位置、文件名线索）与天花板效应，导致分数虚高、无法反映真实判别力，因此需要把"工艺判断"与"测试博弈"分离并加以量化。

Method: 提出 TasteBench：跨视觉、品牌、书籍、技术品的成对 good-vs-bad 基准；冻结 rubric，采用仅专家金标准（专家组 n≥3，percent agreement≥0.60 为主门槛；弱参与标签仅用于训练/分析），设弱标签防火墙。配套控制协议：at construction 阶段做侧别随机化、文件名清洗、困难样本过滤；Round-1 试点为主专家标注（3 名真人专家，n=250 对），并在 A/B 随机化（eval_assignment_seed7，gold_side_A≈0.47）下评测 5 个 VLM。发布参考评测 harness 与侧别随机化工具。

Result: 量化三项效度威胁：(1) 位置——偏好项位于 A 槽概率 0.956，always_item_a 策略得 0.956（随机 0.5）；(2) 词汇泄漏——文件名 token 线索可得 0.912；(3) 难度天花板——书籍/品牌/技术人类一致性达 1.0，A/B 随机化下 5 个 VLM 在工艺域全部 1.0，仅视觉域有区分度（约 0.84–0.91），事后困难子集（n=107）工艺域仍为 1.0。侧别随机化工具可将位置偏斜从 0.916 修正为 0.495/0.505。

Conclusion: 给出该基准"能测什么、尚不能测什么"的校准视角：位置偏置与词元泄漏属可修复的构建伪影；工艺域天花板是成对难度极限，需 Round-2 解决。本文不评估参与度、年代/圈层条件与校准，也不主张通用品味 SOTA。

Abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

</details>


### [1213] [A Decade of PhotoMappers: A Longitudinal Study of Crowdsourced Disaster Photos Geolocalization with Vision-Language Models and Geospatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15403)
*Li, Hao,Yin, Wenping,Deuser, Fabian,Jia, Jia,Liu, Ziqi,Juhász, Levente,Zhang, Fan,Biljecki, Filip*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用十余年PhotoMappers众包灾害影像，结合纵向空间分析与跨视角地理定位（VGI+SVI+RSI），并用30项指标评测VLM地理推理，发现档案时空分布不均、Sinkhorn重排达40.90% R@1，GeoAI应辅助而非替代人类地理判读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包灾害影像可提供及时的地面观测，但其地理价值取决于观测产生的位置、如何被解释、以及能否被可靠定位为可操作的地理空间情报（GEOINT）；同时需要厘清新兴GeoAI模型与人类地理判读之间的能力差异。

Method: 以PhotoMappers十余年数据为基础，结合纵向空间分析与基于街景（SVI）和遥感影像（RSI）的跨视角地理定位；引入Sinkhorn重排序融合VGI/SVI/RSI；并用覆盖地理线索与推理证据的30项指标评测视觉语言模型（Qwen3.6-27B、InternVL3-8B）。

Result: 档案在地理与时间上分布不均，受灾害类型、社区生命线（Community Lifelines）与运营优先级影响；融合方法取得40.90% R@1、61.10% R@5、69.45% R@10，但逐年R@1波动于25.00%–65.07%；地理推理表现亦不均衡，Qwen3.6-27B总体一致率67%，InternVL3-8B为51%，两模型在局部化、地点特定证据上均明显弱于宏观空间格局。

Conclusion: GeoAI的价值不在于取代志愿地理判读，而在于补充：扩展候选检索规模，同时把模糊且后果重大的案例保留给人类判断，从而走向更以人为本、负责任的灾害测绘GeoAI。数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

</details>


### [1214] [Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16261)
*Chung, Jinwoo,Kim, Jangho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Token-Group Quantization，一种面向 Mamba 超分模型的硬件友好激活后训练量化框架：用轻量预测器从 pre-scan 特征推断 token 分组，替代无法硬件实现的 post-scan 分组，并以频域保持精炼目标校准裁剪边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba 的选择性扫描是输入依赖的状态空间算子，不同空间 token 的激活范围差异大，单层统一裁剪范围无法匹配所有 token；而理论上最优的 post-scan 分组在静态低比特推理中无法运行时执行。

Method: 1) 静态近似 post-scan 分组 oracle，将偏好裁剪范围相近的 token 归为同组；2) 校准时对 post-scan 激活描述子聚类生成伪标签，训练轻量预测器从 pre-scan 特征预测分组；3) 推理时冻结预测器查表选取离线校准的组级裁剪边界，无需运行时统计、动态更新或 post-scan 分组；4) 提出频域保持精炼（FPR）目标，在裁剪边界校准中对齐全精度教师与量化学生的傅里叶幅值与相位以保留高频结构。

Result: 在多种 PTQ 协议、比特宽度、主干与任务上一致优于已有 Mamba 与超分 PTQ 基线；可迁移到 Transformer 超分与 Vision Mamba 分类；可与基于旋转的量化组合；在 Jetson Orin Nano 上相对 FP16 取得 2.23 倍加速。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了一个无需运行时开销、可直接部署的 Mamba 超分低比特量化方案，兼顾精度与硬件效率，并具备跨架构与跨任务的泛化性。

Abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

</details>


### [1215] [XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16478)
*Yao, Wei,Wang, Chuyao,Wang, Ziwei,Aouf, Nabil*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出XAI引导的傅里叶域泛化框架XFD，用于纯仿真的视觉自动驾驶sim-to-real强化学习，通过可解释性归因图生成策略条件化的频谱扰动，构建鲁棒视觉域，在仿真与零样本真机部署中提升行驶距离与回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉自动驾驶策略在仿真中训练后迁移到真实世界常出现严重性能退化。现有sim-to-real方法存在两类缺陷：图像迁移式域适应需大量目标域数据且局限于部署域；策略无关的域随机化引入无引导扰动，未必对应真实的sim-to-real差异，导致迁移次优。

Method: XFD框架：从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图（XAI attribution maps），将其转化为策略条件化的傅里叶域干预；扰动外观敏感的低频/高频频谱分量，同时保留定义任务的空间结构，从而完全在仿真内构造增强鲁棒的视觉域；随后采用鲁棒策略优化，引导策略关注任务关键特征、抑制对无关视觉信息的敏感性。

Result: 在仿真实验与零样本真机部署中，XFD在行驶距离与回报上稳定优于标准策略和随机域随机化基线，在背景杂乱、未见地图上优势尤为明显；基于归因的分析表明，所提策略在仿真与真实观测间保持了更一致的任务相关视觉证据。

Conclusion: XAI归因可作为有信息量的先验来引导频谱域扰动，实现无需目标域数据的纯仿真sim-to-real泛化；该方法提升策略鲁棒性与视觉证据一致性，为视觉自主驾驶的域泛化提供可解释的新路径。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

</details>


### [1216] [G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16558)
*Gui, Ke,Shi, Chenghao,Wang, Ziyue,Chen, Longwen,Chen, Xieyuanli,Lu, Huimin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: G²WAM：面向图像目标导航的几何锚定世界-动作模型，在潜空间联合预测未来状态与动作，无需显式3D重建或CEM规划，轨迹预测ATE/RPE降低约40%/35%，闭环导航成功率54%→63%、SPL 36.4%→59.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像目标导航中目标常在视野外，智能体既需建模环境动态，又需维持持久空间记忆。现有方法要么在目标任务上微调预训练模型、浪费其空间先验，要么依赖外部3D重建，计算开销大、难以实际部署。

Method: 提出G²WAM：(1) 学习式场景坐标定位模块，将当前帧、目标帧与历史帧锚定到统一参考系，提供稳定一致的空间上下文；(2) 遵循world-action-model范式，联合预测未来状态与动作，省去CEM式规划；(3) 全程在潜空间运行，避免像素级重建，显著降低推理成本。

Result: 四个轨迹预测基准上平均ATE降低40.1%、RPE降低35.2%；闭环导航成功率由54.0%提升至63.0%，SPL由36.4%提升至59.2%，同时保持高效率；无需显式3D重建。

Conclusion: 几何锚定的空间记忆与世界-动作联合建模，可在无显式3D重建、无CEM规划的条件下高效实现图像目标导航，空间一致性与效率兼得。

Abstract: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. Following the world-action-model paradigm, G$^2$WAM jointly predicts future states and actions, eliminating the need for costly cross-entropy method (CEM) style planning. In addition, G$^2$WAM operates entirely in latent space, avoiding the computational burden of pixel-level reconstruction and substantially reducing inference cost. Across four trajectory prediction benchmarks, G$^2$WAM reduces average ATE and RPE by 40.1% and 35.2%, respectively. In closed-loop navigation experiments, it improves the success rate from 54.0% to 63.0% and the success weighted by path length (SPL) from 36.4% to 59.2%, while maintaining high efficiency.

</details>


### [1217] [Acceptable Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16881)
*van Lier, Maud,Marinucci, Ludovica,Santucci, Vieri Giuliano,Chatila, Raja,Doncieux, Stéphane,Garrabé, Émiland,Duro, Richard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文论证价值对齐问题在理论与实践上均无法完全实现，主张从"最大化对齐"转向"使错位事件可接受"的条件，提出"可接受错位"概念、规范性要求及新的方法论框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向开放式学习的自主机器人在设计阶段存在部署方式、学习内容及基于所学行动方式的诸多未知，如何在伦理上稳妥地开发这类系统成为核心难题。现有回应是让机器人活动与目标尽量对齐人类价值（价值对齐问题），但作者认为最大化对齐的进路无法处理"实施对齐方法后残余错位风险仍可能不被社会接受"这一情形。

Method: 概念分析与规范论证：首先分析价值对齐问题所面临的系列挑战，论证完全对齐在理论与实践上的不可能性；随后进行视角转换，从对齐最大化转向错位可接受性的条件分析；进而提出"可接受错位"概念，并给出针对对齐机制的规范性要求，最后构建由可满足这些要求的对齐机制组成的方法论框架。

Result: 论证得出完全对齐不可能、错位事件将持续发生，因此以对齐最大化为目标的现有方法在规范性上不充分；据此提出的规范性要求与机制框架为设计者提供了在残余风险下仍具伦理性开发路径的组织原则（属概念与框架层面的成果，无实证数据）。

Conclusion: 自主机器人伦理设计应从追求对齐最大化转向界定并满足错位事件可接受的条件；"可接受错位"概念及相应方法论框架为对齐机制的设计与评估提供了新的规范基础。

Abstract: There is a specific challenge designers face in developing autonomous robots capable of open-ended learning. This challenge is how one can develop such systems in an ethically sound way when there are many unknowns during design time about their manner of deployment, what they can and will learn, and how these systems will act on the basis of what they have learned. One response to this challenge is to align, as far as possible, the activities and goals of autonomous robots with human values, raising the question of how to make this alignment possible, a question known as the value alignment problem. We argue that the value alignment problem faces a number of challenges that show that full alignment is both theoretically and practically impossible, meaning that misalignment incidents will keep occurring. This undermines current alignment approaches, as the attempt to maximize alignment cannot properly deal with the possibility that the risk of misalignment that remains after alignment methods have been implemented might still be unacceptable to society. To overcome this difficulty, we argue that a shift in perspective is required from a focus on the maximization of alignment to the conditions under which misalignment incidents become acceptable. In this paper, we explore what this shift in perspective entails. We introduce the concept of acceptable misalignment, formulate normative requirements for alignment mechanisms aimed at bringing misalignment incidents to an acceptable level, and we conclude by presenting a new methodological framework that consists of alignment mechanisms that can meet these requirements.

</details>


### [1218] [Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16895)
*Szlatincsán, Adrián,Ziliotto, Filippo,Lepri, Bruno,Serafini, Luciano,Luca, Massimiliano,Campari, Tommaso*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在PARTNR基准上，将Habitat多智能体零样本ReAct规划器置于严格个体感知的"解耦部分可观测"设定，系统消融伙伴状态观测(OAS)、物体知识交换(KE)、伙伴下一动作预测(OANA)三要素，发现OAS提升任务质量、KE提升执行效率，而显式预测反而多数情况下降成功率，协调收益主要来自对共享上下文的响应而非显式心理建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为具身智能体高层控制器已较常见，但其是否支持无对话的实时协作推理尚不明确。作者希望厘清：仅共享感知、不共享意图/计划/任务级信息的条件下，观测伙伴状态、交换物体知识、预测伙伴下一步动作，分别如何影响协作结果与角色对称性。

Method: 基于Habitat的PARTNR多智能体协作基准，提出"解耦部分可观测(Decoupled Partial Observability)"机制以强制严格个体感知；在去中心化零样本ReAct规划器上分别加入三项组件——伙伴状态观测(OAS)、同处一地智能体间的物体知识交换(KE)、伙伴下一动作预测(OANA)；在完整2×2×2组合网格上用四种规划器、1000个验证任务进行评测。
