Result: OAS观测提升任务质量并减少所有规划器的多余动作；KE主要提升执行效率，模拟步数最多减少25%，成功率变化很小。两者对强规划器大体冗余，对最弱规划器互补，且"仅KE无OAS"是最差配置。OANA预测在16个"模型×上下文"组合中有15个降低成功率，但把显式提及伙伴的比例提高到55–100%；其准确率收益主要来自粗粒度动作类型，部分原因是智能体识别的是伙伴"正在执行"的动作。机器人比模拟人类更早取物、更早完成任务；共享上下文通过缩短人类独自工作的剩余时长来减少总任务时间。协调收益更多来自对共享上下文(尤其OAS)的响应，而非显式预判，伙伴建模呈浅层且依赖规划器的特征。

Conclusion: 在无意图通信的严格个体感知设定下，LLM多智能体协作的收益主要来自对伙伴状态等共享上下文的被动响应，而非显式动作预测；显式预判甚至有害。当前LLM规划器对伙伴的建模是浅层且依赖具体规划器的，协作推理能力有限，角色亦非对称。

Abstract: LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. OAS observation improves task quality, reducing extraneous effort for every planner, whereas KE primarily improves execution efficiency, cutting simulation steps by up to 25% with little change in success. The two are largely redundant for strong planners but complementary for the weakest, for which KE without the OAS is the worst configuration. OANA prediction lowers the success rate in 15 of 16 model x context pairs while raising explicit partner mentions to 55-100%, and its accuracy gains lie mainly in the coarse action type, partly because agents recognize the action the partner is already performing. The robot retrieves objects sooner and completes its tasks earlier than the simulated human. Shared context reduces total task time by shortening the remaining duration that the human works alone. Also, coordination benefits arise from responding to shared context, especially the OAS, rather than explicit anticipation, yielding shallow, planner-dependent partner modeling.

</details>


### [1219] [VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17057)
*Ott, Simon,Chen, Yufan,Liu, Ruiping,Zheng, Junwei,Wei, Jiale,Wen, Di,Peng, Kunyu,Zhang, Jiaming,Stiefelhagen, Rainer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VL-DocIR 是一个页面级视觉长文档检索基准，由 29,641 篇 HTML 原生文档渲染为 388,548 张页面图像，含 271,760 条查询，覆盖单页、文档内多页与跨文档三类证据结构；最强配置在结构均衡 Macro 评估下达到 69.3 nDCGAll@10 与 80.6 RecallAll@10，跨文档检索仍显著更难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉文档检索评测偏重短文档与单一相关页，排行榜表现与真实长文档检索场景存在明显落差：回答一个查询所需的证据可能横跨多页甚至多篇文档。论文希望填补这一评测空白，暴露现有检索器在证据完整场景下的失效模式。

Method: 构建 VL-DocIR 基准：从 Wikipedia、arXiv、PubMed 与 SEC proxy statements 的 29,641 篇 HTML 文档渲染出 388,548 张页面图像，生成 271,760 条查询，覆盖 23 个领域与六种证据结构（单页、文档内多页、跨文档）。证据标注锚定到渲染页面与 HTML 元素 ID；查询经清洗流水线过滤，确保清晰性、正确性、封闭性与不出现显式版式指代。评测单向量与多向量视觉检索器，并设诊断性检索设置：文档上下文打分、查询切分、重排序与轮询集成。

Result: 最强评测配置在结构均衡 Macro 评估下达到 69.3 nDCGAll@10 与 80.6 RecallAll@10。按来源与证据结构拆分显示：跨文档检索显著难于单页检索；文档上下文打分对文档内多页查询帮助尤为明显。

Conclusion: VL-DocIR 揭示了视觉长文档检索中此前被掩盖的失败模式，为证据完整的页面级检索提供了更具挑战性的评测目标；数据集与代码将公开。

Abstract: Vision-based document retrieval has improved rapidly, but current evaluation settings still emphasize short documents and single relevant pages. This leaves an important gap between leaderboard performance and realistic long-document retrieval, where the evidence needed to answer a query may span multiple pages or even multiple documents. We present VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval. VL-DocIR is built from 29,641 HTML-born documents rendered into 388,548 page images from Wikipedia, arXiv, PubMed, and SEC proxy statements. It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. Evidence annotations are grounded to rendered pages and HTML element identifiers, and queries are filtered with a cleaning pipeline targeting clarity, correctness, closedness, and the absence of explicit layout references. We evaluate leading single-vector and multi-vector visual retrievers together with diagnostic retrieval settings such as document-context scoring, query splitting, reranking, and round-robin ensembles. The strongest evaluated configuration reaches 69.3 nDCGAll@10 and 80.6 RecallAll@10 under structure-balanced Macro evaluation, but source- and evidence-structure breakdowns show that cross-document retrieval remains substantially harder than single-page retrieval, and that document-context scoring is especially helpful for within-document multi-page queries. VL-DocIR exposes these failure modes and provides a more demanding target for visual long-document retrieval. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR.

</details>


### [1220] [ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17183)
*Chen, Aotian,Baker, Frazier N.,Averly, Reza,Zhang, Shan,Chen, Tianao,Adu-Ampratwum, Daniel,Ning, Xia,Xue, Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ChemExplain 基准（1,180 道多选题，源自 383 篇同行评审论文），首次系统评测模型的"解释性归因"能力：即识别图中哪种结构特征最能解释观测到的化学效应，最强模型仅达 78.6% 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有化学基准多评测结果预测或反应路径生成，很少检验模型能否解释"为什么出现某化学效应"。作者认为解释性归因（explanatory attribution）是化学智能中被忽视的关键能力，需要专门的评测工具来暴露模型短板。

Method: 构建多智能体自动生成框架：从 383 篇论文中抽取分子/反应图像、观测效应与四个候选解释（各对应图中不同结构特征），正确答案由源论文中的支撑证据确定而非由生成用 LLM 臆造；在三阶段实施渐进式质量控制，并由八位化学领域专家进行验证；另设 600 题专家复核子集，用推理链分析对错误进行分类。

Result: 最强模型准确率 78.6%，仍有明显提升空间；在 600 题专家复核子集上，最强模型 71.4% 的错误被归类为归因失败（attribution failure）；归因错误也是开源模型与化学专用模型中最大的错误类别。

Conclusion: 解释性归因是当前（多模态）化学模型的主要瓶颈，ChemExplain 为诊断与改进该能力提供了可扩展、经专家验证的评测基准；未来工作应关注结构感知与机制推理的对齐。

Abstract: Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control at three stages and validate it with eight chemistry domain experts. The strongest evaluated model reaches 78.6% accuracy, leaving considerable room for improvement. On a 600-question expert-reviewed subset, reasoning-trace analysis classifies 71.4% of the strongest model's errors as attribution failures. Attribution is also the largest error category for the open-source and chemistry-specific models included in our analysis.

</details>


### [1221] [IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17234)
*Li, Shuyue Stella,He, Jacqueline,Chen, Jiahui,Roy, Sreya Dutta,Tsvetkov, Yulia,Zettlemoyer, Luke,Ghazvininejad, Marjan,Han, Xiaochuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 IsoVRBench：用"控制变量式"干预生成 8000 对视频偏好数据（8 类属性干预），无需人工标注；据此训练 IsoVRM 奖励模型并在 VBench-2.0 上超人类标注数据基线 3.8 分，同时暴露现有奖励模型在时序顺序等属性上的严重盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频奖励模型在人类偏好对上进行训练与评测，而真实偏好对往往同时改变提示对齐、视觉保真、运动、生成器身份等多个属性，导致聚合准确率无法揭示模型究竟能可靠区分哪些视频属性。作者希望构建属性解耦的评测与训练信号。

Method: 通过受控干预改变生成视频的单一属性、固定其余属性，构造偏好对，从而在无需人工标注的情况下获得特定维度上的偏好标签；据此构建 IsoVRBench（8 类干预、8000 对），并用这些隔离干预对作为训练数据训练奖励模型 IsoVRM，再对生成器做后训练得到 IsoWan。

Result: SOTA 奖励模型能区分生成器间宽泛质量差异，但会漏掉时序顺序等重要特征：在帧重排任务上最佳模型仅 60.8%，人类为 100%，且现有基准排名无法预测该失败。IsoVRM 在 VBench-2.0 上比使用更大规模人类标注偏好数据训练的对应模型高 3.8 分；IsoWan 在人类偏好上优于人类数据对应版本；与人类数据结合时收益可叠加。

Conclusion: 受控干预构造的偏好对是可自动生成、可随生成器演进低成本扩展的评测与训练资源，既能提供更强的奖励模型训练信号，也能显式诊断属性级能力盲区。

Abstract: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

</details>


### [1222] [What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17376)
*Brito, Iago,Rios, Walcy,Fernandes, Lucas,de Oliveira, Kaiki,Filho, Arlindo Galvão*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在 HumanML3D 上受控多 schema 运动 VAE 实验表明，共享潜在空间并不意味着潜坐标可直接互换；少量配对样本即可大幅提升直接兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "共享潜在空间"常被假设为不同 schema 的表征可直接互换，但共享参数、维度或先验并不能决定对应实例如何在潜坐标中表达。作者希望澄清这一假设混淆了"可恢复对应关系""直接兼容性"和"解码器复用"三个不同概念。

Method: 在 HumanML3D 上构建受控的多 schema 运动 VAE 实验：比较原始 Recall@1 与配对 token 余弦相似度、线性校准后的对应可恢复性、cycle consistency 的作用，并考察少量配对片段（如 64 对）对直接检索与 token 一致性的影响，以及交叉解码与原生重建的差距。同时检验降低边际分布差异（marginal discrepancy）是否意味着 schema 不变性。

Result: 即使输入完全相同，原始 Recall@1 仅 5.9--17.7%，配对 token 余弦 0.221--0.484；线性校准后对应关系几乎可完美恢复。Cycle consistency 提升可恢复性，但直接检索与 token 一致性仍接近零。仅 64 对配对片段即可将原始 Recall@1 提升至 88.4--90.3%，token 余弦约 0.82，使多数事后对齐变得不必要；但交叉解码仍显著劣于原生重建。降低边际差异并不代表 schema 不变性。

Conclusion: 共享 backbone 或先验并不保证潜坐标直接兼容；在测试设定下，有限的配对对应关系即可显著改善直接兼容性，但跨 schema 解码仍是未解决难点，且边际分布对齐不等于不变性。

Abstract: A shared latent space is often assumed to make representations from different schemas directly interchangeable, yet sharing parameters, dimensionality, or a prior does not determine how corresponding instances are expressed in latent coordinates. We show that this assumption conflates recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse. In a controlled multi-schema motion VAE on HumanML3D, even identical inputs yield only $5.9$--$17.7\%$ raw Recall@1 and $0.221$--$0.484$ paired-token cosine, despite correspondence being almost perfectly recoverable after linear calibration. Cycle consistency strengthens recoverability but still leaves direct retrieval and token agreement near zero. In contrast, only $64$ paired clips raise raw Recall@1 to $88.4$--$90.3\%$ and token cosine to approximately $0.82$, making most post-hoc alignment unnecessary, although crossed decoding remains substantially worse than native reconstruction. We further find that reducing measured marginal discrepancy does not imply schema invariance. These results show that a shared backbone or prior does not ensure directly compatible latent coordinates, while limited paired correspondence can substantially improve direct compatibility in the tested setting.

</details>


### [1223] [TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17540)
*Lu, Jack,You, Yurong,Li, Boyi,Cao, Yulong,Tian, Thomas,Xiao, Chaowei,Chen, Xiangyu,Luo, Wenjie,Ivanovic, Boris,Pavone, Marco,Wang, Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TacitVLA 提出让动作专家不再关注当前生成的推理文本，仅靠推理监督提升主干表征，从而在保持显式推理 VLA 性能的同时大幅降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本推理能提升 VLA 性能，但每个动作都需等待自回归解码，带来严重延迟。作者假设动作无需真正等待或条件化于推理文本，因为推理监督本身已改善主干表征。

Method: 提出 TacitVLA：动作专家不 attend 当前调用生成的推理文本；在需要推理文本作为情景记忆的长时程任务中，将每条记忆条目在动作执行过程中生成而非动作前生成。在 RoboMME、RMBench、LIBERO、PhysicalAI-AV 四个基准上做受控对比。

Result: 四个基准上均以最高 3.4 倍更低延迟匹配显式推理版本性能；相比无推理同架构最高 +17.1% 成功率。RoboMME Counting 达 82.7%（此前最佳 66.8%），RMBench 77.5%（56.5%），LIBERO-Plus 72.9%，PhysicalAI-AV 闭环驾驶 52.5% 场景分。

Conclusion: 动作无需条件化于推理文本即可从推理监督中获益，解耦推理与动作执行可同时实现高性能与低延迟，刷新多项基准最优结果。

Abstract: Textual reasoning before acting has improved vision-language-action (VLA) models, but at the cost of latency: every action conditioned on the reasoning text must wait for autoregressive decoding. We show that actions do not need to wait for or condition on the generated reasoning to benefit from it, because the reasoning supervision already improves the backbone representation. We introduce TacitVLA, a reasoning VLA whose action expert never attends to the reasoning it generates for the current call. On long-horizon tasks where the reasoning text also serves as episodic memory, it can generate each entry during action execution rather than before acting. We evaluate it in a controlled study on four benchmarks spanning manipulation and autonomous driving, memory and non-memory tasks: RoboMME, RMBench, LIBERO, and PhysicalAI-AV. On all four, TacitVLA matches the performance of its explicit-reasoning counterpart at up to 3.4x lower latency, and matches the latency of the same architecture trained without reasoning at up to +17.1% success. In absolute terms, it surpasses the best previously published results on the RoboMME Counting suite (82.7% vs. 66.8%) and RMBench (77.5% vs. 56.5%), and reaches 72.9% on LIBERO-Plus and a 52.5% scene score on the public split of the PhysicalAI-AV closed-loop driving challenge. Project page: https://tacitvla.github.io.

</details>


### [1224] [Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17549)
*Yelamanchi, Jahnavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在RLBench自然语言指令基准上，比较5种免训练词法排序器在80组随机参考描述下的指令到任务检索性能，字符n-gram TF-IDF最优（61.3% top-1）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究"哪些描述可用于检索"这一参考措辞敏感性对机器人任务识别的影响，并建立一致的评测协议来量化参考措辞与文本表示选择的作用。

Method: 从62个公开任务文件中提取296条固定描述，对每任务随机选1条索引描述、共80组gallery；排除与冲突标签完全一致的字符串作为主分数；比较5种免训练词法排序器（char n-gram TF-IDF、word TF-IDF、BM25等），并测试加入第二条索引描述的效果。

Result: char n-gram TF-IDF平均top-1为61.3%，高于BM25的55.6%与word TF-IDF的54.9%；跨gallery波动55.2%-66.8%，5-95百分位56.9%-64.8%；增加第二条索引描述在匹配查询上提升7.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 参考描述措辞与文本表示选择显著影响指令-任务检索结果，需在固定评测协议下报告，避免单次gallery带来的虚高或虚低。

Abstract: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [1225] [MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17690)
*Wang, Xiaoliang,Chen, Zhuo,Zheng, Chuanyang,Wang, Quanbin,Lao, Jiangwei,Liu, Yingao,Liu, Jiajia,Cao, Jinming,Lin, Honglin,Lu, Zhihong,Jin, Hao,Wang, Jian,Wu, Lijun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedEvo利用医学标签分类与错误类型诊断来引导失败推理轨迹的修复与数据选择，仅用SFT即在多个医学多模态基准上超越教师蒸馏，并揭示失败轨迹中可保留的有效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学多模态推理模型通常依赖教师生成的推理链进行训练，丢弃了学生自身失败轨迹中有效的推理片段；而通用领域的纠错方法对图像阅读、解剖上下文、鉴别诊断等医学特有错误缺乏针对性指导。

Method: MedEvo以医学知识（标签分类体系与错误类型诊断）为导航信号，同时驱动轨迹修复与数据选择。对每条失败 rollout，由"金标准盲"审计器定位首个关键错误并给出最小化、不含答案的提示，学生模型保留有效前缀并重新生成错误后缀；每轮结束后在留出反馈集上按医学标签识别能力缺口，优先补充相关问题进行新 rollout 与修复，最终用SFT训练。

Result: 仅用SFT，Qwen3.5-9B在七个基准上的平均准确率由65.57%提升至69.12%（MedXpertQA-MM多模态赛道由47.40%提升至54.50%），超过教师蒸馏SFT的66.93%；Qwen3.5-35B与397B平均准确率分别由67.91%升至73.04%、由71.83%升至74.95%。分析表明失败轨迹包含值得保留的推理，修复成功不等于学习价值，独立反馈是持续提升的关键。

Conclusion: 医学领域专用的失败轨迹修复与知识驱动的数据选择优于教师蒸馏，失败的推理轨迹中蕴含可复用价值，且独立于答案的反馈机制是持续改进的核心。

Abstract: Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

</details>


### [1226] [Autonomous 3D Visual-Thermal Inspection for Utility-Scale Solar Farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17762)
*Tychsen-Smith, Lachlan,Cox, Mark,Wood, Brett,Haddon, David,Anderson, Kenrick,Duck, Benjamin,O'Malley, Jim,Duffy, Noel W,Moghadam, Peyman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出自动化三维视觉-热成像巡检系统Tricorder，将LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定的RGB/热红外影像及机器学习检测分割结合，实现光伏组件下方资产的检测、识别与三维空间定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公用事业规模光伏巡检主要依赖航拍，仅能发现组件级热斑，对阵列下方连接器、电缆、紧固件和结构件等关键部件的可见性有限；这类缺陷空间尺度小、易被遮挡，单张图像难以稳定检测和定位。

Method: 融合LiDAR-惯性SLAM与几何标定的RGB、热红外影像，配合基于机器学习的物体检测与分割；将检测到的资产关联至重建的三维环境，实现多视角视觉与热观测的空间融合与定位。

Result: 在公用事业规模光伏数据上验证了MC4连接器检测与连接状态识别、热异常识别，以及螺栓、螺母、扭矩管等结构件的检测。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了从图像式巡检向空间锚定自主巡检的路径，缺陷可被检测并关联到具体资产及其在光伏电站中的三维位置。

Abstract: Utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) inspection is dominated by aerial surveys, which are effective for identifying module-level hot cells but provide limited visibility of critical components located under the array, including connectors, cabling, fasteners and structural elements. These assets are difficult to inspect consistently at scale, and their defects are often spatially small, partially occluded and difficult to localise from isolated images. We present an automated 3D visual-thermal inspection system (Tricorder) for under-panel PV asset inspection. The approach combines LiDAR-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) with geometrically calibrated RGB and thermal imagery and machine-learning-based object detection and segmentation. Detected assets are associated with the reconstructed 3D environment, allowing visual and thermal observations from multiple viewpoints to be spatially fused and localised. We demonstrate the approach on utility-scale PV data for MC4 connector detection and connection-state recognition, thermal anomaly identification, and detection of structural components including bolts, nuts and torque tubes. The results demonstrate a pathway from image-based inspection toward spatially grounded autonomous inspection, where defects are detected and linked to specific assets and their 3D locations within the solar farm.

</details>


### [1227] [Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18447)
*Thinker Team,Gao, Peng,Jiao, Jichao,Liao, Chen,Luo, Daqin,Ma, Yiming,Pan, Baiyu,Shi, Hailin,Wang, Jiyuan,Xu, Xiangming,Zhao, Xiongwei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Thinker-WM：以统一动力学Transformer为共享中间表示，联合建模与生成RGB、度量深度与机器人动作，多模态在表示层统一、共享参数演化；同一套参数支持视频-动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作、逆动力学等功能。训练数据约20K小时第一视角视频 + 10K小时真机 + 1K小时仿真（约4K小时真机带对齐深度监督）。在EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena上排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在模态与功能上高度割裂：视觉动力学、几何结构与可执行动作通常通过独立接口或下游模块耦合，而非在同一共享动力学模型内联合表示与演化，导致表征不统一、功能难共享、跨模态信息无法互相增益。作者希望验证"外观—几何—动作"能否在表示层被统一到同一动态表征中并由共享参数联合演化。

Method: 提出Thinker-WM：以Unified Dynamics Transformer为共享中间主干，配以模态专属编码器/解码器。在表示层做多模态统一——外观、几何、动作映射为公共动态表示、由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自输出结构，因此单一参数化即可支撑六类任务（视频-动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推理、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成、逆动力学）。另设计轻量motion probe，验证冻结视觉表征中可恢复运动信息。数据为异构语料：约20K小时第一视角视频、10K小时真机、1K小时仿真，其中约4K小时真机数据含对齐深度监督。

Result: 在具身世界模型评测中表现强劲：EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena三项榜单均排名第一。消融/控制实验进一步显示动作条件、几何交互与多功能联合训练在共享表征内部带来增益；motion probe证明冻结视觉表征含有可恢复的运动信息。

Conclusion: 结果表明外观、几何与动作可以在统一表示层被共享参数联合建模，且多模态统一带来的动作条件、几何交互与多任务训练互为增益，单一参数化即可覆盖生成、预测、策略与逆动力学等多样功能，为具身世界模型提供了一种统一化范式。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

</details>


### [1228] [Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18842)
*Zhou, Hai,Yang, Fan,Chen, Zeyi,Zhang, Lejun,Fu, Chenyang,Li, Jianping,Zhu, Jiayi,Liu, Xianyang,Yang, Yingxuan,Meng, Lili,Wang, Lu,Han, Xinyang,Sun, Jiankai,Ye, Weirui,Wang, Guanchu,Li, Wanhua,Zhou, Ming,Li, Boyi,Jin, Ming,Shao, Kun,Chen, Muhao,Chen, Guang,Ma, Lei,Zhou, Joey Tianyi,Spanos, Costas,Hu, Xia,Schwager, Mac,Zhang, Weinan,Feng, Qian,Gu, Shangding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Physical Recursive Self-Improvement（Physical RSI）概念与 L0-L5 分级框架，系统梳理机器人自我改进在"能力层/元层"与"任务内/跨任务"维度的研究现状，结论是现有文献尚未实现严格意义上的 Physical RSI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人任务执行日益自主，但其能力提升仍主要依赖人类驱动。作者希望探讨物理经验能否同时改进机器人能力与其改进程序本身，使后续改进更高效，从而迈向自主自我改进的机器人。

Method: 提出 L0-L5 分级框架，区分 capability-level 与 meta-level 更新、within-task 与 across-task 收益，并将 L5 保留给经独立验证的递归增益；围绕 harness adaptation（工具/评测框架适配）与 model training 两条主线综述现有方法，并结合安全与控制机制分析执行与连续更新的约束。

Result: 分析表明，尽管自我改进方向已有显著进展，但所调研文献均未展示符合该框架定义的 Physical RSI（即经独立验证的递归自我改进）。

Conclusion: 指出四个关键研究优先级：可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保持与基准测试，并给出兼顾安全性的自主自我改进路线图；开源仓库见 https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.

</details>


### [1229] [GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19100)
*Xie, Qingsong,Tian, Jiahao,Tang, Jiacheng,Li, Zhifeng,Ciobanu, Madalina,Singh, Navan Preet,Mao, Qingqing,Das, Ritankar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ScreenRef GUI 指代定位数据集（58.6万截图、63.3万指代表达）与 D2RL（蒸馏到强化学习）训练方法，训练出 GroundGUI-8B，在多个 GUI 定位基准上取得 8B 规模领先成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI 智能体依赖多模态视觉定位，但覆盖桌面/网页/移动多环境的高质量定位数据稀缺；同时 SFT 泛化有限、RL 存在奖励稀疏问题。

Method: 构建 ScreenRef 数据集（截图+指代表达+框/点标注，涵盖文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解、拒答任务）；提出 D2RL，先 SFT 再强化学习蒸馏，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 训练 GroundGUI-8B。

Result: ScreenSpot-V2 95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro 63.9%、OSWorld-G 65.4%、MMBench-GUI L2 86.8%、UI-Vision 38.3%；8B 规模下优于开源数据训练模型，与闭源数据训练模型相当或更优。

Conclusion: 大规模跨平台 GUI 定位数据加 SFT-D2RL 训练可显著提升 GUI 智能体定位能力，数据与模型开源。

Abstract: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.

</details>


### [1230] [Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19366)
*Guo, Minghao,Jiao, Qingyue,Liu, Xiujin,Pang, Jianhong,Yang, Ruimeng,Xu, Naihao,Che, Liwei,Xue, Haochen,Wang, Ziqi,Cai, Xinying,Luo, Jiaxuan,Deng, Jiaxin,Ye, Xuesong,Qu, Jintao,Gao, Wenyao,Gu, Jingwen,Zhao, Chenyang,Liu, Shichun,Zhang, Guibin,Liu, Zefang,Wang, Siyin,Xu, Wujiang,Li, Danrui,Shi, Zeru,Yeo, Woongyeong,Liu, Shuang,Huang, Wei-Chieh,Zhang, Weizhi,Yang, Tianyu,Kim, Kangsan,Hu, Yebowen,Wen, Bowen,Jiang, Bowen,Su, Haohao,Yin, Ming,Yu, Sheldon,Zhang, Mian,Chen, Yuyan,Zhang, Hanrong,Mei, Kai,Zhang, Zihao,Jin, Mingyu,Zhu, Xi,Wang, Hengyi,Wei, Tianxin,Nan, Linyong,Liang, Zhenwen,Chu, Zhendong,Huang, Ziqi,Su, Yongye,Dong, Sixun,Liu, Shujian,Liang, Kaiqu,Han, Jiaojiao,Fei, Zhaoye,Wang, Kun,Dou, Shihan,Guo, Zhichun,Diao, Xingjian,Gu, Zeqi,Wang, Heng,Feng, Tao,Qian, Cheng,Palangi, Hamid,Xu, Silei,Yun, Xi,Zhu, Yi,Liu, Shilong,Wen, Qingsong,Hwang, Sung Ju,Wu, Zuxuan,Jiang, Yu-Gang,Shi, Yiyu,Metaxas, Dimitris N.,You, Jiaxuan,McAuley, Julian,Wang, Mengdi,Han, Jiawei,Yu, Philip S.,Ye, Ziyi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架：轴I刻画多模态信息的形成与表征，轴II按管理复杂度划分T1静态、T2动态、T3自进化三层记忆，并提炼设计模式、原则与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体在长时程与终身场景中，难以从复杂异构多模态数据中持续获取有用信息，需要能跨会话保持连续性、适应变化用户与环境、并通过累积经验改进策略的记忆机制；而该领域缺乏统一的分析与组织视角。

Method: 构建双轴分析框架。轴I（形成与表征）区分保留何种信息及其编码方式，如模态专属嵌入、文本与结构化记录、隐式与参数化表征；轴II（记忆管理）划分三层：T1静态记忆复用固定记忆，T2动态记忆按稳定策略更新，T3自进化记忆按演进策略更新。基于该框架归纳重复出现的设计模式，推导出四类原则：保真度与抽象的平衡、时间有效性与来源可追溯、将记忆使用锚定于可恢复证据、让记忆策略随经验演进。

Result: 产出以双轴框架为核心的组织性综述成果，给出跨模态、跨管理层级的设计模式与可操作原则，并梳理当前挑战与潜在未来方向，未报告实证实验或量化指标。

Conclusion: 多模态智能体记忆可沿"形成与表征"和"管理自适应"两轴统一刻画，记忆策略应随累积经验从静态走向自进化；未来需在长时程与终身设定下解决证据可恢复性、来源与时间有效性维护等关键问题。

Abstract: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.

</details>


### [1231] [VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19517)
*Shi, Diyuan,Tang, Yiqi,Zhang, Hongyin,Wu, You,Wang, Donglin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VLRLA：在部署阶段为现有VLA模型赋予"上下文强化学习"能力，通过从历史观测、动作、奖励与终止信号中学习，在不更新模型参数的前提下逐步改进动作生成与任务成功率，并验证了仿真学习特性与真实环境未见场景的适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练VLA策略缺乏在部署过程中通过累积交互经验持续适应的机制，无法在部署期逐步提升任务成功率。

Method: 在VLA模型上增加一个强化学习模块，以历史观测、动作、奖励、终止信号为上下文输入（in-context RL），使策略在参数冻结下逐步细化动作生成；框架强调通用性与对多种学习历史构建策略、训练流水线的兼容性。

Result: 仿真中系统刻画了VLRLA的学习特性，并在真实部署中展示了适应未见场景的能力；摘要未给出量化成功率与具体任务指标。

Conclusion: 将上下文强化学习与VLA结合，为冻结参数下的部署期自适应提供了一条通用且可兼容现有训练管线的路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.

</details>


### [1232] [ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20532)
*Hu, Miaobo,Hu, Shuhao,Guo, Xiaobo,Wang, Xin,Wang, Bokun,Zhang, Peng,Zha, Daren,Xiao, Jun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"决策可认证的主动证据获取"框架，用反事实证据交互图(CEIG)与决策加权的包络界、缺口导向细化及ε-决策证书，在多模态智能体的"免费元数据/付费观测"边界下决定何时看、看哪里、何时停止；在640例上达到0.842任务分、1.74次调用、742ms p95，认证一致率0.992。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体需在严格预算与随机向量代价下判断视觉证据是否值得获取、查询哪个候选或分辨率、以及交互何时无法再改变决策；该问题缺乏既能显式界定不确定性、又能给出可验证停止准则的形式化方法。

Method: 构建反事实证据交互图(CEIG)，表示一元证据价值、带符号二阶交互与有向条件性危害，并为未解析交互维护显式分数包络；用决策加权包络目标收紧能改变动作身份的界，采用缺口导向细化只评估可能替换当前获取动作的交互项，直至ε-决策证书成立；证书是模型相对的(在冻结的学习打分下验证策略一致最优)，语义质量由冻结后标签单独度量；用配对续演(paired continuation rollouts)学习付费预览的下游价值，在线运行代价过滤器与独立有限策略族轨迹认证分离，并由独立实现的验证器把每份证书绑定到冻结执行轨迹。

Result: 在640例(384/128/128训练/验证/测试)上，控制器任务分0.842、grounding F1 0.816、证据召回0.873、1.74次被接受调用、286.5K视觉token、p95延迟742ms；对已发证书的稠密复演得到0.992动作一致率与0.988证书率，且每决策仅评估19.6个昂贵交互项(对比191.4)。

Conclusion: 该方法以"模型相对证书"为代价换取了可验证的提前停止与大幅计算节省，在不重训冻结打分的前提下提供策略一致最优的决策保证；局限在于认证正确性仅相对于冻结的模型打分与有限策略族，语义质量需外部标签，真实部署与跨任务泛化证据尚未给出。

Abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $\epsilon$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

</details>


### [1233] [PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20560)
*Lyu, Weichen,Xia, Chong,Dong, Mingyu,Xu, Long,Zhang, Shengjun,Duan, Yueqi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PhySGA——一个"物理空间具身"的智能体框架，通过智能体探索与物理仿真实现通用交互式 3D 物体组合（刚体、铰接体、可变形体）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么用 LLM 直接预测物体坐标，要么用生成式扩散先验合成图像做视觉对齐，均依赖数字空间中的静态先验，难以处理精确悬挂、重力沉降、隐藏容纳等需要全局规划、细粒度对齐与物理仿真的复杂组合任务。

Method: 协作式前馈-反馈架构：Assembly Agent 负责几何与运动学推理，做全局步骤规划与粗调；Critic Agent 基于接触动力学推理，进行仿真器状态诊断与细粒度闭环修正。Action Router 将语义规划与分析映射为仿真器中可执行的物理基元；任务特定的自进化技能库将历史试错反馈蒸馏为可复用经验。

Result: 在 Isaac Sim 中的大量实验表明，PhySGA 在关系保真度、物理合理性与视觉质量上显著超越现有方法。

Conclusion: 将 LLM/VLM 直接用于 3D 组合任务不足，因其缺乏具身物理理解与交互构建经验；通过智能体探索结合物理仿真、闭环修正与经验蒸馏，可有效提升复杂 3D 组合的成功率与效率。

Abstract: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.

</details>


### [1234] [When Reality Outpaces Cognition: A New Scaling Principle for Reliable Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20764)
*Adeel, Ahsan,Riaz, Talha Bin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"有效连贯认知速度"S_C^eff作为理论无关的基准指标，衡量智能体在观测-现实差距不断增大时仍能可靠感知、推理与行动的最大"现实速度"，并通过将基线训练好的RL智能体在推理时把S_R提升至最多50倍、算力固定来评测；受细胞机制启发的新架构Co^4显著优于Transformer与门控MLP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI范式与世界模型对"智能系统在现实变化超过多快时不再可靠"缺乏量化刻画，需要一个理论与模型无关的挑战框架来比较不同系统的认知连贯性极限。

Method: 定义有效连贯认知速度S_C^eff为系统从基线起持续满足预设行为可靠性准则的最高测试现实速度S_R；作为概念验证，在基线S_R训练RL智能体（不重训），将S_R提升至最多50倍且计算资源固定进行评测；对比Transformer、门控MLP基线与受意识加工相关细胞机制启发的Co^4架构。

Result: 在所测试场景中，Co^4达到的S_C^eff显著高于Transformer和门控MLP基线。

Conclusion: S_C^eff可作为新的基准，而"连贯认知的可扩展性"可作为构建可靠AI的原则。

Abstract: This paper challenges the understanding capabilities of existing AI paradigms and emerging world models by asking a fundamental question: How quickly can reality change before an intelligent system can no longer reliably perceive, reason, and act? We formulate this as a theory- and model-agnostic challenge in which systems must infer reliable actions for increasingly distant future states across a growing observation--reality gap. We operationalize this challenge through the effective Speed of Coherent Cognition (\(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\)), defined as the highest tested Speed of Reality (\(S_R\)) through which a system continuously satisfies a predefined behavioural reliability criterion from baseline. As a proof of concept, reinforcement-learning agents are trained at the baseline \(S_R\) and evaluated, without retraining, as \(S_R\) is increased by up to \(50\times\) while computational resources remain fixed. We compare Transformer and gated-MLP baselines with \(Co^4\), an architecture inspired by cellular mechanisms implicated in conscious processing and awake thought. Across the tested scenarios, \(Co^4\) achieves substantially higher \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) than the baselines, motivating \(S_C^{\mathrm{eff}}\) as a new benchmark and the scaling of coherent cognition as a principle for reliable AI.

</details>


### [1235] [Temporal Specification Guidance for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20822)
*Khare, Avishree,Okamoto, Hideki,Hoxha, Bardh,Fainekos, Georgios,Alur, Rajeev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的推理期框架TSG，将自然语言中的时序约束（顺序、时机、持续性）形式化为Metric Temporal Logic规范，用可微定量语义对视频-文本注意力轨迹打分，并以梯度构造去噪方向增强CFG，在220条提示、11类时序约束基准上使规范满足率相对CFG提升9.5–20个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文生视频模型常能生成提示中提到的视觉概念，却难以满足概念的先后顺序、出现时机与持续时长等时序要求；现有引导手段缺乏对这种"何时、以何种顺序"的显式、可优化表述。

Method: 把时序要求写成一阶/度量时序逻辑（MTL）规范；以视频-文本注意力轨迹作为概念出现证据，用可微定量语义（robustness degree）对轨迹打分；对该分数求梯度得到规范引导的去噪方向。实现上利用注意力偏置（gradient-derived attention biases）直接作用于注意力前向过程，因此不需要外部概念分类器，也不需要穿过视频Transformer反传，最终以该方向增强classifier-free guidance。

Result: 在涵盖11类时序约束（如物体按序进入、状态转换）的220条提示基准上，该实例在5个模型上将规范满足率较CFG提升9.5–20个百分点，额外显存开销极小。

Conclusion: 结果表明，时序规范与可微满足度目标可作为控制视频生成的一种灵活接口，说明用形式化逻辑约束扩散采样过程是提高生成时序可控性的可行路径，且可免训练迁移到多种现成模型。

Abstract: Text-to-video models often generate the visual concepts requested in natural language prompts but fail to satisfy their intended ordering, timing, and persistence requirements. We propose representing these requirements as specifications in a formal Temporal Logic, and introduce Temporal Specification Guidance (TSG), a training-free inference-time framework that turns temporal specifications into executable objectives for guiding video generation during sampling. TSG scores traces of visual concept evidence using differentiable quantitative semantics and uses the score's gradients to construct a specification-guided denoising direction. We instantiate this framework with video-text attention traces, efficient differentiable scores for Metric Temporal Logic, and gradient-derived attention biases. This instantiation requires neither an external concept classifier nor backpropagation through the video transformer. Its attention-steered forward pass yields a denoising direction that augments classifier-free guidance (CFG). On a benchmark of 220 prompts spanning 11 categories of temporal constraints, including ordered object entry and state transitions, this instantiation improves specification satisfaction accuracy over CFG by 9.5-20 percentage points across five models, with minimal memory overhead. These results demonstrate the potential of temporal specifications and differentiable satisfaction objectives as a flexible interface for controlling video generation.

</details>


### [1236] [MSP: Modality Self-Play for Training Multimodal LLMs Without Paired Cross-Modal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20965)
*Moseley, Robert,Reza, Md Kaykobad,Patil, Ameya,Ayrapetian, Edward,Asif, Salman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MSP提出以"代理文本描述"作为语义桥梁，在训练中不依赖真实配对非文本模态数据的情况下，实现零样本多模态组合与推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型依赖大规模对齐配对数据，成本高、跨模态组合难以扩展，成为继续提升的瓶颈。作者希望摆脱真实配对非文本监督。

Method: 提出Modality Self-Play (MSP)训练框架：(1) 给定观测模态（图像/音频），模型自生成互补未见模态的代理文本描述；(2) 代理描述经预训练对比编码器编码；(3) 通过学习到的模态桥梁与观测模态对齐，实现无真实配对的跨模态交互。核心假设是"代理文本+对比预训练编码器"足以提供多模态组合所需语义结构。

Result: 在多个多模态基准上达到SOTA或具竞争力表现；实现零样本模态组合。消融显示学习到的桥梁改善对齐，锚点支撑的代理描述有效支撑跨模态组合。

Conclusion: MSP去除了对真实配对非文本（如音-视）监督的依赖，但仍需模态-文本对、预训练对比编码器与模态分布桥梁校准，属通用多模态基础模型训练范式。

Abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved remarkable progress by scaling model capacity and training on massive paired multimodal data. However, this paradigm introduces a fundamental bottleneck: aligned multimodal datasets are expensive to curate, difficult to scale across diverse modality combinations, and increasingly constrain further progress. We introduce Modality Self-Play (MSP), a training framework for multimodal foundation models based on proxy-mediated modality composition. Instead of relying on paired cross-modal data, MSP uses anchor-supporting proxy textual descriptions of unseen modalities as semantic bridges during training. Given an observed modality (e.g., image or audio), the model generates proxy descriptions for complementary unseen modalities, which are then encoded and aligned with the observed modality through learned bridges, enabling cross-modal interaction without real paired non-text supervision. Our central hypothesis is that proxy text, combined with contrastively trained pretrained encoders, provides sufficient semantic structure for multimodal composition to emerge. We show that MSP enables zero-shot modality composition: models trained only with a real anchor modality and accompanying proxy descriptions can integrate and reason over multiple modalities at inference time despite never observing real paired non-text data during training. Empirically, MSP achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on multiple multimodal benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate that learned bridges improve alignment, while anchor-supporting proxy descriptions enable effective cross-modal composition. MSP removes the need for real paired non-text (e.g., audio-vision) supervision, while continuing to rely on modality-text pairs, pretrained contrastive encoders, and modality-distribution bridge calibration.

</details>


### [1237] [Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21283)
*Liu, Xuanyi,Li, Ruiqi,Ma, Siwei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Mallea 系统，用编码智能体从文本构建“代码世界模型”，联合规划对象结构、属性与交互规则，支持用户干预、属性编辑与对象纹理记忆，实现构建—干预—记忆统一的文本驱动世界建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码世界模型以显式状态与可执行规则表达世界动态，但如何在该范式中协调对象表示、规则修订与视觉记忆尚不清晰。作者希望围绕同一组对象组织世界的构建、干预与记忆，使后续观测条件化于最新状态与兼容外观。

Method: 让编码智能体从提示中推断对象交互需求，并联合规划对象结构、属性与规则，偏好支持这些需求的紧凑表示；世界在规划规则下演化，可选用户动作进行引导，文本请求可编辑属性或扩展能力并保留未受影响状态；对象纹理记忆仅对白盒定义对象保留可复用外观并随其变化自适应；程序推进世界状态，生成式渲染器将当前结构与记忆外观结合。

Result: 摘要未给出量化实验指标，仅以项目页形式展示构建、引导与记忆能力，属于系统与框架层面的方法论述。

Conclusion: 通过围绕同一对象组织构建、干预与记忆，Mallea 使代码世界模型在状态更新与外观一致性上形成闭环，为文本驱动的可编辑世界模型提供了可解释、可干预的路线。

Abstract: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memory around the same objects, Mallea conditions subsequent observations on the latest state and compatible appearance. Project page: https://lxycopper.github.io/Mallea.

</details>


### [1238] [DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21327)
*Liang, Zhuowen,Lin, Xiaotian,Luo, Yuyu,Wang, Haixun,Tang, Nan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DocPilot：面向多模态长文档问答的智能体框架，通过页面级导航与细粒度证据定位编排求解流程，并结合课程式智能体训练使小模型（4B）具备竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态长文档问答需在跨页、跨模态中寻找稀疏证据并做跨模态推理；现有VLM单次前向易忽略稀疏证据，已有文档智能体又依赖预定义流程或粗粒度动作，灵活性与粒度不足，且大模型驱动的智能体难以被小模型复用。

Method: 提出DocPilot智能体式文档框架：以页面级导航+细粒度证据定位进行证据寻找，并整合局部视觉检查、代码式数值推理、跨模态推理三类工具化能力；提出课程式智能体训练，从单一能力学习逐步过渡到自适应编排，监督信号来自数据可溯的推理轨迹与可执行交互轨迹，从而把复杂文档求解能力迁移到SLM。

Result: 在MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V、MADQA四个基准上，配前沿VLM骨干取得显著提升；DocPilot-4B相比更大规模模型表现具有竞争力，验证有效性与跨场景泛化性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 细粒度工具化编排加课程式轨迹监督，可让小模型获得接近大模型的长文档多模态推理能力，为通用文档智能体提供可学习、可扩展范式。

Abstract: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.

</details>


### [1239] [AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21482)
*Al-Emadi, Noora,Imran, Muhammad,Yang, Yin,Weber, Ingmar,Lashi, Fabjan,Rigodanza, Gaia,Hajzmanova, Ivana,Ofli, Ferda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文是一篇关于AI在人道主义任务中应用的宏观综述，涵盖气候预测、贫困预测、灾害响应与冲突监测等方向，不含具体方法或实验结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐述AI在应对气候变化、贫困、灾害与冲突等全球性问题上的潜力与广泛应用前景。

Method: 综述性论述，举例说明（如AI天气预报、可再生能源控制、卫星影像与社经数据驱动的贫困预测、灾害损失评估与流离失所追踪等）。

Result: 未提供新方法或定量结果，仅为已有应用方向的概括性描述。

Conclusion: AI可作为可扩展、数据驱动的工具服务于多类人道主义任务，但缺乏技术细节与实证支撑。

Abstract: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development. AI has also transformed disaster response and conflict monitoring, providing innovative solutions for assessing damage and urgent needs and tracking displacement.

</details>


### [1240] [DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21755)
*Peng, Yufeng,Zhang, Yixin,Liu, Ziyi,Xu, Zhikun,Yang, Jiarong,Wang, Sijie,Feng, Wenjie,Kang, Qiyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 DeciCAD——一个面向计算机辅助设计(CAD)的领域原生 agent harness，将 CAD 决策空间显式化为语义动作、决策导向观测与持久状态转移，并基于交互轨迹提取因果决策监督，通过 SFT 与几何约束的在线 RL 提升策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 的行为与策略学习受其 harness 定义的决策空间约束，但这一"操作空间"如何影响 agent 行为尚缺乏系统研究。CAD 领域具有持久状态、几何约束与长时程流程等特性，通用编码 harness 并非为此类专业决策设计，导致 token 开销大且几何可用性不足。

Method: 构建 DeciCAD 领域原生 harness，暴露语义 CAD 动作、决策导向观测、环境反馈与持久状态转移；在此基础上设计学习流水线，从交互轨迹中抽取因果决策监督，先做监督微调(SFT)，再用几何接地的在线强化学习进一步优化策略。

Result: 在四个 CAD 基准上，DeciCAD 取得最优 F1 与 IoU，同时相对通用编码 harness 减少 45–88% 模型输出 token。同等监督下 SFT 将 F1 从 0.6883 提升到 0.7437 并优于编码策略；后续在线 RL 将几何可用率从 66.5% 提升到 73.5%，F1 达 0.7880。

Conclusion: harness 所诱导的决策空间切实影响 agent 在 CAD 中的执行效率与策略学习效果，领域原生接口设计是提升专业领域 agent 能力的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). Across four CAD benchmarks, DeciCAD achieves the best F1 and intersection over union (IoU) while reducing model-output tokens by 45--88% relative to a general-purpose coding harness. Under matched supervision, its SFT policy improves F1 from 0.6883 to 0.7437 and outperforms the coding policy; subsequent online RL further raises geometry availability from 66.5% to 73.5% and F1 to 0.7880. These results demonstrate that the decision space induced by a harness materially affects both agent execution and policy learning in CAD.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [1241] [Stochastic Finite-Transition Learning and Exploration for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13095)
*Mirza, Muhammad Usama,Işık, Esin Öztürk,Çukur, Tolga*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: FLEX-MRI 将 MRI 重建分解为少量由 k 空间支撑渐变定义的有限区间，直接学习区间级的有限转移，并结合支撑松弛训练与推理期随机扰动实现随机探索，在少步采样预算下超过扩散/流类少步基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流类生成式 MRI 重建需对局部动力学积分，推理需大量网络评估；少步采样虽降算力但牺牲重建保真度。作者希望在小步数下仍保持高保真，同时不依赖辅助生成采样器。

Method: 按 k 空间支撑的渐进变化把恢复过程划分为少量保留状态间的有限区间，直接学习每个区间的重建变化量。训练时用随机 k 空间采样掩码定义不同支撑的有限转移目标，且预测损失不受单个掩码限制（支撑松弛）。推理时对当前估计的 k 空间系数随机子集施加扰动，使学习到的预测器随机探索替代转移路径，随后通过数据一致性将每个预测状态与采集测量对齐。理论上证明该随机探索在无辅助生成采样器下即可通过学习到的恢复映射与数据一致性产生非零的转移级变化。

Result: 在多线圈 MRI 数据集上，FLEX-MRI 优于对比方法，并保持与少步基线相当的计算效率。

Conclusion: 有限区间直接建模 + 随机探索是少步生成式 MRI 重建的有效范式，兼顾保真度与效率。

Abstract: Generative MRI reconstruction maps an initial source distribution to the target image distribution along a learned recovery trajectory. Common generative methods, such as diffusion and flow, typically learn fine-grained local dynamics whose integration defines this global mapping, hence requiring many network evaluations at inference. Existing few-step sampling approaches can lower computational burden by approximating large transformations from local dynamics, albeit at the expense of reconstruction fidelity. FLEX-MRI instead partitions recovery into a small number of finite intervals between retained states defined by progressive changes in k-space support, and directly learns the reconstruction change across each interval. Because such finite transitions can admit multiple plausible outcomes, FLEX-MRI combines support-relaxed finite-transition learning with stochastic exploration. During training, randomized k-space sampling masks define finite-transition targets with varying support, while the prediction loss remains unrestricted by each individual mask. At inference, FLEX-MRI perturbs a random subset of currently estimated k-space coefficients, allowing the learned predictor to stochastically explore alternative transition paths. Each predicted state is then reconciled with the acquired measurements through data consistency. We theoretically show that this stochastic exploration induces nonzero transition-level variation through the learned recovery map and data consistency without requiring an auxiliary generative sampler. Experiments on multi-coil MRI datasets show that FLEX-MRI outperforms competing methods while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to few-step baselines.

</details>


### [1242] [The Predictability Bias of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Medical Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13237)
*Drexel, Fabian,Kainz, Bernhard,Kather, Jakob N.,Rueckert, Daniel,Adams, Lisa C.,Bressem, Keno K.,Bercea, Cosmin I.*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出TAP-JEPA（ViT-B/3D，113,611例CT），指出JEPA式点预测的"可预测性偏倚"：上下文可预测的解剖学特征被保留，而临床关键的偶发病灶被预测通路系统性削弱，并给出逐环节审计与下游探针证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA通过预测教师对掩码区域的表征来学习，等价于点预测，只能刻画条件分布均值，无法复现上下文无法解释的变化，作者称之为predictability bias。在CT中，重复性解剖结构可由上下文预测，但决定临床判读的散在、局灶性病变往往不可预测，因此"可由上下文预测"不等于"临床相关"。

Method: 构建TAP-JEPA：ViT-B/3D，在113,611例CT体数据上训练，与COLIPRI、Merlin、VoxelFM等SOTA编码器在扫描级分类上对比。通过replay训练时完全相同的masking、teacher与predictor计算，审计学到的预测通路：测Skill（患病率归一化平均精度）；沿teacher方向测量病灶与同一器官匹配对照区域之间的表征位移；做表示替换实验比较对照表征与病灶表征对预测损失的贡献；并在7个扫描级探针中删除最后一层全部病灶token，测量决策裕度变化。

Result: 预测使病灶的均值Skill由0.388降至0.271，解剖学仅由0.921降至0.873。沿teacher方向，预测将病灶表征向匹配对照移动34.7%，将对照向病灶移动13.6%，且距可见上下文越远位移越大。替换可见匹配对照表征比完整替换四类病灶表征带来更大的周围目标预测损失。下游仅改变0.45%以内：7个扫描级探针中有4个在移除最后一层全部病灶token后决策裕度下降不超过0.45%。

Conclusion: 扫描级分类竞争力强，但预测通路系统性压低病灶信息、保留解剖信息，说明上下文可预测性并非医学表征学习中临床相关性的充分代理；训练目标应显式保留诊断性特征，无论其是否可由周围解剖推断。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn by predicting teacher representations of masked regions from visible context. Point prediction summarizes the conditional target distribution and cannot reproduce variation that the context does not resolve. We call this constraint predictability bias. In computed tomography (CT), recurrent anatomy is predictable from context, whereas the sporadic, localized pathology that determines clinical interpretation often is not. We introduce TAP-JEPA, a ViT-B/3D trained on 113,611 CT volumes that is competitive with state-of-the-art encoders (COLIPRI, Merlin, VoxelFM) in scan-level classification. We then audit the learned predictive pathway by replaying the exact masking, teacher, and predictor computations used during training. Prediction lowers the mean Skill (prevalence-normalized average precision) from 0.388 to 0.271 for pathology, but only from 0.921 to 0.873 for anatomy. Along the teacher direction, separating pathology from matched control regions in the same organ, prediction moves pathology 34.7% toward the controls and controls 13.6% toward pathology, with larger shifts farther from visible context. Replacing visible matched-control representations increases surrounding-target prediction loss more than fully replacing pathology representations across four pathology categories. Downstream, removing all final-layer pathology tokens reduces the decision margin by at most 0.45% in four of seven scan-level probes. Together, these results show that contextual predictability is not a sufficient proxy for clinical relevance in medical representation learning. Training objectives should therefore retain diagnostic features regardless of their predictability from surrounding anatomy.

</details>


### [1243] [Radiomics-Based Thyroid Nodule Classification with Label-Conditional Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13387)
*Testa, Laura,Brutti, Pierpaolo,Petrillo, Umberto Ferraro*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出放射组学框架（PyRadiomics + GAM），结合标签条件交叉共形预测为甲状腺结节超声恶性风险评估提供点预测与不确定性量化。TN5000数据集上GAM达AUC 0.89，epsilon=0.09时63%结节获得单标签预测，其余37%转交临床复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有甲状腺结节超声风险分层系统存在显著的观察者间差异，导致大量不必要的穿刺活检。需要兼具判别力与可解释性的模型，并对不确定样本提供量化不确定性而非强制二分类决策。

Method: PyRadiomics定量特征提取；在六个候选分类器中选用广义加性模型（GAM）；Spearman相关过滤后保留36个特征；采用标签条件共形预测（Cross-Conformal Prediction）提供类别条件覆盖保证，标记模糊病例转交临床复核。

Result: 验证集上GAM达AUC 0.89、敏感度0.83、特异度0.82；测试集在epsilon=0.09时63%结节获单标签预测，恶性条件精度0.94，良性条件NPV 0.73，其余37%转交临床。

Conclusion: 放射组学加可解释GAM配合共形预测，可在保证类别条件覆盖的前提下为部分结节给出高置信单标签判断，剩余模糊病例延迟至人工复核，为减少不必要的穿刺提供可行路径。

Abstract: Thyroid nodule malignancy assessment relies on ultrasound imaging, yet current risk stratification systems suffer from substantial interobserver variability, contributing to a high rate of unnecessary biopsies. We propose a radiomics-based framework combining quantitative feature extraction via PyRadiomics with a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) classifier, selected among six candidates for its favorable trade-off between discriminative performance and interpretability. To complement point predictions with uncertainty estimates, Cross-Conformal Prediction with label-conditional guarantees is applied, flagging ambiguous cases for clinical review rather than forcing a binary decision. Experiments are conducted on TN5000, a publicly available ultrasound dataset of thyroid nodules. After Spearman correlation filtering, 36 features are retained and the GAM achieves an AUC of $0.89$, a sensitivity of $0.83$, and a specificity of $0.82$ on the validation set. At a significance level $\epsilon=0.09$, selected to ensure empirical coverage guarantees on both classes, 63\% of nodules on the test set receive a certain (i.e., single-label) prediction, with conditional precision of $0.94$ for certain malignant and conditional Negative Predictive Value (NPV) of $0.73$ for certain benign cases, while the remaining 37\% are referred to the clinician.

</details>


### [1244] [Model-agnostic Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning for Weakly Annotated Bioimaging Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13637)
*Bogahawatte, Jayanie,Seneviratne, Sachith,Maksour, Simon,Do-Ha, Dzung,Qian, Elizabeth,Brennan, Samuel,Keon, Matthew,Ooi, Lezanne,Halgamuge, Saman*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种模型无关的知识增强方法，使ML模型在弱标注生物图像（显微、细胞形态学）上超越自动特征提取所能达到的分类性能，并将其应用于ALS相关的TDP-43核质错位定量分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱标注生物成像数据上的自动特征提取方法因过度依赖单一自动化特征，导致跨数据集分类性能不稳定；同时，ALS相关TDP-43核质错位表型的大规模准确量化仍具挑战，可能造成研究间结论不一致。

Method: 提出模型无关的知识增强方法，将领域知识注入ML流程以弥补自动特征提取的不足；与基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的自监督学习结合，在7种ML架构上进行验证。在三个自建显微数据集和三个公开细胞形态学基准上评估，并用于人诱导多能干细胞来源运动神经元的核水平TDP-43错位分类（三个独立数据集）。

Result: 方法在7种架构上均提升分类性能；与MAE自监督结合时表现最佳，在三个自建显微数据集上精度较次优方法提升2.9%，在三个公开细胞形态学基准上平均提升6.8%。应用到运动神经元显微数据后揭示：蛋白酶体应激剂MG132与氧化应激剂亚砷酸钠（SA）对TDP-43错位的剂量依赖性效应、散发型与家族型ALS供体运动神经元病理的异质性，以及依达拉奉和氯硝柳胺对SA诱导的TDP-43错位缺乏保护作用。

Conclusion: 该流程支持体外细胞图像分析，可推进对ALS相关病理及潜在疗法的理解；知识增强策略为弱标注生物成像中的稳健分类提供了通用方案。

Abstract: Machine learning models are increasingly used for automated feature extraction from weakly annotated bioimaging data, such as microscopy and cytomorphology images. Due to the sole dependency of automated feature extraction, existing methods yield inconsistent classification performance across weakly annotated datasets. Here, we propose a model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that enables ML models to exploit domain knowledge beyond what automated feature extraction can capture. The proposed approach improves classification performance across seven ML architectures. When integrated with masked autoencoder-based self-supervised learning, our method achieves the strongest overall performance, improving precision by 2.9% over the next-best method on three in-house microscopy datasets and by an average of 6.8% across three public cytomorphology benchmarks. We perform nucleus-level classification based on mislocalization of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, a phenotype linked to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), using three independent microscopy datasets of motor neurons derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells. Accurate quantification of this phenotype at scale remains challenging and may contribute to inconsistencies across studies. Application of the best-performing model to these microscopy datasets reveals biological interpretations related to ALS, including dose-dependent effects of the proteasomal stressor, MG132, and the oxidative stressor, sodium arsenite (SA), on TDP-43 mislocalization, variable pathology in motor neurons from sporadic and familial ALS donors, and a lack of protection of the pharmacological compounds, edaravone and niclosamide, against SA-induced TDP-43 mislocalization. Together, our pipeline enables in-vitro cellular image analysis to advance understanding of ALS-associated pathology and potential treatments.

</details>


### [1245] [Can Multimodal Decision Models Classify Breast Ultrasound Images? Benchmarking CLEF and CLEF-Flash Across Prompts and Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13675)
*Minh, Tran Cao,Tran, Hai,Tan, Ha Minh*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 对 CLEF 与 CLEF-Flash 两个多模态决策模型在三个乳腺超声数据集上进行零样本推理基准测试，考察提示设计对分类性能与效率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态决策模型以预定义类别概率输出提供结构化接口，但其在医学超声分类中的实际可靠性与提示敏感性尚不明确，需系统评估以便安全应用。

Method: 在 Dataset B、BUSI、BUS-BRA 共 2818 张乳腺超声图像上，固定模型参数、不做用户自定义预处理，使用三种提示（最小标签、明确分类任务、超声诊断标准），报告准确率、宏 F1、平衡准确率、宏精确率、吞吐量与延迟。

Result: CLEF-Flash 配临床提示在三个数据集上准确率最高（Dataset B 74.85%、BUSI 66.28%、BUS-BRA 51.63%）；BUSI 上 CLEF 配任务提示取得最高宏 F1（64.51%）与平衡准确率（68.72%）；CLEF-Flash 延迟始终更低；混淆矩阵显示良性误判为恶性频发，BUS-BRA 上所有配置均低于多数类预测器的 67.63%。

Conclusion: 性能高度依赖数据集与提示设计，提示增益方向因模型而异；在用于乳腺超声分析前应开展类别特异评估，避免被单一总体指标掩盖的临床风险。

Abstract: Multimodal decision models return probabilities over predefined alternatives, offering a structured interface for image classification. This study benchmarks inference with CLEF and CLEF-Flash on 2818 breast ultrasound images from Dataset B, BUSI, and BUS-BRA. Dataset B and BUS-BRA use binary benign-malignant classification, whereas BUSI includes normal, benign, and malignant categories. Model parameters remain unchanged, and original images are submitted without user-defined preprocessing. Three prompts provide minimal labels, an explicit classification task, or sonographic criteria. We report accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, macro precision, throughput, and latency. CLEF-Flash with the clinical prompt achieves the highest accuracy on all three datasets: 74.85% on Dataset B, 66.28% on BUSI, and 51.63% on BUS-BRA. On BUSI, however, CLEF with the task-guided prompt achieves the highest macro F1 (64.51%) and balanced accuracy (68.72%). CLEF-Flash has lower latency in every matched comparison. Clinical instructions improve CLEF-Flash accuracy relative to the minimal prompt but reduce CLEF accuracy on all datasets. Confusion matrices reveal frequent benign-to-malignant errors, particularly on BUS-BRA, where all configurations fall below the 67.63% accuracy of a majority-class predictor. These findings demonstrate dataset-and prompt-dependent performance and motivate class-specific evaluation before applying multimodal decision models to breast ultrasound analysis.

</details>


### [1246] [RePrior: Measurement-Reconciled Prior Correction for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14102)
*Yin, Mengrui,Ding, Tianxingjian,Zhao, Wufan,Yan, Ziyang,Tian, Yu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: RePrior：面向稀疏视角CBCT的多阶段渐进式先验校正框架，通过选择性校正提议（SCP）、测量约束调和（MCR）与混合残差增强（HRE）提升三维重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角CBCT投影严重不足，学习式重建先验与患者特异高斯重建之间存在两大矛盾：1）先验与当前重建的差异在空间上非均匀，部分差异含缺失的3D信息、部分为先验偏置；2）即使体积上有益的校正也可能与X射线测量（线积分）冲突，空间分离的校正可能作用于重叠射线，其投影响应在残差中相消或叠加，无法独立评估可行性。

Method: 多阶段渐进式先验校正框架RePrior：选择性校正提议（SCP）从先验-重建差异中识别可操作的带符号局部校正；测量约束调和（MCR）联合强制其与患者X射线测量一致；混合残差增强（HRE）在调和锚点周围通过体素域与高斯域的互补自由度恢复额外校正容量。无需测试时真值或个案微调。

Result: 在LUNA16、PANORAMA、PENGWIN上，3D PSNR较R²-Gaussian提升约2.6 dB；在体积质量与观测视角投影保真度上均有增益，骨干匹配评估中在留出视角保真度上取得一致提升。

Conclusion: RePrior以校正可操作性、测量可行性与表示表达力为出发点，提升了稀疏视角CBCT重建质量与投影一致性，且不依赖测试时真值或个案微调。

Abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is severely under-constrained by limited X-ray projections. Learned reconstruction can provide complementary anatomical information, but using it as a prior in patient-specific Gaussian reconstruction introduces two challenges. First, the discrepancy between the learned prior and current reconstruction is spatially non-uniform: some local differences contain useful missing 3D information, whereas others reflect prior bias. Second, even a volumetrically beneficial correction can conflict with the observed X-ray measurements. Since X-ray measurements are line integrals, spatially separated corrections may affect overlapping rays, with their signed projection responses reinforcing or partially canceling in the measurement residual, so their feasibility cannot always be assessed independently. In this paper, we introduce RePrior, a multi-stage progressive prior-correction framework that addresses correction actionability, measurement feasibility, and representation expressivity. Selective Correction Proposal (SCP) first identifies actionable signed local corrections from prior--reconstruction discrepancies. Measurement-Constrained Reconciliation (MCR) then jointly enforces their consistency with patient-specific X-ray measurements, while Hybrid Residual Enhancement (HRE) recovers additional correction capacity through complementary voxel- and Gaussian-domain degrees of freedom around the reconciled anchor. RePrior requires neither test-time ground truth nor case-specific network fine-tuning. RePrior gains approximately 2.6~dB in 3D PSNR over R$^2$-Gaussian across LUNA16, PANORAMA, and PENGWIN. Beyond prior-assisted reconstruction, it delivers additional gains in volumetric quality and observed-view projection fidelity, with consistent gains in held-out-view fidelity in the backbone-matched evaluation.

</details>


### [1247] [Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model for Vessel Extraction Using Physics-informed Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14105)
*Hao, Jinkui,Cantrell, Donald R.,Abdalla, Ramez,Ansari, Sameer A.,Zhou, Bo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出时间扩散桥模型（TDBM），将XCA血管提取建模为图像翻译任务，利用物理仿真引擎生成完全对齐的"含造影剂/无造影剂"配对数据，在无人工标注的情况下实现高保真血管提取，并具备跨模态零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X射线冠状动脉造影（XCA）的血管精确提取对冠心病诊断与介入治疗至关重要，但现有方法受限于血管可见度低、呼吸与心跳运动以及标注稀缺；同时多数深度学习方法仅输出二值血管掩膜，丢失了临床上有意义的血管内造影剂对比度信息。

Method: 核心为TDBM：1）物理驱动的XCA合成引擎，生成多样化且像素级对齐的含造影剂/无造影剂图像对，避免人工标注；2）以扩散桥形式学习跨域映射，恢复高保真血管信息；3）时间条件化引入相邻帧以提升时序一致性；4）血管感知对比损失，利用背景不变的合成配对增强血管与背景的判别性。属于物理知情合成数据驱动 + 扩散桥生成式建模的零样本分割框架。

Result: 在两个XCA血管分割数据集上评测，TDBM一致优于现有方法；在两个真实患者XCA序列数据集上开展阅片者研究（reader study）；在视网膜影像与荧光显微数据集上进行零样本分割测试，验证了跨成像模态的有效泛化。代码与训练权重将开源。

Conclusion: TDBM通过物理知情合成数据与时间扩散桥建模，在无标注条件下实现了优于现有方法的血管提取效果，并展现出跨模态泛化能力，为医学影像中的无标注、保对比度血管分析提供了可推广范式。

Abstract: Accurate artery extraction from X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is essential for coronary artery disease diagnosis and intervention. However, low vessel visibility, respiratory and cardiac motion, and limited annotations challenge existing methods. Moreover, most deep learning approaches produce binary vessel masks without preserving clinically relevant intra-arterial contrast information. We propose a Temporal Diffusion Bridge Model (TDBM) that formulates vessel extraction as image translation and learns from physics-informed synthetic data without manual vessel annotations. A physics-based XCA synthesis engine generates diverse, perfectly aligned pairs of contrast-enhanced and contrast-free images. Using these pairs, TDBM learns cross-domain mappings to recover high-fidelity vessel information. Temporal conditioning incorporates adjacent frames to improve consistency, while a vessel-aware contrastive loss exploits background-invariant synthetic pairs to enhance vascular discrimination. We evaluate TDBM on two XCA vessel segmentation datasets and conduct a reader study using two real-patient XCA sequence datasets. Zero-shot segmentation is further assessed on retinal imaging and fluorescence microscopy datasets. Results demonstrate that TDBM consistently outperforms existing methods and generalizes effectively across imaging modalities. Code and trained weights will be available at: https://github.com/Advanced-AI-in-Medicine-and-Physics-Lab/TDBM

</details>


### [1248] [Exploring the Latent Structure of AMD Severity Using Retinal Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14138)
*Fineschi, Niccolò,Panic, Jovana,Watanabe, Atsushi,Hayashi, Hideaki,Nishimura, Kazuya,Maeno, Yuki,Rosati, Samanta,Balestra, Gabriella,Nishida, Kohji,Nagahara, Hajime*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 以AMD为案例，分析视网膜视觉语言基础模型RET-CLIP的嵌入空间：疾病严重度呈连续谱而非离散类别，这一结构导致下游任务越细粒度性能越差，并用特征归因与表型关联定位关键潜维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜基础模型在多任务上表现优异，但其嵌入中疾病相关信息如何被表征、该分布是否影响下游预测，尚不清楚。

Method: 使用AREDS双眼眼底图像，以AMD为案例，对RET-CLIP（视网膜视觉-语言基础模型）与非视网膜编码器进行对比：先刻画嵌入空间中AMD严重度的分布结构，再在三种粒度递增的临床任务上评估分类性能，最后结合特征归因、统计表型关联与定性图像分析识别最具影响力的潜维。

Result: RET-CLIP将AMD严重度表征为连续谱而非离散类别，健康期与晚期分离更清晰、中间期重叠；下游平衡准确率由二分类AMD的0.844、Late-AMD的0.814降至六分类分级的0.446；关键潜维与drusen沉积、色素改变及晚期视网膜病变等表型显著相关。

Conclusion: 基础模型表征结构决定临床预测任务的难度，表征层面的分析有助于理解疾病组织方式并提升可解释性。

Abstract: Retinal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, yet relatively little is known about how disease-related information is represented within their learned embeddings and whether this distribution influences downstream prediction performance. In this work, we use Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) as a case study to investigate how disease severity is represented within the embedding space of RET-CLIP, a retinal vision-language foundation model, using bilateral fundus images from the AREDS dataset, benchmarked against non-retinal encoders. We first characterize the distribution of AMD severity within the learned representation space and then evaluate how this structure influences classification performance across three clinically relevant task formulations of increasing granularity. Finally, we analyze the most influential latent dimensions combining feature attribution, statistical phenotype association, and qualitative image analyses. Our results show that RET-CLIP represents AMD severity as a continuous spectrum rather than a set of discrete categories, with healthy and advanced disease stages exhibiting clearer separation than intermediate ones. This organization was reflected in downstream performance, which decreased from a balanced accuracy of 0.844 and 0.814 for binary AMD and Late-AMD detection respectively to 0.446 for six-class grading. Furthermore, the most influential latent dimensions were statistically associated to distinct retinal phenotypes, including drusen accumulation, pigmentary alterations, and advanced retinal lesions. These findings suggest that the structure of retinal foundation-model representations influences the difficulty of clinically relevant prediction tasks and demonstrate the potential of representation-level analysis for understanding disease organization and improving interpretability.

</details>


### [1249] [Frozen Site-Probe Accuracy Is Not a Standalone Harmonization Score: An Audit of Evaluation Practice for Multi-Site MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14140)
*Islam, Muhammad Muqsit,Cuenco, Gloria García,Martínez, José M.,Coupé, Pierrick*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文审计了"冻结站点探针准确率下降即代表站点效应被去除"这一常见MRI谐调评估做法，发现在ABIDE I上该指标严重依赖探针训练随机性，且可被高斯模糊等非谐调操作人为压低，而重新训练的探针仍能恢复站点信息，建议报告多探针收敛结果与谐调域上的探针及目标对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像级MRI谐调（harmonization）通常用"冻结的站点分类探针"评估：在原始扫描上训练，直接用于谐调后扫描，准确率下降被视为站点效应被去除的证据。作者认为这一"判决"可能依赖探针训练方式而非真正反映站点信息是否被移除，因此需要系统性审计。

Method: 在ABIDE I（1112例T1加权扫描，17个站点）上，使用7种谐调方法产生的10组输出，并加入随机性、头形、强度、预处理、目标对齐等对照。比较不同随机种子训练的探针、在谐调后扫描上重新训练的探针、以及仅用强度直方图的探针在原始/谐调扫描上的平衡准确率，并测试高斯模糊等非谐调扰动的影响。

Result: 同一CycleGAN输出上，不同随机种子的冻结探针平衡准确率从0.13到0.59（随机水平0.06）；高斯模糊（增大到目标站点的强度距离）即可将冻结探针准确率压至随机水平。在冻结探针失效处，重训练探针仍能恢复站点：HACA3输出上冻结探针0.25，重训练探针0.75，仅用强度直方图0.71。

Conclusion: 冻结探针准确率低并不能证明站点信息已被移除。建议评估时报告多个训练至收敛的探针、在谐调扫描上训练的探针，以及目标对齐结果。

Abstract: Image-level MRI harmonization is often evaluated with a frozen site probe, a site classifier trained on raw scans and applied unchanged to harmonized ones: a drop in its accuracy is read as removal of site effects. We audit this practice on ABIDE I (1,112 T1-weighted scans, 17 sites) with ten output sets from seven harmonization methods and controls for chance, head shape, intensity, preprocessing and target alignment. We find that this verdict depends on how the probe is trained, even among probes that classify raw scans well: across random seeds, its balanced accuracy on the same CycleGAN outputs ranges from 0.13 to 0.59 (chance: 0.06). Low frozen-probe accuracy can also arise without harmonization: a Gaussian blur, which increases the intensity distance to the target site, lowers this accuracy to chance. Moreover, where the frozen probe fails, probes trained on the harmonized scans still recover the site, even from intensity histograms alone: on HACA3 outputs, the frozen probe scores 0.25, a probe trained on those outputs 0.75, and one using only their intensity histograms 0.71. Low frozen-probe accuracy therefore does not show that site information has been removed. We recommend reporting several probes trained to convergence, probes trained on harmonized scans, and target alignment.

</details>


### [1250] [C$^2$LUE: Clinically Aligned Patient-Level Ultrasound Diagnosis via Evidence-Aware Multi-Instance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14143)
*Zhang, Qin-Yi,Cao, Linying,Huang, De-Xing,Lin, Haichuan,Yang, Yi,Wang, Manzhi,Zhou, Xiao-Hu,Chen, Chen,Wang, Shuangyi,Hou, Zeng-Guang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出C²LUE框架，将证据感知的多查询交叉注意力聚合与风险对齐的动态权衡正则化结合，用于患者级超声诊断，在甲状腺与乳腺活检数据集上同时提升判别力并平衡灵敏度-特异度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者级超声诊断不仅要求高预测精度，还需缓解非对称的诊断风险（漏诊与误诊代价不同）。多实例学习虽适合建模多视角检查，但常规聚合器会稀释异质诊断线索，且仅优化全局精度，导致灵敏度-特异度权衡不理想，只能靠事后阈值调整。

Method: C²LUE基于LoRA适配的DINOv3骨干，采用多查询（multi-query）交叉注意力机制，从超声序列中显式提取并解耦多种形态学模式，以保留证据异质性、防止单模态注意力坍缩；同时引入动态权衡正则化目标，在训练中惩罚灵敏度-特异度失衡，使学习到的分数分布趋向更均衡的工作区间。

Result: 在患者级、活检证实的甲状腺与乳腺超声数据集上，C²LUE持续优于既有方法，兼具较强判别力与更均衡的错误分布。

Conclusion: 将强判别能力与均衡错误谱结合，C²LUE为真实世界超声筛查与诊断提供了有前景的解决方案。

Abstract: Patient-level ultrasound diagnosis demands not only high predictive accuracy but also clinically aligned mitigation of asymmetric diagnostic risks. While Multi-Instance Learning (MIL) effectively models routine multi-view exams, standard aggregators often dilute heterogeneous diagnostic cues and optimize solely for global accuracy. This frequently yields undesirable sensitivity-specificity trade-offs. To bridge this gap, we propose C$^2$LUE, a novel MIL framework coupling evidence aware aggregation with risk-aligned regularization. To preserve evidence heterogeneity and prevent unimodal attention collapse, C$^2$LUE employs a multi-query cross-attention mechanism built upon a LoRA-adapted DINOv3 backbone.
