Multiple latent queries explicitly extract and disentangle diverse morphological patterns from the ultrasound sequence. Furthermore, to improve clinical risk alignment, we introduce a dynamic trade-off regularization objective that penalizes sensitivity-specificity imbalance during training. Rather than leaving the clinical trade-off entirely to post-hoc threshold adjustment, this objective encourages the learned score distribution toward a more balanced operating region. Extensive evaluations on patient-level, biopsy-proven thyroid and breast ultrasound datasets demonstrate that C$^2$LUE consistently outperforms prior alternatives. By uniting strong discrimination with a balanced error profile, C$^2$LUE provides a promising solution for real-world ultrasound screening and diagnosis.

</details>


### [1251] [Beyond Discrimination: Evaluating Probability Calibration in Radiomics-Image Fusion for Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14151)
*Liang, Yuan,May, Morgan,Campbell, Abraham,Bhattacharjee, Sourav,Caton, Simon,Dondio, Pierpaolo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 在KiTS23的396例肾细胞癌患者上系统评估radiomics-影像融合模型是否在区分度之外还能提升概率预测质量；17个单模型与4个概率平均集成在区分度、校准与proper scoring上对比，融合在12组配对比较中AUC/AP全部提升，Brier/NLL提升11组、ECE提升8组，概率平均集成在四个模型族中同时改善区分度与校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射组学-影像融合模型在肾细胞癌分类中通常只用区分度（AUC/AP）评价，而临床解读真正依赖的是可靠的概率估计（校准、proper scoring rules）。作者希望验证：加入radiomics是否能在区分度之外真正改善概率预测质量，以及这种改善是否依赖于具体影像架构与融合策略。

Method: 基于KiTS23数据集396例患者，构建四类影像模型族（含3D MedVAE等）下的12组配对"纯影像 vs 融合"比较；共评估17个单模型与4个概率平均集成，融合策略包括concatenation、cross-attention与gated fusion。评价指标包括区分度（AUC、AP）、概率校准（ECE）与proper scoring measures（Brier score、NLL），并采用paired-bootstrap做统计支持度检验。

Result: 12组配对比较中AUC与AP全部12组提升；Brier score与NLL在11/12组提升；ECE在8/12组提升。3D MedVAE gated-fusion模型取得最佳单模型综合表现。概率平均集成在四个模型族中相对纯影像模型在全部五项主要指标上均得到更优的点估计，但paired-bootstrap支持在Brier与NLL上强于ECE，说明校准改善的稳定性弱于区分度与整体概率质量。

Conclusion: radiomics-影像融合不仅能提升区分度，还能改善概率预测质量，但校准行为的改善幅度依影像架构与融合策略而异。提出的概率平均集成模型可在所有研究的架构上同时改善区分度与校准，提示临床概率解读应作为放射组学融合模型的常规评价维度。

Abstract: Reliable probability estimates are important for the clinical interpretation of machine-learning classifiers, yet radiomics--image fusion models for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) are commonly evaluated primarily by discrimination. Using 396 patients from the KiTS23 dataset, we evaluated whether adding radiomics to four image-model families improved probabilistic performance in addition to discrimination. Seventeen individual models and four probability-average ensembles were assessed using discrimination, probability calibration, and proper scoring measures. Across 12 matched image-only versus fusion comparisons, AUC and AP improved in all 12, while Brier score and negative log likelihood (NLL) improved in 11 of 12 and expected calibration error (ECE) in eight of 12. The 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model achieved the strongest overall individual-model profile. Probability averaging across concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion produced favourable point estimates across all five primary metrics relative to image-only models in all four families, although paired-bootstrap support was stronger for Brier score and NLL than for ECE. These findings show that radiomics--image fusion can improve probabilistic prediction quality beyond discrimination, while calibration behaviour varies across image architectures and fusion strategies. We show that our proposed probability-average ensemble models improve discrimination and calibration simultaneously across all architectures in the study.

</details>


### [1252] [Beyond Gate Weights: Decision-Level Interpretation of Radiomics-Image Feature Fusion for RCC Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14152)
*Liang, Yuan,Bhattacharjee, Sourav,Campbell, Abraham*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 在固定3D MedVAE-影像组学融合模型中区分"结构门控权重"与"决策级分支贡献"，提出有效影像组学主导度指标，发现二者严重不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 门控系数只描述融合层如何加权中间特征，未必反映分支在分类器输出端的实际贡献幅度；作者希望澄清门控特征融合中"结构权重"与"有效贡献"的本质差异。

Method: 固定一个3D MedVAE-影像组学模型（增强CT区分透明细胞与非透明细胞肾细胞癌）。因分类头为线性，二分类logit可精确分解为门控图像项、直接影像组学项与偏置。定义"有效影像组学主导度"=直接影像组学项占非偏置分支贡献绝对值之和的比例，并与结构影像组学权重比较；辅以分支定向置换、积分梯度与Shapley式分析。

Result: 结构影像组学权重均值0.823，而有效影像组学主导度仅0.148，逐样本关联弱（ρ=0.290）；门控图像项保留的判别排序信息显著强于直接影像组学项；外部探索性评估复现同一结构-有效差异。

Conclusion: 结构门控权重与决策级分支贡献是门控融合的两个不同侧面，应分别解释；且因影像组学同时生成门控，门控图像项仍依赖影像组学，故加性分支贡献不等于总输入影响。

Abstract: Gate coefficients describe how a fusion layer weights intermediate features, but they do not necessarily reflect the magnitude of branch contributions at the classifier output. We investigate this distinction in a fixed 3D MedVAE--radiomics model for clear cell versus non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma classification from contrast-enhanced CT. Because the model uses a linear classification head, the binary decision logit can be decomposed exactly into a gated image term, a direct radiomics term, and a bias. We define effective radiomics dominance as the direct radiomics term's share of the summed absolute non-bias branch contributions and compare it with structural radiomics weighting. Internally, mean structural radiomics weighting was 0.823, whereas mean effective radiomics dominance was 0.148, with a modest case-wise association (\r{ho} = 0.290). The gated image term retained substantially stronger discriminative ranking information than the direct radiomics term. The same structural-to-effective discrepancy was observed in exploratory external evaluation. Branch-targeted permutation, integrated-gradient, and Shapley-style analyses further identified radiomics descriptors influencing the direct radiomics term. Because radiomics also generates the gate, the gated image term remains radiomics-dependent, so additive branch contribution should not be interpreted as total input influence. These findings show that structural gate weighting and decision-level branch contribution represent distinct aspects of gated feature fusion and should be interpreted separately.

</details>


### [1253] [Generative Quantum Machine Learning Methods for Cancer Detection using Augmented Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15110)
*Knutson, Sophia,Goyal, Nandika,De Luca, Gennaro,Uehara, Glen,Patel, Tanay Kamlesh,Spanias, Andreas*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 利用生成式量子机器学习（QML）为乳腺超声图像数据集（BUSI）合成图像，以扩充训练集；仅用合成图像训练的CNN分类器AUC-ROC达0.802，优于真实数据基线0.760。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癌症图像数据集存在小样本、类别不平衡、训练耗时长、特征生成复杂等问题；恶性样本远少于良性样本限制了少数类训练数据量。作者希望借助QML的高维特征表示、生成式数据增强与纠缠等量子特性利用特征相关性，缓解数据稀缺。

Method: 在压缩后的BUSI乳腺超声图像上应用生成式量子机器学习方法合成图像，构建增强数据集；分别用真实图像、合成图像、真实+合成图像三种设置训练CNN分类器，并在真实图像上测试与对比。

Result: 完全用合成图像训练的CNN取得AUC-ROC 0.802（80.2%），高于真实数据基线的0.760（76.0%）；文中给出三种训练设置的对比结果。

Conclusion: 生成式QML合成数据可作为医学图像分类训练的有效增强手段，在少量真实数据场景下甚至可超越真实数据基线，但研究局限于医学影像单一数据集。

Abstract: Cancer detection using AI methods and image databases faces several challenges, including limited and imbalanced image datasets, long algorithm training times, and high-complexity feature generation. In particular, many cancer image datasets contain very few malignant examples compared to benign ones, limiting the amount of minority-class data available for training. Although classical AI and especially deep learning methods have had some success in providing cancer diagnostics, Quantum Machine Learning (QML) methods may offer advantages through high-dimensional feature representations, generative data augmentation, and the exploitation of feature correlations through quantum properties such as entanglement. In this paper, we propose using a generative QML method on the compressed breast ultrasound image dataset (BUSI) to generate synthetic images and hence augmented datasets for classifier training. In particular, we train a convolutional neural network with real, synthetic, and a combination of real and synthetic images. We test the algorithm on real images and provide comparative results for all three training cases. Our results show that the classifier trained entirely on synthetic images achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.802 (80.2%), compared with 0.760 (76.0%) for the real-data baseline.

</details>


### [1254] [Hybrid Context Forests and Bilateral Viterbi Matching for 3D Rib Centerline Tracing in CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16047)
*Wang, Quan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 开源框架 ribline：通过肺尖/椎体中线坐标帧、混合体素检测器（SCF+3D U-Net）与双侧耦合 Viterbi 全局标注，实现胸部 CT 中 24 根肋骨中心线的自动提取与解剖编号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肋骨展开可视化、骨折检测与手术导航需要全部 24 条肋骨中心线及其解剖编号（R01-R12、L01-L12），但相邻骨融合、钙化肋软骨桥、后凸姿态差异及末端肋骨部分可见等难点使自动提取困难，缺乏开源可复现的完整方案。

Method: 三阶段框架：（1）自动检测肺尖与椎体中线构建坐标帧，并引入后凸感知方位角用于沿肋骨的点排序；（2）混合体素检测器，融合解剖锚定的语义上下文森林（SCF）与轻量 3D U-Net；（3）全局阶段将概率骨架分解为候选曲线，用跨左右半胸耦合的双侧 Viterbi 动态规划分配肋骨索引，再通过模板恢复与法平面居中的 RibSnake 精化曲线。

Result: 在 Siemens Corporate Research 2 mm 胸部 CT 基准（47 训练 / 12 评估）上：标注 Chamfer 距离 2.05 mm，标注 clDice 3 mm 为 0.886、4 mm 为 0.945，编号准确率 97.2%（278/286 肋骨），评估集零假阳性曲线；5 折交叉验证覆盖全部 59 例（1,402 肋骨）时平均 3.64 mm（中位数 2.39 mm），编号准确率 91.8%。代码与预训练模型均已开源。

Conclusion: 该方法在解剖结构提取与全局编号上取得高精度且无假阳性，并开源代码与权重，可作为肋骨分析流水线的可靠基线；但属于医学影像领域专用工作，缺乏跨域泛化与实时性证据。

Abstract: Automatic extraction and anatomical numbering (R01-R12, L01-L12) of all 24 rib centerlines in thoracic CT is essential for unfolded rib visualization, fracture detection, and surgical navigation, but remains challenging due to adjacent-bone confluence, calcified costal cartilage bridges, kyphotic pose variation, and partial visibility of terminal ribs. We present ribline, an open-source three-stage framework combining: (1) an automatically detected lung-apex and vertebral-midline coordinate frame with a kyphosis-aware azimuthal angle for point ordering along each rib; (2) a hybrid voxel detector fusing an anatomically anchored Semantic Context Forest (SCF) with a lightweight 3D U-Net; and (3) a global stage that decomposes the probability skeleton into candidate curves, assigns rib indices via a bilateral Viterbi dynamic program coupled across both hemithoraces, and refines curves via template recovery and normal-plane centering (RibSnake). On the Siemens Corporate Research 2 mm thoracic CT benchmark (47 training and 12 evaluation scans), our pipeline achieves a labeled Chamfer distance of 2.05 mm, labeled clDice of 0.886 (3 mm) and 0.945 (4 mm), 97.2% labeling accuracy (278/286 ribs), and zero false-positive curves on the evaluation split, and 3.64 mm (median 2.39 mm) with 91.8% labeling accuracy across all 59 annotated scans (1,402 ribs) in 5-fold cross-validation. Code: https://github.com/wq2012/ribline Pretrained Models: https://huggingface.co/collections/wq2012/ribline

</details>


### [1255] [Uncertainty-Aware Cortical Surface Reconstruction and Spherical Registration for Heterogeneous Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16595)
*Nielsen, Jesper Duemose,Gopinath, Karthik,Hoopes, Andrew,Dalca, Adrian,Thielscher, Axel,Iglesias, Juan Eugenio,Puonti, Oula*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一个仅在随机对比度与分辨率的合成MRI扫描上训练的神经网络，可从几乎任意MRI扫描中重建皮层表面，并给出顶点级不确定性与fsaverage球面配准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有皮层表面深度学习重建方法局限于1×1×1 mm³的T1加权扫描，无法处理大量低分辨率、非T1w的临床MRI数据；作者希望用合成数据训练实现跨对比度、跨分辨率的通用性，并提供质量评估手段。

Method: 训练数据完全由合成扫描构成，随机采样对比度与分辨率；网络以任意MRI为输入，输出顶点级皮层表面及其不确定性估计，同时回归到fsaverage空间的球面配准。

Result: 在1×1×1 mm³ T1w扫描上与原SOTA深度学习方法持平，并优于唯一能从低分辨率、非T1w扫描估计皮层表面的方法；预测不确定性与低分辨率扫描的整体质量相关，且在T1w扫描上能定位重建较差的区域；球面配准性能与既有深度学习和经典配准方法相当；推理速度快。

Conclusion: 该模型可作为通用、快速的皮层表面分析工具，用于挖掘大规模既有临床MRI数据库，从而发现以往在研究环境中难以获得的疾病特异性模式。

Abstract: Surface-based cortical analysis is useful in many applications as it is a natural way to model the highly folded structure of the cerebral cortex, allowing quantities such as curvature and thickness to be easily calculated. Existing deep learning (DL) methods have focused on 1x1x1 mm3 T1-weighted (T1w) scans, thus replicating classical pipelines. Here we present a neural network that is trained exclusively on synthetic scans with random contrast and resolution. Consequently, it can be applied to almost any kind of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan. In addition, our model provides vertex-wise uncertainty estimates of the predicted surface as well as a spherical registration to fsaverage space. Our model performs on par with other state-of-the-art DL methods on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans and outperforms the only other method capable of estimating cortical surfaces from low resolution, non-T1w scans. The predicted uncertainty, moreover, correlates with overall scan quality on low resolution scans and highlights areas of poor surface reconstruction on 1x1x1 mm3 T1w scans, suggesting that it can be used for quality control. Finally, the predicted spherical registrations prove comparable to other DL and classical registration methods. These qualities, when combined with the fast inference time, will provide the ability to analyze large, existing databases of clinical MRI scans, with the potential for finding disease-specific patterns that would otherwise be infeasible in a research setting.

</details>


### [1256] [Background2Background: a self-supervised background removal framework for high dimensional microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17615)
*Ding, Guangrui,Lin, Haonan,Tang, Rong,Weinberg, Bethany,Ao, Jianpeng,Xia, Qing,Hu, Guorong,Sun, Dingcheng,Yin, Jiaze,Tian, Lei,Cheng, Ji-Xin*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出自监督背景去除框架B2B，利用背景相关性大于信号这一先验，通过局部像素打乱将信号变为等效噪声，从而套用Noise2Noise实现背景去除，在荧光、SRS和MIP成像中实现40倍以上背景抑制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维显微成像（空间、时间、光谱维度）中，复杂背景常淹没真实信号，而现有背景去除方法多依赖配对数据或对信号/背景的强假设，缺乏通用的自监督方案。

Method: Background2Background（B2B）：核心洞察是背景的空间相关性显著高于稀疏信号。采用局部像素打乱（local pixel shuffling）破坏信号的空间相关性、同时保留背景结构，使原本的信号在统计上等效为噪声，进而可直接应用Noise2Noise范式进行自监督背景去除，无需干净标签。

Result: 在荧光显微、受激拉曼散射（SRS）和中红外光热（MIP）三类成像模态上，实现超过40倍的背景抑制，并揭示了此前被背景掩盖的隐藏特征信号。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种模态无关、无需配对监督的背景去除通用框架，将相关性先验与Noise2Noise巧妙结合，展示了跨多种高维显微成像的实用价值，属于计算成像/图像恢复的通用工具性方法。

Abstract: High-dimensional microscopy captures features across space, time, and spectrum, but complex backgrounds obscure signals. We present Background2Background (B2B), a self-supervised background removal framework leveraging the backgrounds larger correlation relative to the signal. Local pixel shuffling disrupts signal correlations while preserving background structure, transforming signals into effective noise for Noise2Noise-based background removal. Across fluorescence, stimulated Raman scattering and mid-infrared photothermal imaging, B2B achieves over 40-fold background suppression and reveals hidden signatures.

</details>


### [1257] [Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition for Building STRATA-S12: An Open SAR-Optical Corpus for Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17680)
*Sanchez-Leon, Christian,Chen, Dongming,Wang, Dongqi*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出 DDSA 算法，将 Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 共配准语料构建建模为分层最大覆盖问题，实现赤字驱动的分层配额采集与人在环修复，产出 STRATA-S12 语料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态遥感数据集多为机会式采集，缺少分层配额控制，且非均匀云覆盖造成地理空洞/偏倚；需要一种在采集过程中主动控制分层覆盖与质量的方法。

Method: DDSA：以(类别×季节×区域)半球校正分层上的约束最大覆盖问题定义采集；强制严格时间配对与多阶段质量门；采集闭环中加入人在环赤字修复阶段；采用赤字优先排序而非丰度优先。

Result: 192 个分层在预算前几个百分点即全部填充；失败可恢复性取决于成因的时间持续性（几何失败如 nodata η=41.4%，云仅 18.8%）；修复环贡献 39.5% 发布对且无质量损失，89.8% 通过人工复核；2,928,370 次采集尝试产出 740,746 对；STRATA-S12 配 STAC/PDS4 侧车，线性探针验证适合自监督预训练。

Conclusion: 将数据采集形式化为分层覆盖优化可显著改善覆盖率与效率，并给出可量化的质量-成本权衡；与 SSL4EO-S12、SEN12MS 的元数据级覆盖比较定位了本语料，跨语料/跨方法的系统比较留待后续。

Abstract: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.

</details>


### [1258] [Augmenting Real-time Visualization in Minimally Invasive Surgery with Particle Filtering and Depth-Aware Occlusion Handling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18422)
*Sarkar, Anuska,Acharya, Partha,Nandury, Vishnu,Basu, Kaustav,Mandal, Subhamoy*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种用于微创手术的实时混合框架,结合增强YOLO检测、粒子滤波与MiDaS单目深度估计,实现器械遮挡检测与深度感知跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术中手术器械常遮挡感兴趣区域(ROI),影响手术精度,需要实时遮挡处理与深度感知跟踪能力。

Method: 基于增强YOLO的器械检测、粒子滤波跟踪,以及MiDaS单目深度估计三者集成;通过器械与ROI之间的距离阈值判定遮挡事件。

Result: 器械检测置信度0.85;深度预测MAE 0.34 cm、RMSE 0.53 cm;体模独立验证MAE 0.65 cm、RMSE 0.66 cm;遮挡检测准确率81.95%,实时性38.7 FPS;外科医生初步反馈具有临床相关性。

Conclusion: 该框架在微创手术中实现实时遮挡检测与深度感知跟踪,具备未来术中图像引导导航与决策支持的潜力。

Abstract: We present a real-time, hybrid framework for occlusion handling and depth-aware tracking in minimally invasive surgeries (MIS). Occlusions caused by surgical instruments often obscure the region of interest (ROI), affecting surgical precision. To address this, our approach integrates enhanced You Only Look Once (YOLO) based detection, Particle Filtering (PF), and monocular depth estimation using Multiple Depth Estimation Accuracy with Single Network (MiDaS). Occlusion is detected using a distance-based threshold between instruments and ROI. Experimental results demonstrate robust instrument detection with a confidence score of 0.85, effective occlusion event handling, and accurate depth prediction with an MAE of 0.34 cm and RMSE of 0.53 cm. Independent phantom-based validation against stereo depth measurements yielded an MAE of 0.65 cm and RMSE of 0.66 cm. The framework further achieved an occlusion detection accuracy of 81.95\% while maintaining real-time performance at 38.7 FPS. Preliminary surgeon feedback indicates that the proposed visualization framework is clinically relevant and holds promise for future intraoperative image-guided navigation and decision support in MIS.

</details>


### [1259] [Focus, Align, and Diffuse: Time-Series-Aware Keyframe Diffusion for Cardiac Dynamic Synthesis from Sparse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19050)
*Liu, Junkai,Wu, Haofan,Aung, Nay,Lima, Joao A. C.,Petersen, Steffen E.,Zhang, Le*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出 CardioFAD，将极端稀疏（单帧）心脏动态合成重构为“可恢复-可对齐”锚点发现问题，用 Focus-Align-Diffuse 范式先合成关键帧再插值，在心脏 MRI 与超声上取得更优的视觉质量与时序一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床实践中只能获得极稀疏的心脏测量（极端 one-shot 情形），而缺乏时序线索导致从稀疏观测恢复完整心脏动态是高度病态问题。ECG 等辅助时序信号虽可提供生理引导，但跨模态表示鸿沟与相位错位使其难以有效利用。

Method: 提出 Focus–Align–Diffuse 范式：核心是学习一组紧凑的锚点状态（关键帧），同时满足两条互补原则——轨迹充分性（保留轨迹关键的运动内容）与锚点对齐性（在这些锚点上促进 ECG-视觉跨模态一致对应）。Focus 与 Align 模块分别针对这两方面优化，Diffuse 采用两阶段生成：先合成关键帧，再插值剩余帧。

Result: 在心脏 MRI 与超声心动图视频上的大量实验表明，在极端 one-shot 设定下，方法在视觉质量、时序连贯性与功能一致性上均优于基线。

Conclusion: 以“锚点发现”视角重述稀疏心脏动态合成问题，通过轨迹充分性与跨模态对齐的联合约束实现最小时序歧义，为跨模态引导的稀疏医学动态建模提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Dense cardiac dynamics are essential for assessing cardiac function, yet in practice clinicians often observe only extremely sparse measurements. However, recovering full dynamics from such sparsity is a highly ill-posed problem due to the lack of temporal cues. While auxiliary time-series signals like ECG provide physiological guidance, effectively exploiting them is challenging due to the cross-modal representation gap and phase misalignment. In this work, we present CardioFAD, a Focus--Align--Diffuse paradigm that reformulates sparse cardiac dynamic synthesis as a recoverability--alignability anchor discovery problem. Our core insight is that resolving extreme temporal ambiguity requires a compact set of anchor states that are both sufficient to recover the visual trajectory and reliable for ECG--visual alignment. We therefore learn motion-salient keyframes under two complementary principles: trajectory sufficiency, which preserves trajectory-critical intra-modal motion content, and anchor alignment, which promotes consistent inter-modal correspondence at these anchors. We implement the Focus and Align modules optimized by the two aspects. Diffuse then performs two-stage generation by first synthesizing keyframes and subsequently interpolating the remaining frames. Extensive experiments on cardiac MRI and echocardiography videos demonstrate superior visual quality, temporal coherence, and improved functional consistency under the extreme one-shot regime.

</details>


### [1260] [DoReMe: Dual optimization of Reconstruction and Motion estimation for self-navigated free-breathing abdominal MRI using Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19120)
*Helo, Majd,Nickel, Dominik,Kuestner, Thomas*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出耦合重建-运动估计算法：用紧凑高斯基元表示自由呼吸腹部MRI的呼吸运动，并在迭代重建中与图像联合细化，实现自导航采集下的运动校正，视觉质量优于常规压缩感知重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由呼吸腹部MRI受呼吸运动影响，产生伪影与k空间不一致；现有重建方法依赖预先估计的运动场或外部呼吸替代信号，限制了适用性与准确性。

Method: 迭代重建在数据一致性更新与运动建模之间交替进行；呼吸运动用高斯基元（Gaussian primitives）表示，并将高斯splatting集成到重建算法中，实现运动与图像估计的联合优化。在4名健康志愿者的自导航自由呼吸笛卡尔GRE采集上评估，含回顾性扫描缩短实验，与正则化压缩感知（CS）重建对比。

Result: 呼吸运动状态重建约需1.5分钟；相比CS，所提方法提升视觉图像质量，尤其在冠状面肝脏视角，并在回顾性缩短的采集中更好地保持解剖结构。属于概念验证性结果。

Conclusion: 耦合重建-运动估计算法较单独CS改善图像质量；高斯基元为非线性呼吸运动提供了紧凑且足够灵活的表征，运行时间可行，支持后续扫描仪集成与更大规模队列验证。

Abstract: Purpose: Free-breathing abdominal MRI is limited by respiratory motion, which introduces image artifacts and k-space inconsistencies. Existing reconstruction approaches often depend on pre-estimated motion fields or external respiratory surrogate signals. We propose a coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm for self-navigated free-breathing acquisition, in which motion is represented by compact Gaussian primitives and jointly refined with the image estimates during iterative reconstruction. Methods: An iterative reconstruction that alternates between data consistency updates and motion modelling was proposed. Respiratory motion was represented using Gaussian primitives. A Gaussian splatting was integrated into the reconstruction algorithm. The method was evaluated on self-navigated free-breathing Cartesian gradient-echo (GRE) acquisition in four healthy volunteers, including retrospective scan shortening experiments, and was compared with regularized compressed sensing (CS) reconstruction. Results: Respiratory motion states were reconstructed in approximately 1.5 min. Compared with CS, the proposed method improved visual image quality, particularly in coronal liver views, and better preserved anatomical structures in retrospectively shortened acquisitions. These findings provide proof of concept for the proposed method. Conclusion: The proposed coupled reconstruction-motion estimation algorithm improved visual image quality compared with CS alone. Gaussian primitives provided a compact and sufficiently flexible representation of nonrigid respiratory motion with practical runtime, supporting further scanner integration and validation in larger cohorts.

</details>


### [1261] [Deep Learning for Atmospheric Turbulence Mitigation: A Comparison Between GANs and Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19274)
*Carrillo, Juan S.,Gilles, Jérôme*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 比较GAN与Transformer两类深度学习模型在SOTIS数据集上的大气湍流退化图像复原效果，并改进湍流缓解Transformer（TMT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大气湍流造成复杂的时空畸变，严重降低成像质量。已有方法缺乏在不同退化程度下GAN与Transformer的系统性对比，也缺少面向不同成像环境的模型选择指南。

Method: 在SOTIS数据集（含多帧序列、多种湍流条件与ground truth）上统一训练与评测GAN类与Transformer类模型；对TMT进行三项改进：精细化的训练策略、引入时间平均帧作为结构先验的增强输入设计、融合SSIM的改进损失函数。

Result: GAN类模型在严重退化、低质量场景下更优；Transformer类模型在中高质量场景、尤其几何畸变校正上更优。三项改进在多种湍流条件下带来一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 给出了湍流缓解中深度学习方法的深入评测，并为不同成像环境下的模型选择提供实践指导；改进后的TMT可作为稳健基线。

Abstract: Atmospheric turbulence creates complex spatial and temporal distortions that significantly reduce image quality. This work compares two deep learning methods for turbulence reduction: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Transformer-based models. Both methods are trained and tested on the SOTIS dataset, which includes multi-frame sequences under different turbulence conditions with ground truth references. Our results show an important finding: GAN-based models perform better in severely degraded, low-quality situations, while Transformer-based models achieve better results in moderate to high-quality settings, especially in correcting geometric distortions. We also enhance the Turbulence Mitigation Transformer (TMT) by introducing a refined training strategy, an augmented input design that includes a temporally averaged frame as prior structural information, and a modified loss function that incorporates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). These improvements lead to consistent performance gains across various turbulence conditions. Overall, this study provides an in-depth evaluation of deep learning methods for turbulence reduction and offers practical guidance for selecting models in different imaging environments.

</details>


### [1262] [Monotone Piecewise-Linear Harmonization of Multitemporal Multispectral Surface Reflectance With Unsupervised Deep Multiview Pseudoinvariant Features Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21183)
*Denaro, Lino Garda,Lin, Chia-Hsiang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出无监督深度多视伪不变特征学习框架DeepMGCCA，用共享卷积编码器替代线性GCCA，结合MAD迭代重加权提取深度伪不变特征，用于多时相卫星地表反射率偏差去除，在Landsat-8/9与Sentinel-2上显著降低光谱角与RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学卫星地表反射率产品因逐景独立大气校正而存在跨成像日期的系统性偏差，破坏不变地物的时间一致性，降低多时相分析可靠性；传统基于MAD的方法依赖线性GCCA，难以刻画非线性辐射差异。

Method: DeepMGCCA：以共享卷积编码器替代各日期独立的线性投影，将Deep GCCA与多元变化检测（MAD）结合；从像素加权典型变量中经迭代重加权策略学习深度不变特征（DIF），并引入重建正则项以保留反射率信息、防止退化解抑制真实时序变化。基于DIF分位数构建四种协调变换（其中单调分段线性变换最优）。

Result: 在4个ROI、4组年度Landsat-8/9与Sentinel-2影像上评估：基于DIF分位数的单调分段线性变换降偏效果最佳，日期间光谱角最多降低2.54、RMSE降低0.015、PSNR最多提升4.04 dB。

Conclusion: 深度不变特征学习可有效去除多时相地表反射率偏差，同时表明非线性表示学习中保留物理意义的时间与光谱信息至关重要。

Abstract: Surface reflectance products derived from optical satellite may exhibit systematic inconsistencies across acquisition dates, because atmospheric correction is generally performed independently for each image. Such residual biases distort the temporal behavior of invariant ground targets and reduce the reliability of multitemporal surface reflectance analysis. This study proposes Deep Multitemporal Generalized Canonical Correlation Analysis (DeepMGCCA), an unsupervised deep multiview pseudoinvariant feature learning framework that integrates Deep Generalized Canonical Correlation Analysis (GCCA) with Multivariate Alteration Detection (MAD) to identify deep-pseudoinvariant features (DIFs) for the removal of surface reflectance biases across multitemporal satellite observations. Unlike conventional MAD-based approaches that rely on linear GCCA, the proposed framework replaces date-specific linear projections with a shared convolutional encoder. The framework learns deep invariant features (DIFs) directly from pixel-weighted canonical variates via iterative reweighting strategy, while a reconstruction regularizer preserves surface reflectance information and prevents degenerate collapse from suppressing genuine temporal variability. Experiments were conducted on four annual Landsat-8/9 and Sentinel-2 acquisitions across four regions of interest (ROIs) to evaluate four DIF-based harmonization transforms. A monotone piecewise-linear transform derived from DIFs quantiles consistently achieved the largest bias reduction, lowering the between-date spectral angle by up to 2.54 and RMSE by 0.015, and raising PSNR by up to 4.04~dB. These findings demonstrate the potential of deep invariant feature learning for multitemporal surface reflectance bias removal while highlighting the importance of preserving physically meaningful temporal and spectral information during nonlinear representation learning.

</details>


### [1263] [Denoising Textures is a Different Ballgame Altogether!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22258)
*Mandal, Saptarshi,Haldar, Oindrila,Bhattacharya, Chirayata,Seelamantula, Chandra Sekhar,Xu, Zhiwei,Pappas, Thrasyvoulos N.,Sharma, Gaurav*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文分析了SOTA去噪器在纹理数据集上的行为，发现仅在纹理数据上微调才能提升性能，但会导致对原始数据集灾难性遗忘，因此主张需要专门的纹理感知去噪器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像去噪在通用场景已取得显著进展，但纹理去噪相对被忽视。细粒度细节（如复杂图案和重复结构）即使在深度学习方法中也常被过度平滑，纹理保真度直接影响生成建模等下游任务。

Method: 在纹理数据集上系统分析SOTA去噪器的行为；对去噪器在纹理数据集上进行微调，并评估其对原始训练数据集的遗忘程度，形成"微调-提升-遗忘"的实证分析框架。

Result: 性能提升只能通过在纹理数据集上微调去噪器来实现；然而这种微调导致模型对原始数据集产生灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 纹理在去噪中需被专门处理，需要专用的纹理感知去噪器以实现忠实的纹理重建与合成，从而惠及生成建模等下游任务。

Abstract: The human brain effortlessly deciphers colors and textures from visual stimuli and reconstructs the world around us, yet preserving such details remains challenging in image denoising. While significant progress has been made in generic image denoising, the problem of texture denoising has remained relatively under-explored. Fine details, such as intricate patterns and repetitive structures, often suffer from over-smoothing even in deep learning based approaches for denoising. In this paper, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art (SOTA) denoisers on texture datasets and show that performance improvements are possible only by fine-tuning the denoisers on the texture datasets. Surprisingly, fine-tuning on texture datasets result in the models catastrophically forgetting the original dataset. These findings highlight the need for specialized treatment of textures in denoising. Since denoising quality directly impacts downstream tasks such as generative modelling, we argue that dedicated texture aware denoisers are essential for faithful texture reconstruction and synthesis.

</details>
